title: Motor Dinamik Tasarım Mühendisi
description: TEI Teknoloji A.Ş. (TEITECH) olarak havacılık motorları ve güç sistemleri alanında özgün teknolojiler geliştirirken; ileri mühendislik, malzeme teknolojileri ve araştırma ve geliştirme yetkinliklerimizi ortak bir hedef doğrultusunda ileri taşıyoruz. TF35000 ve TS3000 motor programlarından yardımcı güç ünitelerine, malzeme teknolojilerinden araştırma ve geliştirme çalışmalarına uzanan geniş yetkinlik alanlarımızla, Türkiye'nin özgün havacılık motoru geliştirme kapasitesine yeni bir ivme kazandırıyoruz. Güçlü araştırma ve geliştirme altyapımız ve nitelikli insan kaynağımızla birlikte özgün motor teknolojileri geliştirme yolculuğumuzda, yetkinliklerini geliştirmek ve ekibimize değer katmak isteyen yetenekleri arıyoruz. Eğer sen de, Eskişehir yerleşkemizde Motor Dinamik Tasarım Mühendisi olarak değer katmak istersen; Sahip Olduğun Değerler: Üniversitelerin Makine/Havacılık/Uçak Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezunsan, En az 2 yıllık yapısal veya dinamik analiz tecrübesine sahipsen Statik, Mukavemet ve Dinamik Mühendislik teorilerine hakimsen, Analiz programlarına (Nastran, Hypermesh, Ansys, Simcenter 3D vb.) hâkimsen, En az bir CAD/CAE programını iyi derecede biliyorsan Motor dinamik tasarım konusunda tecrüben varsa, Tercihen gaz türbinli motorlar konusunda bilgi sahibiysen, İyi derecede yazılı ve sözlü İngilizce biliyorsan, Yeni fikirler geliştirme motivasyonuna sahipsen, Kalite odaklı sonuç ortaya koymaya özen gösteriyorsan, İş birliği içinde çalışmayı önemsiyorsan, Değişen koşullara hızlı uyum sağlayabiliyorsan, Yüksek sorumluluk bilincine sahipsen, Yurt Içi / Yurt Dışı seyahat engelin bulunmuyorsa, Eskişehir’de ikamet edebiliyorsan. Değer Katacağın Alanlar: Projenin teknik isterleri doğrultusunda kendisi ve ekibiyle birlikte istenen tasarımın ortaya çıkartılması, Motor tasarım ve geliştirme projelerinde motor bütünü dinamik hesapları konusunda çalışılması, Motor mimari tasarımından sorumlu olunması, Titreşim test verilerinin incelenmesi, diagnose edilmesi ve raporlanması, Motor bütününe ait hesaplamalarla komponent analizleri için gerekli verinin oluşturulması, Projenin hedeflenen bütçe ve zaman planı çerçevesinde ilerlemesinin sağlanması, Sistem seviyesi proje raporlarını hazırlanması ve üst yönetime sunulması. TEITECH know how ın arttırılması, Tasarım kalitesi ve sürdürülebirliğininin arttırılması.

title: Production Engineering Engineer (Shop Team)
description: Good climate starts with people™ Working at Daikin means working on a brighter and more sustainable future for everyone. As demand for our advanced solutions is growing, we are looking for the right talent to grow and innovate with us. People have always been the heart of our company. That is why we create a workplace where diversity is valued and where you get every chance to unleash your full potential. For Perfecting the Air, Daikin will pursue solutions in the realm of air to contribute to the well-being of the “earth” “cities” and “people.” Who we are? Daikin Industries was founded in 1924, in Osaka, Japan. The global group is the market leader for heat pump and air conditioning systems, as well as air filtration. It is the only manufacturer in the world that develops and manufactures heating, ventilation, air conditioning and refrigeration equipment, as well as refrigerants in-house. Daikin Turkey Daikin, which has been operating in Turkey through distributors since 1978, became an ambitious investor in the Turkish air conditioning sector by acquiring Airfel in July 2011. Today, Daikin Turkey is the company with the widest product range in Turkey in the field of heating, cooling and ventilation with its Airfel and Daikin brands. The head office is located in Istanbul. It manufactures products suitable for different needs such as combi boilers, air conditioning units, fancoils, VRV, air handling units with the latest technology in its production facilities located in Sakarya on an area of 163 thousand square meters. -About the Job- We are looking for an " Production Engineering Engineer (Shop Team) " to join our team in Sakarya, Hendek . What we're looking for? University degree (BS/MS) in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering Newly graduated or maximum 3 years of work experience Excellent command of English (interviews will be conducted in English) Analytical thinking, result oriented, enthusiastic, self motivated, positive and energetic Flexible, and able to adapt to learn PDS (Production of Daikin System) methods and philosophy Knowledge of Kaizen, 6S, VSM, Lean and/ or TPM activities is preferred Knowledge of AutoCAD, Inventor MS Office programs Solidworks basic knowledge preferable No restriction for travel in and out of country Driving licence (class B) Willing to live in Sakarya What do we expect from our new Team Member? To be employed in Engineering departments activities for heat exchanger manufacturing lines Basic knowledge of manufacturing processes and production technologies used in heat exchanger production Improve production line performance on cost/quality/efficiency/ergonomics/safety Follow-up on going projects with project members Cooperation and coordination of solution partners like engineering companies/sub-contractors for project ramp up and implementation phases Continuous improvement and development of lean manufacturing solutions including realization of projects Maintaining lean manufacturing activities like 6S, Kaizen, SMED Support the head of department to achieve objectives of the team & company. **Our policy for the protection of your personal data related to our recruitment announcement, our company, you can reach our lighting texts and application form via https://www.daikin.com.tr/daikin-kisisel-verilerin-korunmasi address or contact us via our contact form at https://www.daikin.com.tr/daikin-kisisel-verilerin-korunmasi for all your questions. We would like to remind you that no special personal data (such as blood group information, etc.) should be included within the scope of these documents.**

title: Machining Expert
description: Founded in 1960 in the UK, REED has grown continuously and become a leading brand both in the UK and the international arena. Today REED has 350 offices with more than 3.000 employees and is providing services across 20 specialist sectors. We work closely with experienced and qualified professionals across a wide range of industry sectors, delivering bespoke recruitment solutions on a variety of roles for mid and senior level. As Reed Turkey, we are looking for a "Machining Expert" with below requirements for our international client. RESPONSIBILITIES Lead and support machining technology projects across company’s global production network Develop, optimize, and implement machining processes and manufacturing technologies Analyze and improve machining concepts, NC programs, and production processes Support machine selection, commissioning, validation, and process release activities Define and drive global machining standards and best practices Support industrialization, relocation, technology transfer, and continuous improvement projects Evaluate and introduce innovative machining technologies and manufacturing solutions Conduct technical trainings and facilitate knowledge transfer across international production sites Collaborate with production, engineering, and project teams worldwide to ensure efficient and standardized manufacturing processes QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field 5-7 years of experience in machining technologies and manufacturing processes Experience in Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or Industrial Engineering Strong knowledge of NC programming, preferably Creo NC or Hexagon Esprit Experience in technical project leadership or project management Good command of written and spoken English Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills Strong communication and collaboration skills Willingness to travel internationally NICE TO HAVE Knowledge of German Experience working in an international manufacturing environment Experience with machining equipment procurement, commissioning, and validation activities Experience in technology transfer, industrialization, or relocation projects Familiarity with global manufacturing standards and continuous improvement methodologies

title: R&D Engineer
description: As an R&D Engineer at BSK HVAC, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and testing innovative HVAC technologies. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to research new concepts, improve existing products, and ensure our solutions meet the highest standards of performance, reliability, and sustainability. The ideal candidate is a creative problem-solver with a strong technical background and a passion for innovation. Key Responsibilities Conduct research and development activities to design and optimize HVAC systems and components. Develop prototypes and conduct experiments to validate new concepts and technologies. Analyze test data and prepare detailed reports to communicate findings and recommendations. Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and marketing teams to ensure seamless product development and launch. Stay up-to-date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory requirements to drive innovation. Identify and implement process improvements to enhance product performance and reduce costs. Support the preparation of technical documentation, including patents, white papers, and technical manuals. Participate in cross-functional projects to address complex engineering challenges. What We Offer Competitive salary and benefits package. Opportunities for professional growth and development. A collaborative and innovative work environment. The chance to work on cutting-edge projects that make a real impact. Perks A full-time position Attractive salary package. Trainings New skills and knowlege Health Benefit Full heath coverage Eat & Drink Meal, coffee and snacks provided.

title: Mašinski tehničar - konstruktor
description: U Ime Našeg Klijenta, Kompanije S-Beca, Koja Se Bavi Proizvodnjom i Montažom Metalnih Konstrukcija i Različitih Tehničkih Rješenja Od Čelika, Aluminija i Inoxa., Manpower BiH Traži Motivisanu i Odgovornu Osobu Za Poziciju Mašinski tehničar – konstruktor (2D/3D) Popis Izrada i dorada 2D tehničkih crteža u AutoCAD-u te izrada 3D modela i razrada konstrukcijskih rješenja. Tehnička razrada projekata koji uključuju čelične, aluminijske i inox konstrukcije, stepeništa, ograde i rješenja za ventilirajuće fasade. Izlazak na teren, uzimanje mjera i provjera uslova za izradu i montažu. Priprema tehničkih rješenja i dokumentacije potrebne za proizvodnju i izvođenje radova. Komunikacija i koordinacija s klijentima, izvođačima i kolegama uključenim u proizvodnju i montažu. Praćenje realizacije radova na gradilištu, kontrola kvaliteta izvedbe i praćenje dogovorenih rokova. Učestvovanje u dogovaranju i organizaciji realizacije projekata te pravovremeno rješavanje tehničkih izazova na terenu. Zaštita interesa kompanije tokom realizacije projekata kroz odgovoran pristup, dobru organizaciju i aktivno praćenje svih faza posla. Požadujeme 2–5 godina relevantnog iskustva u radu s metalnim konstrukcijama, tehničkoj pripremi, proizvodnji ili montaži. Dobro poznavanje AutoCAD-a za 2D crtanje. Poznavanje rada u 3D CAD programu ili sposobnost rada u odgovarajućem programu, u skladu s potrebama posla. Razumijevanje tehničkih crteža, mjera i konstrukcijskih detalja. Praktično razumijevanje proizvodnje i montaže konstrukcija od čelika, aluminija i/ili inoxa. Spremnost za kombinaciju kancelarijskog rada i terenskog angažmana. Iskustvo u izradi i montaži čeličnih stepeništa, hala, ograda, ventilirajućih fasada i sličnih konstrukcija. Iskustvo u samostalnom mjerenju, pripremi tehničkih rješenja, organizaciji i praćenju radova na gradilištu. Iskustvo u komunikaciji s klijentima i izvođačima te koordinaciji različitih faza realizacije projekta. VSS mašinskog smjera

title: Mekanik Süpervizör
description: Şirket Hakkında Arven İK Danışmanlık olarak, İstanbul'da faaliyet gösteren, uluslararası hizmet standartlarına sahip, konaklama sektörünün önde gelen lüks otellerinden biri olan iş ortağımız için Mekanik Süpervizör arayışımız bulunmaktadır. İş ortağımızın Teknik Servis Departmanı bünyesinde, mekanik sistemlerin güvenli ve kesintisiz çalışmasını sağlayacak, bakım ve onarım süreçlerini takip ederek teknik operasyonların koordinasyonunda aktif rol üstlenecek bir profesyonel arıyoruz. Pozisyon Hakkında Bu pozisyon, mekanik sistemlerin işletilmesi, bakım ve onarım süreçlerinde 4–6 yıl deneyime sahip, teknik bilgi birikimini operasyonel koordinasyon becerileri ile birleştirmek isteyen profesyoneller için uygun bir kariyer fırsatı sunmaktadır. Mekanik Süpervizör, otelin mekanik altyapısının günlük operasyonlarını takip edecek, teknik arızaların çözümünü koordine edecek ve ekip organizasyonu ile bakım süreçlerinde departman yönetimine destek verecektir. Görev ve Sorumluluklar ● Otelin mekanik tesisat, ısıtma, soğutma ve havalandırma sistemlerinin günlük kontrol, bakım ve onarım süreçlerini takip etmek. ● Mekanik ekipmanların güvenli, verimli ve kesintisiz çalışmasını sağlamak. ● Sıcaklık, basınç ve diğer teknik parametreleri izlemek; ölçüm cihazlarından elde edilen verileri değerlendirmek. ● Kazan sistemleri ve ilgili teknik ekipmanların çalışma performansını denetlemek. ● Periyodik ve önleyici bakım faaliyetlerini yürütmek, teknik arızaların giderilmesini koordine etmek. ● Mekanik ekibiyle birlikte sahada aktif görev almak, operasyonel ihtiyaçlar doğrultusunda gerektiğinde akşam ve gece vardiyalarında çalışmak. ● Bakım, arıza ve işletme faaliyetlerine ilişkin teknik kayıtları düzenli olarak tutmak ve raporlamak. ● Teknik ekibin günlük iş organizasyonu, vardiya planlaması ve eğitim süreçlerinde departman yönetimine destek olmak. ● Diğer departmanlarla koordineli çalışarak teknik ihtiyaçlara zamanında çözüm üretmek. ● Tüm teknik faaliyetlerin iş sağlığı ve güvenliği prosedürlerine ve kurum standartlarına uygun yürütülmesini sağlamak. Aradığımız Nitelikler ● Teknik lise, meslek lisesi veya meslek yüksekokullarının Makine, Mekanik Tesisat, İklimlendirme ve Soğutma veya ilgili bölümlerinden mezun, ● Mekanik sistemlerin bakım, onarım ve işletilmesi alanında 4–6 yıl deneyimli, ● Tercihen otelcilik veya benzer tesis yönetimi operasyonlarında teknik servis deneyimi bulunan, ● Isıtma, soğutma, havalandırma ve kazan sistemleri konusunda teknik bilgi sahibi, ● Mekanik arıza tespiti, periyodik bakım ve teknik ekipman yönetimi konularında deneyimli, ● Elektrik tesisatı, sarı ve bakır kaynak uygulamaları hakkında teknik bilgi ve uygulama deneyimine sahip, ● Orta seviyede İngilizce bilen, ● Teknik ekip koordinasyonu ve operasyonel iş takibinde sorumluluk alabilecek, ● İş sağlığı ve güvenliği standartlarına hâkim, ● Planlama, organizasyon ve problem çözme becerileri güçlü, ● İletişim becerileri gelişmiş, ekip çalışmasına yatkın ve sorumluluk sahibi çalışma arkadaşları arıyoruz. Bu Pozisyon Neler Sunuyor? Bu rol, mekanik sistemler alanındaki deneyimini uluslararası hizmet standartlarına sahip prestijli bir otel bünyesinde değerlendirmek, teknik operasyonlarda aktif sorumluluk üstlenmek ve ekip koordinasyonu alanında kendini geliştirmek isteyen profesyoneller için önemli bir kariyer fırsatı sunmaktadır. Teknik uzmanlığınızı profesyonel bir otel ortamında değerlendirmek ve kariyerinizde yeni bir adım atmak istiyorsanız başvurunuzu bekliyoruz. Başvurular Arven İK Danışmanlık tarafından gizlilik esasları çerçevesinde değerlendirilecektir.

title: Makine Servis Teknisyeni (Paketleme Makinesi)
description: Bakım Onarım ve Servis Teknisyeni (Paketleme Makineleri) Pozisyon Özeti Şirketimizin bünyesinde yer alan Doypack, Dikey ve Yatay paketleme sistemleri, toz, sıvı, granül dolum ve sayarak paketleme makinelerinin kurulum, periyodik bakım, arıza tespiti ve saha servis süreçlerini yürütecek; işini sorumlulukla ve disiplinle benimseyen Bakım Onarım Servis Teknisyeni arıyoruz. Şirketimizdeki Yeri ve Başarı Tanımı Bu rol; paketleme çözümlerimizin yüksek performans, hassasiyet ve kesintisiz çalışma standartlarını korumada kritik bir konuma sahiptir. Müşteri sahalarında ve merkez tesisimizde makinelerin sorunsuz çalışmasını sağlamak temel hedefimizdir. Bu rolde başarılı olmak; teknik uzmanlığın yanı sıra yüksek sorumluluk bilinci, disiplinli çalışma alışkanlığı ve düzenli iş takibi gerektirir. Mekanik, pnömatik, elektrik ve otomasyon aksamlı arızaları zamanında, disiplinli ve kalıcı şekilde çözüme kavuşturmak. Bakım ve servis süreçlerini planlı, düzenli ve eksiksiz bir şekilde raporlamak. Operatör eğitimlerini ve teknik bilgilendirmeleri titizlikle gerçekleştirmek. Nitelikler Meslek Yüksekokulu veya Teknik Liselerin Mekatronik, Makine, Elektrik-Elektronik veya Otomasyon bölümlerinden mezun. Doypack, paketleme ve dolum makinelerinin bakımı/teknik servisi konusunda deneyim sahibi. Sorumluluk sahibi, iş disiplinine özen gösteren ve düzenli çalışma prensiplerine sahip. Elektrik, mekanik ve pnömatik şemaları rahatlıkla okuyabilen. Yurt içi / yurt dışı seyahat engeli bulunmayan. B sınıfı sürücü belgesine sahip ve aktif araç kullanabilen. Neler Sunuyoruz? Servis Primi: Gerçekleştirilen saha servis operasyonlarına bağlı prim imkanı. 6 Ayda Bir 1 Maaş Prim: Yılda 2 defa performans ve devamlılığı ödüllendiren prim sistemi. Ulaşım Desteği: Yol ücret desteği. Ofiste Ev Yapımı Yemek: Her gün sıcak ve lezzetli ev yemeği imkanı. Gelişim ve Çalışma Ortamı: Eğitimli, nitelikli ve işinde uzman profesyonellerden oluşan dinamik bir ekiple birlikte çalışma ve sürekli mesleki gelişim fırsatı. title: Global Lead Engineer
description: At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: Global Project Execution Manager __ Your Role And Responsibilities Design authority for engineering disciplines related to complete assignments to support local units on tenders, projects or portions projects in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards and safety requirements. In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute our global engineering function, providing technical support across Engineering Units within Sales and Solutions Global Solutions Centers. You will be the focal design authority for engineering disciplines related to complete assignments with the aim to support local units on tenders, projects or portions of projects in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards and safety requirements. The work model for the role is: # hybrid, Position location: EMEA This role is contributing to the Electrification Distribution Solutions Business Division. You will be mainly accountable for: Provides technical support for design activities, preparation of technical documentation, testing, installation, and commissioning procedures. Supports local units in the preparation of tender and project documentation within the assigned scope of work. Actively participates in project and tendering meetings, resolving technical issues to ensure contractual obligations are met. Assists in the preparation of engineering project proposals, presentations, and planning activities. Performs design verification using applicable standards, engineering guidelines, and checklists while ensuring compliance with safety regulations and contractual requirements. Shares best practices and Lessons Learned documentation across projects and disciplines, while identifying process and tool improvement opportunities. Supports technical risk assessments and reports contract, safety, quality, schedule, or cost-related issues to Project Manager(s) for resolution. Collaborates with Supply Chain, factories, and local units to ensure technical solutions are properly manufactured, staged, tested, installed, and commissioned. Supports updates of engineering deliverables after installation and commissioning and shares lessons learned within the global team for future implementation. Qualifications For The Role You are highly skilled in MV/LV systems, Protection & Control, Automation, Auxiliary Systems, eHouse and mobile solutions, with strong understanding of the EPC engineering environment and switchgear engineering processes. You have established experience in Data Center applications, particularly within Hyperscale and Colocation environments. Possess enhanced knowledge of commissioning activities and quality procedures related to FAT and SAT processes. You are passionate about effective communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration across regions and organizational levels. Have demonstrated experience working with engineering projects involving power distribution, automation systems, and switchgear solutions. More About Us ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium-voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear for the ANSI standard markets. This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive. The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: AI Engineer — Simulation & Training Systems
description: About Us Junosis Teknoloji A.Ş. develops simulation and training systems for land, air, and naval platforms across defense and civilian industries. Our projects bring together software, physical controls, motion systems, and interactive 3D environments to support practical, scenario-based training. We are expanding our AI capabilities to develop intelligent instructor support, adaptive learning, and performance assessment features across our simulation and technical training platforms. Position Summary We are looking for an AI Engineer who can turn AI concepts into reliable, working applications. You will develop AI components that help trainees access technical information, receive feedback, and improve their performance. Working closely with our Unity3D developers and technical specialists, you will integrate these components into simulation and interactive training environments. A key focus of this role is building locally deployed AI systems that can operate without internet access or external cloud services . Responsibilities Develop and integrate AI features for virtual instructors, technical training assistants, and instructor support tools. Build RAG pipelines that retrieve relevant information from approved technical manuals, procedures, and training materials, with traceable source references. Deploy and optimize locally hosted language models for offline and on-premises environments. Develop methods to analyze trainee actions, identify procedural errors, and generate useful performance feedback. Support adaptive training features that adjust guidance or scenario difficulty based on trainee performance. Collaborate with Unity3D developers to connect AI services to simulation environments through well-defined APIs and data interfaces. Evaluate AI outputs for accuracy, relevance, response time, and consistency; implement safeguards for unsupported or incorrect responses. Take solutions from prototype to deployment, including testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and maintenance. Integrate developed AI components into Unity projects and test their functionality, performance, and compatibility within the simulation environment. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong Python programming skills and hands-on experience developing AI/ML applications. Practical experience with LLM applications, embeddings, vector search, and RAG pipelines. Experience running and integrating locally hosted models, with an understanding of memory, GPU, and latency constraints. Experience with at least one major machine learning framework, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Ability to build APIs and integrate AI components into existing software systems. Understanding of data preparation, model evaluation, and systematic testing of AI applications. Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development practices. Ability to work with software developers and domain specialists to translate training needs into technical requirements. Good command of English for reading technical documentation and communicating technical ideas. Preferred Qualifications Experience integrating AI services with Unity3D or other real-time 3D applications; familiarity with C#. Experience with simulation, interactive technical training, or decision-support systems. Experience with model quantization, inference optimization, or fine-tuning. Familiarity with Docker, Linux, and deploying applications in restricted or isolated network environments. Experience with speech recognition or text-to-speech systems, particularly for Turkish and English. Experience in learning analytics, adaptive learning, or automated performance assessment. Knowledge of computer vision, reinforcement learning, or behavior modeling for simulation applications. Experience with MCP tools and custom AI skills to connect AI models with external tools, data sources, and application workflows. What We Offer The opportunity to develop AI features for real simulation and training products. Close collaboration with software, hardware, and domain specialists. Involvement throughout the development lifecycle, from early prototypes to deployed systems. Opportunities to contribute to national and international projects. A collaborative environment that supports technical ownership and continuous learning. Application Please include examples of relevant projects with your application, where available. A short description of your contribution, the technologies used, and how the solution was evaluated or deployed is particularly valuable. Public repositories or demos are welcome but not required; please do not share confidential project materials.

title: Senior QA Engineer (OTE $50,000/year USD), Sparkrock
description: Are you a senior QA engineer who writes the test automation that keeps enterprise ERP software reliable? At Sparkrock, we help social benefit organizations, such as nonprofits, school boards, and government agencies, reach their full potential through technology. Every day, over 150,000 people use our ERP and product platforms to work more efficiently, freeing up time and resources to focus on the good they want to achieve. When our software works reliably, those people spend their time on their mission instead of on workarounds. We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to strengthen how we test our ERP products. You will own quality from business requirements to release: planning test cycles, designing and writing test cases, building and maintaining automated tests and frameworks, and tracking defects to resolution. You will work closely with development, product management, and operations. Reporting to the Director of Platform Development, you will shape how QA works across our products and be measured on what you deliver: complete, relevant test coverage, clear test cases, and automated tests that run reliably and are easy to maintain. If you enjoy complex enterprise systems and keep improving your work through metrics and new tools, we would love to hear from you. Responsibilities Analyse business requirements to understand the testing needs and keep testing aligned with business goals. Design test cases and strategies that cover all functionality and scenarios. Plan test cycles and schedule them around development phases and project timelines. Write clear, concise test cases and scripts. Run tests manually and with automation to find issues and bugs. Develop and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks to make testing more efficient. Report test results, give a clear view of software quality, and recommend improvements. Track defects from identification to resolution and make sure they are fixed on time. Maintain the QA testing environment and tools that keep testing efficient. Requirements 5 years or more of experience in QA automation. Hands-on experience writing and maintaining automated test code and frameworks. Experience testing ERP or other enterprise SaaS products in production. Experience turning business requirements into test plans and test cases. Experience managing defects from identification to resolution. Experience working in Agile teams. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field, and an ISTQB, CSTE, or similar testing certification. Fluent, professional English, spoken and written Nice to have Experience with Microsoft Business Central is a huge advantage Experience with writing AL-based tests for Microsoft Business Central is an even greater advantage Daily use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code. Benefits We don’t call them perks; they’re just part of what makes working at Sparkrock great. We are 100% remote and global. Live your best life, wherever that may be, and never lose out on career opportunities because of it. Flexible work hours. We work asynchronously and don’t care when you’re online, just that you deliver great results. Dedication to development. We focus on career paths for each and every one of our employees and help provide training to advance at every stage of their careers. Introductions to thought leaders in the space and webinars on cutting-edge tech hot topics Stipend to help set up your ideal home office Focus on culture. Coffee chats, happy hours, cooking classes, book clubs, and more! Sparkrock is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from traditionally underrepresented groups. This is a fully remote independent contractor engagement and is not eligible for company-sponsored employee benefit programs. We welcome applications from any country where we can lawfully engage you. If you need an accommodation during the application process, you can request it once you apply. All open roles are for existing vacancies unless otherwise communicated. We notify all interviewed applicants of our hiring decision within 45 days of their interview and retain job postings and related recruitment information for at least three years. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Wat is jouw rol? Bij Lely ontwikkelen we robots en geavanceerde machines die wereldwijd bijdragen aan een duurzamere en efficiëntere melkveehouderij. Als Mechanical Engineer speel je een belangrijke rol in het ontwerpen en realiseren van innovatieve oplossingen die dagelijks worden gebruikt op boerderijen over de hele wereld. Je werkt binnen multidisciplinaire productontwikkelingsteams aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe producten én de doorontwikkeling van bestaande oplossingen. Daarbij vertaal je gebruikersbehoeften en technische eisen naar slimme, robuuste en produceerbare ontwerpen. Van het eerste concept tot validatie in de praktijk ben je betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkelproces. Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van engineering en praktijk. De ene dag werk je aan een nieuw ontwerp in CAD, de volgende dag test je een prototype in onze werkplaats of bezoek je een boerderij om te zien hoe jouw oplossing presteert in de dagelijkse praktijk. Zo zie je direct de impact van je werk en werk je continu aan producten die betrouwbaar functioneren onder uitdagende omstandigheden. Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van mechanische componenten, subsystemen en complete machines voor onze robotoplossingen. Samenwerken met collega's uit onder andere software, elektronica, systems engineering en testing om tot geïntegreerde oplossingen te komen. Begeleiden van prototypes van ontwerp tot validatie en ondersteunen bij het testen van nieuwe concepten. Afstemmen met leveranciers over technische oplossingen, maakbaarheid en optimalisaties. Analyseren en oplossen van technische vraagstukken tijdens ontwikkeling, testen of in het veld. Bijdragen aan een soepele overgang van ontwerp naar serieproductie, met oog voor kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en kostenefficiëntie. Solliciteer

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: As a Senior Mechanical Engineer, you take ownership of complex mechanical engineering challenges and translate system requirements into robust design solutions for advanced high-tech equipment. As a Senior Mechanical Engineer, you support our customers in the high-tech industry with developing cutting-edge equipment, both in the Brainport region and internationally. Together with experts in mechanics, mechatronics, electronics, software and mathematics you contribute to high-tech solutions such as advanced lithography machines, compact electron microscopes and medical devices that automate human tissue analysis. What excites you as a Senior Mechanical Engineer From our location in Eindhoven or sometimes at our clients' premises you like to keep yourself busy with: Translating requirements and specifications into mechanical concepts and design solutions in collaboration with Architects, System Designers and fellow Engineers. Developing and detailing mechanical designs in 3D CAD, while taking ownership of assigned work packages and deliverables. Performing engineering activities such as calculations, tolerance analyses and design trade-offs to support robust design decisions. Ensuring designs are manufacturable, testable, serviceable and cost-effective through the application of Design for Excellence (DfX) principles. Creating engineering estimates, planning your work, identifying risks and issues, and contributing to quality assurance in accordance with QMS procedures. Collaborating with suppliers and manufacturing partners regarding feasibility, component selection and integration of purchased parts. Sound good so far? We'd love to tell you more... Your future workplace This is what you bring to the table A BSc or MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electro-mechanics. Approximately 5-10 years of experience in the development and design of mechatronic or precision mechanical systems. Experience with translating requirements into practical engineering solutions and making well-balanced technical trade-offs. Knowledge of DfX principles, including manufacturability, assembly, cost and serviceability considerations. Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams and support more junior colleagues in their development. This is what you can expect in return from Sioux flexible 32-40 hour working week, with room to work from home. A healthy work-life balance is very important to us, we have 28 holidays with an option to acquire an additional 12 holidays. You will work with passionate colleagues who share your drive for technology and business success. By combining our expertise in software, electronics, mechanics, mechatronics, mathematics and assembly, we make the impossible possible for our customers – working on challenging high-tech projects. You get a lot of freedom and responsibility; after all, you know exactly what you are doing. Personal coaching and a training budget of €6000 per year, so you can keep developing yourself. We also find it important to have fun together, this means everything from family festivals and sparkling Christmas parties, to inspiring knowledge sessions for the high-tech community. You will be working on the Sioux Campus in the heart of the Brainport region, with daily access to our Sioux Labs living room for lunch, sports, making music, or sharing knowledge in one of our Tech Labs. High Tech & High Fun We can tell you all about the typical Sioux culture and the challenging high-tech projects. About how you can develop yourself like nowhere else. But we prefer to leave this to our own colleagues. Go to testimonials > If you want to know more about our challenging projects, please click here. Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require Sioux to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.

title: Senior Principal Mechanical Engineer, Robotics Capital & Test Systems - Surgical
description: Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. A Day in the Life Making the best possible surgery accessible to every patient. We believe the future of surgery is less invasive and more precise, predictable, and personalised. We bring together sharp surgical expertise, extensive medical knowledge, and cutting-edge technology with a single-minded focus on each patient - wherever they are, and however they need to be treated. Each surgical specialty faces unique challenges, yet the goal is universal: better care for patients. By understanding these differences, we deliver solutions that empower surgeons and keep patients at the heart of every decision. We are seeking a Senior Principal Mechanical Design Engineer – Robotics Capital & Test Systems to provide technical leadership for the design and development of the physical infrastructure used to characterise, verify and validate advanced medical devices and robotic systems. The role will combine deep machine-design expertise with hands-on engineering to deliver robust fixtures, mechanisms, actuators, load-application systems, instrument interfaces, mounting structures and capital-equipment adaptations. This is a senior individual-contributor role with significant influence across multidisciplinary teams. The successful candidate will define mechanical architecture, lead critical design decisions and establish reusable test-system platforms that safely and repeatably reproduce clinically relevant loads, motions and boundary conditions while meeting requirements for accuracy, reliability, usability, manufacturability, serviceability and cost. The role will be based at the Mervue Campus in Galway, Ireland. Lead the mechanical design and development of capital equipment and test systems used for instrument performance testing, characterisation, identification, verification and engineering investigations. Design precision fixtures, mechanisms, actuators, load frames, load-application devices, instrument interfaces, mounting structures, guarding and capital-side adaptations. Translate test objectives, system requirements and measurement needs into robust mechanical architectures and detailed equipment specifications. Create and review 3D models, assemblies, drawings, bills of materials and design documentation using SolidWorks and Creo. Apply machine-design principles including structural design, mechanism and actuator selection, bearings and guides, tolerance analysis, materials, fastening, alignment and maintainability. Integrate mechanical systems with motors, sensors, data-acquisition hardware, controls, electrical cabinets, safety circuits and software interfaces. Perform engineering analysis and appropriately apply calculations, tolerance stack-ups, motor and transmission sizing, structural analysis and finite element analysis. Lead concept generation, feasibility, prototyping, detailed design, design reviews, build, commissioning, verification, troubleshooting and release of test equipment. Ensure equipment provides controlled, repeatable and traceable application of force, torque, displacement, velocity and other relevant mechanical inputs. Embed machine-safety, ergonomics, guarding, risk reduction and safe access for set-up, calibration, maintenance and service activities. Collaborate with test, systems, electrical, controls, software, quality, manufacturing, facilities and external suppliers to deliver integrated solutions. Lead technical problem solving, root-cause investigations and design improvements for complex interactions between instruments, robotic systems and test infrastructure. Key Skills & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline with 10+ years of relevant experience, OR a Master’s/advanced degree with 8+ years of relevant experience. Demonstrated senior-level experience in machine design, capital equipment, automation equipment, test systems or special-purpose machinery. Strong capability in the design of precision fixtures, mechanisms, structures, actuators, load paths and electromechanical assemblies. Proven hands-on capability using SolidWorks and/or Creo for 3D modelling, large assemblies, drawings and design documentation. Strong understanding of mechanical design principles, materials, manufacturing processes, assembly methods, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, and tolerance analysis. Experience selecting and sizing motors, gearboxes, linear actuators, bearings, guides, transmissions, load cells and other sensors used in test equipment. Experience integrating mechanical equipment with electrical, controls, software, data-acquisition and systems-engineering interfaces. Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical decisions, conduct design reviews and solve multidisciplinary equipment and test-system problems. Strong communication, collaboration, technical leadership and mentoring skills. Experience with machine safety, risk assessment, guarding, ergonomics, equipment commissioning, calibration and preventive-maintenance considerations is desirable. Experience in medical devices, robotics, regulated product development or high-reliability test environments is advantageous. title: Senior Specialist (Product Scale-up), Global Manufacturing
description: Role and impact How do you help a new catalyst product move from development towards production? In this role, you’ll work at the practical heart of scale-up: designing, building and commissioning a catalyst production pilot line, then using it to run tests, develop process knowledge and deliver new capable products to our production plants. Your work will also support production teams with troubleshooting and help plant engineering make informed equipment decisions. Responsibilities Your primary objective will be to deliver capable new catalyst products, supported by well-established and understood process windows, to the industrialization step—the next stage in our new product development stage-gate model. You will plan and carry out work safely, optimize equipment and processes, report your findings, and document relevant best practices. You will also work with production and engineering colleagues to address equipment and process needs. This Will Involve Designing, building and commissioning equipment for a catalyst production pilot line. Performing tests at the Manufacturing Development Centre, including completing safety assessments and reporting results. Troubleshooting production challenges and supporting problem-solving as a subject-matter expert in relevant unit operations and equipment. Assisting plant engineering and EPCM with equipment selection, testing (on site or at vendors) and reviews. What You Will Bring Equipment and/or unit operation subject matter expert in e.g. powder handling, milling, screening, continuous furnaces etc. Experience in Plant process engineering and commissioning experience Minimum 7 -10 years of relevant experience Experience troubleshooting and solving problems in industrial production processes. A practical, hands-on approach and confidence working directly with equipment. The ability to write clear, scientifically sound reports in English and communicate fluently in English, both spoken and written. Flexibility to manage changing priorities and work to tight timelines. Ability to work with several tasks and projects simultaneously, being robust/resilient when faced with challenges It Would Also Be An Advantage To Have Experience with production process scale-up or scale-down. Danish, both written and spoken or with a willingness to learn the language Project management experience. Knowledge of risk assessment, data handling or statistics Ability to think strategically and proactively seek information with respect to what is needed for future pilot development, Project manager experience, knowledge on risk assessment. Knowledge on data handling and statistics an advantage Why join us You’ll have the opportunity to be a part of accelerating new catalyst products to the market by building and operating a pilot facility, take part in practical testing, optimizing, and solve real equipment and production challenges. The role brings together design, hands-on problem-solving and technical reporting, with work that supports scale-up and manufacturing development. Your new Team You’ll join R&D’s Scale-up and Manufacturing Development team. You’ll work with colleagues involved in developing and industrializing new catalyst products, pilot testing, production troubleshooting and plant engineering support. The team’s work connects equipment and process development with the needs of industrial production. How You Can Apply If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English. Application deadline: 23-11-2026. If you have questions regarding the role, feel free to reach out to Ninna Halberg Jokil, Director- Scale up and Manufacturing development, on NIH@topsoe.com. You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team. To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references. To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding. About Us Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition. Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals. We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air. We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com. At Topsoe we strive towards having a safe work environment. We are aware of the risks in our work and continuously optimize our safety procedures.

title: Mekanikkonstruktör – avancerad produktutveckling
description: Därför är detta jobb för dig Du är en erfaren mekanikkonstruktör med en stark bakgrund inom produktutveckling, gärna från försvarsindustrin eller annan teknikintensiv verksamhet. Du har arbetat med komplexa mekaniska konstruktioner där precision, funktion, kvalitet och tillförlitlighet behöver samverka. Hos oss får du möjlighet att använda din erfarenhet i tekniskt utmanande utvecklingsprojekt, där du arbetar med allt från vidareutveckling av befintliga produkter till utveckling av helt nya tekniska lösningar. Projekten kan omfatta avancerade mekaniska system och komponenter där höga krav ställs på prestanda, robusthet och funktion även under krävande förhållanden. Vi tror på att ge våra ingenjörer både ansvar och utrymme att påverka. Du får möjlighet att bidra med din kompetens, dina idéer och ditt tekniska kunnande i nära samarbete med andra specialister i tvärfunktionella team, där samarbete och kunskapsutbyte är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du kommer att tillhöra vårt affärsområde Hardware & Design, där vi kombinerar bred ingenjörskompetens med djup specialistkunskap för att utveckla fysiska produkter och tekniska lösningar – hela vägen från tidiga koncept till färdig produkt och produktion. Arbetsuppgifter Som mekanikkonstruktör arbetar du med produktutveckling i tekniskt komplexa projekt, där krav på funktion, precision, kvalitet och tillförlitlighet är centrala. Beroende på projekt och din erfarenhet kan dina arbetsuppgifter bland annat innebära att: Utveckla och vidareutveckla avancerade mekaniska konstruktioner, komponenter och system. Arbeta med konstruktion och produktutveckling från koncept och detaljkonstruktion till verifiering och produktionsanpassning. Ta fram robusta och tillförlitliga tekniska lösningar med hänsyn till materialval, hållfasthet, toleranser och tillverkningsmetoder. Arbeta med mekaniska gränssnitt och integration av komponenter i större tekniska system. Samarbeta med tvärfunktionella team inom exempelvis konstruktion, beräkning, provning och systemutveckling. Bidra med teknisk kompetens vid kravställning, problemlösning, dokumentation och verifiering av tekniska lösningar. Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som har en gedigen teknisk bakgrund och erfarenhet av mekanisk konstruktion och produktutveckling. Du är van att arbeta med komplexa produkter och system där flera tekniska discipliner behöver samverka och där höga krav ställs på funktion, kvalitet och tillförlitlighet. Du har ett analytiskt och strukturerat arbetssätt, tycker om att lösa tekniska problem och trivs i utvecklingsmiljöer där noggrannhet, teknisk dokumentation och förståelse för helheten är viktiga delar av arbetet. Vi Söker Dig Som Har Ingenjörsexamen inom maskinteknik, mekanikkonstruktion, produktutveckling eller motsvarande. Minst 6 års erfarenhet av mekanikkonstruktion och produktutveckling, gärna från tekniskt komplexa produkter eller system. Goda kunskaper i 3D-CAD, exempelvis CATIA, Creo, SolidWorks eller Siemens NX. Erfarenhet av konstruktion där faktorer som hållfasthet, toleranser, materialval, funktion och tillverkningsbarhet har stor betydelse. Erfarenhet av att arbeta strukturerat med tekniska krav, dokumentation och kvalitetssäkring genom produktutvecklingsprocessen. Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Det Är Meriterande Om Du Har Erfarenhet av produktutveckling i CATIA V5 samt arbete i PDM- eller PLM-system. Erfarenhet från försvarsindustrin, exempelvis Saab, BAE Systems eller liknande verksamheter. Erfarenhet av utveckling av avancerade mekaniska system och komponenter med höga krav på robusthet, precision och driftsäkerhet. Erfarenhet av produktutveckling i större organisationer med etablerade utvecklingsprocesser, kravhantering och verifiering. Säkerhetsprövning Flera av våra kunder anlitar oss för säkerhetsklassade uppdrag så säkerhetsprövning kan komma att ske. Dessa tjänster kan kräva svenskt medborgarskap. En spännande resa med Knightec Group Knightec Group är idag en av Norra Europas ledande strategiska partners inom produkt- och digital tjänsteutveckling – hur häftigt är inte det? Genom att förena ingenjörskompetens, digital expertis och affärsförståelse hjälper vi våra kunder att omvandla ny teknik till verkliga lösningar som skapar värde. Vi arbetar i skärningspunkten mellan affärsstrategi och teknikutveckling och stöttar våra kunder genom hela resan – från de första idéerna till utveckling, implementering och vidare utveckling. På Knightec Group samlas människor med olika perspektiv, erfarenheter och specialistområden. Tillsammans skapar vi innovation som gör verklig skillnad – för företag, människor och samhället i stort. För våra medarbetare innebär det stora möjligheter att vara med och forma framtidens lösningar genom meningsfulla projekt i teknikens absoluta framkant. Här får du inte bara utvecklas och växa i din roll – du blir också en del av ett team där nyfikenhet, samarbete och modet att utmana driver oss framåt. Låter det som platsen för dig? Häng med på vår fortsatta resa! Praktisk information Detta är en tillsvidareanställning med en provanställning på sex månader, placerad på vårt kontor i Stockholm, Rättarvägen 3 (Solna). Resor i tjänsten kan förekomma till våra kunder. Planerat startdatum är februari 2027 eller enligt överenskommelse. Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, men senast 2026-12-20. Om du har några frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Paola Banegas, Talent Acquisition Partner. Observera att vi, på grund av GDPR, endast tar emot ansökningar via vår karriärsida. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Mechanical CAD Engineer – Automotive Seat
description: Join EDAG Engineering Scandinavia AB – Certified Great Place to Work! At EDAG, we are proud to be our customers' global mobility technology experts. As part of a global engineering network, we deliver innovative solutions to leading automotive manufacturers while maintaining a strong local presence in Sweden. We are looking for a Mechanical CAD Engineer with Automotive Seat experience to become the connector, coordinator and catalyst behind successful product development, driving collaboration across teams and leading design activities from concept to release. About the Role You will be responsible for the design and development of seat components, with a particular focus on: Foam STD ISOFIX Bezels & Curtain/Plastic Flaps Foam ICS Main Cushions Mechanical Seat Foam Components The role requires strong CAD expertise, close collaboration with cross-functional teams and the ability to independently drive design activities while ensuring high quality and manufacturability. Key Responsibilities Develop and release 3D and 2D CAD models using CATIA V5. Design and optimize seat-related components, primarily within CATIA Surface Workbench. Develop foam, cushion, trim and related seat components from concept to production. Ensure manufacturability, feasibility and compliance with engineering standards. Collaborate with design, manufacturing, purchasing, and supplier teams throughout the development cycle. Manage CAD data, drawings, and release processes. Support technical reviews and present design solutions to stakeholders. Required Qualifications Several years of experience as a Mechanical CAD Engineer within the automotive industry. Proven experience working with automotive seat components, such as foam, cushions, seat structures, bezels, trim parts, or related interior components. Strong hands-on experience with CATIA V5, including Surface Workbench and Advanced Surface Modelling. Experience working with Volvo Cars. Good understanding of automotive manufacturing processes and product development. Experience with TeamCenter / TCPLM / PLM systems. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across engineering teams. Excellent communication skills in English. Swedish language skills are considered highly meritorious. Who You Are Outgoing and proactive. Enjoy being the central point of coordination between teams. Strong team player with a leadership mindset. Structured, responsible, and solution-oriented. Comfortable handling and distributing information in a clear and organized way. Confident presenting technical information to stakeholders. Important Information Candidates must be currently based in Sweden. Applicants must already have the legal right to work in Sweden. Visa sponsorship is not available. Immediate availability is required, as the expected project start is Week 48 (W48).

Mentorship responsibilities to guide processes and support junior team members. Your contribution will be essential in delivering comprehensive engineering solutions in customer order engineering projects. support from concept to execution. Apply the full engineering design process to adapt designs to satisfy the customer needs Design innovative steel structures and installation solutions while producing manufacturing data in NX and associated technical documentation. Engage with other package systems and contribute to the overall design philosophy of our gas turbine packages. Collaborate with procurement and sub-suppliers to develop robust technical solutions, addressing generic issues and conducting root cause analyses. Work closely with the project team to ensure design work aligns with the current schedule, creating, reviewing, and updating documentation within your technical area. Background within large industrial gas turbine engineering is a merit Excellent teamwork skills, with a structured, driven approach to prioritizing and organizing your work effectively. Our team is committed to innovation and excellence, working collaboratively to ensure the stability and performance of mechanical systems. Our responsibilities are design of steel structures and installation solutions both in workshop assembly stage and site installation stage. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. title: R&D Engineer- HVDC Converter valve cooling design
description: You will be part of Technology and Solutions Development for HVDC applications, within Hitachi Energy, in Ludvika. The HVDC technology has been on the market for the past 60 years and is used, among other things, to transmit power over long distances with minimal losses, using overhead lines, underground and submarine cable systems. The Valve Development Department is a part Technology and Solutions Development office in Ludvika, and it is responsible for the development of new HVDC and SVC converter valves. HVDC converter valves are used to convert AC to DC, and vice versa, and are essential for HVDC power transmissions. SVC converter valves are used in SVC systems, in order to support and stabilize AC systems. The Valve Development Department is focusing mainly on electrical and mechanical design and development activities and works in close collaboration with the global HVDC organization. Please find out more about our world leading technology at https://www.hitachienergy.com/offering/product-and-system/hvdc You are welcome to join our energetic team with mix of experienced and young engineers and colleagues from diverse nationalities around the world. We work closely with design teams and collaborate with engineering and research team in Sweden and abroad. How You'll Make An Impact Develop new cooling technologies and improve existing ones to enhance the performance of HVDC converter Valves and its cooling system. Conduct research, testing, and validation of cooling systems using advanced modelling, simulation, and analysis tools Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including electrical, mechanical, and software engineers, to integrate cooling systems into designs. Evaluate and select materials, components, and suppliers for cooling systems based on technical requirements, cost, and reliability. Work in new product development projects focusing on valve cooling design tasks involving Perform DFMEA to prevent unnecessary product development issues in future Preparation of 3D CAD Models, drawings and BOM Your background Master’s degree in mechanical engineering or engineering physics. Genuinely curious in physics and new technologies that can be applied in a future product. Theoretical understanding in fluid mechanics and thermodynamics are must. Experience in CFD simulations or thermal cycle calculation will be an advantage. Open for multi-disciplinary assignments in mechanical and electrical fields. Experience with new product development, flow simulations, thermal cycle calculations, or control of cooling systems will be an advantage. Proficiency in 3D-CAD modeling, ideally in NX environment is preferred. Understanding of mechanical core competences, material selection, manufacturing methods, GD&T, and basic understanding of electrical technology. Knowledge of fieldbus technology, component/instrument, deionizing chemistry, and cooling system redundancy philosophy will be an added advantage. Fluency in English -written and spoken. Proficiency in Swedish will be an advantage. Experience in exchange study or any other international opportunity will be an advantage. More About Us We are interested to learn more about you and what you can contribute with so don’t hesitate to apply even though you don’t meet all requirements. A team with great cooperation and with diverse backgrounds is waiting for you to join! All other questions can be directed to Talent Partner Filip Henriksson at Publication date : 2026-11-03

title: Senior Design Engineer
description: Moog is a performance culture that empowers people to achieve great things. Our people enjoy solving interesting technical challenges in a culture where everyone trusts each other to do the right thing. For you, working with us can mean deeper job satisfaction, better rewards, and a great quality of life inside and outside of work. Job Title Senior Design Engineer Reporting To Management, Design Engineering Work Schedule Hybrid – Wolverhampton, GBR Moog Commercial Aircraft Group is seeking a Senior Design Engineer. Moog Commercial Aircraft Group is seeking a Senior Design Engineer (Mechanical) to develop and improve commercial flight control products. In this role, you will work with engineering teams to support new product introduction (NPI) and product improvement initiatives, taking designs from concept through prototype testing, manufacture, and product handover. You will report to the Commercial Engineering Manager (Design) and be based at either the Wolverhampton or Tewkesbury Moog site. As a Senior Design Engineer, you will collaborate cross-functionally with project, systems, stress, manufacturing, supply chain, and product engineering teams to deliver innovative and robust engineering solutions. You will provide technical leadership, mentor junior engineers, and ensure designs meet customer requirements, regulatory expectations, quality standards, cost targets, and project schedules. As a Senior Design Engineer , you will make critical contributions by holding responsibility for: Design and develop mechanical components and assemblies for rotating equipment and hydraulic systems from concept through production release. Provide technical ownership of design deliverables, ensuring quality, schedule, and performance objectives are achieved. Mentor and coach junior engineers while supporting the development of engineering best practices. Collaborate with project, systems, and stress engineering teams to ensure designs meet customer performance, airworthiness, and regulatory requirements. Create and review detailed technical drawings and 3D CAD models suitable for manufacturing and assembly. Apply GD&T principles and perform tolerance analysis to validate fit, function, and manufacturability. Support DFMEA activities, identify technical risks, and develop mitigation strategies throughout the product lifecycle. Present design concepts, development progress, and technical solutions to customers and key stakeholders. Partner with manufacturing, supply chain, and product engineering teams to deliver robust and producible product designs. Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting activities, and design refinements based on test results. Generate and maintain engineering documentation including bills of materials (BOMs), revision records, and engineering change notices (ECNs). Participate in design reviews, risk assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance engineering processes and product performance. Collaborate with suppliers and manufacturing partners to define components, tolerances, and manufacturing processes. Support occasional international travel as required by project and customer needs. To be considered for the Senior Design Engineer position, here's what you'll typically bring with you: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Significant experience in mechanical product design and development. Experience designing complex mechanical systems, preferably within aerospace or another highly regulated industry. Working knowledge of GD&T, tolerance analysis, materials, and manufacturing processes. Experience using 3D CAD software, ideally Siemens NX, and PLM/PDM tools. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and technical decision-making skills. Excellent communication skills with the ability to present technical information to customers and stakeholders. Experience leading projects or providing technical leadership to engineering teams is preferred. What We Offer Flexible benefits package and development opportunities to support career progression. 33 days annual leave (including bank holidays). Private medical insurance, mental health support, and financial wellbeing resources. Generous life assurance and company pension contribution (from 6%). Employee share options, bonus opportunity free onsite parking, and EV charging.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: We are accepting applications from varying seniority levels, from Graduate to Principal Engineer, and will adjust terms accordingly. We will pause this opening when we reach application capacity (around 9th Nov), so please apply soon if you are keen. About Amodo Amodo is a hardware engineering company building the 21st century's most important technologies. Our team of mechanical, electronic, firmware, and software engineers are trusted by world-leading startups, universities, governments and philanthropists to solve pressing technical challenges. See who they are on https://amododesign.com - including MIT, Cambridge, Oxford, Imperial, ARIA and Rand Corp. We are selective in the projects we take on and proactive in seeking out where our exceptional engineering teams can make the most impact. We believe in differential technology development: deliberately accelerating safety-enhancing technologies to ensure human flourishing. Not every technology is inevitable – rather, the market fails to incentivise key domains. We work in these areas. What do we do? At Amodo you will work with a world class team to create some of the most important technologies of our time. We focus on high speed development and real world impact, making sure we’re continually delivering tangible, concrete progress across the board. You will see your designs manufactured and distributed globally, your research inform policy, and you will support multi-million pound projects. We’re currently focused on four key fields: AI safety, biosecurity, humane tech, and accelerating science (developing the hardware tools that scientific breakthroughs require, but don't yet exist). In addition to client work, we want to bring our inventions into the world as spin-out companies, open-source projects, and products. We're actively hiring people to take charge of making this happen. New invention & new research - We design and build new products, equipment, and tools. Invention and rapid iteration are core to our DNA. We use these new inventions and our experience to perform new research and push boundaries. More products than powerpoints - Common failure modes of today’s consultancies include risk aversion, theatre for clients, and misrepresentation of what is important in projects. We reject this approach. We’re here to do truth-seeking, progress-optimising engineering, not to make slide decks. Work that matters - Unlike many consultancies we also get involved at the pre-product stage. Our experience in industry and biotech puts us in the position to run feasibility studies for new and existing companies. This research-heavy work can include literature reviews, feasibility modelling and market research. A bit on our culture and what it would look like to work here: Our values: Truth-seeking, excellent, enthusiastic, kind, humble, and always learning Our approach: We think before diving in, iterate fast, and focus on the highest-impact 80/20 work. We favour rapid experimentation, quick feedback loops, and sprinting to "something that works" rather than over-planning. Feedback culture: We practice radical candor, which means being clear and direct while staying kind, and welcoming feedback at every level No "not my job"-ism: If we see something wrong, we fix it. If your part of a project is going great and another is struggling, don't settle for polishing a chunk of a struggling ship Socials: Table tennis every lunch, personal project evenings, pub trips, trail running club, and more Office: Spacious, modern space in central Sheffield, with parking and bike storage. In-house workshop and equipment for our mechanical and electrical work. Project structure: You will generally be on 1 main project at a time, whilst supporting on 1-2 smaller projects. Team sizes vary from 2-10+ engineers, where most are ~4. Durations largely are within the 2 - 8 months range. Project variety: We get to work on loads of super varied, technically complex and interesting projects, from drone mounted laser holography for climate-tech to next-gen motors. About you We value drive, culture fit, and a track-record of engineering excellence and above all else, but the below competencies, interests, and attributes are extremely desirable: Strong background in mechanical design - concepts, calcs, and CAD Practical experience with GD&T and fully defined engineering drawings Experience with design for manufacture and manufacturing systems Interest in or experience in practical making - very familiar with a toolbox. Alongside the above, the below competencies will strengthen an application: Familiarity with electrical and electronics Programming competence (preferably python, cpp) Expertise in design for specific manufacturing processes, particularly Injection moulding or precision machining. An eye for beautiful as well as practical design Note : We’ve doubled year on year since our founding in 2023, and we aim to do so again in 2026. That means we're actively hiring across electronics, FPGA, mechanical, firmware, software, physics, HPC infrastructure, and DevOps - plus exceptional talent in any discipline. If you're an ambitious top performer, engineering or otherwise, please fill in our job application form linked. Benefits Free lunch every day Flexible hybrid working Flexible working hours 35 days holiday (including bank holidays) We can pay your professional registration and institution fees Relocation assistance may be negotiated £300 annual personal project budget with weekly maker evenings (tools, pizza and support provided) To let you know a bit more about what to expect, our core interview process is as follows. 15 minute technical screening interview 1 hour technical interview 1.5 hour in-person interview Offer! We may occasionally include 1-3 additional stages, including aptitude tests or video calls with one of our founders. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

title: Senior Design Engineer - Hydraulics
description: We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer to join our Powertrain Hydraulics group, contributing to a wide range of assemblies throughout the F1 car with a particular focus on hydraulic, pneumatic, and gearbox systems . Collaborating with the Group Principal and Head of Powertrain, you will be responsible for the design and integration of hydraulic and pneumatic components that interface with the power unit and transmission systems. You will take ownership of projects from concept through to prototype, testing, and race deployment, working closely with other engineering departments to ensure world-class performance and reliability. About You With a deep understanding of hydraulic and pneumatic system design, you bring hands-on expertise in gearbox or powertrain hydraulic systems , confidently selecting pumps, valves, actuators, accumulators, and other critical components, and packaging them efficiently within tight spatial constraints. Your strong grasp of engineering fundamentals - materials, stress, and fluid mechanics - underpins every decision you make, and your background includes a relevant engineering degree (Mechanical, Automotive, or Aerospace), supported by practical design experience in motorsport, aerospace, or precision engineering. You’re fluent in CAD and ideally familiar with Siemens NX, but you’re just as capable of adapting quickly if your experience lies with other platforms. Above all, you’re a clear communicator and a collaborative teammate, confident working across disciplines and influencing others to drive the best possible outcomes. Main responsibilities : Leading the concept, design, and detailing of mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic components and assemblies across the powertrain and chassis. Designing and integrating gearbox hydraulic systems, including actuation, lubrication, and control circuits. Performing stress, flow, and sizing calculations to support component and system design decisions, with clear supporting documentation. Conducting design reviews independently or alongside the Principal Engineer and Head of Department. Deputising for the Principal Engineer and Head of Department when required. Taking end-to-end ownership of projects - from design through manufacture, assembly, testing, and on-car validation - including fault analysis and root cause resolution. Supporting design checking and peer reviews, ensuring compliance with performance specifications and continuous benchmarking against competitors. Driving innovation and continuous improvement in hydraulic and pneumatic systems. Mentoring junior engineers, sharing expertise in fluid system design and integration best practices. Company Description For almost 50 years, Williams Racing has been at the forefront of one of the fastest sports on the planet, being one of the top three most successful teams in history competing in the FIA Formula 1 World Championship. With an almost unrivalled heritage of engineering and racing F1 cars and unforgettable eras that demonstrate it is a force to be reckoned with, the British squad boasts 16 F1 World Championship titles to its name. Since its foundation in 1977 by the eminent, late Sir Frank Williams and engineering pioneer Sir Patrick Head, the team has won nine Constructors’ Championships, in association with Cosworth, Honda and Renault. Its roll call of drivers is legendary, with its seven Drivers’ Championship trophies being lifted by true icons of the sport: Alan Jones, Keke Rosberg, Nelson Piquet, Nigel Mansell, Alain Prost, Damon Hill and Jacques Villeneuve. The team has made history before and is out to make it again with a long-term mission to evolve and return to the front of the grid. Additional Information Atlassian Williams F1 Team is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We are happy to discuss reasonable job adjustments.
