title: Turbojet Stress Engineer — FEA Expert for UAV Engines
description: About The Role Imagine this. You are ensuring the structural integrity of the propulsion systems powering the next generation of high performance UAVs. Every analysis you perform helps guarantee that critical engine components can withstand extreme thermal and mechanical loads while delivering exceptional reliability and performance. From early concept development through testing and production, you will work alongside multidisciplinary engineering teams to solve complex challenges and help bring advanced turbojet engines from design to reality. At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations. What You'll Do Perform structural, thermal, and thermo mechanical analyses of turbojet engine components using analytical methods and Finite Element Analysis. Assess centrifugal, thermal, vibratory, and combined loading on rotating and stationary engine hardware. Evaluate the mechanical integrity and durability of compressor and turbine wheels, shafts, blisks, casings, bearing supports, combustor structures, and exhaust components. Predict thermal growth and hot to cold geometry changes to optimize running clearances and engine performance. Perform fatigue, creep, thermo mechanical fatigue, and durability assessments for high temperature engine components. Analyze bearings, shafts, interference fits, couplings, mechanical joints, and sealing systems under operational loading. Develop detailed FEA models and analytical calculations to support design decisions and component sizing. Define critical engine load cases and correlate analysis with rig, endurance, and flight testing results. Collaborate closely with design, manufacturing, aerodynamics, combustion, and test engineers to improve component performance and manufacturability. Prepare technical documentation and contribute to engine qualification and certification activities. What You'll Need Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Between 3 and 8 years of experience performing structural or mechanical integrity analysis for gas turbine or turbojet engines. Strong understanding of rotating machinery operating under high centrifugal and thermal loads. Hands on experience using NX Simcenter. Solid knowledge of classical stress calculations, structural sizing, fatigue analysis, and durability assessment. Experience evaluating thermal deformation, hot to cold geometry changes, and tip clearance optimization. Understanding of high temperature aerospace materials, creep, thermo mechanical fatigue, and material behaviour. Experience analyzing bearings, shafts, sealing systems, interference fits, and mechanical joints. Familiarity with aerospace manufacturing processes including machining, casting, additive manufacturing, and heat treatment. Strong communication skills with professional English proficiency. Experience with MATLAB or Python is considered an advantage. Who You Are You enjoy solving challenging engineering problems where structural integrity directly impacts engine performance, safety, and reliability. You combine analytical thinking with practical engineering judgement, making decisions that balance performance, manufacturability, and durability. You thrive in a fast moving development environment where testing, iteration, and collaboration are part of everyday work. You are naturally curious, hands on, and motivated by seeing your analyses validated on real hardware while taking ownership of complex engineering challenges from concept through production. Security screening is an integral component of the selection process, ensuring that candidates meet the organization's security standards and safeguarding against potential risks. Providing a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) is a standard part of the application process at Destinus.

title: Mechanical Design & Structural Analysis Engineer
description: Description Intro Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular. With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, space consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, flight test services, satellite propulsion systems, and much more. SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future. Are you fueled by a passion for people and the ambition to create an awesome workplace? Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help earth benefit from space? If you answer yes to these questions, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact. We are looking for a dedicated professional who shares our core values of Customer passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage. Requirements Specific Qualification requirements Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Minimum 4 years of relevant professional experience in mechanical design and engineering, preferably within the aerospace, space, or testing industry. Proven experience in the design and development of mechanical structures, fixtures, Mechanical Ground Support Equipment (MGSE), or specialized testing equipment. Proficiency in 3D CAD modelling and mechanical design, preferably using 3DEXPERIENCE (3DX). Hands-on experience with Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and structural analysis, preferably using MSC Nastran/Patran. Good knowledge of mechanical design principles, structural integrity, materials, manufacturing processes, and engineering tolerances. Experience preparing manufacturing drawings, design justification files, engineering calculations, and technical documentation. Familiarity with mechanical equipment installation, integration, and verification activities, including proof load and acceptance testing. Good command of English, both written and spoken. Legal and Security Requirements Only European Union (EU) citizens can be employed by SSC Space Netherlands for this specific position. Applicants are required to provide a copy of their passport and degree certificate. SSC Space Netherlands will validate the Degree with the issuing University and provide evidence to ESA. Prior to issuing a letter of employment the applicant shall provide to SSC Space Netherlands a recent official document declaring that they are of good conduct from the country where currently resident. Responsibilities Specific Tasks The Service Provider Shall Create MGSE design to be used to support tests in the Test Centre and in the ESTEC laboratories. The design is meant to be ready for manufacturing either in the electromechanical workshop of the Engineering Services Section, or by an organisation that is not part of ESA. If the design will be manufactured by an organisation that is not part of ESA, then the Service Provider shall create manufacturing drawings. As part of this design task, the Service Provider shall perform all required numerical analysis and report it in the design justification file. The tools to use are the ones made available as a Customer Furnished Item (CFI) by ESA: 3DX for mechanical design, Nastran/Patran for Finite element modelling and analysis. Install the MGSE the Service has designed only when requested to do so by ESA. This installation includes supervision and/or execution of any required tests (e.g. proof load testing, acceptance testing). Benefits Contract The selected candidate will receive good remuneration in line with ESA Job Class. Will be registered for both social security and tax in the Netherlands. The standard working hours are 40 per week. There are 12 public holidays and an additional 30 annual days holiday. Training to improve efficiency and provide strength for future career are of course included. SSC Space Netherlands assist with relocation both with support and financially. SSC Space Netherlands contributes 15,4% of pensionable salary to a company pension scheme and employees can optionally make additional contributions. To be considered for this Position Prior to 2026-12-10 , please apply via our Job Application form. If not directly interested, feel free to share this Job Vacancy with your friends! Outro SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space. With local presence on all continents and about 750 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions. We help Earth benefit from space. Learn more at sscspace.com

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de constructieve integriteit van complete systemen en zorgt ervoor dat ontwerpen veilig, betrouwbaar, licht en efficiënt zijn. Je bepaalt de uitgangspunten voor nieuwe ontwerpen, beoordeelt complexe technische vraagstukken en zorgt ervoor dat verschillende engineeringdisciplines goed samenwerken. Daarbij ben je zowel inhoudelijk betrokken bij het ontwerp als verantwoordelijk voor de technische begeleiding van andere engineers. Ontwikkelen, berekenen en valideren van complexe constructieve ontwerpen en systemen, met aandacht voor sterkte, stijfheid, stabiliteit en vermoeiing; Analyseren van dynamische belastingen, windbelasting, versnellingen en bewegingen en deze vertalen naar technische ontwerpeisen; Uitvoeren en beoordelen van FEM/FEA-simulaties, sterkteberekeningen, stabiliteitsanalyses en knikberekeningen; Beoordelen van ontwerpwijzigingen, technische risico's en de gevolgen voor constructieve veiligheid en systeemintegriteit; Opstellen en bewaken van technische uitgangspunten, planningen, urenbegrotingen en projectkosten; Coördineren van multidisciplinaire engineeringactiviteiten en afstemmen met projectmanagers, leveranciers en andere technische specialisten; Verbeteren van ontwerpmethodieken, delen van technische kennis en begeleiden van engineers bij complexe constructieve vraagstukken. Dit krijg je ervoor terug! Je krijgt een uitdagende senior engineeringfunctie waarin je veel invloed hebt op de ontwikkeling van innovatieve technische systemen. Je werkt binnen een ervaren R&D-team en krijgt volop ruimte om jouw expertise in te zetten en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Een salaris tussen €5000,- en €8000,- bruto per maand op fulltime basis, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring; 27 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen bij een fulltime dienstverband; Arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de cao Metalektro, met aanvullende gunstige regelingen; Een premievrije pensioenregeling op basis van middelloon; Flexibele werktijden, een thuiswerkregeling en een goede reiskostenvergoeding; Mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en verdere technische specialisatie; Een informele werkomgeving met een bedrijfsrestaurant, gratis fruit en regelmatig georganiseerde personeelsactiviteiten; Direct dienstverband bij de opdrachtgever. Dit ben jij! Jij bent een technisch sterke engineer die complexe constructieve vraagstukken weet te doorgronden en het grotere geheel blijft overzien. Je werkt analytisch, neemt verantwoordelijkheid en weet technische keuzes goed te onderbouwen. Daarnaast vind je het leuk om jouw kennis over te dragen en andere engineers mee te nemen in nieuwe ontwikkelingen. Je beschikt over wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een opleiding in Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechanical Engineering of een vergelijkbare technische richting; Je hebt ruime ervaring met complexe constructies binnen de machinebouw of vergelijkbare technische systemen; Je beschikt over diepgaande kennis van sterkteleer, dynamica, materiaalgedrag, FEM/FEA en constructieve berekeningen; Je bent in staat om op systeemniveau te denken en begrijpt de samenhang tussen verschillende mechanische en technische subsystemen; Je hebt kennis van hydraulische en pneumatische systemen en begrijpt de invloed hiervan op constructieve ontwerpen; Je hebt ervaring met MATLAB en/of Python voor technische analyses. Hier ga jij aan de slag: Je gaat aan de slag bij een innovatieve machinebouwer in Oss die hoogwaardige, complexe machines ontwikkelt en produceert voor de internationale markt. Binnen de organisatie komen werktuigbouwkunde, hydrauliek, elektrotechniek en geavanceerde aandrijftechniek samen. Engineering, productie, testen en service vinden grotendeels binnen dezelfde organisatie plaats. Hierdoor zijn de lijnen kort en zie je direct hoe jouw technische keuzes in de praktijk worden toegepast. Je werkt samen met ervaren specialisten binnen een betrokken R&D-team waar innovatie, kwaliteit en technische ontwikkeling centraal staan. You can expect Competitive industry benchmarked salary and excellent pension; Performance based salary raises and bonuses; 30 holidays days per year, flexible working hours; Extensive training and development programme, study budgets and coaching; A company-sponsored fitness scheme; Internal clubs, committees, parties and (sportive) events.

title: Research Associate in Modelling and Robotics
description: Research Associate in Modelling and Robotics About The Role We are seeking a motivated Research Associate to join our research team at the University of Bath, contributing to the ARIA-funded Robot Dexterity Programme. The project aims to advance the fundamental understanding, modelling and control of robotic systems, with a particular focus on developing new analytical and computational frameworks for dexterous soft robotic manipulators. The successful candidate will contribute to ground breaking research at the intersection of computational mechanics, robotics and intelligent modelling, working within a multidisciplinary team to bridge fundamental physical principles and practical robotic applications. Key Responsibilities Include High-fidelity computational modelling: Develop and validate advanced physics-based models of robotic systems, including nonlinear mechanics, structural dynamics, large deformation and multi physics interactions, using numerical simulation tools such as COMSOL, ABAQUS or ANSYS. Robotic modelling and dynamics: Investigate the kinematics, dynamics and actuation of robotic manipulators, particularly soft and continuum robots, and establish computational frameworks that capture their complex physical behaviour. Experimental validation: Design and conduct experiments to validate high-fidelity computational models of robotic systems, integrating experimental measurements with numerical simulations to assess model accuracy, investigate dynamic behaviour and support the development of robotic manipulation and control. Research collaboration and validation: Work closely with researchers in robotics, modelling and control to validate theoretical developments through simulations and experiments, contribute to scientific publications, and support the delivery of project achievements. About You You will have a PhD (or be close to completion) in Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Computational Mechanics, Applied Mathematics or a closely related fields. Experience in robotics, finite element analysis, multi physics simulation would be particularly advantageous. This position offers an opportunity to contribute to an ambitious ARIA research programme, combining fundamental engineering science with the development of next-generation intelligent robotic systems. We are looking for a motivated researcher with a strong background in computational modelling and robotics, who enjoys tackling challenging engineering problems and working collaboratively within a multidisciplinary research team. Essential Qualifications, Skills And Experience A PhD (or nearing completion) in Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Computational Mechanics, Applied Mathematics or a closely related STEM field, or equivalent relevant research experience. Strong knowledge and practical experience in high-fidelity computational modelling, particularly finite element analysis (FEA), nonlinear mechanics, structural dynamics or multi physics simulation. Experience using numerical simulation software such as COMSOL, ABAQUS or ANSYS, or equivalent computational modelling tools. A good understanding of robotic systems, including kinematics, dynamics, actuation and control. Strong programming and numerical analysis skills, preferably in MATLAB, Python or equivalent environments. Ability to conduct independent research, analyse complex technical problems and communicate findings effectively. Good interpersonal and collaborative skills, with the ability to contribute effectively to a multidisciplinary research team. We welcome applications from candidates with diverse technical backgrounds who can demonstrate relevant expertise and a willingness to develop new skills. Further information The role is offered on a full time (36.5 hours per week) fixed term basis with an expected start date of January/February 2027. For an informal discussion about the role, please contact Professor Min Pan at m.pan@bath.ac.uk. We consider ourselves to be a university where difference is celebrated, respected and encouraged. title: Ingénieur-e Développement Mécanique F/H
description: Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie, actif dans l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements, intérieurs), l'espace et la défense. Sa mission : contribuer à un monde plus sûr et à un transport aérien plus écologique, confortable et accessible. Présent sur tous les continents, Safran emploie 110 000 collaborateurs, réalise 31,3 milliards d'euros de chiffre d'affaires en 2025, et occupe des positions majeures, seul ou en partenariat, sur ses marchés mondiaux ou européens. Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME. Safran Transmission Systems, héritier d'une tradition d'innovation, fait partie des leaders mondiaux des systèmes de transmission de puissance mécanique pour avions commerciaux, d'affaires et militaires, avec plus de 50 000 produits en service et 80% de parts de marché sur les avions court et moyen-courriers. Ses 2 000 collaborateurs, principalement en France et en Pologne, couvrent R&D, conception, fabrication et maintien en service, pilotant un réseau d'une centaine de fournisseurs majeurs. Safran Transmission Systems développe des systèmes innovants pour la prochaine génération de moteurs et la propulsion électrique et hybride, participant à la décarbonation de l'aéronautique. Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi. Au sein de notre équipe Développement, vous serez responsable des études techniques, de la conception, de la fiabilisation de matériels. Vos principales activités sont : * Piloter et exécuter les phases de conception mécanique dans le cadre du processus de développement, en garantissant le respect des coûts, de la qualité et des délais. * Réaliser des simulations (éléments finis, calculs structurels) et interpréter les résultats pour ajuster vos solutions et proposer des évolutions méthodologiques. * Rédiger et contrôler la documentation technique (notes de calcul, plans , dossiers d'essais, rapports de conformité) selon les procédures internes. * Veiller à la fabricabilité et à la maintenabilité des matériels tout au long du cycle de vie produit. * Identifier et valoriser vos innovations par le dépôt de déclarations d'inventions * Capitaliser et transmettre les bonnes pratiques auprès des autres ingénieurs et des réseaux d'expertise. De formation Bac + 5 en génie mécanique, ou doctorat dans un domaine proche Vous possédez une expérience d'au moins 3 ans sur une fonction similaire, idéalement dans l'aéronautique, l'automobile ou un secteur industriel exigeant. Au cours de votre parcours vous avez acquis des compétences en : * Conception et dimensionnement mécanique (familiarité avec les normes de cotation et de tolérancement) * Maîtrise des outils de simulation et d'analyse (éléments finis, calculs matériaux…) * Rédaction de documents techniques et suivi de validation (NT, CAD, DECs, plans d'essais) Enfin vous savez faire preuve : * D'esprit d'équipe et bonnes aptitudes relationnelles * De sens de l'organisation, rigueur et fiabilité * D'autonomie, curiosité technique et capacité à prendre des initiatives * Et avez des notions de gestion de projets et d'amélioration continue

description: Job Description Agilent inspiriert und unterstützt Entdeckungen, die zur Verbesserung der Lebensqualität beitragen. Wir versorgen Labore in den Bereichen Life Science, Diagnostik und angewandte Märkte weltweit mit Instrumenten, Dienstleistungen, Verbrauchsmaterialien, Anwendungen und Know-how. Agilent ermöglicht seinen Kunden, die Antworten und Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen, die sie suchen, damit sie das tun können, was sie am besten können: die Welt um uns herum verbessern. Weitere Informationen über Agilent Technologies: www.agilent.com. Für unser R&D Mechanical Engineering Team in Waldbronn suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n Entwicklungsingenieur:in mit Schwerpunkt Maschinenbau. In dieser Rolle entwickelst du anspruchsvolle mechanische Baugruppen für analytische Instrumente und verantwortest technische Arbeitspakete von der Konzeption über Konstruktion und Prototyping bis zur Verifikation und Vorbereitung für die Produktion. Dabei verbindest du fundiertes Mechanical Engineering mit Hands-on-Mentalität, Eigenverantwortung und enger interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit. Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst und konstruierst komplexe mechanische Komponenten und Baugruppen von der Konzeptphase bis zur Produktionsvorbereitung. Du entwickelst und bewertest technische Lösungskonzepte hinsichtlich Funktion, Robustheit, Toleranzen, Fertigbarkeit, Kosten und Entwicklungsaufwand. Du erstellst parametrische 3D-CAD-Modelle, fertigungsgerechte Zeichnungen und Toleranzanalysen und legst geeignete Werkstoffe und Fertigungsverfahren fest. Du analysierst auch komplexe technische Probleme selbstständig, entwickelst Lösungsansätze und treibst daraus resultierende Designentscheidungen voran. Du planst, koordinierst und bewertest Prototypen- und Entwicklungsversuche und leitest aus den Ergebnissen konstruktive Verbesserungen ab. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für technische Arbeitspakete, identifizierst Risiken und Abhängigkeiten und vertrittst deine Lösungen in Design Reviews und gegenüber dem Projektteam. Du koordinierst die technischen Schnittstellen zu anderen Engineering-Disziplinen sowie zu NPI, Einkauf, Qualität, Fertigung und externen Partnern. Abhängig von deiner Erfahrung und dem Projektumfang kannst du auch die technische Verantwortung für komplette mechanische Module übernehmen. Qualifications Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossenes Studium im Maschinenbau, in der Mechatronik, Feinwerktechnik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung. Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung in der mechanischen Produktentwicklung, typischerweise mindestens 4 Jahre. Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Entwicklung komplexer mechanischer Komponenten oder Baugruppen, idealerweise von der Konzeption über Konstruktion und Prototyping bis zur Verifikation. Sicherer Umgang mit einem parametrischen 3D-CAD-System. Erfahrung mit Siemens NX ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Gute Kenntnisse in fertigungsgerechter Konstruktion, technischen Zeichnungen, Toleranzen, Passungen und Form- und Lagetolerierung (GD&T). Sehr gutes Verständnis spanender Fertigungsverfahren sowie Erfahrung mit Werkstoffauswahl und Toleranzanalysen. Praktische Erfahrung mit Prototyping, Testing, Verifikation und strukturierter Ursachenanalyse. Grundverständnis weiterer Fertigungstechnologien wie Blechbearbeitung, Kunststoff/Spritzguss sowie von Oberflächen und Beschichtungen ist von Vorteil. Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar zu vertreten. Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit und daran, technische Themen auch über Funktionsgrenzen hinweg aktiv voranzutreiben. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens Niveau C1 sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Von Vorteil sind Erfahrung mit Siemens NX und Teamcenter Kenntnisse in Blechkonstruktion und Kunststoff/Spritzguss Kenntnisse zu technischen Oberflächen und Beschichtungen Erfahrung mit additiver Fertigung und Rapid Prototyping Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lieferanten bzw. externen Entwicklungspartnern Erfahrung in einem NPI-Umfeld erste technische Verantwortung für größere Baugruppen, Teilsysteme oder Module Additional Details This job has a full time weekly schedule. title: Ingénieur Calcul de Structures Mécaniques (H/F)
description: À propos d’ACALY 🚀 Créée en 2015, ACALY est une société de conseil en ingénierie implantée en France (Lille, Paris, Lyon et Nantes), en Suisse et en Belgique. Partenaire privilégié des entreprises industrielles, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réalisation de projets à forte valeur ajoutée, en mobilisant notre expertise technique et notre engagement. Chez ACALY, nous proposons un accompagnement solide dès votre intégration et tout au long de votre parcours professionnel, avec de réelles perspectives d'évolution. ➡️ Description du poste Dans le cadre d'un projet innovant dédié au développement d'un système de stockage d'énergie cinétique à haute vitesse de rotation, vous interviendrez sur des composants mécaniques critiques, avec un rôle essentiel dans la fiabilité, la performance et la sécurité du système. Missions principales : Réaliser les calculs de dimensionnement mécanique des pièces et ensembles en rotation, en tenant compte des contraintes liées aux vitesses de rotation élevées. Construire et exploiter des modèles par éléments finis (FEA) sous ANSYS, en définissant les hypothèses de calcul et en sélectionnant les méthodes de simulation adaptées. Analyser le comportement dynamique du rotor et de ses paliers , notamment les vibrations, les modes propres et les phénomènes de résonance. Étudier la résistance mécanique et la tenue en fatigue des composants , en évaluant les contraintes et les risques de défaillance dans des conditions de fonctionnement exigeantes. Interpréter et valider les résultats des simulations , vérifier la cohérence physique des modèles et proposer des solutions techniques pour améliorer la fiabilité et la sécurité du système. ➡️ Profil recherché Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'ingénieur ou d'un Master en mécanique, calcul de structures ou domaine équivalent. Vous disposez idéalement d'une expérience en calcul mécanique, avec une connaissance des machines tournantes et des systèmes fonctionnant à haute vitesse. Compétences techniques : Bonne maîtrise du calcul et du dimensionnement mécanique. Expérience en calcul par éléments finis et capacité à interpréter les résultats de simulation. Connaissances en analyse des contraintes, résistance des matériaux et fatigue. Compréhension des phénomènes de dynamique vibratoire, des modes propres et des fréquences de résonance. Maîtrise du logiciel ANSYS pour les simulations et calculs mécaniques. Connaissance d'un logiciel de CAO mécanique, notamment CREO . Les avantages ACALY Rejoindre ACALY, c’est bénéficier d’un CDI à temps plein et d’un package de rémunération adapté au niveau de responsabilité du poste. Nous proposons notamment un véhicule de société selon le profil et les besoins de la mission, des chèques repas, des écochèques, une assurance santé, et d'autres avantages.

Develop system architectures, derive requirements at subsystem and component levels, and define and manage interfaces. Evaluate technical alternatives and support engineering analyses and design decisions. Plan and execute system integration, verification, and validation activities. Prepare systems engineering technical documentation, coordinate with relevant disciplines, and maintain documentation currency. Awareness of safety-critical systems, reliability, and system safety processes. Experience in the development of hydraulic, pneumatic, or electromechanical systems or aerospace equipment.

title: Sistem Emniyeti Güvenilirlik Mühendisi
description: İlan Hakkında HARPAX Sistem Teknolojileri, hava, kara ve deniz platformlarına yönelik silah entegrasyonu ve kritik alt sistemlerin tasarım ve üretimini gerçekleştiren, bir mühendislik şirketidir. Pozisyon; Mühimmat ve Silah Sistemleri, Motor Aksesuar Sistemleri ile hava, kara ve deniz platformlarına yönelik kritik alt sistem ve sistem entegrasyonu projelerinde emniyet, güvenilirlik, hazır bulunuşluk, idame edilebilirlik ve test edilebilirlik çalışmalarını gereksinimden doğrulamaya kadar yürütecektir. İş Tanımı Proje ve müşteri gereksinimleri ile uygulanabilir standartlara uygun sistem emniyeti ve güvenilirlik programını planlamak; analiz, gözden geçirme, teslimat ve raporlama faaliyetlerini yürütmek. Emniyet ve RAMS gereksinimlerini sistem, alt sistem ve birim seviyelerine ayrıştırmak, tahsis etmek; gereksinimlerin mimari, tasarım ve doğrulama çıktılarıyla izlenebilirliğini sağlamak. Tehlikeleri sistematik olarak belirlemek; riskleri şiddet ve olasılık açısından değerlendirmek, tehlike kaydını (hazard log) güncel tutmak ve risk azaltma aksiyonlarının kapanışını takip etmek. Projenin niteliğine göre FHA, PSSA, SSA, PHA, SHA ve SSHA gibi emniyet değerlendirmelerini gerçekleştirmek veya ilgili disiplinlerle koordineli yürütmek. Hata Ağacı Analizi (FTA), Hata Türleri, Etkileri ve Kritiklik Analizi (FMEA/FMECA), güvenilirlik blok diyagramı ve ortak neden analizleri gibi yöntemleri uygulamak ve raporlamak. Güvenilirlik hedeflerini sistem ve alt sistem seviyelerine tahsis etmek; arıza oranı, MTBF, hazır bulunuşluk, idame edilebilirlik ve test edilebilirlik hesaplarını veya tahminlerini yürütmek. Sistem mimarisi, fonksiyonel ayrıştırma, arayüzler ve tasarım alternatiflerine emniyet ve güvenilirlik girdisi sağlamak; teknik gözden geçirmelere ve tasarım kararlarına katılmak. Sistem, mekanik, elektronik, yazılım, analiz, test, kalite ve proje yönetimi ekipleriyle koordinasyon kurarak emniyet ve güvenilirlik aksiyonlarının proje planına uygun şekilde tamamlanmasını sağlamak. Doğrulama ve test planlarına emniyet ve güvenilirlik girdileri sağlamak; güvenilirlik gösterim, çevresel test, hata enjeksiyonu veya benzeri doğrulama sonuçlarını değerlendirmek. Prototip, test, üretim ve saha kullanımından gelen arıza verilerini FRACAS kapsamında takip etmek; kök neden, düzeltici faaliyet ve etkinlik doğrulama çalışmalarına katkı sağlamak. Uygunluk matrisi, emniyet değerlendirme raporu, güvenilirlik raporu ve müşteri teslimatlarını hazırlamak; önemli riskleri, sapmaları ve aksiyon durumlarını proje yönetimine düzenli raporlamak. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği, Mekatronik Mühendisliği, Uçak Mühendisliği, Havacılık ve Uzay Mühendisliği veya ilgili bölümlerinden mezun. Sistem, alt sistem veya birim seviyesinde emniyet ve/veya güvenilirlik çalışmalarında en az 6 yıl proje deneyimli. FTA, FMEA/FMECA, tehlike analizi, risk değerlendirme ve güvenilirlik tahmini yöntemlerinden birkaçını uygulamalı olarak kullanmış. Gereksinimlerin ayrıştırılması, tahsisi, izlenebilirliği ve doğrulama yöntemlerinin belirlenmesi konularında bilgi sahibi. Arıza oranı, MTBF, hazır bulunuşluk ve benzeri güvenilirlik ölçütlerini hesaplayabilecek; nicel verileri ve analiz varsayımlarını sorgulayabilecek düzeyde istatistik ve mühendislik bilgisine sahip. Proje kapsamına bağlı olarak MIL-STD-882, SAE ARP4761/ARP4754, MIL-HDBK-217 veya eşdeğer emniyet ve güvenilirlik standartlarından en az birine aşina. Ansys medini analyze, PTC Windchill veya eşdeğer emniyet analizi, gereksinim ve PLM araçlarından biriyle çalışmış olması tercih sebebidir. Teknik rapor hazırlama, literatür ve güvenilirlik verisi araştırma, kanıta dayalı değerlendirme ve sonuçları tasarım ekiplerine aktarabilme yetkinliği gelişmiş. Sistem, tasarım, analiz, test, kalite ve proje ekipleriyle etkin iletişim kurabilen; aksiyon takibi ve sonuçlandırma konusunda disiplinli. Analitik düşünebilen, detaylara dikkat eden, problem çözme ve teknik karar alma becerileri güçlü. İyi derecede İngilizce bilen. Seyahat engeli olmayan ve Ankara'da ikamet eden veya edebilecek. Erkek adaylar için askerlik hizmetini tamamlamış veya muaf.

title: Field Service Specialist
description: ZEISS is technology and innovation. Founded in Germany, in 1846, ZEISS is an internationally leading technology enterprise operating in the optics and optoelectronics industries across 50 countries. As a company wholly owned by a foundation, ZEISS is committed to responsibility in all its activities. As a pioneer in scientific optics, its employees across the globe continue to push the boundaries of what is possible. With a strong focus on quality and innovation, ZEISS creates value for its customers and helps shape new ways of seeing the world. We’re looking for a Field Service Specialist to join us in Istanbul or Ankara, Türkiye, with frequent travel to customer sites. ZEISS Research Microscopy Solutions (RMS) provides advanced microscopy solutions for life sciences, materials research, semiconductor, and academic institutions. Our portfolio includes light, confocal, electron, and X-ray microscopy systems, supporting scientific discovery and technological innovation across research and industry. Your Role As a Field Service Specialist, you will be responsible for providing high-quality technical service and support for advanced ZEISS microscopy systems at customer sites. You will work closely with customers, internal teams and global technical experts to ensure equipment performance, customer satisfaction and long-term system reliability. The Role Of Field Service Specialist Will Involve: Installing, commissioning, maintaining, calibrating, upgrading and troubleshooting advanced microscopy systems, including SEM, FE-SEM, FIB-SEM and related equipment. Performing preventive and corrective maintenance, acceptance testing, performance verification and system upgrades in accordance with manufacturer standards. Diagnosing complex technical issues across mechanical, electronic, electrical, computer and software systems, using a structured root cause analysis approach. Providing on-site and remote technical support, identifying customer needs and developing effective, long-term solutions. Working closely with Sales, Applications, Customer Support, Product Management and Global Technical Support teams to resolve technical issues and manage escalations. Providing technical guidance and basic user training to customers on equipment operation, maintenance and best practices. Identifying spare part requirements, supporting service planning and ensuring preventive maintenance activities are completed effectively. Preparing accurate service reports and maintaining complete records of technical activities within CRM, service reporting and ticketing systems. Building strong, long-term customer relationships and maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction. Following all relevant health and safety requirements, including those related to high-voltage systems, vacuum technology, radiation/X-ray safety and laboratory environments. Your Experience Bachelor’s degree in Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Physics, Physics Engineering or a related technical discipline. 1–3 years of experience in a technical service, field service or similar engineering role, preferably within an international organisation. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and develop sustainable solutions. Ability to read and interpret electrical/electronic schematics, technical drawings, service documentation and maintenance instructions. Ability to troubleshoot and analyse mechanical, electronic, computer and software-related issues. Comfortable working with measurement instruments, diagnostic equipment and technical testing tools. Strong customer-facing and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical information clearly and professionally. Good command of written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate effectively with international technical teams. Valid driving licence and active driving experience. Willingness and ability to travel frequently to customer sites. For male candidates, completion of military service or no military obligation is required. It Would Be Desirable If You Had: Experience with electron microscopy, vacuum technology, high-voltage electronics, precision mechanics or scientific instrumentation. Previous experience working with SEM, FE-SEM, FIB-SEM or similar high-technology equipment. Experience with CRM systems, remote support tools, service reporting systems or ticketing platforms. Previous experience working with medical devices, analytical instruments, laboratory equipment or other complex technical systems. Your Benefits If you join ZEISS, you will have access to a range of benefits, including: Working with advanced technologies and highly skilled international teams. Opportunities for technical training, professional development and career growth within a global technology organisation. The opportunity to work directly with customers and contribute to the performance of advanced scientific and research equipment. Role Details Location: Istanbul or Ankara, Türkiye Working conditions: Field-based role with frequent travel to customer sites across Türkiye and occasional international travel as required. Apply now to take the next step in joining ZEISS, where you can push technological boundaries, shape markets and contribute to the advancement of society. title: Mechanisch ontwerper - Product Development
description: Werk jij mee aan precisiemechanica voor grensverleggende wetenschap en technologie? Binnen JPE ontwikkelen en leveren we binnen onze CNP-afdeling (Cryo & Nano Products) compacte en uiterst nauwkeurige positioneeroplossingen voor gebruik in cryogene en vacuümomgevingen. Deze technologie wordt wereldwijd toegepast in onder andere quantumtechnologie en wetenschappelijke instrumentatie. Wij zoeken een Mechanical Design Engineer – Productontwikkeling die graag ontwerpt en construeert én producten daadwerkelijk wil bouwen, testen en verbeteren. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de ontwikkeling en verdere verbetering van onze CNP-producten. Je werkt in een klein team en bent betrokken bij vrijwel de volledige levenscyclus van onze producten: van een eerste idee of verbetering tot engineering, prototypebouw, validatie, documentatie en uiteindelijk toepassing bij de klant. Wat ga je doen? Als Mechanical Design Engineer werk je aan de ontwikkeling en realisatie van onze CNP-positioneerproducten. Daarbij combineer je werktuigbouwkundige engineering met praktisch testen en een goed begrip van de toepassing waarvoor het product wordt ontwikkeld. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Ontwikkelen en verbeteren van mechanische onderdelen, modules en complete CNP-producten Vertalen van functionele eisen naar slimme, nauwkeurige en maakbare constructies Uitwerken van ontwerpen in 3D CAD en productietekeningen Bouwen, assembleren, testen en valideren van prototypes voordat producten worden vrijgegeven Opstellen en onderhouden van technische productdocumentatie, zoals manufacturing data, design reports, assembly manuals, user manuals, datasheets en 3D STEP-modellen Uitvoeren van klantspecifieke aanpassingen en custom engineeringprojecten Technisch ondersteunen van klanten en sales bij selectie, integratie en toepassing van onze producten Signaleren en uitwerken van verbeteringen aan bestaande producten en ideeën voor uitbreiding van het portfolio Verder structureren en verbeteren van onze engineering- en productontwikkelprocessen Technisch actueel houden van productinformatie voor de website Door de omvang van het team is je werk breed. De ene dag werk je aan een nieuw mechanisch concept, de volgende dag analyseer je testresultaten of denk je met een klant mee over de integratie van een positioneeroplossing in zijn systeem. Wat zoeken wij? Je bent een werktuigbouwkundig engineer die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor een product en verder kijkt dan alleen het CAD-model. Je wilt begrijpen waarom een constructie werkt, hoe deze zich in de praktijk gedraagt en wat nodig is om er een betrouwbaar product van te maken. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende: HBO of MSc Werktuigbouwkunde, Precision Engineering of vergelijkbaar Goede kennis van mechanisch ontwerpen en construeren Affiniteit met precision engineering en fijnmechanische constructies Kennis van en affiniteit met onderwerpen zoals: - statisch bepaald construeren - stijfheid en sterkte - toleranties en tolerantieketens - materiaalkeuze - thermisch gedrag - precisiegeleidingen en lageringen - maakbaarheid en assemblage Ervaring met 3D CAD Je werkt analytisch en kunt ontwerpkeuzes technisch onderbouwen Je vindt het leuk om naast engineering ook praktisch bezig te zijn met assemblage, testen en validatie Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt actief de samenwerking met collega's uit andere disciplines Je spreekt goed Nederlands en kunt gemakkelijk deelnemen aan zowel technische overleggen als informele gesprekken binnen ons team. Daarnaast communiceer je gemakkelijk in het Engels met collega's, leveranciers en klanten. Je werkt gestructureerd en vindt het belangrijk dat ontwerpen, testresultaten en productdocumentatie goed worden vastgelegd Een pré is ervaring met: Het ontwikkelen van mechanische systemen voor vacuüm-, ultrahoogvacuüm- en/of cryogene omgevingen Constructieprincipes binnen precision engineering Aangrenzende vakgebieden zoals electronica, mechatronica Wat maakt deze functie bijzonder? In deze functie werk je niet alleen aan de ontwikkeling van afzonderlijke producten, maar bouw je mee aan een eigen technisch productportfolio. Je gebruikt feedback uit productie en van klanten om een volgende generatie producten beter te maken. Je blijft betrokken bij producten die je eerder hebt ontworpen: je ontwerpbeslissingen werken daardoor door in de verdere ontwikkeling. Die betrokkenheid loopt van de eerste engineering tot de daadwerkelijke toepassing bij een klant. Tegelijkertijd werk je binnen JPE, waardoor je kunt terugvallen op collega's met veel ervaring op het gebied van precision engineering, mechatronica, analyse en systeemontwikkeling. Zo combineer je de verantwoordelijkheid en korte lijnen van een klein productteam met de technische kennis en disciplines binnen de bredere JPE-organisatie. Wat bieden wij? Een brede engineeringfunctie met veel technische verantwoordelijkheid Werken aan hightech producten voor internationale klanten en onderzoeksinstellingen Directe betrokkenheid bij de volledige product lifecycle Veel vrijheid om producten én werkwijzen verder te verbeteren Een klein team met korte lijnen en ruimte voor eigen initiatief Samenwerking met ervaren engineers binnen JPE Mogelijkheden om je verder te ontwikkelen in precision engineering, cryogene techniek en productontwikkeling Marktconforme arbeidsvoorwaarden Wil jij niet alleen ontwerpen, maar jouw ontwerp ook zien uitgroeien tot een product? Een product dat wereldwijd wordt toegepast in geavanceerde systemen en grensverleggende toepassingen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Stuur je CV, motivatie en contactgegevens naar Maurice Teuwen via maurice.teuwen@jpe.nl. Directe sollicitaties van kandidaten hebben de voorkeur. Voor deze vacature werken wij niet samen met werving-, selectie- of detacheringsbureaus.

title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer - HVAC

This is a senior technical leadership position, offering the opportunity to take ownership of complex mechanical design projects across Air Handling Units (AHUs), Computer Room Air Handling (CRAH) systems, Fan Wall units and Cooling Distribution Units (CDUs). Working closely with customers and multidisciplinary engineering teams, you will translate complex technical requirements into practical, innovative and manufacturable solutions. You will lead projects from initial concept and detailed design through prototype development, validation and final production release. This role would suit an experienced HVAC mechanical design engineer who combines strong technical expertise with customer-facing experience and the ability to mentor and guide other engineers. Key Responsibilities Lead the mechanical design and development of bespoke HVAC and data centre cooling equipment, including AHUs, CRAHs, Fan Walls and CDUs. Act as the primary technical interface between customers and internal engineering teams. Lead customer meetings and technical discussions to understand, challenge and define project requirements. Translate customer specifications into practical and manufacturable engineering solutions. Drive projects from concept development through detailed design, prototype testing, validation and production release. Conduct technical feasibility assessments, design reviews and engineering risk evaluations. Perform coil, fan and pump selections using relevant engineering methodologies and selection software. Review and approve engineering designs, technical submittals and customer-facing documentation. Support prototype testing, performance verification and resolution of technical issues. Work closely with manufacturing, quality, sourcing, controls and project management teams. Provide technical leadership, guidance and mentorship to mechanical engineers. Ensure designs comply with relevant industry standards, project specifications and internal engineering practices. Support customer presentations, technical proposals and bid reviews. What We Are Looking For Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Minimum 10 years' experience in HVAC mechanical design engineering. Extensive knowledge of Air Handling Unit (AHU) design and HVAC equipment. Experience leading complex, customer-driven engineering and product development projects. Strong understanding of mechanical design principles, manufacturing considerations and product development lifecycles. Experience taking engineering projects from initial concept through prototype validation and production handover. Practical experience with coil selection, fan selection and pump selection. Previous experience engaging directly with customers in a technical or engineering capacity. Demonstrated ability to review, approve and technically sign off engineering designs. Strong communication, problem-solving and technical leadership capabilities. Desirable Experience Experience designing or developing data centre cooling equipment, including CRAH, CRAC, Fan Wall or CDU systems. Knowledge of chilled water and refrigerant pipework design. Familiarity with relevant HVAC industry standards, codes and regulatory requirements. Experience with prototype development, performance testing and product validation. The Package Competitive salary, dependent on experience. Opportunity to take on a senior technical leadership position within a specialist engineering environment. Involvement in complex, technically challenging HVAC and data centre cooling projects. Opportunity to influence product development and engineering standards. Apply If you are an experienced HVAC Mechanical Design Engineer looking to take on a senior technical leadership role within a specialist engineering environment, we would be interested in hearing from you. Apply today or contact our engineering recruitment team for a confidential discussion.

Dit kan gaan om detail berekeningen voor componenten tot globale structurele modellen van vliegtuigen. Verder werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe proces simulaties van nieuwe innovatieve fabricage concepten en ondersteun je experimentele testen met simulaties. title: Materials & Integrity Engineer
description: EPZ zoekt voor de afdeling Engineering een Materials & Integrity Engineer met focus op verouderingsbeheersing, materiaalkunde en de technische integriteit van de veiligheidsrelevante systemen, structuren en componenten van Kerncentrale Borssele. Dit is een inhoudelijk sterke engineeringfunctie binnen een uniek werkveld. Je werkt aan vraagstukken rond materiaaldegradatie, inspecties, levensduur, normering en technische onderbouwingen voor veilige en betrouwbare bedrijfsvoering. Bij deze rol hoort, na inwerktraject en formele aanwijzing binnen EPZ, de bevoegdheid om technische onderbouwingen te accepteren, voorwaardelijk te accepteren, op te schorten of te weigeren wanneer integriteit of vergunningsconformiteit onvoldoende onderbouwd is. Daarmee draag je direct bij aan de technische basis voor de bedrijfsduurverlenging. Wij zoeken een ervaren engineer die inhoudelijke diepgang combineert met eigenaarschap. Iemand die technische conclusies zorgvuldig onderbouwt, standhoudt onder druk en helder communiceert met collega’s, leveranciers en externe stakeholders. Help jij ons in ons streven naar technische excellentie? Jouw functie Je draagt vanuit jouw materiaalkundige en integriteitstechnische expertise bij aan het beheer, de ontwikkeling en de beoordeling van verouderingsbeheersing binnen de kerncentrale, met focus op de primaire systemen, het reactorvat, de stoomgeneratoren en secundaire systemen. Je houdt je bezig met degradatiemechanismen, inspectieresultaten, technische normering en de beoordeling van de restlevensduur van componenten. Je rapporteert aan de Chef Engineering. Concreet Betekent Dit Dat Je Verouderingsmechanismen identificeert, beoordeelt en vertaalt naar passende beheersmaatregelen; Ageing Management Reviews en verouderingsbeheersingsplannen opstelt, beoordeelt en actueel houdt, conform IAEA SSG-48 en de IGALL-systematiek; Inspectie-, test- en monitoringprogramma’s ontwikkelt en de resultaten daarvan technisch beoordeelt — onder meer voor In-Service Inspection (volgens ASME XI), PRD-bevindingen, reactorvat-surveillance en embrittlement-monitoring (conform KTA en ASME XI); Trends, afwijkingen en degradatiebeelden analyseert en vertaalt naar onderbouwde adviezen voor inspectie, herstel, vervanging of voortgezet bedrijf; Interne en internationale operationele ervaring, gewijzigde regelgeving (IAEA SSR-2/1, IAEA SSG-48, Nederlandse nucleaire wet- en regelgeving) en externe ontwikkelingen beoordeelt en vertaalt naar verbeteringen in programma’s en werkwijzen; Technische onderbouwingen, vendor-documenten en externe rapportages (van bijvoorbeeld Framatome, TÜV SÜD, NRG) beoordeelt vanuit de rol van deskundige opdrachtgever; Bijdraagt aan risicoanalyses, fit-for-purpose beoordelingen, Item Equivalency Evaluations bij obsolescence en technische onderbouwingen voor voortgezet bedrijf ( Justification for Continued Operation ); Samenwerkt met collega’s op het gebied van inspectie, vermoeiing, equipment qualification, ontwerp, onderhoud, operations en reliability; Projectplannen opstelt, planning en budget bewaakt en zorgt voor duidelijke voortgangs- en eindrapportages, inclusief de jaarrapportages binnen je domein; Jouw kennis actief deelt binnen EPZ en in internationale vakgroepen (FROG, IGALL, PWROG, ASME-codecommissies). Binnen deze functie werk je in een omgeving waarin technische oordeelsvorming belangrijk is. Niet iedere vraag heeft direct een eenvoudig antwoord. Juist daarom zoeken we iemand die zorgvuldig kan omgaan met onzekerheden in data, modellen en inspectieresultaten, en die helder kan aangeven wat technisch wel en niet verantwoord is. Jouw profiel Eisen Een afgeronde technische academische opleiding, bij voorkeur in materiaalkunde, werktuigbouwkunde of een vergelijkbare richting; Ruime relevante ervaring (typisch 5 jaar of meer) in een nucleaire of vergelijkbaar streng gereguleerde (proces)industrie, met aantoonbare praktijk in degradatie-analyse, integriteitsbeoordeling of inspectie-evaluatie; Kennis van materiaaldegradatie, sterkteleer, breukmechanica en inspectie- en lastechnieken; Kennis van en werken met de relevante internationale normen, zoals bijvoorbeeld: ASME XI, KTA, IAEA SSG-48, ENIQ; Kennis van risico- en veiligheidsanalyse, inclusief het werken met probabilistische modellen, empirische data en deterministische compliance — het komen tot een verantwoord oordeel onder onzekerheid is voor deze rol een kerncompetentie; Vlot lezen van Engels (IAEA, ASME, ENIQ), en helder schrijven in Nederlands en Engels.Specifieke plantkennis (Konvoi-veiligheidsconcept, ontwerp en vergunningskader van de Borssele-kerncentrale) bouw je bij EPZ verder op via opleiding, begeleiding en praktijkervaring. Pré Vlot lezen van Duits voor KTA- en Konvoi-documentatie, of de bereidheid om dit op werkniveau te ontwikkelen na indiensttreding; Aanvullende opleiding of certificering op inspectietechnieken, lastechniek of fitness-for-service-analyse (API 579 / ASME); Ervaring met gangbare integriteits-, monitoring- en transient-tracking-systemen (zoals FAMOS, COMSY of vergelijkbaar); Eerdere deelname aan internationale vakgroepen of IAEA-missies (Pre-SALTO, SALTO, OSART). Wat we naast vakkennis belangrijk vinden Voor deze functie zoeken we niet alleen een technisch sterke engineer. We zoeken iemand die ook past bij de rol die de afdeling Engineering binnen EPZ heeft. Dat Betekent Dat Je Nieuwsgierig blijft en technische conclusies niet zomaar overneemt zonder eigen oordeel; Verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor je adviezen en conclusies; Zorgvuldig werkt en keuzes goed vastlegt; Constructief samenwerkt met andere disciplines, ook wanneer belangen of prioriteiten verschillen; Rustig en duidelijk communiceert, ook wanneer de boodschap technisch of organisatorisch lastig is; EPZ professioneel vertegenwoordigt richting interne en externe stakeholders. Ons aanbod Een bruto salaris conform de cao PLb en cao EPZ van minimaal €5.535 en maximaal €7.472 bij een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van ervaring

title: Marine Engineer - Global Engineering
description: Working at Boskalis is about creating new horizons and sustainable solutions. In a world where population growth, an increase of global trade, demand for (new) energy and climate change are driving forces, we challenge you to make your mark in finding innovative and relevant solutions for complex infrastructural and marine projects. In your job you will work for the offshore energy division. Boskalis has one of the largest global fleets of specialized offshore vessels, allowing us to carry out a broad range of offshore activities. We provide innovative and sustainable all-round solutions to tackle major worldwide maritime challenges. Our Offshore Energy division supports sustainable energy solutions such as wind energy as well as traditional fossil facilities. We’re involved in the entire journey from developing and transporting to maintaining and decommissioning these facilities. Vacatureomschrijving Make your mark as a Marine Engineer at the Global Engineering department of Boskalis Offshore Energy. As a Marine Engineer, you assist multidisciplinary project engineering teams, which are responsible for the complete engineering of complex projects - from the concept design all the way to the supervision and assistance of the actual execution phase. Your knowledge of ocean environments, behavior of floating structures, machinery and (lifting) equipment is of vital importance for the understanding of offshore operations. Therefore, your expertise could be of great importance for the success of a project. Your Responsibilities. You commence project specific Vessel Motion Analysis, Station Keeping Analysis (Anchor Moorings and/or DP), Cable/Pipeline installation Analyses, Offshore Lifting Analyses, Sea fastening calculations, Stability calculations and many more. In addition to actual calculation assignments, you will be assisting in engineering various maritime and offshore related procedures as Towing manuals, Lifting procedures and Installation TaskPlans. Besides project specific engineering, you’ll also be involved in assisting the tender department with technical queries on future projects. Your Qualities And Experience You can move ahead as a Marine Engineer if you have: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering, Civil engineering, Marine engineering, Offshore Engineering or Naval Architecture. Knowledge and experience with programming language (Python, Matlab) is required. Knowledge and experience with Hydrodynamic software packages such as Orcaflex are highly appreciated. Willingness to stay on board during start-up & execution of offshore projects (approx. 4 to 6 weeks each year). Functie-eisen What You Can Expect A dynamic environment: A job that allows you to collaborate with a talented team of experts from different backgrounds and contribute to making a significant impact. Rewarding conditions: A competitive salary and much more, including holiday allowance, holiday entitlement (based on a full-time contract), a non-contributory pension scheme, collective schemes such as company health insurance, travel allowance, and much more. Career development: We offer you plenty of opportunities to bring out the best in yourself, for example, through (online) courses at our Boskalis academy. The Boskalis Campus: Experience the unique Boskalis vibe at our Papendrecht site, complete with restaurants, a sports field, and a wharf where our vessels dock. We offer a state-of-the-art auditorium, brainstorming rooms, an experience center for client meetings, and a barista corner where you can connect with colleagues. Young Boskalis: Are you under 36? Come and join Young Boskalis! Have fun and join in social and sports activities ranging from pub quizzes to yoga, bootcamps, and an annual sailing boat race. Networking and knowledge sharing are a vital part of Young Boskalis as well. Extra information Your team: You will be part of the Boskalis Global Engineering team in Boskalis Offshore Energy, based in Papendrecht. The 15 persons international team is characterized by their informal yet professional way of working together, flexibility, adaptability, and work hard play hard mentality. Full/part-time job: The position can be full-time or part-time (24 to 40 hours per week). Working location: The role is Papendrecht office based. Next steps: Apply easily by completing the online application form. Interviews are held online or in the office. Once it’s clear we’re a good match, we’ll make you an offer – and look forward to welcoming you to the company. Aanvullende informatie We are more than happy to answer your questions about the position of Marine Engineer. Please contact Thijs Wanders, Corporate Recruiter, via thijs.wanders@boskalis.com Please note: Boskalis never requests a financial contribution to arrange visas or other documents related to a job vacancy. Be wary of individuals who pretend to be our recruiters and do ask for such contributions. Disclaimer for Recruiters and Recruitment Agencies We appreciate your interest in our vacancies and understand that your candidate might be enthusiastic about this exciting opportunity. However, our recruitment process is not structured this way, at Boskalis we handle recruitment ourselves. Therefore, we do not accept unsolicited applications or CVs from recruitment agencies. Any submission will be treated as a direct application.

title: Senior Staff R&D Mechanical Engineer
description: About SAVA All the health information we need is within us. Just below the skin. SAVA is redefining the way people interact with their health by developing the most advanced biosensing technology science has to offer, capable of accessing bodily information in a painless, real-time and affordable way. The Role We are hiring a senior R&D Mechanical Engineer to own and lead experimental and analytical work to support the development of our wearable sensor. You will set experimental strategy, own the selection and sourcing of test equipment, and turn complex data into clear engineering decisions that shape the product. More generally, you will also support R&D efforts through research, analysis, modeling and simulation, as required to support engineering development. The technical challenges for this role are far-reaching and diverse. Some examples include understanding adhesive interfaces with the skin, modelling how the body interacts with our sensors, mechanically simulating our product under stress conditions, and carrying out root cause analyses of some of our most elusive technical challenges. You will be a technical authority in the team, mentoring others and setting an example for how we carry out R&D with creativity and rigour. You will be expected to be comfortable with desk-based analysis, lab-based experiments, technical planning, reporting of technical results, and leading others in their work. Suitable candidates may be considered for a Team Lead role. What You'll Do Own major workstreams that feed directly into product development, such as functional testing of materials, modelling of device subsystems, and simulation of component interactions. Lead root cause analyses to fully understand failure modes, and subsequently implement engineering solutions. Champion best-practices and define SOPs for experimental methods, statistical analyses and modeling approaches. Where necessary, lead the selection, evaluation and qualification of new test equipment, and author the methods and SOPs behind it. Work with the Product Engineering Team on investigative and verification testing. Collaborate with other teams across the business (e.g. Biomaterials, Data Science, Clinical etc.) to drive technical progress, whether this be in the form of bench testing, theoretical analysis or internal clinical trials focusing on real-world device performance. Effectively communicate results and recommendations to the leadership team. Mentor, lead and train junior engineers on experimental design, statistical analysis and good lab / workshop practices. What You'll Bring A Masters or PhD in mechanical engineering or a closely related field. 6+ years of hands-on experimental R&D, including time in a relevant industry. A track record of leading technical workstreams from open questions to clear outcomes. Deep expertise in experimental design and a good understanding of statistical approaches. Strong understanding of engineering fundamentals. Experience with mechanical and materials testing. Confidence in designing test fixtures and prototypes (CAD, 3D printing, machining). Fluent data analysis in Python, MATLAB, Minitab, JMP or similar. Sound engineering judgement: be able to make good calls even with incomplete data and defend your rationale. A mature approach to engineering risk: be able to thoroughly analyse risks as relevant to different development stages, and drive progress with appropriate mitigations. A practical approach to fast-paced engineering development: balance quick, informative experiments and intuitive engineering judgement with rigorous testing and documented engineering development. A thirst for knowledge: Gaps in experience should be filled through research, continuous learning, and active exposure to new areas of engineering. Bonus Points Exposure to medical device development (ISO 13485, design controls, verification testing). Experience with simulation software (FEA, CFD), such as ANSYS, COMSOL, Abaqus or similar. Experience in tolerance analysis. Previous work in a fast-paced and agile workplace, such as another engineering startup. Expertise in a specialist engineering field, such as polymer science, soft materials simulation or microfabrication techniques. Experience leading engineering teams and/or projects. Experience setting up a lab or specifying capital equipment.

The Opportunity Our resilience, security and risk practice has consistently been at the forefront of the field since it was formed in the mid-1990s. The practice brings together threat specialists, physical and electronic security engineers, operational security specialists and blast engineers in a unique multi-disciplinary environment, helping our clients manage malicious risk, natural hazards and operational reliability in each aspect of their businesses and operations. We bring together a talent for engineering and design with a sound knowledge of fluid dynamics and the theory of structural dynamics, allowing us to use first principles to understand the fundamental behaviour of structures under extreme loads and develop innovative design solutions. We are looking for Graduate Blast Engineers to join our team in London or Manchester. Your role will be to prepare blast engineering analysis and design of structural and façade systems, working in collaboration with multi-disciplinary design teams formed of architects, engineers, cost consultants and project managers to integrate our design solutions into the built environment. Unlike traditional codified design, blast engineering requires a very different approach to the design but requires a designer's empathy with regard to aesthetic, form and function of any proposed facility. As such, this is a great opportunity for a structural engineering graduate to position their future career, providing strategic input and undertaking first-principles design. Often working outside mandatory codes of practice in a risk-based framework, you will be responsible for developing the design basis and then preparing a design to meet these requirements. The team has a comprehensive training system to allow you to apply the fundamental theory you have gained from your University Degree into the blast engineering field. title: Structural Simulation Engineer
description: Responsibilities The Structural Simulation Engineer will support the structural design and development of Liebherr container cranes through Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and simulation activities. The primary focus of the role will be the assessment and optimisation of crane components and structures using Ansys, including both static and transient/dynamic simulations. The successful candidate will also have the opportunity to develop skills in multi-body dynamics modelling and control system simulation using MATLAB/Simulink and Simscape Multibody, working closely with structural, automation and control engineering teams. Key Elements of the Role: Responsibilities shall include, but are not limited to the following: Perform structural analysis of crane components and assemblies using the Ansys suite of software. Conduct static, nonlinear and transient dynamic simulations to support product development and verifi-cation activities. Evaluate structural strength, stiffness, fatigue performance and dynamic behaviour of crane structures and mechanical systems. Prepare, review and interpret finite element models, simulation results and technical reports. Support the development and validation of simulation methodologies and best practices within the de-partment. Collaborate with design engineers to improve component and system performance through simulation-led design. Develop and maintain simplified and detailed simulation models for complex mechanical systems. Support the modelling of crane mechanisms using MATLAB/Simulink and Simscape Multibody. Collaborate with automation and control engineers to understand the interaction between mechanical systems and control algorithms. Contribute to the development of simulation tools, automation workflows and engineering processes us-ing Python, Ansys APDL and VBA. Work with CAD models generated in PTC Creo and prepare geometry for simulation activities. Constructively collaborate with the simulation engineering community within MCC and the broader Liebherr Group. Qualifications, Requirements & Experience The successful candidate will hold a third-level qualification in an engineering discipline – preferably L9 or L10. A strong interest in engineering simulation, numerical methods and analytical problem solving. Knowledge of Finite Element Analysis principles is essential. Experience with Ansys Mechanical or similar FEA software is desirable. Knowledge of structural mechanics, strength of materials and dynamics. Exposure to transient or dynamic analysis methods would be advantageous. Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, Simscape Multibody or similar modelling environments would be advantageous. Experience with CAD software, particularly PTC Creo, would be beneficial. Basic programming skills are desirable, with Python considered a significant advantage. Demonstrated aptitude for learning new software tools, simulation techniques and engineering methodologies. We do not require the assistance of recruitment agencies for this role. #LCC Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Jennifer Connolly. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The Company Liebherr Container Cranes Ltd. is one of the world's leading manufacturers of ship to shore cranes, rail mounted gantry cranes and rubber tyre gantry cranes. From its base in Killarney, Ireland, the company designs, builds and exports container cranes worldwide. Founded in 1958 as the first Liebherr factory outside of Germany, today, container cranes manufactured by Liebherr in Ireland are renowned for their quality, longevity and productivity. title: Shell Graduate Program Netherlands - Mechanical Engineer
description: What’s the role As a Mechanical Engineer, you will play a key role in supporting the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of critical equipment across Shell's energy assets. Working closely with operations and maintenance teams, you will provide technical expertise on rotating and static equipment, helping to ensure assets perform as intended and contribute to safe and reliable operations. This role offers the opportunity to combine engineering knowledge with practical field experience. Rather than being purely desk-based, you will spend significant time working alongside operational teams, troubleshooting equipment issues, monitoring performance, and supporting machinery reliability improvements. You will gain hands-on exposure to a wide range of mechanical systems, including compressors, pumps, turbines, and other critical equipment. We are looking for individuals who enjoy solving real-world engineering challenges, are eager to learn, and have a genuine passion for machinery and industrial operations. As part of Shell's graduate programme, you will have opportunities to develop your technical and professional capabilities while contributing to the energy systems of today and tomorrow. What you’ll be doing Support operations teams in resolving machinery and equipment-related issues across operational assets. Investigate equipment performance concerns, including vibration issues, reliability challenges, and mechanical failures. Assist in troubleshooting rotating and static equipment to identify root causes and recommend practical solutions. Monitor equipment performance and reliability indicators to ensure machinery operates safely and efficiently. Support the installation, commissioning, and optimization of mechanical equipment and systems. Work closely with maintenance, operations, and engineering teams to improve equipment performance and operational reliability. Participate in field inspections, equipment assessments, and technical reviews. Contribute to reliability improvement initiatives by analyzing equipment trends and recommending corrective actions. Develop practical engineering solutions that balance technical requirements, operational needs, and business objectives. Build technical knowledge of compressors, pumps, turbines, pressure systems, and other critical mechanical equipment. Collaborate with stakeholders across different functions while maintaining strong safety and operational standards. Continuously develop engineering expertise through on-the-job learning, coaching, and structured development opportunities. What you bring A Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Strong interest in rotating equipment, machinery, mechanical systems, and industrial operations. Demonstrated practical engineering mindset with a willingness to apply technical knowledge in real-world environments. Interest in troubleshooting, problem-solving, and improving equipment reliability and performance. Ability to balance technical understanding with awareness of operational and business priorities. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. A proactive attitude and willingness to learn from experienced engineers and operations professionals. Good communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams. Comfort working both in office environments and on-site operational locations. Curiosity, resilience, and a hands-on approach to engineering challenges. Interest in developing expertise in compressors, pumps, turbines, vibration analysis, and other mechanical systems. A strong commitment to safety, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. What we offer You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself. Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together. Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead. Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices. Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise. Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself. Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working. Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world. Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents. Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply. Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams. Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes. Note: As part of your application, please submit a motivation letter along with your resume. The motivation letter should outline your reasons for applying to this position and how your skills and experiences align with the job requirements. This will help us better understand your interest in the role and your suitability for the position. We'd like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we're working towards that goal, click here . Shell in The Netherlands The Netherlands is one of the two founding countries of the company. Here 9,380 employees (March 2024) of more than 100 nationalities jointly work to provide the country with energy for today, for tomorrow and for you. Energy for
