title: Ingénieur d'études (Pôle Frein) H/F 1 1
description: Req ID:532670 À la tête des entreprises qui s’engagent vers un avenir plus vert, Alstom développe et commercialise des solutions de mobilité qui apportent les fondements durables pour l'avenir des transports. Notre portefeuille de produits s'étend des trains à grande vitesse, métros, monorails et tramways jusqu’aux systèmes intégrés, services sur mesure, infrastructures, signalisation et solutions de mobilité numérique. Nous rejoindre, c'est rejoindre une entreprise bienveillante, responsable et innovante où plus de 80 000 personnes ouvrent la voie à une mobilité plus verte et plus intelligente, dans le monde entier. Pourriez-vous être l'Ingénieur d'études (Pôle Frein) H/F à temps plein au Creusot que nous recherchons ? Votre futur rôle Relevez un nouveau défi et mettez à profit votre expertise en conception et simulation mécanique dans un domaine de pointe. Vous travaillerez avec une équipe collaborative, multiculturelle et innovante, et vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l’optimisation des systèmes de freinage des bogies, contribuant ainsi à l'amélioration continue de nos produits en termes de performance, de confort et de durabilité. Au quotidien, vous collaborerez étroitement avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires, notamment celles en charge des essieux, des boîtes de vitesses, des suspensions et du comportement dynamique des véhicules. Vous serez également en interaction avec nos fournisseurs pour garantir la pertinence des équipements de freinage proposés. Vous vous occuperez plus particulièrement de la définition des équipements de freinage des bogies et de leur validation à travers des tests spécifiques, mais aussi de la résolution des problématiques techniques rencontrées dans vos projets. Nous ferons appel à vous pour : Réaliser des simulations de performance et thermiques pour définir les équipements de freinage adaptés aux performances attendues. Rédiger les spécifications techniques des équipements de freinage des bogies. Analyser et vérifier la pertinence des équipements proposés par les fournisseurs. Gérer vos projets en respectant les objectifs de qualité, coût et délai (QCD). Définir et valider des tests sur bancs ainsi que les résultats obtenus. Superviser les tests réalisés sur train et vérifier la conformité des résultats par rapport aux performances attendues. Contribuer à la résolution des problèmes techniques dans le cadre de vos projets. Participer à l’amélioration continue des méthodes de travail appliquées dans vos activités quotidiennes. Votre profil Nous accordons plus d'importance à la passion et à l’état d’esprit qu'à l'expérience. C'est pourquoi nous n'attendons pas de vous que vous possédiez toutes les compétences. Nous avons plutôt dressé une liste de celles qui, selon nous, vous aideront à réussir et à vous épanouir dans ce rôle : Diplôme d’ingénieur en mécanique. Rigueur, autonomie et capacité à travailler en équipe. Excellentes compétences techniques et interpersonnelles en communication. Maîtrise de l’anglais (écrit et oral). Une expérience préalable dans un domaine d'ingénierie pertinent est un atout, mais les profils débutants à expérimentés sont les bienvenus. Ce que vous apprécierez Rejoignez-nous pour une nouvelle expérience de vie - le secteur ferroviaire est un secteur d’avenir, vous pouvez donc vous développer et acquérir de nouvelles compétences et expériences tout au long de votre carrière. Vous pourrez également : Bénéficier de stabilité, de défis et d'une carrière à long terme sans routine quotidienne. Travailler avec des experts de différents horizons et des équipes multiculturelles. Collaborer avec des équipes transversales et des collègues qualifiés. Contribuer à des projets innovants qui façonnent l’avenir de la mobilité. Utiliser notre environnement de travail flexible et inclusif. Orienter votre carrière dans la direction de votre choix à travers les fonctions et les pays. Bénéficier de notre investissement dans votre développement, par le biais de programmes d’apprentissage primés. Progresser vers des postes à responsabilité ou d’expertise technique. Bénéficier d'un système de rémunération équitable et dynamique qui reconnaît vos performances et votre potentiel, ainsi que d'une couverture sociale complète et compétitive (assurance-vie, assurance-maladie, pension). Il n'est pas nécessaire d'être un passionné de trains pour s'épanouir chez nous. Nous vous garantissons que lorsque vous monterez dans l'un de nos trains avec vos amis ou votre famille, vous en serez fier. Si vous êtes prêt(e) à relever le défi, nous aimerions vous connaître ! Important En tant qu'entreprise mondiale, nous sommes un employeur qui prône l'égalité des chances et qui célèbre la diversité dans les 63 pays où nous sommes présents. Nous nous engageons à créer un lieu de travail inclusif pour tous.

title: Design Engineer
description: Intellectica is recruiting a motivated Design Engineer on behalf of a well-established industrial manufacturing group with over 70 years of history, specializing in engineered pumping solutions for water management, energy, infrastructure, and industrial applications. Headquartered in Kryoneri, Attiki, with manufacturing facilities and an established international network spanning Europe and Asia, the Group has delivered projects and installations in more than 50 countries worldwide, serving sectors such as construction, utilities, power generation, and marine. title: Ingénieur R&D Conception Mécanique (H/F)
description: À propos de nous Shape & Share Sustainable Links LISI est un groupe industriel mondial, spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions d’assemblage et de composants à forte valeur ajoutée pour les secteurs de l’aéronautique et de l’automobile. LISI AEROSPACE, filiale du groupe LISI produit des fixations et de structure/moteurs pour les plus grands acteurs mondiaux du secteur aéronautique avec un chiffres d’affaires de 1 milliard d’€ en 2024, 6279 collaborateurs répartis sur 19 sites dans 8 pays. Portée par son sens de l’innovation et de l’excellence opérationnelle, LISI AEROSPACE est en recherche de futurs talents afin d’accompagner sa croissance et atteindre ses objectifs ambitieux. Mission CDI – Saint-Ouen-l’Aumône (95) Rejoignez LISI AEROSPACE et participez au développement de solutions mécaniques innovantes pour l'aéronautique ! Vous êtes passionné(e) par la conception mécanique et aimez voir vos idées se concrétiser en solutions techniques ? Vous souhaitez intervenir sur des projets de développement, de la définition du besoin jusqu'à la validation des produits, tout en évoluant au sein d'une équipe d'experts ? Rejoignez notre Centre d'Études R&D de Saint-Ouen-l'Aumône ! Votre environnement LISI AEROSPACE est un acteur international de référence dans la conception et la fabrication de solutions d'assemblage et de composants de structure pour l'industrie aéronautique. Au sein de notre Centre d'Études, vous rejoignez une équipe à taille humaine composée de collaborateurs permanents et de partenaires techniques, où l'expertise, la collaboration et l'innovation occupent une place centrale. Rattaché(e) au Responsable Conception, vous prenez en charge le développement de sous-ensembles mécaniques, notamment des outillages destinés à l'installation de fixations aéronautiques . Véritable acteur du développement de nos solutions techniques, vous intervenez sur l'ensemble du cycle de conception. À ce titre, vous serez amené(e) à : Concevoir et développer des sous-ensembles mécaniques et des outillages de pose de fixations aéronautiques, depuis l'analyse du cahier des charges jusqu'à la validation technique. Réaliser les études et dimensionnements mécaniques, en vous appuyant sur les outils de CAO, de gestion des données techniques (PLM) et de simulation numérique. Piloter les développements techniques, en assurant le suivi des différentes étapes, le respect des exigences et la coordination des intervenants. Construire les plans de validation, suivre les essais et rédiger les dossiers de justification technique. Coordonner fonctionnellement les ingénieurs et techniciens mobilisés sur vos projets, ainsi que les prestataires externes. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de nos produits, de nos méthodes de conception et de nos processus de développement. Participer aux échanges techniques et au partage d'expertise au sein de notre communauté Conception Mécanique. Vous interviendrez notamment sur des projets de développement d'outillages de pose, au cœur des enjeux de performance et de fiabilité de nos solutions d'assemblage. Profil Issu(e) d'une formation supérieure en mécanique ou conception mécanique, idéalement de niveau Bac+5, vous justifiez d'une expérience confirmée de 5 à 10 ans en conception et développement de sous-ensembles mécaniques . Vous disposez : D'une solide maîtrise de la conception mécanique et des outils de CAO. De connaissances en dimensionnement mécanique et simulation numérique. D'une expérience dans le développement de produits ou d'outillages mécaniques. D'une capacité à piloter des études techniques et à coordonner différents interlocuteurs. De connaissances en méthodologie de développement et de gestion de projets, de type APQP ou équivalent. La connaissance de CATIA ainsi que des compétences en programmation Python constitueront des atouts supplémentaires. Au-delà de votre expertise technique, nous recherchons avant tout une personnalité autonome, proactive et collaborative . Vous aimez travailler en équipe, partager vos connaissances, proposer des solutions et contribuer activement à l'amélioration des pratiques. Votre curiosité technique, votre esprit d'initiative et votre capacité à fédérer différents interlocuteurs seront essentiels pour réussir dans cette fonction. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Des projets techniques concrets et stimulants, au service de l'industrie aéronautique. Une réelle autonomie dans la conduite de vos développements. Un environnement collaboratif, au contact d'ingénieurs, de techniciens et d'experts métiers. La possibilité de proposer et de concrétiser vos idées, en contribuant directement à l'amélioration de nos solutions. L'opportunité de développer votre expertise au sein d'un groupe industriel international reconnu pour son savoir-faire. un salaire fixe avec un variable de 10% Envie de concevoir les solutions d'assemblage aéronautiques de demain ? Rejoignez LISI AEROSPACE et mettez votre expertise au service de projets où la technique, l'innovation et le collectif font la différence.

description: Bio-Optica Milano S.p.A. è una realtà solida e consolidata, da oltre 40 anni punto di riferimento nella produzione e commercializzazione di strumenti, reagenti e materiali di consumo per i laboratori di anatomia patologica. Collaborazione con Produzione, Ufficio Acquisti, Servizio Post Vendita e fornitori per lo sviluppo e l’ottimizzazione dei prodotti Interfaccia con enti certificatori e supporto alla conformità normativa dei prodotti Redazione di documentazione tecnica e supporto tecnico a produzione e area commerciale Supporto alla risoluzione di problematiche tecniche Requisiti richiesti: Laurea in ingegneria meccanica o affini Esperienza di almeno 5 anni in ruoli analoghi presso realtà industriali di medie dimensioni; Ottima conoscenza del software di progettazione 3D SolidWorks. title: Ar-ge Mekanik Mühendisi
description: Biz kimiz? Temelleri 1994 yılında atılan TEKSAN, serüvenini dünya çapında global bir marka olma yolunda sürdürüyor. Kalite ve inovasyonda öncü bir mühendislik şirketi olarak güvenilir güç mottosu ile çıktığımız bu yolculuğumuzda sürdürülebilir bir yaşam için güvenilir ve yenilikçi ürünler geliştirerek bugün, 2 Fabrika ve 750 kişiyi aşkın çalışan ile 6 kıtada 140’tan fazla ülkede hizmet veriyoruz. Dünya çapındaki onlarca bayimizin yanı sıra İngiltere ve ABD ofislerimiz ile sürdürülebilir yaşam, enerji ve jeneratör denince akla gelen ilk marka olma kararlılığı ile büyüyoruz. Neden biz? Çeyrek asrı aşkın tecrübemiz ile kurulduğumuz günden beri, hep en yeni ve en iyiyi yapmayı hedefliyoruz. Çalışma ortamımızda birbirimize destek oluyor, ortak aklın ve takım çalışmasının gücüne inanıyoruz. Ar-Ge merkezimizde yeni şeyler öğrenme ve gelişim için fırsatları yakalayabileceğin, yurt dışı ile bağlantılı çalışma fırsatı yakalayacağın ve büyük başarıların parçası olmayı deneyimleyebileceğin bir kariyer yolculuğu Teksan’da seni bekliyor. Her geçen gün büyüyen şirketimize yaratıcı, yenilikçi, heyecanı yüksek, takım çalışmasını seven arkadaşlar katmak istiyoruz. Eşsiz tecrübemiz ve birikimimiz ile misyonumuzu benimseyen, vizyonumuzu paylaşan, değerlerimizi kendi değerleri ile örtüştüren geleceğin Teksanlıları ile tanışma heyecanı içindeyiz. Seni neler bekliyor? Teksan Akademi ile eğitim gelişim fırsatları İlham veren liderlik Farklı lokasyon ve iş kolları arasında geçiş Sosyal Destek Ödemeleri Sağlık Sigortası Burs İmkanları Genel Nitelikler Üniversitelerin ilgili bölümlerinden mezun, (Makine Mühendisliği) İlgili mühendislik departmanlarında minimum 5 yıl deneyimli, Yapısal analiz, ısı transferi ve akışkanlar mekaniği konularında en az orta seviyede teorik bilgiye ve uygulama deneyimine sahip, Ansys (Mechanical/Workbench) programını aktif olarak kullanabilen, İyi derecede İngilizce dil bilgisine sahip, Tercihen Proje Yönetim Metodolojisi Bilgisine hâkim, Ekip çalışmasına yatkın, yönetim ve raporlama becerisi gelişmiş, Erkek adaylar için askerlik hizmetini tamamlamış, Yurtiçi/Yurtdışı seyahat engeli olmayan, İstanbul Anadolu yakasında ikamet eden, “Ar-Ge Mühendisi ” ekip arkadaşı arıyoruz. İş Tanımı Ar-Ge faaliyetleri ile yenilik tanımı kapsamındaki projelerde, yeni bilgi, ürün, süreç, yöntem ve sistemlerin oluşturulmasında görev almak, Görevlendirildiği projelerle ilgili teknik fizibilite hazırlamak, iş paketleri ve proje takvimi oluşturmak ve dokümante etmek/ edilmesini sağlamak, Projelerle ilgili gerekli test ve ölçümleri yapmak/yaptırmak/uygunluğunu denetlemek, Uzmanlık alanının gerektirdiği mühendislik hesap ve analizlerini yapmak, yapılan analizleri kontrol etmek, Devlet destekli projelerde proje yürütücüsü veya proje mühendisi olarak çalışmayı gerçekleştirmek, teknik raporları hazırlamak veya usul yönünden kontrol etmek, Yeni ürün ve teknoloji araştırmaları yapmak, Gerektiğinde numune ürün tedariğini sağlamak, uygunluğunu test ederek raporlamak, Yenilikler ve gelişmeleri takip etmek için fuar, eğitim, seminer, tanıtımlara katılmak. Bu ekibin bir parçası olmak istersen, başvurunu bekliyoruz!

title: MRI Field Engineer
description: Company Description Medical Imaging Academy (MIA) is a global multi-modality service provider specializing in the full lifecycle of medical imaging equipment, including installation, de-installation, transportation, packing, storage, repair, calibration, and turnkey radiology solutions. The organization supplies spare parts, complete used systems, and offers professional support to hospitals, universities, and research clinics across Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and Africa. MIA’s highly qualified and experienced team delivers onsite clinical applications training, helping partners maximize the performance and safety of their imaging systems. With over 20 years of field experience and consistently positive feedback from clients in multiple countries, MIA has built a strong reputation as a reliable radiology partner. The company is committed to pushing boundaries in every project and maintaining long-term, trust-based relationships with its customers. Role Description The MRI Field Engineer role at MIA │ Medical Imaging Academy is a full-time, on-site position based in Istanbul. The MRI Field Engineer will perform installation, maintenance, calibration, and repair of MRI systems, ensuring optimal performance, safety, and regulatory compliance. Daily responsibilities include conducting diagnostic tests, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, performing preventive maintenance, and documenting all service activities clearly and accurately. The role involves visiting customer sites, providing technical support and guidance to clinical and technical staff, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of service requests. The MRI Field Engineer will also support project execution for equipment upgrades and turnkey solutions, contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, and uphold MIA’s quality and customer service standards. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong troubleshooting and technical support skills for MRI and related medical imaging systems. Candidates should possess field service experience, including on-site installation, maintenance, and repair of complex equipment. Candidates should possess effective communication skills to interact with clients, clinical staff, and internal teams in a clear and professional manner. Candidates should possess project management abilities to plan, coordinate, and complete equipment deployments and service projects on schedule. Relevant technical education (e.g., degree or diploma in Biomedical Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a related field) and prior experience with MRI or other medical imaging modalities are highly beneficial. Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, follow safety protocols, and work independently in the field is essential. Willingness to travel within the region as needed, and proficiency in English and local languages, is an advantage.

title: Automation Engineer
description: At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: Service Manager - Southern __ More About Us - B&R Industrial Automation The pursuit of Perfection in Automation has inspired and guided B&R for over 40 years. To us, perfection means more than developing the best solutions in industrial automation, it also means developing the best relationships, with our customers and partners as well as our employees and suppliers. Keen foresight and entrepreneurial courage helped us rise quickly into the ranks of top global players in industrial automation. An intuitive sense of market dynamics and emerging trends has established us as a pioneer, leading the way with the most innovative technology on the market. Our role as the ABB Group's global center for machine and factory automation strengthens our position of leadership and adds new momentum to our impressive record of sustained growth. Your Role And Responsibilities In this role, you will have the opportunity to act as a design authority for an engineering discipline with low to medium complexity. Each day, you will complete assignments on small projects or portions of larger projects in a cost-effective manner. You will also showcase your expertise by applying basic design thinking/design for excellence concepts in projects. The work model for the role is: {hybrid} This role is contributing to the Machine Automation Division (B&R), Service organization in Türkiye. You will be mainly accountable for: Evaluating, selecting, and applying standard techniques and procedures to perform engineering assignments. Providing technical support for testing, installation, and commissioning activities. Assisting in preparing proposal/presentation of engineering projects. Reports any integrity, compliance, safety, cybersecurity, quality, contract, program, and cost issues to the management and/or project manager(s) for resolution. Ensures that engineering activities and deliverables comply with safety and cybersecurity regulations and standards and contractual requirements. Ensures the project meets the technical requirements of the contract and is technically completed as part of contract closure activities. Collaborates with the supply chain function and the project manager(s) to meet the contractual obligations. Coordinates with commissioning / service functions to ensure the designs are appropriately installed and commissioned (if applicable as part of the contract) Assists in preparing proposal / presentation of engineering projects / programs (provision of bills of materials, estimated engineering hours, etc.). Qualifications For The Role Degree in Automation Engineering or Mechatronics Engineering, At least 2 years of experience in the industry. Possess an enhanced interest in automation, programming, digitalization, AI and innovation. You are passionate about structured programming, with basic knowledge of IEC 61131 languages or C. You are familiar with industrial automation products, such as PLCs, motion control systems, and SCADA. You possess basic knowledge of electronics, mechanics, mathematics, control theory and AI infrastructures. Knowledge of object-oriented programming is also appreciated. Knowledge of major simulation and modeling tools (Matlab Simulink, MapleSim) and familiarity with theoretical and practical concepts of artificial vision are also appreciated. You are at ease communicating English, both written and spoken and fluent in Turkish. You have willingness to work in a team and have a strong inclination for continuous training and improvement You are available to travel within the assigned area, as well as occasionally throughout Türkiye and abroad for short trips. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Technical Inspection Manager, Mechanic
description: Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding engages in various sectors, primarily energy, shipbuilding, finance, and real estate industries. The Group is the only owner, operator and builder of the first Powership™ (floating power plant) fleet in the world and plays an active role in medium to long-term investments with more than 2.500 employees around the world in different 19 countries in Europe, Africa, Latam and Asia. About Karpowership Karpowership, part of the Karadeniz Holding, is the owner, operator and builder of the only Powership™ (floating power plant) fleet in the world and plays an active role in medium to long-term investments; providing access to fast-track, affordable and reliable electricity. Powerships have a range of 30 MW to 470 MW and are delivered ready to operate in less than 60 days. Currently, Karpowership owns and operates over than 30 Powerships with an installed capacity exceeding 3,500 MW and another 5,000 MW are under construction or in the pipeline. In addition to a Powership fleet, Karpowership owns and operates its own LNG fleet. With expertise and experience in the field, Karpowership serves as a one-stop-shop for LNG to Power solutions, as a single provider delivering all parts of the value chain; including but not limited to LNG sourcing, transport, delivery, regasification, and electricity production; with the mission of powering life wherever needed. With more than 2,000 employees globally; Karpowership is operational in Mozambique, Ghana, Sierra Leone, Guinea Bissau, Gambia, Senegal, Sudan, Ivory Coast, New Caledonia, Brazil, Dominican Republic and Cuba. We are looking fo r a Technical Inspection Manager to join our Operational Excellence at our Head Office located in Kağıthane, Istanbul. WHAT DO WE EXPECT? Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering, or Naval Architecture Engineering Minimum 10 years of experience in the maritime, power generation, shipbuilding, or industrial sectors. Strong technical expertise in diesel engines (HFO/LNG), gas turbines, and auxiliary mechanical systems. In-depth knowledge of equipment reliability, automation systems, and protection systems. Proven experience in Root Cause Analysis (RCA), risk assessment, and reliability engineering methodologies. Solid understanding of preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance practices. Ability to interpret technical drawings, P&IDs, and maintenance documentation. Experience with ERP/CMMS platforms, preferably SAP. English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above. Availability for both domestic and international travel. WHAT AWAITS YOU? Ensure that technical inspection and operations within power generation plants are conducted in full compliance with corporate management systems, international regulations, and industry standards, while maintaining the highest levels of safety, reliability, and operational excellence. Plan, coordinate, and execute technical audits and inspections across power generation facilities and mechanical systems, ensuring effective closure of audit findings through structured follow-up processes. Evaluate and report on equipment condition, maintenance effectiveness, and the implementation of preventive and predictive maintenance programs. Lead the preparation of technical incident and failure investigation reports. Assess technical operational processes, identify corrective actions, and document observations, findings, and improvement opportunities. Monitor equipment performance trends and evaluate oil analysis reports, vibration measurements, and condition monitoring data. Participate in root cause investigations and failure analyses, contributing to the development of preventive measures and best practices. Identify reliability risks, recurring failures, and maintenance deficiencies, and develop recommendations for technical improvements. Lead root cause analysis activities for critical equipment failures. Drive initiatives aimed at enhancing equipment reliability, asset performance, and operational efficiency. Prepare comprehensive technical inspection reports and present findings to senior management. Coordinate effectively with plant teams, OEMs, and third-party technical specialists. Support the development of technical teams and contribute to technical training and capability-building initiatives. WHAT DO WE OFFER? Opportunity to work on large-scale international energy projects. Exposure to diverse operational environments across multiple countries. Collaboration with industry-leading experts and access to mentoring opportunities. A dynamic and growth-oriented environment that supports career advancement. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package. Hybrid working opportunity, One day off on your birthday, Comprehensive Private Health Insurance, Professional and personal training & development opportunities, Exclusive discounts and campaigns for employees. In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity. In accordance with the Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data, please review the Personal Data Protection Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

For more than 35 years, ground breaking technologies and business models engineered and developed by Siemens Turkey R&D department contributes to the global success of Siemens Our R&D activities focused on the fields of electrification, automation and digitalization, provides end-to-end support to our global customers on their unique digital transformation journey. We aim to increase our strength on solution and product development with world class SW development experts, with the vision to be the digitalization partner for our global customers. We need game changers like you, to bring the next level of smart manufacturing and infrastructure from mere concept to reality, develop tomorrow’s smart cities, and address the most critical digitalization challenges across a comprehensive range of industries. What part will you play? Develop, maintain, and enhance SCADA applications and industrial software components, with a strong focus on reliability, performance, and maintainability. Plan, track, and manage project progress, tasks, and milestones to ensure on-time delivery while coordinating support activities and handling customer inquiries. Perform rigorous testing of crane products, applications, and SCADA solutions, with a strong emphasis on user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) quality, operator ergonomics, and intuitive visualization. Contribute across the project and product lifecycle, translating requirements into delivery-ready solutions and using customer feedback and field experience to improve quality. Work with customers and solution partners to clarify requirements and deliver industrial automation projects, from system design to commissioning and handover. Plan and implement upgrades and migrations for existing systems, ensuring compatibility and minimizing operational disruption. Integrate SCADA solutions with in-house and 3rd-party automation systems and higher-level applications using industrial communication protocols. Address IT/OT integration and cybersecurity requirements within automation projects to ensure solutions fit the customer's operational environment. Provide hotline, remote, and on-site technical support to customers worldwide for product-related issues. Deliver technical training and workshops for customers, solution partners, and internal teams. Support pre-sales activities through feasibility assessments, technical scope definition, system configurations, bills of materials, product demonstrations, and technical presentations. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including user manuals, configuration guides, and troubleshooting resources. What You Need To Make Real What Matters. A bachelor's degree in Control and Automation Engineering, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. A very good command of written and spoken English for seamless collaboration with international customers, partners, and cross-functional teams. At least 5 years of relevant experience in industrial automation and SCADA engineering, including hands-on customer project involvement. Strong hands-on expertise in SIMATIC WinCC and its ecosystem, including SCADA development, associated options, tools, and integration capabilities. Strong organizational skills with hands-on experience in project tracking, task management, and coordinating multi-tiered support activities. Experience with PLC programming, diagnostics, and SCADA integration, preferably using Siemens SIMATIC S7 and TIA Portal, including third-party communication protocols. Practical experience with SCADA scripting and software customization (C, VBScript, JavaScript), version control, and lifecycle practices (testing, release preparation, documentation, and change management). An understanding of IT/OT integration, industrial networking, and cybersecurity requirements relevant to automation projects. Hands-on experience deploying and maintaining SCADA solutions in Windows-based and virtualized environments (VMware or Hyper-V), including upgrades and migrations. Working knowledge of relational databases, including SQL queries and basic troubleshooting. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills to investigate product issues, identify root causes, verify solutions, and manage customer expectations effectively. Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools for coding, debugging, testing, and documentation, complying with data confidentiality and security standards. Willingness to travel for commissioning, technical support, and customer training. Proven experience in testing industrial applications, specifically focusing on crane products and crane automation, with a dedicated eye for UI/UX evaluation and visual clarity. Experience with crane automation, condition monitoring, or SIMOCRANE CMS is a strong advantage. Experience with WinCC OA, WinCC Unified, or web-based industrial visualizations is an advantage. Familiarity with integrating and making minor adjustments to 3D models for industrial visualizations is an advantage. What We Offer? title: Mekanik Tasarım Mühendisi
description: BU POZİSYON, KIBRIS OFİSİMİZDE GÖREVLENDİRİLMEK ÜZERE AÇILMIŞTIR VE TAM ZAMANLI, OFİSTEN ÇALIŞMAYI GEREKTİRMEKTEDİR. RELOKASYON VE KONAKLAMA DESTEĞİ SAĞLANMAKTADIR. İnsansız hava araçları, modern çatışmaların maliyet dengesini ve harekât temposunu değiştiriyor. TMT, bu değişen harekât ortamı için otonom savunma sistemleri geliştiriyor. Mekanizma ve mekanik tasarım çalışmalarımızı yürütmek üzere Kıbrıs ofisimizde görev alacak bir Mekanik Tasarım Mühendisi arıyoruz. Bu pozisyondaki mühendis, hava aracı mekanizmalarından yapısal parçalara, test düzeneklerinden yer ekipmanlarına kadar farklı bileşenlerin tasarımı ve imalata hazırlanmasında görev alacaktır. Mekanizmanın hangi işlevi yerine getireceği mühendislik ekibi tarafından tanımlanır. Çözümün kurgulanması, tasarlanması, üç boyutlu modellerin ve imalat resimlerinin hazırlanması bu pozisyonun sorumluluğundadır. Tasarımların mukavemet, ağırlık, üretilebilirlik ve montaj gereksinimleri birlikte değerlendirilerek geliştirilmesi beklenmektedir. ARANAN NİTELİKLER Makine, Mekatronik veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun olmak. SolidWorks ile katı modelleme ve montaj tasarımı konusunda yetkin olmak. Mekanizma ve kinematik tasarım konusunda deneyim sahibi olmak. Teknik resim, toleranslandırma ve geometrik ölçülendirme bilgisine sahip olmak. İmalat yöntemlerine hâkim olmak; 3B baskı, CNC işleme, sac, talaşlı imalat ve plastik enjeksiyon kısıtlarını gözeterek tasarım yapabilmek. Mukavemet hesapları ve sonlu elemanlar analizi ile parça boyutlandırması yapabilmek. Standart mekanik bileşen seçimi yapabilmek. Ağırlık, dayanım ve üretilebilirlik arasında denge kurabilmek. Montaj sürecini izleyerek tasarımını revize edebilmek. İngilizce teknik kaynakları okuyup anlayabilmek. Yapay zekâ destekli çalışma araçlarını iş akışına entegre edebilmek. Yoğun çalışma temposuna ve esnek çalışma saatlerine uyum sağlayabilmek. Takım çalışmasına yatkın, disiplinler arası çalışmaya açık ve öğrenmeye istekli olmak. Seyahat engeli bulunmamak. GÖREV VE SORUMLULUKLAR Tanımlanan işlevsel gereksinimler doğrultusunda mekanizma çözümleri geliştirmek; alternatif kinematik yaklaşımları değerlendirmek. Katlanma, kilitleme ve benzeri mekanizmaların tasarımını yapmak. Üç boyutlu katı modelleme ve montaj tasarımı yapmak; hareket analizleriyle çalışma zarfını ve girişimleri doğrulamak. İmalat resimlerini hazırlamak; toleranslandırma ve geometrik ölçülendirme çalışmalarını yürütmek. Tasarımı imalat yöntemine göre uyarlamak; 3B baskı, CNC işleme, sac, plastik enjeksiyon ve hazır bileşen kullanımına uygun hale getirmek. Tasarlanan parça ve mekanizmaların mukavemet analizlerini yapmak; yük senaryolarını tanımlayıp gerilme, deformasyon ve emniyet katsayısı sonuçlarına göre tasarımı boyutlandırmak. Hava aracı gövde ve yapısal parça çizimlerine destek vermek. Test standı, montaj aparatı ve yer ekipmanı tasarımlarını yapmak. Bağlantı elemanı, rulman, yay, lineer eleman ve benzeri standart mekanik bileşenlerin seçimini yapmak. Üretilen parçaların montaj sürecini takip etmek; tespit edilen uyumsuzlukları tasarıma yansıtmak. Parça numaralandırma, revizyon takibi ve malzeme listesi (BOM) yönetimini yürütmek. EK NİTELİKLER Yorulma, titreşim veya darbe analizi gibi ileri seviye yapısal analiz deneyimi Hareket ve kinematik simülasyonu deneyimi Plastik enjeksiyona uygun parça tasarımı deneyimi; et kalınlığı, çekme payı, ayırma yüzeyi ve kalıptan çıkma açısı konularında bilgi Kompozit ve hafif yapı tasarımı deneyimi İnsansız hava aracı veya havacılık alanında yapısal tasarım deneyimi PDM / PLM sistemleriyle çalışma deneyimi Fusion 360, CATIA, NX veya benzeri diğer CAD araçlarına aşinalık CAM yazılımı ve CNC iş hazırlama bilgisi Servo, solenoid veya lineer eyleyici içeren aktüatörlü mekanizma tasarımı deneyimi Kişisel projeler, yarışma takımı çalışmaları (TEKNOFEST, Formula Student vb.) veya açık kaynak katkılarından oluşan teknik portföy Savunma sanayii, havacılık veya insansız sistemler alanında deneyim DİĞER KOŞULLAR T.C. veya K.K.T.C. vatandaşı olmak SAĞLANAN DESTEKLER Relokasyon desteği Şirket tarafından sağlanan konaklama Ulaşım desteği Özel sağlık sigortası Mesleki gelişim ve eğitim desteği

title: Test Engineer
description: At Sensorsan , we design and manufacture high-performance sensor systems that serve the most demanding environments — from industrial automation to defense applications. Our expertise lies in signal processing, sensor fusion, embedded systems, and real-time algorithms. With a focus on precision and reliability, we are a trusted partner in critical systems where sensing accuracy and data integrity are paramount. Job Description We are seeking a Test Engineer to own the verification and validation of our sensor systems — from design verification in the lab to automated end-of-line testing on the production floor. You will build the test infrastructure that proves our products meet their specifications, including the tools used in sensor production, and you will take part in environmental qualification and on-site field testing with customers. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys instrumentation, measurement, and automation in equal measure. Responsibilities Develop test tools and automation software for production infrastructure Analyze sensor and system performance using laboratory and field test data Define and execute test plans and procedures for design verification, qualification, and production testing Investigate test failures, perform root-cause analysis, and drive corrective actions Take part in field testing activities and customer acceptance tests Provide technical support to customers both remotely and on-site Prepare test procedures, test reports, and acceptance documentation required for internal quality processes and customer deliveries Basic Qualifications BSc or MSc in Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or a related field At least 2 years of experience Knowledge of hardware interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, RS-422/485, or Ethernet Proficiency in at least one of C/C++, Python, or MATLAB Experience with version control, debugging tools, and test frameworks Strong communication and documentation skills Preferred Skills Hands-on experience with real-time embedded systems (ARM Cortex-M or DSP) Experience with environmental testing and qualification standards such as MIL-STD-810 or MIL-STD-461 Familiarity with sensor technologies (IMUs, temperature, pressure, etc.) Familiarity with statistical methods for test and production data analysis Previous experience in defense, automotive, or industrial automation

title: ECU Design Release Engineer (Onsite)
description: Job Description We are looking for an ECU Design and Release Engineer to support vehicle electronics development, software validation and commissioning activities. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, design teams and system engineers throughout the testing and release lifecycle. Key responsibilities Coordinate software flashing, part installation, ECU commissioning and vehicle inspections. Provide on-site support for aftersales services. Plan and execute ECU, system and vehicle-level verification and validation tests. Develop electrical system validation test plans and procedures. Create and perform test items using vehicle testing systems. Maintain and regularly update test environments. Analyse test logs to identify root causes and confirm software bugs. Create test cases and procedures based on system features and project experience. Share feedback with function owners to improve system functions. Report and follow up on issues identified during testing and commissioning. Work with design teams and system engineers on requirements and intended vehicle or module functionality. Requirements Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Electronics Engineering or Communication Engineering. At least 3 years of experience in electrical component development or testing. Knowledge of ECU Design and Release Engineering activities. Technical knowledge of vehicle electronics, wiring harnesses, ECUs and electronic components. Experience with CAN/LIN analysis and simulation tools. Knowledge of automotive network architecture. Understanding of ASPICE and the V-Model. Experience with ECUs in infotainment, body or similar domains. Ability to perform vehicle and system-level software validation. Familiarity with system engineering tools such as DOORS or Codebeamer. Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, C, CAPL or Python is preferred. If you are interested in vehicle electronics, ECU validation and hands-on testing, we would like to hear from you.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: We are looking for an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer to strengthen our engineering team and contribute to ongoing product development projects and continuous improvement activities. In this role, you will be responsible for understanding technical requirements, developing mechanical design concepts, and delivering high-quality engineering solutions in accordance with established processes, standards, and customer expectations. You will work across the complete mechanical design lifecycle, from concept development and realization to 3D CAD modelling, technical drawings, and product specifications. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of mechanical engineering principles, manufacturing processes, materials, and proven experience working with industrial product development. Key Responsibilities Develop and realize mechanical design concepts based on project requirements and technical specifications. Perform 3D CAD design, modelling, and product development using Creo. Create, modify, and maintain detailed engineering drawings and product specifications. Perform machine element dimensioning, including screw joints, bolted connections, and welded attachments. Apply knowledge of general machine design, weld technology, manufacturing methods, and material selection. Ensure designs meet functional, quality, reliability, manufacturing, and cost requirements. Work in accordance with established engineering processes, design standards, and ways of working. Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams and stakeholders to ensure successful project execution. Analyse technical challenges, identify potential solutions, and drive design improvements. Ensure timely delivery of engineering outputs while maintaining high-quality standards. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field. Proven experience in mechanical design and product development. Strong knowledge of general machine design and mechanical engineering principles. Hands-on experience in 3D CAD design and modelling using Creo. Knowledge of machine element dimensioning, including screw joints, bolted connections, and weld attachments. Understanding of welding technology, manufacturing processes, and engineering materials. Experience in preparing engineering drawings and product specifications. Good understanding of mechanical design principles and industrial product development. Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal. Preferred Qualifications Experience working with Teamcenter PLM. Knowledge of Geometrical Product Specifications (GPS), particularly ISO 8015. Previous experience with the client's products, engineering systems, processes, and ways of working. Experience working in cross-functional product development environments. Knowledge of design for manufacturing and assembly (DFMA). Personal Attributes Self-driven and proactive, with the ability to take ownership of assigned tasks. Strong analytical and structured approach to problem-solving. Ability to independently handle complex engineering challenges and recognise when support is needed. Responsible, organised, and committed to delivering high-quality results. Strong teamwork and collaboration skills. Ability to balance functionality, quality, reliability, delivery timelines, and cost. Strong technical interest and willingness to learn new technologies and engineering methods.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Job Description Tulip Tech designs and manufactures high-density lithium battery systems for drones and electric aircraft. Our silicon-anode technology extends flight times well beyond conventional packs. Every system is designed, built, tested, and assembled in-house in Den Bosch. Following a 2025 partnership with the Dutch Ministry of Defence, we are scaling from prototype development to volume production. The technology is proven. Our focus now is building it reliably, at scale, without losing the engineering quality that got us here. Designed, built, and proven in Europe. Why this role matters Our batteries fly. What keeps them in the air is a mechanical assembly that has to be light, strong, thermally sound, and manufacturable at volume. As our Mechanical Engineer, you own that chain end to end: from the first CAD model, through prototyping and validation, to production handover. There is no separate test team to hand off to and no decades of in-house mechanical standards to fall back on. You design it, build a prototype, and stress-test it until you know it survives heat, vibration, and assembly before it goes anywhere near an aircraft. As we industrialize, you also help define how mechanical design and validation work here. It is real ownership over a core part of the product. What You Will Achieve Battery enclosures and mechanical assemblies, designed in SolidWorks to be light, thermally efficient, and manufacturable at scale. Designs validated for structural integrity and environmental durability under real airborne conditions, using FEA and thermal analysis. Prototypes built and tested with CNC, 3D printing, and shop tools before anything moves to production. A measurable reduction in mechanical iteration time, through earlier prototyping and design-for-manufacture feedback to the engineering team. Repeatable mechanical design and validation practices the team can reuse as we scale from prototype to volume. Specifications, test results, and compliance documentation that hold up to certification review. Job Requirements Proven mechanical design experience in a real manufacturing or production environment, ideally around 2 - 7 years. Strong SolidWorks skills: assemblies, drawings, and BOM management. FEA and thermal analysis to validate designs under structural and thermal load. Working knowledge of manufacturing methods: CNC machining, injection molding, sheet metal, and extrusion. A hands-on mentality: you build and break things to prove they work, not just model them. The judgment to work from engineering knowledge and experience, not procedures alone, and to correct a design when it is wrong. Nice to have Thermofluid knowledge or experience with thermal management systems A background in battery, EV, drone, automotive, or aerospace hardware Experience taking a design from prototype through to volume production Why join A genuine core engineering challenge: you own the mechanical design of a product that flies, from CAD to production handover. Real ownership and influence over technical decisions in a flat, engineering-led organization. A clear mission: enabling electric flight and contributing to European defense capability. Salary between 3300,- and 5800,- 38 paid days off per year (25 vacation + 13 ADV via CAO Metaal & Techniek). 8% holiday allowance, travel reimbursement, pension via PMT, and daily lunch on-site. An international team of more than 10 nationalities, with regular team events.

Contratto a tempo indeterminato, CCNL Autoferrotranvieri; selezione con colloquio su Teams e colloquio in presenza. Välkommen till en arbetsplats med tekniken i fokus där du har möjlighet att göra skillnad. Din roll Vi söker nu två engagerade medarbetare till sektionen för Landställ & Hydraul. Som systemingenjör hos oss kommer du att arbeta med integration av våra avancerade system i flygplan. Du kommer främst att jobba med Gripen, men ev även med andra flygande farkoster. I vår moderna och innovativa utvecklingsmiljö är du en nyckelperson i systemutvecklingen, från kravanalys via systemdesign och verifiering ända fram till driftsättning hos kund. Driftuppföljning, förbättringar och produktstöd av system hos kund är ett annat mycket viktigt område där du kan göra en stor skillnad. Du kommer att arbeta tillsammans med motiverade, stödjande och kompetenta medarbetare och ledare som snabbt tar dig med i gemenskapen. Samarbete med leverantörer, kunder och kollegor från andra system i flygplanet är en naturlig del av arbetet. Vanligt förekommande arbetsuppgifter Systemutveckling och design med avseende på funktionalitet Kravanalys och rapportering för kund- och myndighetskrav Systemsäkerhetsarbete Analysera och delta i verifiering, validering och prov i simulator, rigg, mark- och flygprov Delta i förstudier av framtida flygsystem Utföra utredningar av ärenden som uppstått i kunders verksamhet Arbeta med utveckling och förvaltning av apparater i nära samarbete med inköp och leverantörer Driftuppföljning och produktstöd av system till kund Rollerna är mångsidiga och erbjuder möjlighet att bredda och fördjupa sig i teknikområdet. Inriktningen på dina arbetsuppgifter kommer till stor del att styras av din erfarenhet, dina styrkor och intressen. Din profil För att trivas i rollen ser vi att du är en person som tar initiativ och ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter, samtidigt som du gillar att jobba i ett lag där man ställer upp och hjälper varandra för att uppnå gemensamma mål. Du är nyfiken, engagerad och bidrar med ett positivt driv i teamet. För att lyckas i din roll behöver du ha en god känsla för mekanik och fysik samt en vilja att se helheten i komplexa system. Vi söker både dig med några års arbetslivserfarenhet och dig som ännu inte har hunnit arbeta så länge. Lämplig bakgrund är högskole- eller civilingenjörsutbildning. Dokumentation och kontakter i det dagliga arbetet sker både på svenska och engelska, så du behöver behärska båda språken flytande i tal och skrift. Meriterande: Kunskaper om beräkningar och simuleringar Kunskap om hydraulik och andra mekatroniska system Kunskaper inom dataanalys Erfarenhet eller starkt intresse av AI i samband med ditt arbete Erfarenhet inom systemutveckling Erfarenhet inom flygbranschen Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap. Vad du blir en del av Bakom våra innovationer finns alla de som har gjort det möjligt. Modiga pionjärer och kluriga tänkare. Vardagshjältar och kreativa problemlösare. De som delar djup kunskap och de som utforskar nya områden. Och alla däremellan. Här har du chansen att påverka och bidra på ditt unika sätt. Allt från att utveckla kod och bygga imponerande försvars- och säkerhetslösningar till att ta en kaffe med en kollega. Varje bidrag räknas. Vi ger dig möjlighet att anta utmaningar och skapa smarta innovationer. I vår vänliga och tekniksmarta värld finns plats för dig att växa. Vi finns här för att tillsammans skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med uppdrag att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidrar till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 22 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här

title: Ingénieur Développement Matériel - Spécialisé en mécanique et thermodynamique
description: Lieu : Limours, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée Un package de rémunération attractif Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu Votre quotidien Situé à 20mn du Pôle technologique de Paris-Saclay, le site est l’un des plus grands centres d’excellence radars de surface. Nous contribuons à développer, concevoir, intégrer et tester des radars de surveillance aériennes dédiés à la détection et l’identification de cibles. La mission se déroule dans le cadre d’un projet d’offre puis de développement d’un radar d’alerte avancée au sein de la Business Unit Ground Master Radars (GMR) de Surface Radar (SRA). Ce Projet est à fort enjeux pour la Business Unit et pour Thales vis-à-vis de clients identifiés comme stratégiques. Le Projet travaille en Equipe Intégrée Projet (EIP), les membres de l’équipe sont co-localisés. Une habilitation au SECRET sera demandée. Vous travaillerez au sein du Centre de Compétences en Ingénierie de Développement Matériel des Structures et des Antennes Radar : CC ARS Mission Principale Contribuer à la construction des offres, puis, concevoir, développer et qualifier les sous-systèmes « hardware » des produits (structures, distribution électriques et refroidissement, équipements, boîtiers, interfaces mécaniques) en garantissant la conformité aux exigences fonctionnelles, de fiabilité, de sécurité, de coût, de qualité et de délais, tout en prenant en compte, entre autres, les contraintes climatiques, CEM et Safety. Responsabilités Et Activités Principales Conception et développement des éléments de solution mécaniques : Analyser les besoins et exigences (fonctionnelles, environnementales, normatives) et contribuer à la rédaction du cahier des charges mécanique ; Contribuer, sur les sujets hardware (boîtiers, châssis, interfaces de fixation, systèmes de refroidissement, protections, etc …), aux choix d’architecture matérielle des produits ; Contribuer à la spécification des chaines fonctionnelles et des allocations spécifiques à la mécanique : masse, volumes, précision et tolérances, interfaces, etc … ; Dimensionner les pièces et assemblages (résistance des matériaux, tolérances, ajustements, tenue aux chocs/vibrations, thermique, vieillissement). Intégrer les contraintes d’assemblage, de test, de maintenance et de recyclabilité ; Réaliser et(ou) faire réaliser les dossiers de définition. Études, Simulations Et Validation Réaliser ou piloter des calculs et simulations (RDM, éléments finis, thermique, vibrations, chocs, tenue en fatigue, etc.) ; Contribuer à la définition et à l’exécution des plans de qualification (essais fonctionnels, environnementaux et de fiabilité) ; Analyser les résultats d’essais et proposer des actions correctives ou d’optimisation ; Contribuer aux revues de conception (design reviews) et aux analyses de risques (AMDEC, analyses de modes de défaillance). Industrialisation Et Vie Série Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes industrialisation et production pour assurer la fabricabilité (DFM/DFA) des solutions ; Gérer la mise à jour de la documentation technique (spécifications, dossiers de définition, dossiers de justification, etc …) ; Traiter les problèmes hardware en production (non-conformités, écarts, retours terrain) et proposer des solutions pérennes ; Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des produits et des procédés (réduction des coûts, simplification, robustesse) ; Gestion De Projet Et Coordination Estimation des charges et délais des activités de développement hardware et mécanique dans son périmètre ; Planification et « reporting » d’avancement des activités dans son périmètre ; Contribuer à la coordination des activités avec les autres métiers ; Contribuer à la relation technique avec les fournisseurs et sous-traitants (revues de conception, validation de prototypes, suivi de qualité, etc …). Votre profil Vous êtes de formation Ingénieur, ou Master 2 généraliste avec spécialisation en mécanique. Vous avez 5 à 10 ans d’expérience dont une expérience en bureau d’études mécaniques dans le domaine des équipements industriels, électroniques, aéronautiques, ferroviaires, défense, énergie ou similaire est un plus. Compétences Techniques Maîtrise d’au moins un logiciel de CAO 3D/2D (ex. : CATIA, SolidWorks, Creo, NX, Inventor…). Connaissances solides en mécanique : RDM, tolérancement, dynamique du solide, etc … ; Pratique des simulations (FEM/FEA, thermique, vibratoire) ou capacité à dialoguer avec des spécialistes calcul ; Connaissance des procédés de fabrication ; Familiarité avec les normes et standards applicables au secteur (Environnement, CEM et Safety, etc …) ; Connaissance des outils de gestion de configuration et de gestion documentaire. Compétences Transverses Capacité à travailler en équipe pluridisciplinaire ; Rigueur, sens du détail, esprit d’analyse et de synthèse ; Capacité à gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle et à tenir les délais ; Bonnes qualités de communication écrite et orale ; Anglais technique (lecture de documents, échanges avec fournisseurs internationaux). Vous Maîtrisez Des Indicateurs De Performance (exemples) R

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: ARQUIMEA , we are a technology company operating globally and providing innovate solutions and products in highly demanding sectors. Our areas of activity are Aerospace, Defense & Security, Big Science, Biotechnology and Fintech. Main function and scope: We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer with proven experience in the design, calculation and validation of mechanical systems subjected to shock, vibration and extreme loads. The successful candidate will join a project focused on the development of high-precision sensors and robotic systems, with the objective of reaching TRL9 in an extremely demanding operating environment and severe operating conditions. Core functions: Mechanical design of the system and its subassemblies. Define structural solutions, materials, joints, encapsulation, isolation and protection strategies. Perform structural and thermal calculations and simulations, dynamic analyses, and shock and vibration simulations. Analyse stresses, deformations, natural modes and vibration transmission. Evaluate thermal dissipation, mechanical stability and system behaviour in demanding environments. Develop modal analyses and assess design margins. Define design criteria focused on reliability, repeatability, manufacturability and electronics integration. Ensure the dimensional stability and mechanical robustness of the system. Participate in the definition of environmental tests. Interpret test results, identify failures and propose redesigns. Collaborate in the technical planning of a multidisciplinary team. Collaborate with electronics, firmware, systems and testing teams. Required experience and candidate profile: Degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Aerospace Engineering or similar. Senior-level experience in the mechanical design of systems subjected to severe dynamic environments. Strong command of mechanical calculation, structural simulation and vibration analysis, preferably using ANSYS or similar FEA tools. Experience with CAD/CAE tools. Ability to critically review models, assumptions, boundary conditions and results. Knowledge of materials, treatments, tolerances and mechanical joints. Experience with adhesives, encapsulation, thermal dissipation and integration of embedded electronics. Technical leadership capability and practical judgement. Nice-to-have training / specific knowledge: Experience in defence, ammunition, aerospace or embedded systems. Experience with ruggedised electronics or inertial sensors. Experience with equipment subjected to high acceleration. Participation in shock, vibration, fatigue, temperature and environmental validation test campaigns. Focus on robust, manufacturable and qualifiable solutions. We're looking for curious, creative, tenacious and collaborative people , eager to do things and unafraid to tackle challenges in order to contribute to improving the society in wich we live. Think Big, Do the Job & Enjoy Life At ARQUIMEA, we value diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or other protected factors by law. All candidates will be considered equally based on their skills and experience

title: Ingénieur Calcul - ANSYS APDL

Définir les hypothèses de calcul : chargements, conditions aux limites, matériaux et critères de dimensionnement. Construire et optimiser les modèles éléments finis. Réaliser des analyses linéaires et non linéaires selon les besoins. Étudier les phénomènes de statique, flambement, modes propres et réponse dynamique. Analyser les contraintes, déplacements, déformations et différents indicateurs de dimensionnement. Vérifier la cohérence et la pertinence des résultats numériques. Participer au dimensionnement et à l’optimisation des conceptions. Rédiger les notes de calcul et rapports de justification. Présenter les résultats aux équipes projet, Bureau d’Études et partenaires techniques. Participer à l’amélioration et à l’automatisation des méthodes de calcul via le langage APDL. title: Simulation Engineer (CFD / FEA)
description: We are seeking an experienced Simulation Engineer to support a major offshore wind energy programme off the Polish coast, based in Gdansk, Poland. The role will involve performing advanced Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) simulations to assess the behaviour and performance of offshore structures. The successful candidate will contribute to engineering design optimisation, structural integrity assessments and simulation-driven decision-making throughout the project. Key Responsibilities Develop, set up and execute Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations to assess wind, wave and current loading on offshore foundations, transition pieces and installation equipment. Perform Finite Element Analysis (FEA) for static, fatigue, modal and buckling assessments of steel structures, brackets, lifting tools and mechanical components. Develop and execute coupled fluid-structure interaction (FSI) studies to evaluate the impact of fluid loads on structural behaviour and deformation. Simulate motion, mechanical loads, clearances and operational behaviour of automated and remotely operated offshore installation and handling systems. Prepare high-quality computational meshes and perform mesh independence and convergence studies to ensure simulation accuracy and reliability. Prepare detailed technical calculation reports, simulation documentation and engineering recommendations. Present simulation findings and technical conclusions to structural designers, mechanical engineers, project managers and client representatives. Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams, including structural, mechanical and robotics specialists, to support design development and optimisation. Maintain accurate, traceable and reusable simulation models, calculation files and technical documentation. Requirements Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Civil Engineering, Naval Architecture or a closely related engineering discipline. Minimum 6 years of professional experience in engineering simulation, preferably within offshore, marine, renewable energy or heavy industrial sectors. Strong hands-on experience with Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) software such as ANSYS Fluent, ANSYS CFX, STAR-CCM+ or OpenFOAM. Good understanding of turbulence modelling, transient simulations, fluid flow behaviour and hydrodynamic loading. Proven experience in Finite Element Analysis (FEA) using ANSYS Mechanical, Abaqus or equivalent simulation software. Strong knowledge of static, dynamic, linear and non-linear structural analysis, fatigue assessment, modal analysis and buckling calculations. Ability to perform mesh quality assessments, mesh independence studies and simulation validation. Strong understanding of engineering mechanics, structural behaviour and environmental loading conditions. Experience preparing technical calculation reports and presenting simulation results to multidisciplinary engineering teams. Excellent analytical, problem-solving and technical communication skills. Professional proficiency in written and spoken English is essential. Polish language proficiency will be an advantage but is not mandatory. Previous experience in offshore wind projects, wave loading, hydrodynamic analysis or marine engineering will be highly preferred. Exposure to multibody dynamics, motion simulation or robotic and lifting system analysis will be an added advantage. Experience in fatigue assessment of welded structures and joints will be beneficial.

title: Lead Robotics & Automation Engineer
description: Job Description Summary Ingénierie associée au processus de fabrication. Responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution des opérations du département ou axé sur l'exécution d'activités professionnelles au sein d'une discipline technique. Fonctions dotées d'une certaine autonomie, mais guidées par les politiques établies ou l'analyse des résultats finaux. Ce poste est autorisé à modifier les procédures et les pratiques en relation avec les tâches dans la mesure où les résultats finaux répondent aux normes d'acceptabilité (qualité, volume, respect des délais, etc.). Job Description Rôles et responsabilités Travaille sur des « usines exceptionnelles » et d'autres systèmes de fabrication basés sur l'informatique. Les personnes dans ce domaine ont une expertise informatique mais sont principalement spécialisées dans la fabrication. Se fonde sur une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique, un esprit d'analyse et une expérience technique pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie. Possède une connaissance approfondie des meilleures pratiques et de la manière dont son propre domaine s'intègre aux autres. Possède une connaissance pratique de la concurrence et des facteurs qui les différencient sur le marché. Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis pour traiter des processus de fabrication plus complexes comportant une variété d'aspects techniques et/ou de cycles de production interdépendants. Se fonde sur son expérience technique et un esprit d'analyse. Fait appel à des ressources limitées internes et externes en dehors de ses propres équipes pour l'aider à prendre une décision. Agit en tant que ressource pour ses collègues moins expérimentés. Peut piloter de petits projets avec des risques et des besoins en ressources faibles. Explique les informations. Développe des compétences pour amener les membres de l'équipe à un consensus autour de sujets relevant du domaine. Transmet les attentes en matière de performances et peut gérer des problèmes sensibles. Qualifications De Base Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent). Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction). Caractéristiques souhaitées Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années.Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable. title: Mekanik Dizayn Şefi
description: Biz Kimiz? 1993 yılında kurulan Rönesans Holding, bugün Türkiye, Avrupa, Orta Asya ve Afrika’yı kapsayan geniş bir coğrafyada; inşaat, gayrimenkul, enerji, endüstri ve sağlık alanlarında ana müteahhit ve yatırımcı olarak faaliyet göstermektedir. 40.000’i aşkın çalışanı ve 60’tan fazla milletten oluşan güçlü ve çok kültürlü ekibiyle Rönesans, dünyanın en büyük müteahhitlik şirketleri arasında yer almakta; sürdürülebilir bir gelecek inşa etme vizyonuyla yenilikçi ve küresel ölçekteki mühendislik projelerini hayata geçirmeye devam etmektedir. Adaylardan Beklentilerimiz Şirketimizin İstanbul'da yapımını üstlendiği Veri Merkezi Projesi’nde değerlendirilmek üzere; Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, Büyük ölçekli ve yoğun disiplinler arası koordinasyon gerektiren projelerde minimum 8 yıl deneyim sahibi, Tercihen veri merkezi, endüstriyel tesis, sağlık yapıları, havalimanı veya yüksek teknik gereksinimli projelerde görev almış, Yerel ve uluslararası şartname ve yönetmeliklere hakim, Revit programını aktif ve ileri seviyede kullanabilen Navisworks, AutoCAD ve MS Office uygulamalarına hakim, Mekanik tesisat dizaynı ve hesapları konusunda tecrübeli, İleri seviyede İngilizce bilgisine sahip, Yoğun çalışma temposuna ve saha koşullarına uyum sağlayabilecek, İstanbul’da ikamet eden/edebilecek olan ''Mekanik Dizayn Şefi'' arayışımız bulunmaktadır. Biz Neler Sunuyoruz? Performans ve başarıyı destekleyen prim uygulamaları Kapsamlı yan haklar ve çalışan destek uygulamaları Özel Sağlık Sigortası kapsamında çalışanlarımızı destekleyen sağlık uygulamaları Mesleki ve kişisel gelişimini destekleyen eğitim ve gelişim programları Çeşitlilik ve Eşitlik Beyanımız Rönesans Holding, şirketlere stratejilerini ve operasyonlarını evrensel insan hakları, çalışma, çevre ve yolsuzlukla mücadele ilkelerine uygun hale getirmeye ve toplumsal hedefleri ilerletecek önlemler almaya çağıran BM Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi'nin imzacıları arasında yer almaktadır ve Birleşmiş Milletler Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi çerçevesinde evrensel kabul görmüş beyanlara dayalı ilkeleri benimser. Rönesans Holding, ana ilkeleri olan dürüstlük, rekabetçilik ve yenilikçilikten ödün vermeden şeffaf ve etik değerleri gözeterek insan kaynakları uygulamalarında eşitliği sağlamayı amaçlayan bir işverendir. Tüm başvurular cinsiyet, dil, din, ırk ve etnik kökene bakmaksızın fırsat eşitliğine göre değerlendirilir ve ayırımcılık yapılmaz.

title: Project Engineer
description: Who we are? Wilo is proud to be one of the leading companies in the pump industry and a premium supplier for building technology, water management and the industrial sector. By developing excellent products and solutions, we not only move water, but also the future for people all over the world. Major movements like globalization, digitalization and energy shortages shape some of our largest future challenges. Challenges that we are happy to accept and dive into. We understand the trends that influence our company and our business and act accordingly. By developing products and solutions we move not only water, but we also move the future for people all over the world. As a pioneer in the pump industry, we focus as much on our employees as on our high-quality pumps. Those of you who want to be part of the Wilo will experience a constant flow of personal and organizational development as well as sufficient space for the implementation of own ideas. At Wilo you will move the future, for yourself and for others. We are looking for a Project Engineer to join the Production Department of our organization in Turkey. Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering Minimum 5–7 years of relevant experience Experience in electrical design, including Low Voltage (LV) projects Experience in automation project drawings and commissioning Proficiency in WSCAD or Eplan Knowledge of SAP PP and MM modules Good command of written and spoken English Knowledge of Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen, Lean Management, Production System tools and/or Six Sigma projects Knowledge of SolidWorks and AutoCAD Living in or willing to relocate to the Asian side of Istanbul Completed military service (for male candidates) Job Responsibilities 1. Electrical Design & Technical Documentation Design and develop Low Voltage (LV) electrical projects and automation systems. Create high-quality electrical drawings and schematics using WSCAD or Eplan . Prepare comprehensive technical reports, specifications, and project documentation. Develop detailed Bill of Materials (BOM) for new control panels and electrical systems. Utilize AutoCAD and Solidworks for layout and mechanical-electrical integration tasks. Manage material movements and production data using SAP (PP and MM modules) . 2. Project Management & Planning Create and manage project schedules, cost estimates, and regular status reports. Coordinate Production Planning by collaborating with internal stakeholders to align manufacturing capacities with project timelines. Lead the Commissioning phase of automation projects, ensuring systems are fully operational and meet quality standards. Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients, translating their needs into tailored engineering solutions. 3. Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement Knowledge in Value Stream Mapping (VSM), Kaizen, and Lean Management to optimize production flow. Identify bottlenecks and execute Six Sigma continuous improvement projects to enhance efficiency and reduce waste. 4. Quality & Supply Chain Coordination Evaluate and audit suppliers to ensure the quality of components and external services. Work closely with operations personnel and external subcontractors to ensure seamless project execution on-site. Ensure all projects comply with international electrical standards and safety regulations.

title: Üretim Mühendisi
description: 1871 yılında İstanbul’un Fatih semtinde Mehmet Efendi tarafından kurulan Kurukahveci Mehmet Efendi, Türkiye’nin en köklü ve saygın markalarından biridir. 150 yılı aşkın süredir Türk kahvesi denilince akla gelen ilk isim olmayı başaran markamız, bugün kahve sektöründe sürekli büyüyen ve globalleşen bir dünya şirketidir. Üretim süreçlerinde geliştirdiği özel teknoloji ve yöntemler, kaliteye verdiği önem, yaptığı yatırımlar ve araştırmalarla şirketimiz, ülke ekonomisine katkı sağlamaya devam etmektedir. Kurukahveci Mehmet Efendi Mahdumları A.Ş. olarak başarımızın temelini oluşturan insan kaynağımızı, uluslararası standartlarda yönetmeyi ve çalışanlarımız tarafından tercih edilen bir kurum olmayı ilke edindik. Eşit fırsat anlayışıyla tüm adaylara adil davranmayı, yetenekleri geliştirmeyi ve sürdürülebilir insan kaynakları politikaları oluşturmayı benimsiyoruz. Bu anlayış doğrultusunda, Dudullu'da bulunan üretim tesisimizde görevlendirilmek üzere aşağıdaki niteliklere sahip " Üretim Mühendisi " arayışımız bulunmaktadır. GENEL NİTELİKLER Üniversitelerin Kimya Mühendisliği veya Endüstri Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, Alanında en az 5 yıl deneyimli, Tercihen gıda veya ilaç sektöründe üretim süreçlerinin yönetimi ve takibi konusunda deneyimli, Tercihen kahve kavurma, öğütme ve paketleme süreçleri hakkında bilgi sahibi, Proses kontrolü ve verimlilik çalışmalarına hâkim, Gıda güvenliği, kalite ve hijyen standartları konusunda bilgi sahibi, Üretim verilerini analiz edebilen; raporlama ve problem çözme becerileri gelişmiş, MS Office programlarını etkin kullanabilen, tercihen ERP sistemleri konusunda deneyimli, Üretim sahasında aktif görev alabilecek, Ekip çalışmasına yatkın, iletişim ve koordinasyon becerileri güçlü, Tercihen ileri düzeyde İngilizce bilen, İş sağlığı ve güvenliği kurallarına uygun çalışmayı ilke edinmiş, Erkek adaylar için askerlik hizmetini tamamlamış, Tercihen İstanbul Anadolu Yakası'nda ikamet eden ya da edebilecek. İŞ TANIMI Üretim faaliyetlerinin belirlenen plan, kalite standartları ve gıda güvenliği gereklilikleri doğrultusunda yürütülmesini sağlamak, Kahve kavurma, öğütme ve paketleme aşamalarındaki proses parametrelerini takip etmek; sapmaların giderilmesine yönelik çalışmaları yürütmek, Günlük üretim planının uygulanmasını takip etmek, iş gücü, makine ve malzeme ihtiyaçlarının koordinasyonuna destek olmak, Üretim miktarı, fire, duruş ve kapasite kullanım verilerini izlemek, analiz etmek ve raporlamak, Üretim kayıplarının azaltılması, kaynakların etkin kullanılması ve verimliliğin artırılmasına yönelik iyileştirme çalışmalarında görev almak, Makine ve ekipmanların bakım ihtiyaçlarını ilgili birimlerle paylaşmak, bakım çalışmalarının üretim planıyla koordinasyonunu sağlamak, Üretim çalışanlarını iş akışına uygun şekilde yönlendirmek, Üretim alanlarında hijyen, düzen ve iş sağlığı ve güvenliği kurallarının uygulanmasını takip etmek. Kumanda Odası ile koordineli olarak üretim süreçlerinin yönetilmesini sağlamak.
