title: Satellite System Engineer
description: Job Description We are a startup developing missions for Low Earth Orbit (LEO) and are looking for a mid-level Satellite Systems Engineer with a strong design mindset and hands-on execution capability. This role is design-heavy, with end-to-end responsibility spanning system architecture, subsystem selection, integration, environmental testing, and launch preparation. You will play a key role in shaping the spacecraft design, making pragmatic trade-offs appropriate for LEO environments, and selecting and procuring COTS subsystems and components that balance performance, reliability, cost, and schedule. Responsibilities: • Drive system-level spacecraft design for LEO CubeSat missions, including architecture definition, requirements flow-down, and interface management. • Perform design trade-offs considering LEO environmental constraints such as thermal cycling, radiation exposure, and launch loads. • Lead or contribute to the selection, evaluation, and procurement of COTS subsystems and components, including avionics, power systems, radios, payload electronics, and sensors. • Assess vendor documentation, qualification data, heritage, and risks associated with COTS hardware; define acceptance or additional screening tests as needed. • Prepare and maintain clear, traceable technical documentation, including system requirements, interface control documents, test plans and procedures, verification matrices, and anomaly or corrective action reports. • Define and maintain electrical architectures, including power distribution, grounding, harnessing, and data interfaces. • Work directly with spacecraft interfaces and protocols such as RS-422/232, UART, I2C, CSP, SPI, CAN, and similar onboard buses. • Support and execute hands-on AIT activities, including hardware bring-up, integration, debugging, rework, and re-test. • Plan, support, and analyze environmental testingappropriate for LEO missions, including TVAC, TID, vibration, and shock. • Understand and apply launch environment requirements, including static and dynamic loads, acoustic environments, deployer constraints, and separation events. • Apply EMI/EMC design principles throughout the spacecraft; investigate and mitigate interference issues discovered during integration or test. • Generate and maintain system documentation including ICDs, test plans, verification matrices, anomaly reports, and corrective action records. • Support launch integration activities and early mission operations as a technical contributor when required. Minimum Qualifications: • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Aerospace, Systems, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline. • 3+ years of relevant experience in satellite, aerospace, or high-reliability embedded hardware systems. • Understand basic orbital mechanics and assess how orbit characteristics impact mission operations • Strong design experience at system or subsystem level for small satellites or equivalent complex hardware. • Demonstrated experience selecting and working with COTS hardware, including vendor evaluation and technical due diligence. • Solid understanding of CubeSat system hierarchy and subsystem interactions. • Practical experience with embedded and spacecraft interfaces (RS-422/232, UART, I2C, CSP, SPI, CAN, etc.). • Working knowledge of environmental testing for space hardware • Strong understanding of EMI/EMC fundamentals and grounding • Ability to troubleshoot issues using schematics, test and lab equipment, logs, and engineering judgment. Preferred Qualifications: • Prior experience in an aerospace company. • Direct involvement in at least one LEO missionthrough integration, environmental testing, and launch preparation. • Experience defining acceptance vs. qualification test strategies for COTS-based spacecraft. • Working proficiency with mechanical and electrical CAD tools to review layouts, assess integration constraints, and support design trades. • Familiarity with deployers, launch integrators, launch provider requirements, and rideshare integration processes. • Experience with power systems, avionics boards, harness design, and grounding strategies for space applications. • Comfortable operating with incomplete information and making pragmatic engineering decisions under startup constraints. • Hands-on experience with spacecraft Assembly, Integration, and Test (AIT), including hardware bring-up, environmental testing support, and anomaly resolution in a lab setting. • Familiarity with IPC standards and PCB quality, including inspection, workmanship criteria, and acceptance testing relevant to high-reliability aerospace hardware. Benefits: Competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance and fuel support. Continued support for candidates currently enrolled in a master's or doctoral program. Opportunities for continuous professional growth and skill development. Engage in a collaborative and innovative work environment. Enjoy a positive and enriching work environment, situated in a desirable location.

title: Power Systems Engineer
description: At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: ELSE Cluster Manager North Europe __ Your Role And Responsibilities In this role you will work as a power engineer on a range of exciting projects for global clients in a rewarding team environment, developing technical and solution development skills to develop into an industry-recognized consulting engineer. The position would suit a practical and adaptable individual who wishes to work in a progressive, innovative electrical consultancy. We are seeking experienced Power Systems Engineers who are eager to deepen their technical expertise and contribute to complex engineering projects for global clients. This role is ideal for a practical, adaptable, and technically driven engineer who wants to grow into an industry-recognized consulting specialist within a progressive and innovative electrical consultancy environment. The work model for the role is: #hybrid, Driven by strong business growth and increasing customer demand, we are expanding our team and recruiting multiple professionals for this role across the listed countries. You will be mainly accountable for: Providing technical input and leadership on a variety of complex projects. Working closely with clients to understand their technical and business requirements and translating them into practical engineering solutions. Ensuring project outputs meet client expectations, quality standards, timeframes, and budget requirements. Conducting in-depth power systems analysis using industry-leading methodologies and software tools. Preparing detailed technical and non-technical reports, presenting clear recommendations and actionable insights. Attending client meetings remotely, building trusted relationships and managing expectations through effective communication and responsiveness. Tracking and reporting on project performance and client satisfaction. Mentoring, coaching and developing more junior engineers. Online training to be delivered where applicable. Typical projects include: Power system studies include load flow, short circuit, protection coordination and system resilience assessments. Electrical safety and power quality studies, including arc flash, harmonics and earthing assessments. Grid connection and renewable energy integration projects, covering stability, harmonics and compliance analyses. Reliability assessments and failure investigations for critical electrical infrastructure. Software-based engineering solutions and emerging technology evaluations. Supporting wind energy projects from design through installation and commissioning. Qualifications For The Role You are highly skilled in power system studies, including short circuit, protection coordination and arc flash analysis, and enjoy working on complex electrical infrastructure projects. You have 3+ years of experience in power systems engineering, applying technical expertise to deliver reliable, safe and efficient electrical solutions. You possess advanced knowledge of industry-leading power system analysis tools such as SKM, EasyPower, ETAP or similar. You have proven experience in protection system design, settings development and coordination studies, with exposure to transformer and bus differential protection, REF and directional protection schemes. You have experience performing electrical calculations and developing designs in accordance with relevant IEC standards. Knowledge of power quality, harmonics and renewable energy integration studies would be an advantage. You are passionate about solving technical challenges, collaborating with clients and stakeholders, and continuously expanding your expertise. Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field. You are at ease communicating in English and can clearly present technical concepts to a wide range of audiences Compensation Package This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage. The offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer - Deep-Tech Startup
description: Wil je niet een onderdeeltje van een machine ontwerpen, maar de complete mechanische basis van een tool die nog nergens anders bestaat? Voor een jonge, snelgroeiende deep-tech startup in Eindhoven zoek ik een Mechanical Design Engineer . Het bedrijf bouwt inspectie- en metrologieapparatuur voor de halfgeleiderindustrie en zit volop in de opbouwfase. Wat ga je doen? Je ontwerpt de hardware die de metingen draagt: van machinebehuizing en frames tot de wafertafel en de draagconstructies van het systeem. ✅ Ontwerpen van concept tot productietekening, inclusief materiaal- en oppervlaktekeuze ✅ Zelf schakelen met CNC-bedrijven en leveranciers over offertes, toleranties en wijzigingen ✅ FEM-, thermische en dynamische analyses waar het ertoe doet, eenvoud waar het kan ✅ Je eigen ontwerpen assembleren en testen in het lab, en leren voor de volgende versie ✅ Nauw samenwerken met mechatronica-, optica- en systeemengineers Wie ben jij? 🔹 3+ jaar hands-on ervaring met mechanisch ontwerp van high-tech apparatuur (semicon, metrologie of wetenschappelijke instrumenten) 🔹 Je ontwerpen zijn van CAD naar werkende hardware gegaan 🔹 Sterk in 3D-CAD (Creo bij voorkeur, SolidWorks of NX ook prima) 🔹 Goede kennis van GD&T, tolereren en DfMA 🔹 Je weet wat een CNC-bedrijf wel en niet kan 🔹 Je staat net zo graag aan de labtafel als achter je CAD-scherm 🔹 Professioneel niveau Engels Pluspunten: cleanroom- of vacuümontwerp, trillingsisolatie en thermisch management, SEMI-standaarden en CE-markering, opto-mechanisch ontwerp, een leveranciersnetwerk in Brainport. Geen perfecte match? Geen probleem. Engineering-inzicht en eigenaarschap tellen hier zwaarder dan het afvinken van een lijstje. Heb je precisiehardware ontworpen én gebouwd, dan wil ik je spreken. Wat krijg je ervoor terug? 🚀 Volledig eigenaarschap over het mechanisch ontwerp van een unieke tool 👥 Klein team, korte lijnen en directe impact op het product 💶 Marktconform salaris Interesse of ken je iemand die hier perfect op past? title: Mechanical Engineer Machinebouw
description: Ben jij een ervaren Mechanical Engineer met ervaring in de machinebouw en kun je moeiteloos door alle fasen van een project navigeren? Dan is de rol bij VIRO in Schiedam de perfecte uitdaging voor jou! Als Mechanical Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van mechanische systemen en componenten. Je werkt aan uitdagende en innovatieve projecten, waarbij je jouw technische expertise inzet om producten te creëren die volledig aansluiten op de wensen en eisen van onze klanten. Je bent van begin tot eind betrokken bij het project, van de conceptontwikkeling en het ontwerp tot de testfasen en de uiteindelijke oplevering. In samenwerking met een multidisciplinair team zorg je ervoor dat elk project voldoet aan de hoogste kwaliteitsstandaarden en bijdraagt aan de klanttevredenheid. We zoeken een gedreven collega met voldoende ervaring om zelfstandig aan de slag te gaan, maar je hoeft het niet alleen te doen. Bij VIRO kun je rekenen op de steun van je collega’s, want dat is de kracht van werken bij VIRO: een toonaangevende ontwikkelingspartner voor de industrie. Wat ga je doen? Zelfstandig en samen met het team technische oplossingen vinden voor diverse machinebouwprojecten. Proactief rapporteren aan betrokken stakeholders, zoals lead engineers en projectleiders, over de planning, voortgang en wijzigingen in de opdracht of het ontwerp. Controleregistraties uitvoeren, ontwerpen verifiëren en zorgen voor de benodigde rapportages. Waar nodig verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor zowel de concept- als detailengineering. Regelmatig contact onderhouden met de klant en, indien nodig, af en toe op locatie werken. Overleggen met externe partijen en collega's binnen VIRO om projecten succesvol af te ronden. Collega’s ondersteunen en junior engineers begeleiden in hun ontwikkeling en projecten. In de pauze is er altijd tijd voor een potje poolen of tafelvoetballen, als dat in de smaak valt! Vereisten Een afgeronde hbo- en/of wo-opleiding in de richting Mechanical Engineering, Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in de machinebouw om zelfstandig te kunnen werken Projecten binnen de gestelde tijd en het budget succesvol opleveren is één van je drijfveren Oplossingsgericht om de diverse vraagstukken op te kunnen lossen Je communiceert makkelijk met je klanten en collega’s in het Nederlands en in het Engels Je draagt bij aan het teamgevoel Flexibele instelling omdat elk project weer anders is Wat bieden wij je? Afwisselende projecten met veel ruimte voor innovatieve en duurzame ideeën Een uitdagende en afwisselende baan in een gemoedelijk maar professioneel team Enthousiaste, vakkundige collega’s en een open, prettige sfeer Regie over je eigen carrière via onze VIRO Academy Prima mogelijkheden en faciliteiten om hybride te werken, inclusief thuiswerkvergoeding 22 vakantiedagen en 13 ATV-dagen Vergoeding voor het woon – werkverkeer of gebruik van een zakelijke NS-business card Je kunt gebruik maken van een fietsleaseplan, een aantrekkelijke fitnessregeling en/of het hybride warmtepompplan Profiteer van een uitstekende pensioenvoorziening bij Nationale Nederlanden en onze collectieve zorgverzekering via VGZ Onze actieve personeelsvereniging zorgt voor de nodige ontspanning en voor mooie verhalen bij de koffieautomaat Je afdeling VIRO vestiging Schiedam is een bruisende, jonge en ambitieuze vestiging waar een enthousiast team collega’s met elkaar samenwerkt en elkaar helpt wanneer dat nodig is. De sfeer is informeel en collega's ondernemen vaak activiteiten. Of dit nu gaat om een gezellige gameavond of filmavond op kantoor, iets sportiefs ondernemen, genieten van een biertje in onze VIRO bar of een potje poolen op kantoor, er is altijd ruimte voor gezelligheid en elkaar ook na werktijd leren kennen. We moedigen initiatieven aan, stimuleren persoonlijke ontwikkeling en betrekken onze collega’s bij het meedenken over de groei en de ontwikkeling van onze vestiging. Interesse? Bij interesse in deze vacature zien we je sollicitatie graag tegemoet en wie weet maak jij dan binnenkort deel uit van ons enthousiast team in Schiedam! Heb je vragen over deze of andere vacatures binnen VIRO, bel of whatsapp dan onze talentspecialist Rutger van Rugge via 0614756851 of We willen deze functie rechtstreeks invullen en maken hierbij geen gebruik van werving- en selectiebureaus.

title: Senior Design Engineer CAD
description: Ben jij een gedreven en ervaren werktuigbouwkundig ingenieur die energie krijgt van het omzetten van concepten naar slimme, produceerbare oplossingen? Sluit je aan bij ons team en speel een belangrijke rol in het vormgeven van de toekomst van technologie voor pluimveeverwerking. Over de functie Als Senior Design Engineer CAD ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen van innovatieve concepten naar basis- en detailontwerpen van machines. Je vervult een centrale rol binnen de concept- en definitiefase van productontwikkeling en werkt nauw samen met een multidisciplinair team om hoogwaardige ontwerpen, stuklijsten (BOM's) en technische documentatie voor seriematige productie te ontwikkelen. Je bent vertrouwd met het werken binnen een engineerings- en productieomgeving en begrijpt de belangen, onderlinge relaties en doelstellingen van verschillende stakeholders. Je draagt niet alleen bij als ervaren engineer, maar ook als coach en sparringpartner voor collega’s. Met jouw scherpe blik op produceerbaarheid, hygiëne, veiligheid en kostenefficiëntie help je elk ontwerp naar een hoger niveau te tillen, van de eerste schets tot het uiteindelijke technische dossier. Deze functie biedt veel technische diepgang en afwisseling. Je wordt regelmatig uitgedaagd met nieuwe vraagstukken en werkt aan machines die een cruciale rol spelen binnen een wereldwijde hightechindustrie. Je neemt deel aan FAT- en SAT-tests, ondersteunt verbetertrajecten en bent actief betrokken bij de conceptfase als productspecialist op het gebied van ontwerp. Om de functie nog dynamischer te maken, krijg je de mogelijkheid om enkele keren per jaar internationaal te reizen (gemiddeld 2 tot 4 reizen per jaar). Je bezoekt productielocaties en werkt rechtstreeks samen met internationale klanten en partners. Hierdoor krijg je een waardevol praktijkperspectief en worden projecten nog tastbaarder en interessanter. Ben jij op zoek naar een functie waarin techniek, eigenaarschap en internationale exposure samenkomen? Dan is dit jouw kans. Wat breng je mee? Een bachelor- of masteropleiding in Werktuigbouwkunde of een vergelijkbare richting Minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring in mechanisch ontwerp en 3D CAD-engineering Ervaring met het opstellen van technische tekeningen, waaronder maar niet beperkt tot overzichtstekeningen (General Arrangements), ontwerpspecificaties, werkplaatstekeningen en pneumatische- en hydraulische schema’s Ervaring met modulair ontwerpen, ERP en wijzigingsbeheer-/change management-systemen Kennis van materialen, productieprocessen en hygiënisch ontwerpen (HACCP) Bekendheid met CE-richtlijnen, risicoanalyses en technische documentatie Goede beheersing van CAD-software (bij voorkeur CATIA V5 of V6) Ervaring met Infor LN is een pré Ervaring met FEM-berekeningen en bewegingsanalyses is een pluspunt Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels; kennis van het Duits is een pre Een gestructureerde, praktische instelling met passie voor technische nauwkeurigheid en teamwork Waarom bij ons werken? Je wordt onderdeel van een samenwerkend, internationaal engineeringteam dat tastbare en hoogwaardige producten ontwikkelt. Deze functie biedt een unieke combinatie van technische diepgang, ontwerpverantwoordelijkheid en teamwork . Je helpt mee aan het ontwikkelen van machines die een essentiële rol spelen in de wereldwijde voedselproductie, terwijl je tegelijkertijd je eigen expertise verder ontwikkelt binnen een dynamische en ondersteunende werkomgeving. Wat maakt deze functie aantrekkelijk? Je krijgt de kans om innovatieve concepten om te zetten in concrete, produceerbare oplossingen Je neemt deel aan het testen van je eigen ontwerpen en bent hier direct getuige van in onze eigen testfaciliteiten Je werkt in een projectmatige omgeving waarin jouw werk een directe impact heeft op wereldwijde operaties Je begeleidt en ontwikkelt jongere engineers, waardoor je zowel hun groei als je eigen leiderschapsvaardigheden stimuleert Je hebt een gezonde afwisseling tussen ontwerp-, test-, verbeter- en documentatiewerkzaamheden Je bent betrokken bij en getuige van de bouw van machines tijdens en na de opstartfase in onze eigen productiefaciliteiten Wat bieden wij Salaris tussen € 3665,00 en € 5.845,00 afhankelijk van opleiding en werkervaring Aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling Royale vrije tijd: in totaal 33 dagen, waarvan 25 vakantiedagen en 8 ADV-dagen Groei- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden: ruime mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en loopbaangroei Reiskostenvergoeding: € 0,25 per kilometer Over Meyn Al meer dan 65 jaar is Meyn een vertrouwde wereldwijde leider in oplossingen voor pluimveeverwerking. Als Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) ontwerpen en bouwen wij onze eigen machines en systemen, die wereldwijd door klanten worden gebruikt. Door bij Meyn te komen werken, word je onderdeel van een team dat wordt gedreven door innovatie, samenwerking en een voortdurend streven naar excellentie. Solliciteer nu en word onderdeel van een team dat succes drijft. Geïnteresseerd Solliciteer via de sollicitatieknop. Heb je vragen over de vacature? title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Job Description About Us E2M Technologies BV, part of the MTS group, is a fast-growing high-tech company headquartered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, with manufacturing facilities in Mijdrecht. We design, develop, and manufacture electric motion and control loading systems for applications such as vehicle simulation, entertainment rides and R&D environments. Our products are exported and serviced worldwide. At E2M, we combine engineering excellence with an informal, dynamic and collaborative working culture. Are you passionate about mechanical design and turning concepts into working machines? We are looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join our team and work on innovative motion platforms from concept and design through manufacturing, testing, and delivery. Key Responsibilities As our Mechanical Engineer, you'll be involved throughout the entire product lifecycle from concept and design to assembly, testing and delivery. You Will Design mechanical parts and assemblies using Siemens NX. Create detailed production drawings and Bills of Materials (BOMs). Perform kinematic, motion, and collision analyses. Select and apply appropriate manufacturing methods such as machining, laser cutting, welding, casting, and 3D printing. Support assembly, testing, and commissioning activities together with our workshop team. Research and evaluate new technologies and engineering solutions. Collaborate closely with Mechanical, Electrical, and Software Engineers. Contribute throughout the entire product lifecycle, from concept development to customer delivery. Participate in technical reviews and help drive continuous improvement. Take ownership of engineering decisions and technical problem-solving. What You Bring You don't need to tick every box, but this role will likely suit you if you have: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Industrial Design Engineering, or a related field. Up to 4 years of engineering experience. Experience with 3D CAD software, preferably Siemens NX. A solid understanding of mechanical design and manufacturing processes. A practical, hands-on engineering mindset. A proactive attitude and willingness to take ownership. Strong communication skills and the confidence to share and challenge ideas. Professional proficiency in English. Experience with mechatronic systems. Experience working in a multidisciplinary engineering environment. Why Join Us? Freedom to take ownership, innovate, and lead improvements. Modern working environment with a collaborative team culture and short communication lines. Opportunities to growth in responsibilities. Access to courses and personal development opportunities. Competitive salary and benefits. An international working environment. The chance to work with cutting-edge high-tech products. Have the freedom to explore additional responsibilities outside your job description. Apply If you enjoy hands-on engineering, technical challenges, and seeing your designs come to life, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application via ITW Careers. Please note that we do not provide relocation assistance for this role. Candidates must already be legally authorized to work in the Netherlands at the time of application. E2M manage our recruitment process directly. Should we require additional support, we will contact our preferred recruitment partners ourselves.

title: Project Engineer
description: Do you enjoy cross-functional collaboration and customer-focused projects? As a Project Engineer at GEA, you will gain valuable insight into our customers' products and production processes while playing an active role in designing and implementing systems that expand and optimise their operations. From design to implementation, you can look forward to collaborating with skilled colleagues across our many areas of expertise to develop tailored solutions that meet each of our customers’ unique challenges. At our office in Skanderborg, you will become part of our Liquid Technologies department, where we deliver customized liquid processing and engineering solutions primarily to the food and dairy industries in the Nordic region. Responsibilities / Tasks Joining GEA Liquid Technologies, you will develop a comprehensive understanding of the full project lifecycle for liquid projects in the Nordic region – from sales through project execution and aftermarket services. You will contribute to the execution of customer projects from design to handover (including commissioning and start-up), as well as occasionally participating in the pre-project and proposal stages. Depending on project size and your experience, you may assume responsibility for both the technical and commercial execution of projects, acting as project engineer and project manager. Our projects typically run for 12 to 18 months and combine complex technical tasks with close collaboration across multiple disciplines. More Specifically, You Will Develop process flow diagrams (PFDs), mass balances and piping & instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs) for hygienic process applications and review associated 3D models prepared by technical designers. Size and specify process equipment, tanks and flow components, perform hydraulic and utility consumption calculations, and support plant layout optimisation. Serve as a technical point of contact for customers throughout project execution. Specify, procure and technically evaluate process equipment, packages and services from approved suppliers and subcontractors in collaboration with our procurement department. Collaborate with project managers to develop project schedules and resource planning. Coordinate process requirements with automation engineers to support functional design, control philosophy development and commissioning activities. Lead and support equipment commissioning, site acceptance testing (SAT), start-up and performance validation activities at customer sites. As you will be collaborating closely with our customers, you can expect some travel in the Nordic region for customer meetings, supplier visits and customer site activities. Your Profile / Qualifications You enjoy building strong relationships across the organisation and naturally collaborate with colleagues to draw on their expertise. Combining an analytical mindset with a practical approach, you work through technical challenges while maintaining the attention to detail needed to deliver high-quality engineering solutions. Additionally, We Imagine That You Bring A degree in mechanical engineering, process engineering, dairy engineering or a similar field. Previous experience in project engineering, process engineering or equipment design, preferably within food, dairy, beverage, pharmaceutical or related process industries. Experience with commissioning or start-up of liquid processing systems is an advantage, but not a prerequisite. Strong proficiency in spoken and written English. We are open to candidates at different stages of their careers. Responsibilities and degree of autonomy will be adapted to your experience level. Finally, you preferably live near our site in Skanderborg, as this will be your regular work location. Would you like to know more? If you would like to find out more about this position, please contact Engineering Manager, Stephanie Gunn, phone no. +45 28107650. Please apply via the indicated link. Please note that GEA exclusively uses electronic recruiting, and only applications received through our application system will be considered. Did we spark your interest? Then please click apply above to access our guided application process.

title: Senior Application Engineer
description: Senior Application Engineer – har du mod på at blive et stort tandhjul i et mindre maskineri Dan-iso A/S, Aars · Fuldtid · Tiltrædelse efter aftale Da vores mangeårige Engineer har søgt nye udfordringer som selvstændig, søger vi dig der vil være den, der omsætter kundernes behov til nye produkter – fra den første skitse til færdig løsning i produktionen? Hos Dan-iso bliver du virksomhedens tekniske omdrejningspunkt. Du får ansvar, frihed og kort vej fra idé til beslutning, da du refererer direkte til direktøren. Vi er ikke en stor koncern med mange lag, men en specialiseret produktionsvirksomhed, hvor din faglighed gør en synlig forskel hver dag. Om Dan-iso A/S Siden 1986 har Dan-iso udviklet og produceret isolering i hårdt polyurethanskum (PUR og PIR) på fabrikken i Aars. Vi leverer rørskåle og bøjninger, rørbæringer, blokskum, montageskum, færdige isolerings-kits og specialemner efter tegning – og vi fræser emner, forme og prototyper på egne CNC-maskiner. Vores produkter bruges i fjernvarme, industrikøling, vindindustrien, byggeri, offshore og marine samt Power-to-X. Fælles for dem er, at de skal isolere effektivt på lidt plads, holde i mange år og ofte tilpasse til en helt specifik opgave. Dine opgaver Som vores eneste ingeniør ejer du den tekniske udvikling fra start til slut. Du kommer til at: Udvikle og materiale afprøvning af nye produkter, der møder konkrete behov i markedet Udvikle kundespecifikke løsninger – ofte ud fra en tegning, en skitse eller en udfordring, kunden ikke selv har løst Besvare tekniske forespørgsler fra kunder og være salgets tekniske sparringspartner Udarbejde og vedligeholde virksomhedens tekniske dokumentation, fx datablade, produktspecifikationer og vejledninger Stille de rigtige spørgsmål til vores leverandører – både råvareleverandører af polyoler og isocyanat og leverandører af maskiner og procesudstyr Udfordre leverandørerne, når en ny løsning kræver mere end standardsortimentet Samarbejde med leverandørerne om udvikling af nye produkter og materialer Du driver selv dine projekter og planlægger din hverdag. Til gengæld kan du se dine løsninger blive produceret og leveret til kunderne. Din profil Du er uddannet ingeniør, gerne cand.polyt. eller civilingeniør inden for maskinkonstruktion. Er du proces-, kemi-, bygge-, materialeingeniør eller har en anden relevant uddannelse og erfaring fra produktionsindustrien, er du måske det match vi søger. Du har mindst 5 års erfaring som ingeniør, gerne med produktudvikling i en mindre produktionsvirksomhed Du arbejder selvstændigt og kan drive projekter i mål uden et stort teknisk team omkring dig. Du er nysgerrig, analytisk og træffer beslutninger på et fagligt grundlag. Du kan kommunikere klart med både kunder, leverandører og kolleger i produktionen. Du taler og skriver dansk og engelsk; (tysk er en fordel). Erfaring med polyurethan, plast eller kompositter er et plus, men ikke et krav. Ligeledes er erfaring med termisk isolering et plus, men ikke et krav. Vi lægger mest vægt på din tekniske dømmekraft og lyst til at lære materialet at kende. Vi tilbyder En central rolle med stor indflydelse på virksomhedens produkter og fremtid Kort beslutningsvej: du refererer direkte til ejer og adm. direktør, uden unødigt bureaukrati Varierede opgaver, hvor du følger dine løsninger fra udvikling til produktion og levering Tætte samarbejder med kunder og leverandører i både Danmark og udlandet Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø i en solid nordjysk produktionsvirksomhed med 40 års erfaring Mulighed for faglig udvikling og efteruddannelse Konkurrencedygtig løn og pension efter kvalifikationer Mulighed for sidemandsoplæring og sparring For yderligere information, er du velkommen til at kontakte direktør Erik H. Møller på ehm@dan-iso.dk eller på 2947 9433. Din ansøgning sendes til ehm@dan-iso.dk eller via Jobindex – hvor den naturligvis behandles fortroligt. Ansøgningsfrist: Ansøgningerne behandles løbende.

title: Mekanikkonstruktör: Från idé till färdig konstruktion
description: Företagsbeskrivning AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle. Jobbeskrivning Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens produkter, maskiner och produktionslösningar? Nu söker vi en mekanikkonstruktör som vill kombinera teknisk kreativitet med praktisk problemlösning i spännande uppdrag inom industrin. Som mekanikkonstruktör hos AFRY får du arbeta genom hela konstruktionsprocessen, från tidiga idéer och konceptutveckling till färdig konstruktion och implementerad lösning. Du tar fram 3D-modeller och teknisk dokumentation i moderna CAD-verktyg såsom SolidWorks och Inventor, samtidigt som du bidrar med materialval, komponentval och tekniska bedömningar för att säkerställa hållbara och kostnadseffektiva lösningar. Du blir en viktig del av våra projektteam och arbetar nära kollegor inom flera teknikområden för att omsätta kundernas behov till smarta och funktionella lösningar. Rollen innebär ett stort eget ansvar där du driver konstruktionsarbetet framåt och säkerställer att leveranser håller hög kvalitet, uppfyller tekniska krav och följer projektets tidplan. Arbetet sker främst från AFRYs kontor eller ute hos kund, med möjlighet till visst distansarbete beroende på uppdragets karaktär. Som ny medarbetare hos oss får du stöd från både chef och en utsedd buddy som hjälper dig att snabbt komma in i verksamheten. Du blir även en del av AFRYs breda nätverk av specialister där kunskapsutbyte, samarbete och kompetensutveckling är en naturlig del av vardagen. För dig som vill utvecklas finns goda möjligheter att forma din fortsatta karriär utifrån dina intressen. Du kan exempelvis fördjupa dig inom hållfasthetsberäkningar, utvecklas mot konstruktionsledning eller projektledning, eller bredda din kompetens som teknisk konsult med ansvar för större helhetsleveranser. Vissa uppdrag kan kräva säkerhetsprövning, vilket innebär att rollen framöver kan komma att innefatta arbete inom säkerhetsklassade projekt. Kvalifikationer I rollen som mekanikkonstruktör är dina personliga egenskaper avgörande för att lyckas. Du behöver vara en Problemlösare som kan hantera komplexa utmaningar i konstruktionen genom att se helheten och angripa problem från flera infallsvinklar. Vidare är det viktigt att du Planerar och strukturerar ditt arbete, med tydliga planer för konstruktionsuppdrag och ordning på ritningar och utgåvor för att säkerställa kvalitet i projektet. Rollen kräver också att du är Initiativtagande, då du som konsult ofta förväntas driva arbetet framåt utan att någon detaljstyr dig. Slutligen är det avgörande att du är Serviceinriktad, eftersom du representerar AFRY ute hos kund och behöver agera med serviceanda, leverera enligt kundens behov och vara lyhörd för nya möjligheter. title: Rör- och mekkonstruktör till AFRY – starta din karriär med talangprogram
description: Rör- och mekkonstruktör till AFRY i Piteå – starta din karriär med talangprogram Vill du vara med och utveckla några av Sveriges mest spännande industriprojekt samtidigt som du får en trygg och inspirerande start på karriären? Nu söker vi dig som är nyexaminerad ingenjör och vill arbeta med tekniskt avancerade lösningar inom processindustrin tillsammans med AFRY. Genom Framtidens Talangprogram får du en unik möjlighet att växa in i konsultrollen, bygga ett starkt professionellt nätverk och utvecklas tillsammans med erfarna specialister. Här får du kombinera teori med praktik från dag ett och vara med och skapa lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för industrin. Talangprogrammet: den bästa starten på din ingenjörskarriär Du blir en del av Framtidens talangprogram i samarbete med AFRY, ett program som är utvecklat för att ge dig mer än ett jobb. Redan från dag ett arbetar du i riktiga projekt tillsammans med några av branschens mest erfarna specialister. Under det första året kombinerar du konsultuppdrag med ett skräddarsytt utvecklingsprogram med: Utbildning och kontinuerligt stöd i takt med att du tar större ansvar Mentorskap och coachning Ett nätverk av andra nyutexaminerade talanger från Norra Sverige Målet är att du ska växa till en självständig konsult och specialist. Oavsett om du siktar mot att bli teknisk expert, projektledare eller framtida ledare får du en stark grund att bygga vidare på. Om rollen Som rör- och mekkonstruktör blir du en viktig del av AFRY:s grupp Project & Plant Engineering Piteå. Här arbetar du nära några av Sveriges största industribolag inom papper och massa, gruv- och kemiindustrin. Du kommer att vara involverad genom hela projektprocessen, från förstudier och projektering till installation och idrifttagning. Rollen ger dig en bred förståelse för industriprojekt samtidigt som du utvecklar din tekniska specialistkompetens. Hos AFRY får du dessutom tillgång till ett stort internt nätverk av specialister och goda möjligheter att på sikt utvecklas mot exempelvis projektledning eller montageledning. Det här kommer du att göra Ta fram teknisk handling för processindustrin, främst inom papper och massa, gruva och kemi Rita i 3D och 2D i AutoCAD, Cadmatic och Plant 3D Ta fram layouter, isometrier, flödesscheman och materiallistor Genomföra spänningsanalyser och ta fram pumpuppställningar Ta fram kostnadskalkyler och vara med i hela projektprocessen Delta i förstudier, projektering och idriftagning samt i arbete med att effektivisera produktionen Bidra i större projekt, både som del av internt projekt och ute hos kund Det här söker vi hos dig Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom maskinteknik, energiteknik eller annat relevant område Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift Vana att arbeta i CAD B-körkort Meriterande Erfarenhet av arbete inom processindustrin Personliga egenskaper Du är social och framåt och har lätt för att prata med människor, både kollegor och kunder. Du är noggrann och vill göra det lilla extra för att leverera ett bra resultat. Du är flexibel, trivs med förändring och anpassar dig till nya uppgifter och projekt. Teamet du kommer ingå i Project & Plant Engineering Piteå består av 17 personer i Piteå och Umeå. Gruppen arbetar med projektledning, rörkonstruktion, mekanik och HVAC, med många uppdrag inom papper och massa samt gruva. Teamet växer och har stor samlad erfarenhet. Du blir en del av ett prestigelöst och kunnigt team som värdesätter samarbete och kunskapsdelning, och som välkomnar nya kollegor med olika erfarenhetsnivåer. Om AFRY AFRY är ett internationellt teknikkonsultbolag och är rankat som en av Sveriges mest populära arbetsgivare bland ingenjörer. AFRY har över 19 000 medarbetare och kontor i 50 länder. De är experter inom inom områdena infrastruktur, industri och energi. De arbetar över hela världen för att skapa hållbara lösningar för kommande generationer där de har en uttalad strategi inom just hållbarhet och transformativa segment. Om Framtiden Framtiden är ett rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag med kontor på åtta orter i Sverige. Vi finns för att fler ska älska måndagar! Inom Tech People är vi experter på ingenjörer, med roller för både juniora och seniora profiler inom IT och teknik. Inom Business People är vi experter på ekonomer på alla erfarenhetsnivåer, från specialister, chefer och interimsledare till juniora talanger inom ekonomi/finans, HR, lön och administration. Vår rekrytering bygger på evidensbaserade metoder för en rättvis och träffsäker matchning. Vi gör skillnad genom att hjälpa människor att hitta rätt jobb och rätt kollega. I denna tjänst påbörjar du din resa som anställd hos Framtiden, vilket innebär att du får fullt stöd och resurser från vårt team. Sedan har du möjlighet att gå över och bli anställd direkt hos AFRY. Skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Manufacturing Engineer – Mechanical Tooling & Equipment
description: Location: Gothenburg, Sweden Aurora Engineering is looking for an experienced Manufacturing Engineer for an assignment within Manufacturing Engineering at Volvo Cars, supporting the industrialisation of advanced high-voltage battery assembly systems for electric vehicles. You will lead the mechanical development and verification of automated production equipment, tooling, fixtures, nests, grippers and handling solutions. The focus is on robust mechanical design, equipment interfaces, supplier delivery and production readiness. Your Responsibilities Develop and review mechanical concepts for production stations, tooling, fixtures, nests, grippers and handling devices. Translate process, product, geometry, safety, maintainability and cycle-time needs into technical equipment requirements. Review supplier layouts, 3D concepts, detailed designs, calculations, engineering drawings and interface definitions. Ensure equipment provides safe access, ergonomics, serviceability, efficient changeovers, error-proofing and an appropriate replacement-parts strategy. Coordinate mechanical interfaces with automation, robotics, controls, utilities, process equipment and facilities. Support RFQs, supplier selection, design reviews, manufacturing follow-up, equipment buy-off, installation and commissioning. Drive mechanical risk assessments, tolerance reviews and technical issue resolution. Support equipment acceptance and handover, documenting deviations and outstanding actions. You will work closely with manufacturing, process, product, automation and quality teams, as well as equipment suppliers. Your background 5+ years developing automated production equipment and tooling. 5+ years reviewing mechanical designs using 3D CAD and engineering drawings. 3+ years working with equipment suppliers from concept through commissioning. 3+ years working with machine safety, maintainability, ergonomics and tolerance engineering. 3+ years in high-volume automated manufacturing industrialisation. A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline, or equivalent demonstrated professional experience. You bring senior-level industrialisation experience from automotive, battery manufacturing, electrification or comparable high-volume automated production. You can work independently, take ownership of technical deliverables and collaborate effectively with engineering teams and suppliers. Additional Advantages Experience with high-voltage battery assembly equipment. Experience with precision handling, joining fixtures, grippers, conveyors or pallet systems. Familiarity with CATIA, Teamcenter or equivalent CAD/PLM tools. Knowledge of CE conformity, machinery risk assessments and equipment acceptance. Key deliverables Approved tooling and mechanical equipment concepts. Mechanical requirements and interface specifications. Documented supplier design reviews and action tracking. Mechanical risk assessments and mitigation plans. Equipment buy-off, installation and commissioning documentation. Equipment acceptance and handover packages. Application Apply through our careers site with your CV in English .

title: Mechanical Design Engineer - Life Science
description: Company Description TTP is an employee-owned technology and product development consultancy, with a 40-year track record of helping ambitious clients solve complex technical challenges and bring innovative, commercially successful solutions to market. We invent, design, and manufacture impactful products and technologies across a wide range of industries – including healthcare, life science, energy, and communications – and at the intersection of biology, physical science and engineering. Our working culture encourages entrepreneurship, shared ideas and technical collaboration, while providing you with the freedom to do your best work. Job Description We’re looking for a talented Mechanical Design Engineer to join our Molecular Synthesis & Omics team (part of a larger Life Science department) and help tackle some of the challenging engineering problems at the interface of biology, chemistry and technology. The interdisciplinary team develops innovative technologies and products for genomics, molecular synthesis and life-science research. We work with leading biotechnology companies and research organisations to turn emerging scientific ideas into practical, robust and scalable products — from novel microfluidic consumables and molecular processing systems to complex automated laboratory instruments. Projects span areas such as next-generation DNA synthesis, sequencing sample preparation, precision liquid handling, automated molecular workflows and novel biological measurement technologies. Your work as a Mechanical Design Engineer will be varied, technically demanding and often involves developing solutions that don't yet exist. You'll work closely with molecular biologists, chemists, physicists and engineers in both our MS&O and the broader Life Science team, contributing mechanical design expertise from early concept generation through detailed design, prototyping, testing and product development. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of mechanical design challenges, develop creative solutions and see your ideas become working prototypes and ultimately commercial products. If you are an experienced mechanical designer who enjoys hands-on engineering, thrives on solving unfamiliar problems and wants to apply their skills to technologies that could shape the future of life sciences, we’d love to hear from you. Qualifications You'll be an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer with excellent design capabilities, a wider understanding of the electromechanical considerations of product development and an innovative approach to problem solving. This role will be a full-time, on site position. Essential Experience And Skills Strong experience in mechanical design and development of complex products or instruments. Excellent 3D CAD skills, ideally including SolidWorks (and ideally familiarity with Onshape). Good understanding of mechanical and electromechanical system design. Experience taking designs from initial concepts through detailed engineering, prototyping and testing. Knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials and design for manufacture. Ability to perform tolerance analysis and develop robust mechanical assemblies. Strong practical engineering skills, including building, testing and troubleshooting prototypes. Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly through CAD models, sketches, prototypes and design reviews. Experience working collaboratively with engineers and scientists from different disciplines. Ability to manage competing priorities and take ownership of design deliverables. Desirable experience Design of precision motion systems, positioning mechanisms or automated instrumentation. Experience with microfluidics, liquid handling, laboratory automation or life-science instruments. Design of plastic injection-moulded parts and single-use consumables. Experience designing assembly jigs, fixtures and test equipment. Experience of structured concept-generation techniques and engineering risk assessments, including dFMEA and pFMEA. Experience sourcing custom components and working with specialist manufacturing suppliers. Experience using rapid prototyping, visualisation and rendering tools to communicate and evaluate design concepts. Additional Information Benefits TTP is an employee-owned business, based at TTP Campus in Melbourn, just 10 miles south of Cambridge. Our purpose-built, sustainable offices and laboratories are set in green surroundings, creating an inspiring environment for innovation. Our working culture encourages entrepreneurship, shared ideas and technical collaboration, while providing you with the freedom to do your best work. Our employee benefits include: Annual profit-related bonus 25 days holiday Employer pension contribution of 10% of salary Free, nutritious lunch in our on-site restaurant Private medical insurance for employees and dependants Enhanced family friendly leave Life insurance worth 6x salary Electric car leasing scheme Cycle to work scheme Season ticket loan An activities and community fund that supports healthy activities that bring colleagues together; whether it’s lunchtime squash or football, Zumba or our own rock band. Local sports facilities and theatre discounts and memberships Please click the following link to read the TTP Group Diversity Statement.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer (All Genders)
description: At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments. We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions. WHY JOIN US The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty. You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms. We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing. About The Team You will join an agile, multidisciplinary engineering team dedicated to bringing next-generation autonomous flight systems from concept to operational deployment. Working at the intersection of design engineering and manufacturing, our team collaborates daily with Stress, Systems, and Flight Test specialists to iterate at rapid pace. In this environment, you will bridge the gap between digital modeling and the factory floor, ensuring our platforms transition smoothly from initial prototypes into high-rate production. YOUR MISSION As a Mechanical Design Engineer at STARK, you will serve as a key contributor to the mechanical architecture of our next-generation UAV platforms. You will take critical subsystems from initial concept through to high-rate production, working closely with our manufacturing facilities to ensure our airframes are robust, cost-effective, and mission-ready. What You Will Do At Stark Own the mechanical design of major assemblies and payload integrations across current and future UAV platforms. Optimise designs for high-rate production to scale platforms seamlessly from prototype to hundreds of units without quality degradation. Apply advanced parametric modeling, GD&T, and tolerance stack-up analysis to ensure first-time-right assembly on the factory floor. Drive material selection, structural layouts, and manufacturing processes with an emphasis on composites, additive manufacturing, and machining. Collaborate with Stress, Flight Test, and Systems teams to validate structural integrity and support successful flight trials. Execute hands-on rapid prototyping, CAD iterations, and shop-floor troubleshooting to solve manufacturing bottlenecks at pace. What You Bring To The Mission Professional experience in mechanical design within aerospace, UAVs, automotive, light aircraft, or autonomous systems. Proven track record of taking structural parts and assemblies from initial sketch through verification and into full production. High proficiency in SolidWorks for complex 3D parametric modeling and drafting. Strong working knowledge of manufacturing processes, including composites, 3D printing, CNC machining, and injection moulding. Clear technical communication skills with the ability to articulate trade-offs to engineering peers and programme leadership. Eligibility for UK Security Clearance (SC). NICE TO HAVE Experience using CATIA for advanced surface modeling or aerospace assemblies. Familiarity with MIL standards and military/civil aerospace certification pathways. Armed Forces Commitment We are proud to hold the Bronze Award from the Defence Employer Recognition Scheme (ERS) , reflecting our meaningful commitment and ongoing support for UK defence personnel. At our core, we believe in championing those who serve, those who have served, and their families. As part of this scheme, we are dedicated to providing an inclusive, supportive environment where members of the Armed Forces community can thrive and bring their invaluable skills to our team. If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English . We're looking forward to meeting you! SECURITY CLEARANCE Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. title: Engineering Criticality Assessment Engineer
description: Contribute to the safe and reliable installation of offshore pipelines by defining acceptable weld flaw sizes and advancing weld integrity assessment methods. Allseas is a world-leading contractor in the offshore energy market. Our specialised vessels and advanced systems enable us to perform complex projects in some of the world’s most challenging offshore environments.For our Pipeline Production Department in Delft, we are looking for an Engineering Criticality Assessment Engineer, or ECA Engineer. The position is open to both early-career engineers and experienced specialists. Your role As ECA Engineer, you assess the structural integrity of pipeline girth welds for offshore installation projects. Using specialist ECA software and 3D modelling techniques, you calculate weld flaw acceptance criteria in line with international standards. You work with internal engineering teams and external parties to gather pipeline design, installation and material data. Based on this information, you define testing programmes for girth welds and pipeline materials. You also contribute to the development of welding techniques and improved weld integrity assessment methods through in-house studies and cooperation with external organisations. Your Responsibilities Perform Engineering Criticality Assessments for offshore pipeline installation projects; Calculate girth weld flaw acceptance criteria; Apply fracture mechanics principles and relevant international standards; Evaluate pipeline installation, post-lay design and material data; Define testing programmes for girth welds and linepipe materials; Translate assessment results into clear technical reports and recommendations; Coordinate technical requirements with internal and external stakeholders; Contribute to welding development and weld integrity research. What we expect from you Bsc or Msc in a relevant technical field Knowledge of welding metallurgy and fracture mechanics; Strong analytical skills and a practical approach; An accurate and structured way of working; Good communication skills and a customer-focused mindset; Fluency in written and spoken English; The ability to work independently and within a multidisciplinary team. Experience in Engineering Criticality Assessments, pipeline engineering, welding engineering, material testing or integrity assessment is an advantage. Motivated graduates with a relevant technical background are also encouraged to apply. What we Offer Working at Allseas means joining an entrepreneurial organisation where technical innovation, collaboration and a down-to-earth culture are central. You Can Expect A competitive, industry-benchmarked salary and pension; Performance-based salary increases and bonuses; 30 holiday days and flexible working hours; Training, development opportunities, study budgets and coaching; A company-sponsored fitness scheme; Internal clubs, social activities and sporting events. Interested? Would you like to apply your knowledge of welding metallurgy and fracture mechanics to challenging offshore pipeline projects? Apply via the Apply button and submit your CV and motivation letter. An online personality questionnaire may form part of the selection procedure.

title: Mechanical engineering- Research department

The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance. The Role As a Manufacturing Process Engineer at OLIX, you will be responsible for turning our optical interconnect technology for co-packaged optics (CPO) into scalable, manufacturable, and reliable hardware. You will work closely with our development team in London to establish high-throughput, high-yield manufacturing processes, then transfer those processes to our manufacturing partners and support them through ramp. This is a hands-on, high-impact role. The lines you build are how our optical interconnect reaches production. The role involves extensive travel (up to 50% of the time), including to our manufacturing partner sites. Responsibilities Establish and qualify robust, high-throughput, high-yield manufacturing lines for our optical interconnect technology Work with our manufacturing partners to establish high throughput, high yielding manufacturing lines and support those partners through qualification and volume ramp Specify, commission and qualify production equipment Develop new and improved manufacturing processes, and drive continuous improvement in throughput and yield Improve process capability through statistical process control Represent OLIX to the management, engineering and production teams at our manufacturing partners Collaborate across R&D, Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, Characterisation & Test and Production, within OLIX and at our partners, to hit project milestones Contribute to strategic IP development and patents Ensure compliance with site and factory protocols and safety regulations Skills & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or a related field Experience with process development in high-volume, high-technology manufacturing (e.g. semiconductors, electronics or display technologies), including New Product Introduction (NPI) and scaling to volume Experience working in controlled or cleanroom environments Proven track record of designing DoEs and executing structured experiments Experience applying statistical process control, yield improvement and throughput optimisation in production Ability to interpret complex experimental data, troubleshoot process issues and drive systematic improvements Excellent teamwork, documentation and communication skills Nice to Have Experience transferring processes to contract manufacturers or foundries Failure analysis experience Patent or IP contributions Compensation & Equity Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience, skills, and location Equity & Ownership: Meaningful stock options. You’re not just joining the mission; you’re owning a piece of it Proximity Bonus: We value your time. Werkzaamheden Als Mechanical Engineer ontwerp en werk je technische oplossingen uit voor onze klanten. Je voert inmeetwerkzaamheden uit bij de klant op locatie en vertaalt deze naar gedetailleerde technische tekeningen. Je werkt binnen de gestelde planning en zorgt voor een nauwkeurige uitwerking van de ontwerpen. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van verschillende disciplines om innovatieve en efficiënte oplossingen te realiseren die voldoen aan de specifieke wensen van de klant. Jouw profiel Je hebt een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding in de richting van Werktuigbouwkunde of Mechatronica. Je hebt ervaring met 3D CAD-ontwerp en het maken van technische tekeningen. Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed en bent in staat om technische vraagstukken op te lossen. Je bent communicatief sterk, werkt graag in teamverband en hebt een proactieve houding. Wat bieden wij jou? Een uitdagende functie van 32 tot 40 uur per week in een innovatieve werkomgeving waar je de ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt aan diverse projecten voor uiteenlopende klanten en draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van hoogwaardige technische oplossingen. Daarnaast bieden we een marktconform salaris, goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden en een prettige werksfeer binnen een hecht team van professionals. Klaar om jouw technische kennis in te zetten voor innovatieve machineontwerpen? Direct weten om welk bedrijf het gaat? Meld je gratis aan.

title: Junior Mechanical Engineer
description: Pozzuoli (Naples), Italy | Full-time | Primarily on-site Role Overview Join TSD-Space to design, integrate, and test precision mechanical components and assemblies for high-reliability electronic systems used in space missions. Working closely with experienced colleagues, you will contribute to the full mechanical hardware development lifecycle, from 3D CAD design and manufacturing documentation to supplier coordination, hands-on assembly, inspection, and testing. Who We Are Techno System Developments (TSD-Space) is an Italian aerospace electronics company specializing in the design, development, and manufacturing of high-reliability onboard and ground electronic systems. With flight heritage dating back to 1993, TSD-Space has contributed to over 50 space missions and accumulated more than 500,000 hours of flight operations. Today, our hardware is on eight currently operating space systems, spanning Earth-orbiting satellites, deep-space spacecraft and orbiters, and the International Space Station. Our expertise spans the complete payload data chain, from imaging and data acquisition to handling, compression, storage and onboard processing, together with spacecraft avionics and ground support equipment. We develop solutions for a broad range of applications, including Earth Observation, in-orbit servicing, navigation and inspection, and deep-space exploration. What You'll Do Mechanical design: Develop 3D CAD models of mechanical parts and assemblies, and prepare 2D manufacturing drawings with appropriate dimensions and tolerances. Manufacturing support: Prepare production documentation, support manufacturing activities, and coordinate technical matters with external suppliers. Assembly and integration: Assemble mechanical components and subassemblies, supporting the integration of electronic equipment. Prototype work: Perform light workshop operations, including drilling, tapping, minor milling, and threaded insert installation. Inspection and quality control: Verify manufactured parts against technical drawings and specifications, including dimensional inspections using measurement instruments. Testing and troubleshooting: Support mechanical, functional, and environmental tests, investigate issues, and contribute to corrective actions. Engineering support: Assist with structural and thermal analyses, and prepare technical documentation covering analysis, design, integration, and test activities. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering field. Solid understanding of mechanical design principles, engineering drawings, dimensional tolerances, and manufacturing requirements. Ability to develop 3D CAD models and produce accurate 2D technical drawings. Basic knowledge of mechanical materials, manufacturing processes, and measurement instruments. Practical aptitude and attention to detail when working with precision components and laboratory equipment. Ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams while taking responsibility for assigned tasks. Full professional fluency in Italian and English proficiency at B2 level or above (CEFR). Nice to Have Experience with SolidWorks or comparable parametric CAD software. Practical experience in mechanical assembly, prototyping, or workshop operations. Familiarity with dimensional inspection and quality control of manufactured components. Knowledge of structural or thermal analyses, including finite element analysis (FEA). Previous experience with high-reliability electronic equipment, aerospace hardware, or environmental testing. We welcome candidates who are eager to develop their skills through hands-on work and close collaboration with experienced engineers and technicians. Why Join TSD-Space At TSD-Space, you'll play an active role in demanding space missions, from Earth orbit to deep-space exploration, working side by side with experienced engineers and technicians to turn innovative designs into flight-ready hardware. Our focused, multidisciplinary teams give you the opportunity to: Experience the full development lifecycle: Gain exposure to projects from customer requirements and system design through manufacturing, integration, testing, and delivery. Grow through responsibility: Take on meaningful technical ownership early, with opportunities for career progression that reflect your contributions and increasing responsibilities. Engage with international stakeholders: Work on projects involving leading space agencies, international customers, and industrial partners, with opportunities for direct technical interaction. Keep growing: Develop well-rounded expertise in your field through hands-on engineering and exposure to a broad range of technical challenges. What We Offer Permanent employment: An open-ended employment contract under the applicable Italian National Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL Terziario). Competitive compensation: A competitive salary with a 14-month pay structure and an annual bonus based on individual and company performance. Flexible working arrangements: We value in-person collaboration, particularly for hands-on engineering activities, while offering flexible working hours and remote work arrangements depending on role requirements and project needs. Recruitment Process Our selection process typically includes two online interviews, one introductory and one technical, followed by a practical assessment, usually conducted on-site. The process may vary depending on the role. Apply Today Ready to contribute to the next generation of space systems? Apply directly through LinkedIn or send your CV to recruiting@tsd-space.it TSD-Space is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and inclusion, reject all forms of discrimination, and are committed to treating every candidate with fairness and respect. Applications are welcome from all qualified candidates, in accordance with applicable law.

title: Junior Mechanical Design Engineer (K/M/I)
description: Do zespołu R&D poszukujemy osoby na stanowisko Junior Mechanical Design Engineer , która chce rozwijać swoje kompetencje w obszarze projektowania mechanicznego, prototypowania oraz budowy i testowania urządzeń elektronicznych. Twoje zadania: Przygotowywanie rysunków technicznych, dokumentacji wykonawczej i montażowej oraz zestawień materiałowych (BOM). Modelowanie 3D prostych części mechanicznych i zespołów na podstawie specyfikacji technicznych. Modyfikowanie istniejących projektów, m.in. pod kątem nowych płytek PCB i złączy. Montaż mechaniczny prototypów i urządzeń elektronicznych, obejmujący obudowy, elementy mocujące, uszczelnienia i wiązki kablowe. Przygotowywanie prototypów do testów oraz udział w testowaniu urządzeń. Dokumentowanie problemów montażowych i wprowadzanie zmian konstrukcyjnych. Projektowanie i budowanie prostych stanowisk testowych, przyrządów oraz oprzyrządowania montażowego. Aktualizowanie dokumentacji technicznej i nadzorowanie jej zgodności z wprowadzanymi zmianami. Szukamy osoby, która: Posiada wykształcenie techniczne, np. z zakresu mechaniki i budowy maszyn, mechatroniki lub kierunków pokrewnych. Zna SolidWorks lub Fusion 360 i potrafi modelować części, tworzyć złożenia oraz rysunki techniczne. Potrafi czytać i interpretować dokumentację konstrukcyjną. Zna podstawowe technologie produkcyjne, takie jak obróbka CNC, obróbka blach czy druk 3D. Ma zdolności manualne i dobrze radzi sobie z pracami montażowymi oraz obsługą narzędzi warsztatowych. Jest dokładna, skrupulatna i dobrze zorganizowana. Posługuję się językiem angielskim w stopniu komunikatywnym. Dodatkowym atutem będzie: Doświadczenie z drukiem 3D (FDM/SLA). Znajomość zagadnień związanych z projektowaniem szczelnych obudów (IP67/IP68). Wiedza dotycząca połączeń odpornych na drgania. Znajomość narzędzi do zarządzania projektami, np. Jira.

You lead by listening and supporting your team, with at least five years of experience managing a team of fewer than 10 people. Designed to recycle long lived nuclear waste as fuel, our technology also advances a more circular nuclear fuel cycle. Having completed the conceptual design of our demonstrator reactor and secured the site for its deployment in Noord Holland, we are entering the next phase: detailed engineering, licensing, supply chain development and construction of our first of a kind reactor, paving the way for commercial deployment in Zeeland. We work alongside leading industrial partners including Orano, VDL Groep, Tractebel and EPZ. Our program has been selected by the European Commission and by the French government under the France 2030 investment plan, and is recognized by the Dutch government as a flagship innovation project strengthening the country's long term competitiveness. At Thorizon, we believe a strongly coupled multidisciplinary technology development requires a culture of full openness and transparency. That’s why we foster values like unity, communication, and support to ensure we grow together as a team while achieving our purpose.

title: PROJE VE ÜRETİM MÜHENDİSİ
description: PROJE VE ÜRETİM MÜHENDİSİ Firma: ON TRAILER Çalışma Yeri: Ankara / Başkent Organize Sanayi Bölgesi Çalışma Şekli: Tam Zamanlı – Fabrika / Ofis Pozisyon: Proje ve Üretim Mühendisi İş Tanımı Ankara Başkent Organize Sanayi Bölgesi'nde faaliyet gösteren, araç üstü ekipman, özel amaçlı mobil araç ve üstyapı sistemlerinin tasarım ve üretimini gerçekleştiren firmamız bünyesinde görevlendirilmek üzere; proje tasarımı, teknik çizim, üretim planlama ve üretim takibi süreçlerinde aktif rol alabilecek, en az 3 yıl deneyimli Proje ve Üretim Mühendisi arıyoruz. Adayın, projelerin teknik şartname aşamasından tasarım ve üretim süreçlerinin tamamlanmasına kadar olan çalışmaları takip edebilmesi beklenmektedir. Görev ve Sorumluluklar Proje ve Tasarım Süreçleri SolidWorks ve AutoCAD programlarını kullanarak 2D ve 3D teknik çizimler hazırlamak. Araç üstyapı sistemleri ve özel amaçlı mobil araç projelerinin tasarım çalışmalarını yürütmek. Üretime esas teknik resimleri, montaj çizimlerini ve imalat detaylarını hazırlamak. Teknik şartnameleri incelemek, şartname gerekliliklerine uygun proje ve tasarımlar oluşturmak. Projelere ait malzeme listelerini (BOM) ve teknik dokümantasyonları hazırlamak. Proje kapsamında ihtiyaç duyulan teknik hesaplamaları ve uygunluk kontrollerini gerçekleştirmek. Proje revizyonlarını yönetmek ve güncel teknik dokümanların üretime aktarılmasını sağlamak. Üretim ve İmalat Süreçleri Fabrika içerisindeki imalat ve montaj faaliyetlerinin teknik resimlere ve proje gerekliliklerine uygunluğunu kontrol etmek. Üretim aşamalarında ortaya çıkan teknik problemlere çözüm geliştirmek. Üretim personeliyle koordineli çalışarak işlerin planlanan takvime uygun ilerlemesini sağlamak. Proje bazında üretim ilerlemesini takip etmek ve yönetime düzenli durum raporları sunmak. Malzeme ihtiyaçlarını belirlemek ve satın alma birimiyle koordinasyon sağlamak. Üretim tamamlandığında gerekli teknik kontrolleri gerçekleştirmek ve teslimat süreçlerine teknik destek vermek. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği bölümünden mezun. Proje, tasarım veya üretim mühendisliği alanında en az 3 yıl mesleki deneyime sahip . SolidWorks ve AutoCAD programlarını aktif ve iyi derecede kullanabilen. Teknik resim hazırlama, okuma ve yorumlama konusunda yetkin. 3D modelleme, montaj tasarımı ve imalat detaylandırma süreçlerine hâkim. Teknik şartnameleri okuyabilen, yorumlayabilen ve şartnameye uygun proje geliştirebilen. Üretim planlama, imalat takibi ve üretim koordinasyonu konularında deneyimli. Malzeme bilgisi, temel imalat yöntemleri ve üretim süreçleri konusunda teknik bilgi sahibi. Proje dokümantasyonu, malzeme listesi ve teknik raporlama hazırlayabilen. Fabrika ortamında üretim ekipleriyle koordineli çalışabilecek. Problem çözme, planlama ve organizasyon becerileri gelişmiş. İş takibi kuvvetli, disiplinli, sorumluluk sahibi ve sonuç odaklı. Erkek adayların askerlik görevini tamamlamış olmak. Tercih Sebebi Olacak Deneyimler Aşağıdaki alanlarda proje, tasarım veya üretim tecrübesi bulunan adaylar değerlendirme sürecinde öncelikli olarak tercih edilecektir: Araç üstü ekipman ve ticari araç üstyapı projeleri. Frigorifik kasa ve soğutuculu araç üstyapı sistemleri. Mobil sağlık araçları, mobil klinikler, mobil laboratuvarlar ve özel amaçlı araç projeleri. Kapalı kasa, panelvan dönüşümü ve sandviç panel üstyapı sistemleri. Mobil yaşam alanları, özel üretim römorklar ve yarı römork projeleri. Çelik konstrüksiyon, sac metal, kompozit panel ve mekanik montaj uygulamaları. Sincan , Etimesgut, Elvankent bölgelerinde ikamet etmek Çalışma Koşulları Çalışma Yeri: Ankara / Başkent Organize Sanayi Bölgesi Çalışma Şekli: Tam zamanlı, yerinde çalışma Çalışma Saatleri: Pazartesi – Cuma, 08.00 – 18.00 Çalışma Ortamı: Proje ofisi ve fabrika üretim sahası Başvuru Araç üstü ekipman ve özel amaçlı mobil araç projelerinde tasarım ve üretim süreçlerinde sorumluluk almak isteyen, teknik bilgi ve tecrübesiyle ekibimize katkı sağlayabilecek mühendis adaylarının başvurularını bekliyoruz.
category_reasons: Örtüşen: SolidWorks, CAD / 3D modelleme, Teknik resim, AutoCAD

GENEL NİTELİKLER • Üniversitelerin Makine, Mekatronik Mühendisliği veya ilgili bölümlerinden ya da Teknik Eğitim / Teknoloji Fakültelerinin Makine Eğitimi bölümlerinden mezun (formasyonlu makine öğretmenleri dahil), • Makine/ekipman tasarımı alanında en az 3 yıl deneyimli, • SolidWorks ve AutoCAD programlarını ileri düzeyde kullanabilen, • SolidWorks PDM (veya benzeri PDM/PLM) sistemlerinde çalışmış, revizyon ve doküman yönetimine hâkim, • FEA/CFD analiz programları hakkında bilgi sahibi, • Teknik resim, GD&T ve imalat yöntemleri konusunda bilgili, • Isı transferi, termodinamik ve mukavemet konularında hesap yapabilen, • Literatür taraması, sektör ve teknoloji araştırması yapmayı seven, • Teknik doküman okuyabilecek ve yazışma yapabilecek düzeyde İngilizce bilen, • Yurt içi ve yurt dışı seyahat engeli bulunmayan, • Erkek adaylar için askerlik hizmetini tamamlamış veya muaf, • Araştırmaya ve yeni teknolojilere ilgi duyan, öğrenmeye açık, takım çalışmasına yatkın. TERCİH SEBEPLERİ • Döküm, ergitme fırını, ısıl işlem, hadde/ekstrüzyon veya makine imalatı alanında deneyim, • Ar-Ge veya tasarım merkezi projelerinde çalışmış olmak, • Anahtar teslim tesis / hat projelerinde saha ve devreye alma tecrübesi. İŞ TANIMI • Anahtar teslim döküm tesislerinin; proses makineleri ve yardımcı tesisleri ile birlikte bütünleşik tasarımını yapmak, • Yeni ürün ve teknolojiler için literatür, patent ve sektör/rakip araştırmaları yapmak, Ar-Ge projelerinde görev almak, • Isı transferi, soğutma sistemleri, enerji dengesi, refrakter ve yalıtım, mukavemet ve mekanizma hesaplarını yapmak, • Tasarımlar için FEA/CFD analizlerini gerçekleştirmek, • İmalat için teknik resim, montaj resmi, malzeme listesi (BOM) ve üretim dosyalarını hazırlamak, • Tasarım verilerini PDM üzerinde yönetmek, revizyon ve onay süreçlerini takip etmek, • İmalat, montaj, otomasyon ve satın alma birimleriyle koordineli çalışmak, • Prototip, test ve devreye alma süreçlerine katılmak, • Mevcut ürünlerde iyileştirme ve revizyon çalışmalarını yürütmek, • Ar-Ge ve tasarım merkezi proje dokümantasyonunu hazırlamak ve güncel tutmak. SUNDUKLARIMIZ • Uluslararası ölçekte, özgün döküm teknolojisi projelerinde yer alma fırsatı, • Tasarım merkezi kapsamında mesleki gelişim ve eğitim imkânı, • Deneyimli ve multidisipliner bir ekiple çalışma ortamı. BAŞVURU Özgeçmişinizi ve varsa tasarım/proje portfolyonuzu ilan üzerinden iletebilirsiniz. Başvurular gizlilik içinde değerlendirilecektir.
