title: Welding Engineer (Brazing Processes)
description: What You Will Do Lead the development, optimization, and standardization of brazing processes used in manufacturing operations. Support New Product Introduction (NPI) activities, including process design, validation, and production transfer. Investigate production and quality issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement sustainable corrective actions. Drive projects aimed at reducing scrap, rework costs, and process losses. Collaborate with product design teams to improve the reliability and manufacturability of brazed joints. Support continuous improvement initiatives and lean manufacturing projects across the factory. How You Will Do It Analyze process performance and identify opportunities to improve quality, productivity, and cost efficiency. Apply structured problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, Root Cause Analysis, and Kaizen. Develop and maintain process documentation, PFMEA, Control Plans, and process control strategies. Deliver process training and technical support to operators and technicians. Support the evaluation, installation, and commissioning of new manufacturing equipment. Ensure compliance with EHS and quality standards throughout all process improvement activities. What We Look For Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical & Materials Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Minimum 3 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, welding, brazing, or joining processes. Hands-on experience with brazing process development, validation, and production support. Knowledge of PFMEA, SPC, MSA, and Control Plan methodologies. Experience with structured problem-solving tools and continuous improvement practices. Strong analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Good command of English.

title: Mekanik Tasarım Mühendisi
description: Biz Kimiz? 1993 yılında kurulan Rönesans Holding, bugün Türkiye, Avrupa, Orta Asya ve Afrika’yı kapsayan geniş bir coğrafyada; inşaat, gayrimenkul, enerji, endüstri ve sağlık alanlarında ana müteahhit ve yatırımcı olarak faaliyet göstermektedir. 40.000’i aşkın çalışanı ve 60’tan fazla milletten oluşan güçlü ve çok kültürlü ekibiyle Rönesans, dünyanın en büyük müteahhitlik şirketleri arasında yer almakta; sürdürülebilir bir gelecek inşa etme vizyonuyla yenilikçi ve küresel ölçekteki mühendislik projelerini hayata geçirmeye devam etmektedir. Bu Rolde Seni Neler Bekliyor? Konsept tasarım aşamasından shop drawing ve asbuilt süreci sonuna kadar mekanik tesisat sistemlerinin Revit ortamında modellenmesi ve projelendirilmesi, Havalandırma, ısıtma, soğutma, sıhhi tesisat ve yangın tesisatı sistemlerine ilişkin uygulama projelerinin hazırlanması, Projelerin ilgili standartlar, işveren şartnameleri ve saha uygulama gerekliliklerine uygun olarak geliştirilmesi, Disiplinler arası koordinasyon süreçlerine destek verilmesi ve çakışma analizlerinin gerçekleştirilmesi, Genel proje koordinasyonunu etkileyebilecek teknik konuların ilgili ekiplerle paylaşılması ve gerekli çözüm önerilerinin sunulması, Şantiye ekipleri ile koordineli çalışarak uygulama süreçlerine teknik destek verilmesi. Adaylardan Beklentilerimiz Şirketimizin Ankara’da yapımını üstlendiği Veri Merkezi Projesi’nde değerlendirilmek üzere ; Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği bölümünden mezun, Alanında en az 3 yıl deneyimli, Üç boyutlu modelleme ve Yapı Bilgi Modellemesi (BIM) süreçlerine hakim, İleri seviyede Revit, Navisworks ve AutoCAD kullanabilen, Mekanik tesisat uygulama projeleri ve shop drawing hazırlama süreçlerinde deneyimli, Teknik çizim standartlarına, ölçülendirme ve proje dokümantasyon süreçlerine hakim, Tercihen büyük ölçekli altyapı ve üstyapı projelerinde (hastane, havaalanı, endüstriyel tesis, AVM vb.) görev almış, Navisworks Clash Detection süreçlerinde deneyimli, Ekip çalışmasına yatkın, çözüm odaklı ve analitik düşünme becerisine sahip, Planlama, takip ve dokümantasyon süreç becerileri gelişmiş, İleri seviyede İngilizce bilgisine sahip, Ankara’da ikamet eden veya edebilecek, “Mekanik Tasarım Mühendisi” aramaktayız. Biz Neler Sunuyoruz? Performans ve başarıyı destekleyen prim uygulamaları Kapsamlı yan haklar ve çalışan destek uygulamaları Özel Sağlık Sigortası kapsamında çalışanlarımızı destekleyen sağlık uygulamaları Mesleki ve kişisel gelişimini destekleyen eğitim ve gelişim programları Çeşitlilik ve Eşitlik Beyanımız Rönesans Holding, şirketlere stratejilerini ve operasyonlarını evrensel insan hakları, çalışma, çevre ve yolsuzlukla mücadele ilkelerine uygun hale getirmeye ve toplumsal hedefleri ilerletecek önlemler almaya çağıran BM Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi'nin imzacıları arasında yer almaktadır ve Birleşmiş Milletler Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi çerçevesinde evrensel kabul görmüş beyanlara dayalı ilkeleri benimser. Rönesans Holding, ana ilkeleri olan dürüstlük, rekabetçilik ve yenilikçilikten ödün vermeden şeffaf ve etik değerleri gözeterek insan kaynakları uygulamalarında eşitliği sağlamayı amaçlayan bir işverendir. Tüm başvurular cinsiyet, dil, din, ırk ve etnik kökene bakmaksızın fırsat eşitliğine göre değerlendirilir ve ayırımcılık yapılmaz.

title: İşletme Mühendisi
description: Aydem Enerji’de 40 yılı aşkın bir süredir ülkemizin sürdürülebilir geleceği için çevik, yenilikçi yaklaşımımızla elektrik üretimi, dağıtımı ve perakende alanlarında “hayat için enerji” üretiyor ve sektörümüzde imza attığımız pek çok ilkle fark yaratıyoruz. İşimizi “başarı” ile yaparak ve “hayata” dokunarak kurumu “geleceğe” taşırken, enerjimizin kaynağı olan çalışma arkadaşlarımız tarafından neden “Harika Bir İş Yeri” seçildiğimizi merak ediyorsan detaylara web sitemizden ve hakkında alanından ulaşabilirsin. Sen de bu ekibin bir parçası olmak istiyorsan Aydem Yenilenebilir Enerji A.Ş. bünyesinde bulunan Rüzgar, Hidroelektrik ve Hibrit GES Santrallerimizde çalışacak “İşletme Mühendisi” pozisyonunda görevlendirilmek üzere ilanımıza başvur, bizimle birlikte “enerji için biz” de. Senden neler bekliyoruz? Üniversitelerin Elektrik, Elektrik-Elektronik veya Makina Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, Tercihen Enerji üretim tesislerinin işletme ve bakım süreçlerinde 2–5 yıl deneyimli; RES ve/veya GES tecrübesine sahip, Rüzgâr türbinleri, güneş panelleri, inverterler ve yardımcı sistemlerin çalışma prensipleri hakkında bilgi sahibi, OG/YG sistemleri, güç transformatörleri, şalt ekipmanları ve koruma sistemleri konusunda temel teknik bilgiye sahip, SCADA üzerinden üretim, ekipman durumu ve alarm takibi yapabilen; işletme verilerini analiz edip raporlayabilen, Planlı bakım, arıza takibi ve kök neden analizi çalışmalarına katkı sağlayabilecek, Üretim kayıpları, duruş süreleri, emreamadelik ve santral performans göstergelerinin takibi konusunda bilgi sahibi, Teknik çizimleri, tek hat şemalarını ve ekipman dokümanlarını okuyup yorumlayabilen, Yüklenici ve servis ekipleriyle saha çalışmalarını koordine edebilecek, İş sağlığı ve güvenliği kurallarını benimseyen, saha çalışmalarında güvenli çalışma kültürünü gözeten, MS Office programlarını, özellikle Excel’i etkin kullanabilen; tercihen SAP PM veya benzeri bakım yönetim sistemlerinde deneyimli, Teknik dokümanları takip edebilecek düzeyde İngilizce bilgisine sahip, Analitik düşünme ve problem çözme becerileri gelişmiş, ekip çalışmasına yatkın ve sorumluluk sahibi, B sınıfı sürücü belgesine sahip ve aktif araç kullanabilen, Santral lokasyonunda ikamet eden veya edebilecek. Temel sorumlulukların neler olacak? Kayıp zaman ve kayıp enerji değerlerinde kalıcı bir azalma sağlamak, İşletme personelinin üretimde verimliliği esas alınmasını sağlayarak, olağanüstü işletme şartlarına karşı hazırlıklı olmasını sağlamak, İşletme giderlerini belirli bir bütçe dahilinde disiplin altına almak, Dışarıdan sağlanan fayda ve hizmetleri, rekabete dayalı objektif değerlendirme yaparak temin ve tedarik etmek için gerekli desteği sağlamak ve belirli limitler dahilinde satınalma işlemlerini yapmak. İşletme raporlamalarının amaçlarına uygun bir şekilde yapılmasını sağlamak, Tüm periyodik bakım ve onarımların gerçekleştirmesini sağlamak, İşletmenin her zaman (bakım çalışmaları dışında da) emre amade tutulmasını sağlamak. Bu şekilde kayıp zamanın minimize edilmesini ve kayıp enerjinin sıfırlanmasını sağlamak, Seninle enerjimiz nasıl tutar? Hayata dokunan duyarlı bakış açınla, Sorumluluk bilincinle, Dinamik oluşunla, Yenilikçi yaklaşımınla.
category_reasons: Örtüşen: Excel / Office, Kök neden analizi

description: 📢 Vardiya Mühendisi Arıyoruz! 1997 yılından bu yana ambalaj sektörünün öncü kuruluşu olarak, Konya 2. title: SENIOR DATACENTER FACILITIES ENGINEER
description: Turkcell olarak yeteneklerimize eşsiz insan deneyimi yaşatarak, değer yaratan sürdürülebilir bir organizasyon inşa etmeyi ve işveren markamızı zirveye taşımayı hedefliyoruz. Bu hedef doğrultusunda benimsediğimiz değerlerimizi iş yapış biçimlerimize yansıtıyoruz. Turkcell’de Neye Değer Veriyoruz? İnsan Odaklılık: Eşsiz insan deneyimi oluşturmak amacıyla uygulamalarımızın merkezinde insanı konumluyor, çalışanlarımızın potansiyelini en üst düzeye çıkarmayı ve onların yeteneklerini geliştirmeyi hedefliyoruz. Yenilik: İnsanların hayatında fark yaratan yenilikçi çözümler üretmek, fikir ve teknolojileri keşfetmek için tutkulu bir şekilde çalışıyoruz. 🚀 Mükemmellik: Dahil olduğumuz ve temas ettiğimiz her noktada mükemmeliyeti hedefliyor, kendimize yüksek standartlar belirliyor, olağanüstü sonuçlar elde ediyoruz. 🎯👌🏼 İş Birliği: Başarının anahtarı olarak birlikte çalışmayı, saygı ve şeffaflık kültürünü teşvik ediyoruz. 👥🔗🧩 Müşteri Odaklılık: Müşterilerimizin ihtiyaçlarını merkeze koyarak olağanüstü müşteri deneyimleri sunmayı hedefliyoruz. 🤝🖇️ Sürdürülebilirlik: Müşterilerimiz, çalışanlarımız ve dünyamız için sürdürülebilir bir gelecek amacıyla çalışıyoruz. 🌍 Ne Bekliyoruz? title: RME Technician (Mechanical) , Reliability Maintenance Engineering
description: Description The Maintenance Technician (Mechanical) plays a key role in ensuring the mechanical reliability and operational continuity of conveyor systems, material handling equipment, and rotating machinery within our IST2 Fulfillment Center. This position is responsible for performing preventive and corrective maintenance on a wide range of mechanical components including bearings, motors, gearboxes, belts, rollers, and conveyor systems. The technician will work closely with engineers and other RME teams to minimize equipment downtime and support continuous improvement initiatives. Key job responsibilities Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on conveyor systems, motors, gearboxes, reducers, belts, rollers, and bearings. Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical failures on material handling and rotating equipment. Execute planned maintenance tasks according to CMMS work orders and preventive maintenance schedules. Conduct bearing replacements, belt tensioning and alignment, roller and idler changes, and gearbox oil services. Perform motor coupling alignments, V-belt and chain drive maintenance, and shaft/seal replacements. Collaborate with engineers and other RME teams to support equipment upgrades and reliability improvement projects. Assist in root cause analysis for mechanical failures and develop corrective action plans. Document all work performed in the CMMS system, including parts used and time spent. Ensure compliance with safety policies, procedures, lockout/tagout (LOTO) standards, and mechanical safety practices. Basic Qualifications Technical Diploma in Mechanical , Industrial Maintenance, or related field. Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with industrial mechanical maintenance. Solid understanding of conveyor systems, power transmission components (bearings, gearboxes, couplings, belts, chains). Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings and schematics. Proficient in using hand tools, precision measurement tools (calipers, dial gauges), and alignment equipment. Knowledge of LOTO (Lockout/Tagout) procedures and mechanical safety standards. Willingness to work shifts, weekends, or on-call as needed. Preferred Qualifications Experience in high-volume manufacturing, logistics, or e-commerce fulfillment environments. Hands-on experience with conveyor belt systems, roller replacements, and sortation equipment. Knowledge of lubrication programs and bearing failure analysis. Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS). Experience with vibration analysis tools or basic condition monitoring techniques. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Mechanical engineer
description: As a Mechanical Engineer, you’re looking for a role where you can fully express your creativity and problem-solving skills. Ideally, you'd like to do this for an innovative company, one you can be proud of. At Teqram, we’re working on one of the biggest innovations in industrial automation: autonomous vision guided robots. Your Key Challenge as a Mechanical Engineer: Together with our other mechanical engineers, you will be responsible for quickly developing high-quality, mechatronic systems. We build standardized solutions which are highly configurable to customer specific use-cases. Most of our robots are used in the sheet metal and plate industry, so every solution you create must not only be functional but also robust. Your work starts with a problem that probably has not been solved before. On top of that there are challenging constraints and demands such as space, form-factor, cost, maintainability and durability. title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Food Machinery Manufacturing · Zeeland · Internationale projecten · Machine- en lijnontwikkeling · Tot €5.600 bruto per maand Introductie Wil jij niet alleen machines tekenen, maar écht begrijpen hoe ze werken en hoe ze onderdeel worden van een complete productielijn? Voor een internationaal opererende machinebouwer binnen food processing zoeken we een Mechanical Design Engineer die zich wil ontwikkelen binnen machine- en lijnontwikkeling. Je werkt aan klantspecifieke machines en complete productielijnen die wereldwijd worden gerealiseerd. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om technische vraagstukken zelf te onderzoeken, oplossingen te bedenken en steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Ervaring is welkom, maar technisch inzicht, nieuwsgierigheid en ontwikkelpotentieel zijn minstens zo belangrijk. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Je werkt aan zowel individuele machines als de manier waarop deze machines samen één goed functionerende productielijn vormen. Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van klantspecifieke machines en mechanische systemen. Uitwerken van concepten naar 3D-modellen, detailengineering en productietekeningen. Meedenken over de opbouw en inrichting van complete productielijnen. Ontwerpen van onder andere conveyors, frames, constructies en mechanische interfaces. Rekening houden met de operator: bediening, bereikbaarheid, onderhoud, veiligheid en praktische inzetbaarheid. Technische vraagstukken onderzoeken voordat je tot een oplossing komt: waarom is iets nodig en kan het slimmer? Afstemmen met klanten, collega-engineers, leveranciers en andere technische disciplines. Ondersteunen bij productie, assemblage, installatie en het oplossen van technische uitdagingen. Bestaande machines verbeteren en bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe equipment. Jouw ontwikkeling De engineeringorganisatie in Nederland wordt verder opgebouwd. Daardoor krijg je de kans om vanaf een vroeg stadium mee te groeien met de afdeling. Je kunt je ontwikkelen richting: zelfstandig machineontwerp; complete lijnontwikkeling; product development / R&D; technische projectverantwoordelijkheid; en op termijn eventueel een leidende rol binnen het engineeringteam. Je krijgt daarbij de mogelijkheid om kennis op te doen van ervaren engineers die wereldwijd food processing machines en productielijnen hebben ontwikkeld, gebouwd en opgestart. Als jij een kickstart aan jouw carrière in machinebouw wilt geven, is dit jouw kans. Bedrijfsprofiel Je komt terecht bij een internationale organisatie die machines, productielijnen en turnkey oplossingen ontwikkelt voor de voedingsmiddelenindustrie. Projecten lopen uiteen van individuele machines tot complete productielocaties en worden wereldwijd gerealiseerd. Binnen de Nederlandse organisatie wordt momenteel verder gebouwd aan een eigen product development- en engineeringteam. De ambitie is om steeds meer kennis rondom machine- en lijnontwikkeling lokaal op te bouwen. De cultuur is praktisch, ondernemend en informeel. Engineers krijgen vrijheid, maar er wordt ook verwacht dat je initiatief neemt, vragen stelt en verantwoordelijkheid pakt. Jouw profiel We zoeken vooral iemand met technisch potentieel en een praktische engineeringmentaliteit. Hbo- of wo-opleiding in Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar. Je bent starter of hebt enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen machinebouw, mechanical engineering of productontwikkeling. Ervaring met Inventor, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Solid Edge of vergelijkbare CAD-software. Je vindt het leuk om uit te zoeken waarom iets technisch op een bepaalde manier moet werken. Je denkt niet alleen aan het ontwerp, maar ook aan degene die de machine uiteindelijk moet bedienen en onderhouden. Je bent nieuwsgierig, praktisch ingesteld en niet bang om vragen te stellen. Ervaring binnen food processing, conveyors of productielijnen is mooi meegenomen, maar geen harde eis. Goede beheersing van het Engels. Je hoeft dus zeker niet alles al te kunnen. Belangrijker is dat je de ambitie hebt om machines écht te leren begrijpen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Aanbod Salaris passend bij jouw ervaring, tot circa €5.800 bruto per maand. 25 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen. Arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de cao Metaal & Techniek. Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid binnen je eigen projecten. Persoonlijke begeleiding en ruimte om technisch sterk door te groeien. Internationale projecten en de mogelijkheid om machines en productielijnen ook in de praktijk te zien. De kans om mee te bouwen aan een groeiende engineering- en product development-afdeling in Nederland. Interesse? Ben jij een engineer die niet alleen wil tekenen, maar vooral wil begrijpen, ontwikkelen en verbeteren? Vores filosofi er enkelt: Energi (varme og køling) skal flyttes – ikke genereres. Den energi, bygninger har brug for, findes allerede omkring dem. Den skal udnyttes bedre gennem lagring og flytning. Det gør vi hos Energy Machines! I Energy Machines bygger vi integrerede energisystemer, hvor varmepumper, geotermisk lagring, varmegenvinding og intelligent styring arbejder sammen som én maskine, og ét integreret system. Vi tager ansvaret hele vejen fra design til drift, og vores kunder kan vælge at eje vores løsninger eller få løsningerne som Energy-as-a-Service. Med over 120 gennemførte projekter har vi etableret os som en førende aktør for fremtidens energisystemer. Vores vision er, at alle bygninger kan blive energileverandører eller energimaskiner, og dermed bidrage aktivt til den grønne omstilling til brugen af mere bæredygtig energi. description: Är du någon som snabbt vill se resultatet av ditt arbete, följa projekten hela vägen och vara med när tekniska utmaningar blir färdiga produkter? Vi söker dig som uppskattar korta ledtider snarare än att lägga flera år på att ta fram en detalj i en större helhet. När ett kundanpassat fordon lämnar fabriken finns en god chans att det började som en idé på ditt skrivbord. Vem är du? Kanske är du ingenjör eller så har du byggt kompentens genom arbetserfarenhet, det viktigaste för oss är att du drivs av att hitta lösningar. Du trycker om att ta ansvar, fatta beslut och driva ditt arbete framåt. Samtidigt värdesätter du samarbete och vet att de bästa resultaten ofta skapas tillsammans. Vi ser att du har goda kunskaper i CATIA eller motsvarande konstruktionsverktyg samt en god förmåga att kommunicera på både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Vad kommer du att göra? Översätta kundens behov till tekniska lösningar Utveckla och konstruera i 3D-CAD Koordinera utveckling mellan olika tekniska discipliner Lösa utmaningar tillsammans med produktion, kollegor och kunder Följa din konstruktion hela vägen ut i verkligheten Du blir en del av ett prestigelöst team med bred teknisk kompetens, högt tempo och stort leveransfokus. Här hjälps vi åt, utmanar varandra och har kul på vägen. Därför väljer många att stanna hos oss På Toyota Material Handling Europe får du möjlighet att utvecklas i en trygg och framtidsorienterad organisation. Vi tror på kraften i samarbete och arbetar aktivt för att skapa en arbetsplats där alla känner sig välkomna, respekterade och delaktiga. Vi erbjuder flexibla arbetssätt med flextid och möjlighet till distansarbete när verksamheten och rollen möjliggör det. Utöver detta får du tillgång till gym, gruppträning och friskvårdsbidrag samt ett omfattande förmånspaket med bland annat försäkringar, bonus, föräldralön och löneväxling. Toyota Material Handling Europe är världsledande inom materialhantering och vi gör stora investeringar för att möta framtidens behov. På vår site i Mjölby arbetar 3 000 medarbetare med materialhantering från utvecklingskoncept till producerat fordon. Vår produktrange går från manuella handtruckar till självkörande fordon och innovativa energilösningar. Vill du vara med och bygga framtidens lösning? Välkommen med din ansökan! title: Mechanical Design Engineer - Production Machines, Lund
description: Job Title Mechanical Design Engineer - Production Machines, Lund Job Description We are looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to join the Machine Mechanics team within Production Systems Hardware, part of the Production Engineering & Technologies department at Axis in Lund. In this role, you will design robust, cost-efficient mechanical solutions for the unique test and production systems used to manufacture Axis products. Who is your future team? At Production Systems Hardware, we develop the hardware for the machines that manufacture Axis products. We take solutions from initial concept all the way to fully tested and verified production equipment. The Machine Mechanics team consists of four dedicated mechanical engineers who specialize in developing mechanical parts for the production systems used on Axis production lines. What You'll Do Here As Mechanical Design Engineer In the Machine Mechanics team, you will design, develop and deliver high-quality, robust and cost-efficient mechanical solutions for Axis' unique test and production systems. You will work from concept to verified product in cross-functional projects. The role involves a wide range of interfaces and gives you the opportunity to build knowledge across different technology areas. In this role, you will: Design, develop and improve mechanical solutions using the Creo 3D CAD system and the Windchill PDM system Take an active part in development projects, with a focus on simplicity, scalability, repeatability and quality, to create the best possible production setup for Axis products Work from concept to verified product in cross-functional projects The role may include travel, mainly to our contract manufacturers around the world, for approximately 15 days a year. Who are you? You are structured and driven, with a natural commitment to seeing your deliverables through to completion. You enjoy working cross-functionally, you have an open mindset, and you help build a creative environment around you. If that sounds like you, we believe this is the place for you. We'd love to hear that you have: A bachelor's degree or higher in mechanical engineering At least 2 years' relevant experience of product development Experience of 3D CAD, ideally Creo Experience of 3D printing and of designing parts specifically for 3D printing Very good communication skills in English Communication skills in Swedish Bonus points if you have any combination of: Design experience from mechatronics and automation Experience of designing and producing moving mechanics, and of designing aluminum parts for CNC machining International production experience, or experience of developing production equipment Experience of optics or metrology What Axis Has To Offer We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you’ll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance — developing solutions used worldwide. As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You’ll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance. Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal “fika” chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities. Check it out: Axis HQ Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance — and even your own Axis bicycle. To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore: Axis Career Hub Life at Axis blog Engineering at Axis blog Innovation at Axis Ready to Act? Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications. We go through applications continuously so don’t wait – send in your application today! In case of questions, please reach out to recruiting manager Sofie Månsson at Sofie.Mansson@axis.com This recruitment is handled solely by Axis Communications AB, and we politely but firmly decline all calls from recruitment and consulting companies. Type of Employment Permanent Employment Posting End Date 2026-11-17 Certain roles at Axis require background checks, which means applicable verifications will be done in these recruitments. Notice will be provided before we take any action. About Axis Communications We enable a smarter and safer world by creating innovative solutions for improving security and business performance. As a network technology company and industry leader, we offer solutions in video surveillance, access control, intercom, and audio systems, enhanced by intelligent analytics applications. With around 6,000 committed employees in over 50 countries, we collaborate with partners worldwide. Together, we thrive in our friendly, open, and collaborative culture and inspire each other to think beyond the expected. United by our commitment to inclusion, diversity, and sustainability, we consistently seek to develop our skills and way of working. title: Erfaren mekanikkonstruktör till pumptillverkning
location: Östra Göinge kommun, Skåne ili, İsveç
description: Om företaget W. Ruberg är ett svenskt industriföretag med en lång och gedigen historia som sträcker sig tillbaka till 1932. Från anläggningen i Immeln utvecklar och tillverkar vi brandpumpar, nödkylningspumpar, skumsystem, vatten- och skumkanoner som används i moderna brandbekämpningsfordon. Med lång erfarenhet, hög teknisk kompetens och ett starkt fokus på kvalitet har W. Ruberg etablerat sig på en internationell marknad och levererar produkter till kunder i flera länder. Trots sin globala närvaro är W. Ruberg ett mindre och familjärt företag, där cirka 20 medarbetare arbetar tillsammans i en modern produktionsmiljö. Vi söker nu en erfaren konstruktör som bor i närområdet. I denna rekrytering samarbetar vi med Wikan Personal. Dina arbetsuppgifter Som konstruktör hos oss får du en bred, varierad och utvecklande roll där du får stor frihet att planera ditt arbete och möjlighet att ta ett stort ansvar. Du blir en viktig del av våra projekt och får vara med hela vägen – från idé och konstruktion till färdig produkt. Du arbetar med att ta fram bearbetningsritningar, outlineritningar och sprängskisser samt konstruerar kundanpassade pumpar, större pumpaggregat, skumsystem och kringutrustning såsom hydraul- och växellådsdrivningar. Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat layoutarbete, konstruktion och teknisk dokumentation i olika projekt. Du kommer in tidigt i projekten och arbetar parallellt med flera olika applikationer, vilket ger dig en omväxlande vardag med många tekniska utmaningar. Som en del av rollen arbetar du i Autodesk Inventor och hanterar även projektadministration i vårt affärssystem Monitor. Du arbetar nära din konstruktörskollega och utvecklingsavdelningen, vilket ger goda möjligheter att utbyta kunskap och utvecklas tillsammans. För rätt person finns dessutom goda möjligheter att växa med rollen och ta ett större ansvar över tid. Din bakgrund/Dina egenskaper Vi söker dig som har minst gymnasieutbildning med inriktning mot maskinteknik och som har byggt på din kompetens genom några års erfarenhet av konstruktionsarbete. Erfarenhet av CAD är ett krav, och du har en god teknisk förståelse och ett genuint intresse för hur konstruktioner fungerar i praktiken. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet från tillverkande industri och har arbetat nära produktion eller verkstad, gärna i en mindre organisation där du fått ta ett brett ansvar. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av pumpkonstruktion eller arbete med gjutmodeller. Du har goda kunskaper i Officepaketet och behärskar svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift. För oss är din personlighet viktig. Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för teknik, konstruktion och produktion och som trivs i en miljö där du får vara delaktig, påverka och ta ansvar. Du är självgående, social och lösningsorienterad, samtidigt som du är noggrann och strukturerad i ditt arbete. Du har ett kostnadsmedvetet förhållningssätt och förstår vikten av att hitta smarta och effektiva lösningar utan att kompromissa med kvaliteten. Framför allt är du en person som tar ansvar, gillar att utvecklas och trivs med att se dina konstruktioner gå från idé till verklig produkt. Information och kontakt Tjänstgöringsort är Immeln och vi har en stark närvarokultur, vilket kräver att du har B körkort och tillgång till bil. Vi ser därför att du har maximalt 45 minuters pendling. Tjänsten är på 100 % och du kommer att jobba dagtid. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning hos W. Ruberg. Välkommen med din ansökan senast 6 november via Wikans hemsida www.wikan.se . För mer info kontakta rekryteringskonsult Sara Kvist på telefon 044-590 65 12. Välkommen med din ansökan! Om Wikan Personal Wikan Personals verksamhet är grundad på närhet och engagemang för att alltid kunna tillgodose bra service till våra kunder och anställda. Vi är djupt övertygade om att lokal förankring, långsiktiga kundrelationer och kompetenta medarbetare är nyckeln till framgångsrika samarbeten inom rekryterings- och bemanningsbranschen. Med närvaro på 17 orter i Sverige, en omsättning på cirka 400 miljoner kronor och omkring 700 engagerade anställda, strävar vi efter att vara en pålitlig samarbetspartner. Läs mer på www.wikan.se

title: Tooling & Equipment Mechanical Engineer
description: At Tata Technologies we make product development dreams a reality by designing, engineering and validating the products of tomorrow for the world’s leading manufacturers. Due to our continued growth, we are now recruiting for a Tooling & Equipment Mechanical Engineer strengthen our team in Gothenburg, Sweden. The role This assignment is within Manufacturing Engineering and supports the industrialization of advanced High Voltage Battery Assembly systems for Battery Electric Vehicles. The work is performed in a cross-functional engineering environment covering manufacturing processes, automated production equipment, product-to-process interfaces, quality assurance and supplier collaboration. The consultant will lead mechanical development and assurance of production equipment, tooling, fixtures, nests, grippers and handling solutions used in automated High Voltage Battery Assembly. The focus is on robust mechanical design, equipment interfaces, supplier execution and production readiness. Responsibilities Develop and review mechanical concepts for production stations, tooling, fixtures, nests, grippers and handling devices. Convert process, product, geometry, safety, maintainability and cycle-time needs into technical equipment requirements. Review supplier layouts, 3D concepts, detailed designs, calculations, drawings and interface definitions. Secure access, ergonomics, serviceability, changeover, error-proofing and replacement-part strategy. Coordinate mechanical interfaces with automation, robotics, controls, utilities, process equipment and facilities. Support RFQ, supplier selection, design reviews, manufacturing follow-up, buy-off, installation and commissioning. Drive mechanical risk assessments, tolerance reviews and technical issue resolution. Support equipment acceptance and handover with documented deviations and remaining actions. Approve tooling and mechanical equipment concepts. Technical mechanical requirements and interface specification. Documented supplier design reviews and action tracking. Mechanical risk assessment and mitigation plan. Buy-off, installation and commissioning support documentation. Equipment acceptance and handover package. Required Competencies Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline, or equivalent demonstrated professional experience relevant to the assignment. Senior-level industrialization experience in automotive, battery manufacturing, electrification or comparable high-volume automated production. Automated production equipment and tooling development Mechanical design review using 3D CAD and engineering drawings Equipment supplier development from concept through commissioning Machine safety, maintainability, ergonomics and tolerance engineering High-volume automated manufacturing industrialization Preferred Competencies High Voltage Battery Assembly equipment experience. Precision handling, joining fixtures, grippers, conveyors or pallet systems. CATIA, Teamcenter or equivalent CAD/PLM tools. CE conformity, machinery risk assessment and equipment acceptance. If you are passionate about bringing innovation to the projects you work on and want to join a global company, then this is the place for you. Tata Technologies: Engineering a better world. Tata Technologies would like to thank all applicants for their interest; each application will be reviewed against the set criteria for the role. We would like to advise that only candidates under consideration will be contacted. If you do not hear from us within 10 working days following the closing date, it will mean that unfortunately your application has not been successful. We will however retain your details for any suitable future opportunities.

title: Structural Engineer - Heavy Lift
description: The Heavy Lift department is responsible for the concept, basic and detailed engineering phases of topside and jacket installations and removals of up to 60,000 tonnes for both the oil & gas and renewables industries. The department brings together a creative, multidisciplinary team of Heavy Lift Engineers, Structural Engineers, Naval Engineers and Draftsmen. Our agile teams perform all engineering and feasibility analyses required for the safe and efficient execution of projects by Allseas’ heavy lift fleet. With the North Sea rapidly transforming, driven by large-scale decommissioning of aging oil and gas platforms and the expansion of offshore wind farms, Allseas is uniquely positioned to lead this new era. Our flagship vessel, Pioneering Spirit , the world’s most powerful heavy lift and construction vessel, can remove or install entire platforms in a single lift, setting new standards for safety, speed and sustainability. Since 2016, the department has contributed to a total lifted weight of 330,000 tonnes, with a record-breaking 123,000 tonnes in 2022. With an order book of more than 30 assets, Allseas continues to drive the transition of offshore infrastructure in the North Sea and beyond. Your role As a Structural Engineer, you can be involved in all stages structural scope within your projects, from concept design and detailed calculations to offshore support . You will contribute to the engineering work for single-lift platform installations and removals executed by Pioneering Spirit , ensuring that all designs, analyses and procedures meet the highest technical and safety standards.You will be a key point of contact for both internal teams and external stakeholders. We’re looking for a technically strong, results-driven professional who combines deep analytical ability with practical, hands-on insight. Someone who thrives in a collaborative environment, and are motivated by the challenge of pushing the boundaries of heavy lift engineering. Job Specific Tasks You define methodologies, priorities and progress, ensuring quality and efficiency; You perform and validate design studies, calculations and simulations for complex structures; You develop procedures for the use and testing of installation or removal aids, and align outcomes with project and offshore teams; You review subcontractor designs and methods, ensuring alignment with project goals and standards; You support offshore operations and troubleshoot during execution when required; You prepare input for engineering close-out reports and lessons learned; You contribute to the continuous improvement of departmental standards and working methods. What we expect from you In order to be a fit for this job, you should largly recognize yourself in the following criteria: You hold a BSc / MSc degree in Civil, Mechanical or Structural Engineering (or equivalent), preferably with a specialisation in Maritime and Offshore Preferably, you already have a few years of relevant experience in Structural Enigneering in an industry relevant environmen You can think on an abstract level as well as translate analysis to practical solutions You are proficient with structural engineering software (preferably FEMAP and GeniE) or eagerness to expand your expertise; You are fluent in English and comfortable working in and English environment; Dutch is a plus; Occationally, you are willing to travel offshore to one of our vessels; Affinity with offshore and/or marine environments is a huge asset What we Offer Working at Allseas means joining a pioneering team that’s shaping the future of offshore energy. You’ll work in a dynamic, fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment where innovation, teamwork and hands-on problem-solving are at the core of everything we do. Our flat structure and open culture give you the freedom to take initiative, lead projects and make a real impact. Apart From That, You Can Count On A competitive, industry-benchmarked salary and excellent pension scheme; Performance-based salary increases and annual bonuses; 30 holiday days per year and flexible working hours (start between 7:00 and 10:00); Extensive training and development opportunities, including study budgets and coaching; A company-sponsored fitness and wellbeing programme; Internal clubs, social events and sports activities that bring colleagues together. Ready to take on the challenge? Apply today and help us shape the future of offshore engineering!

title: Mechanical Engineer (Machinebouw)
description: NB: For this role we can only consider candidates who speak Dutch at a professional level (B2 to C2). Ben jij een vindingrijke engineer die niet alleen achter een scherm wil zitten, maar zijn eigen ontwerpen ook echt tot leven wil zien komen? In deze rol krijg je de unieke kans om het hele proces te overzien: van concept en constructieve berekeningen tot de assemblage van werkende prototypes en validatie in het veld. Over de organisatie en jouw rol Je komt te werken bij een toonaangevend en innovatief hightech bedrijf dat gespecialiseerde meet-, sensor- en navigatiesystemen ontwikkelt voor complexe industriële toepassingen. Binnen het multidisciplinaire R&D-team worden geavanceerde mechatronische systemen, embedded elektronica en compacte, robuuste behuizingen volledig in-house ontwikkeld. Als Mechanical Engineer ontwerp je maatwerk tooling en behuizingen die moeten presteren onder zware operationele omstandigheden en dynamische rotatiekrachten. Je bent hier geen nummertje dat alleen 3D-modellen doortikt; je bent een allround productontwikkelaar die actief meebouwt in de werkplaats en meegaat tijdens pilotfases om te zien hoe jouw innovaties in de praktijk functioneren. Wat ga je doen? Constructief Ontwerp & Packaging: Je ontwerpt specialistische mechanische tools en compacte behuizingen in SolidWorks, rekening houdend met strenge fysische randvoorwaarden zoals warmtehuishouding, magnetische velden en lekstromen. Berekenen & Simuleren: Je voert zowel sterkte- als warmteberekeningen (thermal management) uit om te garanderen dat roterende componenten en behuizingen bestand zijn tegen wrijvingswarmte, hoge druk, trillingen en dynamische spanningen. Prototypebouw & Montage: Zodra de uitbestede componenten en onderdelen binnenkomen, stroop je je mouwen op en help je actief mee met de montage en de samenbouw van de prototypes. Testen & Veldvalidatie: Je test de tooling uitvoerig in de werkplaats én gaat tijdens pilotfases mee naar externe test- en klantlocaties om de systemen in actie te valideren. Multidisciplinair Sparren: Je stemt nauw af met embedded software- en elektrotechnisch engineers om mechanica en hoogwaardige sensortechnologie naadloos te integreren. Wat breng je mee? Opleiding: Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Werktuigbouwkunde of Mechatronica. Ervaring: Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen productontwikkeling, R&D of machinebouw. CAD & Berekeningen: Grondige ervaring met SolidWorks en het uitvoeren van constructieve sterkte- en warmteberekeningen (FEM / Thermal analysis). Hands-on Mentaliteit: Twee rechterhanden; je sleutelt graag mee aan prototypes en stapt met plezier het veld in voor praktijktests. Locatie & Woonregio: Je bent woonachtig in de Randstad, idealiter in (de omgeving van) Utrecht. Communicatie & Taal: Een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal op professioneel niveau is essentieel; daarnaast spreek je goed Engels. Wat bieden wij? Een salaris tot maximaal € 5.300,- bruto per maand (afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring). Je kunt kiezen uit een fulltime (40 uur) dienstverband, of parttime (32 uur) 30 vakantiedagen en een reiskostenvergoeding a 0.25ct per kilometer is ook onderdeel van het pakket. Je gaat werken met hoogwaardige sensortechnologie en geavanceerde systemen die vooroplopen in de markt. Je krijgt maximale afwisseling: van high-end engineering en werkplaatsmontage tot veldtests bij klanten. Klinkt dit interessant? title: Starter Scientist in Ship Design of Future

The transition to new energy sources for ship propulsion, including hydrogen-based fuels and nuclear energy, presents major engineering challenges. How do ships and offshore systems perform under these new operating conditions? How can regulations be developed to enable their safe introduction? title: Mechanical Integrity Engineer
description: As a Mechanical Integrity Engineer, you will assess whether critical gas turbine components can operate safely and reliably throughout their intended service life. You will carry out detailed stress, thermal and dynamic analysis of components including turbine blades, vanes, rotors and casings, supporting both new product development and upgrades to existing turbine designs. Based in Lincoln, you will join the Turbine Engineering function and work closely with Mechanical Design, Heat Transfer, Materials and test teams. You will use engineering analysis, test data and operational experience from the global fleet to understand component behaviour in demanding high-temperature operating conditions. How You’ll Make An Impact Perform static, transient, linear and non-linear thermal and thermomechanical finite element analysis of gas turbine components, including blades, vanes, rotors and casings. Complete static and dynamic stress analysis, producing component life assessments for high-cycle fatigue, low-cycle fatigue, thermo-mechanical fatigue and creep. Partner with Mechanical Design and Heat Transfer teams to establish component life against operating duty cycles and required life targets. Support new product and upgrade programmes by analysing and adapting component designs, using root cause analysis, weighted decision analysis and design of experiments where needed. Define component and engine test requirements, then calibrate structural models using engine test data and operational fleet experience. Produce technical reports, presentations and method documents, while supporting analysis tool-chain improvements, software validation and the development of more effective engineering methods. What You Bring A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with significant mechanical or structural design content, ideally in aerospace, automotive, power generation turbomachinery or materials science, or equivalent verified vocational experience. At least two years’ professional experience in finite element stress analysis and component life calculation. A sound understanding of stress theory, material behaviour and high-temperature failure mechanisms under cyclic and steady operating conditions. Knowledge of component stress analysis, dynamic analysis and lifing methods, including fatigue and creep assessment. Experience using finite element analysis and pre- and post-processing software, ideally Abaqus. Experience with ANSYS, NX Simcenter, Nastran or RR SC03 would also be relevant. The ability to validate and challenge analysis results using simplified one-dimensional methods and hand calculations, alongside effective communication skills for multidisciplinary working. About The Team Our Gas Services division offers low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. We bring together gas turbines, steam turbines, generators and digital service solutions under one roof. Through modernization, digitalization and innovative service offerings, we support customers worldwide in improving reliability, efficiency and sustainability. You will join the Turbine Engineering function in Lincoln, supporting the structural integrity and durability of gas turbine components throughout product development, upgrades and operational life. The team brings together mechanical design, heat transfer, materials, testing and fleet experience to understand how turbine parts behave in high-temperature service and ensure they achieve the required safety, reliability and lifespan. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fuelled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character, no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits 26 days holiday, increasing to 29 days with time served. Access to a flexible benefits portal, including private medical cover and cycle-to-work schemes. A class-leading adjustable pension scheme. Career development and continuous learning opportunities. The opportunity to develop specialist expertise in gas turbine structural integrity, high-temperature material behaviour and advanced engineering analysis methods.

title: Graduate Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. Hiring now We are hiring as soon as possible. This role is for someone who has already graduated, or who will complete their degree in time to start with us very soon. We are not able to consider final-year students who graduate in summer 2027 or later, and this is not a graduate scheme with a fixed annual intake. Role Overview This is a first full-time engineering role on the NEO-1 satellite. You will design satellite hardware and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised as the design matures, learning from our lead designer and working in a small, multidisciplinary team. You will take ownership of real parts early, translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing. Key Responsibilities Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, such as brackets, panels, component mounts, thermal-control hardware and cable and harness routing, with guidance from the lead designer. Work in the satellite's large 3D CAD assembly alongside the wider design team, learning how to keep interfaces, configurations and revisions in step as several designers work in the same model. Support assembly configuration, PLM data (3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX') or similar), bills of materials and engineering change control (ECO/ECR/ECN), so that models, drawings and interfaces stay consistent as changes are released. Run interference and clash checks and help maintain the digital mock-up, working with each subsystem owner to allocate space and resolve conflicts. Produce dimensioned, manufacturing-ready drawings using GD&T, with review from senior engineers. Support design reviews (PDR and CDR) and qualification, working with structural and thermal engineers. Work with manufacturers and suppliers to make designs easier to build, and to balance cost, mass and reliability. Support prototype builds, integration and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results. Collaborate with electrical, software, systems and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform. Required Skills & Experience Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical, aerospace or a related engineering discipline, completed or completing very soon. Hands-on 3D CAD skills from university projects, a placement or an internship (SolidWorks preferred; CATIA, NX or Creo also considered). Working knowledge of GD&T and experience producing engineering drawings, including from coursework or a team project. Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials and thermal management, with a working understanding of structural mechanics. Evidence of designing, building and testing something real, such as a placement project, Formula Student, a UAV, or a rocketry or satellite team, including troubleshooting and iteration. Clear communicator who is comfortable explaining and defending design decisions, and open to feedback and challenge in a fast-moving team. Preferred Experience A placement, internship or year in industry in aerospace, space, motorsport or another high-reliability field. Experience of several people working in one CAD assembly, for example in a Formula Student or university team, including how files and revisions were controlled. Exposure to PLM or PDM systems (for example 3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX'), Windchill, Teamcenter, ENOVIA or SolidWorks PDM) or to formal engineering change processes (ECO/ECR/ECN). Experience of design reviews, documented requirements and standards. Satellite, CubeSat or rocketry project experience, including hardware that has launched. Basic FEA familiarity and exposure to manufacturing processes. Why NewOrbit Space? Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO. Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology. Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success. Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups. Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week. Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

title: Medior R&D Engineer Machinebouw
description: Wil jij jouw engineeringervaring inzetten voor de ontwikkeling van innovatieve machines? Als Medior R&D Engineer Machinebouw werk je zelfstandig aan technische concepten, prototypes en verbeteringen. Je krijgt verantwoordelijkheid over uitdagende ontwikkelvraagstukken en ziet jouw ideeën terug in werkende oplossingen. Wat ga je doen? Als Medior R&D Engineer Machinebouw werk je voor onze opdrachtgever aan de ontwikkeling en verbetering van machines, modules en technische systemen. Je vertaalt technische eisen en vraagstukken naar slimme concepten en werkt deze uit tot een betrouwbaar en maakbaar ontwerp. Met 3D CAD-software ontwikkel je constructies en beoordeel je onder andere materiaalkeuzes, toleranties en componenten. Je voert technische berekeningen uit en onderbouwt zelfstandig belangrijke ontwerpkeuzes. Daarbij houd je rekening met prestaties, kosten, kwaliteit en maakbaarheid. Binnen R&D ben je betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkeltraject: van conceptontwikkeling en engineering tot prototyping en testen. Je stelt testplannen op, analyseert resultaten en vertaalt deze naar concrete ontwerpverbeteringen. Technische knelpunten onderzoek je zelfstandig en je bespreekt mogelijke oplossingen met specialisten binnen Engineering en Manufacturing. Ook draag je bij aan design reviews en bewaak je technische specificaties tijdens het ontwikkelproces. Met jouw ervaring lever je zo een belangrijke bijdrage aan nieuwe machines en aan de verdere ontwikkeling van bestaande technologie. Jouw werkzaamheden Ontwikkelen en uitwerken van nieuwe machineconcepten, modules en mechanische constructies; Zelfstandig maken en beoordelen van 3D CAD-modellen en technische tekeningen; Uitvoeren van technische berekeningen en onderbouwen van ontwerpkeuzes; Opstellen en uitvoeren van testplannen voor prototypes en nieuwe technische oplossingen; Analyseren van testresultaten en doorvoeren van verbeteringen in het ontwerp; Beoordelen van materialen, componenten, toleranties en productietechnieken; Deelnemen aan design reviews en bewaken van technische specificaties; Oplossen van complexe technische vraagstukken tijdens ontwikkeling en productie; Afstemmen met Engineering en Manufacturing over maakbaarheid, kwaliteit en technische haalbaarheid. Wat heb jij in huis? Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar; Enkele jaren relevante werkervaring binnen R&D, mechanical engineering, productontwikkeling of machinebouw; Ruime ervaring met 3D CAD-software en het uitwerken van technische ontwerpen; Goede kennis van mechanica, materiaalkunde, constructieleer en productietechnieken; Ervaring met prototyping, testen en het analyseren van technische resultaten; Een zelfstandige en analytische werkwijze waarmee je complexe technische vraagstukken omzet in praktische oplossingen. Er is veel ruimte voor technische ontwikkeling, nieuwe ideeën en het verbeteren van bestaande oplossingen. Je krijgt verantwoordelijkheid over uitdagende projecten en ziet jouw ontwerpen uiteindelijk terug in de praktijk. Werken bij Evoke Je gaat via Evoke aan de slag in deze functie. Na een tijdje kun je in dienst bij onze partner, als je wil. Of je begint aan een nieuw uitdagend project via ons netwerk. Wij doen er alles aan om onze mensen op dé werkplek te krijgen. Jouw persoonlijke Career Coach is specialist binnen de sector en samen brengen jullie jouw wensen in kaart. Door écht te luisteren, maken zij steeds de juiste connectie voor jou. Ondertussen bieden wij je alle voordelen als jouw werkgever en Carrière Coach. Zoals een goed salaris, jaarlijks studiebudget en groen pensioen. title: Ingénieur R&D/Conception Mécanique
description: Notre client est une PME industrielle à taille humaine, spécialisée dans la conception et la fabrication de machines spéciales et d'équipements industriels sur mesure. Elle accompagne des industriels issus de secteurs variés dans la définition de solutions adaptées à leurs contraintes de production et à leurs process. Les projets sont réalisés sur mesure et associent conception mécanique, dimensionnement, fabrication et mise en service des équipements. Intégrée à un environnement international, l'entreprise s'appuie sur un savoir-faire technique reconnu tout en conservant une organisation locale agile, avec des équipes proches des clients et des projets. Dans un contexte de développement de son activité, elle souhaite aujourd'hui renforcer son Bureau d'Études situé à proximité d'Angoulême. POSTE / MISSIONS Optima recrute pour le compte d'une PME industrielle à taille humaine, spécialisée dans la conception et la fabrication de machines spéciales et d'équipements industriels sur mesure, un Ingénieur R&D / Conception Mécanique Senior (H/F). Dans un contexte de développement de l'activité et de renforcement du Bureau d'Études, vous occuperez un rôle central dans la définition et la réalisation des solutions techniques proposées aux clients. Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de développement des équipements, depuis l'analyse du besoin jusqu'au suivi de leur fabrication et de leur mise en œuvre. À Ce Titre, Vos Principales Missions Seront De Analyser les besoins, contraintes techniques et process des clients ; Définir et dimensionner les solutions mécaniques adaptées ; Réaliser ou piloter la conception 3D des machines et sous-ensembles mécaniques ; Réaliser les plans, nomenclatures et dossiers techniques associés ; Participer au chiffrage et aux choix technico-économiques des solutions ; Consulter les fournisseurs et sous-traitants et participer aux choix techniques ; Suivre la fabrication des équipements et traiter les éventuelles problématiques techniques ; Participer aux essais, à la mise au point et, selon les projets, à la mise en service des équipements ; Être l'un des interlocuteurs techniques des clients tout au long des projets ; Collaborer avec les différentes équipes techniques du groupe dans un environnement international. Vous aurez une réelle autonomie dans vos projets et serez progressivement amené(e) à devenir une référence technique au sein du Bureau d'Études. PROFIL RECHERCHÉ De formation supérieure en mécanique, conception industrielle ou génie mécanique, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative en conception mécanique dans un environnement industriel. Une expérience dans la machine spéciale, les équipements industriels sur mesure ou les ensembles mécaniques complexes est particulièrement recherchée. Vous maîtrisez la conception mécanique 3D, idéalement sous SolidWorks, et êtes capable de travailler sur un projet depuis la définition du besoin jusqu'à sa réalisation. Une expérience en dimensionnement mécanique, mécano-soudure, chaudronnerie, structures métalliques, convoyage ou manutention constituera un véritable atout. Au-delà de la CAO, nous recherchons un profil capable de comprendre un process client, de proposer une solution technique pertinente et d'échanger avec des fournisseurs, sous-traitants et équipes de fabrication. description: If you want to be a part of the Tüpraş family, let's get to know each other better. Who We Are? Tüpraş is Türkiye’s leading energy producer and largest industrial company. With its four refineries located in İzmit, İzmir, Kırıkkale and Batman totalling to 30 million tons of annual crude oil processing capacity, Tüpraş is the 7th largest refining company in Europe. It is also one of the most complex refining companies in the Mediterranean basin. In addition to refining, Tüpraş operates with its subsidiaries, (OPET) focusing on fuel retail, (Ditaş Denizcilik) marine transportation, (Körfez Ulaştırma) railway transportation (Tüpraş Trading Ltd) crude oil and oil products trading and (Entek Elektrik) electricity generation. In 2021 The company launched its Strategic Transition Plan alongside its goal to become Carbon Neutral by 2050. In 2022, Tüpraş established its corporate venture capital arm, Tüpraş Ventures to invest in, partner with and support technology startups in its strategic focus areas, as well as energy transition solutions. (For further information on Tüpraş Strategic Transition Plan and focus business areas: Strategy - Tüpraş (tupras.com.tr) What You’ll Do? Lead and manage mechanical engineering activities throughout all project phases, including static and rotating equipment, piping systems, tankage, installation, construction, commissioning, and handover activities. Prepare technical specifications, tender packages, and technical evaluations, and provide support during procurement and contracting processes. Coordinate engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities as Owner's Engineer to ensure project objectives are achieved. Lead the technical review and assessment of engineering designs, technical deliverables, deviations, and change requests, ensuring compliance with project scope, applicable standards, operational requirements, and investment objectives, and provide recommendations to support key project decisions. Monitor site construction and inspection activities and ensure the successful integration of new investments into existing facilities. Ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with quality and performance expectations. Provide technical input for project planning, reporting, progress monitoring, and performance tracking activities. Organize and participate in meetings, workshops, and coordination activities with internal and external stakeholders. Ensure compliance with HSE, quality management systems, company procedures, and relevant regulations. What We Look For? Bachelor's degree in a relevant field. Minimum 2 years of experience in a similar role. Proficiency in English. Proficient in MS Office applications. Valid driver's license and active driving experience. Continuously follows technological and industry developments, as well as changes in legislation and standards related to the area of responsibility. Highly adaptable to change and able to quickly embrace new ways of working. Dynamic, proactive, and committed to continuous self-development. Flexible, open-minded, and receptive to new perspectives. Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively follow through on responsibilities, think innovatively and strategically, demonstrate a strong sense of social responsibility, and build sustainable professional relationships. What’s In It For You? Trainings for technical and behavioral development under the leadership of Tüpraş Academy, Koç Academy training and development programs, Opportunity for rotation within Tüpraş and other Koç Group companies, Koç Ailem: Opportunity to benefit from a special privilege platform for Koç employees, Opportunities to take part in future-oriented work such as initiatives and innovation projects developed with agile approaches, Employee experience practices that focus on continuous improvement. Therefore, we kindly ask you to actively check the mailbox (including junk/spam/junk folders) of the e-mail address you applied to. *The only criterion evaluated in recruitment and employment is suitability for the job; equal opportunity is provided without any discrimination.

title: Kıdemli Borulama İşleri Mühendisi
description: Biz Kimiz? 1993 yılında kurulan Rönesans Holding, bugün Türkiye, Avrupa, Orta Asya ve Afrika’yı kapsayan geniş bir coğrafyada; inşaat, gayrimenkul, enerji, endüstri ve sağlık alanlarında ana müteahhit ve yatırımcı olarak faaliyet göstermektedir. 40.000’i aşkın çalışanı ve 60’tan fazla milletten oluşan güçlü ve çok kültürlü ekibiyle Rönesans, dünyanın en büyük müteahhitlik şirketleri arasında yer almakta; sürdürülebilir bir gelecek inşa etme vizyonuyla yenilikçi ve küresel ölçekteki mühendislik projelerini hayata geçirmeye devam etmektedir. Şirketimizin Türkmenistan’da yapımını üstlendiği endüstriyel tesis projesinde görevlendirilmek üzere Kıdemli Borulama İşleri Mühendisi aramaktayız. Bu Rolde Seni Neler Bekliyor? Kıyanlı Tesisi kapsamındaki proses ve yardımcı boru hatlarının tüm bakım, revizyon, imalat, montaj ve mekanik tamamlanma süreçlerini iş programı ve saha önceliklerine göre planlamak ve yürütülmesini sağlamak. Günlük ve haftalık iş planları doğrultusunda; borulama ekipleri ile alt yüklenici personelini sevk ve idare etmek; iş dağılımı, saha disiplini, üretkenlik ve montaj/kaynak ekiplerinin performansını takip etmek. İşe başlamadan önce risk değerlendirmesi ve çalışma izinlerinin (PTW) hazırlanmasını sağlamak; LOTO grubuyla koordineli olarak hat izolasyon süreçlerini takip etmek. Fit-up, kaynak, NDT, montaj, hidrostatik/pnömatik test, flushing, blowing ve reinstatement faaliyetlerinin onaylı prosedürlere uygun yürütülmesini sağlamak Kaynak kayıtlarını, NDT sonuçlarını, test paketlerini ve punch listelerini takip ederek hatları hidrotest ve mekanik tamamlanma aşamasına getirmek. Sahada tespit edilen saha-tasarım uyumsuzluklarını ve ilave işleri kayıt altına alarak proje yönetimi ve teknik ofisle koordine etmek. Sorumlu olduğu ünitedeki vana, conta, saplama, destek ve sarf malzemelerinin ihtiyaçlarını önceden belirlemek; sahaya gelen spool ve malzemelerin teknik uygunluğunu kontrol etmek. Günlük, haftalık, aylık ilerleme raporlarını hazırlanmasını sağlamak; metraj, kaynak çap-inç takibi ve hakediş dosyaları için teknik ofise saha kayıtlarıyla destek vermek. Borulama işlerinin yürütülmesi kapsamında; operasyon, mekanik, enstrümantasyon, kalite, İSG ve devreye alma ekipleriyle disiplinler arası saha koordinasyon süreçlerinde yer almak; bu doğrultuda teknik değerlendirme toplantılarına katılarak alınan kararların ve aksiyonların zamanında tamamlanmasını takip etmek. Tamamlanan borulama sistemlerinin mekanik tamamlanma, test, kabul ve işletmeye teslim süreçlerini ilgili taraflarla birlikte yürütmek. Adaylardan Beklentilerimiz Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği, bölümlerinden mezun, Endüstriyel tesislerde yer altı (UG) ve yer üstü (AG) borulama montajı, test ve mekanik tamamlanma süreçlerinde en az 5 yıl deneyimli, Fit-up, kaynak, montaj, hat kontrolü, hidrostatik/pnömatik test, flushing, blowing ve reinstatement faaliyetlerinde deneyimli, P&ID, izometrik, plot plan, boru sınıfları (pipe class) ve destek projelerini iyi derecede okuyup yorumlayabilen, ASME ve API standartları ile tercihen Türkmenistan mevzuatı (SNiP/GOST) hakkında bilgi sahibi, İSG, kalite ve çevre kurallarına uygun saha çalışması konusunda güçlü uygulama deneyimine sahip, Ekip ve alt yüklenici yönetimi, iş planlaması, koordinasyon ve saha raporlaması konularında yetkin, MS Office ve Navisworks programlarını etkin şekilde kullanabilen, Tercihen iyi derecede İngilizce ve/veya Rusça bilen, Türkmenistan Kıyanlı Tesisi’nde çalışmaya ve proje çalışma düzenine uyum sağlayabilecek. Biz Neler Sunuyoruz? Performans ve başarıyı destekleyen prim uygulamaları Kapsamlı yan haklar ve çalışan destek uygulamaları Özel Sağlık Sigortası kapsamında çalışanlarımızı destekleyen sağlık uygulamaları Mesleki ve kişisel gelişimini destekleyen eğitim ve gelişim programları Çeşitlilik ve Eşitlik Beyanımız Rönesans Holding, şirketlere stratejilerini ve operasyonlarını evrensel insan hakları, çalışma, çevre ve yolsuzlukla mücadele ilkelerine uygun hale getirmeye ve toplumsal hedefleri ilerletecek önlemler almaya çağıran BM Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi'nin imzacıları arasında yer almaktadır ve Birleşmiş Milletler Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi çerçevesinde evrensel kabul görmüş beyanlara dayalı ilkeleri benimser. Rönesans Holding, ana ilkeleri olan dürüstlük, rekabetçilik ve yenilikçilikten ödün vermeden şeffaf ve etik değerleri gözeterek insan kaynakları uygulamalarında eşitliği sağlamayı amaçlayan bir işverendir. Tüm başvurular cinsiyet, dil, din, ırk ve etnik kökene bakmaksızın fırsat eşitliğine göre değerlendirilir ve ayırımcılık yapılmaz.

Şirketimizin Türkmenistan’da yapımını üstlendiği endüstriyel tesis projesinde görevlendirilmek üzere Kaynak Mühendisi (Borulama) aramaktayız. Bu Rolde Seni Neler Bekliyor? Kıyanlı Tesisi kapsamındaki borulama ve mekanik imalat/montaj projelerine ait tüm kaynak faaliyetlerinin uluslararası standartlara, müşteri şartnamelerine ve onaylı prosedürlere uygun olarak yürütülmesini sağlamak. Proje gereksinimlerine uygun olarak WPS ve PQR dokümanlarını hazırlamak, test süreçlerini (tahribatlı/tahribatsız) yönetmek ve ilgili onay merci/klas kuruluşlarına onaylatmak. Kaynakçıların uluslararası standartlara göre yeterlilik testlerini (WPQ) organize etmek, performanslarını değerlendirmek, kaynakçı sertifikalarını güncel tutmak ve sahada sadece yetkili oldukları yöntemlerde çalışmalarını sağlamak. Kaynak tamir (repair) oranlarını günlük/haftalık bazda analiz etmek, hata trendlerini belirleyerek kök neden analizi yapmak ve tamir oranlarını düşürmeye yönelik düzeltici/önleyici saha aksiyonları geliştirmek. Kaynak haritalarının tutulmasını, kaynakçı rumuzlarının işlenmesini ve tüm kaynak geçmişinin izlenebilirliğini sağlamak. Kaynak öncesi fit-up, kaynak esnası parametre (akım, gerilim, paso arası sıcaklık vb.) ve kaynak sonrası görsel kontrollerin (visual inspection) kalite planına uygun yapılmasını denetlemek. Gereken hatlar için kaynak sonrası ısı işlemi (PWHT) ve sertlik testi (hardness test) prosedürlerini hazırlamak, sahada uygulanmasını ve raporlamasını kontrol etmek. Üçüncü taraf denetçiler, müşteri kalite temsilcileri ve NDT ekipleri ile koordinasyonu sağlamak; NDT planlamasını ve rapor onay süreçlerini takip etmek. Teknik ofis, saha montaj ve atölye şefleri ile disiplinler arası koordinasyon toplantılarına katılarak kaynak işlerinin mekanik tamamlama, hidrotest ve test paketi takvimine uyumlu ilerlemesini desteklemek. title: Makine ve Enerji Müdürü
description: 1947 yılında Hakkı Saruhan’ın Rize’de açtığı mağaza ile temeli atılan Saruhan Holding, 1970 yılında Saruhan Ailesi’nin ikinci neslinin yeni bir vizyon geliştirerek İstanbul’da farklı alanlardaki girişimleri sayesinde daha kapsamlı bir yapı halini aldı. Alçak ve yüksek gerilimli elektrik malzemeleri satışıyla başlayan ticaret; • Elektrikli Ev Aletleri • Endüstriyel Temizlik Makineleri • Her türlü toz ve sıvı deterjanların ithalatıyla devam etti. 1985 yılına gelindiğinde, Saruhan Holding, Alman Fakir Hausgeräte ve Nilco markalarının Türkiye ve yakın coğrafyasının genel distribütörü oldu. Bu birliktelik bir süre sonra kurulacak ilk fabrikanın da zeminini oluşturdu. 1996 yılında Saruhan Holding, Çorlu’da kendine ait makine fabrikasını kurarak, Alman mühendislerle birlikte üretilen sanayi tipi temizlik makinelerini dünyaya ihraç etmeye başladı. Şirket, 1999’da Çorlu’da yeni bir yatırım daha yaparak Saruhan Kimya Tesisleri’ni faaliyete geçirdi. Bu tesislerde hem yurt içinde satılmak hem de yurt dışına ihracat yapmak amacıyla yılda 25.000 ton deterjan ana hammaddesi Labsa, 55.000 ton toz deterjan, 60.000 ton sıvı deterjan üretimi gerçekleştirildi. Ürettiklerini satmak adına yurt içi ve yurt dışı distribütörlük ağlarını kurmasıyla birlikte dağıtım anlamında da güçlü bir isim halini aldı. 2007 yılına gelindiğinde, Almanya’da Saruhan Deutschland Holding kuruldu. Almanya merkezli faaliyetler geliştirmek adına kurulan firma ile Fakir Holding arasında kısa sürede stratejik ortaklık anlaşması yapıldı. Ardından hisse alımıyla tam ortaklık yapısına ulaşan Saruhan Holding, elektrikli ev aletlerinde 80 yıllık Alman teknolojisinin birikimine sahip Fakir ve Nilco’nun tüm “know-how”ıyla üretim yapan, dünya pazarlarına dağıtımını birlikte sürdüren sağlam bir beraberliğin de temelini attı. Son olarak De'Longhi ve Braun markalarının resmi distribütörü olan Saruhan Holding, kendi yolunda güvenle büyümeye devam etmektedir… Hızlı tüketim malları (FMCG) sektöründe lider konumda olan, deterjan ve hijyen ürünleri üretiminde yenilikçi çözümler sunan fabrikamız için, büyüme ve yatırım süreçlerimize liderlik edecek dinamik bir Makine ve Enerji Müdürü arıyoruz. Genel Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği , Elektrik Mühendisliği veya ilgili mühendislik fakültelerinden mezun. FMCG veya kimya sektörü ve bakım süreçlerinde en az 10 yıl deneyimli. Üretim tesislerinde bakım yönetimi, enerji optimizasyonu ve yeni yatırım projelerinin devreye alınması konularında güçlü, kanıtlanmış bir geçmişe sahip. SAP sistemini (özellikle PM - Plant Maintenance ve MM modüllerini) etkin bir şekilde kullanmış ve bakım süreçlerine entegre edebilen. Yasal mevzuatlara, iş sağlığı ve güvenliği (İSG) ile çevre standartlarına tam uyum sağlayarak çalışabilecek. Güçlü liderlik, analitik düşünce, problem çözme ve karar verme yetkinliklerine sahip. İyi derecede İngilizce bilen. Tekirdağ Çorlu, Çerkezköy, Kapaklı, Ergene ilçelerinde ikamet eden veya edebilecek olan. İş Tanımı Fabrika genelindeki tüm üretim hatlarının, ekipmanların ve planlı ve arıza bakım (kestirici/önleyici bakım) faaliyetlerini yönetmek. Üretim verimliliğini artırmak, arıza duruşlarını en aza indirmek ve OEE (Genel Ekipman Etkinliği) metriklerini sürekli iyileştirmek. Fabrikanın enerji tüketimini (elektrik, buhar, su vb.) optimize etmek, sürdürülebilirlik ve enerji verimliliği projelerine liderlik etmek. Planlanan yeni yatırım projelerinin (makine, altyapı, otomasyon) fizibilite, bütçeleme, satın alma, montaj ve devreye alma süreçlerini yönetmek. Bakım ve yatırım süreçlerinin tamamını SAP sistemi üzerinden takip etmek, raporlamak ve süreç iyileştirmeleri yapmak. Bakım ekibinin teknik gelişimini sağlamak, performansını yönetmek ve departman içi bütçeyi etkin bir şekilde yönetmek. İş Sağlığı, Güvenliği ve Çevre (İSG-Ç) kurallarına eksiksiz uyulmasını sağlayarak güvenli bir çalışma ortamı tesis etmek. Bu ilana başvurmanız kapsamında elde edilen kişisel verileriniz yalnızca başvurunuzun değerlendirilmesi, insan kaynakları süreçlerinin yürütülmesi, ilgili yönetici/birimle yapılacak görüşmelerin yürütülmesi ve şirketimiz bünyesinde pozisyona uygunluğunuzun ölçülmesi amaçlarıyla işlenir. Kişisel verileriniz yalnızca kurum içi iletişim teknolojilerinin kullanılması, saklama ve arşiv faaliyetlerinin yürütülmesi ve bilgi güvenliğinin sağlanması amacıyla teknoloji tedarikçilerimize aktarılır. Detaylı bilgi ve haklarınıza ilişkin ayrıntılar için saruhan.com.tr/kvkk adresini ziyaret edebilirsiniz.

Assess mechanical design submissions including cooling load calculations, precision cooling system layouts (CRAC/CRAH, chillers, cooling towers), pipework schematics, Fire Fighting, HVAC ductwork arrangements, and equipment specifications against project requirements and industry best practice. Review fire suppression, plumbing, and drainage design packages for completeness, standard compliance, and compatibility with the wider building and mechanical systems. Verify that submitted designs comply with the applicable Tier classification requirements (TIA-942, Uptime Institute), resilience configurations (N+1, 2N), and the power usage effectiveness (PUE) targets set out in the project brief. Check mechanical design coordination across disciplines, identify unresolved spatial conflicts, interface gaps between mechanical sub-systems, and missing cross-discipline coordination between electrical, CSA, and ICT/ELV packages. Review BIM models and coordination reports submitted by the contractor, verify that mechanical systems are modelled to the required LOD, and confirm clash detection has been carried out and resolved prior to IFC issue. Track the status of all open review comments, verify the adequacy of contractor responses and resubmissions, and maintain a live register of outstanding and closed technical issues. Attend design review meetings, design coordination workshops, and BIM coordination sessions as the PMO’s mechanical technical representative; prepare and issue meeting minutes and action trackers. Support the PMO team during construction by reviewing mechanical shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, FAT and SAT procedures, and commissioning plans; flag deviations from the approved IFC design and raise non-conformance records as required. Qualifications & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering. Minimum 8–12 years of experience in mechanical engineering for data centers or mission-critical facilities, with a demonstrated track record in design on consultancy-side engagements. Deep technical knowledge of data center mechanical systems: Precision cooling, diesel generators, BMS, drainage, fire suppression, and HVAC. Strong familiarity with Tier classification standards (TIA-942, Uptime Institute), resilience design principles, and PUE benchmarking. Proficiency in reviewing mechanical design packages produced in AutoCAD, Revit MEP, ETAP, or equivalent tools; ability to interrogate calculation reports and verify design assumptions. Working knowledge of BIM coordination processes (Revit, Navisworks) sufficient to review federated models and assess LOD compliance. Thorough knowledge of applicable standards: IEC 60364, BS 7671, NFPA 70/75, ASHRAE A2, and local authority requirements. Strong written communication skills: able to produce clear, well-referenced review comment schedules and technical correspondence.
