title: Stembio / StemHeart - Tıbbi Cihaz Kalite ve Regülasyon Kıdemli Uzmanı / Medical Device Quality & Regulatory Senior Specialist
description: StemHeart, şu anda erken prototipleme aşamasında bulunan yenilikçi bir sentetik kalp kapağı teknolojisi geliştirmektedir . StemHeart, Koç Healthcare bünyesinde faaliyet gösteren Stembio’nun yönetimi altında çalışmalarını sürdürmekte olup; Stembio’nun kalite, regülasyon ve operasyonel altyapısından ve daha geniş Koç Healthcare ekosisteminden faydalanmaktadır. Proje kapsamında ayrıca Koç Üniversitesi Hastanesi bünyesinde, ilerleyen dönemde akredite bir kalp kapağı test ve geliştirme merkezine dönüştürülmesi planlanan özel bir alan bulunmaktadır. StemHeart için kalite ve regülasyon altyapısını kuracak ve hayata geçirecek bir Tıbbi Cihaz Kalite ve Regülasyon Kıdemli Uzmanı arıyoruz. Pozisyonun temel sorumluluğu, Sınıf III bir tıbbi cihaz için ISO 13485’e uygun bir Kalite Yönetim Sistemi’ni (KYS) sıfırdan kurmak ve kalite ile mevzuat gerekliliklerinin prototip ve tasarım geliştirmeden doğrulama ve geçerli kılma çalışmalarına, üretime hazırlıktan tedarikçi kontrollerine, ruhsatlandırma/uygunluk değerlendirme başvurularından piyasaya arz sonrası süreçlere hazırlık ve ticarileştirmeye kadar ürün yaşam döngüsünün tüm aşamalarına entegre edilmesini sağlamaktır. Bu pozisyon ayrıca hastane bünyesindeki kalp kapağı test ve geliştirme tesisinin, akreditasyon kapsamı doğrultusunda ISO/IEC 17025 gerekliliklerini karşılayan akredite bir test ve geliştirme merkezi olarak yapılandırılmasını destekleyecektir. Mevcut bir kalite sistemini yalnızca sürdürmekle sınırlı kalmayıp, kurum genelinde tıbbi cihaz Kalite Yönetim Sistemi’ni kurabilecek ve uygulamaya alabilecek, sahada aktif rol üstlenen bir profesyonel arıyoruz. İdeal adayın prototip ve tasarım geliştirme → tedarikçi ve üretim kontrolleri → doğrulama ve geçerli kılma → düzenleyici onay/uygunluk değerlendirmesi → ticarileştirme süreçlerinin bütününe hâkim olması ve her aşamada gerekli kalite altyapısını oluşturabilmesi beklenmektedir. Genel Nitelikler Biyomedikal Mühendisliği, Makine Mühendisliği, Malzeme Mühendisliği, Biyomühendislik, Yaşam Bilimleri veya ilgili bir alanda lisans veya üzeri derece. Tercihen en az 5 yıl tıbbi cihaz kalite güvencesi/regülasyon (QA/RA) deneyimi; KYS’yi bağımsız olarak kurup yönetmesi beklenen adaylar için 7 yıl ve üzeri deneyim tercih sebebidir. ISO 13485 KYS’nin kurulması, kapsamlı biçimde iyileştirilmesi veya uygulanmasında doğrudan sorumluluk üstlenmiş olmak zorunludur. ISO 13485, ISO 14971, EU MDR 2017/745 ve Türkiye’de geçerli tıbbi cihaz mevzuatı hakkında güçlü uygulama bilgisi. Tasarım kontrolleri, teknik dokümantasyon, risk yönetimi, CAPA, iç/dış denetimler, validasyon, üretim kalitesi ve tedarikçi kalitesi alanlarında uygulamalı deneyim. Onaylanmış Kuruluş denetimleri, belgelendirme projeleri veya düzenleyici otoritelerle yürütülen süreçlerde deneyim güçlü tercih sebebidir. Kardiyovasküler, implante edilebilir, Sınıf III veya diğer yüksek riskli tıbbi cihazlarda deneyim önemli tercih sebebidir. Önceki görev kapsamına bağlı olarak ISO 5840 serisi, ISO 10993, sterilizasyon/ambalaj validasyonu veya ISO/IEC 17025 bilgisi avantajdır. ISO 13485 iç denetçi/baş denetçi yetkinliği ve/veya geçerli şartlar kapsamında Mevzuata Uygunluktan Sorumlu Kişi (PRRC) rolünü üstlenme şartlarını karşılamak avantajdır. Türkçe ve İngilizcede güçlü iletişim, dokümantasyon ve paydaş yönetimi becerileri. Bağımsız çalışabilme, riskleri önceliklendirebilme, yapıcı biçimde sorgulayabilme ve birden fazla fonksiyon ile lokasyonda uygulamaya liderlik edebilme. Rol ve Sorumluluklar 1. Kalite Yönetim Sistemi • ISO 13485’e uygun bir KYS oluşturmak, uygulamak ve düzenleyici gerekliliklere hazırlık yol haritasını geliştirmek. • Standart operasyon prosedürleri (SOP), kayıtlar, doküman ve değişiklik kontrolü, sapmalar, düzeltici ve önleyici faaliyetler (CAPA), denetimler ve yönetimin gözden geçirmesi dâhil temel KYS dokümantasyonunu hazırlamak ve güncel tutmak. • Ar-Ge, mühendislik, üretim, tedarik zinciri, insan kaynakları ve yönetim birimleri arasında süreç sahipliğini, sorumlulukları, eskalasyon mekanizmalarını ve fonksiyonlar arası uygulamayı netleştirmek. 2. Tasarım, Risk ve Ürün Geliştirme Planlama, tasarım girdileri ve çıktıları, tasarım gözden geçirmeleri, doğrulama, geçerli kılma, tasarım transferi ve tasarım değişiklikleri dâhil tasarım ve geliştirme kontrollerini oluşturmak ve sürdürmek. ISO 14971’e uygun yaşam döngüsü boyunca risk yönetimini uygulamak ve sürdürmek; risk kontrollerinin tasarım, test, üretim ve üretim sonrası bilgilerle ilişkilendirilmesini sağlamak. Kalp kapağının prototip/Ar-Ge aşamasından kontrollü ve valide edilmiş üretime aktarılmasını desteklemek. 3. Üretim ve Tedarikçi Kalitesi Üretim, ekipman kalifikasyonu, proses validasyonu, çevresel ve üretim kontrolleri, ürün kabulü/serbest bırakılması ve uygunsuzluk yönetimine ilişkin kalite gerekliliklerini oluşturmak. Tedarikçi kalifikasyonu ve performans takibi, gerektiğinde kalite anlaşmaları, satın alma kontrolleri, girdi muayenesi ile malzeme/bileşen izlenebilirliği süreçlerini oluşturmak. Dış kaynaklı ve kritik süreçler üzerinde yeterli kalite gözetimini sağlamak. Uygulanabilir olduğu durumlarda sterilizasyon, ambalajlama, taşıma ve raf ömrü validasyonuna ilişkin kalite gerekliliklerini koordine etmek. 4. Personel ve Eğitim • İnsan Kaynakları ve ilgili birim yöneticileriyle birlikte yetkinlik, eğitim ve kalifikasyon gerekliliklerini belirlemek. Pozisyona dayalı eğitim matrislerini güncel tutmak ve personelin düzenlemeye tabi faaliyetleri bağımsız olarak gerçekleştirmeden önce gerekli yetkinliğe sahip olmasını sağlamak. Farklı fonksiyonlardaki ekiplere uygulamaya dönük kalite rehberliği sunmak ve önleyici yaklaşıma dayalı kalite kültürünün yerleşmesini desteklemek. 5. Regülasyon Süreçleri Türkiye ve Avrupa Birliği için AB Tıbbi Cihaz Tüzüğü (EU MDR 2017/745), CE işaretlemesi ve teknik dokümantasyon dâhil regülasyon stratejisini desteklemek. • Dış kuruluşlar, test merkezleri, sertifikasyon kuruluşları ve Onaylanmış Kuruluşlar ile yürütülen regülasyon, sertifikasyon ve test faa

title: Research Engineer – Multi-Agent Systems & A2A Intelligence
description: Türkiye R&D Center is pioneering the next frontier of autonomous network intelligence through OpenAN (Open Autonomous Networks) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) collaboration architectures for 5.5G and future 6G systems. We are seeking Research Engineers in Computer Science or Artificial Intelligence to join our research team. In this role, you will tackle fundamental challenges in distributed agent coordination, collaborative negotiation protocols, semantic intent alignment, and safe agentic workflows. You will conduct cutting-edge applied research with direct impact on carrier-grade networks operating at global scale. Key Research Focus Areas 1- Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Coordination & Negotiation Protocols Distributed multi-agent architectures for autonomous cross-domain network orchestration. Negotiation protocols, dynamic consensus mechanisms, and conflict resolution in heterogeneous multi-agent systems. Deadlock detection, prevention, and cycle-breaking in iterative multi-agent communications. 2- Intent Understanding, Knowledge Graphs & Semantic Alignment Natural language intent parsing and bidirectional translation between business objectives and technical network configurations. Domain-specific Knowledge Graph (KG) construction, ontology design, and schema alignment across OSS and RAN domains. Multi-turn dialogue management and persistent memory architectures for autonomous agents. 3- Safety, Trust & Hallucination Mitigation in Multi-Agent Workflows Hallucination detection and mitigation in LLM-based autonomous decision-making loops. Trust models, formal verification, and policy guardrails for agent-to-agent interactions in critical infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Conduct fundamental and applied research at the intersection of Multi-Agent Systems, Foundation Models, and Autonomous Systems. Design novel algorithms, protocols, and architectural prototypes validated on real-world and simulated network environments. Publish research findings in top-tier AI and networking venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, AAMAS, SIGCOMM, INFOCOM). File high-value international patents and contribute novel proposals to global standardization initiatives (e.g., 3GPP, O-RAN, ITU-T). Collaborate with global Telecom Operators, Huawei HQ researchers, and local academic partners at top Turkish universities. Qualifications Required: PhD with strong publication in related area / MSc Degree with 3+ years research experience in academics/industry Demonstrated research track record in at least two of the following areas: Multi-Agent Systems (MAS), Game Theory, or Distributed AI Large Language Model (LLM) Agents, Tool Use, and Agentic Workflows Knowledge Graphs, Ontologies, or Semantic Web Natural Language Processing (NLP) / Information Extraction Formal Methods, Deadlock Prevention, or Consensus Protocols Solid publication record in reputable conferences or journals. Strong programming skills in Python and deep learning/agent frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom distributed agent platforms). Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). Preferred: Prior exposure to telecommunications concepts, network management (OSS/RAN), or 3GPP service architecture (helpful, but domain background will be provided). Experience with open-source foundation models (fine-tuning, RLHF, alignment, quantization). Track record of filing patents or contributing to open-source systems.

title: Lead Engineer Mechanical
description: Vi bygger datacentercampus i Dalarna med höga krav på kylning, redundans och tillgänglighet. Stora värmemängder ska hanteras på liten yta, systemen måste samspela med el och BMS och en brist i hydraulik eller styrsekvens kan påverka hela anläggningens funktion. Rollen kräver därför att du kan växla mellan systemperspektiv och tekniska detaljer. Som Lead Engineer Mechanical ansvarar du för den tekniska leveransen av kyl- och mekaniska system i våra projekt. Du är vår seniora tekniska specialist inom mekanik och har mandat att driva tekniska beslut på projektnivå, inom den arkitektur och de standarder som Technology & Design-teamet under vår CTO sätter. Du rapporterar till Construction Engineering Director och ingår i vårt interna teknikteam, som i dag är nio personer men kommer växa till 12–15. Rollen innebär tekniskt ledarskap utan personalansvar. Din vardag rör sig mellan projektmöten, granskningar och tekniska avvägningar. Ena dagen driver du ett beslut om redundans eller produktval, nästa dag går du ner i ett P&ID eller en styrsekvens för att avgöra om lösningen håller när lasten förändras snabbt. Du tar fram beställarkrav, utmanar konsulternas underlag och arbetar tillsammans med inköp med inköpshandlingar och leverantörsutvärderingar. Genom hela projektet samordnar du leverantörer och hanterar tekniska leveransrisker, så att lösningarna går att bygga, driftsätta och överlämna till drift på ett kontrollerat sätt. Vid driftsättning stöttar du våra commissioning-tekniker på site. Du samarbetar dagligen med projekt, drift, inköp, Technology & Design och externa konsulter, och vägleder kollegor i mekaniska frågor. I takt med att byggtakten ökar blir du ett allt viktigare stöd för fler projekt och konsultgrupper. De första tre månaderna sätter du dig in i befintlig design och pågående projekt, bygger relationer i teknikgruppen och tar plats i designmötena. Efter 6–12 månader ansvarar du självständigt för den mekaniska leveransen i projekten, är en tydlig teknisk motpart till konsulter och leverantörer och bidrar aktivt till att standardisera lösningar mellan våra campus. Dina främsta arbetsuppgifter Ansvara för den mekaniska leveransen i projekten och driva tekniska beslut och lösningar, inklusive produktval, inom den tekniska arkitektur och de standarder som Technology & Design sätter Ta fram beställarkrav och stötta designkonsulter i hur de omsätts i design Granska och utmana underlag från konsulter, leverantörer och entreprenörer Säkerställa funktion, redundans, kapacitet och energieffektivitet enligt kundkrav, våra standarder och EN 50600 Ta fram inköpshandlingar, granska anbud och utvärdera leverantörer tillsammans med inköp Samordna med el, BMS och säkerhet så att systemen fungerar som en helhet Stötta vid funktionsprovning, felsökning och överlämning till drift Driva standardisering av mekaniska lösningar över flera projekt och campus Vem är du? Du är en erfaren mekanik-, kyl- eller HVAC-ingenjör som ser anläggningen som ett system, inte som en samling komponenter. Du rör dig obehindrat mellan systemnivå och detaljer som hydraulik och styrsekvenser. Du är trygg i din kompetens utan att behöva ha rätt i varje diskussion. Du utmanar när en lösning inte håller och väger teknisk prestanda mot byggbarhet, kostnad, tid och drift. Den bästa lösningen ska inte bara fungera på papperet – den ska gå att bygga, driftsätta och underhålla i många år. Som person är du öppen, ödmjuk och initiativrik. Du kanske kommer från en HVAC-konsult, processindustri, energi, läkemedel, sjukhus eller redan från datacenter. Saknar du datacentererfarenhet lär du dig miljön hos oss. title: Afstudeerstage Werktuigbouwkunde - Beweegbare Bruggen
description: Functieomschrijving Jouw impact bij Movares Verdiep je in werktuigbouwkundige vraagstukken rond beweegbare bruggen en werk mee aan innovatieve oplossingen. Dit ga je doen bij Movares kies een technisch, werktuigbouwkundig afstudeeronderwerp uit ons aanbod dat aansluit bij jouw interesses en talent; ontwikkel nieuwe concepten of onderzoek en analyseer bestaande ontwerpen, data en technische richtlijnen; werk nauw samen met Werktuigbouwkundige specialisten vertaal jouw bevindingen naar praktische adviezen voor projecten in Nederland. Tijdens deze afstudeerstage werk je aan een actueel vraagstuk binnen de wereld van beweegbare bruggen. Je kiest een onderwerp dat past bij jouw interesses, zoals de aandrijving van bruggen, verbindingen in constructies of het hergebruik van onderdelen. Het afstudeeronderwerp bespreken wij samen tijdens een kennismakingsgesprek. Je combineert onderzoek met praktijkgerichte adviezen en levert een bijdrage aan een veilige, duurzame en betrouwbare infrastructuur. Dit ben jij bij Movares je volgt een hbo- of wo(master)-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde; je toont initiatief, pakt kansen op en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je onderzoek; je werkt analytisch, legt verbanden en vertaalt inzichten naar heldere adviezen; je zoekt actief de samenwerking op en deelt kennis met collega's. Een stage bij Movares is een kickstart van je carrière, en dat heeft verschillende redenen. Zo kun je erop rekenen dat de begeleiding door jouw stagebegeleider, het team waarin je komt te werken én campusrecruiter Noortje op-en-top voor elkaar is. Daarnaast kom je terecht in een groep mede-afstudeerders, allemaal gelijkgestemden. Elk jaar verwelkomt Movares namelijk tussen de 30 en 40 stagiaires. Hen ontmoet je tijdens de maandelijkse bijeenkomsten van Movares Backstage, waar de verbinding met anderen voorop staat. Soms gaan jullie samen lunchen of bezoeken jullie een project. Andere maanden staat er een inhoudelijke sessie op de planning en leer je bijvoorbeeld beter presenteren of adviseren. En ook als lid van onze jongerenvereniging staan er regelmatig leuke activiteiten in je agenda. Daarnaast kun je elke tweede dinsdag van de maand aanschuiven bij het Café van de Toekomst: een inspiratiesessie waarbij je samen met je collega’s wordt bijgepraat over onderwerpen en projecten die in onze organisatie spelen. En dat is nog niet alles: je kunt gebruikmaken van onze eigen Academy met ruim 3.000 verschillende leerlijnen, trainingen en e-learningmodules. Dit krijg je bij Movares Bij Movares werk je mee aan een uitdagende opdracht met volop kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Er hangt een leuke en gezellige sfeer. Je krijgt een kijkje in de keuken van een toonaangevend advies- en ingenieursbureau, volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief en goede begeleiding. De duur en startdatum zijn in overleg nader te bepalen. Verder krijg je: een aantrekkelijke vergoeding van €550 op basis van een fulltime dienstverband; ruimte voor het vinden van jouw ideale werk-privé-balans; leuke collega’s en een afstudeerplek in hartje Utrecht. En er is méér. Want afstuderen bij Movares betekent ook: bijdragen aan een schone wereld, omdat je stageloopt bij het eerste bedrijf in Nederland met een Zero Waste-certificaat; lid worden van Young Movares, de jongerenvereniging waar je leert van én met andere jonge collega’s. Jouw team bij Movares Voor jou als Afstudeerstagiair(e) Werktuigbouwkunde is er plek op onze afdeling Civiele Constructies in team Werktuigbouw. Je komt terecht in een hecht team van betrokken specialisten die werken aan beweegbare bruggen en andere complexe kunstwerken. Binnen het team combineren we diepgaande technische kennis met nieuwsgierigheid en innovatiekracht. We werken nauw samen met collega's uit de disciplines Staalbouw, Beton en Bruginstallaties. Daardoor kijk je ook verder dan je eigen vakgebied en leer je hoe integrale oplossingen tot stand komen. De sfeer is open en toegankelijk: collega's helpen elkaar graag, delen kennis actief en geven je de ruimte om ideeën uit te werken. Samen werken we aan een veilige, duurzame en betrouwbare infrastructuur voor Nederland.

title: Mechanical Engineering Degree Apprenticeship
description: Programme title: Mechanical Engineering Degree Apprenticeship Level: 6 Salary: Year 1: £23,598 Year 2: £26,903 Year 3: £30,208 Year 4: £33,513 Location: Warrington Application closing date: 8th December 2026 Programme start date: September 2027 Role ID : 74992 Join our Cavendish Nuclear business and build a career that truly matters. Over this 4-year programme, you’ll study towards a BEng (Hons) in Professional Engineering (Product Design) while gaining hands-on experience on initiatives that support the safe delivery of nuclear new build and decommissioning projects. It provides a solid foundation for a rewarding career in the nuclear industry. About The Programme As a Mechanical Engineering Apprentice at Cavendish Nuclear, you’ll join a collaborative and experienced team working across all phases of the engineering lifecycle. Whether you’re supporting new build or decommissioning projects, you’ll play a vital role in the UK’s civil nuclear sector helping to deliver national energy resilience, meet net zero commitments, and safely clean up the nuclear legacy. You’ll work on a variety of nuclear projects, from developing new technologies and maintaining essential systems to extending the life of vital infrastructure. Your day-to-day activities will include hands-on experience with Computer Aided Design (CAD), 3D modelling, mechanical calculations, and producing engineering documentation to national and international standards. You’ll support operational teams, resolve technical issues, and inform decisions that impact real-world outcomes. As part of your role, you’ll define design requirements, develop 3D CAD models, produce detailed engineering drawings, and carry out scoping calculations. You’ll also prepare equipment specifications, technical reports, and help manage plant and equipment obsolescence to ensure systems remain safe and reliable. Supporting assembly, testing, and operational teams, you’ll offer technical guidance, resolve engineering queries, and manage nonconformance issues, while gaining exposure to advanced engineering tools such as Finite Element Analysis (FEA) software. Based at one of our key sites in Warrington, you’ll support major projects at locations like Sellafield. You’ll begin by shadowing experienced engineers, building a strong foundation in design, modelling, calculations, and documentation. As you develop, you’ll take on more complex tasks and gain valuable experience across the full design lifecycle. Every drawing, design, or calculation you contribute to plays a part in protecting people, the environment, and the nation’s energy future. Throughout your apprenticeship, you’ll be surrounded by supportive mentors and experienced engineers who are invested in your growth. You’ll be part of a wider emerging talent community, sharing experiences and learning alongside other apprentices across the business. You’ll be trusted to take ownership of your development and supported every step of the way as you turn theory into real-world impact. title: Ingénieur mécanique - R&D
description: Le succès d'une entreprise passe avant tout par les hommes et femmes qui la composent... Ensemble, partageons nos talents. Ceva Santé Animale est la 1ère entreprise de santé animale française, et est classée au 5ème rang mondial. Ensemble, c'est avec passion que les femmes et les hommes de Ceva recherchent, développent, produisent et commercialisent des solutions de santé innovantes pour soigner tous les animaux, et ainsi contribuer à la préservation des grands équilibres de notre planète. Nous nous engageons à assurer le meilleur niveau de soins et de bien-être possible aux animaux d’élevage (volailles, porcs, ruminants), aux animaux de compagnie (chiens et chats) et à la faune sauvage. En effet, notre vision « Ensemble, au-delà de la santé animale » met en avant le lien étroit qui existe entre la santé et le bien-être des personnes, des animaux et de notre planète. Ceva est plus que jamais engagé dans une approche « One Health », une seule santé en français. Dans le cadre de notre politique "Diversité, équité et inclusion", Ceva Santé Animale s'engage en faveur de l'emploi des personnes en situation de handicap et déploie les moyens nécessaires au bon déroulement des entretiens de recrutement. N'hésitez pas à nous solliciter. Vos Missions Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Mécanique R&D pour piloter des projets de développement de nouveaux équipements et fonctionnalités, depuis l'identification du besoin jusqu'à la validation finale. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement stimulant où innovation, expertise technique et collaboration sont au cœur de notre réussite. Au sein de l'équipe R&D, vous prenez en charge des projets d'innovation et de développement de nouveaux équipements mécaniques. Vos Missions Conception & Expertise Technique Analyser les besoins clients et rédiger les cahiers des charges techniques. Concevoir et développer des solutions mécaniques innovantes répondant aux exigences de performance, qualité, coût et délai. Réaliser les études mécaniques : calculs, dimensionnement, conception 3D et documentation technique. Valider les concepts via des simulations, prototypes et preuves de concept (POC). Sélectionner les composants et contribuer aux choix techniques. Superviser les phases d'essais, de validation, de mise en service et accompagner l'industrialisation des équipements. Contribuer à l'innovation par une veille technologique active, le développement de nouveaux concepts et l'accompagnement de stagiaires. Gestion de Projet & Coordination Transverse Piloter les projets de développement en assurant leur planification, coordination et suivi. Collaborer avec les équipes métiers (production, achats, commerce, marketing, bureau d'études) tout au long du projet. Garantir l'atteinte des objectifs de qualité, coûts et délais, tout en maîtrisant les risques techniques. Piloter les relations fournisseurs et suivre les éventuelles sous-traitances. Votre Profil Votre profil : De formation ingénierie mécanique ou équivalent, vous disposez d'une expérience confirmée de 3 ans minimum en conception et développement de machines spéciales ou d'équipements industriels. Vous maîtrisez la conception mécanique et la CAO 3D, idéalement sur Autodesk Inventor, ainsi que les méthodes de gestion de projet. Des connaissances en sécurité machine, étanchéité et environnements industriels exigeants sont attendues. Une sensibilité à la robotique constitue un atout. Enfin, votre anglais courant vous permet d'évoluer efficacement dans un contexte international. Vous aimez explorer de nouvelles technologies et contribuer activement à l'innovation. Vous êtes capable de transformer un besoin ou une idée en solution concrète, en conciliant créativité, faisabilité technique et pragmatisme. Vous savez identifier les problématiques, proposer des solutions pertinentes et prendre des décisions adaptées dans un environnement technique exigeant. Votre sens de l'organisation vous permet de gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle tout en respectant les priorités et les échéances. Vous appréciez le travail collaboratif et savez interagir efficacement avec des interlocuteurs variés, qu'il s'agisse d'équipes techniques, de fournisseurs ou de clients internes. Autonome et orienté(e) résultats, vous faites preuve d'initiative, de rigueur et d'un fort engagement dans la réussite des projets qui vous sont confiés.

title: Advanced R&D Engineer
description: Are you technically curious, hands-on, and comfortable exploring new ideas? At Intralox, one of the world’s leading innovators in conveyance solutions, we are looking for an Advanced R&D Engineer to join our R&D team in Eindhoven and play a key role in turning emerging technologies into practical products and customer solutions. Why this role matters Our Advanced R&D team explores new and emerging technologies that can shape the next generation of Intralox solutions. We work across disciplines including magnetics, motors, actuators, sensing, vision, robotics, and mechatronics. Rather than focusing on one established product or repeating the same assignments, the team investigates varied applications and develops net-new technology. Curiosity, experimentation, collaboration, and practical problem-solving are central to how we work. As an Advanced R&D Engineer, you will explore promising technologies and translate them into prototypes, concepts, and integrated solutions. Based in Eindhoven, you will work closely with local technical colleagues and collaborate with Advanced R&D team members in the US. You will have the freedom to move between different technologies and applications, combining sound engineering principles with hands-on experimentation to solve real customer challenges. What You’ll Do Explore new and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for innovative products and customer solutions. Develop and evaluate prototypes to turn early-stage ideas into technically viable concepts. Design, build, and test concepts involving magnetics, motors, actuators, sensing, vision, robotics, or related technologies. Apply simulation and engineering analysis to improve design decisions and reduce technical risk. Use rapid-prototyping methods, including 3D printing, to accelerate learning and concept validation. Investigate supplier technologies and assess their potential for use in future Intralox applications. Combine multiple technologies into integrated solutions that address practical customer needs. Consider machining, injection molding, and other production methods to improve the manufacturability of proposed designs. Document and communicate technical findings so that colleagues across locations can build on your work. Collaborate with engineers in Europe and the US to connect global expertise and advance shared R&D initiatives. Participate in occasional customer visits, installations, and technical collaboration sessions in Europe and the US. What You Bring A bachelor’s, master’s, or doctoral degree in mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, applied physics, or a related technical discipline. At least five years of relevant experience in industrial engineering, product development, advanced R&D, or a comparable applied-technology environment. An understanding of manufacturability, including machining, injection molding, and other relevant production processes. Hands-on experience developing, prototyping, testing, or validating physical products and technical concepts. The ability to connect theoretical engineering principles with practical implementation and customer needs. The flexibility to work across unfamiliar technologies and pivot between different applications and development challenges. A curious, open-minded, and collaborative approach, with the confidence to work effectively when requirements or solutions are not yet fully defined. Willingness to work from our Eindhoven office at least three days per week and to travel occasionally. Nice-to-have: Experience in one or more of the following areas: magnetic drives, motors, actuators, sensing, vision systems, robotics, mechatronics, simulation, or 3D printing. If you don’t meet every requirement but are excited about the role, we still encourage you to apply. Why Intralox? International environment with opportunities to grow your career globally. A supportive, high-performing team that values collaboration. A workplace driven by ideas, innovation, and ownership. A financially strong, market-leading brand. Performance-based profit sharing. 25 holiday days + 6 ATV days. Excellent benefits package including a mobility card for business and personal use, pension scheme and contributions to health & life insurance. Building great things together Intralox is a global leader in innovative conveyance solutions, with more than 3,000 employees across 20+ countries. For over 50 years, we’ve helped customers grow by solving complex challenges with smart, reliable solutions. At our core is a simple principle: do the right thing. We’ve built a culture grounded in honesty, fairness, and respect, where every idea is valued, and great thinking can come from anywhere. Self-managed, curious individuals thrive here. We believe great results start with great people. That’s why we bring together driven, collaborative teams who are passionate about making a real-world impact. You’ll be empowered to take initiative, supported in your growth, and encouraged to continuously improve, while working alongside colleagues who celebrate shared success. Note: To be considered for this role, you need to be based in the Netherlands and have a valid work permit. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled

title: Mechanical Engineer | Robotics
description: We build humanoid systems: full stack, from hardware and electronics to software and manufacturing, all in-house in Berlin. At Cell Labs, we push the boundary of what robotics can achieve. Our goal is clear: to build systems that empower humans, not replace them. Our technology is already deployed with industry leading customers and partners. Now, our own product is close to launch. The quiet phase is over. We are looking for people who want to be here early, take ownership, and help us build what others only talk about. Location: Berlin (on-site) Start: Asap Employment Type: Full-time Tasks Mechanical Design & CAD: Design and develop mechanical components and assemblies for humanoid systems, from actuators and kinematic mechanisms to sensor mounts and protective enclosures and model them in CAD (e.g. Onshape). Actuator Kinematics: Design and optimize the kinematic structure of the robot's joints and limbs, including joint layouts, degrees of freedom, ranges of motion, and transmission mechanisms. Select and integrate actuators (motors, gearboxes, encoders) so that torque, speed, and load requirements are met across the full motion range. Production Readiness: Optimize designs for series production with product requirements, user experience, and target cost in mind. Prepare the handover to manufacturing, including assembly processes, jigs and fixtures, and supplier ramp-up. Prototyping & Testing: Prototype and validate mechanical systems for performance, safety, and durability. Design and build test rigs for actuators and subassemblies, including endurance and load testing. Electronics Integration & Wiring: Integrate PCBs, sensors, and batteries into mechanical assemblies, including cable routing and heat management. Build and solder cables and wiring harnesses for prototypes and test setups. Analysis & Materials: Run stress analysis and weight optimization to improve performance and longevity. Research, test, and qualify new materials and processes, such as composites and additive manufacturing. Documentation & Specifications: Maintain complete design documentation, including drawings, part specifications, BOMs, and wiring diagrams, with full traceability throughout development. Requirements Background: You studied mechanical engineering, mechatronics, robotics, electrical engineering, or something close to it. Experience: At least 3 years working on robotic systems, mobile machinery, or similar electromechanical products. What you built matters more to us than where you built it. Mechanical Design: You've designed complex mechanical systems and understand robot kinematics, actuators, and how mechanical and electrical parts come together in a working robot. Manufacturing: You know CNC machining, injection molding, sheet metal, and additive manufacturing, and you design with mid- and high-volume production in mind. You've worked with suppliers and brought hardware into production. Hands-on: You like building things yourself. You solder cables, put together wiring harnesses, build test rigs, and track down problems on the bench. Tools: You work confidently in Onshape and Autodesk Fusion, including its electronics design tools. Product lifecycle: Ideally, you've taken at least one hardware product all the way from concept to series production. How you work: You get a first prototype built quickly and improve from there. You can keep several projects moving at once and know when a design is good enough to move forward. Languages: Fluent English. German is a plus. Benefits Your work goes into a real robot: The joints, assemblies, and test rigs you design end up in humanoid robots we build ourselves. You take ownership of real subsystems and see them go from CAD to working hardware. Everything under one roof: Office, workshop, and test rigs are in the same building in Kreuzberg. Your design goes from screen to prototype in days. The electrical and software engineers are a short walk away, not a ticket . Room to grow: Paid learning time and a personal budget for courses, conferences, and the tools you need. You'll get space to try new materials, processes, and ideas, and you'll take on more responsibility as the company grows. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Deployable Solar Arrays
description: Job Description Rockets have not gotten wider. Satellites need far more power than they used to. The only way through is structures that pack into a fairing and unfold into something massive on orbit. Gama is building that: ultra-light deployable solar arrays, from 3 kW to over 100 kW, in a factory sized for 100 MW a year by 2028. Almost nothing about this exists off the shelf. Most of it has to be invented, tested, and made manufacturable, here, by a small team. We are hiring a senior mechanical engineer to own a large piece of that invention. You do not need to have worked on a solar array. You do need to have built something new from nothing and made it work at scale. Gama operates with extreme ownership: you own the outcome, not just the parts or the process. Your Mission Will Be To Design, develop and qualify key mechanical subsystems of an extremely lightweight deployable solar array, taking end-to-end ownership of a major share of the mechanical architecture, including panel structure and PV integration Drive design trades and analyses (structural, thermal, mechanism kinematics) from early concept through detailed design and test. Requirements at Gama are a starting hypothesis; you are expected to challenge them and make them better. Start from physics, not from heritage. Get hands-on with hardware. Prototype in the morning, put it in the thermal chamber in the afternoon, learn from what broke, iterate. We test in-house and we treat failure as data. Design for a production line, not a one-off. 100 MW a year means every part you draw has to be made thousands of times. Build robust, flight-proven solutions that meet aggressive mass and volume targets in demanding launch and orbital environments Raise the bar for the engineers around you: mentor, review, and become the person others come to when the physics gets hard. Requirements Must have Multiple full development cycles under your belt: you have taken hardware from blank sheet to working hardware more than once. Any domain: robotics, motorsport, aircraft, drones, medical devices, consumer hardware, industrial machinery, research rigs. What matters is that it did not exist before, you designed it, it got built, and it worked. First-principles mechanical engineering. Given an unfamiliar problem, you open the textbook, and find the governing equations. You can explain the "why" behind every design decision you have made. Fluency with CAD (e.g. CATIA, Siemens NX, Solidworks) and FEA tools; comfort with hand calculations to sanity-check results Strong analytical skills, a proactive attitude, excellent interpersonal skills and unbounded curiosity Autonomy, and a willingness to be fully responsible for a significant part of the finished product A proven track record of delivering reliable systems for harsh environments Roughly 5+ years of relevant experience, but we care far more about what you built than how long you have been working. Professional English. French is a plus, not a requirement. Nice to have Hands-on experience in spacecraft or launch vehicle mechanical design, ideally with direct exposure to solar array or deployable panel structures, within a fast-paced New Space environment Experience with design for manufacturing, making a design that is not only producible but easy to make This role is probably not for you if your typical work has been executing a design against a standard or requirements list handed to you, or if you are most comfortable working in a rigidly defined engineering process. At Gama, everyone is a systems engineer and we embrace the ownership and the messy reality of hardware development to produce world-changing products.

title: Senior R&D Product Engineer
description: Senior R&D Product Engineer Location: Galway (On-site) Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time This is a pivotal opportunity for an experienced engineer to join a late-stage medical device start-up during a period of significant transition and growth. As the company moves to bring the development and manufacture of a device retrieval system from a third-party partner, you will play a central role in shaping the technical direction and operational success of this key product line. This role is ideally suited to an engineer who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment and enjoys the challenge of working across the full product lifecycle. Role Overview Reporting directly to the Senior R&D Manager, the Senior R&D Product Engineer will lead and support projects from initial concept through to regulatory approval and commercial scale-up. You will be responsible for the design, manufacture, and testing of innovative medical devices, ensuring that technical excellence is maintained throughout the transition to in-house production. This is a hands-on role requiring a blend of design expertise, process validation knowledge, and the ability to troubleshoot complex manufacturing issues in real-time. Key Responsibilities - Lead R&D projects through the complete development cycle, ensuring all milestones meet regulatory requirements for 510k and PMA submissions. - Support Operations in sustaining and optimising manufacturing lines, focusing on production flow and process efficiency. - Take ownership of real-time troubleshooting, including CAPA and NCR investigations, to maintain high quality standards. - Manage the Design History File (DHF) and compile necessary documentation for EU MDR and ISO 13485 compliance. - Partner with Quality and Operations teams to develop and execute robust validation protocols and reports. - Provide technical guidance to external suppliers and mentor junior members of the engineering team. Requirements Essential: - A degree in a relevant Engineering or Science discipline. - A minimum of 5 years experience within the medical device industry. - Proven track record in product and process validation, including design verification and validation (V&V). - Proficiency in Solidworks or similar CAD software, backed by strong mechanical design fundamentals. - Excellent technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information to cross-functional teams. - A flexible, proactive approach suited to a small-team, start-up environment. Desirable: - Experience with polymer-based delivery systems, catheters, or rigid/flexible endoscopes. - Familiarity with medical device materials such as Nitinol and metallic introducers. - In-depth knowledge of FDA CFR 820/QMSR and ISO 13485 standards. - Demonstrated experience in project planning and execution. What the Opportunity Offers You will have the unique chance to lead the in-sourcing of a critical product kit, providing you with high visibility and the ability to influence the companys manufacturing strategy. The role offers a technical challenge that spans prototyping to commercialisation, providing a breadth of experience rarely found in larger corporate structures. You will work within a collaborative, fast-paced culture that values technical autonomy and professional growth. Application Process If you are a motivated engineer looking to take the next step in your career within Galways thriving medtech hub, please submit your CV for consideration. LNKD1_IJ

title: Intern in the Mechanical Department - Structures Section
description: Intern in the Mechanical Department - Structures Section Job Requisition ID: 21052 Date Posted: 1 November 2026 Closing Date: 30 November 2026 23:59 CET/CEST Publication Method: External Only Type of Appointment (learn more): Directorate: Technology, Engineering and Quality Workplace: Noordwijk, NL Location ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands Our team and mission The Structures Section TEC-MSS is in charge of all structural engineering aspects: Structural Design and Verification Methods / Tools; Static / Dynamics / Vibro-Acoustics; Crash / Impacts / Meteoroids Absorption Analysis; Damage Tolerance / Fracture Control / Health Monitoring; Fluid Structure Interaction (e.g. Sloshing); Launcher Coupled Dynamic Analysis; Demisability / Re-Usability; Thermo-Elastic distortion; High Stability / High Precision Structures; Active / Adaptive Structures; Inflatable and Deployable Structures; Launchers / Re-Entry (Hot Structures) / Planetary Landing Vehicles; Crew Habitation / EVA Suits. The ESA Structures Section brings together a diverse team of approximately 43 engineers and specialists covering the complete structural lifecycle of space systems—from early concept development and structural sizing to analysis, verification, testing and in-flight performance. Our expertise includes structural design and analysis, loads and coupled-loads analysis, structural dynamics, vibro-acoustics, shock, micro-vibration, thermo-elastic performance, fracture control and fatigue, advanced materials and manufacturing, deployable structures, structural digitalisation and emerging technologies. The team supports ESA missions across Earth observation, science, exploration, telecommunications, navigation and space transportation, working closely with project teams, European industry, research organisations and partner agencies. Our mission is to ensure that European spacecraft, payloads and launch systems are structurally robust, reliable and fit for purpose throughout their operational life. We provide independent technical expertise, solve complex engineering challenges and help projects manage structural risks through sound engineering judgement and proportionate verification. Beyond direct project support, the Section develops new technologies and methodologies, preserves and shares structural-engineering knowledge, contributes to European standards and technical guidelines, and strengthens industrial capabilities. By connecting operational experience with research and innovation, we aim to anticipate future needs and maintain Europe’s technical excellence and autonomy in spacecraft structures. Candidates interested are encouraged to visit the ESA website: http://www.esa.int Field(s) of activity for the internship You will contribute to the development and analysis of advanced structural solutions for space systems. The internship will focus on applying modern design, simulation, and testing methods to improve the performance, reliability, and efficiency of spacecraft structures. Depending on your background and interests, you may work in one of several key domains, such as: structural optimisation: exploring lightweight and high-performance structural concepts through numerical and computational design methods; fracture control and damage tolerance: supporting studies and simulations related to material strength, crack propagation, and structural integrity in extreme environments; vibro-acoustics: analysing vibration and acoustic environments during launch and their influence on structural behaviour; ultra-stable structures: investigating thermo-elastic stability and precision design techniques for optical or scientific payloads; hypervelocity impacts: studying the effects of micrometeoroid and debris impacts on spacecraft structures and assessing protection or resilience strategies through modelling and test data. You will learn how advanced structural engineering is applied to real space missions, gaining hands-on experience with modelling tools, simulation techniques, and engineering processes. Throughout the internship, you will be supported by experienced mentors who will help you connect theoretical knowledge with practical challenges in spacecraft design and verification. Learning outcomes include developing a system-level understanding of spacecraft structures, applying modern analytical and computational methods, and strengthening problem-solving and communication skills in a multidisciplinary engineering environment. Behavioural competencies Result Orientation Operational Efficiency Fostering Cooperation Relationship Management Continuous Improvement Forward Thinking For more information, please refer to ESA Core Behavioural Competencies guidebook Education You must be a university student, preferably in your final or second-to-last year of university course at Master's level. title: Intern in the Projects Department - EnVision Project: Thermo-Elastic Modelling
description: Intern in the Projects Department - EnVision Project: Thermo-Elastic Modelling Job Requisition ID: 20952 Date Posted: 1 November 2026 Closing Date: 30 November 2026 23:59 CET/CEST Publication Method: External Only Type of Appointment (learn more): Directorate: Science Workplace: Noordwijk, NL Location ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands Our team and mission EnVision is a Venus orbiter mission selected by ESA’s Science Programme Committee as the fifth Medium-class mission in the Agency’s Cosmic Vision plan. It will be the first mission to investigate Venus from its inner core to its upper atmosphere, characterising the interaction between its atmosphere, surface/subsurface and interior. It aims at providing a holistic view of Venus, studying the planet’s history, activity, and climate. The project team in which this internship is proposed is in charge of the implementation of the mission: the procurement of the spacecraft and the launch vehicle and the liaising with the developers of the instruments that will be embarked on EnVision. As with most Science missions, the instruments are provided by Member States, with ESA providing several specific payload elements. At the time of writing (September 2026), the EnVision spacecraft is undergoing the Preliminary Design Review. This proposed activity is of significant interest to the EnVision project, as thermo-elastic distortion analyses play a key role in the verification of several mission performance requirements, particularly those related to the pointing stability of scientific instruments or the link budget of communication antennae. Candidates interested are encouraged to visit the ESA website: http://www.esa.int Field(s) of activity for the internship Topic of the internship: Improving Thermo-Elastic Modelling of Spacecraft and Payload Coupling You will be part of the EnVision project team at ESA's European Space Research and Technology Centre and will work closely with spacecraft engineering specialists and experts from the ESA Technical Directorate. Your task will be to investigate how interactions between a spacecraft platform and its payload equipment influence thermo-elastic distortions, and how these effects can be represented more accurately and efficiently in engineering analyses. Starting from the existing EnVision thermo-elastic analysis model, you will enhance the spacecraft structural model by integrating representations of payload instruments, electronics units, and other heat-dissipating equipment. You will then perform thermo-elastic analyses to evaluate how the thermal and structural behaviour of these units affects the deformation of the spacecraft structure. A particular focus of the work will be to assess coupling effects between payload equipment and the spacecraft platform. You will investigate how temperature gradients and structural stiffness within payload units and electronics boxes influence the deformation of the spacecraft panels on which they are mounted, and how these distortions may propagate to neighbouring areas supporting other sensitive instruments. Based on your findings, you will develop simplified modelling approaches that can reproduce the key coupling effects without requiring the use of highly detailed models. These simplified representations could significantly improve analysis efficiency while maintaining the accuracy needed for engineering assessments. Finally, you will evaluate the extent to which separate analyses of the spacecraft platform and payload units can reproduce the results of a fully integrated thermo-elastic analysis. Where appropriate, you will propose methods to better capture platform-to-payload interactions when payload units are analysed independently. The results of this work could contribute to improving future thermo-elastic modelling practices and increasing the representativeness of performance predictions for space missions. Using the EnVision mission as a case study, you will explore modelling aspects that are often neglected in conventional analyses and help identify practical methods to account for spacecraft-payload coupling effects. During this internship, you will gain experience in: thermo-elastic analysis of spacecraft structures; structural and thermal modelling using finite element methods; interpretation of spacecraft performance impacts arising from thermo-mechanical distortions; development and validation of simplified engineering models; collaboration with multidisciplinary spacecraft engineering teams; application of advanced analysis techniques to a real ESA space mission. In addition, you must be able to prove that you will be enrolled at your university for the entire duration of the internship. Additional Requirements The working languages of the Agency are English and French. A good knowledge of one of these is required. Knowledge of another ESA Member State language is an asset. title: Stagiair Werktuigbouwkunde (Zwolle, NL)
description: Functietitel: Stagiair Werktuigbouwkunde Recruiter: Mark Hietkamp Vacature-ID: 4622 Voor ons team Ontwerp & aanleg zijn wij op zoek naar een proactieve derde- of vierdejaars stagiair. Ben jij een hbo-student Werktuigbouwkunde of Technische Bedrijfskunde en wil je bijdragen aan een belangrijk vraagstuk binnen de drinkwatersector? Tijdens deze afstudeer- of meewerkstage onderzoek je de toepassing van pneumatische en elektrische aandrijvingen voor vlinderkleppen binnen Vitens. Je combineert technische analyses met bedrijfseconomische inzichten en levert een concreet standaardisatieadvies waarmee Vitens haar installaties efficiënter, betrouwbaarder en toekomstbestendig kan beheren. Je krijgt de kans om zelfstandig onderzoek uit te voeren, samen te werken met technische specialisten en direct impact te maken op de keuzes die Vitens maakt voor haar infrastructuur. Geen dag is hetzelfde en je draagt bij aan iets belangrijks: Iedere dag 1 miljard liter drinkwater van topkwaliteit winnen, zuiveren en leveren. Elke druppel telt! Waar jij mee aan de slag gaat Tijdens deze stage onderzoek je de technische, operationele en economische prestaties van pneumatische en elektrische afsluiteraandrijvingen binnen Vitens. Je vertaalt jouw bevindingen naar een objectieve Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)-analyse en een onderbouwd advies voor standaardisatie. Belangrijke taken Onderzoeken en analyseren van bestaande installaties met pneumatische en elektrische actuatoren Verzamelen en beoordelen van gegevens over investeringskosten, energieverbruik, onderhoud en betrouwbaarheid Ontwikkelen van een TCO-model voor beide aandrijfconcepten Vergelijken van technische prestaties, onderhoudsbehoefte, fail-safe eigenschappen en benodigde infrastructuur Opstellen van een onderbouwd standaardisatieadvies voor de toepassing van afsluiteraandrijvingen binnen Vitens Je werkt samen met verschillende technische collega’s en krijgt inzicht in zowel de operationele als strategische kant van de afdeling Ontwerp & aanleg. Daarmee lever je een concrete bijdrage aan de optimalisatie van vitale drinkwaterinstallaties. Wat breng jij mee? We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wie jij bent én wat jij kunt. Belangrijk is dat jij jezelf bent én een analytische en nieuwsgierige houding meebrengt. Die zien we terug in het uitvoeren van technische analyses en het vertalen van data naar concrete adviezen. Verder rekenen we op jou: Je volgt een hbo-opleiding in Werktuigbouwkunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare technische studie Je hebt affiniteit met technische installaties en procesoptimalisatie Je kunt data analyseren en gestructureerd verwerken in rapportages Je werkt zelfstandig en neemt initiatief in je onderzoek Je communiceert helder en werkt prettig samen met verschillende stakeholders Je hebt interesse in techniek, duurzaamheid en infrastructuur Zo zorgen wij voor jou Als Stagiair Werktuigbouwkunde draai je mee in een enthousiast team en krijg je de mogelijkheid om praktijkervaring op te doen. Het aantal uren en stagedagen stemmen we samen af. Daarnaast bieden wij onder andere de volgende arbeidsvoorwaarden: Een stagevergoeding van € 525,00 per maand Een reiskostenvergoeding conform de CAO Waterbedrijven Deelname aan de Dag van de Stagiair en andere activiteiten binnen Vitens Een leerzame stage met professionele begeleiding en ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling Onze toekomst, jouw toekomst Meewerken aan het toekomstbestendig maken van ons drinkwatervoorziening? Dan ontvangen wij graag je sollicitatie. Vragen over de procedure? Kijk hier naar de sollicitatieprocedure binnen Vitens of stel je vragen aan onze recruiter Mark Hietkamp via Mark.Hietkamp@vitens.nl. Meer weten over de inhoud van de functie? Mail teammanager George Keijzer via george.keijzer@vitens.nl Samen elke druppel duurzaam Wij hebben als grootste drinkwaterbedrijf het doel om voor 2030 elke druppel duurzaam te maken. Benieuwd hoe wij dit willen realiseren? Kijk dan even op Over Vitens | Vitens. Vitens is belangrijk voor de basisvoorzieningen in onze maatschappij. Daarom vragen wij altijd een screening aan voordat we iemand aannemen. Onderdeel van deze screening is het aanleveren van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG). title: Mechanical Design Engineer – Photonic Hardware
description: PsiQuantum’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems. Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale. PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies—including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical—to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact. Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift—and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real. Come join us. Job Summary We are looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to support the development of next-generation photonic hardware systems. This is an R&D role focused on the mechanical and thermal design, prototyping and validation of high-specification hardware for demanding optical quantum computing. The role will involve developing robust, testable and manufacturable hardware for controlled operating environments, working closely with photonics, systems and architecture colleagues, as well as external partners and suppliers. It will suit a serious engineer with experience of precision experimental or industrial hardware, who is motivated by solving difficult multidisciplinary engineering problems and translating novel concepts into reliable hardware. We welcome candidates from both conventional academic routes and hands-on engineering pathways, including those who have developed equivalent experience through apprenticeships, national laboratories, experimental physics facilities, or advanced industrial R&D. Responsibilities Contribute to the mechanical design of precision hardware systems, from early concepts through prototype build and validation. Develop enclosure, packaging and internal layout solutions for hardware operating in controlled or stability-critical environments. Design mechanically robust solutions for precision assemblies, including routing, handling, support and integration of sensitive components. Support the development of thermal management and temperature stabilisation approaches, including environmental control and, where appropriate, active feedback methods. Carry out mechanical and thermal analysis and simulation to inform design choices and identify technical risks. Plan and execute validation activities to assess mechanical stability, thermal performance, environmental sensitivity and repeatability. Work with photonics, systems architecture and experimental teams to translate system requirements into practical hardware designs. Engage with suppliers and external collaborators on components, fabrication methods, manufacturability and assembly approaches. Support prototype build activities, including design documentation, drawings, procurement, assembly planning and test support. Contribute to the development of hardware that can move from laboratory demonstrator to repeatable and manufacturable system. Experience/Qualifications Required Degree, apprenticeship-based qualification, or equivalent practical experience in mechanical engineering, physics, engineering science, hardware design or a related discipline. Around 1–2 years of relevant post-degree or post-PhD experience, or equivalent hands-on experience in a demanding engineering environment. title: Robotics Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: Who We Are Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. The role Based in Barcelona, this role sits at the heart of Helsing's robotics engineering function, responsible for driving the mechanical architecture, design, and development of next-generation robotic systems. You will own complex electromechanical systems from concept through to production, ensuring platforms are robust, scalable, and built for real-world deployment. Working closely with electrical, firmware, and software engineers, you will bring both technical depth and cross-functional leadership to a team building some of the most consequential technology in European defence The day-to-day Lead the detailed design and integration of complex robotic subsystems, including high-precision actuators, structural chassis, and dynamic motion systems, translating high-level concepts into robust 3D assemblies and comprehensive engineering drawing packages. Drive cross-functional integration with electrical and software teams to ensure seamless packaging, cable routing, and thermal and sensor integration, resolving technical challenges across the full development cycle. Define material selection strategies and fabrication methods, conducting FEA, stress analysis, and tolerance stack-up analysis to ensure designs meet rigorous functional, cost, yield, and lead-time requirements. Establish and advocate for mechanical engineering best practices, including modelling standards, GD&T drawing controls, and technical documentation, raising quality across the team. Critically evaluate system architectures in design reviews, identifying risks and delivering high-impact solutions that optimise performance and manufacturability from prototype through to production ramp-up. You should apply if you Have shipped complex robotic, mechatronic, or automated systems to market, with a verifiable track record of ownership across the full product development cycle. Bring expert-level proficiency in 3D CAD modelling, ideally SolidWorks, combined with deep knowledge of GD&T for precision manufacturing environments. Have applied structural and thermal FEA, static simulations, and tolerance stack-up analysis to solve real engineering problems in production-grade systems. Have worked extensively across diverse manufacturing processes, including CNC machining, injection moulding, sheet metal fabrication, and additive manufacturing, in high-mix or low-to-medium volume environments. Communicate complex technical decisions with clarity to cross-functional stakeholders, from firmware engineers to programme leadership, driving alignment without sacrificing rigour. Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. Nice to Have Experience architecting high-performance, high-power-density actuators and advanced mechatronic systems for legged robotics platforms. Background working in agile, small-scale mechanical design teams, with direct experience taking full technical ownership from early concept through to serial production. Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about What we offer Competitive salary and VSOP options Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health) Social: regular company events and monthly social allowances Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary care

title: Mechanical Engineer – Desktop SEM
description: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Laboratory Setting, Office Position Summary As a Mechanical Engineer , you will design and develop precision mechanical systems for our advanced Desktop Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM) products. Working closely with Systems Engineering, Electronics, Software, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Quality, and Service, you will contribute throughout the product lifecycle—from early concepts and detailed design through verification, manufacturing introduction, and product improvements. This role is part of the expansion of our Brno Development Center , working closely with our Innovation and Architecture team in Eindhoven. Our Technology Our Desktop SEM business develops advanced scanning electron microscopes used worldwide in materials science, manufacturing, research, and quality assurance. Our products combine: Electron optics and vacuum technology Precision mechanics and mechatronics Embedded electronics Scientific software and user interfaces Image acquisition and analysis Manufacturing automation and system integration Key Responsibilities Design and develop precision mechanical assemblies and subsystems for Desktop SEM products. Translate system requirements into practical and manufacturable mechanical solutions. Develop 3D designs, engineering drawings, and technical documentation using Siemens NX. Apply precision engineering principles including tolerance analysis and GD&T. Consider structural, vibration, thermal, and vacuum requirements throughout the design process. Perform engineering trade-off studies and contribute to mechanical architecture decisions. Support mechanical verification, validation, system integration, and product release. Participate in design reviews, technical investigations, and engineering changes. Work closely with suppliers and manufacturing on component development and qualification. Support New Product Introduction (NPI) and manufacturing transfer. Contribute to root-cause investigations and product improvements. Share technical knowledge and contribute to mechanical engineering best practices within the Brno Development Center. What We’re Looking For Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field. Extensive experience in mechanical design within high-tech product development. Strong experience designing precision mechanical systems and assemblies. Proficiency with Siemens NX CAD. Experience with tolerance analysis and GD&T. Understanding of structural, vibration, and thermal behavior of mechanical systems. Experience with vacuum systems, precision mechatronics, or similar high-precision technologies. Experience working with manufacturing and suppliers. Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills. Excellent communication skills in English. Opgaverne spænder bredt – fra dæksudrustning til maskineri – og fællesnævneren er, at udstyret skal være robust, driftssikkert og let at betjene. Samtidig skal det indpasses i et design, hvor pladsen ofte er begrænset, og hvor der tænkes i fremtidige ændringer og udvidelser. Samtidig er det er mindst lige så vigtigt at du lægger vægt på at være på forkant med den teknologiske udvikling, hvor du ser øgede krav til bæredygtighed og omkostningseffektivitet som en mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling. title: Electro-Acoustic Engineer
description: Electro Acoustic Development Engineer If electro acoustic development of hearing instruments throughout the spectra form concept to finial product seems interesting, and if having fun at work makes you smile, then read on! We may just have the job for you. In the Device Hardware area, we are looking for an Electro Acoustic engineer to expand our team. You will work with product development using cutting-edge tools in well-equipped modern facilities with the goal of developing the best hardware for our hearing instruments. Join the Hardware development team As an electro acoustic developer, you would be part of an agile development team with responsibility for design and verification of the electroacoustic concepts. We focus on delivering solutions that enable us to deliver high-quality hearing instrument solutions, including in-depth transducer knowledge and development of new acoustic concepts for future products. We are depending on, and facilitating, in-depth knowledge about vibroacoustic behavior of subsystems and complete hearing aid solutions. We participate in product development as well as maturation of concepts, before they are used in product development. Sometimes we participate in after launch activities as well. Building, documenting and sharing knowledge is key to our success. Communication of key findings and results gained in is cross functional cooperation with mechanical and electronics developers in our Agile Release Trains are sessional. Building innovative Electro Acoustic Solutions In collaboration with skilled team members within your own Agile Release Train, you will work to innovate electro acoustic and mechanical solutions that elevate the experience of both end-users and customers. The excitement this group faces daily is the development of highly complex platforms, due to the high degree of functionality that hearing instruments offer. Furthermore, we focus on developing our platforms to fit multiple brands, adding to the complexity. The team works closely together with other professionals, i.e., audiologists and engineers specializing in amplifiers and embedded systems. The biggest hardware challenge is to develop a platform that provides the needed acoustical gain and at the same time securing a good mechanical and acoustic feedback margin. Here a close cooperation with the mechanical engineers and the pre-production team is crucial for a good result. You will be involved in: Acoustic systemdesign and Development Platform calibration/settings Design specifications Selection of components i.e. transducers – microphones, receivers/speakers Testing, verifying and documenting electro-acoustical performance of HW platforms Effort estimation and planning done in an agile framework In the role of Electro Acoustic Developer, you will collaborate with skilled team members to advance the design of next-generation cutting-edge hearing instruments. Apart from working together with motivated colleagues you will experience that we have great focus on your skills development, the department’s professional skills and in Work-life balance. You can expect 1-5 travel days a year, visiting suppliers and our production site in Poland. Qualifications We expect you to hold a degree in Engineering, focusing specifically on electro acoustics. We anticipate that you possess strong qualifications in Sound Quality, Acoustic measurements, vibro-acoustics, and sound path design. Knowledge from working with electro acoustic or magnetic designs of hearing instruments or other smaller products such as cell phones, headsets or similar is an advantage. You perform best in a vibrant atmosphere and enjoy partnering with experienced coworkers to make the most of your skills. We offer further development opportunities and believe Oticon is a good place to develop your career further. As a person, you are proud of your profession, curious and a team player by heart. You have good communication skills and enjoy networking and navigating in a delivery driven, cross-functional organization with several parallel development tracs. Apply Please send your CV and motivation letter no later than November 15th, 2026. Interview are planned for November 20th and 23nd and 2. Interview are planned for November 26., 2026 If you would like to know more about the position, you are welcome to contact. Team Manager, Anders Eriksen on aens@demant.com. We are looking forward to hearing from you. At Demant we value diversity, equity, and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is p art of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

Vårt kontor i Jönköping ligger i nyrenoverade lokaler med historisk karaktär, med närhet till både Jönköpings centrum och den växande Munksjöstaden. Vi erbjuder förmåner såsom kollektivavtal, friskvård, sjukvårdsförsäkring, föräldraledighetstillägg och tjänstepension.
