title: Senior Design Engineer
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. The Company At Volvo Construction Equipment you will contribute to the transformation of our company, the transport industry and society at large. The Volvo Construction Equipment Haulers Ltd. site located in Motherwell, Scotland, has designed and manufactured Rigid trucks for over 70 years for distribution around the globe. About The Role Do you dream big? We do too, and we are excited to grow together. As a Senior Engineer provides technical leadership and engineering expertise for the Volvo Rigid Hauler product platform, delivering robust mechanical, structural and hydraulic engineering solutions throughout the product lifecycle. Working with cross-functional teams and suppliers, the role supports the development of safe, reliable, cost-effective and customer-focused products that meet performance, quality and business objectives. Key Responsibilities Provide technical expertise across the Rigid Hauler Product Platform. Lead, or support, technical investigations relating to component performance, durability, reliability, and lifecycle management. Support the definition, development, integration, and validation of machine systems and subsystems. Develop engineering solutions that optimise performance, quality, manufacturability, serviceability, and total product cost. Create and review 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, and supporting technical documentation. Apply structured engineering methodologies and processes, including New Product Introduction (NPI), Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), and design reviews. Ensure compliance with internal engineering standards, industry standards, and regulatory requirements. Engage effectively with Purchasing, Manufacturing, Quality, Aftermarket, and Supplier partners to ensure successful project delivery. Support continuous improvement activities through data-driven problem solving and implementation of lessons learned. Contribute to technology development, product strategy, and future platform evolution. Skills, Qualities And Experience Essential Skills, Qualities and Experience Degree qualified (BSc/BEng or equivalent) in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Demonstrated experience in the design, analysis, or application of structural and/or mechanical systems used in heavy-duty equipment, large capital equipment, or mobile machinery. Experience working within architecture-based product development environments involving integrated components and subsystems. Proven ability to lead technical investigations and drive engineering solutions from concept through implementation. Proficiency in 3D CAD modelling using modern engineering design software. Well-developed understanding of engineering design principles and lifecycle management practices. Experience applying recognised engineering tools and methodologies, including NPI, FMEA, FTA, design standards, and technical specifications. Well-developed analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured and data-driven approach. title: Mechanical Engineer | NL Based & Dutch Speaking
description: Please apply only if you currently live in the Netherlands and speak Dutch fluently. Both requirements are mandatory. Voor onze engineeringafdeling in Barneveld zoeken wij een werktuigbouwkundige engineer voor 32 tot 40 uur per week. Wil jij meewerken aan innovatieve machines die lasten tot maar liefst 200 ton kunnen tillen en verplaatsen? In deze veelzijdige functie ontwerp en bereken je klantspecifieke hefoplossingen en begeleid je jouw projecten van A tot Z. Van het eerste technische ontwerp en de sterkteberekeningen tot het testen en de uiteindelijke inbedrijfstelling. Je combineert werktuigbouwkundige kennis met praktische techniek en ziet jouw ontwerpen tot leven komen in onze eigen fabriek. Salaris en voorwaarden Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de €3.000 en €4.500 (o.b.v. fulltime en ervaring); Fulltime functie voor de lange termijn, of minimaal 32 uur per week; 30 vakantiedagen, waarvan 5 vooraf ingepland; 8% vakantiegeld en pensioenopbouw; Laptop van de zaak; Reiskostenvergoeding; Hybride werken in Barneveld en testen/inbedrijfname in onze fabriek in Hengevelde. Wat je kunt verwachten Innovatieve projecten die een echte impact hebben in diverse industrieën; Een veelzijdige functie bij een internationaal bedrijf met combinatie van ontwerp en praktijk; Een prettige werksfeer met ruimte voor eigen inbreng; Donderdagmiddagborrel en iedere maand een dönerdag die heel creatief aangekondigd wordt. Wat breng je mee? Een afgeronde HBO opleiding (Werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar); Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal; Affiniteit met hijsmiddelen en zware machinebouw is een pré; Een zelfstandige, flexibele en initiatiefrijke instelling. Over de functie Als Mechanical Engineer bij Aerolift ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen en berekenen van geavanceerde machines met een hefcapaciteit van 1 tot maar liefst 200 ton. Als werktuigbouwkundig engineer profiteer je van onze eigen productie, doordat je direct ziet hoe jouw ontwerpen in de praktijk tot leven komen. Dit versnelt je leerproces en geeft je de unieke kans om de impact van je werk echt te ervaren. Je werkt in een klein, hecht team waarin je je eigen projecten van A tot Z oppakt. Jij zorgt voor een strakke begeleiding van het project: je signaleert knelpunten, bewaakt de planning en bent betrokken bij alle stappen; van het ontwerp en de berekeningen tot het selecteren van grote inkoopdelen, de productie, het testen en het inbedrijfstellen van de machine. Daarbij heb je rechtstreeks contact met klanten en leveranciers. Naast de projecten voor Aerolift werk je ook aan technische oplossingen en engineeringprojecten voor ons zusterbedrijf Niconlift. Dit zorgt voor extra diversiteit en technische uitdagingen binnen je functie. In deze rol krijg je te maken met alle facetten van techniek: van constructies en hydrauliek tot elektrische installaties en besturingstechniek. Geen project is hetzelfde; elke keer zet je jouw technische creativiteit en kennis in om een oplossing te creëren die precies past bij de situatie. Jouw taken op een rij: Sparren met de verkoopafdeling over de technische oplossing; Het bedenken en ontwerpen van klantspecifieke hefoplossingen, gedeeltelijk in teamverband; Projecten begeleiden in nauw contact met leveranciers, klanten en collega’s; Het maken van tekeningen en stuklijsten; Het maken van de benodigde sterkteberekeningen; Het selecteren van aandrijvingen en besturingen; Het ondersteunen van onze collega’s in de fabriek bij de fabricage en het testen van onze machines; Bijdragen aan de verdere standaardisatie en modularisatie van onze ontwerpen door het ontwikkelen van herbruikbare technische modules en het uitbreiden en optimaliseren van de engineeringdatabase. Over ons Aerolift is al meer dan 60 jaar gespecialiseerd in het ontwerpen en bouwen van hijssystemen en handlingsoplossingen voor verschillende lasten, zoals beton, tunnelsegmenten, metalen platen, buizen en papierrollen. Onze vacuümheffers, vacuümkantelaars, mechanische spreaders en C-haken hebben hefcapaciteit van 1 tot 200 ton en bevatten doordachte techniek, zowel mechanisch, elektrisch als hydraulisch. Deze hefoplossingen produceren wij volledig in onze eigen fabriek, voordat ze wereldwijd naar onze eindklanten worden verscheept. Ons zusterbedrijf Niconlift biedt efficiënte laad- en losoplossingen voor exceptioneel transport met afneembare sideloadersystemen voor het hanteren van zware kabelhaspels en transformatorhuizen. Wie wij zoeken Om deze rol succesvol te kunnen uitvoeren, is het belangrijk dat jij in staat bent een machine van A tot Z te bedenken, te berekenen en te tekenen, zodat deze gebouwd kan worden. Hierbij is het van groot belang om nauwkeurig te werk te gaan en kwalitatief goed werk te leveren. Ervaring is geen vereiste voor deze functie; we zoeken vooral naar talent en potentieel. Of je nu net bent afgestudeerd of al enkele jaren werkervaring hebt, we nodigen je uit om te solliciteren. Interesse? Stuur je CV en korte motivatie naar hr@aerolift.nl of bel ons via 0346 354 333. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Aan cv’s die ongevraagd door bureaus worden aangeleverd kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend.

title: Junior System- und Projektingenieur (m/w/d) HVAC & Hilfssysteme Offshore Wind

Unsere 361° Offshore Expertise steht für ganzheitliche Unterstützung über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus – plus das eine Grad, das den Unterschied macht. So entstehen vielfältige Möglichkeiten für deine berufliche Entwicklung – in unseren eigenen Teams oder in spannenden Projekteinsätzen bei unseren Kunden. Für unser Engineering-Team in Hamburg suchen wir eine*n Junior System- und Projektingenieur (m/w/d) HVAC & Hilfssysteme für Offshore-Plattformen Startdatum : ab sofort| Standort : Hamburg | Arbeitsmodell : Hybrid | Beschäftigungsart : Festanstellung In dieser Position wirst du Teil unseres internen Teams bei SeaRenergy und arbeitest direkt an Themen mit, die unsere Projekte, Fachbereiche und Unternehmensgruppe voranbringen. Dazu gehören je nach Projekt Lüftung, Heizung und Kühlung, Kühlwasser, Trinkwasser, Sanitär und Entwässerung, Druckluft sowie Dieselversorgung. Du arbeitest an der Definition von Systemgrenzen, Schnittstellen, Betriebskonzepten sowie Redundanz- und Wartungsanforderungen mit und lernst, Systemverhalten im Normalbetrieb, bei Ausfällen, Notfällen und Wartung zu bewerten. Du erstellst und überarbeitest unter Anleitung technische Unterlagen wie Auslegungsberechnungen, Layouts, P&IDs, Schemata, technische Spezifikationen und Equipmentlisten. Du stimmst dich mit den Disziplinen Elektro, Struktur, Rohrleitungsbau, Architektur, Brandschutz, Automatisierung und Installation ab und lernst die Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden, Lieferanten und externen Engineering-Partnern kennen. Du prüfst Lieferantendokumentation gegen Projektanforderungen und einschlägige Normen und wirkst bei Design Reviews, Risikobewertungen (z. B. FMEA) und der technischen Beschaffung mit. Du begleitest Fertigung, Installation, Tests und Inbetriebnahme und lernst dabei die Praxis auf Werften und – nach entsprechenden Sicherheitstrainings – auch offshore kennen. Du bringst dich in Projekte und Angebote ein, etwa bei Aufwandsschätzungen und der Abgrenzung von Engineering-Leistungen. Dein Profil erfüllt die meisten der folgenden Anforderungen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung: Abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) im Maschinenbau, Schiffbau/Schiffstechnik, in der Versorgungstechnik/TGA oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Erste praktische Erfahrungen im maritimen Umfeld, z. B. durch Praxissemester, Werkstudententätigkeit oder Abschlussarbeit in den Bereichen Offshore-Wind, Offshore-Plattformen, Schiffbau oder Schiffstechnik. Grundkenntnisse in HVAC und mechanischen Hilfssystemen, z. B. Thermodynamik, Lüftungs- und Klimatechnik oder Fluidsysteme. Erste Erfahrung mit einem CAD-Tool (z. B. AutoCAD, Inventor, SolidWorks, Revit, Siemens NX) und die Bereitschaft, dich in unsere Tools einzuarbeiten. Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Berechnungen, Risikoanalysen wie FMEA oder technischer Dokumentation. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse für technische Abstimmungen und Dokumentation sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, Freude an Teamarbeit und die Bereitschaft, regelmäßig im Hamburger Büro zu arbeiten und zu Kunden, Werften und Offshore-Anlagen zu reisen. Mitarbeiterempfehlungsprämie – Empfiehl einen Kandidaten aus deinem Netzwerk und erhalte bis zu 3.000 €, nachdem dieser seine Probezeit erfolgreich abgeschlossen hat. BusinessBike-Leasing – Lease oder kaufe dein Fahrrad über eine steuerbegünstigte Gehaltsumwandlung, mit Paketen von Basic bis Pro. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge – Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 20 % für alle Voll- und Teilzeitbeschäftigten, in Zusammenarbeit mit Bernhard Assekuranzmakler. An unserem Hauptsitz in Hamburg bieten wir eine Reihe von Benefits, die jeden Arbeitstag angenehmer machen: Modernes Büro & angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre – Unser neuer Standort im Herzen Hamburgs (Holstenhof/Gänsemarkt) bietet ein offenes, modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Raum für Austausch, Zusammenarbeit und kurze Kommunikationswege im Team. Lunch & Team-Momente – Ein großzügiger Mitarbeiterbereich lädt zu gemeinsamen Pausen, spontanen Gesprächen oder einer entspannten Mittagspause mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen ein. Weiterentwicklung & Performance-Reviews – Deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung ist uns wichtig. In regelmäßigen Performance-Reviews besprechen wir gemeinsam deine nächsten Entwicklungsschritte und unterstützen dich aktiv bei deiner fachlichen Weiterbildung. Duscheinrichtungen vor Ort – Ideal, wenn du vor der Arbeit Sport machst oder dich zwischendurch kurz frisch machen möchtest. Dich erwartet eine abwechslungsreiche Position mit viel Eigeninitiative und Verantwortung in einem dynamischen Team im Offshore-Windenergie-Umfeld, in der du wertvolle praktische Erfahrungen sammelst und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterentwickelst. Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Bewirb dich gerne auch dann, wenn dein Profil nicht in allen Punkten der Ausschreibung entspricht, da wir Lernbereitschaft ebenso schätzen wie fachliche Kompetenz.

Long-term career development opportunities within a dynamic construction environment. 👉If you are an ambitious graduate looking for an opportunity to learn, grow and make an impact, we would love to hear from you. title: SENIOR R&D MECHANICAL ENGINEER
description: La figura ricercata entrerà a far parte del team R&D per lo sviluppo meccanico di nuovi prodotti e l'evoluzione delle piattaforme esistenti. Sarà coinvolta lungo l'intero ciclo di sviluppo, dall'ideazione all'industrializzazione, assicurando prestazioni, affidabilità e qualità. Un'opportunità per professionisti che desiderano operare su prodotti proprietari ad elevata complessità tecnica e con impatto concreto sul business. Dettagli sul cliente L'azienda è una realtà industriale italiana ad alta specializzazione tecnologica, riconosciuta per lo sviluppo e la produzione di sistemi elettromeccanici, soluzioni di controllo e tecnologie ndel settore building automation. Oggi parte di uno dei principali Gruppi multinazionali a livello globale, rappresenta un hub strategico di Ricerca & Sviluppo all'interno dell'organizzazione internazionale. Forte di una consolidata presenza sui mercati internazionali e di una filiera di competenze completamente integrata, l'azienda presidia internamente tutte le fasi del ciclo di sviluppo prodotto, dalla progettazione meccanica ed elettronica alla validazione, certificazione e industrializzazione. In questo contesto, il sito italiano svolge un ruolo centrale nello sviluppo di piattaforme tecnologiche proprietarie destinate a mercati globali caratterizzati da elevati standard di affidabilità, performance e conformità normativa. L'HQ si trova vicino a nella Provincia Nord di Treviso. (Essential) Applicare i requisiti normativi relativi ai prodotti aziendali Redigere e gestire la documentazione tecnica progettuale di modo sia conforme agli standard aziendali Assicurare la tracciabilità delle modifiche e la corretta gestione del ciclo di vita del prodotto Contribuire all'introduzione di nuove tecnologie e all'evoluzione delle piattaforme prodotto esistenti Individuare opportunità di innovazione, standardizzazione e miglioramento continuo. Collaborare con Project Manager e Product Owner per garantire il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di costo, tempi e qualità. Applicare logiche di Design for Manufacturing & Assembly (DFMA) per migliorare qualità, affidabilità ed efficienza produttiva Contribuire ad attività di cost optimization e value engineering Favorire il riutilizzo di componenti e piattaforme tecnologiche comuni. Supportare le scelte progettuali garantendo la corretta integrazione delle diverse tecnologie coinvolte. Innovazione e Proprietà Intellettuale Contribuire allo sviluppo di nuove soluzioni tecniche e concept innovativi. Contribuire alle attività di tutela della proprietà intellettuale e alla valorizzazione delle soluzioni innovative sviluppate. title: R&D Design Engineer - Product Company
description: Are you passionate about engineering innovation and eager to make a real impact? At our Product Company, we’re looking for a Design Engineer to join our dynamic team and contribute to the development of next-generation piston compressor machines . We’re on a mission to introduce new, energy-efficient, high-performance, and environmentally conscious products to the compressor market. As a Design Engineer, you’ll play a key role in turning ideas into reality, transforming concepts into prototypes and supporting the journey to full-scale industrialization. If you will join us in this role you will initiate new projects and follow up existing ones, reporting to the R&D Engineering Team Leader and cooperating with the Project Leader and Test Engineer to create an efficient and effective R&D organization. What will you be responsible for as Design Engineer? Support the entire development process—from component design to full machine validation. Create technical drawings, perform calculations, and conduct testing. Collaborate closely with the Project Team, applying your technical leadership to bring innovative technologies from concept to product. Focus on maximizing customer value while minimizing waste. Work alongside the R&D Engineering Team Leader, Project Leader, and Test Engineer to ensure efficient and effective project execution. What do we expect from you? A degree in Industrial or Mechanical Engineering. 3–5 years of experience in design and process manufacturing, ideally in an industrial design environment. Strong skills in CAD design, mechanical parts calculation, and BOM management. A keen eye for detail and a hands-on approach to problem-solving. A self-motivated team player who thrives in multidisciplinary environments. You’re full of energy, eager to collaborate, and ready to bring your technical expertise and fresh ideas to tackle the challenges of product development. You take pride in your work and are driven by results. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and experience with Inventor or similar CAD tools. Fluency in English (written and spoken). What we offer A challenging role in a global, fast-growing environment Opportunities for professional and personal development Collaboration with a highly skilled and passionate international team Multiple career paths within Atlas Copco Group Compensation & Benefit Permanent contract White-collar employee, Level B1, National Collective Labour Agreement (CCNL) for the Metalworking Industry The offered salary starts from €33,000 gross per year, with a higher starting point available for candidates bringing relevant experience and expertise Collective profit-sharing bonus Additional fixed company premium Fully company-paid canteen service Flexible Benefits Platform Dedicated psychological support services to support employees’ wellbeing The overall compensation package offered will be determined based on various factors, including, but not limited to, internal pay equity, level of responsibility, and the experience and skills of the selected candidate. Where will you be based? You will join Abac Aria Compressa Product Company in Robassomero, Turin Area, Italy . Abac Aria Compressa is part of the Industrial Air Division of the Atlas Copco Group , a world-leading business operating in more than 180 countries. Diversity & Inclusion ariac srl is committed to and promotes equal opportunities. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, nationality, disability, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. Why join us? If you want to be part of a global business , work on innovative compressor technologies , and contribute to delivering excellence to customers worldwide—this could be your next challenge. Uniting curious minds Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

title: Mechanical Development Engineer
description: As a Mechanical Development Engineer( Hydrophone Sensor) at Optics11, you contribute to the development and engineering realization of the hydrophone sensor subsystem throughout the product development lifecycle. You translate allocated product and subsystem requirements into robust engineering solutions while developing your technical expertise in underwater sensor technology. The hydrophone sensor subsystem comprises the acoustic sensing element, mechanical housing, internal structural components, sealing concepts, and associated mechanical interfaces that enable reliable underwater sensing performance. Working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team, you contribute to developing, improving, and maturing subsystem solutions that support successful product realization. You work closely with Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, manufacturing partners, and other subsystem development teams to develop reliable hydrophone sensor solutions while continuously expanding your technical capability. Key Responsibilities: Contribute to the development and realization of the hydrophone sensor subsystem throughout the product development lifecycle. Translate product and subsystem requirements into robust engineering solutions. Develop hydrophone sensor assemblies, mechanical housings, internal structures, sealing concepts, and subsystem interfaces. Produce detailed mechanical designs, engineering drawings, specifications, calculations, and design documentation. Develop prototypes and support subsystem integration, testing, and verification activities. Perform engineering analysis, characterization, and validation of hydrophone sensor assemblies. Support acoustic characterization and correlate engineering models with experimental results. Analyze engineering results, identify technical issues, and implement design improvements. Apply engineering expertise in precision mechanical design, fiber-optic sensing technology, materials, sealing, and structural design. Contribute to technical trade-off studies, design reviews, and multidisciplinary engineering discussions. Support root cause investigations and implement corrective engineering solutions. Improve subsystem robustness, manufacturability, maintainability, reliability, and production readiness. Plan and execute assigned engineering activities within agreed priorities and timelines. Communicate technical progress, risks, and dependencies proactively with stakeholders. Collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams and share engineering knowledge and best practices. Ensure engineering deliverables meet quality, performance, and reliability requirements. Contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes, methods, and product quality. Why Join Us? Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups. Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization. Competitive salary and benefits package. Enjoy regular team activities and company events. Fresh team lunches provided 3 times/week. Qualifications: BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Applied Physics, Precision Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Approximately 2–5 years of experience in precision mechanical design, instrumentation, sensor systems, or product development. Experience with CAD (SolidWorks or equivalent) and engineering analysis tools, like Comsol or ANSYS. Understanding of materials, sealing, and mechanical design principles. Experience with Python or similar scripting tools for engineering analysis is an advantage. Interest in precision instrumentation, underwater sensing technologies, and multidisciplinary product development. Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills. Good written and verbal communication skills in English. Eligible to obtain EU/NATO security clearance. Preferred: Experience with fiber-optic sensors, underwater systems, or precision instrumentation. Familiarity with engineering testing, prototype development, or product verification. Security & Compliance: You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

title: Ingénieur simulation de performances F/H
description: Découvrez un projet adapté à votre talent ! Filiale du Groupe REEL, industriel spécialisé dans les systèmes de levage et de manutention complexes et dans les solutions de systèmes intégrés. Présent sur 4 continents, 3 500 collaborateurs, +10% de croissance sur les 12 dernières années. CNIM Systèmes Industriels (CSI) est un équipementier et ensemblier industriel français de dimension internationale installé à La Seyne-sur-Mer (Var, France) depuis 1856. CNIM Systèmes Industriels intervient dans les secteurs de pointe de l’industrie : Défense (franchissement, architecture de systèmes et équipements navals, dissuasion), Nucléaire (civil, militaire, recherche), Grands Instruments Scientifiques, Spatial, Semi-conducteurs... L’atout majeur de CNIM Systèmes Industriels repose sur un outil industriel exceptionnel unique en Europe (60 000 m2 d’atelier) et sur notre capacité à passer de la conception à la réalisation (recherche de concepts, ingénierie des procédés, création de moyens de fabrication et de contrôle). Ce que nous pouvons vous apporter : o Un environnement riche, en perpétuel mouvement o Une communauté de passionnés évoluant dans une culture du partage d’informations o Des possibilités d’évolution et de découverte de différents domaines Plus de 80 % de nos collaborateurs apprécient l’autonomie qui leur est accordée, l’expression libre de leurs idées, l’entre aide et la reconnaissance du droit à l’erreur. Laissez s'exprimer votre talent ! Au sein de la BU défense, rattaché(e) au Responsable Ingénierie, vous avez en charge la simulation numérique et la justification de systèmes mécaniques complexes dans le domaine de la Défense et notamment de la Dissuasion. A ce titre, vos missions sont les suivantes : - Vous analysez le besoin défini dans le cahier des charges ; - Vous collectez les données d’entrée client et participez aux revues associées ; - Vous élaborez et maîtrisez les lois de comportement des matériaux permettant de représenter fidèlement le système ; - Vous validez les résultats (méthode analytique, comparaison avec des résultats d’essais, comparaison codes à codes…) ; - Vous simulez le système sur les codes de performances (langage compilé ou interprété, simulation multi-physique, éléments ou volumes finis…) ; - Vous êtes en charge de l’ensemble des calculs, analyses et livrables liés aux performances, et permettant de respecter les exigences du système notamment en termes de probabilité de défaillance ; - Vous participez aux revues d’avancement en interne et avec le client. Venez développer votre talent ! - Ingénieur à dominante mécanique ; - Des compétences en matériaux élastomères et composites ainsi que des notions en sûreté de fonctionnement et de calculs statistiques sont souhaitables ; - Expérience minimale de 10 ans en calculs scientifiques avec simulation par éléments finis ; - Notion de mécanique des fluides ; - Idéalement connaissances dans le domaine de la Défense ou du Spatial ; - Utilisation avancée d’Excel ; - Maitrise des logiciels simulation 3D (ABAQUS ou ANSYS / STARCCM+) - Connaissance des outils de simulation Process (ex: MATLAB / AMESim), de langage de programmation (Fortran / VBA / PYTHON) et des outils statistiques type PERSALYS / Openturns / ModeFrontier - Anglais courant. Votre expertise technique et votre rigueur ainsi que votre capacité à travailler en équipe seront des atouts majeurs. Ce que nous vous proposons : - Statut cadre au forfait 216 jours (environ 2 semaines de RTT/an) - Rémunération à partir de 52K€ sur 13 mois - Télétravail possible 2 jours/semaine - Ticket restaurant à 11.5€ (4.60€ part employé / 6.90€ part employeur) - Mutuelle : enfants couverts gratuitement, cotisation du salarié 7€ - Un environnement de travail attractif : food truck sur site, espaces de travail agréables, 2 jours fériés supplémentaires, un suivi RH de carrière régulier avec des perspectives d’évolution, CSE (chèques cadeaux, réductions, etc…)

title: Design & Simulation / Mechanical Engineer
description: Job Overview You will be part of the Application Engineering team in our Paris/La Défense based office. You will be performing engineering design of lattice-based mechanical parts, simulation, and analysis activities to validate product performance, optimize designs, and ensure compliance with technical requirements. The role involves using CAD and simulation tools to evaluate design feasibility, identify potential issues, and support product development from concept through validation. Key Responsibilities Create, modify, and continuously improve 3D CAD models of the lattice-based mechanical parts to optimize design performance for light-weight and meet project requirements. Perform engineering analyses (structural, mechanical, vibration or other relevant simulations) according to project requirements. Define simulation parameters, boundary conditions, material properties, and loading conditions according to project requirements. Analyze simulation results and prepare technical reports with conclusions and recommendations. Identify design weaknesses, potential failure modes, and opportunities for product optimization. Collaborate with R&D, software, manufacturing and commercial teams. Attend and support customer meetings. Support design verification and validation through simulation and correlation with physical test results. Maintain technical documentation, simulation files, design revisions, and engineering reports. Participate in design reviews, technical meetings, and continuous improvement activities. Ensure compliance with applicable engineering standards, internal procedures, and project specifications. Required Skills and Qualifications Minimum 5 years of experience, degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field. Knowledge of CAD and CAE tools relevant to the industry. Experience in product design and mechanical simulation. Understanding of engineering mechanics, material behavior, and design principles. Ability to interpret simulation results and translate them into practical design recommendations. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Highly adaptable to rapid changes and evolving project requirements, with strong awareness of emerging design and simulation tools, and keen to propose technical improvement and solution. Take responsibility for the quality of what you ship, together with the QA team. Share progress through milestones, decompose complex tasks, and raise questions early so nothing gets stuck. Practical experience using AI tools in your daily work (experience with agents or MCP is a big plus). Experience with databases and working with data. Product and business orientation: you think about user impact, not just code correctness. Autonomous, proactive working style, clear written communication, and the ability to learn fast. What you may expect from working with us: Flexible remote work: Work from anywhere with a schedule that fits your life. High ownership and real impact: You’ll actively influence product and technical decisions, not just execute predefined tasks. Fast-moving startup environment: We value speed, autonomy, and practical problem-solving over rigid corporate processes. Direct communication: We keep things simple and transparent, ensuring you focus on what matters most — getting things done. Professional Support: We provide a monthly budget that you can allocate based on your personal and professional priorities — including language learning, professional development, mental health support, sports, or health insurance.

title: Digital Twin & City Simulation Specialist
description: Digital Twin & City Simulation Specialist 🚀 Ever wanted to build a city, not just in a game, but one that actually helps real places work better? We're looking for someone who knows their way around GIS and city data, gets excited by simulation, and can keep a complex project moving from idea to delivery. At Placemaking AI, you'll join our Ankara team to help lead PAI map development. Our innovative solutions empower clients to improve spaces and experiences through actionable insights derived from complex data. Position Summary You'll be a core member of the PAI technical team, combining hands-on technical work in GIS and city simulation with day-to-day project coordination. This role sits at the intersection of urban data, digital twins and interactive experiences, and gives you real ownership over how the project takes shape. 📊 Key Responsibilities: Plan and track project timelines, milestones and deliverables, keeping the team and stakeholders aligned. Build, maintain and improve city digital twin models using GIS and spatial data. Source, clean and integrate city datasets such as mobility, demographics, land use, buildings and points of interest (POI). Design and run city simulations to test scenarios and explore how changes affect people and places. Explore how game engines and game design thinking (e.g. Unity, Unreal, interactive scenarios) can make simulations more engaging and easier to understand. Coordinate with internal teams, clients and external partners, and turn meetings into clear action items. Prepare clear visuals, demos and reports that explain complex urban data to non-technical audiences. Use AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) to speed up data work, documentation and prototyping. 💡 What You'll Gain: Ownership of a cutting-edge digital twin project from an early stage. Direct work with leadership and a seat at the table on product and project decisions. Hands-on experience applying simulation and game technologies to real urban challenges. Exposure to real client projects in location intelligence and urban development. Room to grow as PAI project and team expand. 🏆 Qualifications: 1–2 years of experience working with city digital twins, GIS, urban analytics, or a closely related area. Solid project management experience: you can plan work, track deadlines and keep multiple stakeholders on the same page. Solid hands-on skills with GIS tools (e.g. QGIS, ArcGIS) and working with spatial and city data. Experience with or strong interest in city simulation and modelling. A genuine interest in games, game engines or interactive simulation is a plus. A degree in Urban Planning, Geomatics, Geography, Computer Science, Architecture or a related field. A Master's degree in a relevant field is a plus. Experience with Python, spatial databases (e.g. PostGIS) or 3D city formats (e.g. CityGML) is a plus. Strong spoken and written communication in Turkish and English. Based in Ankara and able to work from our office on agreed days. 📋 Our Hiring Process: Application Review: We'll screen all applications against the qualifications above and shortlist the strongest fits. Screening Interview (15 min): A short introductory call to talk through the role and get to know each other. Initial Offer: You'll get a more detailed description of the role, including compensation, benefits, office location etc. Paid Trial Task: If it's a mutual fit, we'll send a short, compensated task based on real responsibilities of the role. Payment is processed within 15 business days of submission. Final Interview: Top candidates move to a longer conversation with the team to align on expectations and fit. Offer: We'll extend an offer to the best match, with backups held in reserve. 💥 Apply now and help us build the cities of tomorrow, one simulation at a time.

title: Lead Mechanical Engineer
description: Bij cropr zoeken we een Lead Mechanical Engineer die het mechanisch hart van onze autonome onkruidwieder verder ontwikkelt. Bij cropr zoeken we een Lead Mechanical Engineer die verantwoordelijk wordt voor het ontwerpen, bouwen en doorontwikkelen van de diverse onderdelen van onze autonome onkruidwieder. Onze eerste machines hebben seizoen 2026 over de velden gereden, waarmee de focus nu verschuift naar doorontwikkeling, optimalisatie en opschaling. Wat krijg je? Een salaris tussen € 4.500 en € 7.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring, op basis van een fulltime dienstverband van 38 uur per week, exclusief 8% vakantiegeld Reiskostenvergoeding (€ 0,25 per km netto) voor woon-werkverkeer vanaf meer dan 10 km enkele reis. 25 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen. Een plek in een dynamische, snelgroeiende start-up waar ruimte is voor initiatief, innovatie en persoonlijke groei Een sleutelrol in de ontwikkeling van een innovatieve landbouwrobot met grote impact Veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid én ruimte om te pionieren binnen een ambitieuze start-up Een multidisciplinair team waar software, elektronica en mechanica samenkomen Wat ga je doen? Als Lead Mechanical Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor de mechanische ontwikkeling van de weedr : een autonome robot die onkruid detecteert en vernietigt met behulp van lasers. Je ontwerpt en verbetert het rijdend platform, met aandacht voor structurele sterkte, betrouwbaarheid, onderhoudbaarheid, trilgedrag, assemblage en productie. Je denkt mee over systeemarchitectuur en interfacegrenzen tussen mechanica, elektronica en software. Je bouwt en test prototypes in de praktijk, analyseert bevindingen uit veldtesten en vertaalt die naar gerichte ontwerpverbeteringen. Ook lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan standaardisatie, documentatie en de overdracht naar productie. Daarnaast treed je, op basis van jouw senioriteit en technisch inhoudelijke autoriteit op als team-lead in het team van Mechanical Engineers. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Het ontwerpen en uitwerken van mechanische onderdelen en het opzetten van assemblages voor productie in CAD. Het dimensioneren van constructies met betrekking tot sterkte, stijfheid, duurzaamheid en produceerbaarheid. Prototypes bouwen, testen en iteratief verbeteren op basis van praktijkervaring. Mechanische interfaces definiëren en afstemmen met software- en elektronicateams. Testresultaten en velddata analyseren en vertalen naar ontwerpaanpassingen. Ontwerpkeuzes documenteren en technische overdracht naar productie ondersteunen. Meedenken over onderhoudsgemak, assemblagevolgorde en schaalbaarheid van het ontwerp. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van 2D-werktekeningen, structureert stuklijsten (BOM's) en stuurt de technische afstemming en wijzigingsprocessen met productie strak aan. Jij brengt mee Een HBO- of WO-opleiding in werktuigbouwkunde, mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting. Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met het ontwerpen, dimensioneren en valideren van mechanische systemen. Ervaring met CAD-ontwerp en het uitwerken van maakbare constructies, bij voorkeur in Solidworks. Ervaring met de vertaling van prototypes naar een robuust ontwerp voor serieproductie. Ervaring met PLM-systemen is een pré, in het bijzonder SolidWorks 3DEXPERIENCE. Affiniteit met landbouwmachines (klein voertuig) of terreinrobots is een pré. Je kunt goed samenwerken in multidisciplinaire teams en collega's van technisch advies voorzien. Ervaring met het onderhouden van technische product documentatie voor productie. Grondige kennis van de geldende normen voor technische tekeningen, ervaring met TPD-beheer en het direct aansturen van toeleveranciers op maakbaarheid. Over cropr Bij cropr ontwikkelen we een landbouwrobot die onkruid selectief verwijdert, zonder herbiciden. Na het succes van onze tulpenrobot binnen (H2L Robotics) is de cropr weedr de volgende stap in duurzame precisielandbouw. De eerste systemen draaien inmiddels commercieel, en dat maakt de rol extra interessant: je werkt aan een platform dat al waarde levert in de praktijk en dat tegelijkertijd klaar wordt gemaakt voor verdere groei en industrialisatie. Geïnteresseerd, maar nog twijfels? Twijfel je of je aan alle eisen voldoet? Geen probleem. title: Installation Engineer
description: Design cable installation systems for offshore projects Do you want to apply mechanical engineering and 3D design to offshore cable installation projects that support the green transition? As a Installation Engineer within NKT Grid Solutions Offshore Hub, you will create installation equipment, cable routes and technical documentation while contributing to an international company on a growth journey. Create practical engineering solutions for cable installation You will support offshore and onshore installation projects through mechanical design, structural calculations and technical documentation. The role covers metal accessories, jointing pits, cable routes, pull-in analysis and installation equipment. You will work with project managers, site managers, subcontractors and engineering colleagues, translating project needs into clear 2D and 3D deliverables that meet applicable ISO and EN standards. Your Responsibility Will Be To Design metal accessories, jointing pits and cable installation equipment in 2D and 3D CAD. Prepare cable routes, pull-in analyses, FEM analyses and structural calculations. Produce manufacturing drawings, technical reports, instructions, layouts and task plans. Prepare ITP, FAT and SAT checklists and technical design requirements for MRB activities. Provide technical support to Service and Installation projects, including field engineering. The position reports to the Installation Engineering team and works across project functions, particularly with colleagues in Karlskrona, Sweden. The final work location will be confirmed. Domestic and international travel is approximately 50 days per year. Analytical and collaborative mechanical engineering professional You approach technical questions methodically, communicate clearly and cooperate well across functions. You can organise several parallel activities, remain adaptable when project conditions change and contribute with a practical, safety-aware perspective in both office and field settings. You Also Have A minimum BSc in mechanical, structural, design, civil or related engineering. Experience with mechanical design, structural analysis and manufacturing drawings. Experience with 2D and 3D CAD; AutoCAD, SolidWorks or Navisworks are relevant tools. Ability to produce technical documentation and work with ISO and EN standards. Fluent Swedish and English; cable installation project experience is preferred. Engineer the cable systems enabling a greener future NKT is committed to developing a diverse organization and culture where people of diverse backgrounds can grow and are inspired to do their best. We have high ambitions on establishing gender diversity at NKT and encouraging all interested candidates to apply – even if you don’t tick all the boxes described. We believe that a diverse organization enables long-term performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture creates a better work environment. This role offers career development through varied engineering assignments, collaboration with project and site teams, and opportunities to grow your skills in an international setting. You will contribute across design, analysis, manufacturing documentation and installation support for cable projects connected to the green transition. “As a leader, I value clear engineering judgement, practical collaboration and a safety-aware approach. In this role, you can turn project needs into workable installation solutions while learning across functions and locations,” says Hiring Manager, Simon Lilley. Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here! We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 22 November. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. If you have any questions about the role, you are very welcome to contact Hiring Manager Simon Lilley at Simon.Lilley@nkt.com. For inquiries about the recruitment process, please reach out to Sara Karlsson at Sara.Karlsson@nkt.com. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e-mail. We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions. Be a Connector of the green tomorrow! About NKT Join a diverse and international team within NKT’s Grid Solutions business, supporting the delivery and operation of reliable power grids worldwide. We deliver HVAC onshore cable systems and provide specialist service for AC and DC cable systems onshore and offshore. As a global organisation with operations across Europe, Australia, the United States, and the Middle East, Grid Solutions works closely with customers around the world and across the full lifecycle of power cable systems. At NKT, we are all Connectors. We connect to develop leading power cable technologies that enable the world’s transition to renewable energy - and we stay connected to grow as people and professionals. As a company, NKT connects a greener world with high-quality power cable technology and plays a key role as the world moves towards clean energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low-, medium- and high-voltage power cable solutions enabling reliable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology, building the infrastructure from the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today. NKT is headquartered in Denmark, operates from more than 30 countries worldwide, and employs 6,500 people globally. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3.6 billion in 2025. NKT - We connect a greener world. www.nkt.com

title: Rör- och anläggningskonstruktör
description: Företagsbeskrivning AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle. Jobbeskrivning Är du en engagerad Rör- och anläggningskonstruktör som är redo för nya möjligheter? Vi på AFRY befinner oss i en spännande tillväxtfas och söker nu dig till vårt team! Hos oss får du vara delaktig i leveransen gällande processdesign och konstruktion. Leveranserna omfattar att ta fram den processtekniska lösningen och funktionen, rita flödesscheman, ta fram komponent- och rörlistor, utarbeta kravspecifikationer på utrustningar, 3D modellera och ta fram tillverknings och installationsunderlag. Som medarbetare hos oss kommer du antingen arbeta på plats ute hos kund i kundens projektorganisation, eller så ingår du i något av våra in-houseprojekt. Du utgår från ett av våra kontor i Malmö eller Helsingborg . Kvalifikationer För att lyckas i rollen hos oss är det centralt att du har ett stort teknikintresse och tycker om att lära dig nya saker. Vi ser att du har en relevant teknisk utbildning på högskolenivå alternativt från yrkeshögskola eller annan jämförbar erfarenhet. Vi söker dig som har: Erfarenhet av programvaror som AutoCAD Plant 3D, AVEVA E3D, Navis. Har 2-3 års erfarenhet av att arbeta som rör- och anläggningskonstruktör. Extra meriterande är om du har erfarenhet ifrån petrokemi men även inom papper/massa eller vatten då flertalet av våra uppdrag finns inom dessa industrier. Utöver detta har du mycket goda kunskaper vad gäller svenska och engelska, i såväl tal som skrift, samt har B-körkort då resor till kund förekommer i tjänsten. I alla våra rekryteringar läggs stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. Som person har du en god kommunikationsförmåga och visar engagemang. Du värderar samarbete och är alltid villig att stötta dina kollegor. Dessutom är du strukturerad och noggrann i ditt arbete. Din nyfikenhet och envishet bidrar till att du alltid vill hitta den bästa lösningen! Är du den vi söker? Ansök redan idag! Ytterligare information Vi erbjuder dig en flexibel arbetsmiljö och stor frihet under ansvar då vi förstår att allas liv ser olika ut. Med det sagt finns det också möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån när man så vill eller behöver om det fungerar med verksamheten. På AFRY delar vi en stark kultur som präglas av att dela kunskap och kompetensutveckling i form av interna och externa utbildningar samt individuella utvecklingsplaner. Utöver detta erbjuder vi dig generöst årligt friskvårdbidrag, företagshälsovård, tjänstepension samt tillhörighet i vår fantastiska personalförening Club AFRY. Här anordnar vi roliga aktiviteter så som skidresor, handledda träningstillfällen, stuguthyrning, gästföreläsningar och mycket, mycket mer! Vi är flexibla vad gäller anställningsstart. Har du frågor om tjänsten hör av dig till Ahmet så besvarar han gärna dina funderingar. Har du frågor gällande rekryteringsprocessen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Julia. Sista ansökningsdatum är 2026-11-16. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! Du finner kontaktuppgifter nedan: Ahmet Barac Market Area Manager ahmet.barac@afry.com Julia Lindén Talent Acquisition Partner julia.linden@afry.com För samtliga rekryteringar på AFRY genomförs som grund alltid en ID-kontroll, referenstagning samt verifiering av utbildning. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser. På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. Vi söker konstant kvalificerade kandidater som vill ansluta sig till våra inkluderande team runt om i världen. Bli en del av oss och påskynda den gröna omställningen

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Joining Arup Arup's purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. Around the globe, Arup’s mechanical engineers bring specialist expertise to solutions for buildings, transport infrastructure and energy, water and waste utilities. Our comprehensive services to the energy, water and resources sectors include development of solutions for utilities and infrastructure assets, industrial processes and manufacturing systems, renewable energy and storage and sustainable mechanical system design. The Opportunity We are seeking a Mechanical Engineer to join our Water team either in Cardiff or Birmingham , and contribute to the delivery of robust, efficient engineering solutions across the water industry. In this role, you will support the design and execution of water and wastewater treatment projects, including pumping systems pipelines and associated infrastructure. You’ll work on technically challenging and high-value projects within long-term frameworks for major UK water utilities such as Welsh Water, United Utilities, Severn Trent Water and Wessex Water. You will apply your technical expertise, deliver key project tasks, and provide guidance to junior team members. In this role, you will support the mechanical design and delivery of water sector projects from feasibility through to construction. You will form part of multidisciplinary teams, with a focus on treatment systems, pumping solutions, and pipework design. The role involves overseeing and supporting the work of junior engineers and technicians, ensuring high standards across all stages of project delivery. You will make effective use of digital tools such as BIM, Revit and Plant 3D to enhance project outcomes and will be expected to promote a culture of technical rigour, operational efficiency, and innovation within the team. The available position is for engineers preferably with experience in water, including treatment facilities, pumping systems and pipework. We want people who are self motivated and able to adapt to the demands of projects and clients, someone who will enjoy solving problems and have the capability to contribute within our multidisciplinary teams to deliver high quality solutions. Is this role right for you? We Are Seeking The Below Skills And Knowledge Proven experience delivering mechanical designs in the water utilities sector, or a related field, including treatment facilities and pumping systems Progressing towards Chartered Engineer (CEng) status with IMechE or relevant body. Knowledge of current mechanical design standards and practices in the UK water industry Understanding of digital design software (e.g. BIM, Revit, Plant 3D) Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams A results-oriented mindset, with the ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work on time Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email. What We Offer You At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together. Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognizes the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do. We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts. We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs. Different people, shared values Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence. Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup. We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact maria.mindrut@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you. Our Application Process To understand what to expect next, please visit https://www.arup.com/careers/recruitment-process/ We may close the role earlier than the advertised date should we receive a large number of applications, so please ensure you apply early. Je vergelijkt bestaande oplossingen met innovatieve alternatieven, zoals composietconstructies, en vertaalt jouw bevindingen naar concrete verbeteringen voor de praktijk. The company was established in 1958 and to date has manufactured over half a million trailers. We are a Welsh indigenous business, with core values that are important to us. We are proud to send trailers manufactured in Wales, all around the world. If you wish to join a team environment, where everyone’s effort comes together to make the final step, we would like to hear from you. The Role: We are looking for enthusiastic graduates to join and strengthen our existing business operations. As a valued member of the team, you will be given responsibility from the outset, taking ownership of key project areas and working closely with the Company’s decision-makers. This role provides a unique opportunity to gain valuable insight into the key performance indicators (KPIs) that drive a successful manufacturing business. The Graduate Design Engineer will be responsible for facilitating design changes raised through these systems, supporting the validation of designs with the relevant manufacturing sites, and ensuring the smooth delivery of changes from initial request through to completion. Responsibilities: Work with the Sales Team, Site Leaders and Continuous Improvement Engineer to ensure the requested changes are completed in a timely manner. Ensure that the 3D Models and Drawings are suitable for Manufacture (Design for Manufacture) Act as point of contact for any issues arising from the design change. Meticulous & accurate documentation skills. Ensuring that our MRP System is updated with the new data as required and all Engineering Change Documents are distributed around the business as required Key Requirements: Have a desire to learn and grow the role, have a “Can-Do” attitude and the ability to accept guidance on the requested design changes. A flexible and enthusiastic team player with a passion for problem solving. Demonstrates a practical hands-on approach. Demonstrates a sense of urgency and a desire to deliver against agreed targets. Good interpersonal skills with an ability to communicate clearly. IT literate and understand Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook etc) Work closely with our Design and Production Engineers, Site Leaders and Quality Engineers to deliver a Right First-Time solution. Looks forward to new challenges and ask questions. Able to accept instructions and take notes as required. Time management skills Willing to go the “Extra Mile” to achieve a goal. Practical understanding of modern manufacturing technology and processes. Experienced in the use of Solid Works 3D CAD Software and the creation of Engineering Drawings. Willingness to travel between all our sites to speak with other members of the team to ensure a Right First Time is delivered to Ifor Williams Trailers. An understanding of Solid Works PDM System is desirable but not essential Qualifications and Skills Required: A degree in an Engineering/Design related subject or studying towards one. Experience using Solid Works 3D CAD Software, that can be demonstrated at an interview. Experience in the creation of Drawings generated from the 3D model that can be demonstrated at an interview Job Types: Full-time, Permanent Ability to commute/relocate: Deeside CH5 2LR: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required) Education: Bachelor's (preferred) Experience: Solid Works CAD Software: 1 year (required) Work Location : In person

title: Graduate Structural Engineer
description: Here at Pick Everard, we are passionate about creating a prosperous and sustainable future, taking a fresh perspective on the built environment. Our core values of professionalism, compassion, drive and positivity are at the heart of everything we do. Do you want to work with a team that’s proud of its culture, values, and the work it delivers? Do you bring a positive attitude and a willingness to learn, even when faced with new or challenging tasks? Do you want to work in an environment where learning and development is genuinely supported? If you answered yes to the above questions, we want to hear from you! We are seeking an Graduate Structural Engineer to join our team in Glasgow, developing strong foundations in structural engineering through hands-on project experience and targeted learning. In this role, you will integrate your university knowledge, gain exposure to a variety of engineering projects, and build proficiency in structural design using typical construction materials. You will also develop a thorough understanding of structural design standards, codes of practice, and best practice approaches to support your professional growth. Joining a supportive network as part of a national team, you can expect to receive valuable training, guidance and genuine scope for career development. Your core responsibilities will include: Preparing CAD drawings/Revit models from engineer’s sketches. Assisting Structural Engineers. Undertaking analysis and design calculations / drawings, reports and contract documents under supervision. Assisting in the management of projects including having a financial understanding. Assisting in on-site survey and inspection work when required. Working towards Chartership, but will have full support, including mentors (IStructE/ICE) and access to workshops and seminars to help meet core objectives. Following compliance with Health & Safety requirements, practices and procedures. Further Development At Pick Everard we have carefully considered your journey as a Graduate, ensuring you have the correct tools and support to thrive. You will automatically be enrolled on to our early careers programme, which covers the necessary soft skills needed when entering the workforce. Mentors are available for everyone, as we are dedicated to providing development opportunities for you. Find out what it is like to start your career with us: Early careers - Pick Everard Our ideal Graduate Structural Engineer will have: A minimum of a BSc or BEng in Civil/Structural Engineering (2:1 desired); MSc or MEng preferred. Good verbal communication skills, with the ability to discuss work and collaborate effectively within a team. An understanding of technical standards, analysis, and design software, including AutoCAD and Revit. The ability to learn and gain experience in UK design standards, codes of practice, and construction methods. A collaborative mindset, pushing yourself and others to find innovative solutions to complex challenges. A passion for structural engineering, sustainability, and creative design. The ability to learn and gain experience in Health and Safety knowledge and awareness. Commitment to personal development through CPD and training. Unsure you tick every box? We still encourage you to apply as your experience might be a great fit for this role or other opportunities in our team. Our nationwide multidisciplinary team of 780+ employees, work collaboratively to deliver outstanding places and spaces that create lasting value for local communities. Through our remarkable history we have established the sound principles of success, and we have the vision and ambition to be even better. We’re committed to creating sustainable communities where everyone feels safe, cared for and valued. We achieve that by encouraging a diverse, welcoming workplace for our people, clients and colleagues. We care about our people and improving our society and that means supporting your ambitions and interests at every level. We will provide you with an inspiring environment in which you will be able to drive real progress and impact in your career. What We Offer Providing a balanced, enjoyable career is important to us, and we work hard to make sure everyone feels a valued part of our organisation. You will receive an attractive salary, and amongst other benefits you can also expect: Agile working. Career and Professional Development. Corporate Social Responsibility opportunities. 26 days’ annual leave + Bank Holidays + option to buy up to 5 days’ additional leave. Private healthcare, life assurance and healthcare cash plan. Stakeholder pension. Professional subscriptions. Employee Discount Scheme. Eyecare Scheme. Wellbeing support and Employee Assistance Programme. Equal Opportunities As an equal opportunities’ employer, Pick Everard is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees and does not condone discrimination on the basis of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, or marriage and civil partnership. We aspire to have a diverse and inclusive workplace and strongly encourage suitably qualified applicants from a wide range of backgrounds to apply and join us on our journey. Accessibility We’re committed to helping you perform at your best throughout the recruitment process. If you have a disability or require any adjustments to support your application or interview, please get in touch with us at careers@pickeverard.co.uk. We’ll be happy to discuss how we can assist you. Agencies We are committed to building and nurturing great relationships with our agency partners. However, this role is being recruited for directly and therefore we are not seeking support at this time. Any unsolicited CV Introductions will not be accepted.

title: Graduate Structural Engineer 2027
description: Job Description To be considered for this role, please make sure you read the job description carefully and apply by submitting all the relevant documents and answer the application questions. Any applications submitted without the required information or application questions completed will be rejected. Please ensure all competency questions are submitted as part of your application. You must have graduated no earlier than 2026 to be eligible to apply for this role. Please note – Ramboll cannot sponsor any post-study or Skilled Worker visas for our early career roles, as the Home Office’s eligibility criteria would not be met. You must have the right to live and work in the UK indefinitely without the need for sponsorship, either now or in the future. PLEASE ENSURE YOU HAVE FULLY COMPLETED YOUR APPLICATION, INCLUDING ANSWERING THE 3 QUESTIONS IN THE 'HOW TO APPLY' SECTION. ANY INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL AUTOMATICALLY BE REJECTED. Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the United Kingdom and Ireland Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the United Kingdom and Ireland has a proven track record of sustainable and responsible business and is a top ten engineering and environmental and sustainability consultancy in the UK, with more than 1,500 employees across 16 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Buildings, Transport, Environment & Health, and Energy. In 2024, Ramboll was included in the Sunday Times’ list of Best Places to Work. About The Opportunity As a graduate engineer at Ramboll, you will be directly involved in some of the UK’s most innovative and complex projects. Each day as a graduate will provide you with new opportunities and challenges, making no two days feel the same. You will be involved in the design and delivery of buildings, including the component parts of the structure and associated infrastructure, monitoring implementation through the entire project lifecycle, from initial concepts to visits on site. You will become part of the Buildings Department, which houses Structures, Civil, Mechanical & Electrical, Facades, Acoustics and many more disciplines. Your role will allow you to collaborate with all disciplines, providing growth and knowledge to increase engineering competence. As ‘the Partner for Sustainable Change’ we put sustainability at the forefront of our projects. We encourage our employees to go above and beyond current sustainable practices to provide our projects with relevant sustainable change. We are looking for Graduate Structural Engineers in the following disciplines: Commercial & Residential Life Science & Pharma Transformation & Public Buildings Business Advisory & Consultancy Please ensure you specify your preferred discipline on your application. Our roles are available in the following locations: Southampton, London, Chester, Leeds, Bristol, London, Birmingham, Cambridge. Please ensure you specify your preferred location on your application. Your skills and experience: From the moment you join Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you grow with the company. For this role, we believe your starting point is: MEng or MSc level degree in a relevant engineering subject (from an Engineering Council Accredited University) including modules in structural design . Please only apply for this role if you hold or are studying the correct degree (obtained no earlier than 2026) Interest in the design of buildings and associated infrastructure, and an active curiosity about primary construction materials and emerging / innovative materials Ability to summarise and present engineering concepts in clear English and drawn formats An interest in digital transformation, tools and methodologies Understanding of and passion for sustainable design Personal qualities that will help you succeed in this role include flexibility and adaptability, a growth mindset, a positive attitude, proactivity, creativity, good communication skills, willingness and ability to learn, curiosity, enthusiasm, and reliability. How to apply: Apply online. Attach your CV. In a separate document, please address the following questions: and attach to your application. Question 1. Ramboll’s initiative, ‘The Partner for Sustainable Change’, focuses on four key unifying themes; Decarbonise for net-zero, Resilient societies and liveability, resource management and circular economy, Biodiversity and ecosystem. Please choose one unifying theme and explain what this means to you personally? (max. 150 words) Question 2. Why are you interested in joining Ramboll and what strengths do you have which will contribute to your role within the Ramboll team? (max. 150 words) Question 3. What do you believe are the key challenges in the building industry and what do you believe are the best solutions to overcome these? (max. 150 words) PLEASE NOTE: YOUR APPLICATION WILL BE REJECTED IF THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS ARE NOT COMPLETED. Selection Process: We aim to respond to your application shortly after the deadline by the latest. There are three steps to our selection process. You will advance onto the next step if you are successfully shortlisted. Step 1: Apply Online and complete required application questions Step 2: Shortlisting Step 3: Assessment Centre We personally review every application, as our selection process is fully human-led. It’s absolutely fine to use tools to support you—for example, to check spelling and grammar or to gather background research—but we ask that your answers reflect your own original thoughts. title: Junior Mechanical Engineer
description: Who are we? We are an engineering group and a major player in the fields of buildings, water, energy, industry and mobility. Wholly owned by our employees, we are united by a shared passion: a profession that combines the art of designing with ingenuity and delivering with commitment. Our 11,000 employees across more than 40 countries create solutions every day for a positive future, addressing key challenges for both people and the planet. Our teams remain human-sized, fostering close relationships, day-to-day collaboration and the sharing of knowledge and experience. To make this job advertisement easier to read, inclusive writing has not been used. Any masculine terms are intended to refer equally to women, men and non-binary people Job Description For our Industry Division, we are looking for a recent Mechanical Engineering graduate to join our Milan team. We are seeking a bright, curious and motivated individual interested in developing skills in both building services design engineering and field supervision and technical support activities , contributing to complex industrial projects within an international environment. The successful candidate will work alongside experienced professionals and will have the opportunity to follow the entire project lifecycle, from engineering design through to project execution. What you will do Support the team in mechanical and building services engineering design activities for industrial projects. Contribute to the preparation and review of technical documentation. Participate in the coordination of the various project disciplines. Assist construction teams during plant and equipment installation phases. Conduct site visits to monitor the progress of project activities. Support the analysis and resolution of technical issues. Interact with clients, suppliers and contractors in an international environment. Participate in technical meetings conducted in English. Qualifications Requirements Master's Degree in Mechanical Engineering. Excellent command of Italian. Excellent command of English, both written and spoken. Interest in the industrial sector and technical building services systems. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office. Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit or 3D modelling software. Participation in university projects, experimental thesis work or international experiences. International study experiences (Erasmus or equivalent programmes). Personal qualities Strong analytical skills. Technical curiosity and eagerness to learn. Proactive attitude and results-oriented mindset. Excellent interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary and international teams. Additional Information Permanent employment contract with a gross annual salary of €35,000-45,000 plus €9 meal vouchers. Structured training and professional development programme. Involvement in major international industrial projects. Mentoring and support from senior professionals. Opportunity to develop skills in both design engineering and field engineering activities. International and multidisciplinary working environment. Location: Agrate Brianza (Milan area), Italy. Working model: Full-time presence on project/construction sites.

description: Il Gruppo Almaviva leader italiano nell’Information & Communication Technology, accompagna i processi di crescita del Paese raccogliendo la sfida che le realtà enterprise devono affrontare per rimanere competitive nell’era del digitale.Da solide competenze Made in Italy, unite alla capacità di integrare culture, intelligenze ed esperienze diverse, è nato un network globale. Entrerai a far parte di SADEL, la società del Gruppo Almaviva leader nel mercato nazionale dei Passenger Information Systems per il settore ferroviario. L’azienda sviluppa e distribuisce soluzioni tecnologiche di bordo treno e ha installato oltre 40.000 apparati su gran parte della flotta ferroviaria nazionale. Posizione: Ti unirai al nostro team come JR Mechanical Engineer operando nel mercato internazionale dei sistemi di trasporto ferroviario, su commesse italiane ed estere. All'interno dell'Ufficio Tecnico di Prodotto, riporterai al Mechanical Design Manager e supporterai le attività di progettazione, sviluppo e industrializzazione di prodotti e componenti meccanici, collaborando con le diverse funzioni aziendali e contribuendo al raggiungimento degli obiettivi di qualità, costo e tempistiche di progetto. In particolare, svolgerai le seguenti attività: Supportare la progettazione e lo sviluppo di componenti e assiemi meccanici mediante strumenti CAD 3D; Collaborare alla definizione delle soluzioni tecniche in accordo con i requisiti di prodotto, qualità e producibilità; Realizzare e aggiornare disegni tecnici, specifiche e documentazione di progetto; Eseguire verifiche dimensionali, studi tecnici e analisi funzionali sotto la supervisione dei progettisti senior; Collaborare alla gestione e all'aggiornamento delle distinte base (BOM); Supportare le attività di prototipazione, test e validazione del prodotto; Collaborare con Produzione, Qualità, Acquisti e Supply Chain nelle attività di industrializzazione; Supportare la gestione delle modifiche tecniche e delle attività di miglioramento continuo; Collaborare all'analisi delle non conformità e all'implementazione delle azioni correttive; Operare nel rispetto delle normative tecniche e delle procedure aziendali. Requisiti: Ecco le competenze che cerchiamo in te: Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica o equivalente; Buona conoscenza di software CAD 3D (preferibilmente Inventor) e CAD 2D; Buona conoscenza del disegno meccanico e delle tolleranze dimensionali e geometriche; Conoscenza di base delle principali tecnologie produttive; Interesse per la progettazione meccanica e lo sviluppo prodotto; Attitudine all'apprendimento, problem solving e lavoro in team; Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese tecnica. Esperienze maturate attraverso stage, tesi, tirocini o collaborazioni in ambito tecnico saranno considerate un plus. Altre informazioni: Sede di lavoro: Castel Maggiore (BO), con possibilità di lavoro in modalità ibrida Orario di lavoro: full time, dal lunedì al venerdì Contratto: apprendistato, CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria Profilo: Mechanical Engineer equiparato a Disegnatore progettista Inquadramento: livello C3 Retribuzione: RAL 27.689,28 € Benefit aziendali: buono pasto per ogni giornata
