title: Junior Design Engineer
description: TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go. Job Purpose As a Junior Design Engineer in the Manifold & Foundation Systems department, you will support the design of Flow Control products as part of a multidisciplinary project team. You will work on assigned design tasks, develop your engineering and CAD skills, and prepare product documentation in accordance with company standards and processes. You will work independently on straightforward tasks and receive guidance from more experienced engineers when needed. Job Description Create and update 3D models, layouts, assemblies and engineering drawings using CAD tools Prepare and maintain part reports, bills of materials and product documentation required for procurement, manufacturing, service and testing Deliver straightforward designs and modifications in accordance with project requirements, engineering standards and applicable processes Check product interfaces and support the preparation of engineering calculations and design documentation Participate in product design reviews and ensure that documentation is reviewed by a more experienced engineer when required Use engineering databases and other tools required for daily work, and keep engineering records up to date Plan assigned tasks and monitor deliverables, commitment dates and engineering hours, raising questions or risks early Work with other departments to obtain the information needed to complete assigned design tasks and resolve technical questions Support product and documentation improvements, including the use of standard product solutions where appropriate Prepare reports, correspondence and technical information related to assigned work. Communicate with clients or suppliers on technical topics under the guidance of a more experienced engineer when needed Requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Machine Design or a related engineering discipline Basic knowledge of mechanical engineering principles, engineering drawings, materials and manufacturing processes Ability to use 3D CAD software to create or modify models and drawings Ability to read and understand engineering drawings, technical documentation and applicable standards Good organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage assigned tasks and meet agreed deadlines Willingness to learn, ask questions, use feedback and develop technical knowledge Good written and verbal communication skills in English (minimum B2 level) and the ability to work effectively in a team It would be an advantage if you have Previous work experience, internship or student placement in an engineering or manufacturing environment Knowledge of ISO GPS and/or ASME GD&T standards and the definition of geometrical tolerances Experience with Siemens NX or another 3D CAD system Experience with Teamcenter or another Product Lifecycle Management system Experience with engineering calculation tools such as Mathcad Exposure to fabrication processes and the design of welded joints Experience working with manufacturing, suppliers or customers on technical topics Department Manifold & Foundation Systems | Well & Flow Control Engineering, Kraków Full-time employment contract | Hybrid work: four days per week from the office and one day from home Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture. TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.

title: Ingénieur conception mécanique h/f
description: UTO c'est la nouvelle utopie vélo, le vélo sans les contraintes du vélo. La liberté d'esprit rendue possible grâce à plus que de simples vélos, des Unidentified Transport Objects. UTO conçoit des vélos pliants et compacts, pensés pour se déplacer spontanément, partout, tout le temps. Nous possédons notre usine en propre - à Lyon - dans laquelle nous concevons et assemblons à la main l’ensemble de nos produits, que nous commercialisons à travers l’Europe. En quelques chiffres, UTO c’est 2 fondateurs, 8 années d’existence, une quarantaine de salariés, 1000 revendeurs européens et déjà près de 50000 vélos en circulation. Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un ingénieur conception mécanique H/F. Mission : 1. Conception et développement produit Concevoir des pièces mécaniques et réaliser des assemblages sous SolidWorks. Mener des études complètes : modélisation 3D, mises en plan et simulations si nécessaire. Collaborer étroitement avec les designers et chefs de produit afin de co-développer des solutions à la fois techniques, esthétiques et centrées sur l’usage. Participer à la rédaction des cahiers des charges techniques, au choix des concepts et à la définition des spécifications fonctionnelles. Identifier et sourcer les composants adaptés aux produits en cours de développement. Assurer le suivi de projet en lien constant avec les fournisseurs. 2. Prototypage, essais et validation Piloter la fabrication des prototypes en collaboration avec les fournisseurs et les partenaires de prototypage rapide. Organiser, réaliser et documenter les essais internes et externes. Mettre en place une démarche structurée de validation des prototypes. Analyser les résultats d’essais, proposer des évolutions et les documenter. Assembler les prototypes dans l’atelier R&D. 3. Normalisation et conformité Intégrer les exigences réglementaires et normatives dès les phases amont de la conception. Préparer les dossiers techniques nécessaires à la certification des produits. Travailler avec les laboratoires d’essais externes pour garantir la conformité aux normes en vigueur. 4. Industrialisation et mise en production Accompagner la transition entre développement et production série, en lien avec les équipes internes et les fournisseurs. Rédiger les nomenclatures produits Valider la fabricabilité des pièces auprès des partenaires industriels. Suivre les premiers lots de production, identifier les défauts éventuels et mettre à jour la documentation technique en conséquence. 5. Support Qualité Appuyer le service Qualité dans la reconception de pièces selon les cahiers des charges définis. Contribuer à la démarche d’amélioration continue aux côtés de l’équipe Qualité. Profil recherché Savoirs et savoir-faire Formation Ingénieur / Bac + 5 ou équivalent avec une spécialité en Industrialisation / Mécanique Anglais courant Maitrise de SolidWorks Expérience de 2 ans minimum au sein d’un service BE Savoir être Dynamisme, esprit d’équipe, humilité, confiance et implication Créatif et rigoureux Capacité d’analyse et de synthèse Une vraie passion pour tout ce qui touche au « outdoor » ! Bon à savoir Vous bénéficiez de 60% de remise pour l’achat d’un vélo UTO Nous bénéficions de la mutuelle ALAN et des chèques déjeuners avec la carte SWILE Vous rejoignez une entreprise qui sait se réinventer chaque mois, et qui compte sur chacun de ses salariés (on compte sur toi !) Jusqu’à 2 jours de télétravail par semaine (après la période d’intégration) Pourquoi nous rejoindre Un poste complet et stimulant, avec une grande variété de missions Un environnement jeune, bienveillant et sans lourdeur bureaucratique Une immersion rapide avec des interlocuteurs disponibles et à l'écoute Un vrai impact sur la création de nos produits ! Process du recrutement Echange téléphonique avec Stéphanie notre RRH + entretien avec Ludovic notre responsable du BE et Stéphanie. Poste basé à Genas (69), région lyonnaise. CDI – poste à pourvoir au plus vite. Salaire : 35/37K€ brut suivant profil

Requirements 1. Education/Experience -Master's degree or above, major in Mechanical Design and Manufacturing and Automation, Mechanical Engineering, Vehicle Engineering, Power Machinery and Engineering and other related majors, PhD or 5+ years of experience at leading OEM or Tier-1/2 supplier preferred; -Experience in industry-leading product development and mass production is preferred; -Have successful experience in electric motor development, and those who develop products to achieve mass production status are preferred. 2. Knowledge -Proficient in the mechanical design principles, structural optimization methods and manufacturing processes of motors (stators, rotors, end covers, bearings, etc.), proficient in core technologies such as motor structural strength, vibration and noise control, sealing design, and assembly accuracy control, and familiar with the selection and application of lightweight materials (aluminum alloy, composite materials, etc.); -Familiar with the manufacturing processes of core motor mechanical components (such as machining, die casting, injection molding, welding, etc.), have good cost awareness and design for manufacturability capabilities, and be able to reduce motor product costs and improve production efficiency through design optimization; -Familiar with relevant industry standards for motor mechanics (such as automotive industry motor mechanical design standards, motor structure design standards, etc.), have rich experience in motor product testing and verification, able to formulate test plans, analyze test data and promote closed-loop of test problems; those familiar with quality tools such as DFMEA and PFMEA are preferred. 3. title: INGÉNIEUR CALCUL MÉCANIQUE – NUCLÉAIRE (H/F)
description: INGÉNIEUR CALCUL MÉCANIQUE – NUCLÉAIRE (H/F) Fonctions : Ingénierie mécanique / Calcul de structures / Industrie nucléaire Description du poste et des missions : Dans le cadre de projets techniques d'envergure dans le secteur nucléaire , situés à Marseille , nous recherchons un Ingénieur Calcul Mécanique (H/F) expérimenté, spécialisé dans les calculs de structures, la simulation numérique et la vérification de modèles complexes sous ANSYS Workbench . Vous interviendrez sur des projets liés aux équipements mécaniques nucléaires, notamment aux échangeurs de chaleur et aux équipements sous pression , en assurant la réalisation, la vérification et la validation des études de calcul mécanique. Vos principales missions seront les suivantes : Études et calculs mécaniques : Analyser les données d'entrée techniques et les exigences des projets. Définir les méthodologies de calcul et de dimensionnement mécanique. Réaliser et modifier des modèles éléments finis sous ANSYS Workbench . Effectuer des simulations numériques et des analyses de comportement mécanique. Définir les conditions aux limites, les chargements et les caractéristiques des matériaux. Réaliser le post-traitement des contraintes mécaniques dans les structures. Vérifier les assemblages boulonnés, les soudures, les ancrages et les descentes de charges. Participer aux études de résistance mécanique et de tenue des équipements. Rédiger les notes de calcul, rapports techniques et documents justificatifs. Vérification et contrôle technique : Assurer la vérification technique des études et des modèles numériques complexes. Contrôler la conformité des calculs aux exigences techniques et réglementaires. Vérifier la cohérence des hypothèses, des méthodes et des résultats de calcul. Identifier les écarts techniques et proposer des solutions correctives adaptées. Garantir la fiabilité et la robustesse des études réalisées. Participer à la validation des méthodologies de calcul. Assurer le respect des référentiels et des normes applicables au secteur nucléaire, notamment le RCC-M . Participer aux échanges techniques avec les équipes d'ingénierie et les responsables de projets. Assurer le reporting de l'avancement des études. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue et à la capitalisation du retour d'expérience technique. Les équipements concernés pourront notamment comprendre : Les échangeurs thermiques et échangeurs de chaleur. Les équipements mécaniques sous pression. Les structures et supports mécaniques. Les assemblages boulonnés et soudés. Les équipements mécaniques intégrés aux installations nucléaires. Profil recherché : Formation Bac+5 ou diplôme d'ingénieur en mécanique, calcul de structures, simulation numérique ou domaine équivalent. Minimum 10 ans d'expérience en calcul mécanique, idéalement dans le secteur nucléaire. Maîtrise impérative du logiciel ANSYS Workbench , avec une expérience approfondie d'au moins 8 ans. Excellente maîtrise de la méthode des éléments finis (MEF). Connaissance approfondie du code RCC-M . Expérience significative en vérification de modèles numériques complexes. Bonne connaissance des équipements mécaniques nucléaires et du fonctionnement des échangeurs de chaleur. Maîtrise des réglementations et codes de calcul applicables au secteur nucléaire. Capacité à lire et interpréter des plans mécaniques et des plans d'échangeurs. Bonne maîtrise des analyses de contraintes, des assemblages et des dimensionnements mécaniques. Capacité à rédiger des notes de calcul et documents techniques en anglais. Rigueur, autonomie, esprit d'analyse et capacité à apporter une expertise technique sur des projets complexes. Toutes les candidatures sont étudiées dans le respect de l'égalité des chances, de la non-discrimination et de la diversité. À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux personnes bénéficiant d'une Reconnaissance de la Qualité de Travailleur Handicapé (RQTH) . Des aménagements peuvent être étudiés afin d'adapter le processus de recrutement et le poste de travail. Localisation du poste : Marseille Secteur d'activité : Nucléaire / Ingénierie mécanique Contrat : Type de contrat : CDI Temps de travail : Temps plein Prise de poste : Dès que possible Télétravail : À définir selon les exigences du projet Rémunération : Selon le profil et l'expérience Informations utiles : Vous rejoindrez un environnement technique exigeant , au cœur de projets industriels nucléaires nécessitant une expertise approfondie en calcul mécanique et simulation numérique. Ce poste représente une belle opportunité de participer à des projets d'ingénierie complexes, avec une forte dimension technique et des perspectives d'évolution à long terme. Si vous disposez d'une solide expérience en calcul mécanique, maîtrisez ANSYS Workbench et connaissez les exigences du secteur nucléaire, notamment le RCC-M, n'hésitez pas à nous transmettre votre candidature.

title: FEA Engineer
description: Leading societies to a low carbon future, Alstom develops and markets mobility solutions that provide the sustainable foundations for the future of transportation. Our product portfolio ranges from high-speed trains, metros, monorail, and trams to integrated systems, customised services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility solutions. Joining us means joining a caring, responsible, and innovative company where more than 70,000 people lead the way to greener and smarter mobility, worldwide At Alstom, we build what millions depend on daily: rail transportation systems that can't afford to fail. We're more than 85,000 people worldwide creating the industry's most diverse portfolio: high-speed trains, metros, trams, maintenance services and integrated systems. More Than a Job: A Mission We are looking for a FEA Engineer to join our engineering team in Chorzów. In this role, you will use Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and structural calculations to support the design and validation of railway products, turning analysis results into practical engineering solutions. You will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams and internal and external customers, ensuring that technical solutions meet project, quality and delivery requirements. Your Role, Your Impact Drive FEA and structural calculation activities throughout the project, from planning and analysis to validation and delivery of technical documentation. Apply relevant calculation methodologies, engineering processes and simulation tools to deliver reliable analyses that meet project and customer requirements. Translate analysis results into engineering recommendations, proposing design improvements, reinforcements or simplifications of calculated parts. Prepare FEA validation plans and calculation reviews, document results and follow up on key technical actions in line with project schedules. Monitor and report progress, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and customers, and proactively flag risks that could impact Quality, Cost and Delivery (QCD) commitments. What You Bring A degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline, with 3+ years of relevant experience, ideally in railway or a comparable engineering environment. Hands-on experience in Finite Element Analysis (FEA), structural calculations and mechanical simulation; experience with tools such as ANSYS, HyperMesh or NASTRAN is an advantage. A structured, analytical and hands-on approach, combined with good planning, prioritization and time-management skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and internal or external customers, challenge solutions and raise technical concerns when needed. Good English, both written and spoken, enabling you to prepare technical documentation and participate effectively in engineering meetings. How Success Is Measured High-quality FEA and structural calculation deliverables completed in line with project milestones. Effective validation planning, calculation reviews and timely closure of technical actions. Practical design improvements resulting from structural analysis. Proactive identification and escalation of technical or project risks. Effective cooperation with engineering teams and internal and external customers. Alstom, A Great Place to Grow Work with cutting-edge digital engineering tools shaping the future of mobility. Contribute to global projects with tangible local impact in Chorzów. Grow your career through continuous learning and technical development programs. Here, progress isn't always easy but the impact is real. Because the scale is massive, the tasks are complex when the system runs, the train moves, and the city connects that feeling stays with you. And the legacy lasts. Alstom is the leading company in the mobility sector, solving the most interesting challenges for tomorrow’s mobility. That’s why we value inquisitive and innovative people who are passionate about working together to reinvent mobility, making it smarter and more sustainable. Day after day, we are building an agile, inclusive and responsible culture, where a diverse group of people are offered opportunities to learn, grow and advance in their careers, with options across functions and geographic locations. Are you ready to join a truly international community of great people on a challenging journey with a tangible impact and purpose? Equal opportunity statement: Alstom is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive working environment where all our employees are encouraged to reach their full potential, and individual differences are valued and respected. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by local law.

title: Döner Ekipman Mühendisi
description: Biz Kimiz? 1993 yılında kurulan Rönesans Holding, bugün Türkiye, Avrupa, Orta Asya ve Afrika’yı kapsayan geniş bir coğrafyada; inşaat, gayrimenkul, enerji, endüstri ve sağlık alanlarında ana müteahhit ve yatırımcı olarak faaliyet göstermektedir. 40.000’i aşkın çalışanı ve 60’tan fazla milletten oluşan güçlü ve çok kültürlü ekibiyle Rönesans, dünyanın en büyük müteahhitlik şirketleri arasında yer almakta; sürdürülebilir bir gelecek inşa etme vizyonuyla yenilikçi ve küresel ölçekteki mühendislik projelerini hayata geçirmeye devam etmektedir. Şirketimizin Türkmenistan’da yapımını üstlendiği endüstriyel tesis projesinde görevlendirilmek üzere Döner Ekipman Mühendisi aramaktayız. Bu Rolde Seni Neler Bekliyor? Teklif aşamasında, ihale sürecinde Teknik Teklif Departmanına teknik destek sağlamak ve adam/saat (manhour) tahminleri hazırlamak. Pompalar, kompresörler, fanlar ve blowerlar gibi döner ekipmanların seçimini yapmak. Teknik şartnamelerin hazırlanması ve yayımlanması. Makine ve ekipmanların seçimi ile performans değerlendirmelerini gerçekleştirmek. Teklif ve sipariş süreçleri için Malzeme Talep Dokümanlarının (Material Requisition) hazırlanması ve yayımlanması. Mekanik veri sayfalarının (Datasheet) hazırlanması ve yayımlanması. Tedarikçi listelerinin hazırlanması ve/veya değerlendirilmesi. Tedarikçilerden gelen makine tekliflerinin teknik inceleme ve değerlendirmelerinin yapılması. Tedarikçi çizim ve dokümanlarının kontrol edilmesi, incelenmesi ve takibi. P&ID (Borulama ve Enstrümantasyon Diyagramları) dokümanlarının gözden geçirilmesi ve yorumlanması. Özel amaçlı makineler için test faaliyetlerine katılım sağlamak ve gerektiğinde denetim (inspection) ekibine destek vermek. Gerektiğinde özel amaçlı makinelerin sahadaki devreye alma (commissioning) ve ilk çalıştırma (start-up) faaliyetlerine katılmak. Adaylardan Beklentilerimiz Makine Mühendisliği lisans derecesine sahip olmak. Türbomakine ekipmanlarının seçimi ve performans değerlendirmesi konusunda en az 5 yıl deneyim sahibi olmak. API standartları hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak tercih sebebidir (API 610, API 618, API 682 vb.). Endüstriyel/ Rafineri /Bakım projelerinde deneyimi olan, İyi düzeyde İngilizce dil bilgisine sahip, Ekip çalışmasına yatkın olan, Biz Neler Sunuyoruz? Performans ve başarıyı destekleyen prim uygulamaları Kapsamlı yan haklar ve çalışan destek uygulamaları Özel Sağlık Sigortası kapsamında çalışanlarımızı destekleyen sağlık uygulamaları Mesleki ve kişisel gelişimini destekleyen eğitim ve gelişim programları Çeşitlilik ve Eşitlik Beyanımız Rönesans Holding, şirketlere stratejilerini ve operasyonlarını evrensel insan hakları, çalışma, çevre ve yolsuzlukla mücadele ilkelerine uygun hale getirmeye ve toplumsal hedefleri ilerletecek önlemler almaya çağıran BM Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi'nin imzacıları arasında yer almaktadır ve Birleşmiş Milletler Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi çerçevesinde evrensel kabul görmüş beyanlara dayalı ilkeleri benimser. Rönesans Holding, ana ilkeleri olan dürüstlük, rekabetçilik ve yenilikçilikten ödün vermeden şeffaf ve etik değerleri gözeterek insan kaynakları uygulamalarında eşitliği sağlamayı amaçlayan bir işverendir. Tüm başvurular cinsiyet, dil, din, ırk ve etnik kökene bakmaksızın fırsat eşitliğine göre değerlendirilir ve ayırımcılık yapılmaz.

title: New Graduate Production Engineer (20 Months Contract)
description: Overview At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Pepsi, Doritos and Lipton Ice Tea, our work touches millions of people every day. At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve. Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you. We are looking for a Production Engineer - New Graduate to join our team in Adana Plant. This role will directly report to Plant Production Manager. This role offers an opportunity to build your career in Production through hands-on experience in a dynamic manufacturing environment. You will learn our processes, collaborate with different teams and contribute to continuous improvement and innovation initiatives. Responsibilities Support daily production activities and gain hands-on experience in end-to-end manufacturing processes. Follow key production indicators related to safety, quality, efficiency and waste, and support performance reporting and analysis. Participate in root cause analysis and continuous improvement activities together with Production, Quality and Maintenance teams. Contribute to Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen and productivity initiatives, bringing a fresh perspective to improve existing ways of working. Explore new ideas, technologies and innovative solutions that can contribute to safer, simpler and more efficient production processes. Collaborate with different plant functions and contribute to cross-functional improvement and innovation projects. Take part in daily production meetings and shop-floor activities, supporting the follow-up of agreed actions. Support compliance with PepsiCo standards and plant requirements related to safety, quality, food safety and environment. Work closely with operators and frontline teams to identify operational losses, solve problems and improve line performance. Qualifications Fresh graduate or professional with maximum 2 years of working experience. Bachelor’s degree in engineering, preferably Industrial, Mechanical, Electrical & Electronics, Mechatronics, Chemical or Food Engineering. Fluent in both English and Turkish. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Curious and eager to learn, explore new ideas and challenge existing ways of working. Strong collaboration and communication skills with a willingness to work across different teams. Agile and adaptable mindset, comfortable working in a dynamic manufacturing environment. Interest in continuous improvement, innovation, and new technologies within manufacturing.

title: Data Center Facilities Lead Engineer-Istanbul
description: We are looking for Data Center Facilities Engineer to support the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of mission-critical infrastructure across assigned data center sites. This role is responsible for on-site facilities operations, incident and change management, maintenance oversight, technical support, and continuous improvement of critical systems. You will work closely with internal teams and external service providers to ensure operational excellence, risk control, and high availability across data center facilities. Responsibilities Ensure the safe, stable, and compliant operation of critical facilities systems, including electrical, mechanical, cooling, fire protection, and monitoring systems. Lead on-site response to facilities incidents and safety events, including escalation, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and closure. Oversee the execution of planned changes, preventive maintenance, and routine inspections, ensuring quality, compliance, and documentation traceability. Monitor key operating metrics such as capacity, energy efficiency, and system reliability, and drive improvement opportunities across assigned sites. Provide technical support for complex site issues and contribute to engineering reviews, equipment selection, upgrades, and optimization initiatives. Coordinate with vendors, colo, and cross-functional teams to support smooth site operations and continuous improvement. Qualifications Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Facilities Engineering, Automation, or a related discipline. Relevant experience in data center facilities, mission-critical environments, telecom infrastructure, industrial operations, or large-scale commercial facilities. Strong knowledge of critical infrastructure systems such as power distribution, UPS, generators, HVAC/cooling, fire protection, and BMS/EPMS/DCIM platforms. Proven ability to manage incidents, planned works, maintenance activities, and operational risks in a high-availability environment. Strong problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills. Bilingual or multilingual proficiency is preferred, with proficiency in Chinese considered a strong advantage. Preferred Qualifications Experience in hyperscale, colocation, or enterprise data center environments. Familiarity with MOPs, SOPs, EOPs, permit-to-work processes, and operational risk controls. Experience working with third-party vendors and on-site operation teams. Relevant professional certifications in electrical, mechanical, HVAC, facilities, or data center operations.

Genel Nitelikler Makine, Metalurji ve Malzeme, Endüstri, Otomotiv veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun, Tercihen otomotiv ana sanayi veya Tier-1 tedarikçi firmalarda ürün geliştirme, proje yönetimi veya APQP süreçlerinde en az 2 yıl deneyimli, İyi derecede yazılı ve sözlü İngilizce bilgisine sahip, MS Office programlarını etkin kullanabilen, Tercihen SAP, MS Project veya benzeri proje planlama araçları konusunda bilgi sahibi, APQP, PPAP, VDA MLA (Maturity Level Assurance), mühendislik değişiklikleri (ECN/ECR) ve yeni ürün devreye alma (NPI) süreçleri hakkında bilgi sahibi, AIAG Core Tools (APQP, FMEA, SPC, MSA, PPAP) ve VDA metodolojileri konusunda bilgi sahibi, Tercihen VDA 6.3, müşteri özel gereklilikleri (CSR) ve OEM proje yönetim süreçleri konusunda deneyimli, Teknik resim okuyabilen, tercihen GD&T konusunda bilgi sahibi, Analitik düşünme, problem çözme, planlama ve organizasyon becerileri gelişmiş, Takım çalışmasına yatkın, iletişim yönü güçlü, sonuç ve müşteri odaklı çalışma anlayışına sahip. İş Tanımı Müşteri teklif aşamasından seri üretime kadar yeni ürün devreye alma (NPI) projelerini; zaman, maliyet, kalite ve kapsam hedefleri doğrultusunda yönetmek. Müşteri gereksinimlerini analiz ederek proje planlarını oluşturmak, kilometre taşlarını belirlemek ve proje ilerleyişini düzenli olarak takip etmek. Proje Kick-off, APQP, teknik gözden geçirme (Technical Review) ve milestone toplantılarını organize etmek, alınan kararların uygulanmasını takip etmek. Mühendislik, Kalite, Üretim, Satın Alma, Planlama, Lojistik ve Tedarikçi ekipleri arasında etkin koordinasyonu sağlayarak fonksiyonlar arası proje yönetimini yürütmek. Müşteri, tedarikçi ve şirket içi teknik ekiplerle etkin iletişim kurarak proje koordinasyonunu sağlamak. Proje bütçesini, ürün maliyetlerini ve Cost Walk çalışmalarını takip ederek proje finansal performansını izlemek. Maliyet düşürme, sürekli iyileştirme ve Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VAVE) çalışmalarını yürütmek. Prototip, numune, validasyon, PPAP ve seri üretime geçiş süreçlerini planlamak ve koordine etmek. Mühendislik değişikliklerini (ECN/ECR) ilgili fonksiyonlarla koordineli şekilde yönetmek ve müşteri gerekliliklerine uygun olarak yürütmek. Proje KPI'larını takip etmek, proje performans raporlarını hazırlamak ve düzenli olarak yönetime sunmak. VDA, AIAG ve müşteri özel gereklilikleri doğrultusunda proje dokümantasyonunun eksiksiz hazırlanmasını ve güncel tutulmasını sağlamak. Proje boyunca ortaya çıkabilecek teknik ve operasyonel problemlerin çözümüne liderlik etmek ve ilgili ekiplerle koordinasyonu sağlamak. Seri üretime geçiş (Launch Management) sürecini yöneterek ürünün hedeflenen kalite, maliyet ve termin kriterleri ile devreye alınmasını sağlamak. Müşteri memnuniyetini esas alarak proje hedeflerinin başarıyla gerçekleştirilmesini sağlamak. title: Ustabaşı - Mekanik Montaj
description: Milvus Robotics Hakkında Milvus Robotics olarak, sadece teknolojik trendleri takip etmekle kalmayıp aynı zamanda öncü olmayı hedefliyoruz. Otonom mobil robotların geleceğini şekillendirme ve önemli bir etki yaratma konusunda hazır hissediyorsanız, sizinle iletişime geçmek için sabırsızlanıyoruz! Misyonumuz, endüstrileri yeniden tanımlamak, operasyonları optimize etmek ve inovasyonu daha hızlı pazara sunmak için mobil robot teknolojisi ve yapay zekanın gücünden yararlanmaktır. Milvus Robotics olarak, gerçek iş ve toplumsal sorunlarla başa çıkan sofistike, güvenli ve verimli robotlar geliştirmekte gurur duyuyoruz. Milvus Robotics, robot teknolojisi ve ticari uygunluk arasındaki boşluğu kapatıyor. Otomasyonun, mobil robotların ve Yapay Zeka'nın (AI) teknolojik potansiyelini endüstriler arasında kullanarak üretimi, operasyonları ve pazara çıkış süresini iyileştirmeyi hedefliyoruz. Milvus Robotics olarak, iş ve toplumsal ihtiyaçları karşılamak için gören, düşünen ve hareket eden yüksek kaliteli robotlar geliştirmekten gurur duyuyoruz. Bu Rolde Sizi Neler Bekliyor? Firma bünyesinde yürütülen farklı projelerin günlük üretim planını son teslim tarihleri doğrultusunda iş istasyonlarına ve yönettiği ekibe dağıtmak; iş başlangıcında malzeme, iş talimatı, ekipman (tool), fikstür ve kalibrasyon durumunu kontrol etmek. Robot projelerinin mekanik montaj, demontaj ve parça değişim işlemlerini güncel iş talimatlarına göre yürütmek, yürütülmesini sağlamak; tork, bağlantı sabitleyici, gevşeme işareti, hizalama ve ölçü kontrollerinin eksiksiz uygulanmasını sağlamak. Uygunsuzluk durumunda operasyonu durdurmak, şüpheli yarı mamulü (WIP) ayırmak, uygunsuzluk raporu (NCR) için bilgi sağlamak ve onaylı yeniden işleme (rework) adımlarını yetkili personele uygulatmak. Çalışma alanının düzen, tertip ve temizliğini sağlatmak; el aletleri ve takımların bakımlarının yapılmasını sağlamak, Ekibe işbaşı eğitimi vermek ve yeni teknisyenleri yetki seviyelerine uygun işlerde görevlendirmek. title: Tedarikçi Kalite Mühendisi
description: BeeVision olarak, otomasyon çözümlerinde uzmanlaşmış, yenilikçi ve dinamik bir teknoloji şirketiyiz. Statik ve dinamik hacim ölçerler üreterek, dünya genelinde 50'den fazla ülkeye ihracat gerçekleştiriyoruz. Sektördeki güvenilir konumumuzu, sürekli gelişim ve müşteri memnuniyeti odaklı yaklaşımımızla pekiştiriyoruz. Üretim tesislerimiz ve yüksek kaliteli ürünlerimizle, endüstriyel otomasyon alanında çığır açmaya devam ediyoruz. Şimdi, büyüyen ekibimize katılacak yetenekli Tedarikçi Kalite Kontrol Mühendisi arıyoruz. Görev ve Sorumluluklar: Tedarikçilerde üretimi gerçekleştirilen sac metal (lazer kesim, abkant büküm), kaynaklı imalat, talaşlı imalat ve toz boya/kaplama süreçlerinin kalite standartlarına uygunluğunun denetlenmesi ve yönetilmesi, Fason üretim süreçlerinde oluşabilecek eksen/gönye sapması, büküm tolerans hataları ve kaynak deformasyonlarına karşı kök neden analizlerinin (8D, 5 Neden vb.) yapılması ve düzeltici/önleyici faaliyetlerin (DÖF) yürütülmesi, Kaynaklı imalat ve montaj adımlarında kaliteyi güvence altına alacak Kaynak Fikstürü ile büküm tolerans kontrollerini hızlandıracak Büküm Mastarı gereksinimlerinin belirlenmesi, tasarımı veya tasarım süreçlerine teknik girdi sağlanması, Tedarikçilere yönelik Kontrol Planları (Control Plan) ve fabrikamız için Giriş Kalite Kontrol (IQC) kriterlerinin oluşturulması ve uygulanmasının takibi, Fason operasyonlar arası ve sevkiyat aşamalarındaki parça kayıplarını önlemek adına parti/lot takibi, etiketleme ve irsaliye kontrolü gibi ürün izlenebilirlik sistemlerinin kurgulanması ve denetlenmesi, Tedarikçi sahasında periyodik kalite denetimlerinin gerçekleştirilmesi, tedarikçi performans puanlama ve geliştirme süreçlerinin koordine edilmesi, Hassas ölçüm aletleri (kumpas, mikrometre, komparatör vb.) ile saha doğrulamalarının yapılması ve teknik resim/standartlara (ISO 2768-mK vb.) uygunluk takibinin sağlanması, Kalite dokümantasyonunun, uygunsuzluk raporlarının ve tedarikçi kalite KPI'larının düzenli olarak raporlanması. Aranan Nitelikler: Üniversitelerin Makine, Metalurji ve Malzeme, Mekatronik veya İmalat Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, Tedarikçi kalitesi, kalite güvence veya kalite kontrol alanında en az 2-3 yıl deneyimli, Sac metal şekillendirme (lazer kesim, abkant büküm), gaz altı kaynağı (GMAW/MIG-MAG), talaşlı imalat ve elektrostatik toz boya/kaplama süreçlerine hakim, Teknik resim okuma, geometrik ölçülendirme ve toleranslandırma (GD&T) bilgisine sahip (ISO standartlarına hakim), Kaynak fikstürü ve kontrol mastarı mantığına/tasarımına aşina, tercihen CAD yazılımlarını (Autodesk Inventor vb.) aktif kullanabilen ya da yorumlayabilen, Giriş kalite, proses kontrol planı ve problem çözme metodolojileri (8D, Kök Neden Analizi, Balık Kılçığı vb.) konusunda tecrübeli, Saha çalışmalarına ve tedarikçi ziyaretlerine/denetimlerine yatkın, dinamik ve girişken, Detaylara önem veren, sistematik, disiplinli ve müzakere/iletişim becerileri güçlü, B sınıfı sürücü belgesine sahip ve aktif araç kullanabilen. Sunduğumuz İmkanlar: Tamamlayıcı Sağlık Sigortası Yol ve yemek yardımı Aidiyet Ödülleri Dinamik ve yenilikçi çalışma ortamı İlanımızın görev yeri Malıköy Başkent OSB / Ankara'da bulunan atölyemizdir. İş yerimize kişisel araç harici bir ulaşım imkanı bulunmamaktadır.

description: Sütaşkımız Sizinle Birlikte Büyüyor Sütün iyiliği ve bereketini yayma misyonu ile çalışan ve her biri işinin uzmanı 5.000 çalışma arkadaşımızın yanı sıra satış dağıtım grubundaki iş ortaklarımız ile birlikte 7.500 kişilik büyük bir aileyiz. Her geçen gün büyüyen Sütaş Ailesi’ne, yaratıcı, yenilikçi, heyecanı yüksek, uluslararası platformlarda çalışabilecek, takım çalışmasını seven çalışma arkadaşları katmak istiyoruz. Misyonumuzu benimseyen, vizyonumuzu paylaşan, değerlerimizi kendi değerleri ile örtüştüren, “Çiftlikten Sofralara” entegre iş modelimiz doğrultusunda gıda mühendisliği, makine mühendisliği, endüstri mühendisliği, veterinerlik, elektrik elektronik mühendisliği, işletme, iktisat, bilgisayar mühendisliği, yazılım mühendisliği gibi pek çok farklı bölümden mezun geleceğin Sütaş'lıları ile tanışma heyecanı içindeyiz. Siz de bu aileye katılarak Sütaş'lı olmaya ne dersiniz? Sütaş Karacabey Tesisimizde, Planlama ve Lojistik Grup Müdürlüğü bünyesinde "Üretim ve Tedarik Planlama Uzmanı" pozisyonunda aramıza katılmanız için başvurunuzu bekliyoruz. Nasıl Bir Takım Arkadaşı Arıyoruz? Üniversitelerin Endüstri Mühendisliği ya da İşletme Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, Hızlı tüketim sektöründe alanında en az 2 yıl deneyimli, İyi derecede İngilizce bilen, Analitik becerileri güçlü, iletişimi kuvvetli, sonuç odaklı ve ekip çalışmasına yatkın, MS Office uygulamalarına hakim, SAP’yi aktif olarak kullanabilen, tercihen Hana modülüne hakim, Erkek adaylar için askerlik görevini tamamlamış, Bursa'da ikamet eden/edebilecek olan. Takım Arkadaşımızdan Neler Bekliyoruz? Ürün ve malzeme stok sipariş yönetimi konusunda kontrol ve koordinasyonunun sağlanması, Ürün deposu stok raporlarının güncel tutulmasının sağlanması, Kendi kategorisi ile ilgili ürünlerin günlük ve haftalık fabrika bazlı üretim planlarının oluşturulması, sisteme üretim siparişlerinin girilmesi. Kendi sorumluluğundaki ürün gruplarının haftalık yapılan kategori toplantılarına katılır, planlama ve üretim ile ilgili aksiyonları alır. Kategorisine ait ürün gruplarının malzeme yeterliliklerini takip eder, satış hedeflerine ve üretim planlarına göre malzeme siparişlerinin açılmasını koordine ve kontrol eder. Sütaş ‘ta sizin için neler var? Çalışma arkadaşlarımızın potansiyellerini en üst seviyede gerçekleştirebilmeleri için kişisel gelişimlerini, bilgi, beceri ve yetkinliklerini destekler, fikir ve önerilerine değer verir, kazanımlarını, kariyer beklentilerini, iş sonuçlarını ve organizasyonun ihtiyaçlarını değerlendirerek onlara kariyer yolculuklarının ilerleyen yıllarında da farklı lokasyon ve iş kolları arasında geçiş imkanı sunarız.

title: Kalite Güvence Test Uzmanı
description: Kalite Güvence Test Uzmanı TEOPS Departman: Kalite Sektör: Savunma Sanayii / Elektro-Optik ve Mekatronik Sistemler Şirket Hakkında TARGET A.Ş. ortaklığında 2021 yılında kurulmuş olan TEOPS, savunma sanayiine 1975’ten beri hizmet veren TARGET A.Ş.’nin tecrübelerinden de faydalanarak, çok hızlı bir şekilde sektörün çözüm ortağı haline gelmiştir. TEOPS, savunma sanayii ve uzay alanlarında ülkemizin önemli projelerinde çalışmış deneyimli bir ekiple, elektro-optik ve mekatronik alanlarında sektörümüzün önde gelen firmalarına destek olmak için kurulmuş bir firmadır. İş Tanımı Pozisyon; firmamızda kalite yönetim sistemlerinin kurulması ve sürdürülmesi, proje bazlı kalite planlarının uygulanması, tedarikçi ve ürün denetimleri, muayene ve test süreçlerinin kalite gerekliliklerine uygun yürütülmesi, düzeltici/önleyici faaliyet ve risk yönetimi ile kalite dokümantasyonunun takibini kapsamaktadır. Bu doğrultuda, kalite yönetimi süreçlerine hâkim, analitik düşünebilen ve ekip çalışmasına yatkın yeni takım arkadaşları arıyoruz. Görev ve Sorumluluklar AS9100, ISO 9001 ve ilgili kalite yönetim standartlarının uygulanmasını ve sürekliliğini sağlamak. Sözleşme ve müşteri gereklilikleri kapsamında, ilgili NATO AQAP yayınları ve askerî standartlar doğrultusunda kalite güvence süreçlerini yürütmek. Proje bazlı kalite planlarını, muayene ve test planlarını hazırlamak; uygulanmasını ve güncelliğini takip etmek. Teknik şartnameler ve müşteri gereksinimleri doğrultusunda test prosedürlerini ilgili mühendislik ekipleriyle hazırlamak; test yöntemlerini, kabul kriterlerini ve gereksinimlerle izlenebilirliğini kontrol etmek. Giriş kalite kontrol, üretim içi kontrol ve son kabul faaliyetlerinin onaylı prosedür ve kontrol planlarına uygun yürütülmesini sağlamak. Tedarikçi kalite denetimlerini gerçekleştirmek; uygunluk belgelerini, malzeme sertifikalarını ve test raporlarını kontrol etmek. Proje gerekliliklerine göre MIL-STD-810 kapsamındaki çevresel koşul testleri ile MIL-STD-461 kapsamındaki elektromanyetik uyumluluk testlerinin planlanmasını koordine etmek; onaylı prosedürlere uygun yürütülmesini ve sonuçların raporlanmasını takip etmek. Elektro-optik ve mekatronik sistemlerin fonksiyonel ve performans testlerini, ilgili ekiplerle birlikte uygulamak veya uygulamaya nezaret etmek; sonuçların kabul kriterlerine uygunluğunu değerlendirmek. Test öncesinde numune ve ürün konfigürasyonunu, test düzeneğini, ortam koşullarını ve ölçüm ekipmanlarının kalibrasyon geçerliliğini kontrol etmek. Dış laboratuvarlarda gerçekleştirilecek test ve kalibrasyon faaliyetlerini koordine etmek; gerektiğinde TS EN ISO/IEC 17025 akreditasyon kapsamının ilgili hizmeti kapsadığını doğrulamak. Müşteri ve gerektiğinde resmî kalite güvence temsilcilerinin katıldığı muayene ve kabul testlerini koordine etmek; ilgili kayıt ve kabul dokümanlarını hazırlamak. Test sonuçlarını, ham ölçüm verilerini ve uygunsuzlukları izlenebilir şekilde kayıt altına almak; test raporlarının eksiksizliğini ve uygunluğunu kontrol etmek. Kök neden analizi, düzeltici/önleyici faaliyet ve risk yönetimi süreçlerini yürütmek; uygunsuzluklar sonrasında gerekli tekrar testlerini ve faaliyetlerin etkinliğini takip etmek. Konfigürasyon yönetimi ve kalite dokümantasyon süreçlerini takip etmek; test edilen ürünün donanım, yazılım ve doküman revizyonlarının kayıtlarla uyumunu sağlamak. Sevkiyat öncesinde gerekli muayene ve testlerin tamamlandığını, kabul kayıtlarının ve teslimat kalite dokümanlarının eksiksiz olduğunu doğrulamak. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin mühendislik bölümlerinden (Endüstri, Makine, Elektrik-Elektronik, Uçak, Havacılık-Uzay vb.) mezun. AS9100 Rev. D, ISO 9001 ve tercihen AQAP sistemleri hakkında bilgi sahibi. Ölçüm teknikleri, test yöntemleri ve kalibrasyon süreçlerine hâkim. Ekip çalışmasına yatkın, iletişim becerileri güçlü ve analitik düşünebilen. Teknik doküman okuyabilecek düzeyde iyi derecede İngilizce bilgisine sahip.

title: Planning Engineer
description: REED is one of the world's largest recruitment companies, delivering tailored recruitment solutions to organizations for more than 60 years. With 350 offices and 3,000 employees across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific, we provide global recruitment services across more than 20 specialist sectors. Through our expert consultants, we work closely with experienced and qualified professionals across various industries, delivering customized talent acquisition solutions to meet our clients’ specific needs. As REED Turkey , we are seeking a Planning Engineer for our client operating in the manufacturing sector. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering or a related Engineering discipline. Good command of English, both written and spoken. Minimum 2-4 years of experience in production and material planning, preferably within high-volume assembly, automotive supplier, or white goods manufacturing environments. Hands-on experience with ERP systems, particularly in production planning, MRP, and inventory management processes (Canias ERP experience is highly preferred). Good understanding of Bill of Materials (BOM), routing management, and capacity planning methodologies. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills with strong data analysis and reporting capabilities. Experience in inventory management, safety stock planning, lead time management, and capacity planning applications. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and organizational skills. Team-oriented, proactive, and results-driven approach. Job Description: Execute MRP (Material Requirements Planning) processes through the Canias ERP system to identify material requirements and support procurement activities. Prepare weekly and monthly Master Production Schedules (MPS) in line with customer orders and inventory targets. Perform capacity planning for production work centers, identify potential bottlenecks, and develop corrective actions proactively. Monitor daily production output, analyze deviations from plan, and revise production schedules accordingly. Track inventory levels of critical domestic and imported components and contribute to inventory optimization initiatives. Monitor and report key operational KPIs, including OTIF (On-Time In-Full), capacity utilization, and production efficiency. Ensure the accuracy of routing, work center, and Bill of Materials (BOM) data within the ERP system and support continuous improvement activities.

title: (Junior) Mechanical Engineer
description: Over de functie Ben jij een gedreven techneut die klaar is voor een uitdagende rol in de werktuigbouwkunde? Bij LiftingXperts (onderdeel Pewag Group) werk je als volwaardig lid van ons engineeringteam aan hoogwaardige oplossingen voor hijs- en hefapparatuur. Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid over je eigen projecten en werkt aan maatwerkoplossingen die wereldwijd in de industrie, bouw en logistiek worden ingezet. Wat ga je doen? Als Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het gehele traject van concept tot productievoorbereiding. Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit: Ontwerp & Ontwikkeling: Het ontwerpen van complexe hijsconstructies en technische systemen met behulp van SolidWorks . Engineering: Uitwerken van gedetailleerde 3D-modellen en technische 2D-tekeningen. Projectbeheer: Verzamelen van de juiste technische specificaties en opstellen van materiaallijsten en documentatie. Innovatie: Actief meedenken over het verbeteren van onze huidige producten en productieprocessen. Samenwerking: Schakelen met internationale productiepartners om jouw ontwerpen tot leven te laten komen. Jouw profiel Je hebt een afgeronde MBO- of HBO-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde/ Engineering met enkele jaren werkervaring. Je hebt een sterke passie voor machinebouw en zware constructies. Je kunt uitstekend uit de voeten met SolidWorks (ervaring met simulaties/FEA is een pré). Je bent nauwkeurig, proactief en beschikt over een flinke dosis technisch inzicht. Je bent een teamplayer die ook uitstekend zelfstandig projecten kan trekken. Wat bieden wij? Wij bieden een modern pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden conform de CAO Metaal en Techniek: Bij een fulltime dienstverband (40-urige werkweek) heb je recht op 25 vakantiedagen en 13 Adv-dagen per jaar. Een marktconform salaris en 8% vakantiegeld . Informele cultuur: Werken in een team van "nuchtere Tukkers" waar hard werken en plezier hand in hand gaan. Groei: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en professionele ontwikkeling onder begeleiding van ervaren vakmensen. Geïnteresseerd? Ben jij de proactieve Engineer die echt impact wil maken? title: Mechanical Engineer - Team Pumps & Specials
description: Ben jij een gedreven Mechanical Engineer met een passie voor zware machinebouw en mobiele hydraulische installaties? Wil jij systemen ontwerpen die wereldwijd het verschil maken tijdens grootschalige overstromingen, industriële incidenten en natuurbranden? Kom dan ons team in Lemmer versterken! Over de functie: Hytrans is een vooruitstrevend bedrijf dat een compleet en uniek systeem maakt, dat ingezet wordt bij de bestrijding van rampen en reddingsoperaties. Een product waar je trots op kunt zijn. We zijn een nuchtere en informele organisatie met klanten in de gehele wereld. Hytrans is wereldmarktleider en heeft de ambitie om dat ook in de toekomst te blijven. In Lemmer werken circa 100 gemotiveerde medewerkers die de producten verkopen, ontwikkelen, assembleren en support verlenen. Binnen het team Pumps & Specials richten we ons specifiek op de ontwikkeling en engineering van mobiele, diesel-hydraulisch aangedreven waterpompunits (zoals de HydroSub) en (klant specifieke) specials. Als Mechanical Engineer werk je aan zowel nieuwe productinnovaties als complexe klantorders en specifieke aanpassingen. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too. Provide technical expertise with Sales, Sourcing, Service, and Manufacturing. Drive continuous improvement and standardization efforts. Ensure lessons learned are captured and implemented. You communicate clearly, influence effectively, and build strong relationships with stakeholders. You make sound technical decisions based on data and engineering principles, identify risks early, and balance customer needs with quality, cost, safety, and schedule. title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: 10% of Europe’s CO₂ emissions are caused by residential heating, and energy bills are out of control. Aira is here to change that. With our intelligent Aira Heat Pump at the heart, we’re making the switch to clean energy-tech easier and more affordable. Helping Europe turn off gas and slashing energy costs one home at a time. Founded in 2022 and with 1200+ employees and counting, Aira is driving the clean energy revolution by providing homes with modern clean energy-tech solutions such as solar power, battery storage solutions, and heat pumps. With a state-of-the-art production facility in Poland, and HQ in Stockholm, Sweden, and hubs across the UK, Germany and Italy, Aira is well on track to install clean energy-tech into 5 million homes by 2034. About The Role: We are now looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to join us on our journey to shape the future of clean energy. In this role, you won't just design – you’ll help drive innovation at the core of Aira’s next-generation heat pump technology. As part of our fast-scaling team, you’ll influence how we work, accelerate product development, and bring bold ideas to life. Your contributions will directly impact both our team’s growth and the products we create – products that will transform how people heat and power their homes. By joining us, you’ll play an essential role in our mission to make sustainable living accessible to millions and create real, positive change for the planet. What You’ll Be Doing: As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will be at the heart of developing the next generation of Aira’s intelligent heat pumps and home energy systems. Your work will span the full development cycle – from concept to detailed design, testing, verification, and preparation for manufacturing – giving you the opportunity to make a direct impact on how our products take shape and reach the market. You’ll design and develop cutting-edge mechanical solutions, with a strong focus on robust design and innovation while balancing the final performance, product size, and costs. Beyond design work, you will influence our ways of working and the technologies we choose, playing a pivotal role in shaping Aira’s future product portfolio. This is not just about engineering excellence – it’s about driving innovation that enables sustainable living for millions of households. By joining us, you’ll help turn bold ideas into tangible solutions that make a real difference for both people and the planet. Your key responsibilities will include: Designing and developing mechanical parts and assemblies, Bills of Materials and component selections tailored for high-performance heat pump systems and its accessories. Creating detailed technical documentation, including 3D models and 2D drawings (experience with PLM tools and SolidWorks is highly valued). Actively contributing to project meetings and reporting progress to product management, ensuring accurate planning, follow-up, and monitoring of all activities within the designated area. Collaborating closely with cross-functional engineering teams to ensure compliance with customer needs, regulatory standards, and the overall product vision and requirements. Exploring and integrating innovative materials and tooling methods, for example within plastics and sheet metals, to enhance product quality, sustainability, and long-term reliability. Designing enclosures for electronics, such as PCBAs and/or similar, by plastic injection molding and/or sheet metal. Working closely with industrial design, taking over A-surfaces, and realizing the CMF specifications. Collaborating with main suppliers and development partners. What You’ll Bring To The Role: Solid experience in mechanical design or relevant technical fields, such as product development and mechanical engineering. B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering or M.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Design & Product Development, or equivalent. Experience working with 3D tools for designing mechanical components in a 3D environment; SolidWorks proficiency is advantageous. Experience in consumer products involving electronics and embedded software. Experience in testing, reliability, and qualification of systems, either in-house or on the partner side. Proven track record in transitioning designs into mass production, ensuring rigorous quality control and reliability standards. Experience working in the conceptual phase, physical prototyping, hands-on testing, and sustainability. Experience working closely with industrial designers. Proficiency with tools such as PowerPoint or Adobe and the ability to present ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences. An open mindset and a passion for working in a start-up environment with a strong ambition to scale quickly. What is in it for you? Gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing scale-up, with a supportive and inclusive culture, and career advancement opportunities. Collaborate with diverse teams across international markets and launch products globally. Develop and grow personally and professionally in an entrepreneurial-minded environment. Thrive in a dynamic, solution-oriented culture, tackling challenges and driving meaningful solutions that make a positive impact on the world. Influence the company's success, with a visible impact on product development and market growth. Enjoy our brand-new R&D Center located at Berga, Helsingborg. At Aira, we champion next-generation energy as well as diversity and inclusion. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, enhancing our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives to join our team. Our commitment is to uphold equality and inclusivity, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to a better future for our people and the planet.

description: As a Structures Analyst at Red Bull Technology, you'll work on some of the most advanced engineering challenges in motorsport, using your analytical expertise to influence the design, optimisation and validation of components that help define the performance of our Formula One cars. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of motorsport innovation, analysing and optimising highly advanced structures that perform in one of the most demanding engineering environments in the world. Your work will directly influence the performance, safety and reliability of our race cars, helping us push the limits of what's possible on and off the track. What you’ll be doing Deliver structural assessments and performance-driven analysis of components and assemblies, ensuring designs meet the demanding requirements of Formula One competition. Use a combination of Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and classical engineering calculations to validate, optimise and refine innovative design concepts. Collaborate closely with Design, Aerodynamics, Vehicle Dynamics, R&D Testing and the Race Team to influence engineering decisions from concept through to trackside performance. Investigate structural behaviour across a range of advanced materials, including composites, metals and plastics, helping to maximise performance while maintaining reliability and safety. Contribute to the continuous development of our race cars by identifying opportunities for weight reduction, increased stiffness and enhanced durability in pursuit of competitive advantage. What You'll Bring We're looking for an engineer who combines strong analytical thinking with a practical understanding of real-world engineering challenges. You'll have: Experience in structural analysis within a high-performance engineering environment. Confidence using both classical hand calculations and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) techniques. A proven ability to investigate, optimise and validate engineering designs. Broad knowledge of structural behaviour across a variety of materials, including composites, metals and plastics. A collaborative mindset and the drive to continually challenge convention in pursuit of performance. Why Join Us? This is far more than a Structures Analyst role. It's a chance to see your work translated directly into world-class racing performance. Alongside a competitive salary, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package including: Performance-related bonus scheme Private healthcare Life assurance Company pension contribution On-site gym and fitness classes Workplace nursery Cycle-to-work scheme Free food on campus At Red Bull Racing & Technology, we believe our greatest strength is our people. We celebrate every success - together - and know that trust and collaboration are what drive us forward as one team. We’re committed to building a workplace where everyone can thrive, no matter their background or identity. Diversity fuels creativity, and inclusion unlocks potential. That’s why we actively foster a culture where you can bring your full self to work, feel you belong, and be part of something extraordinary. If you're passionate about engineering excellence, thrive on solving complex technical challenges, and want to make an impact in Formula One, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Ingénieur Conception F/H/X (Design Engineer)
description: Avec un chiffre d'affaires de 700 millions d'euros et 3300 employés dans le monde, Nemera est l'un des principaux fabricants mondiaux de systèmes complexes d'administration de médicaments pour l'industrie pharmaceutique, offrant aux patients un large portefeuille de produits comprenant des dispositifs d'inhalation, des dispositifs d'injection, des pompes nasales et cutanées et des dispositifs d'administration ophtalmique. Nemera a établi des relations solides et durables avec les principales industries pharmaceutiques mondiales en fournissant des services de développement, d'industrialisation et de fabrication de haute qualité. Nemera développe et fabrique ses propres plates-formes de produits IP, mais propose également des développements entièrement personnalisés et une fabrication sous contrat. Les sites de production de Nemera sont situés aux États-Unis, en France, en Allemagne, en Pologne et au Brésil. Le siège social et le Centre d'innovation pour la conception et le développement de dispositifs sont situés à Lyon 7e. Description du poste Ingénieur Conception F/H/X Design Engineer F/H/X (CDI) Nemera recrute un.e nouveau.velle Design Engineer F/H/X pour rejoindre son Centre d’Innovation basé à Lyon 7e. Le.la Design Engineer contribue à la réalisation de phases de vie série en lien avec les usines, dans la gestion d’une activité technique ou liée à la conception. Il, elle sera également amené.e à travailler sur des projets de développement. Il, elle gère la documentation du projet selon le processus New Product Innovation (NPI) pour les phases de conception. Le poste reporte directement au Design Manager. Missions (liste non exhaustive) : Activités de conception: Contribuer à définir et créer des produits ou concepts innovants, basés sur des principes d’ingénierie, Conception détaillée des composants et des produits, y compris l’analyse de tolérance des systèmes, Application d’approches de tests appropriés pour réduire les risques dans une conception, Investigations et études de robustesse sur certaines fonctions du produit, Contribuer à l’activité Design for Manufacturing (DfM), Analyser les défaillances potentielles du produit et définir les plans d’actions de résolution de ces défaillances, Soutenir activement la qualification de conception, y compris le développement de tests, Interaction technique avec des fournisseurs, Rédaction de rapports techniques et production de documentation de conception de haute qualité, dans le respect du process de change control Interaction technique avec les usines : projet, qualité, injection, assemblage et métrologie Participation au projet: Travailler avec des équipes multidisciplinaires pour créer des solutions nouvelles et innovantes, Participer aux revues de projets, Participer à des activités de projet partagées, telles que des analyses de risque, Contribuer au transfert du projet à d’autres étapes, en soutenant le transfert des conceptions vers la fabrication, les opérations et les fournisseurs. Participer aux revues et groupes de travail d’amélioration continue avec les usines en France et à l’international. Qualifications Profil recherché : Vous êtes diplôme(e) en génie mécanique, en génie de conception ou en génie de conception de produits. Vous avez une formation technique dans la conception et le développement de produits (le dispositif pharmaceutique serait idéal) et une expérience solide (8 à 10 ans) dans la conception détaillée et le développement de produits. Vous maîtrisez la conception, le développement de produits de grande série et de l’injection plastique. Vous aimez comprendre comment fonctionnent les produits et les systèmes mécaniques. Vous savez structurer une démarche expérimentale de manière rigoureuse. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et les échanges avec différents métiers. Vous avez une expérience confirmée des logiciels de CAO (idéalement SolidWorks ou Creo) et / ou outils FEA (structure, fluide, moldflow,…). Rigoureux.se et autonome, vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos capacités d’analyse. Votre relationnel et vos qualités de communication vous permettent d’interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés, sur site ou à distance. Vous parlez couramment l’anglais et le français. Si vous êtes : - A la recherche d'une entreprise en croissance qui vous offrira la possibilité de vous développer, - Attaché.e au travail en équipe et aux environnements bienveillants, - Fier.e de participer à la fabrication de produits qui améliorent la vie des patients, - Et que vous vous efforcez de donner le meilleur de vous-même pour respecter vos engagements, Alors vous vous épanouirez chez Nemera ! Nous offrons la possibilité de télétravailler jusqu’à deux jours par semaine (à l’issue de la période d’essai) Chez Nemera, nous nous engageons à favoriser un environnement de travail qui valorise et célèbre la différence, qui est juste et équitable, et qui est enrichi par l'ouverture, la curiosité et la responsabilité. Tout le monde chez Nemera a un rôle à jouer et la diversité et l'inclusion sont de la responsabilité de chacun. Parce que quand tout le monde est inclus, Nemera gagne ! C'est pourquoi, Nemera est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances et, conformément à notre politique de diversité, nous examinons toutes les candidatures qualifiées, y compris celles des personnes en situation de handicap. Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature. Nous offrons des opportunités d’emploi variées au sein d'un groupe international. Ainsi, si vous souhaitez en savoir plus sur Nemera, n'hésitez pas à consulter notre site www.nemera.net Vous connaissez quelqu'un qui travaille chez Nemera ? Nous avons un programme de cooptation, alors assurez-vous qu'il/elle vous coopte avant de postuler ! title: Postdoktor inom Materialberäkningskemi
description: Institutionen för kemi - Ångström bedriver forskning och utbildning inom kemiämnet. Institutionen har 270 anställda och omsätter 300 miljoner kronor. Vid institutionens sex program bedrivs mycket framgångsrik forskning av hög internationell klass. Vi har ett stort antal externt finansierade forskningsprojekt, ofta med internationellt samarbete och vi ser en fortsatt god tillväxt inom vårt ämnesområde. Institutionen har utbildningsuppdrag inom ingenjörs- och civilingenjörsprogram samt masterprogram. Mer information finns på vår hemsida. Arbetsuppgifter Forskningsprojektets mål är att öka förståelsen för de mekanismer som styr jontransporten i keram-polymer-kompositelektrolyter för fasta tillståndets batterier och ge riktlinjer för utveckling av material med förbättrad jonledningsförmåga. Arbetet fokuserar på metodutveckling samt utveckling och tillämpning av beräkningseffektiva multiskaliga modeller, med särskilt fokus på statistisk termodynamik och sannolikhetsbaserade dynamiska metoder, såsom molekyldynamik och kinetisk Monte Carlo, för att studera transport inom och mellan materialens olika faser. Atomistiska simuleringar och experimentella data används för att utveckla och validera modellerna, med särskilt fokus på interfasernas betydelse för jontransporten. Projektet finansieras av Energimyndigheten och kommer att genomföras inom forskningsprogrammet Strukturkemi vid Uppsala universitet vilket rymmer både forskningsmiljön för Materialberäkningskemi och Ångström Advanced Battery Centre (ÅABC). Postdoktorn kommer att vara en aktiv del av båda dessa miljöer. Projektet genomförs i samarbete med LEPMI vid Grenoble INP i Frankrike. I arbetet ingår även en forskningsvistelse om cirka två månader per år vid Grenoble INP. Kvalifikationer För anställning som postdoktor krävs doktorsexamen (eller utländsk motsvarighet) inom området kemi, fysik, materialvetenskap eller annat för de befattningsrelevanta områdena, inom högst tre (3) år före sista ansökningsdag. Om det finns särskilda skäl kan en tidigare doktorsexamen accepteras. Med särskilda skäl avses ledighet på grund av sjukdom, föräldraledighet, förtroendeuppdrag inom fackföreningar m.m. Bedömningen av ansökningar baseras i första hand på den sökandes förmåga att bedriva självständig forskning utifrån vetenskaplig skicklighet. Kvaliteten på det enskilda vetenskapliga arbetet kommer att läggas större vikt än vid antalet publikationer. Den sökande förväntas ha mycket goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift. En gedigen bakgrund inom beräkningskemiska metoder för olika längd- och tidsskalor, inklusive dynamiska simuleringar, samt en stabil grund i statistisk termodynamik krävs. Den sökande ska ha erfarenhet av och förmåga att samarbeta med experimentella forskare, förmåga att bygga välfungerande team samt ledarskapsförmåga som kan bidra till handledning av doktorander och masterstudenter. Förmåga att kommunicera vetenskap tydligt i tal och skrift krävs också. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid dessa förmågor i bedömningen. Önskvärt/meriterande i övrigt Erfarenhet av metodutveckling och modellering av material samt transportmekanismer och interfaser är meriterande, liksom programmeringskunskaper och erfarenhet av maskininlärning. Villkor Anställningen är tidsbegränsad i 2 år enligt centralt kollektivavtal. Omfattningen är heltid. Tillträde 2027-01-01 eller enligt överenskommelse. Placeringsort: Uppsala Upplysningar om anställningen lämnas av: Amber Mace, epost: amber.mace@kemi.uu.se I denna rekrytering har vi ersatt det personliga brevet med frågor som du besvarar i samband med din ansökan. Svaren kommer att användas som en del i urvalsprocessen. Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 30 november 2026, UFV-PA 2026/3260. Uppsala universitet är ett brett forskningsuniversitet med stark internationell ställning. Det yttersta målet är att bedriva utbildning och forskning av högsta kvalitet och relevans för att göra skillnad i samhället. Vår viktigaste tillgång är alla 7 500 anställda och 53 000 studenter som med nyfikenhet och engagemang gör Uppsala universitet till en av landets mest spännande arbetsplatser. Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att jobba inom Uppsala universitet https://uu.se/om-uu/jobba-hos-oss/ Anställningen kan komma att säkerhetsprövas. Vid säkerhetsprövning är en förutsättning för anställning att sökande blir godkänd. Vi undanber oss erbjudanden om rekryterings- och annonseringshjälp. Ansökan tas emot i Uppsala universitets rekryteringssystem. Fackliga företrädare: Saco-S - saco-s@uu.se, Seko - seko@uadm.uu.se, ST (OFR/S) - ofr@uu.se

description: Inkjet Technology - Global Business Development Manager 📌 Location: Germany Home Office/Hybrid The Opportunity is for a commercially minded and technically credible Global Business Development Manager to identify and develop new growth opportunities across Inkjet Technologies. This is a strategic market development role focused on evaluating new applications, technologies, customers and partnerships that will support long-term business growth. Working closely with global teams, customers and industry partners, you will help translate technical innovation into commercially successful opportunities. Key Responsibilities: Identify and develop new market opportunities, growth areas and applications. Evaluate market trends, customer needs and emerging applications. Build business cases and market-entry strategies for new growth initiatives. Engage with customers, partners and industry stakeholders to uncover opportunities. Background in business development, product management, applications, technical marketing, sales or a similar commercial/technical role. Strong ability to build relationships and identify new business opportunities. Fluent English and willingness to travel across Europe. title: Operations Manager (Materials Testing)
description: The Operations Manager – Aerospace Materials Testing is responsible for leading the day-to-day operations of an materials testing laboratory, ensuring the safe, efficient, and compliant delivery of high-quality testing services to aerospace and defense customers. This role oversees laboratory personnel, testing activities, equipment, scheduling, productivity, and operational performance across disciplines such as mechanical testing, metallurgical testing, fracture and fatigue testing, and materials characterization. The Operations Manager will work closely with Engineering, Quality, Sales, Customer Service, and Business Development to ensure customer requirements are met, testing programs are delivered on time, and operational objectives are achieved. The successful candidate will combine strong operational leadership with technical knowledge of materials testing, a focus on continuous improvement, and the ability to develop high-performing teams in a highly regulated aerospace environment. Key Responsibilities 1. Laboratory Operations Management 2. Aerospace Customer and Regulatory Compliance 3. People Leadership and Development 4. Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement 6. Cross-Functional and Customer Collaboration Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Materials Science, Metallurgy, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered. Typically 5+ years of experience in laboratory operations, materials testing, aerospace testing, or a related industrial testing environment. Demonstrated experience managing technical teams, laboratory personnel, or manufacturing/testing operations. Working knowledge of aerospace materials testing processes, including mechanical testing, metallurgy, fracture mechanics, or fatigue testing. Understanding of quality management systems and ISO/IEC 17025 requirements. Experience managing operational KPIs, resource planning, productivity, and customer delivery commitments. Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills. Demonstrated commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement. Preferred Experience within a Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) organization or an independent materials testing laboratory.

description: Was uns stark macht? Unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter in 50 Ländern weltweit, die täglich mit Leidenschaft an innovativen Lösungen aus Wolfram und Molybdän für die Hightech-Welt arbeiten. Unser Standort in Reutte ist der Hauptsitz und größte Produktionsstandort der Plansee Gruppe. Hier sind die Geschäftsbereiche Plansee und CERATIZIT sowie zentrale Konzernfunktionen angesiedelt, die Innovationen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette der Pulvermetallurgie umsetzen. Werden Sie Teil eines hochmotivierten Teams, das lokale Stärken in Reutte, Österreich mit dem globalen Wissen und den Werten der Plansee Gruppe verbindet. Ihre Aufgaben Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen Berechnungsingenieur:in mit ausgeprägten strukturmechanischen Kenntnissen. Unsere Abteilung führt computergestützte Berechnungen, technische Softwareentwicklungen und Datenanalysen entlang der gesamten pulvermetallurgischen Wertschöpfungskette (von der Pulverherstellung bis zum Endprodukt und Kundenanwendungen) für die ganze Plansee Group durch. title: Makerspace Fellow (Winter/Spring 2027)
description: Fellowship Term: January-April 2027 Commitment: Part-time (20 hrs/week) or Full-time (40 hrs/week), with ability to flex schedule into the early evening after office hours About Formlabs: A 3D printer is one of the most demanding machines you can build. Lasers, optics, precision motion, thermals, airflow, materials handling, chemistry, sensing, controls, and software all have to work at micron-scale precision, for thousands of layers, with almost no tolerance for error. Making that work reliably is an extraordinary engineering problem. That’s what we do. At Formlabs, we’re building 3D printers that are changing the way things get made. We have the smartest minds across every engineering discipline, and the technology they’re building is deployed at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. If you’re energized by the idea of enabling employees to bring their (seemingly impossible) ideas to life, come join us as a Makerspace Fellow. The Job Maintain printers and tools in Community SLA printing spaces: routine cleaning, inspections, tank and cartridge swaps, and first-line troubleshooting. Keep the Community SLA Print Farm and Makerspace stocked, safe, and organized (resin, consumables, PPE, IPA and waste handling, hand and power tools). Print parts for the Workplace Experience and Recruiting teams, from internal event pieces to giveaways for career fairs and candidate events. Design and maintain the signage, workflows, and documentation that guide any employee to print independently. Host office hours and intro sessions for first-time printers. Find ways to improve how the equipment and workspaces are set up for making. Update the Fellow handbook as you go, so the next Fellow starts stronger than you did. Spend 2-4 hours per week working on a personal design or engineering project that showcases a unique or technically complex use of Formlabs hardware, software, and/or materials. You: A hands-on maker: you’ve built, fixed, or printed something because you wanted to see it exist. Organized and reliable; you can own a recurring checklist and keep it current. Comfortable helping people across a wide range of technical backgrounds, from engineers to recruiters. Self-directed with minimal supervision, and quick to ask for help when you get stuck. 3D printing experience with any technology (SLA or SLS a plus). Current undergraduate student. Bonus Skills (Optional): CAD experience (Fusion, Onshape, SolidWorks, Blender, etc.) Experience in a makerspace, fab lab, school shop, or customer-facing role Graphic design or content creation (signage, social) Fellow Benefits & Perks: Flexible schedule built around your classes Dedicated personal project time, plus materials Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits Catered on-site lunches (3x per week), snacks, beverages, & treats Cohort-based social and professional development experience Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community And of course… unlimited 3D prints Compensation Interns at Formlabs are paid on a bi-weekly pay schedule. The pay range for this role will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, location and expected impact on the organization. This is a salaried role, so you will always be paid based on the assumed 40 hours per week as a full-time intern. This position does not offer housing or relocation assistance. The weekly pay range for this role is: $1,000 — $1,300 USD
