title: TEKNİK OPERASYON VE GEMİ TAMİR MÜHENDİSİ
description: Denizcilik sektöründe faaliyet gösteren şirketimizde, gemilerin teknik ihtiyaçları ile bakım ve tamir taleplerine yönelik teklif hazırlama, planlama, koordinasyon ve iş takibi süreçlerinde görev alacak bir mühendis arıyoruz. İş Tanımı Gemilerden gelen teknik servis, bakım ve tamir taleplerini incelemek ve iş kapsamını netleştirmek. Teknik dokümanları, ekipman bilgilerini ve arıza bildirimlerini değerlendirerek uygun çözüm ve hizmet seçeneklerini araştırmak. Servis firmaları, atölyeler ve taşeronlardan teklif almak; teklifleri fiyat, teknik uygunluk ve iş süresi açısından karşılaştırmak. İş bazında maliyet hesaplamalarını yapmak ve müşteriye sunulacak teknik ve ticari teklifleri hazırlamak. Onaylanan işlerin personel, ekipman, malzeme ve zaman planlamasını ilgili ekiplerle koordine etmek. Gerektiğinde gemi ve tersane ziyaretleri gerçekleştirerek iş kapsamının belirlenmesine ve saha takibine destek vermek. Devam eden işlerin ilerleyişini takip etmek; gecikmeleri, ek iş taleplerini ve maliyet değişikliklerini zamanında bildirmek. İş tamamlandığında servis raporlarını, teslim belgelerini ve müşteri onaylarını kontrol ederek ilgili kayıtları tamamlamak. Açık talepler, hazırlanan teklifler, devam eden operasyonlar ve tamamlanan işler hakkında haftalık ve aylık raporlar hazırlamak. İş bazında bütçe, gerçekleşen maliyet ve kârlılık takibi yaparak yönetime rapor sunmak. Teknik talep, teklif ve operasyon kayıtlarını şirketin kullandığı CRM ve iş takip yazılımlarında güncel tutmak. Yeni servis firmaları, atölyeler ve teknik tedarikçiler araştırarak hizmet ağının geliştirilmesine katkı sağlamak. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Gemi İnşaatı ve Gemi Makineleri Mühendisliği, Gemi Makineleri İşletme Mühendisliği veya Makine Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun. Gemi bakım, onarım veya teknik servis süreçlerinde deneyimli. Gemi makineleri, yardımcı ekipmanlar ve gemi sistemleri hakkında teknik bilgi sahibi. Arıza ve tamir taleplerini anlayabilen; teknik dokümanları, çizimleri ve servis raporlarını okuyup yorumlayabilen. Tercihen tersane, gemi teknik servis firması veya denizcilik şirketlerinin teknik departmanlarında çalışmış. Yurt dışı müşteriler ve servis firmalarıyla yazılı ve sözlü iletişim kurabilecek düzeyde İngilizce bilen. Teknik teklif hazırlama, maliyet hesaplama, taşeron koordinasyonu ve iş takibi konularında yetkin. MS Office programlarını, özellikle Excel’i etkin kullanabilen; analiz ve raporlama yapabilen. Tercihen denizcilik sektörüne yönelik CRM veya operasyon takip yazılımlarını kullanma deneyimi olan. Planlama, iletişim ve problem çözme becerileri güçlü. İş takibi ve raporlama disiplini olan, sorumluluk sahibi ve ekip çalışmasına yatkın. Gerektiğinde gemi, tersane ve saha ziyaretlerine katılabilecek. Başvuru İlgilenen adaylar özgeçmişlerini, e-posta konu başlığına “Teknik Operasyon ve Gemi Tamir Mühendisi” yazarak hr@quantum-tms.com üzerinden iletebilirler.

title: Cad-Cam Operatörü
description: İş Tanımı ve Sorumluluklar Siemens NX CAD/CAM yazılımını kullanarak CNC işleme operasyonlarına yönelik CAM programları hazırlamak. 3, 4 ve 5 eksen CNC freze tezgâhları için uygun takım yollarını oluşturmak ve işleme stratejilerini belirlemek. Teknik resim, 3D model ve parça geometrilerini inceleyerek üretime uygun işleme yöntemlerini belirlemek. Kesici takım, takım tutucu, kesme parametreleri ve işleme stratejilerini parça özelliklerine göre seçmek. CAM programlarının CNC tezgâhlarında doğru ve verimli şekilde uygulanmasını sağlamak. İşleme sürelerini azaltmaya, takım ömrünü artırmaya ve üretim verimliliğini geliştirmeye yönelik çalışmalar yürütmek. Üretim ve kalite kontrol birimleriyle koordineli çalışarak teknik problemlerin çözümüne destek olmak. Gerekli durumlarda CNC tezgâhlarında ilk parça işleme, program doğrulama ve proses iyileştirme çalışmalarına destek vermek. Hazırlanan CAM programlarına ilişkin teknik dokümantasyon ve program kayıtlarını düzenli şekilde tutmak. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği, İmalat Mühendisliği, Mekatronik Mühendisliği veya ilgili teknik bölümlerinden mezun olmak ya da pozisyon için yeterli teknik deneyime sahip olmak. Siemens NX CAD/CAM yazılımına ileri seviyede hâkim olmak. 3 eksen, 4 eksen ve 5 eksen CNC freze tezgâhları için CAM programı hazırlama konusunda deneyimli olmak. 3D model üzerinden takım yolu oluşturma, operasyon sıralama ve işleme stratejisi belirleme konusunda bilgi sahibi olmak. Teknik resim okuma, ölçülendirme, toleranslar ve geometrik boyutlandırma konularında yetkin olmak. Kesici takımlar, takım tutucular, kesme hızları, ilerleme değerleri ve talaş kaldırma stratejileri hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak. Takım yolu simülasyonu, çarpışma kontrolü ve işleme optimizasyonu yapabilmek. CNC freze tezgâhlarının çalışma prensipleri ve işleme süreçleri hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak. Hassas talaşlı imalat süreçlerinde karşılaşılan teknik problemlere çözüm üretebilmek. Analitik düşünebilen, dikkatli, planlı ve sonuç odaklı çalışabilmek. Üretim ekibiyle koordineli çalışabilecek ve teknik iletişim becerilerine sahip olmak.

title: Lider Güdüm Kontrol ve Seyrüsefer Mühendisi
description: STM Savunma Teknolojileri Mühendislik ve Ticaret A.Ş. olarak, savunma teknolojilerinin geleceğini şekillendiren projelerde görev alacak; uzmanlığını geliştirmek, sorumluluk alanını büyütmek ve gerçek etki üretmek isteyen profesyonellerle tanışmak istiyoruz. İleri teknoloji projelerinde sorumluluk alabileceğiniz, teknik uzmanlığınızı yönetsel ve kişisel gelişim olanaklarıyla destekleyebileceğiniz bu yolculukta; çalışan gelişimini ve deneyimini merkeze alan yapımız ile sürdürülebilir başarıyı ve sürekli gelişimi esas alan bir kariyer fırsatı sunuyoruz. Proje Yöneticisi ve Proje Teknik Sorumlusu tarafından proje kapsamında verilen teknik görevleri yerine getirmek, projenin gerektirdiği dokümanlara girdi sağlayarak, gereksinimleri oluşturmak ve gereksinim analizi yapmak, MATLAB/Simulink veya benzeri araçlarla hava aracını ve sensörleri modellemek, Döner /sabit kanatlı hava araçları için güdüm, navigasyon ve kontrol (GNC) algoritmalarını geliştirmek, modellemek ve simüle etmek, Otonom uçuş, terminal güdüm ve rota optimizasyonu gibi görev algoritmalarını geliştirmek, Geliştirilen algoritmaların gerçek zamanlı gömülü sistemlere entegrasyonu faaliyetlerine destek olmak, Monte Carlo analizleri, performans testleri ve doğrulama faaliyetlerinin yürütülmesi, GNSS kısıtlı ortamlarda çalışacak navigasyon ve konum kestirim algortimaları geliştirmek, IMU, barometre, magnetometre, lidar, kamera, radar vb. sensör verilerini kullanarak füzyon algoritmaları geliştirmek ve optimize etmek, İnsansız sistemler konularında gelişmelerin uyarlanmasını sağlamak üzere yerli/yabancı standartları ve teknolojik gelişmeleri takip etmek, İş geliştirme faaliyetlerine ve proje teklif çalışmalarına destek sağlamak üzere müdürlük bünyesindeki faaliyetlere katılım sağlamak. Üniversitelerin ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun, İlgili pozisyonlarda minimum 8 yıl tecrübeli, Sistem/alt sistem modelleme alanında deneyimli, İleri derecede MATLAB/Simulink kullanabilen, Sabit kanatlı/döner kanatlı hava araçlarının uçuş dinamiği konusunda bilgi sahibi, Ataletsel seyrüsefer birimi, hava veri ölçüm birimi gibi hava aracı seyrüsefer sistemleri konusunda bilgi sahibi, Model tabanlı tasarım ve HIL/SIL test süreçleri hakkında bilgili, Güdüm algoritmaları (PN, MPN, APN vb.) konusunda güçlü teorik bilgiye sahip, Kontrol teorisi konusunda güçlü teorik bilgiye sahip; PID, LQR, MPC vb. kontrolcülerle çalışmış, Kalman filtreleri, sensör füzyonu veya navigasyon algoritmaları geliştirme konusunda tecrübeli, Tercihen Matlab Code Generation konusunda tecrübe sahibi, Sabit ve/veya döner kanatlı insansız hava araçlarıyla konusunda çalışmaya hevesli, Erkek adaylar için askerlik hizmetini tamamlamış / muaf, Ankara'da ikamet eden / edebilecek, Sözlü ve yazılı olarak iyi derecede İngilizce dil bilgisine sahip. #MilliMühendislikteSenVarsın #BuKariyerdeSenVarsın

title: Machine Maintenance Technician
description: Calderys has a fantastic opportunity to join our Maintenance Team as a Maintenance Technician. Responsibilities Perform preventive, corrective, and routine maintenance on production machinery and equipment. Diagnose and repair mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic failures, including component replacement and reassembly. Install, commission, and test machines, including utility connections, lubrication systems, and operational parameters. Monitor and inspect machine performance, safety systems, pressure levels, lubrication flow, and critical mechanical components. Conduct periodic maintenance on gearboxes, bearings, drive systems, clutches, brakes, and central lubrication systems. Adjust machine settings and ensure efficient, safe, and reliable operation of equipment. Maintain maintenance records, inspection reports, and documentation in compliance with quality management procedures. Follow occupational health, safety, environmental, and emergency response regulations while supporting continuous improvement and professional development activities. Requirements Requires high school diploma or G.E.D equivalent Strong computer skills and previous experience using on-line work order/preventive maintenance tracking system Knowledge of pneumatics and repair skills Ability to read drawings, schematics and blueprints Demonstrable knowledge and skills for electrical installation, maintenance and repair of electrical systems and equipment Strong math, analytical and problem-solving skills Strong understanding of Lean manufacturing principles Understanding of basic safety/OSHA standards Strong interpersonal skills in dealing with coworkers, contractors and vendors The Manufacturing Production Technician requires a strong track record of maintaining technical competency and five plus (5+) years of industrial manufacturing maintenance experience in a highly-automated, batching environment along with experience working on PLC (Modicon and Allen Bradly). Calderys Group Calderys is a leading global solution provider for industries operating in high temperature conditions . The Group specializes in thermal protection for industrial equipment with a wide range of refractory products, and advanced solutions to enhance steel casting, metallurgical fluxes and molding processes. As an international business with a presence in more than 30 countries and a strong footprint in the Americas through the brand HWI, a member of Calderys, we offer our employees a world of opportunity. With a legacy of over 150 years, and an unwavering commitment to excellence, we continue to shape our future through teamwork, customer-centricity and a proactive mindset. We are the vital partner of all high temperature industries and our purpose places sustainability and innovation at the heart of our business. It reflects our reason for existing: to support our customers building a better world through sustainable solutions. Our values are a driving force in this purpose: We are tenacious, accountable, multicultural and authentic.. In our company, performance is recognized and learning is promoted. Our services and solutions depend upon the expertise and commitment of our employees. So we ensure that they have the scope and opportunities to develop their potential within a diverse, inclusive and collaborative setting. It is an environment for people to grow, where every day is a new day and more exciting than the last. Calderys - Forged in legacy. Fueled by excellence. For more information, please visit Calderys.com

title: Kalite Kontrol Teknisyeni - Mekanik
description: Milvus Robotics Hakkında Milvus Robotics olarak, sadece teknolojik trendleri takip etmekle kalmayıp aynı zamanda öncü olmayı hedefliyoruz. Otonom mobil robotların geleceğini şekillendirme ve önemli bir etki yaratma konusunda hazır hissediyorsanız, sizinle iletişime geçmek için sabırsızlanıyoruz! Misyonumuz, endüstrileri yeniden tanımlamak, operasyonları optimize etmek ve inovasyonu daha hızlı pazara sunmak için mobil robot teknolojisi ve yapay zekanın gücünden yararlanmaktır. Milvus Robotics olarak, gerçek iş ve toplumsal sorunlarla başa çıkan sofistike, güvenli ve verimli robotlar geliştirmekte gurur duyuyoruz. Milvus Robotics, robot teknolojisi ve ticari uygunluk arasındaki boşluğu kapatıyor. Otomasyonun, mobil robotların ve Yapay Zeka'nın (AI) teknolojik potansiyelini endüstriler arasında kullanarak üretimi, operasyonları ve pazara çıkış süresini iyileştirmeyi hedefliyoruz. Milvus Robotics olarak, iş ve toplumsal ihtiyaçları karşılamak için gören, düşünen ve hareket eden yüksek kaliteli robotlar geliştirmekten gurur duyuyoruz. Bu Rolde Sizi Neler Bekliyor? Şasi, sac, kaynaklı ve boyalı parçalar, işlenmiş parçalar, bağlantı elemanları ve mekanik hazır (OTS) ürünlerin giriş kalite kontrollerini yapmak, Teknik resim, ölçü, tolerans, yüzey, kaynak, boya, sertifika, lot ve sevkiyat hasarı kriterlerini onaylı kontrol planına göre doğrulamak, Uygunsuz malzemeleri fiziksel ve sistemsel olarak karantinaya almak, uygunsuzluk kaydı (NCR) açmak ve Tedarik Zinciri ekibini bilgilendirmek, Planlanan mekanik tedarikçi saha kontrolleri, numune doğrulama veya denetim (audit) faaliyetlerine katılmak, Gizli veya kritik mekanik montaj kontrol noktalarında (gate) kayıtları, gerçek proses değerlerini, ekipman kimliğini, bağlantı sabitleyici uygulamalarını ve görsel kanıtları kontrol etmek, Test sonuçlarını, prosedür ve test düzeneği (fixture) versiyonlarını, seri numaralarını ve tekrar test (re-test) geçmişini eksiksiz kaydetmek, Standart kriterler içindeki ürünleri yazılı yetkisi dahilinde onaylamak (pass/release); uygunsuz ürünleri beklemeye (hold) almak, Hata (fail) durumlarını değiştirmeden kayıt altına almak ve ürünü teşhis veya yeniden işleme (rework) için ilgili üretim ve mühendislik ekiplerine devretmek, Yeniden işleme (rework) sonrasında bağımsız tekrar kontrol (reinspection) veya tekrar test (re-test) işlemlerini gerçekleştirmek, Ölçüm cihazlarının ve test düzeneklerinin günlük doğrulamasını yapmak; kalibrasyon veya versiyon sorunu durumunda testi durdurmak, Kalite ekibi içinde planlı çapraz görevler üstlenerek vardiya, izin ve girdi yoğunluğunda ürün test sürekliliğini sağlamak. Sizde Aradığımız Nitelikler Makine, metal, mekatronik, otomotiv, kalite veya ilgili alanlardan ön lisans mezunu, Giriş kalite, proses kalite, mekanik üretim veya ölçüm alanlarında tercihen 3 ila 5 yıl deneyimli, Teknik resim okuma, kumpas ve mikrometre kullanımı, tolerans, kaynak ve yüzey kontrolü konularında uzman; ölçüm ve kayıt disiplinine sahip, KONTROL Verilecek eğitim sonrasında prosedür bazlı pin-to-pin ve fonksiyonel testleri uygulayabilecek düzeyde elektriksel temel bilgiye sahip, Tercihen kaynak ve boya kontrolü, temel kalite araçları ile ERP veya Kalite Yönetim Sistemi (QMS) kayıt süreçlerinde deneyim sahibi.

description: Job Description Background UNDP works in about 170 countries and territories, helping to eradicate poverty, reduce inequalities and exclusion, and build resilience so countries can sustain progress. As the UN’s development agency, UNDP plays a critical role in helping countries achieve the Sustainable Development Goals. UNDP’s Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) develops policy guidance and provides technical advice to support the implementation of UNDP’s Strategic Plan. Within BPPS, the Nature, Climate and Energy (NCE) Team works with governments, civil society, and private sector partners to integrate natural capital, environment and climate concerns into national and sector planning and inclusive growth policies. At the regional level, the Istanbul Regional Hub (IRH) - part of UNDP’s Regional Bureau for Europe and the CIS (RBEC) - serves as the advisory hub for 18 countries and territories across Europe and Central Asia. The IRH’s Nature, Climate and Energy Team houses the regional International Waters portfolio, which supports transboundary water cooperation, marine litter prevention, and ecosystem protection across the RBEC region. The regional International Waters portfolio brings together projects under this framework, implemented by UNDP in cooperation with partner organizations and Country Offices across the region. These projects aim to support riparian and coastal countries in the joint management of shared river basins, lakes, aquifers and seas, to prevent and reduce pollution, including marine litter and plastic pollution, and to protect and restore water-related ecosystems through improved water governance, waste management and community engagement. The Bureau for Management Services (BMS) is the UNDP’s central Bureau tasked with the development of corporate strategies, policies, tools and systems in key cross-cutting management areas. The BMS UNDP Office of Human Resources, Bureau for Management Services Internship Terms of Reference, January 2018 supports the achievement of development results through management advice, innovative business solutions, and other corporate services. The Service Delivery Model adopted by BMS aims to provide more integrated, effective, and customer focused services; delivering improved management services in the areas of Legal Support, Procurement Oversight, Information Management and Technology, Consolidated Transactions, Sourcing and Operations, and Security. The UNDP Security Office is a client-oriented Centre of Excellence for Security Risk Management, focusing on high-quality, timely and effective support and advisory services, helping clients to assure an environment for safe programme delivery. The Security Office is responsible for providing effective Security Risk Management advice and support at all levels (HQ, Regional, Country Office and Project), within the overall UN Security Management System, thereby enabling security of UNDP operations, programmes, and personnel globally. The Security Office Intern – Security Analysis and Operations – will work within the structure of the UNDP Regional Security Advisor office for Europe and Central Asia, researching and monitoring the security situation in the region, contributing to maintaining security information awareness of all aspects which could potentially affect the safety and security of the UNDP personnel and operations in field environments. The UNDP RSA RBEC internship provides an exciting opportunity for candidates interested in enhancing their understanding of: i) mandates and operations of the United Nations Development Programme in its efforts to provide support for achieving SDGs; ii) Corporate Security Risk Management Systems, specifically the UN Security Management System; iii) processes of security analysis, threat and risk identification and security management strategies in complex environments; iv) planning and implementing strategic processes and security policy. Duties And Responsibilities The intern will work under the overall supervision of the Regional Security Advisor in supporting Duties the management of open source information relevant to security, and management of operations related activities. Duties may include, but are not limited to the following: Knowledge Management and Research (50%): Performing comprehensive, and accessible unclassified research of online media and other open sources of information, daily situation reports, incident reports, its collation, analysis, drafting advisories and dissemination; Providing timely and accurate information on current conflicts and security threat warnings directly to RSO decision makers; Maintaining up-to-date knowledge of events relating to the security environment; Assist in the process of developing security advisories for corporate clients in the Europe and Central Asia Region; Assist in the process of developing topic and strategic assessments on trends of security threats in the region. Security Operations Management (30%): Monitoring security incident trends that may affect UNDP personnel, assets and operations; Monitoring international security frameworks, policy implementation and crisis preparedness; Adjusting developed information on threats and trends of security incidents to changes in the operational security environment; Supporting Emergency Response and Crisis Management situations; Drafting situation and operational reports, lessons-learnt reports; Security Coordination (20%): Supports liaison and coordination activities with partner organisations and counterparts; Attending conferences and meetings where relevant, providing meeting minutes, outcome notes, briefings and profiles; Support team events and training workshop; Performing other related duties as assigned. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer(R&D)
description: Wil jij jouw ervaring in productontwikkeling en werktuigbouwkundige engineering inzetten binnen de R&D-afdeling van IDD Parts? Kom ons team in Barneveld versterken en geniet van een innovatieve en samenwerkingsgerichte cultuur waarin je de ruimte krijgt om technische ideeën om te zetten in succesvolle producten en oplossingen. Wat ga je doen als onze Senior Mechanical Engineer(R&D) Als onze Senior Mechanical Mechanical Engineer(R&D) ben je verantwoordelijk voor het initiëren, ontwikkelen en realiseren van nieuwe producten en technische oplossingen. Je vertaalt markt- en klantbehoeften naar innovatieve, technisch haalbare en commercieel succesvolle producten. Daarbij begeleid je projecten van conceptfase tot marktintroductie en werk je nauw samen met collega's, leveranciers en andere stakeholders. Daarnaast ben jij verantwoordelijk voor: Het initiëren, plannen en realiseren van R&D-projecten en productontwikkelingen. Het ontwikkelen, testen en optimaliseren van producten en technische constructies in 3D-CAD. Het coördineren van prototypes, validatietrajecten en externe samenwerkingspartners. Het bewaken van projectplanningen, budgetten en technische doelstellingen. Het signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en het vertalen van innovatiekansen naar concrete oplossingen. De vaardigheden en ervaring die je nodig hebt Wij zoeken iemand die beschikt over: Een HBO- of WO-opleiding in Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechanical Engineering of een vergelijkbare technische richting. Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen productontwikkeling, engineering of R&D. Ruime ervaring met 3D CAD-software, bij voorkeur SolidWorks. Ervaring met projectmatig werken en het begeleiden van technische ontwikkeltrajecten. Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. We beoordelen sollicitaties regelmatig, dus wacht niet te lang. We bouwen aan diverse en inclusieve teams en moedigen iedereen die zichzelf bij ons ziet werken aan om te solliciteren. Maak eenvoudig een profiel aan en solliciteer direct. Om ervoor te zorgen dat jouw persoonsgegevens veilig zijn, bekijken we geen sollicitaties die per e-mail of post worden verstuurd. Heb je vragen over de functie of het proces? Neem dan contact op met onze Senior Recruitment Business Partner, Jamal Klasen , via jamal.klasen@assaabloy.com . Let’s create a safer and more open world - together! To find out more about us, visit www.assaabloy.com. We are the ASSA ABLOY Group Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access. As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Junior Product Engineer
description: European Air-Cooled Chiller Engineering | Dublin, Ireland What You Will Do Johnson Controls has an exciting Product Engineer I opportunity based at our Dublin, Ireland location, supporting our new European air-cooled chiller engineering organization. If you are beginning your engineering career and enjoy mechanical design, hands-on testing, and data analysis, this could be the right position for you. In this entry-level role you will support the mechanical design and performance of air-cooled chiller components engineered for the European market, working under close supervision to complete design work as part of a project team. You will build your knowledge of our products, support laboratory testing and factory activity, and contribute to new and exciting product development programs while developing your technical expertise. How You Will Do It Builds an understanding of the theories, concepts, technical principles, and processes related to the fluid, thermal, refrigeration, and other mechanical aspects of air-cooled chillers Works under close supervision, following work instructions and defined processes, and takes direction from more experienced engineers Follows the project plan and participates in design activities with other team members Supports delivery of engineering deliverables, including design specifications, design reviews, data analysis, etc. Learns and applies European mechanical and safety codes and directives, including CE marking, the Pressure Equipment Directive (PED), and the Machinery Directive, and harmonized standards such as EN 378 (refrigerating systems safety) and EN 14511 (chiller performance rating) Supports the build, instrumentation, and running of laboratory test programs; collects, reduces, and presents test data under guidance Assists with the selection of mechanical components – including heat exchangers, fans, valves, and refrigerant piping – considering cost, performance, and availability Provides day-to-day support to factory operations, the laboratory, and product technical service on assigned components Supports the sustaining of released product, including gathering information to support design changes Communicates with project team members and reports progress on assigned tasks Applies standard technical and mathematical principles, theories, concepts, and best-practice methodologies in the field Continuously increases expertise across chiller design, theory, construction, operation, and applications; participates in process improvement Adheres to the Company’s Code of Conduct and Business Ethics standards Required What we look for BS in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline / science Entry level; previous internship, co-op, or work experience in a related field preferred Understanding of fundamental fluid and thermal principles Working knowledge of 3D CAD and engineering drawing practice Willingness to learn and apply European mechanical and refrigeration codes and standards (CE marking, PED, Machinery Directive, EN 378) Able to organize and process large amounts of data Good written and verbal communication skills Ability to work in a fast-paced, schedule-driven, team-oriented environment Ability to travel up to 10%, primarily within Europe Preferred Internship, co-op, or placement experience in HVAC, refrigeration, or another industrial product environment Exposure to laboratory testing, instrumentation, and data acquisition Familiarity with refrigeration systems and the EU F-Gas Regulation Familiarity with HVAC systems and motor-driven mechanical engineering design and test Exposure to structural, thermal, or computational fluid dynamics (CFD) analysis Experience with ERP / material resource planning (MRP) software Familiarity with European regulatory standards such as EN 378, EN 14511, and the Ecodesign / ErP framework #AVRIL

title: Product Development Engineer
description: Join VELUX as a Product Development Engineer and help turn ideas into functional solutions for new product launches and product improvements. Working closely with experienced colleagues, you will solve fine mechanical challenges and help create high-quality Decoration and Sun Protection products. Meet your future team You will join the Decoration and Sun Protection (DSP) team in Skjern, which is part of our Products & Innovation organisation. The team consists of seven product developers and three project managers and develops interior accessories, including mechanical components for electrical products. You will work with skilled mechanical engineers who share knowledge, exchange ideas, and support one another. What We Offer As a Product Development Engineer, you will develop and optimise products, with a particular focus on new product launches. You will work with fine mechanical design, where the performance of small details can be important to the overall product experience. Our close collaboration with the workshop allows you to get from design to physical models fast. You can often see and test a model shortly after developing an idea. The role combines self-directed development work with regular collaboration, idea-sharing, and technical guidance across the team and wider organization. You will work closely with the Lead Engineer, who will help define development tasks and provide technical support throughout the process. More specifically your tasks will be to: Develop new DSP products and product improvements from concept to industrialisation. Define technical solutions, specifications, and design choices that translate physical properties into reliable product functions. Build, test, and refine models in collaboration with the workshop and relevant colleagues. Work with project managers, product developers, and colleagues across VELUX to help ensure products meet performance, quality, regulatory, cost, and sustainability requirements. The role is based in Skjern, with the option to work from home up to two days per week when project and task requirements allow. Limited travel is expected, with up to 15 days per year in Denmark and internationally. What You Will Bring Into The Organization You bring a relevant engineering background and an interest in product development where precision and fine mechanical solutions matter. You can manage your own development tasks while collaborating with colleagues and seeking input to develop practical solutions. Moreover, we expect that you: Hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering or a related field. Bring relevant experience in product development, mechanical design, or related engineering tasks. Have experience using 3D CAD software; experience with CREO is an advantage but not a requirement. Can translate material and physical properties into functional mechanical designs. Apply a methodical and solution-oriented approach to detailed technical challenges. Communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing. Ready to apply? Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process. We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match. All inquiries will be treated confidentially. About VELUX In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air. The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, "courage" and "mutual respect" define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world. Equal Opportunity Employer At VELUX, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all - whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

Technical support and trouble shooting in cooperation with colleagues and external clients. Travel activity must be expected (approx. 120 days/year) domestic and abroad. Being persistent and quality-conscious in your work and having the interest and professionalism for this type of specialist tasks. You thrive in a high-tech environment and have a good dose of humour. What we offer: Market-leading and trend-setting international company. Exciting and challenging work assignments in a committed department with a large contact area for customers and other stakeholders, internally as well as externally. You will become part of a group with the desire and ability to make a significant difference at a technically high level. Good professional and personal development opportunities in a job that you have the opportunity to shape. Salary according to qualifications. Why you and us? We have a passion for seeking opportunities and the courage to take the initiative. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition? title: Gram Equipment Graduate Program
description: Unleash your potential in the Gram Equipment Graduate talent program - Experience hands-on learning in real business settings, open doors to global career opportunities, and join a community of change-makers! About Us: Gram Equipment is a global leader in providing innovative solutions for the ice cream and dairy industry. We are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology and driving forward the future of our industry. As part of our commitment to nurturing talent and fostering excellence, we are excited to announce our Graduate Program, designed to provide an immersive experience for aspiring professionals who are passionate about both mechanical engineering and commercial business. Program Overview: Our Graduate Program offers a unique opportunity for candidates with diverse backgrounds to gain a well-rounded experience in our organization. The program spans a duration of 24 months, divided into four rotations of six months each. This structure ensures that participants gain a comprehensive understanding of both mechanical engineering and commercial aspects of our business. Qualifications: We are seeking candidates who have or will graduate either in 2026 or in 2027, and who meet the following criteria: Mechanical Engineering Background with Commercial Interest: Candidates with a mechanical engineering background who possess a strong interest in commercial business and project management. Commercial Engineering Background with Mechanical Engineering Interest: Candidates with a commercial/business-oriented Engineering background who are keen to explore the world of mechanical engineering. Key Program Highlights: Mentorship: Participants will have the opportunity to work closely with a personal mentor from our global management team, offering valuable insights and guidance throughout the program. Continuous Development: Gram Equipment is committed to fostering the growth and development of its talent. Participants will have access to the Gram Academy, a platform dedicated to ongoing learning and skill development. International Rotation: Possibility for an international 6 month rotation in either our Turkish or US location. Community Building: Join a vibrant and peer -based community of talented individuals within our organization, creating opportunities for networking, knowledge sharing, and collaboration. How to Apply & Our Recruitment Process: Our recruitment process is designed to identify and nurture potential talent. We believe in comprehensive evaluation, from video interviews and cognitive assessments to in-depth interviews and real-world business case evaluations during the Assessment Day, ensuring we welcome the best fit for our Graduate Program. Application and Assessment: Apply before 1st of March 2027 , and if shortlisted, you'll complete a video interview and cognitive assessment. Interview and Evaluation: Promising candidates proceed to a comprehensive evaluation phase, which evaluates their behavioral competencies and business acumen, including a detailed assessment of a business case. Contract and Start Date: Upon impressing us at every stage, you'll sign a contract and officially begin your journey with the Gram Equipment Graduate Program on 1st of September 2027. Join Us in Shaping the Future: At Gram Equipment, we believe that innovation is driven by diverse perspectives and talents. Join our Graduate Program to embark on a journey that will equip you with the skills, knowledge, and experiences needed to excel in both the mechanical engineering and commercial aspects of our dynamic industry. Many of the things I have learned in my studies, I have been able to apply to what I am doing at Gram Equipment, from engineering work to business understanding. I am actively involved in the strategy work, engineering practices and various digitalization tools. I use a lot of theoretical knowledge that I have acquired in my Engineering studies in relation to my daily work. My business background helped me understand how the business is working, and because the company foundation is at the technical aspect, my background has helped me identify its strengths and weaknesses very fast." - Rudy Mandrup Cazelles (ENG Product Development and Innovation - SDU) - Business Developer at Gram Equipment Gram Equipment is an equal opportunity employer. title: Mekanikkonstruktör inom produktionsutveckling

Dina Arbetsuppgifter Kan Exempelvis Innefatta Mekanisk konstruktion och vidareutveckling av komponenter, system och tekniska lösningar. Konstruktion och tekniska förbättringar med hänsyn till funktion, hållfasthet, materialval och tillverkningsbarhet. Hållfasthetsberäkningar, tekniska analyser och konstruktionsgranskningar. Produktionsanpassning och utveckling av konstruktioner, arbetssätt och tekniska lösningar. Tvärfunktionellt samarbete med produktion, kvalitet, andra teknikdiscipliner och leverantörer. Du Trivs Med Komplexa Tekniska Utmaningar, Har Förståelse För Sambandet Mellan Konstruktion Och Produktion Och Tar Ansvar För Att Driva Ditt Arbete Framåt. Minst tre års erfarenhet av mekanikkonstruktion och tekniskt utvecklingsarbete. Erfarenhet av hållfasthetsberäkningar och tekniska analyser. God erfarenhet av 3D-CAD, exempelvis SolidWorks eller Creo. Erfarenhet av PDM/PLM-system, exempelvis Windchill. God förståelse för konstruktionsprinciper, materialegenskaper och tillverkningsmetoder. Vissa av våra kunduppdrag omfattas av säkerhetsskyddskrav och kan därför kräva godkänd säkerhetsprövning innan uppdraget kan påbörjas. En spännande resa med Knightec Group Knightec Group är idag en av Norra Europas ledande strategiska partners inom produkt- och digital tjänsteutveckling – hur häftigt är inte det? Genom att förena ingenjörskompetens, digital expertis och affärsförståelse hjälper vi våra kunder att omvandla ny teknik till verkliga lösningar som skapar värde. Vi arbetar i skärningspunkten mellan affärsstrategi och teknikutveckling och stöttar våra kunder genom hela resan – från de första idéerna till utveckling, implementering och vidare utveckling. På Knightec Group samlas människor med olika perspektiv, erfarenheter och specialistområden. Tillsammans skapar vi innovation som gör verklig skillnad – för företag, människor och samhället i stort. För våra medarbetare innebär det stora möjligheter att vara med och forma framtidens lösningar genom meningsfulla projekt i teknikens absoluta framkant. title: Lead Piping Engineer
description: Vill du bli vår Lead Piping Engineer/tekniskt ansvarige för framtidens rörsystemslösningar och lockas av att få rita kartan själv i denna helt nya roll? För dig som vill kombinera tekniskt djup, rådgivning och utveckling är detta en möjlighet att verkligen sätta avtryck. Rekryteringen är ett samarbete med Jefferson Wells, men du blir direkt anställd hos Alvenius. Alvenius Industrier söker nu en Lead Piping Engineer/ tekniskt ansvarig för rörsystem till en nyckelroll där du får möjlighet att bygga upp och utveckla ett nytt kompetensområde inom företaget. Rollen är helt ny och här får du kombinera teknisk spetskompetens med rådgivning, beräkningar och projektarbete i en verksamhet som levererar rörsystem till kunder inom bland annat VA, infrastruktur och anläggningsprojekt. Du har inget personalansvar i rollen, istället blir du företagets tekniska expert för rörsystemen och driver utvecklingen av området genom din och teamets kunskap. Du blir den som säkerställer att lösningarna fungerar ur ett hållfasthets-, installations- och driftsperspektiv. Du blir en del av vår teknikavdelning tillsammans med teknikchef, konstruktörer, produktionstekniker, svetstekniker och en certifieringsspecialist, samtidigt som du får stort inflytande över hur rollen och området utvecklas framöver. Om rollen Som Lead Piping Engineer/ tekniskt ansvarig för rörsystem kommer du att arbeta med beräkning, dimensionering, systemanalys och teknisk utveckling av Alvenius rörsystemslösningar. En viktig del av rollen är att vara experten som förstår vad som är tekniskt möjligt redan innan projekten når konstruktionsfasen. Arbetet omfattar bland annat beräkningar kopplade till förankringar, fixpunkter, laster och termisk expansion, men också teknisk granskning och utveckling av olika systemlösningar. Du kommer att vara en naturlig rådgivare i projekt där förståelsen för hur ett rörsystem fungerar i verkligheten är avgörande. Rollen ställer höga krav på din förmåga att: Beräkna, dimensionera och analysera rörsystem Omsätta tekniska utmaningar till praktiska lösningar Granska eller ta fram tekniska modeller och ritningsunderlag Samarbeta i komplexa projektmiljöer med svenska och internationella aktörer Rollen utgår från vår anläggning i Eskilstuna där även produktionen är placerad. Vi värdesätter hög närvaro på plats eftersom samarbetet med kollegor och verksamheten är en viktig del av rollen. Vem söker vi? Vi söker dig som är högskole- eller civilingenjör och har erfarenhet av rörsystem där teknik, funktion och systemperspektiv står i fokus. Du kan komma från exempelvis VA, processindustri, energi, infrastruktur eller annan verksamhet där rörsystem utgör en viktig del av anläggningen. Du har god förståelse för kopplingsmetoder, material och tekniska lösningar inom rörsystem och är van att arbeta med teknisk problemlösning, analyser och beräkningar. Erfarenhet av teknisk modellering med hjälp av BIM-verktyg så som tex Revit är nödvändigt. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska och trivs i en roll med många kontaktytor. Varför Alvenius? Det här är en unik möjlighet att komma in i en roll som inte funnits tidigare. Du får stor frihet att påverka både arbetssätt, tekniska lösningar och hur Alvenius utvecklar sitt erbjudande inom rörsystem framöver. Alvenius Industrier grundades i Eskilstuna 1951 och är idag en ledande leverantör av rörledningslösningar till kunder inom gruvindustri, tunnlar, VA, brandbekämpning, industri och infrastruktur. Med cirka 60 medarbetare i Eskilstuna levererar vi tekniska lösningar till projekt över hela världen. Vi lägger stort fokus på att hjälpa varandra och jobba tillsammans i projekten.

title: Lead Engineer Offshore Wind
description: Wat bieden wij jou. Grote en complexe projecten, veeleisende klanten, technisch uitdagend werk, aan de basis staan van nieuwe ontwikkelingen en collega’s die samen willen werken aan beter: denkers die ook doen. Je sluit je aan bij een ambitieus, technisch sterk team en hebt direct impact op de energietransitie. Hoe doen we dat? Door de levering van unieke zeekabeloplossingen. De wereldwijde vraag naar duurzame energie groeit razendsnel, ook in de offshore-windindustrie. Om de opgewekte elektriciteit van windturbines naar de onderstations op zee te transporteren, zijn kilometerslange kabels en hoogwaardige accessoires nodig. Die moeten natuurlijk bestand zijn tegen de uitdagende offshore-omstandigheden. Unieke kabels, ontwikkeld door ons eigen R&D-team en geproduceerd in onze eigen Nederlandse productiefaciliteiten. Een salaris tussen € 4.300 - € 7.000 Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden. Uitgebreide carrièremogelijkheden. Een platte organisatiestructuur (informeel, korte lijntjes). Wie ben jij. Jouw technische kennis kunnen we natuurlijk goed gebruiken om van het project een succes te maken. Het ene moment met een diepgaande analyse, het andere moment met een praktisch antwoord dat tijd en geld oplevert. Maar daar blijft het niet bij. Als buddy van de projectmanager en technisch aanspreekpunt voor de klant komen jouw vermogen om te denken in (innovatieve) oplossingen, besluitvaardigheid en communicatietalent goed van pas. Je past jouw benadering naadloos aan op de mensen met wie je samenwerkt en bent transparant in je communicatie. Je geeft daarmee vertrouwen, overtuigt en werkt samen aan beter. Wij geloven in innoveren. Jouw ideeën, verbeterplannen en wens tot persoonlijke ontwikkeling zijn dan ook welkom! Binnen TKF zijn we op zoek naar mensen die vooruit willen en het onmogelijke mogelijk maken. Daarvoor hebben we collega’s nodig die een stap verder denken en er staan als dat nodig is. Daar hoort ook bij dat je het vertrouwen krijgt om initiatief te nemen, kansen te realiseren en dat we gezamenlijk aandacht hebben voor jouw ontwikkeling. Bijvoorbeeld door training, interne kansen en met aandacht voor een goede balans tussen werk en privé. Een afgeronde technische HBO/WO opleiding, bij voorkeur Elektrotechniek (power engineering) of Technische Natuurkunde. Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een soortgelijke functie, bij voorkeur binnen een dynamische productieomgeving of de offshore windindustrie. Kennis van FEM of andere analyse software (Comsol, Ansys of Orcaflex). Kennis van energiekabels en de offshore windindustrie is een pré. Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en de Engelse taal. Wat ga je doen. Dat je als Lead Engineer vanuit de afdeling R&D verantwoordelijk bent voor de engineering en coördinatie van projecten, is waarschijnlijk niets nieuws. Maar bij TKF gaat het niet om projecten van een aantal weken. Nee, we praten over een periode van 2 tot 3 jaar. In die tijd heb je vaak afstemming met de klant en de interne afdelingen, ga je aan de slag met het plannen van engineering-werkzaamheden en het managen van engineering-capaciteit. Maar natuurlijk ook door te doen, bijvoorbeeld door het berekenen van de stroombelastbaarheid, thermische eigenschappen, maximale kortsluitstromen, mechanische vermoeiing én maximale vrije overspanning. Werkzaamheden waar je jouw technische kennis goed in kwijt kunt dus. Samen met Project Management, Inkoop, Quality en natuurlijk Operations zorg je voor een complete kabeloplossing die aan alle (kwaliteits)eisen en klantwensen voldoet. Soms zelfs voor de installatie in de turbines en het leggen van de kabel in de zeebodem. De klant kan daarbij altijd op jou terugvallen. Jullie hebben zeer regelmatig contact. Vaak digitaal, maar ook bij de klant, bij één van onze productielocaties of zelfs op de projectlocatie. Lekker afwisselend dus. Een uitdagende functie waarin we van jou een dosis denkkracht én praktisch inzicht verwachten!

title: Junior Mechanical Engineer Machinebouw
description: Als Junior Mechanical Engineer Machinebouw Regio Alkmaar ontwerp je machines en recyclinginstallaties voor het terugwinnen van metalen uit reststromen. Je werkt van 3D ontwerp tot realisatie en kunt incidenteel meegaan naar internationale installaties. Een brede startersfunctie voor een werktuigbouwkundige die machinebouw graag tastbaar wil maken. Wat ga je doen? Als Junior Mechanical Engineer Machinebouw Regio Alkmaar ontwerp je machines en complete installaties waarmee waardevolle metalen worden teruggewonnen uit reststromen. Denk aan feeders, zeven, transportsystemen, Eddy Current separators en andere scheidingstechnieken die samen één recyclinglijn vormen. Je bent betrokken vanaf het eerste technische concept tot aan de realisatie. Je vertaalt projecteisen naar 3D modellen en technische tekeningen en denkt na over hoe verschillende machines logisch in een installatie worden gecombineerd. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar hoe iets eruitziet in CAD, maar ook naar constructie, toegankelijkheid, onderhoud en maakbaarheid. De installaties kunnen modulair worden opgebouwd, maar er worden ook complete klantspecifieke recyclinglijnen ontworpen. Daardoor krijg je als junior te maken met verschillende configuraties, materiaalstromen en technische vraagstukken. Je werkt samen met ervaren collega’s en krijgt steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid over je eigen ontwerpen. Je hebt daarnaast contact met leveranciers om onderdelen en technische specificaties af te stemmen. Af en toe reis je mee naar een klant in het buitenland om te ondersteunen bij de opbouw, inbedrijfstelling of het oplossen van technische vraagstukken. Zo zie je uiteindelijk hoe jouw ontwerp daadwerkelijk metalen uit reststromen terugwint. Jouw werkzaamheden Ontwerpen en uitwerken van machines en complete recyclinginstallaties; Maken van 3D modellen, technische tekeningen en constructieve uitwerkingen; Combineren van feeders, zeven, separators en transportsystemen tot een werkende installatie; Afstemmen van onderdelen en technische specificaties met leveranciers; Meedenken over maakbaarheid, toegankelijkheid, onderhoud en praktische uitvoering; Incidenteel ondersteunen bij opbouw, inbedrijfstelling en service bij internationale klanten. Wat heb jij in huis? Een afgeronde hbo opleiding richting Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechanical Engineering of vergelijkbaar; Je bent starter of hebt enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen engineering of machinebouw; Een goede basis in 3D CAD en technisch tekenen; Interesse in mechanica, constructies, machinebouw en industriële installaties; Je denkt praktisch, analytisch en vindt het leuk om technische problemen op te lossen; Je spreekt goed Nederlands en Engels en bent bereid incidenteel naar het buitenland te reizen. Wat bieden we jou Een salaris van €2.980 - €3.910 p.m.; 25 vakantiedagen per jaar; Uitgebreide groene pensioenregeling; Volg kosteloos sessies via het welzijnsplatform empowr; Opleidingsbudget van €2.000; Een persoonlijke Career Coach; Gratis deelname aan bijvoorbeeld de Marathon van Eindhoven of de Strong Viking Run; Werken bij het groenste detacheringsbureau van Nederland; Mogelijkheid tot overname door opdrachtgever. De organisatie & Duurzaamheid Je komt terecht bij een specialistische machinebouwer die installaties ontwikkelt voor het terugwinnen van metalen uit verschillende reststromen. De techniek wordt onder andere toegepast bij bodemas, metaalstromen, afval en hout, waarbij zoveel mogelijk waardevol materiaal uit de stroom wordt gehaald. De installaties bestaan uit verschillende mechanische stappen. Denk aan bunkers en feeders die materiaal gecontroleerd aanvoeren, zeven die verschillende fracties scheiden en Eddy Current separators waarmee non-ferrometalen uit de materiaalstroom worden gehaald. Afhankelijk van de toepassing worden deze machines gecombineerd tot mobiele, modulaire of volledig klantspecifieke installaties. Engineering, assemblage, service en technische ontwikkeling zitten dicht bij elkaar. Daardoor krijg je als engineer goed mee hoe een ontwerp wordt gebouwd en hoe de installatie uiteindelijk bij de klant presteert. Dat maakt dit een interessante omgeving voor een starter die niet alleen wil tekenen, maar wil begrijpen hoe complete machines en proceslijnen in de praktijk werken. Werken bij Evoke Je gaat via Evoke aan de slag in deze functie. Na een tijdje kun je in dienst bij onze partner, als je wil. Of je begint aan een nieuw uitdagend project via ons netwerk. Wij doen er alles aan om onze mensen op dé werkplek te krijgen. Jouw persoonlijke Career Coach is specialist binnen de sector en samen brengen jullie jouw wensen in kaart. Door écht te luisteren, maken zij steeds de juiste connectie voor jou. Ondertussen bieden wij je alle voordelen als jouw werkgever en Carrière Coach. Zoals een goed salaris, jaarlijks studiebudget en groen pensioen. Samen zetten we zo altijd de beste stappen voorwaarts in jouw loopbaan. Want: Evoke Centers You.

Areas of expertise include structural analyses, fatigue and fracture mechanics assessments. Participate in international project teams and communicate with relevant parties. Ability to travel to the nuclear site to support field interventions or customer meetings. Technical/Academic Qualifications And Experience Required MS degree in mechanical engineering. This requires an experience between 5+ years. Interested in mechanical component stress analysis, finite element analysis software for structural analysis. Interested in the nuclear industry You are fluent in English and French and have proven report writing skills (Dutch is a plus). Previous work experience with ANSYS APDL and/or workbench is a plus. Nuclear-specific licenses and qualifications are required, as well as a clean criminal record (required by law). Why Westinghouse? title: Master thesis - Structural Analysis
description: Company Description AFRY provides engineering, design, digital and advisory services. We are devoted experts in industry, energy and infrastructure sectors, creating impact for generations to come. AFRY has Nordic roots with a global reach. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable society. Job Description AFRY Technical Analysis is the largest consulting CAE-department in Sweden, with extensive experience within structural and fluid mechanics from a wide range of clients in several industries. We are deeply involved in many interesting projects, both national and international, and provide our clients with market leading CAE-competence. This master thesis will be a collaboration between AFRY and AFRY´s clients within automotive, defense or energy-industry. The student will develop new methodology, with respect to structural analysis and FEA, to facilitate more efficient product development for AFRY´s clients. The results can pave the way for new modelling guidelines (often calibrated against test data), a more efficient way of working and increased simulations accuracy. FEA tools such as ANSYS, ABAQUS and LS-Dyna will be used with MATLAB and Phyton as a complement for post-processing and automatization. Analytical calculations are performed mainly to verify the analysis models and results. Qualifications You are specialized in solid mechanics and have good theoretical knowledge in general. You have a clear grasp of the basics with respect to strength, fatigue and dynamic analysis, and have performed some finite element analysis during your education. You have used commercial software before and are familiar with the basic FEA-approach, with respect to pre-processing, analysis, and post-processing. As a person you are meticulous, ambitious, curios and eager to learn. Collaboration comes naturally to you, and you appreciate the value added by working together with your colleagues to find the best solution. Lastly, you also have good communicative skills, both oral and in writing, and can explain complex issues in a comprehensible manner. Additional Information AFRY will most likely offer you a position as a CAE-Engineer after a successful completion of this master thesis. Last day of application is 2026-10-31. This is an ongoing recruitment process, which means that the role might be filled before last day of application. We do not accept applications via email. title: Mekanik Tasarım Mühendisi
description: MEKANİK TASARIM MÜHENDİSİ 🚀 Repkon Makina şirketimizde görev alacak Mekanik Tasarım Mühendisi arıyoruz! 📍 Lokasyon: Şile / İstanbul 📌 Bağlı Yönetici: Mekanik Tasarım Ekip Lideri Repkon Makina Hakkında 1978 yılında kurulan Repkon Makina, ileri metal şekillendirme teknolojileri alanında dünya çapında projeler gerçekleştiren, yüksek teknoloji odaklı bir mühendislik şirketidir. Başta savunma, havacılık ve uzay olmak üzere; enerji, otomotiv ve ağır sanayi gibi sektörlerde faaliyet gösteren Repkon, yalnızca bir üretici değil, aynı zamanda uçtan uca çözümler sunan güvenilir bir mühendislik partneridir. Flowforming, soğuk şekillendirme, shear forming ve hot spinning teknolojilerindeki derin uzmanlığı sayesinde Repkon; müşterilerine yalnızca ürün değil, aynı zamanda anahtar teslim üretim sistemleri ve sürdürülebilir çözümler sunmaktadır. Bugün Repkon, tasarımdan üretime, otomasyondan devreye almaya kadar tüm süreçleri kendi bünyesinde yöneten entegre yapısı ile global ölçekte güvenilir bir çözüm ortağı olarak konumlanmaktadır. Rolün Amacı Bu rol; yeni ve mevcut makine/sistemlerin mekanik tasarım süreçlerini uçtan uca yönetmek, yenilikçi, üretilebilir ve sürdürülebilir mühendislik çözümleri geliştirmekten sorumludur. Amaç; yüksek performanslı ve güvenilir tasarımlar geliştirmenin yanı sıra, tasarım standartlarını oluşturmak, teknik mükemmeliyeti sağlamak ve ekip içi bilgi birikimini güçlendirmektir. Sorumlu Olacağın Alanlar Yeni makine ve sistemlerin konsept tasarımlarını oluşturmak ve Ar-Ge çalışmalarını yürütmek, Tasarım süreçlerinde FMEA (Hata Türü ve Etkileri Analizi) çalışmalarını yürütmek, potansiyel riskleri önceden belirleyerek tasarım doğrulama süreçlerini yürütmek, DFM (Üretim İçin Tasarım) prensipleri doğrultusunda maliyet düşürücü ve kalite artırıcı iyileştirmeler yapmak, çalışmalara liderlik etmek, Mekanik tasarım faaliyetlerini yürütmek ve ilgili teknik dokümantasyonu hazırlamak, Makine elemanlarının seçimi, 3D Mekanizma tasarımı ve mevcut tasarımların optimizasyonunu yapmak, Prototip geliştirme ve ürün iyileştirme çalışmalarını yürütmek, Gerektiğinde üretim ve montaj süreçlerine teknik destek sağlamak, Mukavemet, ömür ve performans analizlerine yönelik hesaplama ve metodolojileri geliştirmek, Orta ve junior seviye mühendislerin teknik gelişimine mentorluk ederek, tasarım süreçlerinde yönlendirme sağlamak, Teknik resim revizyonlarını ve proje dokümantasyon süreçlerini yönetmek, Kaynaklı tasarım ve ilgili teknik konularda dokümantasyon oluşturmak ve bilgi paylaşımını sağlamak, Gerektiğinde kalite ve hata analiz çalışmalarına teknik katkı sağlamak, Süreçlerde sürekli iyileştirme fırsatlarını belirlemek ve hayata geçirmek. Aradığımız Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makina Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, Makina tasarım/üretim alanında en az 10 yıl tasarım tecrübesine sahip, Tercihen hidrolik pres ve/veya soğuk/sıcak şekillendirme makinelerinde tasarım ve imalat tecrübesi, CAD Modelleme yazılımlarından en az birini (tercihen SolidWorks) iyi derecede kullanabilen, Tolerans analizi ve GD&T (Geometrik Boyutlandırma ve Toleranslandırma) konularında uzman, İmalat metotları konusunda tecrübeli, Mukavemet, makina elemanları ve hidrolik sistemler konularına hakim, Tercihen FEA (Yapısal Analiz) hakkında bilgi sahibi, En az bir ürünün tasarım ve üretim süreçlerinde görev almış, Gerektiğinde projelerin tasarım sorumluluğunu üstlenebilecek, Dokümantasyon, veri analizi ve raporlama konularında yetenekli ve takip becerisi yüksek, ERP programları hakkında bilgi sahibi (Tercihen IFS), İyi derecede İngilizce bilen, İletişim, stres yönetimi ve ekip çalışması becerileri gelişmiş, İstanbul Anadolu Yakasında ikamet eden veya edebilecek. Bu Rolde Başarılı Olmanın Sırrı Tasarım kararlarını sadece teknik doğrulukla değil; üretilebilirlik, maliyet ve performans dengesiyle birlikte ele almak, Problemleri kök neden seviyesinde analiz ederek kalıcı çözümler geliştirmek, Tasarım süreçlerinde sürdürülebilir mühendislik çıktıları oluşturmak, Deneyim ve teknik birikimi sistematik şekilde paylaşarak ekip genelinde mühendislik kalitesini yukarı taşımak.

title: Üretim Mühendisi
description: Biz Kimiz? Ar-Ge ve üretim operasyonlarını Teknopark Ankara’da sürdüren şirketimiz, genç ve dinamik ekibiyle verimlilik, sürdürülebilirlik ve nitelikli iş anlayışını benimsemektedir. Proje ve kalite yönetimi ilkeleri doğrultusunda yapılandırdığımız süreçler, EYDEP denetimleriyle tescillenmiştir. Sektördeki deneyimimizi öğrenme ve gelişim odaklı yaklaşım, veriye dayalı çalışma kültürü, başarma azmi ve güçlü iş ahlakı ile birleştirerek sektöre değer katmaya devam etmekteyiz. EYDEP’te yer alan 545 firma arasında, Tasarım, Üretim ve Sistem Entegrasyon Temalarını bir arada bulunduran 16 firmadan biri olmaktan gurur duymaktayız. Bugüne kadar çeşitli yerli ve milli kara, deniz, füze ve roket sistemlerine çözüm sağladık. Milli Hava Savunma Sistemi (Çelik Kubbe) ve Milli Uzay Roketi çözüm sağladığımız ve sağlamaya devam ettiğimiz projelerden önde gelen örnekleridir. Nasıl Bir Çalışma Arkadaşı Arıyoruz? Mühendislik fakültelerinden mezun (tercihen Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği), Elektronik ve elektromekanik üretim süreçlerinde deneyim sahibi, Üretim planlama, iş takibi ve teknik koordinasyon konularında yetkin, Teknik dokümanları okuyabilen, yorumlayabilen ve üretim süreçlerine aktarabilen, Elektronik kart, kablaj, lehimleme ve elektromekanik montaj süreçlerine gözlemcilik yapmış, ERP sistemleri üzerinden üretim emirleri, stok ve onarım süreçlerinin takibi konusunda bilgi sahibi, Microsoft Office programlarını etkin kullanabilen, Tercihen IPC J-STD-001, IPC-A-610, IPC/WHMA-A-620 ve IPC-7711/7721 standartlarına ilişkin bilgi veya sertifika sahibi, Tercihen teknik dokümanları okuyabilecek seviyede İngilizce bilgisine sahip, Analitik düşünme, problem çözme, planlama ve organizasyon becerileri gelişmiş, Ekip yönetimi, teknik yönlendirme ve çalışan gelişimi konularında sorumluluk alabilecek, İletişim becerileri güçlü, takım çalışmasına yatkın ve sonuç odaklı, Verilerle çalışmayı, sürekli öğrenmeyi ve süreç iyileştirmeyi benimseyen. Yeni Çalışma Arkadaşımızdan Neler Bekliyoruz? Proje hedefleri ve teknik gereklilikler doğrultusunda üretim faaliyetlerini planlamak, koordine etmek ve gerçekleşme durumlarını takip etmek, Üretim ekibinin iş planlarını oluşturmak, görev dağılımını gerçekleştirmek ve üretim faaliyetlerinin belirlenen terminlere uygun tamamlanmasını sağlamak, Üretim süreçlerinde ortaya çıkabilecek kapasite, kaynak ve termin risklerini önceden tespit ederek gerekli aksiyonların alınmasını sağlamak, Yeni projelerin üretilebilirlik değerlendirmelerini yapmak, teknik riskleri belirlemek ve ilgili birimlerle koordinasyon sağlamak, Prototip üretim süreçlerini yürütmek, gerekli üretim dokümanlarını oluşturmak ve teknik problemlerin çözümüne katkı sağlamak, Üretim emirleri, onarım faaliyetleri ve stok hareketlerinin KKPY üzerinden doğru ve düzenli şekilde yürütülmesini sağlamak, Üretim süreçlerine ilişkin teknik dokümanların ve kayıtların güncelliğini, doğruluğunu ve izlenebilirliğini sağlamak, Üretim kaynaklarının etkin kullanımını, ekipmanların bakım ve onarım süreçlerinin takibini ve üretim alanının düzenini sağlamak, Kendisine bağlı üretim teknisyenlerinin performansını takip etmek, teknik gelişimlerini desteklemek ve ekip içerisinde bilgi paylaşımı ile yedekleme sisteminin oluşturulmasını sağlamak, Üretim faaliyetlerinin kalite gerekliliklerine ve tanımlanmış süreçlere uygun yürütülmesini sağlamak, Üretim performans göstergelerini izlemek, hedeflerden sapmaları değerlendirmek ve süreçlerin geliştirilmesine yönelik iyileştirme çalışmaları yürütmek, Proje, kalite ve ilgili diğer birimlerle koordinasyon içerisinde çalışarak üretim süreçlerinin etkin ve sürdürülebilir şekilde yürütülmesini sağlamak. title: Technical Inspection Engineer
description: Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding engages in various sectors, primarily energy, shipbuilding, finance, and real estate industries. The Group is the only owner, operator and builder of the first Powership™ (floating power plant) fleet in the world and plays an active role in medium to long-term investments with more than 2.500 employees around the world in different 19 countries in Europe, Africa, Latam and Asia. About Karpowership Karpowership, part of the Karadeniz Holding, is the owner, operator and builder of the only Powership™ (floating power plant) fleet in the world and plays an active role in medium to long-term investments; providing access to fast-track, affordable and reliable electricity. Powerships have a range of 30 MW to 470 MW and are delivered ready to operate in less than 60 days. Currently, Karpowership owns and operates over than 30 Powerships with an installed capacity exceeding 3,500 MW and another 5,000 MW are under construction or in the pipeline. In addition to a Powership fleet, Karpowership owns and operates its own LNG fleet. With expertise and experience in the field, Karpowership serves as a one-stop-shop for LNG to Power solutions, as a single provider delivering all parts of the value chain; including but not limited to LNG sourcing, transport, delivery, regasification, and electricity production; with the mission of powering life wherever needed. With more than 2,000 employees globally; Karpowership is operational in Mozambique, Ghana, Sierra Leone, Guinea Bissau, Gambia, Senegal, Sudan, Ivory Coast, New Caledonia, Brazil, Dominican Republic and Cuba. We are looking fo r a Technical Inspection Engineer (Mechanical) to join our Operational Excellence at our Head Office located in Kağıthane, Istanbul. WHAT DO WE EXPECT? Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering , or a related engineering discipline. Minimum 5 years of professional experience in the power generation, maritime, or shipbuilding industries. Proven experience in the operation and maintenance of diesel engines and auxiliary mechanical systems . Strong technical knowledge of equipment automation, control, protection systems, and asset reliability . Ability to interpret technical drawings, engineering specifications, and maintenance documentation . Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, with a proactive mindset and openness to continuous improvement initiatives. Well-developed analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities. Experience in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and risk assessment methodologies. Good understanding of preventive maintenance strategies and maintenance best practices. Experience with ERP/CMMS platforms , preferably SAP PM . Excellent written and spoken English ( Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above). Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally. WHAT AWAITS YOU? Support technical audit activities across power generation facilities to ensure compliance with corporate management systems, international regulatory requirements, and engineering best practices while maintaining the highest standards of operational safety, reliability, and asset integrity. Coordinate and support technical audits and inspections of mechanical systems and power generation equipment , ensuring effective follow-up and timely closure of audit findings. Evaluate equipment condition and assess the effectiveness of preventive maintenance practices, providing technical reports and recommendations for continuous improvement. Review technical operating practices, identify opportunities for improvement, and document observations, findings, and corrective actions. Monitor equipment performance trends and identify potential reliability concerns through technical assessments and operational data analysis. Participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations and equipment failure reviews, contributing to the implementation of preventive actions and engineering best practices. Support engineering improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing equipment reliability, operational efficiency, and long-term asset performance . Collaborate closely with plant operations teams, OEMs, and third-party technical specialists to ensure the successful execution of technical audits and engineering improvement projects. Contribute to the continuous development of technical standards, maintenance practices, and operational excellence across the organization. WHAT DO WE OFFER? Opportunity to work on large-scale international energy projects. Exposure to diverse operational environments across multiple countries. Collaboration with industry-leading experts and access to mentoring opportunities. A dynamic and growth-oriented environment that supports career advancement. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package. Hybrid working opportunity, One day off on your birthday, Comprehensive Private Health Insurance, Professional and personal training & development opportunities, Exclusive discounts and campaigns for employees. In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity. In accordance with the Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data, please review the Personal Data Protection Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: Global Process Development Senior Engineer
description: Founded in 1987, Hayat operates in the fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) sector, serving millions of consumers globally with 16 powerful brands. Hayat’s portfolio includes Molfix and Bebem Natural in baby care; Molped in feminine care; Joly , Evony , and Goodcare in personal healthcare; Bingo , Gleen , Test , and Has in home care; Papia , Familia , Teno , and Focus in tissue paper; and Sholk in pet care. As the 4th largest branded diaper manufacturer in the world and the leading tissue producer in the Middle East, Eastern Europe, and Africa, Hayat employs over 10.000 people across its operations. Hayat operates 21 production facilities in 8 countries , including Turkey, Egypt, Iran, Algeria, Russia, Nigeria, Pakistan, and Vietnam, and manages sales and distribution companies in Morocco, Bulgaria, Kenya, Thailand, and Malaysia. With its global operations structured under three main regions Eurasia & Americas, Middle East & Africa, and Asia Pacific Hayat reaches over 100 countries across 5 continents, bringing its brands into millions of homes worldwide. We are currently seeking a talented “Global Process Development Senior Engineer” to join our dynamic “Global Production” team. Based at our “ Headquarters ” in “ Kocaeli ”, this role will contribute to transformative projects under the Consumer Group “ Global ”. If you want to be part of a diverse and vibrant community where your ideas can shape the future of the FMCG industry and your contributions can create a lasting global impact, then Hayat is waiting for you! Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering, 4 years of experience preferably in project management and project realisiation,maintenance or production, Preferably worked in tissue plants, Preferably having knowledge and ability about problem solving methods, Effectively using MS Office and Autocad programs, knowledge of SAP and MS Projects are preferred, Fluency in English both written and spoken, Analytical, result oriented, team player and good communication skills, Living in or willing to relocate to Kocaeli, No restriction to travel. Job Descriptions Conduct technical studies with machinery, equipment, and technology suppliers to identify and implement appropriate solutions for process development and improvement needs. Evaluate and compare alternative technical solutions and suppliers based on technical capabilities, process suitability, performance, and cost-effectiveness. Prepare and present technical comparison and evaluation reports for proposed process development solutions to relevant stakeholders. Coordinate production trials, commissioning, and start-up activities for new or modified processes, machinery, and equipment, ensuring their successful implementation in production. Monitor and resolve technical issues and process deficiencies within the scope of responsibility, ensuring root causes are identified and appropriate corrective actions are effectively implemented.

title: Part Quality Engineer
description: Hyundai Motor Türkiye invites you to become part of one of the world's leading car manufacturers. Being a member of our international team, you have the chance to form the future of mobility together with experts inside a global company with a unique success story. As a well-organized, flexible and motivated professional, you will master diverse challenges and work in a dynamic environment with a strong customer focus. We love to defy conventions and drive ambitious future plans with responsibility when it comes to mobility, quality and design. For these aims we need the right team and therefore, we need you. At Hyundai, we believe that the success of our organization lies in the passion and diversity of individual members. That is why we also commit to supporting them in their personal development, while offering an inspiring work atmosphere. We are looking for a Part Quality Engineer to take part in Hyundai Motor Türkiye located in İzmit/Kocaeli; Division: Quality Department: Advanced Quality We want you to: Identify and resolve inline, offline, and PDI part group issues in collaboration with suppliers. Monitor and confirm the implementation of countermeasures at supplier sites. Track and oversee Engineering Orders (EO) & 4M changes at supplier production lines, ensuring compliance with EPI deadlines. Proactively seek quality improvement opportunities and provide comprehensive reports. Identify and implement cost-saving initiatives within supplier operations and component production. Support new vehicle development processes, address quality concerns, and approve project quality documentation. Monitor quality trends, focusing on supplier continuous improvement initiatives. Conduct supplier audits to ensure compliance with quality standards. Perform data-driven analysis to diagnose problems and develop creative, effective solutions. Develop and maintain inspection standards, ensuring supplier processes and parts align with quality expectations and customer requirements. You will also need to have: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Metallurgy & Material Engineering Minimum 2 years of experience in automotive industry with a focus on project quality and quality management. Fluent in both written and spoken English Proficient in Microsoft Office programs Strong expertise in automotive core tools such as SPC, MSA, and FMEA In-depth knowledge of IATF 16949 and ISO 9001 quality management systems and related documentation Ability to interpret technical drawings and a solid understanding of tolerancing Familiarity with CAD programs, particularly CATIA V5 A proactive approach to enhancing overall quality and process improvements Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to drive solutions effectively A team-oriented mindset, capable of collaborating across departments Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain and resolve problems efficiently Customer-focused and results-driven approach No travel restrictions; B-class driver’s license and willingness to travel as required We Offer Working on a global level and recognized internationally, Chance to enhance your competencies and unlock your potential, Structured training and ongoing career development, Flexible working hours (Flextime), Flexible benefits, Comprehensive private health insurance, Casual dress code “Hyundai Motor Türkiye is an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity in the workplace.”

title: Kıdemli İş Geliştirme Mühendisi
description: 1957’den günümüze Türkiye’nin milli servetini ekonomiye kazandıran, Koç Topluluğu Enerji Grubu’nun köklü temsilcisi Demir Export olarak; 4 farklı lokasyonda 3.000’i aşkın çalışanımızla madencilik sektörüne yön veriyoruz. #Başkamadencilik mottosuyla; Dünya Doğa ve Doğal Kaynakları Koruma Birliği, Ramsar Sözleşmesi ve UNESCO kriterlerini çalışma prensiplerimizin merkezine koyuyor, doğaya ve geleceğe değer katan bir sorumlulukla hareket ediyoruz. Bu vizyonu paylaşacak, Ankara Kızılay Merkez ofisimiz ’de görev alacak " Kıdemli İş Geliştirme Mühendisi " arıyoruz. GENEL NİTELİKLER Üniversitelerin Maden Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, Tercihen 3 yıl iş geliştirme deneyimine sahip, MsOffice Programları, MsProject, Datamine, NetCAD, AutoCAD, vb. teknolojileri iyi derecede kullanabilen, B sınıfı ehliyete sahip olmak. Tercihen iyi seviyede İngilizce bilen (yazılı ve sözlü), İŞ TANIMI Yönetimce uygun görülen uzun dönemli madencilik projelerinin teknik fizibilite çalışmalarını (makine parkı seçimi, iş gücü planlaması vb.) yürütmek, Yerli/yabancı ortaklı projelerde aktif rol oynamak; ilgili toplantı, değerlendirme, hukuki ve teknik araştırma süreçlerini ekip ile birlikte koordine etmek, Mevcut ve potansiyel emtia pazarlarına yönelik analizler gerçekleştirmek ve raporlar hazırlamak, Saha ziyaretleri ve proje değerlendirme süreçlerine katılarak yeni iş fırsatlarının geliştirilmesini ve şirkete kazandırılmasını sağlamak. YAN FAYDALAR Koç Ailem üyeliği ile "Aileden Ayrıcalıklısın". Yüzlerce markada Koç'lulara özel avantaj ve indirimlerden faydalan. Özel Sağlık Sigortasından faydalan. Hem de risk değerlendirmesi yapılmadan, bekleme süresi olmaksızın, mevcut hastalıkları da kapsayan poliçe ayrıcalığı ile. Koç Healtcare uygulaması ile, Amerikan Hastanesi ve Koç Üniversitesi hastanesi doktorlarından sınırsız ve ücretsiz online sağlık hizmeti al. Koç Emekli Vakfı ile geleceğini güvence altına al. İlkokul, orta okul ve lise çağında çocuğun varsa Kunduz Eğitim Platformu ücretsiz üyelik hakkı ile çocuklarının eğitimini destekle. Flextra esnek yan fayda sistemi ile yan faydanı kendin belirle. Haftada bir gün uzaktan çalışma imkanının avantajlarını yaşa. Koç Office Free ile Koç topluluğu şirketlerinin ortak ofislerinde gittiğin her yerde ofis rahatlığını yaşa. Özel günlerde şirketin hep yanında, sürprizlerle gülümse. Mesleki ve Yetkinlik gelişimi için eğitim fırsatlarından yararlan. İŞE ALIM SÜRECİMİZ İlanlar üzerinden yapılan başvurular ilanda yer verilen bilgilere göre değerlendirilir. Uygun adaylar, ön görüşme, işe alım testleri ve envanterleri, yönetici görüşmesi, üst yönetim görüşmesi, referans kontrol aşamalarından geçer. Her adım ayrı bir değerlendirme süreci olup, adayın bir sonraki adıma geçebilmesi için ilgili adımı başarı ile tamamlaması gerekir. Demir Export tüm adaylara eşitlikçi işe alım politikası uygular.
