title: Gönüllü Makine Mühendisi
company: IIHSE Uluslararası Sağlık Güvenlik Çevre Enstitüsü
description: Gönüllü Makine Mühendisi | Türkiye | Uzaktan ve Proje Bazlı Kurum: Uluslararası Sağlık Güvenlik Çevre Enstitüsü Derneği (IIHSE) Konum: Türkiye Geneli – %100 Uzaktan Çalışma Modeli: Gönüllü, Esnek Zamanlı, Proje ve Görev Bazlı Ücretlendirme: Ücretsiz – Gönüllülük Esasına Dayalı IIHSE Hakkında Uluslararası Sağlık Güvenlik Çevre Enstitüsü (IIHSE), iş sağlığı ve güvenliği, çevre, sürdürülebilirlik ve toplum sağlığı alanlarında eğitim, araştırma, mesleki gelişim ve sosyal sorumluluk çalışmaları yürüten uluslararası bir sivil toplum kuruluşudur. IIHSE, farklı disiplinlerden profesyonellerin bilgi ve deneyimlerini bir araya getirerek daha sağlıklı, güvenli ve sürdürülebilir çalışma ve yaşam ortamlarının oluşturulmasına katkıda bulunmayı hedeflemektedir. Pozisyon Hakkında IIHSE, makine mühendisliği alanındaki teknik bilgi ve deneyimlerini iş sağlığı ve güvenliği, makine emniyeti ve endüstriyel risklerin azaltılması çalışmalarında değerlendirmek isteyen Gönüllü Makine Mühendisleri aramaktadır. Bu gönüllülük fırsatı; makine mühendislerinin mesleki uzmanlıklarını paylaşmalarına, disiplinler arası projelerde yer almalarına ve mühendislik temelli önleyici güvenlik kültürünün gelişmesine katkıda bulunmalarına olanak tanımayı amaçlamaktadır. Görevler, gönüllülerin uzmanlık alanları, ilgi alanları ve zaman uygunlukları doğrultusunda karşılıklı mutabakatla belirlenecektir. Görev ve Sorumluluklar Gönüllüler, uzmanlıklarına göre aşağıdaki çalışmalardan bir veya birkaçına katkı sağlayabilir: 1. Makine Emniyeti ve Teknik Risk Değerlendirmesi Makine ve iş ekipmanlarına yönelik tehlike tanımlama ve risk değerlendirme çalışmalarına teknik içerik desteği sağlamak. Makine koruyucuları, emniyet sistemleri, mekanik tehlikeler ve güvenli çalışma yöntemleri hakkında teknik kaynaklar hazırlamak. Makine emniyeti standartları ve iyi uygulama örneklerine ilişkin araştırmalar yürütmek. 2. Endüstriyel Güvenlik ve Bakım Emniyeti Bakım, onarım ve ekipman müdahalelerinde güvenli çalışma uygulamalarına ilişkin farkındalık materyalleri geliştirmek. Enerji izolasyonu ve kilitleme-etiketleme (LOTO) uygulamaları hakkında bilgilendirici içerikler hazırlamak. Makine kaynaklı iş kazalarının önlenmesine yönelik teknik çalışmalar yürütmek. 3. Teknik Araştırma ve Yayın Çalışmaları Makine emniyeti, endüstriyel otomasyon, üretim güvenliği ve mühendislik uygulamaları hakkında bilimsel ve teknik literatür araştırmaları yapmak. IIHSE yayınları için teknik makale, kontrol listesi, rehber ve bilgi notlarının hazırlanmasına katkıda bulunmak. Ulusal ve uluslararası teknik standartlar ile iyi uygulamaları incelemek. 4. Eğitim ve Mesleki Bilgi Paylaşımı Makine emniyeti ve endüstriyel güvenlik konularında webinar, seminer ve teknik eğitim içeriklerinin geliştirilmesine destek olmak. Mühendislik öğrencileri ve genç profesyonellere yönelik mesleki bilgi paylaşımı çalışmalarına katkı sağlamak. Uygun deneyime sahip gönüllüler için mentorluk ve teknik bilgi paylaşımı faaliyetlerinde görev almak. 5. IIHSE Projelerine Teknik Katkı IIHSE'nin sağlıklı ve güvenli yaşam alanları, iş kazalarının önlenmesi ve güvenlik kültürünün geliştirilmesine yönelik projelerine mühendislik perspektifi kazandırmak. Farklı mesleklerden gönüllülerle disiplinler arası teknik çalışmalarda iş birliği yapmak. Uzmanlık alanıyla ilgili yeni proje ve araştırma önerileri geliştirmek. Aranan Nitelikler Temel Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği bölümünden mezun olmak. Makine emniyeti, endüstriyel güvenlik veya ilgili mühendislik uygulamalarına ilgi duymak. Teknik araştırma, dokümantasyon ve bilgi paylaşımı çalışmalarına katkı sunmaya istekli olmak. Uzaktan ve ekip çalışmasına uygun iletişim becerilerine sahip olmak. Gönüllülük ilkelerine, mesleki etik kurallara ve IIHSE'nin kurumsal değerlerine bağlı olmak. Tercih Sebebi Olabilecek Yetkinlikler Makine tasarımı, üretim, bakım, otomasyon veya endüstriyel tesislerde deneyim. Makine emniyeti, risk değerlendirmesi ve CE uygunluk süreçleri hakkında bilgi. TS EN ISO 12100, ISO 13849-1 veya ilgili makine güvenliği standartlarına aşinalık. İş ekipmanlarının güvenli kullanımı ve bakım güvenliği konusunda deneyim. Teknik raporlama, araştırma, eğitim veya yayın hazırlama becerisi. Teknik kaynakları takip edebilecek düzeyde İngilizce bilgisi. Yeni mezun makine mühendislerinin başvuruları da değerlendirilecektir. İleri düzey uzmanlık gerektiren çalışmalar, ilgili deneyime sahip gönüllülerin sorumluluğunda yürütülecektir. Gönüllülük Modelimiz IIHSE, gönüllülüğün kişilerin mevcut iş, eğitim ve özel yaşam sorumluluklarıyla uyumlu olması gerektiğine inanır. %100 uzaktan katılım: Türkiye'nin her yerinden katkı sağlanabilir. Ekip çalışması: Disiplinler arası bilgi paylaşımı ve proje geliştirme süreçlerine katılım sağlanabilir. Gönüllüler, IIHSE tarafından açıkça yetkilendirilmedikleri sürece kurum adına resmî teknik onay, uygunluk değerlendirmesi veya bağlayıcı taahhütte bulunamaz. Gönüllülüğün Sağlayabileceği Fırsatlar Makine mühendisliği bilgi ve deneyimini toplumsal fayda amacıyla kullanma. İş sağlığı ve güvenliği alanında disiplinler arası proje deneyimi edinme. Ulusal ve uluslararası profesyonellerle bilgi alışverişinde bulunma. Teknik araştırma, eğitim ve yayın çalışmalarına katkı sağlama. Mesleki iletişim ağını geliştirme. Uygun projelerde sorumluluk ve koordinasyon deneyimi kazanma. Önemli Bilgilendirme Bu ilan ücretli bir iş veya istihdam teklifi değildir. Pozisyon tamamen gönüllülük esasına dayanmaktadır; maaş veya düzenli ücret ödemesi yapılmamaktadır. Gönüllülük süreci gelecekte ücretli istihdam garantisi oluşturmaz. Görevler IIHSE'nin proje ihtiya

title: Tester/Devreye Alma Teknisyeni (Antalya)
description: Dünya şehirleri karmaşıklaştıkça, şehirlerde kolay ve güvenli bir şekilde hareket etmek daha da önemli hale geliyor. KONE olarak şehirleri daha iyi yaşam alanları yapmak için birlikte çalışıyoruz. Kentsel yaşamın akışında bizimle birlikte çalışmak, yetenek ve azim gerektirir. Kariyeriniz bir yolculuktur ve nasıl seyahat ettiğiniz, fark yaratmanızı sağlar. Seyahatinizin sürücü koltuğunda siz oturun! Şimdi hareket etme zamanı. KONE ile hayatın akışına katılın. Antalya’da görev alacak Test & Devreye Alma ekibimize katılmak üzere, detaylara önem veren ve kalite odaklı bir Tester/Devreye Alma Teknisyeni arıyoruz. Bu pozisyonda, asansör ve yürüyen merdiven ekipmanlarının tüm test, devreye alma ve saha denetimlerinin ilgili standartlara, yönetmeliklere ve iç kalite gerekliliklerine uygun şekilde gerçekleştirilmesinden sorumlu olacaksınız. Görev ve sorumluluklar: Tüm test ve devreye alma faaliyetlerini ilgili standart, İSG ve iç kalite gerekliliklerine uygun şekilde yürütmek. Ekipmanın mekanik ve elektriksel olarak güvenli olduğundan ve sözleşme şartlarını karşıladığından emin olmak. Üniteleri teknik şartnamelere ve devreye alma talimatlarına göre devreye almak. Son kontrolleri gerçekleştirmek ve gerekli tüm dokümantasyonu tamamlamak. Günlük test ve devreye alma faaliyetleriyle ilgili müşteri ile etkin iletişim kurmak. Saha faaliyetlerinin kesintisiz ilerlemesi için Saha Süpervizörü ile sürekli koordinasyon sağlamak. Gerekli durumlarda müşteri teslimi, danışman veya onay kuruluşu denetimlerine katılmak. title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Bij RH Marine realiseren wij de systeemintegratie van elektrische- en automatiseringssystemen aan boord van marineschepen, onderzeeboten en luxe superjachten. Een complex en fascinerend werkgebied vol innovaties. Ieder schip is maatwerk voor de klant en na de doop van het schip blijven wij verantwoordelijk voor het onderhoud en upgrades. Het blijft dus de hele life cycle ‘ons kindje’. Voor onze afdeling Mechanical Engineering zoeken wij een Mechanical Engineer met een sterk praktisch en technisch inzicht. Iemand die begrijpt hoe je van een idee, via een basic design, tot een maakbaar eindproduct komt. Het betreft een functie voor 36 – 40 uur per week en de standplaats is Schiedam. Functie Je ontwerpt en realiseert mechanische constructies voor lessenaars, besturingskasten en schakelborden aan boord van schepen. Daarbij ligt de nadruk niet alleen op “tekenen & rekenen”, maar vooral op technisch gevoel, maakbaarheid en zelfstandigheid in ontwerpen. Bij marineschepen ligt de nadruk op schok-, tril- en omgevingseisen, terwijl bij superjachten juist compactheid, ergonomie en beperkte inbouwruimte centraal staan. Je werkzaamheden bestaan o.a. uit: Zelfstandig opzetten van basic- en detailontwerpen voor mechanische constructies. Ontwerpen met oog voor sterkte, stijfheid, schok-, tril- en omgevingseisen. Globaal en waar nodig detailmatig verifiëren van je ontwerp met berekeningen. Selecteren van materialen en opstellen van materiaallijsten. Begeleiden van productie bij leveranciers en aanwezig zijn bij afnames van je eigen ontwerpen. Ondersteunen tijdens assemblage en testen in onze werkplaats en op de testvloer. Intensief samenwerken met collega’s uit o.a. Electrical, Automation en Project Engineering. Actief informatie ophalen binnen projecten – ook als die informatie niet vanzelf naar je toekomt. Functie-eisen Wij zoeken geen “tekenaar”, maar een mechanical engineer met technisch buikgevoel. Iemand die bijvoorbeeld snapt hoe groot een bout moet zijn om een bepaald gewicht te dragen. Of kan inschatten hoe zwaar of stijf een constructie moet worden, vóórdat alles wordt doorgerekend. Ervaring met hands-on projecten (bijv. zelf iets gebouwd, omgebouwd of ontworpen) is een grote plus. Jij bent in staat vanaf nul zelfstandig te ontwerpen en verifiëren zonder dat elke stap moet worden voorgeschreven. Je hebt een goed gevoel voor technische maakbaarheid en praktische productieprocessen. Je jaagt actief informatie na en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je eindproduct. Verder vragen wij: HBO of WO Werktuigbouwkunde (of vergelijkbaar) 2 tot 4 jaar relevante werkervaring Ervaring met Autodesk Inventor en Vault Professional is een pre. Ervaring met sheet metal design is een pre. Bereidheid een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag en Verklaring van Geen Bezwaar aan te vragen. Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Aanbod Een geweldig bedrijf om voor te werken met een rijke historie en een mooie toekomst, met veel aandacht voor innovatie. Je sluit aan bij een jong, gevarieerd team van 13 mechanische engineers, verdeeld over verschillende projecten. Daarnaast werk je regelmatig samen met electrical en automation engineers en ook technisch uitvoerende collega’s. Je kunt op termijn doorgroeien richting Lead Mechanical Engineer. De collegialiteit is groot; een goede sfeer en samenwerking is onmisbaar om ons complexe werk succesvol uit te voeren. Geen project is hetzelfde en ieder project is bijzonder. Het eindresultaat is altijd een prachtig varend schip waarop alles werkt. Werk waar je trots op kunt zijn! De arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn als volgt: Een salaris tussen de € 3.582, - en € 5.656, - bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring; 8% vakantiegeld; Een variabele winstdeling; 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV dagen; Een laptop en smartphone van de zaak; Flexibele werktijden en hybride werken; Een goede pensioenregeling via PMT. Solliciteren Direct reageren kan via het formulier. Ben je geïnteresseerd, maar heb je toch een vraag? Neem dan contact op met Natasja Dokter via 06 -11010122 of natasja.dokter@rhmarine.com. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Aan cv's die ongevraagd worden aangeleverd door uitzend- en detacheringsbureaus kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend.

Samen met collega-ontwerpleiders, ontwerp coördinatoren, engineers, BIM-coördinatoren en BIM-modelleurs werk je aan verschillende projecten voor Schiphol. Als engineer motiveer jij je collega’s en neem je ze mee in jouw ontwerpreis voor het project. Je werkt mee aan de gezonde leefomgeving van heel Schiphol met als doel om in 2030 een emissie loze luchthaven te zijn. Dit bieden wij jou? Een vast contract voor onbepaalde tijd. Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 3.500,- tot € 5.100,- bruto per maand o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband. Afhankelijk van je opleiding en werkervaring. Een prettige werksfeer: als collega’s staan we altijd voor elkaar klaar en komen we regelmatig samen om onze successen te vieren. Een warm welkom: je krijgt letterlijk een Heijmans-welkomstpakket. Tijdens twee introductiedagen maak je uitgebreid kennis met ons bedrijf, daarna volg je drie maanden een inwerktraject. Jouw persoonlijke buddy wijst je de weg en beantwoordt je vragen. Veel groeimogelijkheden, onder meer via onze eigen Heijmans Academie en via praktijkgerichte trainingen, gegeven door je eigen professionele collega’s. Een goede balans tussen werk en privé. Een werkplekvergoeding om het thuiswerken zo aangenaam mogelijk te maken. Een laptop en smartphone. Arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de cao Metaal & Techniek Dit ben jij Het proces van Ontwerp en Engineering uitvoeren vanuit de Heijmans-gedachte: dat kenmerkt jou als werktuigbouwkundig engineer. title: Konstruktionsingeniør
description: Erfaren konstruktionsingeniør som gerne vil være herre i sine egne projekter, og kan omsætte komplekse konstruktioner til gennemarbejdede og robuste løsninger. Hos Torkil Laursen søger vi en erfaren konstruktionsingeniør, der trives med ansvar, har stærke faglige kompetencer og motiveres af at føre projekter sikkert fra de første skitser til det færdige byggeri. Du får ansvaret for dine egne projekter og bliver en central faglig nøgleperson gennem hele projektforløbet. Stillingen indebærer ikke alene beregning og projektering af bærende konstruktioner, men også ansvar for at koordinere løsninger, rådgive kunder og sikre, at kvalitet, økonomi og fremdrift går hånd i hånd. Du kommer til at arbejde med både nybyggeri, ombygning og renovering, hvor du får mulighed for at præge de tekniske løsninger fra idéfase til aflevering. Har du solid erfaring med projektering af bærende konstruktioner og lysten til selvstændigt at drive dine projekter, får du hos os mulighed for at arbejde bredt med mange forskellige opgavetyper og konstruktioner. Vi praktiserer en flad organisation, hvor faglig sparring og samarbejde er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Her er der kort vej fra idé til handling, og rig mulighed for at præge både projekterne og din egen udvikling. Dine opgaver Som konstruktionsingeniør hos Torkil Laursen forventes du selvstændigt at kunne projektere og udvikle konstruktionsløsninger på egne projekter. Du får det faglige ansvar for projekteringen af de bærende konstruktioner og bliver en vigtig sparringspartner for både kunder, kolleger og øvrige rådgivere gennem hele projektforløbet. Dine opgaver vil derfor blandet andet bestå af : Selvstændig projektering af bærende konstruktioner inden for nybyggeri, ombygning og renovering. Udarbejdelse af statiske beregninger, konstruktionsprincipper og teknisk dokumentation. · Dimensionering og vurdering af bærende konstruktioner i træ, stål, beton og murværk. · Koordinering af konstruktionsløsninger med bygherre, entreprenører, arkitekter og øvrige rådgivere. · Kvalitetssikring og faglige afklaringer gennem hele projektforløbet. · Besigtigelse og vurdering af eksisterende bygninger og konstruktioner. · Fagtilsyn og opfølgning på udførende arbejder. · Bidrag til udvikling af tekniske løsninger og optimering af projekter. · Sparring med kolleger og bidrag til afdelingens faglige udvikling. · Videreformidling og koordinering af tegneopgaver med vores tekniske designere. Om dig Du er uddannet ingeniør med speciale inden for konstruktioner eller tilsvarende og har minimum 5 års erfaring fra en rådgivende ingeniørvirksomhed eller lignende. Derudover har du: Minimum 5 års erfaring med projektering og beregning af bærende konstruktioner. Erfaring med selvstændigt at drive egne projekter og tage ansvar for de tekniske løsninger. Indgående kendskab til Eurocodes, SBI 271, YBL og BR18. Erfaring med både renoveringsprojekter og nybyggeri. God forståelse for bygningsfysik og konstruktioners samspil med øvrige bygningsdele. Kendskab til samarbejdet mellem BIM, projektering og øvrige ingeniørfag. Evnen til at arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret. Gode kommunikative evner på dansk, både mundtligt og skriftligt. Certificering som statiker er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det er desuden en fordel, hvis du har en håndværksmæssig baggrund eller på anden måde har opnået en stærk praktisk forståelse for udførelse og byggetekniske løsninger. Vi forestiller os desuden, at du: Tager ansvar og følger dine opgaver helt til dørs. Trives med frihed under ansvar og motiveres af at drive egne projekter. Er kvalitetsbevidst og har blik for både detaljer og helhed. Er nysgerrig på faglig udvikling og nye løsninger. Trives i dialogen med kunder, samarbejdspartnere og kolleger. Bidrager positivt til det faglige og sociale fællesskab. Derfor skal du vælge Torkil Laursen I Torkil Laursen leverer vi en bred vifte af rådgivningsydelser inden for byggeri, konstruktioner, energi, indeklima og bæredygtighed. Vi arbejder for private kunder, boligorganisationer, kommuner og erhvervsvirksomheder, og vores brede faglighed gør os til en attraktiv samarbejdspartner på både små og store projekter. Hos os bliver du en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø med høj grad af tillid, samarbejde og frihed under ansvar. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes gennem stærk faglighed, engagement og godt kollegaskab. Hvad tilbyder vi: · Et spændende og alsidigt job i en virksomhed i vækst. · Mulighed for at drive dine egne projekter fra de første idéer til den færdige aflevering. · Et stærkt fagligt miljø med sparring og korte beslutningsveje. · Mulighed for faglig udvikling og efteruddannelse. · En uformel kultur med et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab. · Varierende og spændende projekter i alle størrelser. · Et afslappet arbejdsmiljø med højt fagligt niveau og gode kolleger. · Fleksibilitet og mulighed for hjemmearbejde. · Pensionsordning, attraktiv løn efter kvalifikationer, madordning, kulturklub, massørordning og meget mere. Lyder det som noget for dig?

title: Structural Analyst
description: Bring your life Do you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and using simulations to influence product development before physical testing begins? At Thule, we develop products that inspire an active life. In this role, you will use advanced structural simulations to help shape product design, improve performance, and ensure our products meet high standards of safety, quality, and durability. If you are motivated by combining engineering expertise with analytical problem-solving in a collaborative product development environment, this could be the opportunity for you. What You'll Do At Thule As a Structural Analyst, you will work closely with engineers and project teams throughout the product development process. Through advanced structural simulations, you will help build knowledge around product behaviour and provide insights that support engineering decisions from concept through verification. A key part of the role is promoting a simulation-driven development approach. By generating early insights into product performance, you will help teams optimize designs, reduce development risks, and make informed decisions before physical testing begins. You will take ownership of the simulation strategy for assigned projects, planning and executing simulation activities in line with project objectives and timelines. You will follow up on simulation results and compare them with physical verification and validation testing to continuously improve the correlation between virtual and real-world performance. You will also contribute to the development and continuous improvement of our simulation environment, helping strengthen simulation capabilities, methods, and ways of working across the organization. What You Bring To be successful in this role, we believe you have experience working with structural analysis, simulation, or engineering calculations within product development. You are comfortable translating technical data into actionable insights and enjoy solving complex engineering challenges through a structured and analytical approach. You have a solid understanding of engineering principles, simulation methodologies, and product development processes. Experience working with LS-DYNA and ANSA is highly valued, as these tools are key parts of our simulation environment. Experience with verification and validation activities, including the relationship between virtual and physical testing, is also an advantage. As a person, you are self-driven, proactive, and collaborative, with a strong ability to take initiative and move work forward. You communicate technical insights effectively, enjoy working across functions, and are motivated by solving complex challenges, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing. To succeed in this role, you are fluent in English, both written and spoken. Why you should join Thule At Thule, we are Proud to Be Thule. We believe anything is possible when we stay curious, take initiative and challenge ourselves. We encourage everyone to take ownership and make the most of their part of the business. We believe we win as a team by collaborating across functions, sharing knowledge and supporting one another. United by our passion for our products, the outdoors and the Thule brand, we take pride in what we do and create a culture where everyone contributes, grows and has fun. Hiring Process Apply by submitting your application and resumé through “Apply for position” on Thule Career Site. Last day for applying is November 15, 2026. Please make sure not to wait until the last application date to show your interest, as interviews are held continuously throughout the process and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Please also note that we do not accept applications by e-mail. For questions, please contact the Talent Acquisition Partner responsible, Oscar Persson, at oscar.persson@thule.com. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Structural Integrity Engineer
description: When decades of offshore history meet today’s engineering challenge. As a Senior Structural Integrity Engineer, you work on offshore structures that have already lived a life. Jackets and top sides may have been operating for decades, modified multiple times and documented with varying levels of detail. When these structures need to be lifted, transported or decommissioned, understanding how they will behave during removal operations. That is where your engineering judgement makes the difference. Using tools such as SACS and DNV Sesam/Genie, you assess structural integrity, challenge assumptions and determine the right analysis approach. You turn complex structural behavior and sometimes incomplete information into clear, practical and technically robust solutions that can be executed offshore. You independently drive your structural integrity scope from definition through analysis, verification and delivery. Depending on the project, you may also act as Lead Engineer, reviewing work and guiding less experienced engineers while remaining closely involved in the technical analysis yourself. What will you be working on? Building, checking and interpreting structural models using SACS, DNV Sesam/Genie or similar software. Assessing offshore jackets, top sides and related structures for lifting, load-out and transportation. Defining fit for purpose analysis strategies, assumptions and acceptance criteria in line with HMC guidance and recognized codes and standards. Developing practical and robust engineering solutions when structural information, geometry or condition is uncertain. Independently managing your technical scope, priorities, risks, interfaces and deliverables towards Project Engineers. Acting as Lead Engineer when required, reviewing analyses and guiding less experienced engineers. Contributing to the continuous improvement of engineering methods, workflows, quality standards and tools. What do you bring? A bachelor’s or master’s degree in civil, Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering. At least 5 years of relevant structural engineering experience, with the ability to independently manage complex engineering scopes. A strong background in steel structures, structural analysis and relevant engineering codes and standards. Experience with structural analysis software such as SACS, DNV Sesam/Genie, STAAD. Ro, SCIA or similar. Strong analytical skills combined with practical engineering judgement. The ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly in English. Strong interest in supporting and coaching less experienced engineers. The flexibility to work temporarily offshore, abroad or from one of our international offices. Your foundation for success You enjoy solving complex engineering problems where there is not always one obvious answer. You are comfortable taking ownership, challenging assumptions and making sound engineering decisions, even when information is incomplete. You combine technical depth with a practical mindset and know how to translate complex structural analyses into clear recommendations. You work well with others, share your knowledge and help less experienced engineers grow. Here’s why people love working with us Strong compensation & benefits, including an annual bonus plan tied to company performance. Future-proof pension scheme. 30 days off, with the option to buy 10 additional days. Free access to our in-house gym, including fitness classes. Activities to connect with colleagues, including our Friday afternoon get-together. A modern and easily accessible office in Leiden. Is this your dream job? Please submit your application. So hit the button, apply, and make the impossible possible with Heerema. We’d love to meet you! Are you ready to make the impossible possible?

title: Civil & Structural Engineer - Design Assurance Support (Energy)
description: Job Description What if you could do the kind of work the world needs? You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you. Working closely with Design Assurance Leads, discipline specialists, and multidisciplinary delivery teams, your role will combine hands-on design capability with critical review, verification, and governance activities across the full project lifecycle. This position offers a clear development pathway towards a future Design Assurance, Checker, or Independent Reviewer role. Developing a strong understanding of design assurance principles, including design checking, verification processes, and technical governance frameworks. Undertaking independent reviews of calculations, drawings, specifications, and 3D models to ensure accuracy, consistency, and buildability. Supporting the delivery of civil and structural design packages where required, maintaining practical design experience to underpin assurance capability. Assisting in the implementation of structured design review processes, including interdisciplinary reviews, design risk workshops, and constructability assessments. Contributing to the identification and management of technical risks, assumptions, and constraints, ensuring these are clearly captured and communicated. Participating in multidisciplinary coordination and model reviews (including BIM environments), supporting clash detection and design integration activities. Liaising with design teams, contractors, and stakeholders to challenge and verify design intent, ensuring alignment with Employer’s Requirements and project objectives. Supporting compliance with relevant UK and international codes, standards, and governance requirements, including ISO 19650 and CDM Regulations. Contributing to lessons learned, technical standards development, and continuous improvement of design assurance processes. Supporting bid and tender activities where required, particularly in defining design assurance strategies, review methodologies, and resourcing approaches. Gaining exposure to certification, verification, and independent checking processes applicable to regulated infrastructure and energy projects. Your team You will be part of the WSP Design Assurance function within the UK Energy Transition team, providing independent technical oversight across major infrastructure and energy projects. You will work closely with both internal design teams and external stakeholders, including clients, EPC contractors, OEMs, and regulatory bodies, across projects in the UK. We are seeking a motivated engineer who is keen to transition towards a Design Assurance role, with a strong technical foundation and a critical, detail-oriented mindset. Experience in civil and structural design, ideally within energy, power, industry or infrastructure sectors. Good understanding of design processes and deliverables across different stages (Feasibility, Concept, FEED, Detailed Design), including expectations for level of definition. Familiarity with relevant codes and standards (e.g. Eurocodes, UK standards) and an appreciation of compliance and assurance requirements. Familiarities with National Grid technical specifications and National Grid Business Procedures will be preferable. Experience with industry-standard engineering and design software, including structural analysis tools (e.g. Robot, STAAD, Tekla Structural Designer) and BIM/CAD platforms (e.g. Revit, Tekla Structures, AutoCAD, Civil 3D). Awareness of design review, checking, and verification processes, with a willingness to develop deeper expertise in design assurance methodologies. Experience working within multidisciplinary teams and coordinating with other disciplines such as MEP, HV primary, and infrastructure design. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to critically assess engineering solutions. Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to challenge designs constructively and present technical findings clearly. Awareness of construction methodologies, temporary works, and health & safety requirements, including CDM Regulations. Experience within the energy transmission and distribution sector, major infrastructure, or industrial projects is highly desirable. title: MEMS Process Scientist (m/f/x) - Temperature Switches for Cryogenic Applications
description: At the DLR Institute of Quantum Technologies in Ulm, we develop precision instruments for space applications based on quantum technologies and bring them to prototype maturity together with industry. In addition, we are driving forward the transfer to aeronautics, digitalisation, energy, security and transport. We have an interdisciplinary approach: Theoretical basic research and experimental tests meet engineering implementation. What To Expect The Department of Micro- and Nanosystems Integration develops technologies for the implementation and miniaturization of quantum systems. In doing so, it pays particular attention to the demanding requirements of the aerospace industry. Cryogenic temperatures are required for a wide variety of quantum systems. For both single-photon detectors and solid-state quantum systems, cooling to temperatures below 10 K is a critical component for functionality. As of now, there is no cryogenic technology that allows for use under space conditions. Systems based on liquid helium are unsuitable for use on satellites due to their size, energy efficiency, and vulnerability. Therefore, the development of novel cooling technologies is a crucial enabling technology for the implementation of quantum systems in space. The MEMS Process Researcher in Cryotechnology is responsible for the new subfield of MEMS cryotechnology within the IMN department. Building on the existing technology chain in the field of quantum system miniaturization, a new technological building block is to be developed that will enable MEMS-based solutions for cooling to temperatures below 10 K. This component is to be made available across institutes as a technology building block and holds enormous potential for technology transfer in the future. Your Responsibilities You will develop miniaturized MEMS thermal switches for the cryogenic temperature range (10–30 K) - from the design of novel process chains in the cleanroom to a functional prototype. You will derive technical requirements from the overall system and design multidisciplinary solutions at the interface of materials science, microsystems engineering, and quantum technology. You will develop test structures and characterization methods for in-process quality assurance and set up a novel cryogenic test rig to evaluate the performance of the developed components. You will perform FEM simulations to predict thermal performance parameters and validate them experimentally using your prototypes. You will plan and implement the integration of the thermal switch into a magnetocaloric cooling chain and conduct a full-system functional demonstration. You will supervise master’s theses in this field, guide students in cleanroom processes and cryogenic measurement technology, and contribute to patents and scientific publications. You will actively help shape the strategic technology field of cryogenic MEMS, independently secure third-party funding for projects, and help define the group’s scientific direction. Your profile Completed scientific university degree (Master / Diploma Uni) in natural sciences (e.g. physics) or engineering (e.g. from the fields of microsystems engineering, physics, electrical engineering, materials science, or a comparable field with an experimental focus) or other degree programmes relevant to the position Several years of proven practical experience in MEMS development and microfabrication: photolithography, dry and wet etching processes, thin-film deposition, wafer bonding, and experience working in a cleanroom and in in-process quality control In-depth knowledge of heat transfer and thermodynamics, particularly in the cryogenic temperature range; Understanding of the temperature behavior of materials below 77 K Initial experience in at least one of the following areas: operation of cryogenic measurement setups and characterization systems, creation of mask designs using MEMS design tools and layout software, and performing thermomechanical analyses using FEM simulation software (COMSOL, ANSYS, or similar) Extensive project experience in the iterative development of microtechnological components (sensors, actuators, or switching elements) from concept to functional prototype Experience in professional quality management: structured documentation, process approvals, traceability—ideally in a standardized environment (ISO, ECSS, or similar) Willingness to collaborate closely with related disciplines (quantum optics, cryogenics, system integration) and to mentor students Remuneration is up to the German TVöD 14 depending on qualifications and assigned tasks. We look forward to getting to know you! If you have any questions about this position ( Vacancy-ID 5541 ) please contact: Dr. Jakob Buchheim Tel.: +49 731 400198 909

title: Junior Technical Engineer met wagen
description: Over het bedrijf Ben jij een pas afgestudeerde ingenieur die technische vraagstukken graag tot op de bodem uitzoekt? Krijg je energie van berekeningen, technische analyses en het zoeken naar de meest efficiënte oplossing? Dan kan dit jouw ideale start zijn. Voor een internationale marktleider binnen een industriële productieomgeving zoeken we een Junior Technical Engineer . Je komt terecht in een stabiele organisatie waar technische expertise, innovatie en ondernemerschap centraal staan. Ondanks de internationale context blijft de bedrijfscultuur toegankelijk, no-nonsense en mensgericht. Je krijgt de kans om te leren van ervaren collega's, impact te maken op uitdagende projecten en jezelf stap voor stap te ontwikkelen tot technisch expert binnen jouw vakgebied. Jouw rol Als Junior Technical Engineer word je na een grondige interne opleiding een belangrijke technische schakel tussen klanten, commerciële collega's en interne afdelingen. Je helpt mee om technische uitdagingen om te zetten in haalbare en efficiënte oplossingen. Technisch advies: Je ondersteunt klanten en collega's met technisch advies en helpt mee de meest geschikte oplossing uit te werken. Projectanalyse: Je onderzoekt technische haalbaarheid en vertaalt projectspecifieke eisen naar concrete oplossingen. Berekeningen: Je maakt technische berekeningsnota's op basis van mechanische, thermische, dimensionale, brandveiligheids- en akoestische vereisten. Samenwerking: Je werkt nauw samen met commerciële collega's en ondersteunt hen met jouw technische expertise. Documentatie: Je stelt technische documentatie op en houdt bestaande documentatie actueel. Marktontwikkeling: Je volgt nieuwe trends, ontwikkelingen en innovaties binnen de sector op. Verbeterprojecten: Je denkt actief mee over productverbeteringen en optimalisaties van bestaande processen. Probleemoplossing: Je ondersteunt bij de analyse van technische uitdagingen tijdens en na de uitvoering van projecten. Jouw profiel Must-haves Opleiding: Je beschikt over een masterdiploma in bouwkunde, mechanica of elektromechanica. Technisch inzicht: Je houdt ervan om technische vraagstukken te analyseren en oplossingen uit te werken. Communicatie: Je communiceert helder en werkt graag samen met klanten en collega's. Talenkennis: Je hebt een goede kennis van het Nederlands en een basiskennis van het Frans en Engels. Analytisch vermogen: Je kan complexe technische informatie verwerken en omzetten naar praktische oplossingen. Motivatie: Je bent leergierig, gedreven en klaar om jouw carrière verder uit te bouwen. Bereikbaarheid: Je woont idealiter binnen een straal van ongeveer 30 minuten van regio Brugge - Tielt. Nice-to-haves Duits: Een basiskennis Duits vormt een extra troef. Bouwsector: Affiniteit met bouwtechnische toepassingen is mooi meegenomen. Technische berekeningen: Ervaring via stages of projecten vormt een meerwaarde. Innovatie: Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technieken en marktontwikkelingen. Wat je krijgt Contract: Een vast contract van onbepaalde duur. Werkregime: Een voltijdse functie. Verloning & voordelen: Een bruto maandsalaris vanaf €2.800 voor een schoolverlater, aangevuld met een bedrijfswagen, maaltijdcheques, hospitalisatieverzekering en groepsverzekering. Opleiding: Een uitgebreid intern opleidingstraject waarbij je producten, markten en technische toepassingen grondig leert kennen. Ontwikkeling: Sterke opleidings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen een internationale organisatie. Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor initiatief en eigen ideeën. Flexibiliteit: Flexibele werkuren in overleg. Werkomgeving: Een innovatieve en technische omgeving waar expertise, samenwerking en ondernemerschap centraal staan. Werksfeer: Een collegiale en no-nonsense bedrijfscultuur waar mensen elkaar ondersteunen en kennis graag delen. Interesse? Ben jij een Junior Technical Engineer die technische uitdagingen graag omzet in slimme oplossingen en zijn carrière wil starten binnen een internationale omgeving met sterke groeikansen? Dan maken we graag kennis met jou. Iedereen is bij ons welkom. We kijken naar jouw talent en motivatie, ongeacht leeftijd, afkomst, genderidentiteit, seksuele geaardheid of eventuele beperking. Reageer via de link of stuur je cv naar tamara@auresjobs.be. Je krijgt altijd binnen 48 uur een antwoord, ook als het geen match is. Is je profiel positief? Dan plannen we een verkennend gesprek waarin jij rustig kan aftoetsen of deze rol en organisatie écht bij jou passen. We leren je graag kennen.

title: Senior Structural Analysis Engineer
description: ReOrbit is looking for a motivated and experienced Senior Structural Analysis Engineer to join our growing team. As our new Senior Structural Analysis Engineer, you will be responsible for the structural analysis of spacecraft structures and development of internal tools for the evaluation and post-processing of the analysis and test results. It is an exciting chance to join a dynamic start-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact and reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer. Responsibilities Creation of mathematical structural models using the finite element method (FEM). Carrying out static and dynamic analyses of satellites and their subsystems. Condensation of finite element models using the Craig-Bampton method. Bolted joints verification according to ECSS-HB-32-23 and VDI-2230. Definition of test plans and procedures, perform test predictions and test-model correlations. Collaboration with mechanical design, thermal and system engineers. Contribution to technical exchanges with suppliers and customers. Development of internal tools for the evaluation and post-processing of the analysis and test results. Development and implementation of standards and procedures. Preparation of structural analysis and test documentation. Presentation of the results internally and to the customer. Skills And Requirements Master’s degree in Aerospace, Mechanical engineering or similar qualification. At least 10 years of professional experience in the fields of static and dynamic analyses of spacecraft/launcher structures. Practical experience using Altair HyperWorks and MSC/Simcenter Nastran is an advantage. Basic proficiency with one or more programming languages such as Python and MATLAB. Good written and verbal communication skills. Organized, autonomous and attentive to detail. Team player capable of integrating into a multicultural team. What does ReOrbit do? ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities. ReOrbit’s top-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in-house software, procure hardware from the best-in-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiaries in Bristol, UK, Bariloche, Argentina and Bengaluru, India. Working at ReOrbit At ReOrbit, we are focused on building a strong team as we believe nothing can be accomplished without innovative, humble and curious minds working together on a common goal. We’re all about fostering an inclusive, dynamic environment where equality and diversity are our strength. We offer Challenging but rewarding environment – you will thrive if you are always reflecting on how to make things better. Your ideas will be heard. Ambitious and supportive network of people, who are motivated to change the space industry, bringing expertise from both classic and new space . Benefits such as lunch vouchers, events, parties, occupational health care and additional health insurance - but most importantly a possibility to be a part of a unique and diverse team, connected by similar mindset and sense of humor. We like to spend time together! You can choose activities whichever is to your liking – runOrbit, climbOrbit; become ping pong or board games champion. We support relocation and integration into Finnish society. Join us in our journey of building software enabled satellites for secure communications and, thus, creating the most compelling in space data flow company of the new space era. The Company may require a security clearance for certain positions. Any such security clearance will be conducted in accordance with applicable law and the Company's relevant policies For agencies: We do not accept unsolicited CVs for our open vacancies. Any CV sent to our team unsolicited will reserve us the right to pursue a candidate without obligation to the sender. All candidate submissions must be conducted through our official channels and in accordance with our terms of engagement.

title: Mechanical Simulation Engineer
description: 📍 Kraków | model hybrydowy Dołącz do zespołu realizującego innowacyjne projekty dla globalnej branży Automotive. Poszukujemy doświadczonego Mechanical Simulation Engineer a , który będzie odpowiedzialny za zaawansowane symulacje FEM oraz wsparcie procesu rozwoju i walidacji produktów elektronicznych dla sektora motoryzacyjnego. Twoje wyzwania Przeprowadzanie zaawansowanych symulacji mechanicznych FEM z wykorzystaniem Abaqus. Realizacja nieliniowych analiz implicit oraz explicit dla komponentów i systemów Automotive. Ocena wytrzymałości i niezawodności produktów poprzez: Stress-Strain Analysis, Natural Frequency Analysis, Random Vibration Analysis, Shock & Impact Analysis, Thermal Expansion Analysis. Praca na istniejących modelach symulacyjnych oraz ich rozwój i optymalizacja. Wsparcie procesów virtual validation i design verification na różnych etapach rozwoju produktu. Tworzenie, kalibracja oraz walidacja modeli materiałowych dla polimerów i elastomerów. Analiza wyników symulacji oraz przygotowywanie rekomendacji konstrukcyjnych i projektowych. Ścisła współpraca z zespołami R&D, konstrukcyjnymi, walidacyjnymi oraz innymi specjalistami zaangażowanymi w rozwój produktu. 🚀 Jeśli chcesz rozwijać swoją karierę w obszarze zaawansowanych symulacji mechanicznych i mieć wpływ na rozwój innowacyjnych produktów Automotive, zapraszamy do aplikowania. Wymagania Minimum 5 lat doświadczenia w branży Automotive, mile widziane w obszarze elektroniki samochodowej. Minimum 5 lat praktycznego doświadczenia w prowadzeniu symulacji FEM przy użyciu Abaqus. Bardzo dobra znajomość nieliniowych analiz implicit i explicit. Doświadczenie w realizacji analiz: Stress-Strain, Natural Frequency, Random Vibration, Shock/Impact, Thermal Expansion. Praktyczna znajomość kalibracji materiałów na potrzeby symulacji: modeli elastic-plastic dla polimerów, modeli hyper-elastic dla elastomerów. Doświadczenie w pracy z modelami opracowanymi przez innych inżynierów oraz ich modyfikacji. Znajomość procesów związanych z virtual product validation i design verification. Dobra znajomość właściwości tworzyw sztucznych i ich zachowania w symulacjach mechanicznych. Bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego w mowie i piśmie. Umiejętność efektywnej współpracy w środowisku międzynarodowym i zespołowym. Oferujemy Udział w zaawansowanych projektach dla czołowych firm z branży Automotive. Możliwość pracy nad nowoczesnymi rozwiązaniami i technologiami przyszłości. Stabilne zatrudnienie w międzynarodowym środowisku inżynierskim. Elastyczny model pracy hybrydowej. Realny wpływ na rozwój produktów wykorzystywanych przez miliony użytkowników na całym świecie. Współpracę z ekspertami w obszarze projektowania, walidacji oraz symulacji. Możliwości rozwoju zawodowego, szkoleń i podnoszenia kompetencji technicznych. Forma współpracy: Umowa o pracę lub B2B (do wyboru). title: Hydraulic Technician
description: Company Description ASCESCO is a heavy equipment manufacturer headquartered in Mersin, Türkiye, specializing in the design, engineering, production, and global distribution of high-performance construction machinery. The company’s portfolio includes crawler excavators, wheel excavators, wheel loaders, and other equipment built for demanding construction, infrastructure, mining, quarrying, and industrial environments. ASCESCO focuses on productivity, reliability, safety, and long-term performance to support customers in complex operational settings. With an emphasis on engineering excellence, advanced manufacturing, and rigorous quality standards, ASCESCO delivers durable machines, innovative solutions, and strong after-sales support. The company is committed to helping customers maximize uptime and reduce total cost of ownership. Role Description The Hydraulic Technician is a full-time, on-site role based in Mersin, Türkiye. This role is responsible for inspecting, diagnosing, and repairing hydraulic systems on heavy equipment, including excavators, loaders, and related machinery. Day-to-day tasks include performing scheduled maintenance, troubleshooting hydraulic and mechanical issues, replacing and adjusting hydraulic components, and conducting functional tests to ensure safe and reliable operation. The Hydraulic Technician collaborates with engineering, production, and service teams to support equipment commissioning, resolve field issues, and document service work accurately. The role also involves following safety procedures, maintaining tools and work areas, and providing technical input to improve service processes and equipment reliability. Qualifications Strong knowledge of hydraulic systems and mobile hydraulics, including diagnosis, repair, and performance testing. Hands-on experience with heavy equipment, such as excavators and loaders, and familiarity with construction machinery operation. Proficiency in troubleshooting and maintenance & repair of mechanical, hydraulic, and related systems. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, hydraulic schematics, and service manuals. Vocational or technical diploma in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or related field; equivalent practical experience is also valued. Basic understanding of electrical systems on mobile equipment is an advantage. Commitment to workplace safety, quality standards, and accurate documentation of service activities. Ability to work on-site in Mersin, handle physically demanding tasks, and collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team.

title: Üretim Müdürü
description: Gürmen Group 1972 yılından bu yana, yenilikçi ve sürdürülebilir çözümlerle sektöre yön vermeye devam ediyoruz. Markalarımız; Ramsey, KIP, Gökkale, MASPO ve Gurmen Technology gibi güçlü markalarımızla sektörde fark yaratıyoruz. Neden Gurmen Group? 50 Yıllık Deneyim ve Başarı: Londra'da temelleri atılan markalarımız, Türkiye’de dünya standartlarında üretimle buluşuyor. Sürdürülebilirlikte Öncü: RE-100 Yenilenebilir Enerji Organizasyonu’na üye olan ilk ve tek Türk şirketiyiz. İnovasyonun Gücü: En son teknolojileri kullanarak sektörde fark yaratan sürdürülebilir çözümler geliştiriyoruz. Uluslararası Başarı: EFQM tarafından “4 Yıldızlı Mükemmellik” ödülüne layık görüldük. Geleceğe Birlikte Yürüyoruz! Gurmen Group’ta her gün yeni bir fırsat, her adım yeni bir başlangıçtır. Türk tekstilini ve modasını dünyaya tanıtırken, birlikte büyüyor ve gelişiyoruz. Çeşitliliği ve fırsat eşitliğini destekleyerek, daha kapsayıcı bir iş ortamı yaratıyoruz. Sıra dışı bir deneyimin parçası olmaya hazırım diyorsan başvurunu bekliyoruz! Safranbolu 'daki üretim tesisimizde, üretim süreçlerinin kalite, maliyet, verimlilik ve termin hedefleri doğrultusunda yönetilmesine liderlik edecek Üretim Müdürü arıyoruz. Bu rolde; üretim planlarının sahada etkin şekilde hayata geçirilmesinden, üretimin tüm aşamalarının birbiriyle koordineli şekilde yürütülmesinden, iş gücü ve kapasitenin verimli kullanılmasından ve üretim performansının sürekli geliştirilmesinden sorumlu olacaksınız. Rolün temel sorumlulukları Üretim Planlama ve ilgili fonksiyonlarla koordineli çalışarak üretimin zamanında, hedeflenen kalite seviyesinde ve planlanan maliyetlerle gerçekleşmesini sağlamak, üretim plan ve programlarının sahada etkin şekilde uygulanmasını takip ederek sapmalara yönelik gerekli aksiyonları almak. Üretimin tüm aşamalarının uyumlu, kesintisiz ve etkin şekilde yürütülmesini sağlamak; süreçler arasındaki koordinasyonu yönetmek ve üretim süreçlerinde gerekli yönetim disiplinini oluşturmak. Günlük, aylık ve yıllık üretim performansını takip etmek; verimlilik, kalite, maliyet, kapasite ve termin göstergelerini analiz ederek performans sapmalarını ve iyileştirme alanlarını belirlemek. Üretim hatlarının performansını, kapasite kullanımını ve iş gücü dağılımını optimize etmek; makine, ekipman ve diğer kaynakların dengeli ve verimli kullanımını sağlamak. Üretim süreçlerindeki kayıp, darboğaz, verimsizlik ve kalite risklerini önceden belirlemek; gerekli düzeltici/önleyici faaliyetleri ve sürekli iyileştirme çalışmalarını hayata geçirmek. Üretim maliyetlerini takip etmek, bütçe çalışmalarına katkı sağlamak ve maliyet ile verimlilik iyileştirmelerine yönelik çalışmalar geliştirmek. Makine ve ekipmanların etkin kullanımını sağlamak, koruyucu ve periyodik bakım süreçlerinin düzenli şekilde yürütülmesini takip etmek. Kalite, çevre, iş sağlığı ve güvenliği standartlarının üretim sahasında etkin şekilde uygulanmasını sağlamak; üretim süreçleri ve çalışma yöntemlerinin standardizasyonunu ve sürdürülebilir performansını geliştirmek. Yeni üretim teknolojilerini ve sektördeki gelişmeleri takip ederek fabrikada uygulanabilecek geliştirme fırsatlarını değerlendirmek; bağlı ekiplerin hedeflerini belirlemek, performanslarını ve gelişimlerini takip ederek yüksek performans, sürekli gelişim ve problem çözme kültürünü güçlendirmek. Aranan nitelikler Üniversitelerin mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun; tercihen Tekstil ve Endüstri Mühendisliği eğitimine sahip, Ceket ve Pantolon üretiminde güçlü deneyime ve üretimin tüm aşamalarına hâkim, Üretim yönetimi, üretim planlama, hat ve kapasite yönetimi ile iş gücü planlama konularında deneyimli, Lean Manufacturing / Yalın Üretim yaklaşımını sahada uygulamış; Kaizen, 5S, standart iş, hat dengeleme ve kök neden analizi gibi yöntemlerde deneyimli, Üretim süreçlerindeki kayıp ve darboğazları analiz ederek verimlilik, kalite, çevrim süresi ve maliyet iyileştirmelerine liderlik etmiş, Üretim KPI’larını etkin şekilde takip eden, veriye dayalı karar alan ve sonuç üreten, Güçlü ekip yönetimi ve saha liderliği deneyimine sahip, Analitik düşünme, problem çözme, planlama ve koordinasyon becerileri güçlü, Farklı fonksiyonlarla etkin iş birliği kurabilen, İyi derecede İngilizce bilen.

What You'll Do Agent-operable system architecture Decompose legacy monoliths into agent-readable, modular systems with strict boundaries and single responsibility Lead incremental modernization using the Strangler Pattern, wrapping legacy logic in modern, contract-driven interfaces Enforce SOLID principles, Dependency Injection, and Hexagonal Architecture to ensure deterministic AI execution and low regression risk Agentic framework & MCP leadership Architect and maintain the agent context layer: standardized Skills, Rules, and Commands for AI-driven engineering workflows Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers exposing legacy APIs, services, and databases as typed, secure, AI-consumable tools Own contract-first API design as the primary interface between human intent and autonomous agent execution Engineering governance & AI quality control Act as architectural gatekeeper for AI-generated pull requests, ensuring scalability, security, and long-term maintainability Mandate test-driven development (TDD) and characterization testing to preserve legacy behavior during refactoring Monitor and optimize agentic reasoning loops to balance cost, speed, and architectural integrity What we're looking for 4+ years in software architecture, platform engineering, or technical leadership Proven experience modernizing large, undocumented legacy systems Deep hands-on expertise with TypeScript, .NET, and Node.js Strong background in API design, distributed systems, and modular architectures Practical experience with agentic development, MCP, LLM tooling, or AI-assisted engineering Bias toward clean code, deterministic systems, and production-grade AI Nice to have Experience with remote-first or globally distributed teams Background in SaaS transformations, scale-ups, or PE-backed environments Comfort operating in high-ambiguity, high-ownership settings

title: Lead Mechanical Engineer Industrie regio Amsterdam
description: Over de vacature Stuur als Lead Mechanical Engineer / senior werktuigbouwkundig ingenieur complete mechanische projecten binnen de (petro)chemie en Food & Pharma, van specificatie tot oplevering. Je verdeelt werkzaamheden, bewaakt voortgang en kwaliteit en ondersteunt het afdelingshoofd bij planning en het binnenhalen van nieuwe industriële projecten. De technische kern: het ontwerpen en specificeren van equipment en complexe installaties, inclusief sterkteberekeningen en FAT/SAT. Je begeleidt meerdere projecten parallel en draagt direct bij aan veiligere, efficiëntere en duurzamere productieprocessen in de regio Amsterdam. Je komt terecht bij een gespecialiseerd industrieel ingenieursbureau actief in de (petro)chemie, Food & Pharma en olie- en gassector. Dit bureau ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en optimaliseert processen, machines en technische installaties voor grote productie- en proceslocaties, zoals raffinaderijen, geautomatiseerde pijpleidingsystemen en fabrieken met focus op energie-optimalisatie. Engineers werken er multidisciplinair samen aan concept-, basic- en detail engineering met 3D CAD-tools zoals SolidWorks en CAE-software zoals ANSYS, ondersteund door Autodesk Vault voor databeheer. In deze omgeving kun je je verdiepen in complexe mechanische vraagstukken en doorgroeien binnen uitdagende industriële projecten. Wat ga je doen? Specificeren van equipment, zoals tanks, pompen, koeltorens, warmtewisselaars en drukvaten; Opstellen van equipment lists, datasheets en technische specificaties; Opstellen van RFQ’s en benaderen van leveranciers ten behoeve van datasheets en offertes; Controleren van equipmenttekeningen van leveranciers; Opstellen van kostenramingen voor mechanische equipment en installaties; Controleren van offertes van leveranciers op technische inhoud en scope; Voorbereiden van en deelnemen aan FAT- en SAT-testen; Ontwerpen van complexe technische installaties en constructies; Uitvoeren van zelfstandig engineeringwerk voor mechanische systemen; Maken van concept-, basic- en detailontwerpen van machines en machineonderdelen; Opstellen van montagetekeningen, lasdetails en werkplaatstekeningen; Uitvoeren van sterkteberekeningen voor machineonderdelen, lassen en boutverbindingen; Selecteren van inkooponderdelen op basis van specificaties en ontwerpcriteria; Betrokken zijn bij de materiaalkeuze voor equipment en constructies. Wat neem je mee? Beschikken over een BSc of MSc in Mechanical Engineering of gelijkwaardig; Hebben van minstens 5 tot 10 jaar relevante werkervaring in de industrie; Beschikken over ervaring met werken in een multidisciplinaire projectomgeving; In staat zijn om prioriteiten te stellen en planningsmatig te werken; Communicatief vaardig zijn in het Engels; vaardigheid in de Nederlandse taal is een pre. Wat bieden we jou? Wij hanteren Gelijkwaardig Belonen. Dit betekent dat jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden als Dosign-professional volledig gelijkwaardig zijn aan die van een collega die rechtstreeks bij onze opdrachtgever in dienst is. Afhankelijk van de opdrachtgever en jouw profiel kun je rekenen op arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals:; Een passend salaris op basis van opleiding, ervaring en functie-inhoud; Verlofregelingen zoals vakantiedagen en ADV; Eventuele extra’s zoals een dertiende maand, bonus- of winstdelingsregeling; Een pensioenregeling en toegang tot collectieve verzekeringen; Opleidings- en ontwikkelbudgetten, inclusief trainingen via onze eigen Dosign Academy; Thuiswerkvergoeding, Overwerktoeslag en overige vergoedingen. Vragen over deze vacature? Heb je (technische) vragen over deze rol of wil je vrijblijvend sparren over de inhoud en de match met jouw expertise? Neem contact op met Nadine van Schie via +31686816336 of nadine.van.schie@dosign.com.

title: Design Engineer
description: Department:Engineering & Technologies Location: Navan As Engineering & Technologies Design Engineer, you will work as part of a multi-disciplinary engineering team to bring water and wastewater infrastructure projects from project brief stage to the detailed design stage and into Construction. You will lead a team of multi-disciplinary engineers and appointed consultants to successfully bring projects from concept to the implementation stage. You will lead in a one-team culture while actively contributing to your own skills and experience. Your role will be key in supporting the Framework Manager to achieve the transition of projects from design into the construction phase. Due to the nature of the works completed by Glanua you will have an opportunity to witness a wide variety of multi-disciplinary engineering activities and will have the opportunity to focus and develop, a specialised knowledge base and progress your career, with a wide variety of career paths available. In this Client facing role you will liaise directly with the Client and their representatives to develop engineered solutions fostering innovation and sustainability at their core. Main Duties and Responsibilities: The main duties and responsibilities of the Engineering & Technologies (E&T) Design Engineer are outlined as follows: Work as part of a team in the delivery of one or more projects at any one time, embracing the ethos of a “one team” culture. Ensure Health, Safety, Environmental & Sustainability standards, policies and procedures are developed into the proposed designs. Work closely and collaboratively with all key stakeholders including clients, client representatives and third-party agencies. Ensure a positive experience for the client and their representatives instilling an ethos of collaboration and cooperation. Lead the design team and any appointed consultants in all aspects of the design scope. Develop a design budget at outset and monitor expenditure going forward against budget. Represent the company at design review workshops and HAZOPs, ensuring all resulting actions are closed in a timely manner. Co-ordinate the role of PSDP for the design phase, ensuring best practice principles of prevention are adopted. Coordinate all designers and ensure all designs are risk assessed and any residual risks are communicated to the PSCS. Ensure best practice design management ensuring design programme is developed at the start of each project and monitored throughout, adjusting as necessary to meet the desired project outcomes. Monitor project performance including risk and opportunities. Mitigate/reduce risk where possible and manage opportunities. This strategic leadership role is responsible for building competitive, scalable, and high-performing treatment solutions across key process technologies. Essential requirements You should have: · A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related discipline. · Relevant mechanical design industrial experience. · Strong experience creating engineering drawings to BS 8888. · Good understanding of GD&T, tolerancing, fits, and manufacturing constraints. · Experience with complex CAD design and mechanical assemblies. · Experience using SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or similar CAD software. · Ability to communicate clearly with suppliers and manufacturing partners. · Good understanding of mechanical materials, manufacturing processes, and design for manufacture. · Strong attention to detail and ability to produce accurate engineering documentation. Desirable Experience · Experience in the automotive, aerospace, electric motor, powertrain, or advanced manufacturing sectors. · Structural FEA experience, preferably using ANSYS, Altair, or similar tools. · Thermal CFD experience, preferably using ANSYS, Altair, or similar tools. · Experience with rotating machinery, electric motors, cooling systems, or high-performance mechanical assemblies. · Experience supporting prototype builds, testing, and design validation. · Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related subject. · Experience working in a startup, R&D, or fast-paced engineering environment. What we are looking for The ideal candidate is a practical mechanical engineer who can take a design from concept through to detailed CAD, drawings, supplier discussions, and prototype manufacture. You should be comfortable working with complex designs, solving engineering problems, and producing clear documentation that suppliers can manufacture from. It is preferred to have good electric motor experience, you should be interested in advanced engineering, future mobility, and high-performance mechanical systems. Why join Cooled Motors? Exposure to automotive, aerospace, and advanced propulsion applications. A fast-moving engineering environment with significant responsibility from day one. The opportunity to work directly with founders and senior technical leadership. Location Cooled motors has multiple small offices and access to co-working spaces in the following locations Sheffield, Coventry, Oxford and London. We operate a hybrid working model and site work when essential. Vous serez en interface : Quotidiennement, avec les pilotes d’études, les responsables des outils de calcul et des méthodologies; avec les autres entités de l’Ingénierie Combustible et de Framatome ; avec les chefs de projet internes ; Régulièrement, avec les clients en France ou à l’étranger; Ponctuellement, avec les autorités de sûreté des pays concernés. Les missions proposées vous offrent l’opportunité de prendre part à des activités à forts enjeux techniques et présentant de nombreuses interfaces avec d’autres métiers (neutronique, mécanique, matériaux et thermohydraulique). Profil Venant d’une formation d’ingénieur en Mécanique ou Thermo-mécanique ou Docteur en Mécanique. Une première expérience (stage inclus) en réalisation de simulation numérique ou d'études de conception dans les secteurs de l’énergie, du transport serait un plus. Compétences techniques Analyse et modélisation de phénomènes physiques faisant intervenir des couplages Mécanique - Thermique ; Développement et maintenance des méthodes ainsi que des codes et outils de calculs scientifiques de type codes industriels et scripts de pré/post-traitements ; Informatique scientifique (environnement Unix/Linux ; Python…) ; Une connaissance du milieu nucléaire serait un atout pour les missions de ce poste. Compétences comportementales Dynamique, vous avez un goût prononcé et une curiosité pour la technique avec orientation résultats. Vous détenez des qualités de rigueur, d’autonomie et de synthèse. Avoir une aisance rédactionnelle et relationnelle ainsi qu’un esprit d’initiative sont également attendus pour réussir pleinement dans les activités d'interface et le travail en équipe. Evolution Selon votre niveau d’expérience et vos aspirations, les compétences acquises dans ce poste vous permettront d’évoluer au sein de l’ingénierie vers des activités de pilotage technique, vers des missions d’expertise, ou vers le management d’équipe. Vous aurez également la possibilité de poursuivre votre parcours de carrière dans d’autres disciplines techniques ou encore de vous orienter vers d’autres métiers de Framatome. Vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases ? Postulez quand même ! Nous croyons autant au potentiel et à la motivation qu’au parcours et aux expériences. Chaque candidature est étudiée avec attention. L’accueil et l’intégration de nos collaborateurs sont au cœur de nos priorités : un accompagnement structuré vous permettra de prendre progressivement en main vos missions et de trouver pleinement votre place au sein de nos équipes. Ce poste est peut-être fait pour vous. Alors osez vous lancer : cliquez, candidatez !

title: Engineering Director
description: About Us At Plexus, our vision is to help create the products that build a better world. By embracing an innovative culture of excellence, we pride ourselves on designing, manufacturing and servicing some of the world’s most transformative products. From life-saving medical technology and mission-critical defense solutions to sophisticated industrial automation, we’re proud to partner with our customers to bring their complex ideas to market. Visit Plexus.com to learn more about our unwavering commitment to our vision. Living Our Values With a vision rooted in the wellbeing and inclusive engagement of our team members, our customers, their end users and our communities, people are the heart of what we do and who we are. Our values unite and guide us in everything that we do. Our values include: Growing our People, Building Belonging, Innovating Responsibly, Delivering Excellence and Creating Customer Success. As part of our team, you’ll do impactful work within an inclusive environment where everyone works together to achieve extraordinary outcomes. You’ll be empowered to reach your full potential through managing your own personalised development plan and access to our learning and development programs. The Opportunity: Shape the Future of Advanced Manufacturing Are you an executive engineering leader ready to take full operational ownership of a world-class manufacturing facility? Plexus is evolving its Oradea facility into a fully connected, intelligent factory. As Engineering Director, you will serve as the executive authority across all primary technical disciplines—Test, Industrial, Process, Automation, and Product Engineering. This is not a maintenance role; it is a strategic mandate. You will bridge high-level corporate innovation with site-level execution, driving multi-million-dollar technology roadmaps, scaling automation, and setting the operational benchmark for regional manufacturing. How You Will Drive Impact Architect the Technology Roadmap: Own the end-to-end engineering strategy across five critical disciplines. Drive process capability, automate production workflows, and lead site-wide implementations for complex products. Define Operational Precision: Serve as the ultimate subject matter expert on standard work and process optimization. Deploy performance systems that lower cycle times, maximize efficiency, and safeguard product quality. Lead Regional Escalations & Resolution: Act as the primary technical authority for site engineering. Drive root-cause analyses and deploy systemic, scalable solutions across our global network. Build a High-Performance Engineering Legacy: Directly execute Plexus’ Best People strategy. Mentor high-potential managers, build robust succession pipelines, and champion a culture of continuous technical growth. The Profile We Are Looking For We are seeking a senior technical leader with a track record of driving change in complex, high-mix/low-volume manufacturing environments. Senior Leadership Experience: 10+ years in progressive engineering roles, with direct executive or director-level oversight in advanced EMS or high-tech manufacturing. Multi-Disciplinary Expertise: Proven ability to manage across Process, Test, Automation, and Industrial engineering teams simultaneously. High-Precision Standards: Hands-on leadership within strictly regulated sectors (Medical/FDA, Aerospace/AS9100, Telecom, or Automotive). Operational Mastery: Strong command of Lean Six Sigma methodologies (Black Belt certification highly valued) and structured problem-solving frameworks. Strategic Influence: Exceptional executive presence, capable of aligning internal stakeholders, global customers, and site operations around a shared vision. Why Take the Lead at Plexus Oradea? Executive Autonomy: Full ownership of engineering strategy and budget allocation at one of our key European facilities. Pioneering Transformation: Direct oversight of our transition toward Industry 4.0 and smart factory digitalization. Global Exposure: Direct interaction with leadership teams and tier-one customers worldwide. Your Rewards and Wellbeing We believe in rewarding your contribution with a comprehensive package designed to support your life both inside and outside of work. We value the unique perspectives you bring and review every candidate holistically, balancing professional experience, education and individual journey. description: About Surapack Surapack is an Istanbul-based manufacturer of paper cups, bowls and food packaging, exporting to 66 countries. Our group company Sura Machine supplies paper cup and packaging machinery worldwide. The Role We are looking for an experienced Machine Maintenance Technician to keep our paper cup and bowl production lines in Istanbul running at full speed. Work permit and visa assistance is provided for international candidates. Products You Will Work On • Single wall and double wall paper cups • Paper salad bowls (500 / 750 / 1000 / 1300 ml) • Soup and ice cream cups • Paper lids • Paper bags (V-bottom / square bottom) Machines • Chinese high-speed machines (Debao, Newtop etc.) • Korean machines (Woosung) • German machines (HORAUF SP/DC series) Responsibilities • Full mold changeover and machine setup • Precision mechanical timing and adjustment • Resolving bottom and side sealing leakage • Bottom knurling and curling tool overhaul • Replacing gears, arms and cams • Troubleshooting control panels and electrical wiring • Replacing sensors, heaters and motor inverters • PLC troubleshooting and error code reading • Ultrasonic sealing system setup • Maintenance of auxiliary equipment: flexo printing, paper slitting and rewinding, die punching, air compressors and pneumatics Requirements • Minimum 3 years of hands-on maintenance experience on paper cup / bowl machines • Both mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills • Experience with packing machines is a plus • Willing to relocate to Istanbul • Basic English We Offer • Work permit and visa assistance • 3-month trial period, then long-term employment • Competitive salary (USD) How to Apply Apply via LinkedIn. Shortlisted candidates will receive our Technical Pre-Screening Form and will be asked for a 1-minute video of themselves adjusting or changing molds on a paper cup machine.

title: Division Manager, Manufacturing Excellence (MENA)
description: WHY YOU BELONG HERE: At Victoria’s Secret & Co, you’ll join a world-leading specialty retail brand recognized globally for innovation and excellence in lingerie and fashion. You’ll work alongside industry leaders to set the standard for what a retail brand can achieve, placing customers at the center of everything we do to create products and experiences that bring them joy. We believe everyone deserves a place where they truly belong. We celebrate individuality and know that your passion, experience, and unique perspective strengthen our team and business. Here, you’ll be empowered to perform, grow, and engage through unmatched opportunities to develop your skills, gain real-world experience, and learn from the best in the business. RESPONSIBILITIES: Vendor Capability Development & Process Optimization Drive the deployment and continuous evolution of the VS&Co. ME framework across the vendor network, covering production layouts, machinery, workflows, and operating standards. Develop and execute structured capability development roadmaps to improve vendor performance, flexibility, and long-term scalability. Develop and execute KPI-driven efficiency roadmaps (e.g., productivity, OEE, quality, throughput) to deliver measurable and sustainable performance gains. Partner with cross-functional teams to support vendor expansion strategies, including onboarding new vendors and scaling existing partners. Manufacturing Automation & Digitalization Drive manufacturing innovation initiatives in alignment with ME strategy, supporting the adoption of advanced technologies and future-ready capabilities. Collaborate with technology partners to implement scalable, ROI-driven automation and process improvements. Support the implementation of Industry 4.0 and digital manufacturing tools to enhance visibility, data-driven decision-making, and operational efficiency. REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering or related field. 12+ years of experience in lingerie/apparel manufacturing. Proven track record of driving manufacturing excellence initiatives, including lean manufacturing, process optimization, and efficiency improvement programs. Experience in project and stakeholder management, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and external partners to deliver results. Strong execution capability with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and drive measurable outcomes in complex environments. Effective communication and influencing skills, with the ability to collaborate across cultures and organizational levels. Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and performance improvements. Familiarity with digital manufacturing, automation, or Industry 4.0 tools is an advantage. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including advanced Excel functions and PowerPoint. Willingness to travel extensively across the MENA region.
