title: Atölye Servis Teknisyeni
description: Rolünüz Merakınızı işinize taşıyın ve Atlas Copco Endüstriyel Teknik İş Alanı'nda Atölye Servis Teknisyeni olarak ekibimize katılın! Bu pozisyonda, Atölye Servis Ekibi'nin bir parçası olacak ve Servis Kalite Güvence ve Atölye Müdürü'ne raporlayacaksınız. Temel sorumluluğunuz, atölye ortamında ürünlerimizin bakım, kalibrasyon, arıza tespiti ve onarım süreçlerini kalite standartlarımız doğrultusunda yürütmek ve servis operasyonlarımızın verimli, güvenilir ve etkin bir şekilde gerçekleştirilmesine katkı sağlamak olacaktır. Teknik uzmanlığınız ve çözüm odaklı yaklaşımınızla müşterilerimize sunduğumuz hizmetlerin kalitesini ve müşteri memnuniyetini artırmada önemli bir rol üstleneceksiniz. Bu Rolde Sizi Neler Bekliyor? Şirket servis prosedürleri ve kalite standartları doğrultusunda ürünlerin arıza tespit, bakım, onarım ve kalibrasyon işlemlerini gerçekleştirmek, Dijital platformlar üzerinden ürün güncellemelerini ve teknik gelişmeleri takip ederek servis süreçlerine uygulamak, Tekrarlayan arızalara yönelik kök neden analizleri gerçekleştirerek iyileştirme fırsatlarını belirlemek ve ilgili birimlerle paylaşmak, Gerçekleştirilen bakım, onarım ve servis faaliyetlerini şirketin dijital sistemlerine eksiksiz ve doğru şekilde kaydetmek, gerekli raporlamaları zamanında tamamlamak, Servis yazılımlarını, mobil uygulamaları ve CRM sistemlerini etkin şekilde kullanarak operasyonel süreçlerin verimliliğine katkı sağlamak, İhtiyaç doğrultusunda saha servis ekibine destek vermek, ürün kurulumlarını gerçekleştirerek sistemlerin sorunsuz ve çalışır durumda müşteriye teslim edilmesini sağlamak, Müşteri bakım ekipleri ve saha servis ekibiyle yakın iş birliği içerisinde çalışarak teknik sorunlara çözüm üretmek ve müşteri memnuniyetini desteklemek, Servis faaliyetlerinde işçilik ve yedek parça maliyetlerini gözeterek operasyonel verimliliğe ve servis sözleşmelerinin kârlılığına katkıda bulunmak, Kullanılan ölçüm cihazları, el aletleri ve teknik ekipmanların doğru kullanımını, bakımını, kalibrasyonunu ve uygun koşullarda muhafazasını sağlamak, Teknik bilgi ve deneyimlerini ekip arkadaşlarıyla paylaşmak, gerekli eğitim ve sertifikasyon süreçlerini tamamlamak ve tüm faaliyetlerini iş sağlığı ve güvenliği (İSG), 5S, ESD, kalite standartları ve şirket değerleri doğrultusunda yürütmek. Yetkinlikleriniz ve Deneyimleriniz Teknik Lise, Meslek Yüksekokulu veya Üniversitelerin Makine, Mekatronik, Elektrik, Elektrik-Elektronik veya ilgili teknik bölümlerinden mezun, Endüstriyel ekipmanların bakım, onarım, arıza giderme, kalibrasyon veya teknik servis süreçlerinde tercihen en az 2 yıl deneyimli, Mekanik, pnömatik, elektrik ve elektronik sistemler hakkında teknik bilgi sahibi, Teknik çizimleri, servis dokümanlarını ve bakım prosedürlerini okuyup yorumlayabilen, Teknik arızaları analiz edebilen, kök nedenleri belirleyerek kalıcı çözümler ve süreç iyileştirme önerileri geliştirebilen, Ölçüm cihazları, el aletleri ve teknik ekipmanların kullanımı konusunda bilgi ve deneyim sahibi, Üretim prosesleri, bakım uygulamaları ve kalite standartları hakkında bilgi sahibi, MS Office uygulamalarını etkin şekilde kullanabilen, tercihen dijital servis araçları, CRM sistemleri ve mobil uygulamalar konusunda deneyimli, Tercihen teknik dokümanları ve servis kılavuzlarını takip edebilecek düzeyde İngilizce bilgisine sahip, İş Sağlığı ve Güvenliği kurallarına uygun, güvenli ve düzenli çalışma anlayışını benimseyen, Analitik düşünme, problem çözme ve sürekli iyileştirme becerileri gelişmiş, Müşteri odaklı, iletişim becerileri güçlü ve farklı ekiplerle iş birliği içerisinde çalışabilen, Yeni teknolojileri ve teknik gelişmeleri öğrenmeye açık, bilgi ve deneyimlerini ekip arkadaşlarıyla paylaşmaya istekli, Sonuç odaklı, dikkatli, disiplinli ve sorumluluk bilinci yüksek. Tüm gereklilikleri birebir karşılamıyor olsanız bile başvurmanızı teşvik ediyoruz. Farklı deneyimlerin ve bakış açılarının yarattığı değere inanıyor, bu rolde ekibimize katacağınız katkıları görmek için heyecan duyuyoruz. Lokasyon Bu pozisyon, İstanbul Tuzla'daki ofisimizde yerinde çalışmayı gerektirmektedir. Dinamik bir ekibin parçası olarak yüz yüze iş birliğinin ve birlikte çalışmanın sunduğu fırsatlardan yararlanacaksınız. Neden Bizimle Çalışmalısınız? Kariyeriniz; yetkinlikleriniz, merakınız ve birlikte çalıştığınız insanlarla gelişir. Birbirimizden öğrendiğimiz ve bilgimizi açıkça paylaştığımız küresel bir çalışma ağının parçası olursunuz. Uzun vadeli gelişime odaklanıyor, bizi ileriye taşıyacak yeni fikirleri keşfetmenizi teşvik ediyoruz. İnovasyon, düşünme ve çalışma biçimimizin ayrılmaz bir parçasıdır. Deneyerek, geliştirerek ve öğrendiklerimizi hayata geçirerek değer yaratan çözümler üretiriz. Bilgi birikiminiz ve fikirlerinizle katkı sağlayarak, çalışmalarınızın sorumluluğunu üstlenerek anlamlı bir etki yaratabilirsiniz. Esnek çalışma yaklaşımlarımız ve çalışanlarını güçlendiren liderlerimizle bu yolculukta gelişiminizi destekliyoruz. Başvuru Süreci İşe alım sürecimiz, adaylarımızı daha yakından tanımamıza olanak sağlayan mülakatları ve bazı pozisyonlar için yetkinlik değerlendirmelerini içermektedir. Sizi tanımayı, güçlü yönlerinizi keşfetmeyi ve bizimle birlikte nasıl gelişebileceğinizi konuşmayı sabırsızlıkla bekliyoruz.

title: Production Planning and Tracking Specialist
description: We are looking for a Production Planning and Tracking Specialist for our client in the Energy(Electric), for whom we provide consulting services. Qualifications A degree in a relevant technical field, such as Industrial Engineering or Mechanical Engineering, Ability to read technical drawings and interpret the fundamental technical specifications of products, Proficiency in MS Excel including the use of formulas, pivot tables, and basic data analysis, Willingness to actively monitor the production floor and conduct site visits to outsourced (subcontracted) suppliers when necessary, Strong skills in planning, organization, task tracking, and prioritization, Excellent communication and coordination skills; ability to work effectively with various internal teams and external suppliers, A flexible, patient, and solution-oriented approach to shifting customer demands and priorities while managing multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously, A disciplined work ethic characterized by attention to detail, a commitment to data accuracy, and a focus on seeing tasks through to completion. Job Description Production Planning and Capacity Management Prepare and update daily, weekly, and monthly production plans based on customer orders, project priorities, and target delivery dates by taking into account product technical specifications, production routings, operation durations, and labour requirements in coordination with relevant departments. Evaluate existing capacity across production units, work centres, and machines; compare workload against available capacity. Identify bottlenecks, overloads, and idle capacity within the production system, and develop proposals for improvements or alternative planning strategies. Monitor capacity utilization and plan adherence by comparing planned production against actual output. Operational Tracking of In-House Production Track open work orders, work-in-progress, and completed production on the shop floor on a daily basis. Verify the physical status, quantity, and location of finished products, as well as their readiness for subsequent operations or shipment. Ensure that data regarding completed production is accurately and promptly recorded in SAP or the relevant tracking systems. Analyse planned versus actual production quantities, the completion status of operations, and any deviations from scheduled deadlines on a daily basis. Identify production delays, backlogs, material shortages, and capacity constraints, and coordinate resolution actions with the relevant departments. Monitor the workflow across production, quality control, packaging, and shipment to ensure the timely transfer of finished products to subsequent stages. Subcontracted Production Planning and Monitoring Track production orders placed with subcontractors, including quantities, technical requirements, and target delivery dates. Monitor the progress of subcontracted production through phone calls, emails, and, when necessary, on-site visits. Regularly evaluate the current workloads, production capacities, and committed deadlines of subcontractors. Coordinate with relevant internal teams to ensure that subcontracted production aligns with the company’s internal production and shipment schedules. Verify—or coordinate the verification of—finished products from subcontractors, ensuring they meet quantity requirements, technical specifications (drawings), and physical completion standards in accordance with established quality procedures. Report on subcontractor performance, including on-time delivery, delays, open orders, and production progress. Daily Reporting and Performance Tracking Prepare and distribute daily production tracking reports covering both in-house and subcontracted production status regarding open work orders, delayed orders, completed products, and jobs at risk of missing their deadlines. Ensure related files remain up-to-date and accurate. Report on planned versus actual production quantities, workloads, and capacity utilization rates for each unit and identify the causes of significant deviations. Prepare summary reports for management and relevant departments covering production performance, capacity status, bottlenecks, and critical action items. Coordination and Continuous Improvement Evaluate the impact of changes in customer demands or project priorities on production capacity and delivery dates, and inform the relevant departments accordingly. Identify gaps in production planning and tracking, and contribute to the standardization and improvement of these processes. Implement initiatives to enhance the accuracy of production data, reduce the need for manual tracking, and streamline reporting. title: Data Platform Engineer (Mid-level)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Platform Engineer (Mid-level) based in Turkey. In this role, you will help transform an established data and machine learning platform into a scalable, self-service environment that empowers engineering teams to work independently. You will build and improve deployment pipelines, infrastructure-as-code modules, and reusable tooling that makes data services easier to launch, manage, and maintain. Working across data engineering, backend development, and infrastructure, you will contribute to reliable systems that support a global shipping and fulfillment platform. You will join an experienced Data & AI team with established engineering standards, giving you a solid foundation to make a tangible impact from your first weeks. The position offers increasing ownership, with the opportunity to lead the roadmap for shared platform tooling within your first six months. You will also work in an AI-enabled engineering culture that values technical judgment, accountability, and the ability to explain and validate the code you deliver. Accountabilities Improve CI/CD pipelines: Analyze existing deployment pipelines, determine the requirements of new tasks, and adapt established workflows to support reliable, repeatable software delivery. Develop infrastructure-as-code: Extend and maintain infrastructure modules in line with existing repository patterns, ensuring consistency, reliability, and maintainability across services. Apply data governance standards: Implement naming conventions, access controls, retention policies, and other governance requirements for new data services and infrastructure. Build self-service platform tooling: Develop and maintain a reusable template repository with preconfigured CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and governance standards so engineering teams can launch new pipelines with minimal manual intervention. Create reusable modules: Build tools and modules that simplify pipeline creation and reduce repetitive engineering work, making common platform tasks accessible through standardized workflows. Improve technical documentation: Write practical documentation, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides that help engineers understand and operate systems independently without relying on individual team members. Own data access workflows: Design and manage access-request processes for data resources, reducing bottlenecks and enabling teams to obtain the permissions they need efficiently. Take ownership of platform tooling: Progress toward full responsibility for the template repository and infrastructure modules, including technical direction, prioritization, maintenance, and roadmap decisions. Collaborate across engineering disciplines: Work with data engineers, backend engineers, and infrastructure specialists to improve platform reliability and make shared tools useful across teams. Use AI tools responsibly: Incorporate AI-assisted development tools into everyday workflows while validating generated code, identifying potential errors, and explaining the reasoning behind technical decisions. Requirements Deployment ownership: Demonstrated experience independently owning a deployment path end to end, including building a pipeline, troubleshooting failures, resolving production issues, and documenting the solution in a runbook. Professional experience: Approximately two years or more of professional experience in software, data, platform, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering. Technical education: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Python and SQL: Practical working knowledge of both languages and the ability to use them regularly in professional engineering tasks. CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code: Experience working with deployment pipelines and infrastructure-as-code practices, with the ability to understand, adapt, and improve existing implementations. Code analysis and troubleshooting: Ability to navigate an unfamiliar codebase, explain how it works, identify potential failure points, and make sound technical judgments. Containers and cloud: Experience with Docker and familiarity with cloud computing concepts, particularly AWS. Previous experience with specific services such as SageMaker is not required. Cross-functional technical skills: Willingness and ability to work across data engineering, backend systems, and infrastructure rather than focusing exclusively on one area. AI-assisted development: Comfortable using AI coding assistants such as Copilot, Claude, or Cursor. You must be able to review generated code critically, explain why it is correct, and recognize when it is inaccurate or unsafe. Ownership and accountability: A proactive mindset, willingness to take responsibility for systems you modify, and honesty about failures, root causes, and lessons learned. Respect for established patterns: Ability to understand existing architecture and engineering conventions before deciding what should change. Communication and reasoning: Comfortable explaining technical decisions, defending implementation choices, and being evaluated on reasoning as well as delivery. Learning mindset: Motivated to develop new skills and explore unfamiliar tools. Prior experience with every technology or the specific business domain is not required. Benefits Competitive salary: Annual compensation ranging from €33,000 to €43,000, determined through an objective salary assessment process. Remote flexibility: Work remotely from anywhere worldwide, with company-funded trips to headquarters for team meetups. Meal vouchers: Meal vouchers available to remote and office-based employees. Mental health and fitness support: Benefits designed to support physical and mental well-being. Learning and development: An annual learning budget to support professional growth and technical development. AI tools: Access to AI-powered tools for everyday engine

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Ben je een medior Mechanical Engineer die toe is aan meer verantwoordelijkheid of een senior mechanical engineer die technisch betrokken wil blijven zonder volledig uit het ontwerpwerk te verdwijnen? Bij Woltman heb je daadwerkelijk invloed op hoe de engineering gaat werken. Jouw werkweek: Als ervaren Mechanical Design Engineer bij Woltman heb je een belangrijke sleutelpositie in het ontwerp en de verdere ontwikkeling van zware mobiele hei- en funderingsmachines en subsystemen. Met werktuigbouw en hydrauliek als jouw domein en elektrische besturing als belangrijk raakvlak, vertaal je technische vraagstukken naar maakbare en servicevriendelijke oplossingen. Dat doe je door nauw samen te werken met je collega’s van productie en service in de werkplaats. Woltman is in ontwikkeling. Je draagt bij aan ontwerpmethoden, de verdere standaardisatie en verbetering van modulaire varianten in het Woltman-machineprogramma. Je stapt dus niet in een omgeving waar alles al jarenlang vastligt. Juist jouw technische inzicht en initiatief zijn welkom. Naarmate je de machines en de organisatie beter kent, krijg je meer verantwoording. Zo: ontwerp en ontwikkel je Woltman machines en onderdelen in 3D; help je minder ervaren collega engineers op design vlak naar een hoger niveau; stuur je externe ingenieursbureaus inhoudelijk aan en controleer je uitbesteed werk; voer je basisberekeningen uit op het gebied van sterkte, stijfheid en stabiliteit; communiceer je regelmatig met onze vaste partner voor electrical & controls. Wat jullie met elkaar in 3D ontwerpen, zie je later terug op de werkvloer als compleet werkende machine van tientallen tonnen staal! Wat je krijgt: Je komt terecht in een organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is. De overstap naar Inventor is gestart, er wordt een nieuw ERP-systeem geselecteerd en engineering wordt verder geprofessionaliseerd. Daardoor heb je daadwerkelijk invloed op hoe er straks gewerkt wordt. Daarnaast krijg je: Salaris € 4500 - € 5500 , passend bij je kennis en ervaring; Een werkweek van 37,5 uur met op vrijdag om 13:45 weekend; 32 uur is bespreekbaar en thuiswerkmogelijkheden na de inwerkperiode; Cao metaal & techniek volgend; Ruimte om mee te bouwen aan internationale groei; Persoonlijke ontwikkelmogelijkheden (bijv. leiderschap of verbredend richting electrical & controls). Je herkent je hierin: Je krijgt een technisch vraagstuk, verzamelt zelf de informatie die je nodig hebt en gaat ermee aan de slag. Belangrijk is dat je technisch stevig genoeg staat om zelfstandig te werken, verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en de samenwerking te stimuleren. Verder: minimaal HBO werk- en denkniveau, studierichting Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar; minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Mechanical Engineer, Constructeur of vergelijkbaar; naast werktuigbouwkundig, sterk onderlegd op het gebied van hydrauliek en aandrijfsystemen; basiskennis van technische berekeningen, zowel handmatig als statische Finite Element Analysis (FEA); een goede beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Het zijn geen vereisten , maar je scoort pluspunten als je: ervaring met Autodesk Inventor (3D CAD) en Vault hebt; je verder wilt verdiepen in elektrische besturingstechniek / elektrificatie. Over Woltman Piling & Drilling Rigs: Woltman is specialist in het ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van klant specifieke hei- en funderingsmachines en onderdeel van Hylkema Funderingstechniek. Zij leveren wereldwijd en tellen 35 collega's, waarvan 3 op de engineeringsafdeling. Met een aangrenzende werkplaats, komt alles hier samen: van ontwerp tot assemblage en testen. Je werkt in een compacte, nuchtere organisatie waar functionaliteit, maakbaarheid en servicegerichtheid leidend zijn. Is dit echt iets voor jou? Solliciteer dan direct! Woltman werkt voor de invulling van deze vacature exclusief samen met Mijn Prolinq. Wil je meer weten? Neem contact op met Leendert Romijn via 06-13971295 of stuur je cv naar leendert@mijnprolinq.nl.

title: Lead Mechanical Engineer Industrie regio Rotterdam
description: Over de vacature Ontwerp en schaal als Mechanical Engineer / Process Engineer elektrochemische high-temperature installaties op voor duurzame materiaalproductie. Je vertaalt innovatieve molten salt-procesconcepten (400–700 °C) naar robuuste, veilige en schaalbare mechanische ontwerpen, van concept tot commissioning. Je werkt aan pilot- en demonstratiesystemen binnen een klein multidisciplinair kernteam op het Innovation Dock in Rotterdam, met directe impact op de energietransitie en de opschaling van nieuwe technologie. Je gaat aan de slag bij een technologiebedrijf in de energietransitie dat elektrochemische molten salt-technologieën ontwikkelt voor de productie van hoogwaardige koolstofmaterialen en andere duurzame grondstoffen. Hier worden Laboratoriumconcepten opgeschaald naar pilot- en demonstratiesystemen, waarbij hoge temperaturen (400–700 °C), elektrochemie en geavanceerde procestechnologie samenkomen. De organisatie werkt met elektrochemische reactoren, molten salt loops, leidingsystemen, skids en drukapparatuur, ontworpen met 3D CAD-tools zoals Inventor en SolidWorks. Engineering vindt plaats volgens onder andere PED, EN13445 en ASME, met gebruik van P&ID’s, equipment datasheets en gestructureerde technische documentatie. Je werkt in een klein, multidisciplinair kernteam waarin Process, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation en Automation Engineers intensief samenwerken aan ontwerp, testen, HAZOP en opschaling naar industriële toepassing, in een hybride werkomgeving met directe invloed op beslissingen en ontwerpkeuzes. Wat ga je doen? Ontwerpen en dimensioneren van mechanische systemen zoals reactoren, molten salt loops, leidingsystemen, vaten en skids; Uitvoeren van concept engineering en basic engineering voor installaties voor duurzame grondstoffenproductie; Bepalen van lay-out en opstelling van equipment binnen pilot- en demonstratiesystemen; Selecteren van materialen voor hoge temperatuur en corrosieve molten salts en media; Opstellen van equipment datasheets en technische specificaties voor mechanische componenten; Opstellen en reviewen van 3D-modellen in 3D CAD en verzorgen van P&ID-input; Schrijven, structureren en reviewen van technische documentatie voor mechanisch ontwerp; Afstemmen van technische specificaties en ontwerpen met leveranciers en EPC-contractor tijdens detailed engineering; Ondersteunen van procurement bij technische keuzes voor equipment en componenten; Begeleiden en ondersteunen van fabricage van mechanische systemen en skids; Ondersteunen en beoordelen van FAT- en SAT-tests voor mechanische equipment; Ondersteunen van commissioning van high-temperature systemen en elektrochemische installaties; Samenwerken met Process, Electrical, Instrumentation en Automation Engineers binnen multidisciplinaire projecten; Bijdragen aan HAZOP-sessies en ontwerp-reviews om veiligheid en betrouwbaarheid te borgen; Overdragen van mechanisch ontwerp en relevante documentatie naar de EPC-partner voor realisatie. Wat neem je mee? HBO of WO Werktuigbouwkunde of gelijkwaardig; 8 jaar ervaring in equipment design, plant engineering of high-temperature systemen of gelijkwaardig; Ervaring met concept engineering en basic engineering en samenwerking met leveranciers of EPC’s; Vaardigheid met 3D CAD-software zoals Inventor, SolidWorks of vergelijkbaar; Kennis van PED, EN13445, ASME of vergelijkbare drukvaten- en equipmentnormen is een pré; Affiniteit met thermische processen, elektrochemie of de procesindustrie; Praktische instelling, in staat om zelfstandig te werken en helder te communiceren; Goede beheersing van de Engelse taal; beheersing van Nederlands is een pré. Wat bieden we jou? Wij hanteren Gelijkwaardig Belonen. Dit betekent dat jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden als Dosign-professional volledig gelijkwaardig zijn aan die van een collega die rechtstreeks bij onze opdrachtgever in dienst is. Afhankelijk van de opdrachtgever en jouw profiel kun je rekenen op arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals:; Een passend salaris op basis van opleiding, ervaring en functie-inhoud; Verlofregelingen zoals vakantiedagen en ADV; Eventuele extra’s zoals een dertiende maand, bonus- of winstdelingsregeling; Een pensioenregeling en toegang tot collectieve verzekeringen; Opleidings- en ontwikkelbudgetten, inclusief trainingen via onze eigen Dosign Academy; Thuiswerkvergoeding, Overwerktoeslag en overige vergoedingen. Vragen over deze vacature? Heb je (technische) vragen over deze rol of wil je vrijblijvend sparren over de inhoud en de match met jouw expertise? Neem contact op met Merlijn van Hinthem via +31659853110 of merlijn.van.hinthem@dosign.com.

title: Principal R&D Engineer - PVH
description: Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. A Day in the Life The Peripheral Vascular Health (PVH) operating unit partners with clinicians to treat peripheral arterial and venous disease—helping people return to fuller lives by saving limbs, reducing pain and swelling, and restoring healthy blood flow. As a Principal R&D Engineer in Galway, Ireland, you will develop and execute multi-disciplinary models to assess design risk and ensure device and system reliability, safety, and performance. You will build fundamental understanding and provide insights for design decisions by building robust performance predictions. This is a very exciting time for this organization as we focus on expanding our product portfolio to treat more patients. If you want a challenging, energizing, and rewarding career that changes lives, join us and help bring life changing medical technology to patients worldwide! Come for a job, stay for a career! In general, the following responsibilities apply to a Principal R&D Modelling & Simulation Engineer. This includes, but is not limited to the following: Collaborate with cross functional team to execute a modelling and simulation strategy for design optimization and reliability evaluation of peripheral vascular devices Develop predictive engineering tools, techniques, and approaches to support the product development process Execute modelling & simulation studies to assess stress/strain magnitudes and distributions in implant components Virtual design and prototyping of new implants, delivery systems, or single-use devices used for peripheral intervention. Using expertise in non-linear finite element software tools to incorporate large deformation, complex multibody contact, dynamic impact, modal analysis and multiaxial cyclic fatigue failure modes Interpretation of complex in-vivo loading modes derived from patient imaging and mathematical conversion to Finite Element Analysis boundary conditions. Research into realistic device-anatomy interaction simulations including reconstruction of patient anatomies into meshed FEA models Application of CFD or FSI software tools to predict flow conditions related to peripheral vascular interventions Key Skills & Experience The Successful Candidate will have : Strong technical aptitude with a deep understanding of the finite element method, and its application using commercially available software packages, and a strong understanding of fundamental engineering principles in mechanics and/or CFD and FSI. Experience in the application of the principles of fatigue analysis for metals including superelastic and shape memory alloys. Simulation of highly deformed metals, polymers, fabrics, biological tissue and pulsatile flow conditions Demonstrated proactive creation of novel algorithms and scripts to automate post-process finite element output databases Exposure to the development of novel model validation experiments and analogous finite element modelling, and development of material testing protocols to calibrate constitutive models, as well as FEA model validation. Development of hydrodynamic testing protocols (e.g. PIV) to facilitate validation of CFD and/or FSI models The candidate shall be familiar with the application of the principles of ASME VVUQ10, 20 & 40 to drive model credibility. Has prepared detailed modelling and simulation engineering reports to support product design characterization and verification, for example in direct support of new product regulatory submissions Qualifications MUST HAVE - MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS: TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE, PLEASE BE SURE THE MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS ARE EVIDENT ON YOUR RESUME Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Engineering Mechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Physics or related technical discipline. Minimum of 7 years of industry experience, or a Master’s degree with 5 years of technical experience, or a PhD with 3 years relevant experience. Nice to Have Significant experience using Abaqus, LS-DYNA or similar FEA software. Extensive experience meshing complex 3D structures. Experience with CAD software. Knowledge of engineering mechanics, mechanical design, material processing, fatigue analysis, metallurgy and strength of materials. Knowledge and experience with application of technical principles, theories, and design concepts in implantable product design including product, process, and technology development and evaluation. Knowledge of risk management analysis including Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and statistical techniques relevant for design and test for reliability. title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Mechanical Project Engineer Turning design intent into buildable, coordinated and well-documented mechanical installations. Role Overview The Mechanical Project Engineer manages mechanical systems design coordination and on-site execution for Sensori's mechanical installations. The role translates design intent into installation-ready solutions, leads BIM coordination for the mechanical scope, manages stakeholder interfaces and technical queries, and holds cost and resource responsibility for the package. It requires an engineer who can move comfortably between model coordination, procurement support and daily site leadership to deliver safely from mobilisation through handover. This position comes with a potential opportunity to support projects within Ireland. Principal Duties And Responsibilities Manage all mechanical systems within the package, ensuring design, procurement and installation align with project requirements. Liaise with client design teams, main contractors, suppliers and subcontractors to resolve technical issues and maintain delivery momentum. Review IFC drawings and specifications to understand scope fully; drive the coordination process so BIM outputs become installation-ready drawings, fabrication details and isometrics. Raise, track and close requests for information and technical queries to remove blockers and protect the programme. Work with the Project Manager and EHS lead to establish, maintain and close the project safety file and ensure safe working practices on site. Set up and maintain site QA records with the QA lead and ensure installations meet the project QA plan. Coordinate engineering activity with the Project Manager, consulting engineers and client milestones to prevent engineering delay affecting the critical path. Manage cost and resource elements for the package, including Sensori mechanical teams, subcontractors, materials, plant, variations and valuations; issue weekly cost reports. Oversee daily site operations, resolve technical issues and ensure efficient use of labour and plant; ensure Sensori policies are flowed down to suppliers and subcontractors. Track subcontractor progress and manpower; hold minuted weekly coordination meetings; operate the in-progress snagging system. Produce internal and external weekly progress reports (percent complete by WBS, risks, KPIs); manage material take-offs and the engineering materials report; schedule deliveries to match the programme. Prepare subcontract and supplier tender packages with the quantity surveyor and assess returns for technical compliance. Evaluate and promote engineering practices that shorten delivery, improve quality or reduce cost; mentor junior engineers. Deliver final account, O&M manuals, punch lists, safety and QA files and final documentation; maintain a weekly photographic diary. Selection criteria / person specification Trade qualification or third-level degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. At least five years with recognised MEP or mechanical contractors, consultancies or in-house delivery teams on construction or installation projects. Strong knowledge of HVAC, piping, enclosures, mounting systems and mechanical installation best practice. Competent with Revit, AutoCAD or equivalent and able to produce fabrication details and isometrics. Familiar with planning software (Primavera, MS Project or equivalent) and project reporting systems. Experience with cost control, variations and valuations. Solid understanding of quality, health, safety and environmental requirements on site. Excellent negotiation, problem-solving and decision-making skills; able to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage workload to deadlines

description: Vil du bruge din tekniske viden til at forbedre processer og teknologier i en international organisation – og spille en nøglerolle i driften af produktionslinjer, der leverer dele til Grundfos' verdenskendte pumper? Vær med i vores mission om at udvikle smartere vandløsninger, der reducerer energiforbrug og forbedrer liv. Som vores nye Manufacturing Engineer, kommer du til at sikre optimale produktionstekniske løsninger og drive forbedringsprojekter, der optimerer oppetid og produktionsflow på vores CR-pumpefabrik i Bjerringbro – et fyrtårn for Industri 4.0. Du bliver en del af en mangfoldig, støttende og inkluderende kultur, der fejrer vores forskelle og sætter mennesker først ved at fremme vækst, trivsel og en følelse af tilhørsforhold. Hvad du kommer til at lave Som en central del af Manufacturing Engineering-teamet skaber du impact ved at drive produktionsoptimeringer, implementere nye teknologier og forme fremtidens fabrik gennem pilotprojekter. Dine primære ansvarsområder omfatter: Sikre optimale produktionstekniske løsninger og yde teknisk support til den daglige drift Drive forbedringsprojekter med fokus på oppetid og produktionsflow Ansvar for investeringer og hjemtagning af nyt udstyr Deltage i NPI-projekter (New Product Introduction) og implementering af nye teknologier Analysere data og identificere muligheder for optimering Bidrage til udviklingen af fremtidens fabrik gennem Industri 4.0-pilotprojekter Hvad gør dig til det rette match Frem for alt er du en hands-on tekniker med naturligt drive, der ikke er bange for at tage sikkerhedsskoene på, og som skaber følgeskab og resultater gennem stærkt samarbejde på tværs af organisationen. Vi forestiller os også, at du er eller har: Teknisk uddannelse som maskiningeniør, produktionsingeniør, maskinmester eller lignende Gode kommunikationsevner på dansk og engelsk Kendskab til problemløsningsværktøjer og gerne LEAN-redskaber Evne til at arbejde hands-on i produktionen og samarbejde på tværs Det er en fordel, hvis du også har: Håndværksmæssig baggrund som supplement til din tekniske uddannelse Erfaring fra en lignende rolle i produktion (nyuddannede er også velkomne) Erfaring med SAP Erfaring med projektledelse Derfor vil du elske at arbejde her I hverdagen kan du se frem til: Et arbejdsmiljø bygget op omkring dine behov, med fleksible arbejdstider, mulighed for hjemmearbejde og forældrestøtte. Årlig bonus, sundhedsforsikring og et stærkt fokus på trivsel. Tre ekstra betalte fridage til frivilligt arbejde. On-demand træning og strukturerede udviklingsprogrammer via Grundfos Academy. At værdsætte vores forskelle hjælper os med at se muligheder, hvor andre ikke kan. Vi byder derfor velkommen til og opfordrer ansøgninger fra alle evner, erfaringer og baggrunde. Som en del af vores forpligtelse til en sikker og compliant ansættelsesproces kan endelige kandidater blive bedt om at gennemgå et baggrundstjek i overensstemmelse med gældende lokal lovgivning. Bliv en del af Grundfos – ansøg i dag!

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Roller og ansvar LEGOLAND® søger smed/mekaniker til værkstedet Vi søger en fagligt stærk og ansvarsbevidst smed/mekaniker til Teknisk Drift med fokus på drift, vedligeholdelse og udvikling af parkens mekaniske anlæg. Har du solid teknisk forståelse? Arbejder du struktureret og sætter sikkerhed først i alle opgaver, og trives du i et team, hvor samarbejde og ansvar går hånd i hånd? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter til værkstedet i LEGOLAND®. Som smed/mekaniker i Teknisk Drift bliver du en del af et velfungerende team på 14 medarbejdere med høj faglighed og stærkt sammenhold. Her arbejder du med drift og vedligeholdelse af parkens kørende aktiviteter, mekaniske animationer og øvrigt mekanisk udstyr. Dine Ansvarsområder Er Dagligt tilsyn for at sikre aktiviteternes sikkerhed og drift Ansvar for opretholdelse og samarbejde omkring alle gældende procedurer Renovering, fejlfinding, reparationer samt vedligehold af aktiviteter og automatiske anlæg Udføre smede- og svejseopgaver i forskellige materialer Opbygning, service og vedligeholdelse af mekanik, hydraulik og pneumatik på parkens anlæg Ansvar og deltagelse ved driftsstop og eventuelle evakueringer Optimering og udvikling af eksisterende og nye anlæg Servicere og deltage ved opgaver på tværs af afdelingerne i parken Om vinteren vil opgaverne primært fordele sig på vedligehold og klargøring til næste sæson samt optimering og udvikling af eksisterende og nye anlæg. Senior Manager Dennis Lauridsen fortæller om jobbet: ”Rutsjebanerne er en kæmpe del af oplevelsen i LEGOLAND. Som smed/mekaniker kommer du til at sikre fantastiske oplevelser til parkens mange gæster sammen med resten af teamet af dygtige og dedikerede elektrikere, smede, mekanikere og teknikere”. Kvalifikationer og erfaring Vi søger dig, der har en uddannelse som smed, mekaniker eller anden relevant baggrund og gerne nogle års erfaring fra en reparations- og vedligeholdsafdeling. For at lykkes i jobbet forestiller vi os, at du: Sætter sikkerhed først i alle arbejdsopgaver Arbejder detaljeorienteret og samtidig bevarer overblikket Er grundig i din opgaveløsning og spørger, når du er i tvivl Tager selvstændigt ansvar og forstår vigtigheden af teamwork Er fleksibel, imødekommende og hjælpsom Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale samt har kendskab til tysk Dennis Lauridsen fortsætter: ”Med solid faglighed og godt humør vil du passe rigtig godt ind i mit team. Du får mulighed for at udvikle dig med afvekslende opgaver og selvstændigt ansvar. I teamet hjælpes vi ad, og har det sjovt i dagligdagen”. I sæsonen vil du indgå i vores vagtordning, som kører alle ugens dage, hvorfor weekend og aftenarbejde skal forventes i visse perioder. Der er løn ifølge overenskomst med vagttillæg og pension. Fordele Vi tilbyder en spændende og udfordrende stilling med rig mulighed for personlig udvikling og deltagelse i fede arbejdsfællesskaber. Har du spørgsmål, kan du stille dem til Senior Manager Dennis Lauridsen på tlf. nr. 29228055. Vi læser ansøgninger og indkalder til samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning og CV hellere i dag end i morgen via link nedenfor. Vi glæder os til at lære dig at kende!

title: Sourcebynet, Technical Product Designer
description: Technical Product Designer med erfaring i 3D Studio MAX Teknisk design, 3D-visualis ering og rendering til vækstende møbelvirksomhed Hos Sourcebynet får du en central rolle i udviklingen af nye møbler – fra de første kundedialoger og 3D-renderinger til tekniske tegninger og produktionsklare løsninger. Fra skitse til produktionsklare løsninger Som Technical Product Designer bliver du en vigtig del af Sourcebynets produktudvikling i Aabenraa. Du omsætter idéer, skitser og kundefeedback til visuelle og tekniske løsninger, der kan føres videre i udviklings- og produktionsprocessen. Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver blandt andet at: Udarbejde detaljerede 3D-modeller og renderinger til konceptudvikling og kundepræsentationer. Deltage i kundemøder og efterfølgende omsætte skitser og kundebriefs til praktiske og producerbare løsninger. Samarbejde tæt med den øvrige organisation for at sikre kvalitet gennem hele design- og udviklingsprocessen. Bidrage til at udvikle og forbedre processer, værktøjer og arbejdsmetoder inden for visualisering og teknisk design. Stillingen er nyoprettet, og du får derfor mulighed for at præge både rollen og den videre udvikling. Du får en hverdag med mange forskellige projekter, stor indflydelse og korte beslutningsveje. Teknisk stærk med et visuelt blik Du har en relevant uddannelse inden for eksempelvis industrielt design, produktdesign, teknisk design, konstruktion eller møbeldesign. Du har erfaring med 3D-visualisering, rendering, teknisk tegning og/eller produktudvikling og er vant til at omsætte idéer til konkrete og gennemarbejdede løsninger. Erfaring med 3ds Max er et krav. Som person er du visuelt stærk, detaljeorienteret og arbejder struktureret med fokus på kvalitet og præcision. Du er nysgerrig på produkter, materialer og nye værktøjer og vil trives i en rolle, hvor du hurtigt får ansvar. Du kommunikerer flydende på dansk og engelsk og er bosiddende inden for rimelig kørselsafstand fra kontoret i Aabenraa. Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Research Consultant Majbrit Kock Andersen på 2628 3821. Bemærk, at vi blot har behov for dit CV, når du søger stillingen . Din henvendelse behandles fortroligt og videregives ikke uden din accept. Om virksomheden Sourcebynet er en førende B2B-virksomhed inden for møbeldesign og supply chain management. Virksomheden blev grundlagt i 2000 med en vision om at skabe et samlet koncept, der kombinerer design, produktion og sourcing – heraf navnet Sourcebynet. Virksomheden har to hovedkontorer: ét i Singapore, som dækker Asien og Australien, og ét i Aabenraa, som dækker de europæiske markeder. Derudover har Sourcebynet salgskontorer i Storbritannien, Australien, Japan, Korea, Brasilien, USA, Malaysia og Kina. Sourcebynet samarbejder desuden med mere end 100 leverandører i seks lande og har ni indkøbskontorer. På globalt plan beskæftiger virksomheden 130 medarbejdere fordelt på 15 forskellige nationaliteter. Sourcebynet har mere end 65 kunder i 26 lande og er officiel partner med Disney Home. Der er tale om en solid, sund forretning med en omsætning på et væsentligt trecifret millionbeløb.

title: Fagprojektleder til konstruktioner
description: Styrk din faglige udvikling og vær med til at forme fremtidens byggeri. I WSP arbejder vi med komplekse og samfundsrelevante projekter og søger en erfaren konstruktionsingeniør og fagprojektleder, som er klar til at stå i spidsen for faglig udvikling og projekter, der gør en forskel. Fagprojektleder i et unikt job Du bliver fagprojektleder i vores konstruktionsafdeling, hvor vi kombinerer dyb faglighed med tværfagligt samarbejde. Du vil få ansvar for at drive projekter, favne og levere konstruktionsprojekter på vores tværfaglige projekter og indgå i et stærkt fagligt miljø sammen med dine danske kolleger og WSP’s globale netværk af eksperter. Du vil være mentor for yngre kolleger og bidrage til udvikling af løsninger, der er designet til fremtiden. Stærk og velfungerende afdeling i Høje Taastrup Du bliver en del af vores konstruktions-, renoverings- og brandafdeling med ca. 40 engagerede kolleger, heraf 25 i konstruktionsteamet. Vi arbejder med teknisk bygherrerådgivning og projektering af konstruktioner inden for renovering, transformation og nybyggeri – fra kulturbyggerier til erhverv og boliger. Vores afdeling er kendt for vores stærke holdånd, tværfaglige samarbejde og en kultur, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og nemt deler viden. Vi skaber sammen innovative og bæredygtige løsninger og du bliver en del af vores Future Ready-program, hvor vi integrerer trends inden for klima, teknologi, ressourcer og samfund i alt, hvad vi gør - også når vi skal bygge til fremtiden. Dine opgaver Hos WSP Står Du Ikke Alene Med Dine Opgaver. Vi Arbejder Sammen, Hjælper Og Støtter Hinanden Og Dine Primære Opgaver Vil Være Projektering og design af bærende konstruktioner Fagledelse på større projekter Mentorrolle for yngre kolleger Bidrage til faglig udvikling og innovation Samarbejde på tværs af fagligheder og landegrænser Hvem er du? Du Er En relevant ingeniøruddannelse Mindst 8 års erfaring med rådgivning og projektering af konstruktioner Solidt kendskab til BR18, SBi271, Eurocodes m.fl. Du må gerne have erfaring med programmerne FEM Design, Robot og Revit Du må gerne være certificeret statiker eller have ambitioner om at blive det Kompetenceudvikling ser vi som en integreret del af din hverdag gennem kontinuerlig sparring med kolleger og den erfaring, du løbende opnår på projekterne. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at tage ansvar, dele din viden og være en del af et team, der tænker stort om fremtiden. Hos WSP får du mere end et job Vi ved, at livet er mere end arbejde. Derfor tilbyder vi fleksible rammer, mulighed for hjemmearbejde og en kultur, hvor familieliv, trivsel og fællesskab er i centrum. Vi har en aktiv medarbejderforening med velbesøgte sociale aktiviteter, en god kantine, sundhedsforsikring, pensionsordning, aktiekøbsprogram, massage mm. Det er vigtigt for os, at du er glad for at gå på arbejde. Vi stræber efter at skabe en venlig og inkluderende kultur med respekt for hinanden og vi værdsætter mangfoldighed og arbejder aktivt for ligestilling. Hos WSP er fleksibilitet kernen i, hvordan vi arbejder. Vil du være med til at skabe løsninger, der holder - også i fremtiden? Tag skridtet og bliv en del af WSP. Send din ansøgning og CV til os og vi behandler ansøgningerne løbende. Om WSP WSP er en af verdens førende rådgivningsvirksomheder inden for ingeniørarbejde, naturvidenskab og infrastrukturløsninger. Med tværfaglig ekspertise arbejder vi for at udvikle og styrke samfund der skaber værdi for mennesker. Fra vores lokale rødder til vores globale tilstedeværelse i dag er WSP repræsenteret i mere end 50 lande og beskæftiger cirka 83.000 medarbejdere, som vi kalder Visioneers. Sammen udvikler vi banebrydende løsninger og leverer innovative projekter inden for transport, infrastruktur, miljø, byggeri, energi, vand samt minedrift og metaller. WSP er børsnoteret på Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: WSP).

title: Mechanical Design Engineer - Base Engine systems
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. Join Us! At Volvo Construction Equipment, we are driven by the idea of leading the way towards developing a cleaner, smarter, and more connected world. We believe in achieving this through the talent of our employees, imagination, and technological innovation. If you thrive on developing the future and want to be part of a team that takes common responsibility and is proud of its products and solutions, this could be the perfect opportunity for you! We are now looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to join our Base Engine and Auxiliaries team within Powertrain Technology, working closely within the network of in-house Volvo engines. What You Will Do As a Mechanical Design Engineer within our Base Engine and Auxiliaries team, you will be responsible for working with technologies connected to internal combustion engine development. You will be given the opportunity to work with a wide variety of mechanical design engineering activities, including both new development as well as improving existing design solutions. Your main activities in this position is to create engineering documentation like 3D-models, drawings, and engineering reports. You will work cross functionally in a network of people where you contribute with your competence, ideas and visions. You will be involved in projects from the initial stages to the maintenance phase after product launch. Who are you? We are looking for you who are excited about making sure that we deliver best possible internal combustion engines to the concerned VCE products. Together with the team you are passionate to secure the flow with high quality from suppliers to factories, aftermarket and end customers. We believe you have analytical skills, are very well organized and enjoy being on top of things. You are a team player who collaborates effectively and have good communication skills. A passion for technical challenges and innovations is much appreciated in this position! You Will Bring A degree in relevant engineering area Work experience as a design engineer preferably with casted parts A strong technical interest and understanding Experience from CAD, Creo and CATIA are a merit Good communication skills in English, Swedish is a merit Who We Are The Base Engine and Auxiliaries team is a global team located in Eskilstuna, Konz, and Belley. We are responsible for the development of internal combustion engines and engine auxiliaries for our construction equipment machinery. Our work encompasses the complete development cycle, from design and implementation to testing in machines. In addition to meeting tougher emission requirements, our journey towards a more sustainable future also focuses on alternative and non-fossil fuels. We offer a collaborative and innovative work environment where personal development is encouraged. You will have good opportunities for competence development and growth, with challenging tasks that will help you progress in your career. We work closely together and support each other in our day-to-day activities, so it will be easy to get up to speed and become a part of our team. Our team is known for its passion, enthusiasm and always ready for new technical adventures. We highly value diversity and believe that a variety of perspectives enhances our creativity and problem-solving capabilities. Ready for the next move? Last application date: 8th of November. We will review all applications after the closing date and then begin contacting candidates. Location: Volvo CE Technology center Eskilstuna Travel: Occasional As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable. We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Who We Are And What We Believe In We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities. Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group . Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. Part of Volvo Group, Volvo Construction Equipment is a global company driven by our purpose to build the world we want to live in. Together we develop and deliver solutions for a cleaner, smarter, and more connected world. By unleashing everyone’s full potential, we build a more sustainable future for all our stakeholders. Come join our team and help us build a better tomorrow.

title: Produktutvecklare inom mekanik och design
description: Vill du vara en del av ett dynamiskt team som driver innovation och förändring inom olika branscher? Trivs du med att ha ett omväxlande jobb och skapa meningsfulla lösningar som kan förändra människors liv? Välkommen till Sigma Industry Development! Våra medarbetare är innovativa personer som motiveras av att utveckla nya eller befintliga produkter, förfina processer och leverera tjänster i olika former, allt för att skapa värde för våra kunder. Vi tror därför att du brinner för teknik och utveckling. Du har hunnit arbeta några år och uppskattar kombinationen av att arbeta självständigt med egna uppgifter samt i projekt tillsammans med större team. Krav: Ca 6 års arbetslivserfarenhet inom mekanikkonstruktion/design Flytande i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift Mycket goda kunskaper inom någon eller några av de vanligaste CAD-programvarorna (CATIA, Solidworks, Inventor, Creo eller liknande) Erfaren i GD&T Meriterande: Akademisk ingenjörsexamen, på B.Sc.- eller M.Sc.-nivå eller motsvarande erfarenhet Konstruktion av formbundna detaljer Elektrifiering/batteriteknik God förståelse för toleranssättning och tillverkningsmetoder Erfarenhet från branscher med höga kvalitetskrav, exempelvis fordons-, flyg- eller försvarsindustrin Vana att arbeta med konstruktion i plåt, plast, gjutgods och/eller bearbetade detaljer Erfarenhet av att ta fram teknisk dokumentation och produktionsunderlag (ritningar, stycklistor etc.) VI ERBJUDER Vi är stora nog för att kunna erbjuda en bred kundbas och vi har ett gott rykte i branschen, samtidigt som vi är små nog att se dig som individ. För oss är gemenskap viktigt, här ska alla känna sig sedda och välkomna. Som en följd av detta har vi bland annat gemensamma sektionsaktiviteter, ett nätverk för kvinnor och icke-binära, ett mentorskapsprogam och utbildningar inom olika kompetensområden. Vi strävar efter att skapa en miljö där alla kan växa och utvecklas tillsammans. Vår ambition är att tillgodose konsultens önskemål gällande uppdragslängd, sektor och arbetsuppgifter. För oss är en bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv en självklarhet och vi är stolta över att vara en av Sveriges mest attraktiva arbetsgivare. Givetvis har vi också kollektivavtal. Nyfiken på hur det känns att vara en del av vårt gäng? I den här filmen delar några av våra medarbetare med sig av sina tankar om vardagen, gemenskapen och varför de valt just oss: https://vimeo.com/1058313176?share=copy#t=0 OM SID Sigma Industry Development är ett teknik- och konsultbolag inom Sigmagruppen som hjälper både ledande svenska och internationella teknikföretag och innovativa och nytänkande start-ups och scale-ups. Vi verkar inom sektorer så som den gröna energisektorn, fordonsindustrin, transportindustrin, medtech, försvarsbranchen och hållbarhet. Vår vision är att vara det ledande teknikkonsultbolaget och vår kultur präglas av familjär samhörighet där människan är i centrum. Med över 100 engagerade medarbetare är vi i en stark tillväxtfas. Vår kärnverksamhet ligger i konsultuppdrag ute hos kund, men vi har även ett in-house-team som arbetar uteslutande från kontoret. Precis som vårt namn antyder, är utveckling kärnan i allt vi gör och våra medarbetare engageras av att ta Sigma Industry Development till nästa nivå. OM SIGMA GROUP Sigma Industry Development AB (SID) är ett av sex dotterbolag som ingår i koncernen Sigma Industry East/North Group, vilka i sin tur ingår i Sigma Group (som ägs av familjekoncernen Danir AB). Läs mer om Sigma Industry Development HÄR och om Sigma Group på HÄR . Utöver att vara del av ett företag som värnar om teknologisk utveckling, arbetar för en bättre miljö och som främjar jämställdhet, så är en viktig del av vår verksamhet socialt ansvarstagande. Mer information om detta hittar du HÄR . Sista ansökningsdag 2026-12-04 MER INFORMATION För mer information kontakta: Magnus Schotte Sektionschef Sigma Industry Development, Stockholm Produktutveckling 073-051 92 61 magnus.schotte@sigma.se LinkedIn 073-051 92 61 magnus.schotte@sigma.se LinkedIn

title: Erfaren konstruktör till T-7
description: Vi tror att framsteg och möjligheter skapas bäst tillsammans. Välkommen till en plats där samarbete gör skillnad. Din roll Vi behöver bli fler och söker dig som vill ingå i ett team som uppskattar varandras olikheter och strävar efter att skapa en öppen kultur som präglas av respekt och acceptans. På vår sektion Mechanical Installation Design ansvarar vi för den mekaniska integrationen av systemen i våra flygande produkter Gripen och T-7. Vi erbjuder dig ett roligt och inspirerande jobb som konstruktör, med många olika och varierade arbetsuppgifter. Du kommer vara en del av ett designteam inom området Structural and Systems Installation Design som består av åtta sektioner med totalt ca. 130 medarbetare som täcker in skrovkonstruktion och all systeminstallation inom mekanik, el och elscheman. Då systemen finns i hela flygplanet, har vi ett mycket tätt samarbete med andra områden och på sätt skapar oss en bred produktkunskap och nätverk inom organisationen. Vi samarbetar även med andra affärsområden inom koncernen. Denna tjänst är kopplad till projektet T-7, ett nytt avancerat pilotutbildningssystem/flygplan i samarbete med Boeing, där vi nu behöver utöka vårt team. Som konstruktör blir dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter: Support till produktion och våra kunder med operativa flygplan. Hantera produktionsutfall (non-conformance) Studier för införande av ny funktionalitet. Design av mekaniska delar i CATIA V5, från koncept till färdig produkt. Förbättringsarbete, en del av vårt dagliga arbete för att göra oss effektivare. Tätt samarbete inom System Installation Design och med angränsande områden så som Skrovkonstruktion, Strukturanalys, Industrialisering och Produktion. Din profil Som konstruktör tror vi att du är en person som är motiverad till att ständigt utvecklas och vara öppen för nya förutsättningar och arbetssätt. Du är strukturerad, lösningsorienterad och strävar efter helhetens bästa. Vi ser att du trivs i en roll där du får samarbeta och kommunicera med andra både inom teamet och organisationen. Din kreativitet och intresse för produktutveckling är något du sprider till din omgivning, såväl som ditt engagemang för att utveckla vårt team och verksamhet. För att lyckas i rollen har du: En relevant utbildningsbakgrund som Högskole- eller Civilingenjör, eller arbetslivserfarenhet inom design eller annat relevant tekniskt område. Erfarenhet av mekanisk konstruktion, skrovkonstruktion eller angränsande områden. Erfarenhet inom CAD, företrädelsevis inom CATIA V5. Goda kunskaper i Svenska och Engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt. Meriterande om du har: Intresse av att kliva in i en tekniskt ledande roll. Jobbat med Non-conformance hantering (Felutfall från produktion och kund). Bakgrund eller intresse av flyg. Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap. Vad du blir en del av Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. title: Volvo Group Graduate Program 2027 - Design Engineer for Wheel End Parts
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. This is the Volvo Group Graduate Program A new era of manufacturing and R&D is here. Are you passionate about technology, eager to solve real business challenges, ready to drive innovation, and join our transformation journey? Then this Graduate program is for you! As part of the Graduate Program at Volvo Group, you will tackle real challenges from day one and contribute to the development of next-generation production solutions. The 15-month Graduate Program combines 50% time in your home department with 50% dedicated program activities, giving you broad exposure across Volvo Group. Through local and international rotations, short-term assignments, and targeted training in areas such as operations, engineering, and purchasing, you will build a strong understanding of our business, brands and strategy. The program also includes direct customer exposure and encourages collaboration, knowledge-sharing and an end-to-end mindset, enabling you to contribute to transformation across the organization from day one. We share a common focus on transforming requirements into sustainable solutions through data-driven decision-making, continuous improvement, and end-to-end ownership, while building long-term competence and business value. Our team of 12, a mix of engineers, analysts, and XFTLs (cross-functional team leaders), focuses on chassis components, specifically wheel-end systems, and works closely with global development teams and related engineering functions to deliver robust and integrated solutions. We hold product ownership for Disc-Brake, Actuators, pads, and complete Hub assembly, and we're also responsible for Rims and Tyres strategies. How You'll Contribute As a design engineer with interest in analysis, you will contribute to the development of our Mechanical brake system by performing calculations for heat, durability, and wear. You will apply technical expertise, analytical methods, and engineering judgement to solve complex problems, and correlate your analytical results with testing and operational data to ensure robust solutions. By combining data-driven strategic support with hands-on project execution, you will help turn business needs into scalable digital and operational improvements, supporting compliance with future emissions legislation while improving customer uptime and sustainability. Collect, analyze, and interpret data to support decision-making. Translate needs, requirements, or findings into actionable improvements and deliverables. Collaborate with cross-functional teams and a wide range of stakeholders. Drive development, improvement, and implementation activities from concept to verified results. Communicate findings, recommendations, progress, and outcomes, while maintaining clear documentation and taking ownership of assignments to support continuous improvement and innovation. Who are you? We are looking for someone with a strong transformation and collaborative mindset who is eager to learn, explore, and understand the business. You thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new challenges and ambiguity, and take ownership of your own development and growth. With strong analytical skills, you take initiatives and drive tasks forward with determination while bringing fresh perspectives and innovative ideas to the team. You enjoy building relationships and leveraging a global network to create impact while working collaboratively across teams and functions. In addition, you contribute to a culture of continuous learning by actively sharing knowledge, exchanging insights, and supporting the development of others. We hope that you have a genuine interest in engineering calculations and simulations related to durability, thermal performance, and flow characteristics, and you're curious to deepen your knowledge of wheel-end systems, disc brakes, and simulation-driven development, even if you're still building that expertise. You bring a structured, data-driven approach to problem solving, with the ability to investigate technical challenges and draw logical conclusions from data, simulations, testing, and field observations. Strong critical-thinking skills and an analytical mindset help you navigate complexity. You communicate and present your findings clearly, making it easy for others to follow your reasoning and act on your recommendations. You Meet The Following Requirements You have a Master of Technology or Master's of Science, in for example Mechanical, Automotive or Industrial Engineering, or in a related field with a strong digital or analytical exposure. You have, through work experience, thesis work, projects or internships, exposure to disc brake and wheel-end systems, chassis development, or vehicle dynamics. Experience in Python Some sort of exposure or experience with CAD tools, for example Creo or similar Interest in leading others and technical areas Additional Desirable Skills Experience with component, rig, or vehicle testing is beneficial, including correlation of analytical results and simulations with physical test data. title: Mechanical/Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: Job Description Your impact Leonardo is a global leader in defence electronics and delivers systems for situational awareness, electronic defence and surveillance across land, sea and air. The Radar and Advanced Targeting line of business is uniquely positioned as one of the world's top designers, developers and manufacturers of radars, lasers and infrared countermeasure systems. At Edinburgh, we have an opportunity for Mechanical and Senior Mechanical Engineers to join our team, where your role will be to design, develop and support our world leading electro-optic products. You will be utilising state-of-the-art methods, technology and tools to explore all aspects of the development lifecycle, including stress and thermal analysis, requirements analysis, design, implementation, test, build and production support. You will interface with customers (internal and external) on many factors within the design and liaise closely with Engineers from other disciplines, particularly Systems and Electronics. Be working towards Incorporated or Chartered Engineer status with the IMechE (or equivalent professional body), and be able to demonstrate the experience and UK-SPEC competencies required to achieve professional registration within the next 2 years. Experience in the design of systems for highly regulated industries and for harsh environments, including but not limited to shock, vibration and temperature. Demonstrable proficiency in 3D CAD software (PTC Creo preferred), including modelling and drawing creation. Experience using ERP and PDM systems for configuration management and revision control (Teamcenter Unified preferred). Experience producing manufacturing data packs and applying Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T). A collaborative approach, with experience of working in interdisciplinary teams and contributing to work package delivery and achieving quality, schedule and cost objectives. Commitment to continuous professional development and staying current with emerging technologies and engineering best practice. Hold Incorporated or Chartered Engineer status with the IMechE (or equivalent professional body), or be able to demonstrate the experience and UK-SPEC competencies required to achieve professional registration. Have the ability to perform first pass analysis with FEA and interpret Structural and Thermal analysis data. Experience of work package management and delivery of tasks on time and on budget. Experience in mentoring, developing and coaching engineers in terms of technical knowledge and soft skills. Strong communication skills, with the ability to present and defend engineering solutions at design reviews and peer reviews. Experience providing technical input and support on complex engineering programmes. Experience in opto-mechanical design would be advantageous, but is not essential. An additional range of Personnel Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC). Flexible working: Flexible hours with hybrid working options. For part time opportunities, please talk to us about what might be possible for this role. For a full list of our company benefits please visit our website. Leonardo UK operates a grade-based salary framework with broad bands. The salary range shown reflects the approved grade band for this role, or a narrower hiring range published within that band, and is benchmarked against the external market. description: Over de vacature Ontwerpen, analyseren en optimaliseren van complexe civiel-constructieve systemen: als Junior Structural Engineer / junior constructeur werk je aan onshore-installaties in de chemie, petrochemie en hernieuwbare energie. title: Mechanical Design Engineer – fluent German (m/f/d)
description: Your Role Molex is currently seeking a Mechanical Design Engineer to support the development, validation, and qualification of connector and interconnect products. This role combines hands-on laboratory engineering with mechanical design, giving you the opportunity to take concepts from CAD and prototype development through testing and technical validation. You will design mechanical parts, assemblies, and test fixtures while performing mechanical, environmental, and reliability testing to support product development and customer requirements. The ideal candidate is a pragmatic, hands-on engineer with solid mechanical design fundamentals who enjoys combining CAD design, prototyping, testing, problem-solving, and data analysis in an engineering laboratory environment. Our Team You will work as part of a collaborative engineering environment supporting the development and qualification of connector systems and related electromechanical products. The role works closely with Product Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supplier teams to resolve design and testing challenges, improve product manufacturability, and ensure solutions meet technical and customer requirements. This is a particularly hands-on position for an engineer who enjoys validating engineering concepts experimentally and working across both product design and laboratory testing activities. What You Will Do Design mechanical parts, assemblies, and test fixtures using 3D/2D CAD, and create engineering drawings incorporating GD&T principles. Develop and execute mechanical, environmental, and reliability tests for connector products, including electrical, thermal, vibration, humidity, and mating-cycle testing. Build and troubleshoot prototypes, test fixtures, and harness assemblies, using appropriate laboratory equipment and hands-on assembly techniques. Analyse test results and prepare technical documentation to support design reviews, qualification activities, and customer requirements. Support DFMEA, tolerance analysis, DFM/DFA, and design improvement activities, collaborating with Product Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supplier teams. Manage engineering documentation, CAD files, BOMs, and design changes through PLM/PDM systems, while supporting laboratory equipment, calibration, and safety requirements. Who You Are (Key Requirements) Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Mechatronics, Materials Science, or a related engineering discipline. Solid hands-on professional experience in mechanical/electrical design, prototype fabrication, or engineering test laboratory environments. Proficiency with 3D/2D CAD, such as SolidWorks, Creo, or equivalent, including assemblies, surfacing, and engineering drawing creation. Good understanding of mechanical engineering fundamentals, including tolerance analysis, GD&T, material properties, fasteners, and basic mechanisms. Practical laboratory skills, including building test fixtures, wiring harnesses, basic soldering, and operating common test equipment. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with good attention to detail. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to prepare clear technical documentation and reports. Fluent in English, good German command. What Will Put You Ahead Experience in connector or electromechanical product design, including testing such as contact resistance, insulation resistance, and high-voltage. Experience with engineering standards, FEA/simulation, and product validation within an R&D or qualification environment. Knowledge of manufacturing processes, including injection molding, metal stamping, and plating. Familiarity with PLM/PDM and manufacturing systems, along with exposure to Lean/continuous improvement and project management. What We Offer Flexible Work Hours 30 vacation days per year and special leave for specific occasions 13 months’ salary plus an annual salary review Attractive offers from leading brands through Corporate Benefits Subsidized membership in the Urban Sports Club or EGYM Wellpass JobRad® bicycle leasing Company pension plan Company accident insurance External Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Subsidized cafeteria meals At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy. Who We Are As a Koch company, Molex is a leading supplier of connectors and interconnect components, driving innovation in electronics and supporting industries from automotive to health care and consumer to data communications. The thousands of innovators who work for Molex have made us a global electronics leader. Our experienced people, groundbreaking products and leading-edge technologies help us deliver a wider array of solutions to more markets than ever before. At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company. Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

title: Kalıp Tasarım ve Uygulama Takım Üyesi
description: KoçMedical I Bıçakcılar Hakkında Pandeminin en yoğun dönemlerinde yaşanan yoğun bakım solunum cihazı eksikliğine çözüm olarak, Mart 2021’de Sağlık Bakanlığı ile Sanayi ve Teknoloji Bakanlıklarının talepleri doğrultusunda, Nisan 2021’de 100 adet ve Haziran 2021’de 5000 adet ventilatör üretimi sağlanmıştır. Bu kısa sürede gerçekleşen üretim süreci, KoçMedical hikayesinin başlangıcını oluşturmuştur. Koç Topluluğu’nun sağlık teknolojileri alanında faaliyet gösteren Hollanda merkezli şirketi olarak, sağlık alanındaki ihtiyaçlara yenilikçi çözümler sunmak, sağlığa erişimi geniş kitlelere ulaştırmak ve bölgesel bir sağlık teknoloji gücü haline gelmek amacıyla kurulduk. KoçMedical olarak, tek kullanımlık tıbbi sarf malzemeler ve tıbbi cihazlar olmak üzere iki ana ürün grubunda faaliyet göstermekte, medikal cihaz ve sarf malzemelerinin tasarımı ve üretimine odaklanmaktayız. Temmuz 2023’te KoçMedical bünyesine katılan Bıçakcılar Tıbbi Cihazlar Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş., 60 yılı aşkın deneyimiyle tıbbi cihazlar alanında pazar lideridir. Medikal sarf malzemeler kategorisinde kateter ve tüp setlerinde Türkiye’nin lider üreticisi olan Bıçakcılar, ameliyathane ve yoğun bakım ünitelerine yönelik geniş ürün portföyüyle Türkiye’de 150’den fazla bayiye, 1.500’den fazla hastaneye ve dünya genelinde 100’den fazla ülkeye hizmet sunmaktadır. Bünyesinde bulunan akredite Ar-Ge merkezinde ürün geliştirme çalışmalarını sürdürürken aynı zamanda kaliteli ve yenilikçi ürünlerin Türkiye ve yakın coğrafyalar distribütörlüğünü üstlenmektedir. KoçMedical | Bıçakcılar, bu güçlü birleşimle sürdürülebilir büyüme hedefini benimseyerek Avrupa merkezli bir global firma olmayı, sağlık teknolojilerinde ürün yelpazesini genişletmeyi ve ihracat pazarlarını büyüterek sektöre uluslararası düzeyde katkı sağlamayı hedeflemektedir. KoçMedical I Bıçakcılar’ın Sundukları KoçMedical | Bıçakcılar, Fortune Global 500'de yer alan güçlü bir grubun parçası olarak, yenilikçi bir şirket ruhu ve dinamik bir çalışma ortamı sunuyor. Çevik, eğlenceli ve esnek yapısıyla, profesyoneller için hem kurumsal bir düzen hem de yenilikçi bir kariyer yolculuğu vadediyoruz. Eşitlik ve birlik ilkelerini her fırsatta vurgulayarak çalışanlarımızın değerli hissetmesini sağlıyoruz. “Sağlığa yenilik, hayata iyilik katmak” misyonuyla çıktığımız bu yolda kalite ve inovasyonu ön planda tutarak sektörün geleceğini şekillendiren bir vizyonla ilerliyoruz. Bizimle çalışmak, sadece bir iş değil; insanı odağına alan bir ortamda gelişim, öğrenme ve başarıya ulaşma yolculuğudur. Çalışma anlayışımız, bireysel katkıyı desteklemek ve güçlü bir takım ruhu oluşturmak üzerine kuruludur. Şirket içi etkinlikler, sosyal sorumluluk projeleri, takım çalışmaları ve düzenli toplantılar ile hem birlikte öğreniyor hem de büyüyoruz. Çalışanlarımızın fikirlerine değer veriyor ve her seviyede katılımı teşvik ediyoruz. Koç Grubu’nun “Koç’lu Olmak” kültüründen ilham alarak, çalışanlarımıza eşitlik ve değer odaklı bir deneyim sunuyoruz. Onların gelişimlerini desteklemek ve kariyer yolculuklarında ilerlemelerine olanak tanımak için yanlarında oluyoruz. Eğer siz de bu heyecan verici, yenilikçi ve gelişim odaklı ortamda bizimle çalışmak istiyorsanız, Üretim ekibimize katılacak bir Kalıp Tasarım ve Uygulama Takım Üyesi arıyoruz. Rol Sorumlulukları Maliyet iyileştirme çalışmalarının ve Aylık KPI hedef takibinin yapılması Kök neden analizlerinin ve yeni proje fizibilitelerinin yapılması Yeni yapılacak kalıpların ve montaj aparatlarının tasarım, üretim ve test süreçlerinin yürütülmesi Kalıp ömürlerinin ve performans takibinin yapılması. Talaşlı imalat süreçlerinin sevk ve idaresinin yapılması. Kalıp problemlerinin önlenmesi ve tekrarlanmasının engellenmesi. İhtiyaç duyulan aparat, fikstür ve parçaların tasarım ve imalatının gerçekleştirilmesi. Performans raporlarına göre kalıplarda alınacak aksiyonların belirlenmesi ve planlanması. Teknolojik gelişmelerin takip edilmesi ve tedarikçiler ile maliyet düşürücü çalışmaların yapılması Yeni veya tadilat görecek kalıpların tasarımlarının, imalatının ve revizyonunun yapılması / yaptırılması. Kalıp bakımı, takibi ve hazırlık süreçlerinin planlanması. ERP (SAP) veya Üretim Yürütme Sistemleri (MES) ile üretimin takip ve raporlanmasının sağlanması Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği bölümünden mezun, Alanında en az 5 yıl deneyimli, tercihen medikal ürün bilgisine sahip, Talaşlı imalat, teknik resim okuma ve geometrik toleranslama deneyimine sahip, Kalıp tasarımı, kalıp üretimi ve test aşamaları konusunda tecrübeli, İleri seviyede İngilizce bilgisine sahip, MS Office, CAD/CAM ve CAE tabanlı bilgisayar programlarına hâkim (NX, Solidworks, Power Mill, Moldflow, Fikus, vb.) İletişimi kuvvetli ve takım çalışmasına yatkın olmak Analitik düşünme yeteneğine sahip Problem çözme yeteneğine sahip Ayrıca şunlara sahipseniz: Güçlü analitik ve proje yönetimi becerileri, Yenilikçi zihniyet odaklı, Güçlü iletişim ve sunum becerileri, Öğren-öğren-yeniden öğren çevikliği, Değişim için esneklik.
