title: KIDEMLİ MEKANİK İŞLER MÜHENDİSİ
description: Biz Kimiz? 1993 yılında kurulan Rönesans Holding, bugün Türkiye, Avrupa, Orta Asya ve Afrika’yı kapsayan geniş bir coğrafyada; inşaat, gayrimenkul, enerji, endüstri ve sağlık alanlarında ana müteahhit ve yatırımcı olarak faaliyet göstermektedir. 40.000’i aşkın çalışanı ve 60’tan fazla milletten oluşan güçlü ve çok kültürlü ekibiyle Rönesans, dünyanın en büyük müteahhitlik şirketleri arasında yer almakta; sürdürülebilir bir gelecek inşa etme vizyonuyla yenilikçi ve küresel ölçekteki mühendislik projelerini hayata geçirmeye devam etmektedir. Adaylardan Beklentilerimiz Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği bölümünden mezun, Tercihen büyük ölçekli endüstriyel projelerde tecrübesi bulunan veya görev almaya istekli tecrübeli, Ekipman Montajı ve/veya Çelik Konstrüksiyon Montajı alanında en az 3-4 yıl saha tecrübesine sahip, MS Office, Autocad ve mesleki bilgisayar programlarına hâkim, Analitik düşünme yeteneğine sahip ve çözüm odaklı, Planlı, programlı, düzenli çalışma disiplinine sahip, Yoğun çalışma temposu ve esnek çalışma saatlerine uyum gösterebilecek, Ekipman kaldırılması işleri konusunda tecrübeli veya bu konuda tecrübelenmek isteyen, Tedarikçi teknik çizimlerini inceleme ve analiz etme konusunda tecrübeli veya öğrenmeye hevesli, Teknik çizim anlama düzeyinde İngilizce dil bilgisine sahip, Bu Rolde Seni Neler Bekliyor? Projenin dokümantasyon ve raporlama süreçlerini takip etmek, Gelen malzeme kontrollerinde bulunmak ve tedarikçi çizimlerine uygunluğunu kontrol etmek, Mekanik ekipman montajları öncesi saha uygunluğu kontrolü, takibi, saha mekanik ekip koordinasyon ve yönetimi, Yapım metotlarını inceleyip saha montajının ilgili metotlara uygun olarak tamamlanmasının takibi, İlgili iş izinlerinin, kaldırma planlarının zamanında hazırlanması ve takibi, Kontrol & Test Planına uygun olarak montajı tamamlanan ekipmanların ilgili kontrol taleplerinin takibi, Uygunsuzlukların takibi ve kayıt altına alınması, Üstlerine günlük, haftalık ve aylık gerekli bilgilendirmelerin ve raporlamanın yapılması Sahada diğer disiplinler ile montaj hazırlıkları kapsamında ve sonrasında koordinasyonun sağlanması. Biz Neler Sunuyoruz? Performans ve başarıyı destekleyen prim uygulamaları Kapsamlı yan haklar ve çalışan destek uygulamaları Özel Sağlık Sigortası kapsamında çalışanlarımızı destekleyen sağlık uygulamaları Mesleki ve kişisel gelişimini destekleyen eğitim ve gelişim programları Çeşitlilik ve Eşitlik Beyanımız Rönesans Holding, şirketlere stratejilerini ve operasyonlarını evrensel insan hakları, çalışma, çevre ve yolsuzlukla mücadele ilkelerine uygun hale getirmeye ve toplumsal hedefleri ilerletecek önlemler almaya çağıran BM Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi'nin imzacıları arasında yer almaktadır ve Birleşmiş Milletler Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi çerçevesinde evrensel kabul görmüş beyanlara dayalı ilkeleri benimser. Rönesans Holding, ana ilkeleri olan dürüstlük, rekabetçilik ve yenilikçilikten ödün vermeden şeffaf ve etik değerleri gözeterek insan kaynakları uygulamalarında eşitliği sağlamayı amaçlayan bir işverendir. Tüm başvurular cinsiyet, dil, din, ırk ve etnik kökene bakmaksızın fırsat eşitliğine göre değerlendirilir ve ayırımcılık yapılmaz.

title: Performans Mühendisi
description: TEI olarak 1985’ten günümüze; havacılık motorları alanında sektöre sunduğumuz yüksek kaliteli ürün, hizmetler ile uluslararası arenada dünya çapında bir üretici ve küresel bir tasarım merkezi konumundayız. Bu güçlü konumumuzdan hareketle kendimizi Gücün Kaynağı olarak tanımlıyoruz. Küresel havacılığa sunduğumuz katkılar ve Türkiye’nin havacılık serüvenine kazandırdığımız ilkler ile başarı hikâyeleri yazmaya devam ediyor; parça ve modül üretimi, motor montaj, test ve bakım, onarım, revizyon, motor tasarımı ve ürün geliştirme alanlarında mükemmeli hedefliyoruz. Türk Havacılık Uzay Sanayii, GE Aerospace, Türk Silahlı Kuvvetleri Güçlendirme Vakfı ve Türk Hava Kurumu ortaklığında kurulan şirketimiz, millî projelerle gurur veren başarılarda yerini alma ve geleceğin havacılık hikâyelerine imza atma fırsatı sunuyor. Bu yolculukta başarımızı teknoloji ile beraber değerlerimizden de alıyoruz: adaletle güven inşa ediyor, birlikte mükemmelliği hedefliyor, kapsayıcı bir ortam kuruyor, yenilikçi bakış açısıyla büyüyor ve sorumluluk bilinciyle hareket ediyoruz. Gökyüzündeki her iki uçaktan birinde TEI parçaları var! Sen de geniş öğrenme imkanlarıyla sınırsız gelişimi planlıyor; yenilikçi ve öncü projelerle başarılı bir kariyer hedefliyorsan aramızdaki yerini hemen al! #GücünOdağındaSenVarsın TEI'de Seni Neler Bekliyor? title: Maintenance Manager
description: Location: Çorlu (Ergene), Tekirdağ, Türkiye Working Model: On-site Why this role matters You will keep our Çorlu factory running safely, reliably and efficiently. Every product that leaves our site depends on equipment that works when it should. In this role you lead the maintenance function and turn reliability into a competitive advantage. You reduce downtime, control costs and build the capabilities we need for the future. Your work directly supports our people’s safety, our product quality and our ability to deliver for customers. What You’ll Do Lead the maintenance team across mechanical, electrical and automation disciplines, including planning, scheduling and shift coverage. Build and run preventive and predictive maintenance programmes to reduce unplanned downtime. Own the maintenance budget, spare parts strategy and contractor management. Drive root cause analysis on breakdowns and lead continuous improvement projects with production and engineering. Ensure all maintenance activities follow safety, environmental and legal requirements, including permit-to-work and LOTO. Support capital projects, new line installations and equipment upgrades from design to handover. Use SAP PM to manage work orders, asset history and maintenance KPIs. Performance You will own the reliability of our assets and the performance of the maintenance function. Success will be measured through OEE improvement, reduction in unplanned downtime, MTBF and MTTR trends, maintenance cost versus budget, and a strong safety record. You turn data into clear priorities and make sure the team delivers on them. Care This role reports to the Regional Operations Director, Emerging Markets and works closely with Production, Quality, SHE, Engineering and Supply Chain teams. You lead and develop a team of technicians and engineers, building their skills and creating a culture where safety comes first and everyone takes ownership. You also manage relationships with external contractors and suppliers to keep standards high and costs under control. Passion You care about how things work and how they can work better. You enjoy solving problems at their root, not just fixing them for today. You take pride in a well-run plant and in a team that grows with every challenge. You are curious about new technologies such as predictive maintenance, automation and digital tools, and you want to bring them to life on the shop floor. About You Degree in mechanical, electrical, mechatronics or industrial engineering. 7+ years of maintenance experience in FMCG, food or a similar process manufacturing environment, including people leadership. title: Principal Engineer, Technical Assessment
description: Tomorrow’s software engineers deserve more than yesterday’s interviews. Proxify is Europe's largest network of vetted software developers. Companies come to us when they need an engineer who can contribute from week one. We find that person, vet them thoroughly, and match them. 20,000 applicants apply each month, and we need to pick the best 200 out of them. Our vetting isn't a step in the process. It is the product. The problem Sometimes we pick the wrong developer. It doesn't happen often, but when it does, a client's roadmap slips and a good engineer ends up somewhere they shouldn't be. Sometimes, that costs us the client for good. It's also getting harder to tell the difference. Software Engineers build alongside AI agents all day now. An engineer who can't recall a sorting algorithm might be the best reviewer you've ever worked with. The one who aces the whiteboard might ship code they don't understand the impact of. The old signals are getting noisier, and nobody has agreed on the new ones. What we do have is one of the richest datasets anywhere on how software engineers perform: 20,000 applications a month, a network of 6,000, and engagement data on every one of them – who thrived on the job, who struggled, and why. Nobody has worked out yet what that data actually predicts. Most people with strong opinions about technical hiring never get the chance to test them on a dataset like this. Can you help us pick the right 200 out of 20,000? Build the new way of evaluating technical talent As our Principal Engineer, Technical Assessment , you'll own how Proxify identifies exceptional engineers in this new reality. You will create better ways to understand how applicants think, build, review, debug, and make decisions. This may include technical interviews, tests, realistic work simulations, AI-enabled methods, and new formats that do not exist yet. This is a senior individual-contributor role. You will own the direction end-to-end: what we evaluate, how we evaluate it, and how we scale it. Nobody is handing you a spec. You will report to the VP of Assessment and work closely with different teams influencing our technical evaluations today. Your work will shape the experience of thousands of applicants every month. What you’ll do Own technical vetting across our engineering roles and seniority levels, turning strong on-the-job performance into clear, measurable signals. Design evaluations. Build interviews, tests, work simulations, and scoring guides, including formats that do not exist yet. Rethink evaluations for the AI era. Decide what matters when software engineers work with AI agents daily: directing and reviewing an agent, catching wrong output, debugging code they didn't write. Use AI in the work itself. Build and maintain technical content, improve consistency between interviewers, and support better decisions at volume. Prove what works. Connect evaluation results with real engagement performance, filter signal from noise, A/B test, and scale what works. Make it hold at scale. Set the standards and quality controls for fair evaluations across thousands of applicants a month. What we’re looking for A strong hands-on software development background and deep expertise in at least one technical area. Strong analytical skills. You’re data-driven and understand reliability, consistency, bias, and predictive value. Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools, and a clear view of how they are reshaping software development. title: Senior E2E Test Engineer – Payments & Channels
description: Design the future architecture of one of Europe's most innovative banking networks while empowering engineers to do their best work. Role Summary At ING Hubs Türkiye, we're looking for a Senior E2E Test Engineer who enjoys looking beyond individual applications and understanding how complete payment journeys work from start to finish. This role combines hands-on end-to-end testing, payment domain knowledge, system integration, API testing, and test automation. You'll validate complex payment flows across multiple applications and interfaces while helping move testing from manual execution toward scalable, maintainable automation. You'll work within an Agile and DevOps environment, collaborating closely with Product Owners, Customer Journey Experts, IT Business Analysts, Solution Architects, DevOps Engineers, application teams, and testing specialists across different squads and domains. Your focus will be on translating business requirements, user journeys, functional specifications, and technical designs into effective E2E test coverage. You'll execute both manual and automated tests, validate data and transaction outcomes across systems, and take ownership of test preparation, evidence, defect retesting, and regression testing. At the same time, you'll play an important role in strengthening test automation using tools such as Postman, Playwright, GitHub, and GitHub Copilot , while contributing to ING's internal testing frameworks and engineering capabilities. Work Model At ING Hubs Türkiye, flexibility is more than a benefit, it's part of how we work. Our hybrid way of working is designed to balance collaboration, innovation, and personal flexibility. Team members typically come together at our Vadistanbul office for two days per week during three weeks of the month, while one week each month is fully remote. We also offer additional flexibility during the summer period, with remote working opportunities throughout August, allowing colleagues to spend more time where they feel most productive while staying connected to their teams. As part of a globally distributed organization, you'll collaborate with colleagues across multiple ING locations while contributing to solutions that create impact across the bank. About the Team You will join the E2E Testing team within the Payments and Channels Area of the Transaction Services Tribe , working in an environment where payment journeys cross multiple applications, interfaces, teams, and locations. We believe quality goes beyond testing a single application. It means understanding how a transaction moves across the complete payment chain, identifying risks across system boundaries, and making sure data, statuses, and outcomes remain accurate and consistent throughout the journey. Our teams work in an Agile environment with a strong DevOps mindset, combining hands-on testing with automation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Curiosity and initiative matter here, and new ideas that improve the way we test are encouraged. What You'll Do Analyze business use cases, functional specifications, solution designs, and acceptance criteria to define the right E2E test coverage. Design and maintain test cases covering complete payment journeys across channels, APIs, processing components, and downstream systems. Execute manual and automated E2E tests, including happy flows, unhappy flows, error handling, boundary conditions, and regression scenarios. Validate payment data, statuses, and outcomes as transactions move between different systems. Prepare and maintain test data, test accounts, access rights, and environment prerequisites. Collect clear test evidence, including expected and actual results, logs, API responses, screenshots, and relevant transaction or message identifiers. Retest resolved defects and perform targeted regression testing to ensure fixes don't create unintended impact elsewhere in the payment chain. Build and maintain automated test suites and help move E2E scenarios from manual testing toward maintainable automation. Collaborate across squads and domains to identify blockers, communicate quality risks, and drive issues toward resolution. About You We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you'll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we'll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself. Ideally, you bring: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Around 3–6 years of experience in software testing or quality engineering. Strong hands-on experience with end-to-end, system integration, API, functional, and regression testing . Experience designing test cases based on business requirements, functional specifications, user journeys, and technical designs. Experience building and maintaining automated test suites. Practical experience with Postman, GitHub, GitHub Copilot , and modern automation frameworks such as Playwright . A hands-on ownership mindset, taking responsibility from test preparation through execution, evidence, retesting, and follow-through. Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to translate complex testing topics into clear risks and decisions. A proactive and resilient approach when priorities shift, dependencies create blockers, or delivery pressure increases. Strong problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills. Good command of English and confidence collaborating across international teams. Equal Opportunity Don't meet every single requirement? Don't let that hold you back. Studies show many talented professionals hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role and believe you can make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. In deze rol ontwerp en produceer je samen met collega’s hoogwaardige drukvaten en warmtewisselaars voor de olie- en gasindustrie. Als Engineer werk je zelfstandig aan unieke, klantgerichte oplossingen. Je krijgt ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen binnen een hecht team dat trots is op maatwerk en vakmanschap. Of je nu graag tekent, berekent of beide: bij dit bedrijf krijg je de vrijheid om je talenten in te zetten op een manier die bij jou past. De opdrachtgever is gespecialiseerd in fabricage en engineering van procesapparatuur, hoofdzakelijk shell en tube warmtewisselaars en drukvaten. Deze apparatuur wordt geproduceerd voor de olie & gas- en (petro)chemische industrie over de hele wereld. Het bedrijf beschikt over een eigen ingenieursafdeling. Daar wordt gewerkt aan het mechanische ontwerp van alle apparatuur en het thermisch ontwerp van de buizenwarmtewisselaars conform HTRI. Voor het ontwerp en de vervaardiging van tekeningen wordt gebruik gemaakt van Autocad, LT en Solidworks. Wat ga je doen? Ontwerpen van apparaten en onderdelen vanaf scratch; Uitwerken en detailleren van ontwerpen in 3D CAD (Solidworks of AutoCAD); Opstellen van stuklijsten voor productie; Verzorgen van technische documentatie; Optioneel: uitvoeren van constructieberekeningen volgens ASME, EN13445 en RToD. MBO of HBO diploma richting Werktuigbouwkunde óf aantoonbare ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol; Ervaring als tekenaar/constructeur of engineer; Ervaring met Solidworks of AutoCAD is een pré; Goede beheersing van het Nederlands in woord en geschrift; Redelijke tot goede beheersing van het Engels. Salaris op basis van opleiding en ervaring; Vakantiegeld (8,33%) en vakantiedagen (minimaal 25 p/j); Netto onkostenvergoeding van €500 op jaarbasis; Pensioenregeling en optie tot deelname collectieve zorgverzekering; Gratis opleidingen en trainingen op onze eigen Academy; Indien gewenst begeleiding door een specialist binnen jouw vakgebied. Vragen over deze vacature? Heb je (technische) vragen over deze rol of wil je vrijblijvend sparren over de inhoud en de match met jouw expertise? Neem contact op met Merlijn van Hinthem via +31659853110 of merlijn.van.hinthem@dosign.com.

title: Mechanical Engineer

Zij leveren hun systemen turn-key aan luchtvaartmaatschappijen, vliegtuigonderhoudsbedrijven (MRO’s), defensie, en ook aan de procesindustrie en het rollend materieel zoals de treinbranche. De bedrijfscultuur is nuchter, professioneel en gedreven door vakmanschap. Je werkt onder begeleiding van een Lead Engineer en draagt zorg voor een accurate en tijdige technische uitwerking. Je vertaalt ontwerpen naar praktische en maakbare oplossingen en bewaakt de technische specificaties. Je werkt mee aan uiteenlopende projecten en denkt actief mee over verbeteringen van processen en eindproducten. Jouw profiel Je bent een nauwkeurige en betrokken technicus die het leuk vindt om technisch complexe oplossingen tot in detail uit te werken. Je voelt je thuis in een dynamische, projectmatige werkomgeving en levert graag een bijdrage aan hoogwaardige maatwerkoplossingen. Verder breng je de volgende ervaring en vaardigheden mee: Een afgeronde technische HBO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Werktuigbouwkunde; Ervaring met 3D modelleren en 2D tekenen, bij voorkeur met SolidWorks of Tekla; Ervaring binnen een technische, projectmatige omgeving is een pré; Je beheerst de Engelse taal in woord en geschrift; Een gestructureerde en kwaliteitsgerichte werkwijze; Affiniteit met staal-/aluminiumbouw; Je past bij de kernwaarden van NIJL: trots, samen, dynamisch, betrokken en klantgericht. title: Ervaren Mechanical Engineer | Machinebouw
description: Combineer technologie en innovatie en maak positieve impact op de wereld! Onze oplossingen helpen voedselverspilling te verminderen, productieketens duurzamer te maken en de kwaliteit van voedsel en planten te verhogen. Zo dragen we bij aan een gezondere en efficiëntere wereld. Sluit jij je aan bij ons team en help je mee het verschil te maken? Wat ga je doen? Je werkt in een multidisciplinair team waarbij je als team een totaal project voorbereidt, vanaf ontwerp tot bestelling, zowel mechanisch als elektrisch. Als Engineer maak je de tekeningen voor een project en denk je mee in nieuwe concepten voor specifieke lijnen. Je werkt nauw samen met het hoofd engineering, de projectleiders, de engineers in de fabriek en de afdeling inkoop. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van je tekeningen en het up to date houden daarvan. Wat wordt van jou verwacht? Je bent een engineer die het leuk vindt om zelfstandig te werken, maar je vindt het ook leuk om samen met een team te ontwikkelen. Je kunt samenwerken en overleggen. Je hebt ideeën, maar je kunt ook luisteren. Je kunt in opdracht werken, maar je vindt het ook leuk om zelf dingen te ontwikkelen en aan te dragen. Je bent nauwkeurig en je vindt het belangrijk om kwaliteit te leveren. Je houdt van een dynamische omgeving, waarin er ook iets gevraagd wordt van jouw initiatief. Een greep uit jouw werkzaamheden: Proactief deelnemen aan het ontwerpproces van (speciaal)machines en systemen. Opstellen van technische tekeningen van goede kwaliteit conform normen. Zelfstandig oplossingen kunnen bedenken voor de wensen van de klant. Initiatief nemen en verbeteringen van bestaande machines / onderdelen aandragen. Aanpassingen en verbeteringen doorvoeren in tekenpakketten. Nauwe samenwerking met collega’s in de werkplaats en op het projectbureau. Wat kunnen we je bieden? Bij Viscon werk je in een innovatieve en groeiende organisatie die wereldwijd impact maakt met slimme technologische oplossingen. Wij zorgen goed voor onze medewerkers en bieden jou: Bruto fulltime maandsalaris tot € 5.800 afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring. 25 vakantiedagen en 6 ATV-dagen. Met volgend jaar een uitbreiding van 2 ATV-dagen. Een goede pensioenregeling. Opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden. Een informele werksfeer met betrokken collega’s. Internationale projecten en veel afwisseling in je werk. Wat vragen we van je? We zoeken een Mechancial Engineer die nieuwsgierig is, analytisch denkt en graag samenwerkt. Verder vragen we: HBO of WO-opleiding in een technische richting, zoals Werktuigbouwkunde of Mechatronica. Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring, in RVS machinebouw is helemaal mooi meegenomen. Bij voorkeur ervaring met Solidworks. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden. Zelfstandig, kritisch en oplossingsgericht, je combineert analytische precisie met pragmatische uitvoering. Goede beheersing van Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift, Duits is een pré. Waarom je deze functie juist bij Viscon wilt uitvoeren? Bij Viscon Group zijn we niet alleen gepassioneerd door technologische innovaties, maar ook door de positieve impact die hebben op onze wereld en gezondheid. Door onze geavanceerde machines, software en geïntegreerde oplossingen maken we het mogelijk om op een duurzamere en efficiëntere manier gezond vers voedsel, bloemen en planten te produceren en te distribueren. Onze technologische oplossingen dragen niet alleen bij aan het verminderen van voedselverspilling, maar ook het verhogen van de voedselkwaliteit en het optimaliseren van de productieprocessen. Door het gebruik van de nieuwste technologieën streven we ernaar om agrarische processen niet alleen rendabeler en schaalbaar te maken, maar ook om de impact op het milieu te verminderen en de gezondheid van mensen te verbeteren. Bij Viscon Group geloven we dat technologie de kracht heeft om de wereld te veranderen en een positieve bijdrage te leveren aan de gezondheid en het welzijn van mensen. Daarom blijven we ons inzetten voor het ontwikkelen van baanbrekende innovaties die niet alleen onze klanten, maar ook de samenleving als geheel ten goede komen.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: Als Senior Mechanical Engineer bij Eurosort draag jij de volledige verantwoordelijkheid voor het mechanisch ontwerp binnen de projecten, van scopebepaling tot realisatie. Je combineert diepgaande technische kennis met leiderschap: je werkt zelf aan uitdagende engineeringvraagstukken, maar bent ook verantwoordelijk voor het aansturen, begeleiden en verbeteren van het werk binnen jouw projecten. Van de eerste technische scope en 2D lay-out tot de uiteindelijke realisatie. Jij behoud het overzicht, bewaakt de kwaliteit en zorgt dat alles klopt. Je opereert in het hart van de engineeringfase en werkt intensief samen met Project Lead Engineers, Project Managers en de andere disciplines binnen de organisatie. Je bent sparringpartner, besluitvormer en coach tegelijk. Binnen projecten neem jij de lead in het definiëren van werkzaamheden, het verdelen van taken en het bewaken van de voortgang, en de kwaliteit. Tegelijkertijd krijg je binnen bepaalde kaders bij Eurosort de vrijheid om jouw rol vorm te geven: of je nu energie haalt uit techniek, coaching of stakeholdermanagement, samen word er gekeken waar jij het beste in je kracht komt. Wat bieden wij Salaris tussen €4.750 – €5.500 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week) Een sleutelrol binnen een internationale en groeiende organisatie Prestatiegerichte bonusregeling tot maximaal 150% van je bruto maandsalaris 30 vakantiedagen per jaar o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband Veel ruimte voor persoonlijke en technische ontwikkeling Mogelijkheden tot trainingen en cursussen (technisch & soft skills) Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per km Vergoeding van 70% van je pensioenbijdrage Laptop & telefoon (ook privé te gebruiken) Werken aan complexe, high-tech machinebouwprojecten Veel autonomie, verantwoordelijkheid en invloed binnen projecten Een sterk engineeringteam met korte lijnen en informele werksfeer Wat ga je doen In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige mechanische engineeringproces binnen projecten. Je werkt aan complexe technische vraagstukken, maar richt je vooral op het definiëren, coördineren en bewaken van het werk. Je zorgt dat ontwerpen technisch kloppen, maakbaar zijn en aansluiten op productie, assemblage en installatie. Daarbij werk je met tools zoals Inventor (3D CAD), Vault (PDM), Ridder IQ (ERP) en Jira voor project- en taakmanagement. Je bent actief in zowel CTO- als ETO-projecten, waarbij je vooral binnen ETO de lead neemt in maatwerkoplossingen. Je bepaalt de technische scope samen met stakeholders, zet projecten op, verdeelt werkzaamheden en bewaakt de voortgang. Daarnaast speel je een sleutelrol in kwaliteitscontrole: je reviewt werk van engineers, geeft feedback en zorgt dat alles in één keer goed is (“first time right”). Je bent daarnaast nauw betrokken bij CE-richtlijnen en machineveiligheid, en zorgt dat ontwerpen veilig, efficiënt en onderhoudsvriendelijk zijn. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Initiëren, opzetten en coördineren van mechanische engineeringprojecten Definiëren van de technische scope samen met de Project Lead Engineer Maken van 2D lay-outs en uitwerken van complexe ontwerpen Ontwerpen en reviewen van 3D modellen in Inventor Controleren en vrijgeven van tekeningen en technische documentatie Verdelen van werkzaamheden binnen het team en het bewaken van de voortgang Coachen, begeleiden en ontwikkelen van junior en medior engineers Actief deelnemen aan en leiden van design reviews en technische overleggen Waar nodig communiceren met klanten over technische oplossingen Opstellen en bewaken van materiaallijsten (BOM) en technische specificaties Ondersteunen van productie, assemblage en service met technische input Deelnemen aan CE-risicoanalyses en borgen van machineveiligheid Signaleren van risico’s, knelpunten en verbeterkansen binnen projecten Bijdragen aan standaardisatie, optimalisatie en procesverbeteringen Monitoren van projectvoortgang, uren en technische kwaliteit (o.a. via Jira) Vereisten HBO of MBO+ opleiding in Werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar 5+ jaar relevante werkervaring binnen de machinebouw of vergelijkbare omgeving Uitgebreide ervaring met 3D CAD software (Inventor) en 2D tekeningen Ervaring met Vault (PDM), ERP systemen (bijv. Ridder IQ) en Jira is een pré Sterke kennis van productieprocessen, assemblage en toleranties (GD&T) Ervaring met CE-richtlijnen en machineveiligheid Ervaring met het begeleiden en coachen van engineers Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en overtuigingskracht In staat om technische keuzes te onderbouwen en anderen mee te nemen Analytisch sterk, oplossingsgericht en kwaliteitsbewust Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal Teamspeler met leiderschapskwaliteiten Over Eurosort Eurosort ontwikkelt en produceert geavanceerde automatische sorteersystemen voor logistieke processen wereldwijd. Vanuit onze locatie in ’s-Graveland werken we met een team van specialisten aan maatwerkoplossingen voor klanten in onder andere e-commerce, logistiek en distributie. Van ontwerp tot installatie en support: we doen het samen. Met nuchtere mensen, korte lijnen en een flinke dosis commerciële daadkracht. Bij Eurosort kun jij jezelf zijn, en werken in een veilige omgeving zodat jij het beste uit jezelf kan halen. Wil jij je verder ontwikkelen? Eurosort stimuleert en ondersteunt jou om het beste uit jezelf te halen. Kortom: een groeiende professionele organisatie met een informele cultuur waar jij er toe doet.

title: Research And Development Engineer
description: R&D Engineer About Your New Employer Our client is an innovative medical device company developing next-generation catheter-based technologies to support the treatment of serious conditions. You will join a multidisciplinary product development team based in Galway. About Your New Job Reporting to the Principal R&D Engineer, you will play a key role in the development of catheter-based medical devices, with an initial focus on catheter components, manufacturing processes, and supplier capabilities. As an R&D Engineer, you will: Lead the development of catheter components, manufacturing processes, and supplier capabilities. Design, build, and evaluate prototypes to support product development activities. Develop test methods, test platforms, and bench models for device development, verification, and validation. Design and execute experiments, analyse technical data, and use results to guide product design decisions. Apply principles of mechanics, fluid dynamics, materials science, and statistics to solve technical challenges. Develop assembly processes and manufacturing methods for catheter-based medical devices. Apply Design for Manufacture and Design for Assembly principles throughout product development. Support validation activities for components, processes, and test methods. Participate in design and process risk management activities, including DFMEA and PFMEA. Work with suppliers and external partners to support component development and manufacturing scale-up. Prepare technical reports, specifications, protocols, and development documentation. Maintain laboratory equipment and facilities in a safe and compliant manner. Keep informed of relevant technologies, standards, and test methodologies. Contribute to invention generation and intellectual property development. Support demonstrations of company technology for clinical collaborators, investors, and other stakeholders. This is a hands-on engineering role suited to someone who takes a first-principles approach to problem solving. You will be expected to break down complex problems, design experiments to test assumptions, and use data to drive engineering decisions. What Skills You Need A Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Biomedical, Materials, Polymer Engineering, or a related discipline. Minimum three years of product development experience within the medical device industry. Practical experience in medical device design, prototype development, and laboratory testing. Experience developing and executing experimental test programmes. The ability to analyse technical data and use evidence to inform design decisions. Experience working within a regulated product development environment. Knowledge of medical device design controls and risk management processes. Experience using SolidWorks and Microsoft Office. A hands-on and methodical approach to technical problem solving. The ability to work collaboratively with R&D, Preclinical, Operations, suppliers, and external partners. What's on Offer The opportunity to work on innovative medical device technology with the potential to improve patient outcomes. A varied, hands-on engineering role covering product design, prototyping, testing, manufacturing, and supplier development. The opportunity to work in a collaborative and fast-paced product development environment. The chance to contribute to invention generation, intellectual property development, and the advancement of next-generation medical technologies. What's Next Apply now to be considered for this R&D Engineer opportunity in Galway. If you have medical device product development experience and are passionate about developing innovative, patient-focused technologies, we would be delighted to hear from you.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Mechanical Design Engineer: Develop robust medical devices from concept to production Would you like to use your mechanical engineering expertise to develop medical devices that make a real difference for people with intimate healthcare needs? Working with engineers, scientists and project managers, you will turn product requirements and concepts into robust mechanical solutions, combining creative problem-solving with engineering rigour from concept evaluation through to production. Welcome to CC & BC Mechanical Engineering At our headquarters in Humlebæk, Denmark, you will join CC & BC Mechanical Engineering within Product Development, developing products for Continence Care and Bowel Care. Mechanical design connects what users need with how a product performs and how reliably it can be manufactured. Our work brings together functionality, materials, tolerances and production considerations to create practical solutions that perform consistently in everyday use. You will work closely with colleagues across Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, Technical Design, Materials, Systems Engineering, Usability and Test Engineering, as well as Manufacturing Systems Development and Centre of Excellence specialists. Turn product concepts into reliable, manufacturable solutions As our new Mechanical Design Engineer, you will plan and deliver mechanical design activities in Product Development projects. Your work will span concept development and evaluation, detailed design, verification support and transfer to production. You will take ownership of your mechanical deliverables and provide clear technical conclusions and recommendations. Working within the agreed project scope, you will identify risks early, make design trade-offs visible and bring in the right expertise to move decisions forward. More specifically, you will: Develop and evaluate mechanical concepts, translating product requirements into practical design solutions in collaboration with Systems Engineering and relevant specialists. Develop and document mechanical designs using 3D CAD, working closely with Technical Design on drawings and specifications. Apply robust design methods and tolerance analysis to understand variation and secure reliable product performance. Apply Design for X principles to balance performance, manufacturability, sustainability and cost, involving manufacturing specialists early. Use calculations, simulation, prototypes and test evidence to evaluate solutions and support timely design decisions. Contribute mechanical expertise to risk assessments, verification planning, technical reviews and design documentation. Plan and deliver your activities against agreed project commitments, communicating risks, dependencies and the impact of proposed changes early. Share technical learning and help improve mechanical design practices across projects. A mechanical engineer with practical judgement and a collaborative approach You enjoy both exploring concepts and working through the details that make a design reliable. You can turn analysis into clear recommendations, explain design trade-offs and challenge unclear assumptions constructively. You take a structured approach without making solutions more complex than necessary. You understand when further analysis is needed and when the available evidence supports moving forward. Above all, you take responsibility for your work while recognising that strong product solutions depend on contributions from several disciplines. We imagine that you: Hold a BSc or MSc in mechanical engineering, mechanical design, product development or a related discipline. Have experience developing mechanical solutions, including plastic components for injection moulding and high-volume production. Work confidently with 3D CAD, preferably SolidWorks. Have experience with robust design, tolerance calculations and design for manufacture. Can apply engineering theory, calculations and data analysis to practical design challenges. Communicate technical ideas and conclusions clearly, both visually and verbally. Work effectively across disciplines and document your work clearly. Communicate confidently in English. Experience in medical devices or another regulated industry is an advantage. We also value experience with simulation and an interest in using digital tools, including AI where relevant, to improve engineering analysis and development efficiency. You do not need to know every method from the outset. Curiosity, sound engineering judgement and a willingness to develop your expertise are important. Interested? title: Customer Solutions Engineer, Mechanical
description: Jupiter Bach is taking the next step in its development as a partner to the global wind industry. Building on our strong position within composite manufacturing, we are expanding our capabilities across engineering, assembly and full-system delivery, supporting leading wind OEMs globally. This means getting involved earlier in the customer dialogue and taking greater ownership of how customer requirements translate into technically sound and commercially viable solutions. As our new Customer Solutions Engineer, Mechanical, you will be an important part of that development. The opportunity You will work at the intersection of customers, Sales and Engineering, shaping mechanical solutions from early customer engagement through to handover to Project Execution. Your role is to understand the customer need, challenge and clarify requirements, and apply your mechanical engineering expertise to develop the right solution. Working closely with customer technical teams and specialists within Jupiter Bach, you will drive the technical dialogue and pre-project activities while considering both engineering feasibility and commercial implications. This is a role for an engineer who wants to use technical depth beyond the traditional engineering function. You will be close to the customer, influence solutions at an early stage and help create a strong foundation for successful engineering and execution. What you will work with You will take responsibility for the technical side of customer opportunities during pre-sales and early project phases. A key part of the role will be to: Act as the technical interface towards customers during pre-sales and early project phases Translate customer requirements into feasible mechanical engineering solutions Apply your understanding of mechanical design, components and manufacturing to solution development Support Sales in customer meetings, proposals and negotiations Drive pre-project activities and technical alignment between customers and internal specialists Prepare and validate technical cost calculations and provide input to pricing decisions Assess engineering changes and their technical and commercial impact Support customer claims through root cause analysis and corrective actions Work within PPAP and APQP4Wind processes to ensure quality and robustness You will be part of a growing team that combines different technical competencies with ownership of specific customers and opportunities. Who we are looking for We are looking for an engineer with strong mechanical expertise who is motivated by applying that knowledge in a customer- and solution-oriented role. You understand how mechanical products and components move from requirements and design through manufacturing and into serial production. Just as importantly, you can communicate your technical knowledge and work effectively with customers, engineers, manufacturing specialists and commercial colleagues. We expect you to bring: An engineering background in Mechanical, Structural, Manufacturing or another relevant engineering discipline Practical experience with mechanical design and CAD Experience designing components and solutions for industrial manufacturing Relevant experience from the wind industry or another technically complex manufacturing environment Good understanding of manufacturing processes and engineering interfaces The ability to balance technical, operational and commercial considerations Strong communication and stakeholder management skills Professional fluency in English Experience with PPAP and APQP4Wind is an advantage. Danish language skills are an advantage but not a requirement. Why Jupiter Bach? Jupiter Bach is expanding from a strong composite manufacturing base towards broader engineering and full-system capabilities. For an experienced mechanical engineer, this creates an opportunity to move closer to the customer and influence solutions much earlier in the process. You will join an international organisation working with leading wind OEMs and have the opportunity to contribute directly to how Jupiter Bach develops its future engineering and customer solution capabilities. Contact For more information about the role, please contact recruitment partner, Lotte Christensen, at loc@slaterconsult.com . Slater Consult is Jupiter Bachs’s recruiting partner for this position.

title: PhD scholarship in Soft Robotic Applications - DTU Electro
location: Kongens Lyngby, Danimarka Başkent Bölgesi, Danimarka
description: Job Description Are you interested in developing innovative robotic systems that can adapt their mechanical properties to interact safely and effectively with their environment? Do you have a background in robotics, mechatronics, and control, and enjoy combining mechanical design with hands-on experimental research? At DTU Electro, you will have the opportunity to develop and validate novel robotic technologies integrating compliant mechanisms, variable stiffness, and advanced control strategies. Your research will contribute to the development of adaptable robotic systems capable of performing complex physical operations in challenging and uncertain environments. The PhD position is part of RESSORT, a European research project aimed at advancing soft and adaptive robotics through the integration of innovative materials, compliant structures, sensing, and intelligent control. The project addresses the limitations of conventional rigid robotic systems by developing solutions capable of adapting their mechanical behaviour to different tasks and operating conditions. Your research will focus on the design, modelling, and control of robotic systems incorporating soft and variable-stiffness mechanisms. Particular attention will be given to the integration of mechanical adaptability and control to improve physical interaction, operational stability, and performance. The developed methods will be implemented and experimentally validated on robotic platforms, including adaptive and morphing aerial systems. Responsibilities And Qualifications Your main responsibility will be to investigate and develop mechatronic and control solutions for soft and adaptive robotic systems. The research will combine mechanical design, dynamic modelling, control development, and experimental validation, addressing the challenges associated with integrating compliant structures into robotic platforms. Your primary tasks will include: Design and develop compliant and variable-stiffness mechanisms for robotic applications. Develop mathematical and dynamic models of robotic systems incorporating flexible and adaptive mechanical structures. Investigate control strategies to manage changes in mechanical configuration, stiffness, and interaction forces. Integrate actuators, sensors, and embedded control systems into experimental robotic platforms. Develop methods for stable and efficient robotic operation under varying mechanical and environmental conditions. Implement and validate the developed technologies through simulations and experiments on real robotic systems. Collaborate with international research and industrial partners and disseminate research results through scientific publications and conferences. We expect you to have a strong background in mechatronics, robotics, mechanical engineering, control engineering, or a closely related field. Solid competences in mechanical design, dynamic modelling, and control of robotic systems are particularly important. Experience with CAD tools, actuators, embedded systems, and experimental prototyping will be considered an advantage. Good programming skills in MATLAB/Simulink, C++, and/or Python are expected. Familiarity with compliant mechanisms, soft robotics, variable-stiffness systems, or aerial robotics will be beneficial. We are particularly interested in candidates who enjoy combining theoretical developments with practical implementation and experimental work. You should be motivated to develop innovative solutions, work independently, and contribute actively to a multidisciplinary and international research environment. You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree. Approval and Enrolment The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education . Assessment The assessment of applicants will be based on their academic qualifications, research potential, and relevance of their technical background to the proposed PhD project. Particular emphasis will be placed on competences in mechatronic design, dynamic modelling, and control, as well as demonstrated experience in the development and experimental validation of robotic systems. We offer DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility. Salary and appointment terms The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures The period of employment is 3 years. Starting date is 1 February 2027 (or according to mutual agreement). The position is a full-time position. You can read more about career paths at DTU here . Further information Further information may be obtained from Associate Professor Matteo Fumagalli, mafum@dtu.dk . You can read more about the department at www.electro.dtu.dk . If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark . Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “ PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar ” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer Getinge Sterilization

Tidigare erfarenhet av tryckkärl är även det meriterande. Förutom tekniska färdigheter värderar vi din personlighet högt. Som person tror vi att du är strukturerad och noggrann men samtidigt öppen för olika tankar, idéer och input från dina kollegor. Vi ser att du är engagerad och driven i ditt arbete och att du trivs med att arbeta tillsammans med vår andra tekniska grupperingar inklusive vår produktion. Framför allt bryr vi oss om varandra för att vi som team och bolag ska kunna fortsatta utveckla världsledande produkter. Vi är Team Players, Forward Thinkers och Game Changers! Vi fokuserar på att utveckla människor och tillsammans skapar vi en plan för lärande och kompetensutveckling när du börjar din karriär hos oss. title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer – Exhaust Aftertreatment Systems (EATS)
description: We are looking for an experienced Design Engineer – Exhaust Aftertreatment Systems (EATS) to join our engineering team and contribute to the development of advanced, reliable, and sustainable engine technologies. The ideal candidate will have experience in EATS muffler or UDS (Urea Dosing System) development , with strong technical expertise in mechanical design and a willingness to explore new technologies and broaden their engineering capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to work across the entire product development lifecycle, from concept development and requirement definition to design, verification, testing, validation, and documentation. Key Responsibilities Develop and optimize exhaust aftertreatment components, with a primary focus on muffler design and system performance. Contribute to concept generation, technical requirement setting, detailed design, and product development activities. Perform design verification, testing, validation, and analysis to ensure product quality and reliability. Design components suitable for demanding thermal, vibration, and mechanical operating environments. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including component owners, engine test engineers, simulation engineers, project managers, and suppliers. Support technical problem-solving, root cause analysis, and implementation of design improvements. Ensure compliance with engineering requirements, performance targets, and applicable quality standards. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, design specifications, and verification reports. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and the development of robust, efficient, and sustainable aftertreatment solutions. Build technical knowledge across related engineering disciplines and contribute to system-level development activities. Required Skills And Experience Experience in EATS muffler development or UDS (Urea Dosing System) development. Strong understanding of mechanical design and component development. Experience with CAD tools for 3D modelling and engineering design. Knowledge of component design considerations for thermal, vibration, and mechanical loads. Experience in design verification, testing, validation, and technical documentation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional engineering teams and external suppliers. Good communication skills and a proactive approach to technical challenges. Preferred Qualifications Experience with KOLA or similar engineering tools. Knowledge of exhaust aftertreatment systems and engine-related components. Experience in concept development, design optimization, and system performance evaluation. Familiarity with simulation, testing, and validation processes. Experience working in automotive, engine development, or industrial engineering environments.

title: Mechanical/Product Design Engineer
description: Design the products where motors, pumps, water and heat all have to work together, and own each one from concept to tooling. You'll be one of three engineers joining a wet NPD team being rebuilt in the UK, so how it works is partly yours to shape. Vax is one of the best-known names in British floor care, and it turns 50 next year. It's part of TTI, the global group behind Milwaukee and Ryobi, so the backing is serious. Product development has been brought back to the UK, and engineering is being rebuilt around short design, build and test loops, with ideas proven on the bench rather than debated. The role You'll own the mechanical and design engineering of carpet washers, spray extraction and steam cleaners, where sealing, pressure and heat behave very differently to dry assemblies. That means CAD of complex parts and assemblies in CREO (any mainstream package is fine to start), tolerance stack ups and FEA to prove a design before you commit, the materials and manufacturing calls, and drawing specifications through to tooling. You'll work across engineering, design, commercial and the product review committee, and challenge gaps in a design when you see them. It suits a hands-on, curious engineer who would rather build a prototype than wait for a perfect brief, and who wants a real say in how a new team works. What you'll need Proven experience designing motorised products that handle fluids, such as pumps, pressure, spray, steam or heating, with the mechanical design decisions sitting with you. A track record of taking products from concept through to production, with strong 3D CAD of complex parts and assemblies in a mainstream package. title: PhD in Multifunctional Polymer Composites
description: Introduction Are you inspired to push the limits of polymeric materials for lighter and smarter defense platforms? Join us to develop a new generation of 3D-printed composite panels that shield electronics from electromagnetic threats and withstand impact. Job Description We are offering 2 PhD positions within project VALOR, an ambitious, interdisciplinary collaboration between academia, industry and government partners. The project aims to develop a new generation of lightweight composite panels that both shield sensitive electronics from electromagnetic threats and withstand impact events, helping to make defense platforms safer and more resilient. Naval ships, drones and military vehicles increasingly depend on electronic radar, communication and navigation systems that must be protected against electromagnetic interference and radar detection . Today, this is mostly done with metals, which block practically all wave power with only a thin layer. However, they add weight, corrode, and reflect electromagnetic waves, making platforms easier to detect. Project VALOR tackles this challenge by merging two fields that have so far been developed separately: absorption-based electromagnetic shielding and impact-resistant sandwich structures . By combining 3D-printed architected nanocomposite materials with predictive modelling into one integrated design strategy, the project will construct a design framework for panels that are able to both carry loads and absorb electromagnetic waves, with a performance that can be tailored to specific (defense) applications. Your role We Are Recruiting Two PhD Candidates Who Will Work As a Team Throughout The Project, I.e. From Material Screening To Design And Testing Of Larger Scale Panel Demonstrators. Both Candidates Will Conduct a Combination Of Experimental And Numerical Work And Collaborate Closely With Industrial Partners Within The Consortium. More Specifically PhD 1 focuses on mechanics and manufacturing: 3D printing nanocomposite lattice materials, fabricating composite facesheets, conducting mechanical tests, constructing and validating mechanical finite element models. PhD 2 focuses on electromagnetic testing and design: formulating polymer nanocomposite materials and characterizing their electromagnetic behaviour, designing and testing absorbing architected nanocomposite structures, conducting electromagnetic shielding simulations. The group has around 20 PhD and post-doctoral researchers working on how processing, structure and properties connect in polymers and polymer-based composite materials. title: Junior Mechanical Engineer Olie- en gas
description: Over de vacature In deze rol werk je, als deel van het Mechanical-team, aan het ontwerpen en modelleren van klantspecifieke mechanische systemen die worden toegepast binnen de proces- en energiesector. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het opzetten van technische tekeningen in 2D en 3D, het beoordelen van ontwerpen van leveranciers en het vertalen van technische concepten naar maakbare oplossingen. Je werkzaamheden sluiten aan bij disciplines als Werktuigbouwkunde, Constructie en Systeemintegratie. Samen met project- en salesengineers werk je aan het realiseren van complete installaties voor internationale klanten in de olie, gas en (petro)chemie. Je werkt aan projecten die gericht zijn op het ontwerpen en realiseren van geavanceerde meet- en bemonsteringssystemen voor vloeistoffen en gassen. Gedurende de tijd dat je bij het bedrijf werkt, zul je on the job trainingen krijgen, waardoor werkervaring niet verplicht is. Onze opdrachtgever is gespecialiseerd in ontwerp, bouw en inbedrijfstelling van instrumenten die aangeven of de metingen die gedaan worden (bijvoorbeeld: de hoeveelheid olie die uit de grond gehaald) ook kloppen. Zij beschikken over multidisciplinaire expertise in Werktuigbouwkunde, Instrumentatie, Elektrotechniek, Software en Procesautomatisering. Met wereldwijde vestigingen realiseren zij voor energie, chemie en olie- en gasbedrijven, volledig op maat gemaakte meetsystemen. Wat ga je doen? Opstellen en uitwerken van technische tekeningen en 3D-modellen van mechanische systemen; Beoordelen en verwerken van tekeningen van leveranciers; Coördineren van tekenwerk met interne en externe partijen; Controleren van ontwerpen op maakbaarheid, onderhoudsvriendelijkheid, veiligheid en ergonomie; Adviseren over materiaalgebruik, opstelling en constructieve details; Ondersteunen van de projectuitvoering met duidelijke technische documentatie. Wat neem je mee? MBO-diploma Werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar; Ervaring met 3D-tekenpakketten, bij voorkeur AutoCAD en/of Inventor; Affiniteit met mechanische constructies, materialen en productietechniek is een pré; Een nauwkeurige en gestructureerde werkhouding; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels; Hands-on mentaliteit en teamgerichte instelling. Wat bieden we jou? Salaris op basis van opleiding en ervaring; Vakantiegeld (8,33%) en vakantiedagen (minimaal 25 p/j); Netto onkostenvergoeding van €500 op jaarbasis; Een pensioenregeling en optie tot deelname collectieve zorgverzekering; Gratis opleidingen en trainingen op onze eigen Academy; Indien gewenst begeleiding door een specialist binnen jouw vakgebied. Vragen over deze vacature? Heb je (technische) vragen over deze rol of wil je vrijblijvend sparren over de inhoud en de match met jouw expertise? Neem contact op met Nadine van Schie via +31686816336 of nadine.van.schie@dosign.com.

title: Project Engineer
description: Vous aimez comprendre comment les choses fonctionnent, concevoir des solutions techniques et transformer une idée en un produit concret ? Rejoignez MAC Valves Europe et participez au développement de solutions pneumatiques sur mesure pour des applications industrielles variées. Qui sommes-nous ? MAC Valves, Inc. est une entreprise américaine spécialisée dans les technologies électropneumatiques de pointe (siège à Wixom, Michigan). MAC Valves Europe est basée à Ans, près de Liège, et couvre les marchés EMEA ainsi que l'Inde. Avec environ 85 collaborateurs, nous combinons la dimension internationale d'un groupe industriel et la proximité d'une structure à taille humaine. Pour renforcer notre département technique, nous recherchons un·e Ingénieur·e Industriel·le motivé·e par la conception mécanique, le développement de produits et le suivi de projets techniques. Une première expérience n'est pas indispensable : la curiosité technique, la motivation et l'envie d'apprendre sont les qualités que nous privilégions. Votre mission Au sein du bureau technique, vous participez au développement de solutions pneumatiques adaptées aux besoins spécifiques de nos clients (production industrielle, verrerie, médical, tri, automation...), en collaboration avec nos distributeurs et les autres départements de l'entreprise. Vous prenez progressivement en charge vos propres projets, de l'étude initiale jusqu'à l'industrialisation. Vos principales responsabilités : Concevoir : Analyser les besoins des clients et étudier la faisabilité des solutions envisagées. Réaliser la conception mécanique et les plans à l'aide de SolidWorks. Piloter : Suivre les projets de bout en bout, du besoin à la mise en production : essais, industrialisation et documentation technique. Accompagner : Participer à des visites sur site, réaliser des mesures et des essais, contribuer à la résolution des problèmes et à l'analyse des retours de terrain. Évoluer : Devenir progressivement référent technique d'une gamme de produits et, à terme, former les équipes commerciales et les distributeurs. Votre profil Vous êtes récemment diplômé·e en ingénierie industrielle ou disposez d'une première expérience professionnelle. Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement technique varié, où à la réflexion, la conception et la résolution de problèmes occupent une place importante. Votre formation : Master en science de l'ingénieur industriel (jeune diplômé·e ou première expérience) Bonnes connaissances de SolidWorks ou d'un logiciel de CAO mécanique similaire Bonne maîtrise de l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit Vos qualités : La curiosité, la méthode et la rigueur font partie de vos principales qualités, vous cherchez des solutions concrètes et prenez des initiatives. Vous appréciez autant le travail en équipe que la conduite de vos propres projets, et vous êtes à l'aise face à des situations nouvelles. Aucune connaissance en pneumatique industrielle n'est nécessaire. Vous bénéficierez d'une formation progressive à nos produits et à nos méthodes de développement, avec l'accompagnement des membres du bureau technique. Le poste implique des déplacement professionnels, principalement en Europe et occasionnellement en Asie ou aux États-Unis. Une disponibilité pour voyager et un bon sens pratique sont donc attendus. Notre offre Un poste technique varié, combinant conception mécanique, développement de produits et suivi de projets La possibilité de suivre des projets, de l'analyse du besoin jusqu'aux essais et à la mise en production Une montée en compétences progressive, pour développer votre expertise technique et gagner en autonomie, notamment via un programme de formation en interne Un environnement international avec des échanges réguliers et des possibilités de déplacement à l'étranger Une entreprise à taille humaine, où vous collaborez avec différents départements et contribuerez concrètement aux projets Un package salarial attractif, en accord avec le marché, comprenant des avantages extralégaux : voiture en fonction, téléphone, ordinateur, congés d'ancienneté et primes Envie de nous rejoindre ? Envoyez votre CV et quelques mots sur votre motivation à Fabienne Léonard, Coordinatrice RH (fabienne.leonard@macvalves.be)

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: The Impact You'll Make As our Mechanical Engineer , you'll join the Research & Development team at Danfoss Climate Solutions in Ljubljana and play a hands-on role in developing the next generation of heating and district energy solutions. Your impact? You'll turn engineering concepts into reliable, manufacturable products — from the early design and prototyping stages through testing, documentation, production, and continuous improvement. Your work will contribute to products such as control valves, electromechanical actuators, and district heating substations used in modern, energy-efficient heating systems. You'll be part of a highly collaborative team of experienced engineers working across disciplines. We value knowledge sharing, mentoring, and different perspectives — giving you the opportunity not only to contribute your expertise, but also to continuously develop it. What You’ll Be Doing Contribute to new product development from concept to project handover, including mechanical design, prototyping, simulations, testing, and preparation of final product documentation. Develop and maintain technical documentation and product specifications, ensuring that designs are clearly documented and ready to support manufacturing. Support product improvements and engineering changes, identifying opportunities to improve product performance, manufacturability, quality, and time-to-market. Collaborate across functions with R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Product Management, and other teams to resolve technical challenges, optimize production, and manage product changes. Take ownership of your engineering expertise and project responsibilities, ensuring milestones and deadlines are met while continuously developing your knowledge of new technologies, tools, and engineering methods. What We're Looking For We're looking for a hands-on Mechanical Engineer who enjoys turning ideas into real products and solving practical engineering challenges. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field, with at least 3 years of experience in mechanical product development or a similar engineering role. Practical experience with 3D CAD modelling, preferably Creo, and an understanding of mechanical design and product development processes. Experience working in multidisciplinary teams, with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, manufacturing, quality, and other functions. Knowledge of HVAC, heating, hydronic, or district energy systems is highly valuable, together with a willingness to learn and develop expertise in new technologies. Fluent English and strong communication skills, combined with a proactive, results-oriented mindset and the ability to take ownership of your work. What You'll Get From Us The opportunity to work on innovative, market-leading heating and district energy technologies that contribute to more energy-efficient and sustainable buildings. A hands-on engineering role where you can see your work move from concept and CAD model to a real product used in the market. Collaboration with experienced engineers and experts in mechanical design, mechatronics, heating technologies, manufacturing, and product development. A strong focus on learning, mentoring, and professional development, with opportunities to expand both your technical expertise and your broader engineering skills. A permanent position in an international and collaborative environment, where knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of how we work. Ready to Make a Difference? If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us. title: Sr. Mechanical Engineer
description: Job Description The Sr. Mechanical Engineer specializing in product design joins the R&D&I team to develop the physical architecture, chassis, and cooling systems for inverters and electrical cabinets to be manufactured. Their mission is to ensure the structural integrity of the equipment, optimize space (“packaging”), ensure proper heat dissipation for critical electronic components, and ensure compliance with applicable technical specifications and regulations. Mission and Main Objective Develop the three-dimensional mechanical design of the equipment, ensuring that it can be manufactured and assembled. Efficiently manage the dissipation of heat generated by the electronics using advanced cooling systems. Ensure compliance with environmental protection, vibration, and mechanical safety regulations for the product. Key Functions 3D Modelling and Drawings: Design the enclosure, support structures, ventilation ducts, and busbar mounting systems. Thermal Simulation (CFD): Perform computational fluid dynamics analyses to optimize heat sinks and cooling systems. Structural Analysis (FEA): Validate the mechanical strength of the chassis against transportation stresses, earthquakes, impacts (IK ratings), and vibrations. Material Selection: Determine the optimal materials (aluminium, steel, engineering plastics) by considering cost, weight, corrosion, and dielectric properties. Tolerance Management and DFMA: Apply design-for-manufacturing-and-assembly (DFMA) methodologies to ensure the equipment’s watertightness (IP ratings). Profile Requirements Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering. A master’s degree or specialization in Thermal Simulation or Product Development is highly desirable. Experience: More than 8 years in mechanical design of capital goods, electrical cabinets, power electronics, or the automotive industry. Fluency in Spanish and English, both written and spoken, is required. Technical Skills Mechanical design of industrial electronic equipment. Advanced proficiency in 3D CAD software (SolidWorks, CATIA, Inventor). Actual experience with thermal and structural simulation tools (ANSYS Fluent, SolidWorks Simulation, Autodesk CFD) is desirable. Knowledge of manufacturing processes (sheet metal, casting, plastic injection moulding, machining). Soft Skills: Ability to work in multidisciplinary teams (with electrical and software engineers), attention to detail, and a focus on innovation. At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure. We are Nextpower

title: Doctoral student in 3D printing the next-generation battery by additive manufacturing
description: Join us at Chalmers University of Technology to pioneer the next generation of batteries through advanced 3D printing and additive manufacturing. Be part of an innovative research team (4 Professors in battery, additive manufacturing, sustainable product design, and AI) exploring new ways to manufacture batteries with greater design flexibility, improved performance, and more sustainable production. About Us At the Department of Mechanical Engineering, we unite the power of technology, people, and society to drive the transition toward a sustainable future. Through research, education, and collaboration, we create solutions that connect materials to mobility, ideas to impact – shaping a resilient and sustainable world. The Division of Materials and Manufacture conducts research across the full value chain, from materials design and processing to advanced manufacturing and characterisation, with a strong emphasis on metallic systems. We combine interdisciplinary expertise with close industry collaboration to develop sustainable materials and manufacturing technologies. About The Research Project What if you could 3D-print a battery? This doctoral project explores advanced additive manufacturing technologies to develop new approaches for battery fabrication, enabling greater design flexibility and new possibilities for integrating battery materials and structures. You will investigate how materials, printing processes and electrode design can be combined to create functional battery components and demonstrate their potential in next-generation energy storage. The research aims to advance innovative and more sustainable battery manufacturing. Who We Are Looking For The following requirements are mandatory: To qualify as a Doctoral student, you must have a Master's degree (masterexamen) of 120 credits or a Master’s degree (magisterexamen) of 60 credits* in materials science, mechanical engineering, materials mechanics, chemical engineering, materials chemistry, physics, or production engineering Strong written and verbal communication skills in English Experience (one of the following) in metal and ceramic additive manufacturing (AM), battery electrode processing, slurry preparation, 3D printing for students with an education earned outside of Sweden, a 4-year Bachelor’s degree is accepted. The position is a fixed-term appointment, with the possibility to teach up to 20%. A starting salary of 35,725 SEK per month (valid from May 1, 2026). title: Laboratory coordinator – Metalography and Additive Manufacturing
description: IMDEA Materials Institute is a public research organization founded in 2007 by Madrid’s regional government to carry out research of excellence in Material Science and Engineering by attracting talent from all over the world to work in an international and multidisciplinary environment. IMDEA Materials has grown rapidly since its foundation and currently includes more than 120 researchers from 22 nationalities and has become one of the leading research centers in materials in Europe which has received the María de Maeztu seal of excellence from the Spanish government. The research activities have been focused on the areas of materials for transport, energy, and health care and the Institute has state-of-the-art facilities for processing, characterization and simulation of advanced materials. More information can be found at our webpage. Description The laboratory coordinator is expected to: Effectively support researchers by providing technical support, demonstrating procedures and collecting, preparing and/or testing samples. Preparation of technical reports. Ensure that the laboratories are well-stocked and resourced and that waste is disposed of according to the established procedure. Understand the requirements, issues and outcomes needed in their technical area. Understand the purpose, operate and maintain the equipment and installations in their laboratories. Take responsibility for ensuring that health and safety practices are followed in their laboratories. Collaborate with management to provide a safe and healthy workplace and carry out health and safety evaluation. Laboratory management tasks: Support laboratory users and train new users. Develop and maintain laboratory procedures, protocols, and instructions. Purchase chemicals and laboratory materials, liaise with suppliers, and monitor stocks. Ensure the proper storage of research materials, including those left by former users. Coordinate equipment maintenance and repairs. Support health and safety compliance in coordination with the H&S Technician, including user guidance, PPE use, and delivery records. Maintain chemical and equipment inventories and the physical SDS repository. Control access to restricted-use equipment, train users, and maintain authorisation records. Manage laboratory waste. Coordinate activities with external service providers. Plan laboratory activities. Identify risks and contribute to risk assessments and accident investigations. Technical tasks: Perform measurements, tests and analysis of results using specialised laboratory equipment, and prepare the corresponding technical reports. Provide training and technical supervision to users in sample preparation and metallographic characterisation. Support additive manufacturing activities, including the use of Reduced Build Volume systems. Perform and support melting, casting and solidification processes, including induction and arc furnaces, casting and drop-casting, directional solidification, infiltration and atomisation. Perform and support powder metallurgy and sintering processes. Perform physical simulation and thermomechanical testing, including tensile and compression tests, melting and solidification studies, dilatometry and phase-transformation analysis, stress-relaxation studies, liquid-embrittlement studies, solid/liquid interface analysis, weld HAZ cycles, and annealing with air or water. Ensure that laboratory procedures comply with applicable quality standards. Perform and coordinate equipment calibration and verification. Troubleshoot and resolve technical and scientific issues. Requirements Required experience : At least 5 years experience in similar position in research institutions Desirable experience : Previous experience in research institutions in technical and research activities. Participation in writing proposals for research projects and providing technical external services. Required training: Vocational training or university degree in Chemistry, Materials science (or similar). English B1. Desirable training : Master in occupational risk prevention. Training in laboratory management and/or quality control systems. English B2. Technical and professional requirements : Metallographic sample preparation and optical microscopy. Hardness testing. Additive manufacturing. Casting and directional solidification. Induction and arc furnaces. Atomisation and powder metallurgy/sintering. Heat treatments. Physical simulation using Gleeble or equivalent equipment, including tensile and compression testing, melting and solidification, dilatometry/phase transformations, and weld HAZ cycles. Laboratory Management : Ensure that laboratory procedures comply with quality standards. Manage and resolve technical and scientific issues. Develop and maintain laboratory procedures, protocols, and instructions. Purchase of chemicals and laboratory material. Contact with suppliers and management of the purchasing process. Monitor the availability of consumables. Supervise adequate storage of research material (including alumni’s). Maintenance and repair of laboratory equipment. Health & safety compliance (in coordination with H&S technician). Initiate coordination of business activities with service providers, planning of activities, assessing and identifying potential risks. Inform and collaborate in the investigation of accidents and in the risk assessment.Educate, train, and guide users on safe working procedures. Ensure that rules are followed and that PPE is used correctly. Sing the PPE delivery registry document for all PPE given. Maintain inventory control of chemicals (including physical SDS repository) and equipment. Restricted-use equipment: identify restricted-use equipment, train, and maintain an updated record of trainees and authorized personnel. Waste management. Desirable technical and profesional requirements : Experience supporting meetings or events involving companies and national or international institutions. Experience training
