title: Calculation Engineer
description: A Snapshot of Your Day Are you ready to make an impact by solving real-world challenges and driving innovation in energy solutions? Join our talented team at Siemens Energy as a Structural Calculation Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the strength, durability, and reliability of our cutting-edge products. You will collaborate with designers daily, contributing to the development of energy solutions that meet the highest industry standards for both onshore and offshore projects. Imagine building and evaluating finite element models to assess static capacity, stiffness, stability, and fatigue of structures while driving efficiency through innovative scripting in Python and MATLAB. Your insights will be delivered through clear technical reports and presentations, making a significant impact on our internal and external stakeholders. How You’ll Make An Impact You will analyze and evaluate finite element models to assess the static capacity, stiffness, stability, and fatigue of structures. Collaborate closely with a team of experienced engineers to develop cost-effective solutions tailored to our customers’ needs. Create and maintain proprietary scripts in Python and MATLAB to streamline processes and innovate new methods of working. Deliver clear and impactful results through technical reports and presentations for both internal and external stakeholders. What You Bring You possess strong analytical skills and a natural talent for solving technical challenges. As a team player, you stay organized and focused, ensuring timely and efficient project delivery. You have experience with the Finite Element Method (FEM) and are skilled in creating simulation models. Hands-on experience with tools like Abaqus, HyperWorks, Ansa, or Ansys is essential; knowledge of MATLAB and/or Python is a bonus! You excel in communication and enjoy building strong relationships with both internal teams and customers. A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related field, with a focus on structural analysis and strength, is required. You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. About The Team You will be part of a team of experienced calculation engineers in a fun and challenging environment, where inclusion and diversity are key pillars. The group is driven by solving challenging problems and staying at the forefront of developing new methods in the field of strength analysis. Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. title: Mechanical Simulations Specialist
description: The opportunity For our Business Unit High Voltage (HV) Products in Sweden, we are looking for a Mechanical Simulations Engineer to strengthen our simulation and analysis group for Live Tank High Voltage Circuit Breakers research and development team. This position involves participation and leading in design, analysis and validation activities related to product development projects. The role requires collaboration with engineers, internal and external stakeholders across the global organization to develop solutions that address various requirements from technology, marketing, and production sectors. “We are excited about solving technical challenges together in a diverse and collaborative environment. If you are eager to learn and develop your skills while working with talented professionals at the Technology Center, join our innovative working culture within an international working environment in Ludvika. We are looking for someone to grow into in this specialized role” – Waqas Tofique, Hiring Manager. How You’ll Make An Impact Lead mechanical and seismic design and qualification activities for HV circuit breakers in accordance with international standards and customer specifications, including IEEE 693, IEC 62271, and utility-specific seismic requirements. Perform and interpret dynamic analyses such as modal analysis, response spectrum analysis (RSA), and transient dynamic simulations using FEA tools (e.g., Abaqus, ANSYS) to assess equipment seismic performance. Develop, validate, and improve finite element models of circuit breakers, support structures, and substation equipment, ensuring correlation with laboratory shake-table testing and field performance data. Participate in R & D Product Development activities adhering to project schedules, costs, and meeting customer expectations. Prepare technical documentation and customer deliverables, including seismic qualification reports, calculations, and design recommendations. Provide support to a global team of seismic engineers through training, knowledge sharing, and active collaboration on all projects. Provide direct support, including direct participation on mechanical and seismic testing programs and provide hands-on support to ensure successful testing campaigns in Swedish and abroad testing facilities. You will be working in a multidisciplinary technical environment where mechanical and electrical considerations are necessary. Convert theoretical results into reality in actual design suggestions in cooperation with product development team. Your background You hold a M.Sc. or Ph.D. degree in Mechanical, Structural, or Civil Engineering. Strong background in structural dynamics, earthquake engineering, and finite element analysis. Knowledge of material behavior, damping characterization, and experimental modal testing. Experience with HV substation equipment, direct circuit breakers is a plus. As a person you get motivated by solving problems and collaborating with others. You have good communication skills and the courage to take on responsibility. The willingness to learn is a key ability to succeed in this position. A general interest in electromechanical systems is needed to be a good fit in this position. The objective is to develop cost-effective solutions that meet all requirements. Fluency in English is required, both written and spoken. Knowledge in Swedish is highly meritorious What We Offer Collective agreement Flexible working hours Health care and wellness allowance Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy, both within Sweden and globally Various training and education supporting employee development Diversified company with over 70+ nationalities working in Sweden Supplementary compensation for parental leave Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks More About Us Are you ready for an exciting new challenge? Does the above description sound like you? Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don’t delay – apply today! title: Maintenance Manager
description: I am Sara , an Executive Consultant , with over 10 years of experience in executive recruitment and consulting for top-tier companies. Projekts is proud to collaborate with over 600 clients, including (Fortune 500 companies), operating in more than 20 countries worldwide. We are currently seeking a Maintenance Manager for GreenField My client, an automotive OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) veyr well knowed and established in EV markets, has just entered a phase of external growth that will profoundly reshape its industrial footprint over the coming years. Several acquisitions are already under review, and executive management has made a clear choice. Position Overview The Maintenance Engineer ensures equipment reliability, maintainability and availability across all four Powertrain APUs — Stator & Rotor, Inverter & Battery, Powertrain Assembly, and Dyno Technology & Testing. Rather than being dedicated to a single line, this role is a shared resource deployed flexibly wherever ramp-up needs are highest, establishing maintenance standards from commissioning through serial production, driving preventive and predictive maintenance, and developing the local maintenance capability required for stable operations plant-wide. Key Responsibilities Maintenance & Reliability Strategy Define preventive, predictive and autonomous maintenance routines across all APUs. Establish equipment handover, maintenance standards and critical spare-parts requirements. Deploy TPM / reliability routines and maintenance performance tracking plant-wide. Commissioning & Equipment Handover Support FAT/SAT, installation, commissioning and maintainability verification across lines. Ensure documentation, spares, PM plans and technical acceptance are complete before handover. Breakdown Elimination & Continuous Improvement Lead troubleshooting and permanent corrective actions for recurring failures on any line. Drive equipment uptime, MTBF and MTTR improvement across the four APUs. Partner with Process and Automation teams to eliminate chronic losses. Cross-APU Prioritization Flex support across APUs based on real-time ramp-up priority, breakdown severity and launch schedule. Maintain visibility of equipment condition and open maintenance issues across all four lines. Technical Scope — By APU APU 1 — Stator & Rotor Winding/forming equipment, impregnation/curing systems, balancing machines and presses. APU 2 — Inverter & Battery HV assembly equipment, dispensing/sealing systems, torque tools and test equipment. Safe maintenance practices for high-voltage manufacturing equipment. APU 3 — Powertrain Assembly Robots, conveyors, presses, torque systems, leak testers and material handling. APU 4 — Dyno Technology & Testing Dynamometers, cooling/conditioning systems, sensors, instrumentation and test racks. Calibration support and utility reliability. Across all APUs: preventive/predictive maintenance, TPM, MTBF/MTTR, spare-parts strategy, equipment availability and rapid breakdown recovery during ramp-up. Capability Transfer Train local technicians and build structured troubleshooting capability across all four APUs. Develop skills matrices and certification requirements for maintenance ownership plant-wide. Skills Strong TPM / RCM, preventive and predictive maintenance knowledge. Advanced troubleshooting across automated manufacturing equipment of different types. Strong reliability analysis, MTBF / MTTR and spare-parts discipline. Working knowledge of CMMS such as SAP PM, Maximo or equivalent. Ability to prioritize and reallocate effort across multiple lines under changing operational pressure. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics or related Engineering discipline. 5-8+ years automotive / EV maintenance or reliability experience. Hands-on commissioning, equipment handover and ramp-up experience. Broad maintenance experience spanning multiple production technologies (e.g. stator/rotor, HV/battery, robotic assembly, or test/dyno systems) is a strong asset. Fluent English required. Preferred Profile A versatile, reliability-focused maintenance engineer who can establish the maintenance system across all four APUs, stabilize equipment performance during ramp-up wherever it is needed most, and build strong local technical capability plant-wide — rather than being anchored to a single line. What is being offered Competitive compensation commensurate with the stakes, a real and openly stated path toward regional leadership, and the rare opportunity to build your own industrial footprint rather than take over someone else's. Added to that are an environment where initiative is expected and rewarded, and flexible working conditions that recognize the importance of your personal balance. Why take this step of your career with Projekts Projekts today supports more than six hundred industrial clients across more than twenty countries, among them Fortune 500 groups. That footprint gives us a concrete reading of executive markets across three continents, and a precise understanding of what separates an appealing promise from a genuine career opportunity. Our approach rests on a simple principle: we take the time to understand in depth the challenges facing our clients and the aspirations of our candidates, because an executive placement only succeeds when both trajectories truly meet. We never present a position without having measured its solidity ourselves, and we support every candidate throughout the process, through to taking up the role and beyond. If this mandate matches what you are seeking for the next stage of your career, I would be glad to discuss it with you directly. All applications are treated in the strictest confidence

title: Field System Engineer
description: The Impact You'll Make As a Field Systems Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring that commercial refrigeration systems used by supermarkets and food retail chains operate reliably, efficiently, and according to the highest technical standards. Your expertise will directly support food quality, energy efficiency, and business continuity for our customers across Türkiye. Working closely with contractors, OEMs, service partners, distributors, and internal teams, you will be the trusted technical expert who helps resolve complex technical challenges and drives successful project execution from commissioning through troubleshooting and customer support. This is a highly visible field-based role where you will combine hands-on engineering knowledge, customer interaction, and technical leadership to help accelerate the adoption of innovative refrigeration solutions. What You’ll Be Doing Provide technical guidance and commissioning support to contractors, OEMs, and service partners, ensuring refrigeration system installations and parameter settings align with Danfoss standards and best practices. Manage customer cases and product investigations, gathering technical data and site information, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring timely communication through resolution. Deliver technical training and develop local-language documentation, helping customers and partners build expertise in Danfoss products and refrigeration applications. Provide technical support to manufacturers, contractors, service providers, distributors, and internal teams through phone, email, remote access, and on-site visits. What We're Looking For At least 3-5 years of practical experience with commercial or supermarket refrigeration systems, including commissioning, troubleshooting, and field support. Strong knowledge of refrigeration cycles, compressors, and refrigerants. Hands-on understanding of electronic controls, sensors, variable speed drives, and industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, CAN, LON, MQTT, and Ethernet/TCP-IP. Professional proficiency in English and Turkish, with the ability to communicate effectively with global and local stakeholders. Ability to influence and guide technical partners, combined with a valid driver's license and willingness to travel extensively across Türkiye. What You'll Get From Us We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities. You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us. We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are. You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great. Ready to Make a Difference? If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us. Our Commitment to Transparency Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice. Want to know more? Please visit our FAQ Page. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

title: Welding Engineer (QA/QC)
description: Who We Are? Founded in 1993, Rönesans Holding operates today as a main contractor and investor across a wide geography spanning Türkiye, Europe, Central Asia, and Africa, with activities in construction, real estate, energy, industrial facilities, and healthcare. With more than 40,000 employees and a global team representing over 60 nationalities, Rönesans ranks among the world’s largest contracting companies and continues to deliver innovative engineering projects on a global scale, driven by its vision of building a sustainable future. We are seeking a Welding Engineer to join our LNG Project to be launched in Mozambique. What You’ll Do? · Prepare, qualify and maintain welding procedure specifications (WPS), procedure qualification records (PQR) and welder performance qualifications (WPQ) for all RET piping, structural steel and HDPE welding on the project, and submit them to the main contractor (CCS JV) for review and approval within the contractual lead time. · Plan and run welder qualification tests (WQT) in coordination with Client welding supervision; maintain the welder qualification register and continuity records. · Prepare and keep up to date the welding documents required under the project quality requirements: weld maps, welding consumable control, preheat / PWHT procedures, welding equipment and consumable storage, handling and baking procedures. · Control welding consumables and welding equipment on site (receiving, storage, baking, issue, calibration of welding machines and heat treatment equipment) and keep the related records. · Supervise welding execution in the field together with the welding inspectors: compliance with WPS essential variables, preheat and interpass temperature, purging, weld identification and traceability of base materials and consumables. · Plan and monitor post weld heat treatment (PWHT) activities, review PWHT charts and hardness test results. · Analyse NDT results, weld repair rates and welder performance; initiate welder re-qualification, re-training or removal where required; prepare the weekly welding and repair rate report. · Manage weld repairs and the related non-conformance reports (NCR): root cause, repair procedure, re-inspection and close-out. · Enter and verify weld and NDT data in the project weld tracking database (WiTS) and ensure traceability from material receipt to the final handover (quality dossier). · Act as RET technical counterpart of the Client welding supervisor and welding engineer on all welding matters (technical queries, PQR comments, consumable approvals), reporting to the RET Quality Chief. · Support the Quality Chief in preparing welding-related inspection and test plans (ITP), procedures and method statements, and in the technical assessment of welding personnel. What We Expect from You? · Bachelor’s degree in metallurgical and Materials or Welding Engineering. · Minimum 7 years of experience in welding engineering or welding quality on oil, gas, LNG, refinery or petrochemical construction projects, of which at least 3 years in a position responsible for welding procedures and welder qualification on an EPC or construction subcontractor site. · International Welding Engineer (IWE) or European Welding Engineer (EWE) diploma, or CSWIP 3.2 Senior Welding Inspector certificate; CSWIP 3.1 Welding Inspector is the minimum acceptable certificate (AWS CWI alone is not sufficient for this project). · Working knowledge of ASME BPVC Section IX, ASME B31.3, ASME Section V, AWS D1.1 and API 1104; knowledge of ISO 3834 and ISO 14731 welding coordination requirements. · Hands-on experience with WPS / PQR / WPQ preparation and qualification, welder qualification test (WQT) organisation, welding consumable control, preheat, interpass and post weld heat treatment (PWHT) control. · Experience with carbon steel, low-temperature carbon steel, austenitic and duplex stainless steel; ferrite measurement and positive material identification (PMI) practice. LNG or cryogenic project experience is preferred. · Experience with HDPE pipe butt fusion and electrofusion jointing procedures and operator qualification is an advantage. · Experience with a weld and NDT traceability database (e.g. WiTS or similar weld tracking system) and with weld repair rate and welder performance reporting. · Fluent written and spoken English, able to prepare procedures and to correspond with the main contractor’s welding and quality representatives. · Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word); able to prepare weld maps, reports and tables What We Offer? title: Sistem Mühendisliği Süreç Yönetimi ve Gelişim Mühendisi
description: Özgün, cesur ve yenilikçi ROKETSAN, fark yaratan yerli ve milli ürünleriyle, küresel hedeflerine doğru ilerlemeye ve ülkemizin gururu olmaya devam ediyor. Türkiye’nin savunma gücüne yön veren projelerde yer alan ekibimizin bir parçası olarak, kariyer yolculuğunuzda fark yaratma fırsatı yakalayabilirsiniz. Şirketimizin Ankara yerleşkesinde görev alacak Sistem Mühendisliği Süreç Yönetimi ve Gelişim Mühendisi ; sistem mühendisliği süreçlerinin geliştirilmesi, yeni nesil mühendislik yaklaşımlarının yaygınlaştırılması ve kurum genelinde mühendislik yetkinliklerinin artırılması, Model Tabanlı Sistem Mühendisliği (MBSE), maliyet odaklı tasarım ve özel mühendislik disiplinlerinin sistem tasarımına entegrasyonu gibi alanlarda yenilikçi yaklaşımların hayata geçirilmesi faaliyetlerinde aktif rol alacaktır. Beklenen Teknik Nitelikler Havacılık ve Uzay, Elektrik-Elektronik, Makine, Mekatronik, Bilgisayar Mühendisliği veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden lisans mezunu olmak. Savunma sanayii projelerinde sistem mühendisliği alanında en az 7 yıl deneyim sahibi olmak. Gereksinim yönetimi, sistem mimarisi, tasarım, entegrasyon, doğrulama ve geçerleme süreçlerinde deneyim sahibi olmak. ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288 standardı ve INCOSE sistem mühendisliği yaklaşımı hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak. Gereksinim yönetimi ve sistem modelleme araçlarını kullanma deneyimine sahip olmak. Sistem mühendisliği süreçlerinin tanımlanması, uygulanması, değerlendirilmesi ve iyileştirilmesi konularına ilgi duymak. Maliyet odaklı tasarım, ürün yaşam döngüsü maliyeti ve RAMS gibi özel mühendislik disiplinlerinin tasarım süreçlerine etkileri konusunda bilgi sahibi olmak veya bu alanlarda gelişime açık olmak. Analitik düşünme, problem çözme, teknik iletişim ve raporlama becerilerine sahip olmak. Farklı mühendislik disiplinleri ve paydaşlarla iş birliği içinde çalışabilmek; teknik bilgi ve deneyimini paylaşmaya istekli olmak. Tercihen; INCOSE ASEP, CSEP veya ESEP sertifikalarından birine sahip olmak. FMECA, güvenilirlik analizi, bakım yapılabilirlik analizi veya entegre lojistik destek çalışmalarında deneyim sahibi olmak. MBSE metodolojilerinin veya SysML tabanlı modelleme yaklaşımlarının uygulanmasında görev almış olmak. Maliyet odaklı tasarım, üretilebilirlik, ürün yaşam döngüsü maliyeti veya seri üretime geçiş çalışmalarında deneyim sahibi olmak. Sistem mühendisliği süreçlerinin iyileştirilmesi, kurumsal yetkinlik modellerinin geliştirilmesi, teknik eğitim veya mentorluk faaliyetlerinde rol almış olmak. Görev ve Sorumluluklar ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288 ve INCOSE yaklaşımı doğrultusunda sistem mühendisliği süreçlerini tanımlamak, geliştirmek, projelere uyarlamak ve süreç olgunluğunun sürekli iyileştirilmesini sağlamak. MBSE ve model tabanlı tasarım yaklaşımlarının geliştirilmesine, uygun araçlarla desteklenmesine ve kurum genelinde yaygınlaştırılmasına katkıda bulunmak. Maliyet Odaklı Tasarım (Design to Cost) ve Üretilebilirlik için Tasarım (DFM) yaklaşımlarını sistem mühendisliği süreçlerine entegre etmek ve uygulama çalışmalarını yürütmek. Güvenilirlik, kullanılabilirlik, bakım yapılabilirlik, test edilebilirlik ve entegre lojistik destek gibi disiplinlerin sistem mimarisi ve tasarım süreçleriyle bütünleşmesini desteklemek. Sistem mühendisliği süreçlerine ilişkin performans göstergelerini belirlemek, izlemek ve iyileştirme fırsatlarını ortaya koymak. Sistem mühendisliği bilgi birikiminin, yöntemlerinin ve iyi uygulamalarının kurum genelinde yaygınlaştırılmasına yönelik çalışmalar yürütmek; eğitim, rehberlik ve gelişim faaliyetlerine katkı sağlamak. ROKETSAN’ın denizlerin altından uzayın derinliklerine uzanan mühendislik faaliyetlerinde, millî teknoloji hedefleri doğrultusunda yürütülen çalışmalara katkı sunarak bu yolculuğun bir parçası olabilirsiniz. Yarın İçin Yüksel!

Know-how on language models. Knowledge of AI based cyber-security algorithms design and development. Experience on Object Oriented Programming (using at least one of the following languages: C#, Java, C++, Python). Fluent speaking and excellent writing skills in English. Responsibilities Develop and modify AI functions. Survey and develop state-of-the-art technologies/methods for AI. Design, code, test, document and maintain software solutions. Conduct requirements engineering/management. Researcher / Power Electronics Qualifications PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a closely related field. Expert knowledge in multi-level converter topologies, thermal management, wide-bandgap semiconductor devices, chip embedding and advanced packaging technologies and automotive EMC standards. Advanced simulation skills (LTspice, PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink, ANSYS). Knowledge of automotive development processes (ASPICE, ISO 26262). Fluent speaking and excellent writing skills in English. Responsibilities Develop next-generation LV/HV automotive power converters using multi-level topologies. Develop gate drivers for wide-bandgap semiconductors and advanced IGBTs with focus on high-frequency, high-efficiency operations. Design switch-mode power supplies with optimization for automotive environment. Perform FMEA for safety-critical automotive systems. Researcher / Batteries Qualifications PhD in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering or a closely related field. Expert knowledge in, automotive-grade battery cells, battery system development, battery management systems. Advanced simulation skills (MATLAB/Simulink, ETAS tools, HiL Simulators). Knowledge in electrical components, sensors and actuators. Knowledge in EVs, electric machines, power electronics and electrical safety standards. Fluent speaking and excellent writing skills in English. Profile Description: The program's goal is to encourage qualified researchers with overseas experience who have excelled in their fields through high-level science and technology-oriented research to come to Türkiye and contribute to projects that will be carried out in research areas of strategic importance for our country. Application Requirements: Applicants must not have resided in Türkiye for more than 1 year within the last 3 years and must not be working in Türkiye. Applicants must meet at least one of the following requirements: To be on the "Top Cited Researchers List" published by Thomson Reuters in any year of the last 5 years. To have worked for a total of at least 30 months in institutions ranked in one of the following positions in the last 5 years: List of top 100 universities published by QS (Quacquarelli Symonds) or THE (Times Higher Education). List of top 2500 companies with the highest R&D spending in the world published by the European Commission Joint Research Centre: List of top 250 institutions in the health - higher education - public - private subfields published by Scimago Institutions Ranking List of most successful Start-Ups and Unicorn Companies receiving the highest investment. Additional Application Requirements For Outstanding Researchers Program Applicants must meet at least one of the following work experience requirements: Having worked full-time for at least 3 years abroad as a faculty member or team leader at a university or public research center, or having conducted independent academic research, after completing their doctoral studies. Having 6 years of full-time research experience, including at least 3 years in the private sector after completing their undergraduate studies abroad (a maximum of 1 year of a completed master's degree or a maximum of 3 years of a completed doctoral degree abroad may be included in this research experience). Additional Application Requirements For Early-Stage Researchers Program Applicants must be under the age of 40 and meet at least one of the following work experience requirements: Having completed doctoral studies abroad within the last 4 years and having at least 1 year of postdoctoral work experience abroad. Having 4 years of full-time research experience, including at least 1 year in the private sector after completing undergraduate studies abroad (a maximum of 1 year of a completed master's degree with thesis or a maximum of 3 years of a completed doctoral degree abroad can be included in this research experience). We Offer: Interested? If so, please use our online application tool to send your application to AVL!

title: Senior Mechanical Project Engineer – Oils & Fats
description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact – on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we’re pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping. You will work across the full project lifecycle, from understanding customer requirements and developing technical solutions to supporting procurement, supplier manufacturing and project delivery. You will join the Technical team within the EMASA hub in Process Engineering Solutions (PES), supporting Alfa Laval’s technologies for the Oils & Fats industry. These include heat transfer, separation and fluid handling solutions for edible-oil refining, oil and fat modification, biodiesel and HVO pretreatment. In addition to project execution, you will support the business unit and portfolio by contributing to new technologies and solutions, including those connected to the wider Oils & Fats offering and the development of the solids area. Key Responsibilities Execute mechanical engineering packages for medium- to high-complexity projects in the Oils & Fats industry. Design mechanical components, systems and plant solutions based on customer requirements and applicable codes and standards. Prepare technical specifications, calculations, verifications and other project documentation. Select and design mechanical products and solutions based on customer requirements and applicable standards and codes. Participate in design reviews, project meetings and technical verifications. Work closely with Procurement and suppliers to define requirements, align technical solutions and follow up during manufacturing and documentation. Who Are You You are a proactive and accountable engineer who takes ownership of your work and follows through on agreements, procedures and deadlines. You do not wait to be told what to do; instead, you identify what needs attention, take action and communicate clearly when priorities or conditions change. You are someone who builds trust through professional, diplomatic and practical communication, even when handling difficult or challenging interactions. You are comfortable working across cultures, enjoy solving technical problems and are willing to go the extra mile to deliver reliable solutions. What You Know To succeed in this role, you have a strong mechanical engineering foundation combined with practical experience from complex project environments. Overall, we believe our ideal candidate has: A degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable engineering discipline. More than five years of practical experience in mechanical engineering and design work within projects. Knowledge of relevant mechanical engineering codes and standards, particularly European and American standards. Knowledge of piping stress calculations. Experience working in international and cross-cultural environments. Fluent written and spoken English. It Is An Advantage If You Have Experience working with suppliers and supporting technical follow-up during manufacturing and documentation. Experience in process industries, process equipment or the Oils & Fats industry Experience supporting product portfolios, technology development or technical improvement initiatives For more information, please contact Jacob Thers, Engineering Manager at Jacob.Thers@alfalaval.com or Raquel Herndon, Talent Acquisition Partner at raquel.herndon@alfalaval.com We are conducting a continuous review of received applications. At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in Copenhagen or have an established presence in the area. Our commitment to integrity We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.

title: Maskinkonstruktör R&D
description: Hos oss får du driva tekniska förbättringar och utveckla lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för våra skogsmaskiner. Just nu söker vi dig som vill arbeta som konstruktör och bli en del av vår R&D-avdelning. Rollen erbjuder stor variation, många kontaktytor och möjlighet att bygga en unik helhetsförståelse för både produkterna och verksamheten. Ditt nya jobb I den här rollen ligger fokus på att vidareutveckla och förbättra vår etablerade produktportfölj av skogsmaskiner. Du driver och deltar i både mindre och större projekt kopplade till exempelvis kvalitetsförbättringar, produktförändringar, hantering av avvikelser och tekniska utredningar. Arbetet är varierat och ger dig möjlighet att ta ansvar för egna uppgifter, arbeta nära flera olika specialistområden och utveckla en bred kunskap om hela maskinen. Som konstruktör på R&D hos Komatsu Forest är du med och: analyserar och löser tekniska utmaningar kopplat till kvalitetsfrågor, förbättringsärenden och övrigt produktunderhåll kopplat till våra redan etablerade modeller, samarbetar nära funktioner som produktion, inköp, kvalitet, leverantörer och andra delar av R&D för att hitta bra och långsiktiga lösningar, tar fram konstruktionsunderlag, genomför tekniska utredningar samt utför och följer upp tester för att verifiera produktförändringar och förbättringar. Rollen innebär stor variation, många kontaktytor och möjlighet att ta eget ansvar. Samtidigt blir du en del av ett erfaret team där vi stöttar varandra och delar kunskap för att nå de bästa lösningarna. Vem är du? För att lyckas i rollen har du: en akademisk examen som civil- eller högskoleingenjör med inriktning mot exempelvis maskinteknik, teknisk design eller motsvarande, kunskaper i CAD, några års erfarenhet av konstruktion eller produktutveckling, gärna inom mobila maskiner eller liknande tekniska produkter. Som person är du nyfiken, analytisk och lösningsorienterad. Du trivs med att ta ansvar för egna uppgifter och projekt samtidigt som du uppskattar att samarbeta med andra för att nå gemensamma mål. Du har ett strukturerat arbetssätt och tycker om att sätta dig in i tekniska frågeställningar från flera perspektiv för att hitta långsiktigt hållbara lösningar. Då en stor del av vårt arbete innefattar både nationella och internationella kontaktytor kommunicerar du obehindrat på svenska och engelska, såväl i tal som skrift. På Komatsu Forest tror vi att olika erfarenheter, perspektiv och bakgrunder gör oss bättre. Vi strävar efter en inkluderande arbetsplats och välkomnar alla kvalificerade sökande. Känner du igen dig i delar av det vi söker, men inte allt? Då hoppas vi att du skickar in din ansökan ändå. Vad erbjuder vi? På R&D erbjuder vi dig ett teamorienterat arbetssätt där vi stöttar och lär av varandra samt löser problem tillsammans. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta brett med våra produkter och följa hur tekniska lösningar gör skillnad i praktiken. Rollen ger dig ett stort kontaktnät inom företaget och en unik inblick i samspelet mellan konstruktion, kvalitet, produktion, inköp och leverantörer. Du får arbeta självständigt med eget ansvar samtidigt som du alltid har kunniga kollegor nära till hands. Vi erbjuder dessutom möjlighet till ett tryggt och omväxlande arbetsliv i en stor och stabil organisation med en lång historia, där du är med och utvecklar framtidens skogsmaskiner. Vi är ett globalt företag som vet att mångfald bidrar till goda resultat och en bättre arbetsplats. Välkommen med din ansökan! Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringsverktyg för att effektivisera och kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsarbetet. Alla dina uppgifter sparas i din profil och du kan enkelt logga in och uppdatera dina uppgifter när du vill. Fyll därför i dina uppgifter så omsorgsfullt som möjligt för att ge en rättvisande bild av dig själv. Uppgifterna behandlas och sparas enligt GDPR.

title: Mekanikutvecklare inom undervattenssensorer till Underwater Systems
description: Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll. Din roll Vi befinner oss i en spännande utvecklingsfas där vi fortsätter att utveckla framtidens undervattenssystem. Inom PU Sea Mines AUV Sensor utvecklar vi produkter som verkar i en av de mest krävande miljöer som finns. Under ytan möter våra produkter mörker, kyla, höga tryck och begränsade möjligheter till kommunikation och navigering. Att lyckas i den miljön kräver innovativa lösningar, teknisk höjd och ett nära samarbete mellan flera olika kompetensområden. Som mekanikkonstruktör i sektionen Underwater Surveillance Systems blir du en viktig del av ett tvärfunktionellt team som utvecklar avancerade undervattenssensorer och övervakningssystem. Sektionen består av systemingenjörer, mjukvaruutvecklare, tekniska specialister och Design Authorities som arbetar med systemdesign, kravhantering, sensorutveckling, hydroakustiska mätningar och analys. I rollen kommer du att ansvara för konstruktion och utveckling av mekaniska lösningar för våra produkter, från tidiga konceptstudier till färdiga system. Du arbetar nära kollegor inom systemutveckling, elektronik, mjukvara, provning, produktion och inköp för att säkerställa att produkterna uppfyller högt ställda krav på funktion, robusthet och producerbarhet. Dina arbetsuppgifter kan bland annat omfatta: Konstruktion och utveckling av mekaniska system och komponenter. Framtagning av konstruktionsunderlag och teknisk dokumentation. Deltagande i konceptstudier och produktutveckling. Samverkan med produktion, inköp, provningsingenjörer och leverantörer. Stöd vid prototypframtagning, integration och verifiering. Medverkan vid tester och provning i både laboratorie- och fältmiljö. Hos oss får du möjlighet att följa produkterna genom hela utvecklingskedjan och se resultatet av ditt arbete omsättas i verkliga system. Vi arbetar i huvudsak i team där varje individ ges stort ansvar och möjlighet att påverka. Samtidigt finns alltid erfarna kollegor nära till hands för stöd, kunskapsutbyte och gemensam problemlösning. Programvaror som används för CAD är främst CATIA V6 (3DEXPERIENCE) och Solid Edge. Din profil Vi söker dig som har ett genuint teknikintresse och motiveras av att omsätta idéer till fungerande produkter. Du trivs i samarbetet med andra men tar också gärna eget ansvar och driver dina uppgifter framåt på ett strukturerat sätt. Du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och uppskattar att arbeta i en miljö där teori och praktik möts. Det är naturligt för dig att bidra där det behövs, oavsett om det handlar om konstruktion, prototypbygge eller provning. Vi tror att du har: Högskole- eller civilingenjörsutbildning inom maskinteknik eller motsvarande. Erfarenhet av produktutveckling och mekanisk konstruktion. Kunskap i något modernt CAD-verktyg. God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. B-körkort. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av: Undervattenssystem eller sensorprodukter. Konstruktion för krävande miljöer. Mekanisk integration av elektronik eller sensorsystem. Provning och verifiering av tekniska system. Som person är du prestigelös, ansvarstagande och trivs med att lösa komplexa tekniska utmaningar tillsammans med andra. Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap. Vad du blir en del av Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas. Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: About Camlin Camlin is a global technology leader that operates with the vision of bringing revolutionary products to life for a wide range of industries, including power and rail, and also has interests in a number of R&D projects in a variety of scientific sectors. Create and maintain Bills of Materials (BoM) and work with Purchasing to identify appropriate suppliers. Ensure that products will perform consistently in specified operating environments, meeting Camlin quality and customer expectations. Contribute to oversight and management of Camlin’s Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system including quality checks of engineering changes, administration of user roles and supporting CAD integration with PLM. Apply Design for Manufacture and Assembly (DFM, DFA) techniques, including standardisation of processes and technologies, to ensure cost-effective and efficient design. Collaborate with other engineering functions, and other departments including the Operations team. Comprehensive understanding of core mechanical engineering principles. Ability to design cost effective solutions from specifications against agreed budget and timescale requirements. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to address technical challenges. Ability to handle multiple competing tasks and demands. Strong interpersonal skills to facilitate effective collaboration within the team and with other departments. Desirable The following skills will be valuable but are not essential: Experience with prototype testing / verification and failure analysis. Practical, hands-on experience, with part manufacture and prototype assembly. Our Values We work together We believe in people We won’t accept the ‘way it has always been done’ We listen to learn We’re trying to do the right thing Equal Employment Opportunity Statement Individuals seeking employment at Camlin are considered without regards to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital states, ancestry, physical or mental disability, gender identity or sexual orientation.

title: Design Engineer - RVM
description: Job Description We have a new vacancy for a Design Engineer to be based at our site in Shipley, Bradford. About CMbE CarnaudMetalbox Engineering (CMbE) designs, develops, and manufactures high-performance metal forming and finishing machinery for the production of beverage, food, and aerosol cans. With our commitment to innovation and precision engineering, it is an exciting time to join our business. CMbE offers you the opportunity to grow and develop your skills in an expanding industry. Your mission in CMbE The Design Engineer will be supporting the development and industrialisation of Reverse Vending Machines (RVMs) designed by CMB's industrial partner. Working as part of a small multidisciplinary team, the role will involve responsibility for modifying and improving existing machine designs to meet safety compliance, manufacturability, usability and cost targets. They will create and develop mechanical component designs, support prototype builds and product trials, and work collaboratively with Electrical Engineering colleagues to integrate sensors, PCBs and other devices before the machines enter mass production. They will work closely with Electrical Engineering teams to support the integration of electromechanical components, contribute to prototype builds and design verification activities, and ensure designs meet performance, quality and manufacturing requirements. This role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate and improve existing designs to enhance safety, manufacturability, usability and cost-effectiveness. Strong planning and organisational skills are essential, to manage priorities and meet project deadlines in a fast-paced environment. They will also be a collaborative team player, capable of working effectively within multidisciplinary engineering teams to deliver successful project outcomes. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: Wanted: Senior Mechanical Engineer Anticipated start date: As soon as possible Salary Band: £50k - £60k (depending on experience) Full Time, Sheffield, UK (Onsite) Do you want to utilise your skills to help cure cancer and make a real-world impact? AI Science and Autonomous Labs are buzzwords; we're building the actual robotics and software tooling to enable scientists to design, execute and analyse experiments without human intervention. We seek a mechanical engineer who's been through the full product lifecycle more than once; someone who knows what good looks like because they've learned the hard way what bad looks like. You'll be a person our principal engineer can delegate projects to with confidence, knowing they'll come back done properly. This isn't a role where you'll be handed a specification and left alone with CAD. You'll be deeply involved in decisions about how we build, how we manufacture, and how we ship products that work in the field. If you've spent your career building things that actually had to perform under real-world constraints, and you're ready to bring that experience to a team building something genuinely new, we'd like to talk. WE VALUE A bias for action to build products with customer value. Engineers who care about what they build, not just how. Clear thinking, pragmatism, and sound judgment over buzzwords. Friendly, organised, efficient, and enthusiastic people with a can-do attitude. People who take responsibility and follow problems through. Low-ego individuals who love asking questions & go above and beyond to help the team succeed. THE ROLE You'll report to our principal engineer and work across our mechanical engineering function. Day-to-day, you'll split your time between hands-on design work, managing engineering projects through to delivery, and mentoring team members. A big part of this role is raising the bar. We need someone who brings rigour, proper documentation, clean CAD practices, structured design reviews, and an instinct for catching problems before they become expensive. You'll help us build the engineering discipline that lets a small team deliver products at a level our customers expect. Key Responsibilities: Leading mechanical design projects from concept through detailed design, prototyping, and release to manufacture. Owning design-for-manufacture and design-for-assembly decisions, making sure what we design can actually be built reliably and cost-effectively. Managing engineering project timelines, deliverables, and priorities in coordination with the principal engineer. Working with suppliers and manufacturing partners to resolve production issues and drive continuous improvement. Contributing to design reviews, risk assessments, and technical documentation. NEED TO HAVE A strong track record of delivering manufactured physical products and electromechanical systems that work in the real world. Deep proficiency in CAD (we use Onshape; proficiency in SolidWorks or similar is fine). Proven experience with design for manufacture and assembly: you understand tolerance stacks, materials, joining methods, and what makes something manufacturable. Experience managing or leading engineering projects: scoping work, tracking progress, and delivering on time. Strong communication skills: you can explain your design decisions clearly and push back constructively when something isn't right. A methodical approach to documentation, version control, and engineering rigour. Experience with, and willingness to do, rapid prototyping on the shop floor using hand tools, additive manufacturing, CNC, etc. NICE TO HAVE Experience designing precision electromechanical systems, instrumentation, or laboratory equipment. Familiarity with GMP, ISO, and regulated manufacturing environments. Experience with FEA, CFD, or other simulation tools. Exposure to sheet metal, machining, injection moulding, and/or additive manufacturing processes. While we consider applicants from any relevant background, you will likely have 7-10+ years of prior professional experience. BENEFITS A senior role with genuine influence: you won't be a cog in a machine; you'll be shaping the next generation of our product family. The opportunity to work on real systems with real-world impact; you will have direct access to the scientists using the equipment you design to discover and manufacture new medicines. Pension with SIPP options and support managing your investments if you want it. Weekly team pastries and monthly all-hands lunches. Conference attendance and professional development support. A culture that values autonomy, responsibility, and thoughtful work. Based in Sheffield, the UK's greenest city, on the doorstep of the Peak District, <15 minutes from our purpose-built R&D and manufacturing facility. ABOUT US Unicorn Biotechnologies is building the infrastructure for autonomous cell biology. We combine robotics, biology, and software into powerful, easy-to-use platforms that let scientists and manufacturers standardise, scale, and automate their workflows, from bench to factory floor. We're a Sheffield-based team with deep R&D foundations, now scaling to meet growing demand from our global customer base. You'll have real ownership over your work, genuine influence on product direction, and the chance to shape a company at a scale-up inflection point. title: Senior pipe stress engineer
description: Waar krachten samenkomen, kom jij tot de oplossing Een leidingsysteem lijkt stil te staan, maar onder de oppervlakte werken druk, temperatuur en beweging continu op het systeem in. Als senior pipe stress engineer zorg jij dat complexe leidingsystemen sterk genoeg zijn en veilig, betrouwbaar en duurzaam blijven functioneren. Bij Iv werk je aan uitdagende technische vraagstukken die andere bedrijven soms voor onmogelijk houden – precies daar begint jouw engineeringwerk. Als senior pipe stress engineer analyseer en ontwerp je leidingsystemen die bestand zijn tegen hoge en lage drukken, grote temperatuurverschillen en dynamische en statische belastingen. Je maakt complexe berekeningen en vertaalt deze naar praktische en werkbare oplossingen voor uiteenlopende projecten binnen industrie, energie, food, chemie, zware industrie en offshore. Met jouw werk voorkom je schade, vergroot je veiligheid en zorg je dat installaties betrouwbaar functioneren gedurende hun volledige levensduur. Je voert statische en dynamische pipe stress berekeningen uit met tools zoals Caesar II en Ansys. Daarnaast stel je pipe stress specificaties op en ontwikkel je klant specifieke pipe classes, onder andere met behulp van PCC. Ook analyseer je kritische situaties zoals waterslag, thermische expansie en vibraties in leidingsystemen. Samen met andere engineers ontwerp en bereken je pipe supports en controleer je of constructies voldoen aan internationale normen zoals ASME B31.3, B31.1, EN13445 en EN13480. Je stelt duidelijke rapportages op in het Nederlands en Engels en licht jouw berekeningen toe aan klanten, projectteams en keuringsinstanties. Je werkt in mono- en multidisciplinaire teams met engineers, leads en projectmanagers. Samen lossen jullie complexe technische vraagstukken op. Bij Iv houden we van ingewikkelde techniek, maar niet van ingewikkeld doen. We werken pragmatisch, met korte lijnen en een oplossingsgerichte mentaliteit. Je krijgt veel ruimte om je rol zelf vorm te geven en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor jouw expertise. Dat noemen wij: de CEO van je eigen functie. Wat verwachten we van jou? Een hbo- of wo-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde Minimaal 10 jaar ervaring met pipe stress berekeningen, zowel statisch als dynamisch Ruime ervaring met Caesar II voor pipe stress analyses 5 tot 10 jaar ervaring met Ansys voor eindige-elementenberekeningen Ervaring met het opstellen van pipe stress specificaties Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en berekenen van pipe classes, bijvoorbeeld met PCC Kennis van waterslagberekeningen en het uitvoeren van pipe support sterkteberekeningen Wat hebben we jou te bieden? Een uitdagende en gevarieerde baan bij het meest diverse ingenieursbureau van Nederland! Zo kun je rekenen op: De gaafste projecten in verschillende sectoren: van offshore windplatformen tot industriële fabrieken in de chemie, food- en staalindustrie en waterzuiveringsinstallaties. Je werkt aan oplossingen waar de maatschappij écht iets aan heeft. Een professionele én gezellige werkomgeving: bij Iv vind je een laagdrempelige werksfeer waarin hard werken hand in hand gaat met plezier. Zo bezoeken we tweejaarlijks het EK- of WK-voetbal, vieren we nieuwjaar groots in de Efteling en organiseren we zomerbarbecues en andere activiteiten. Flexibele arbeidsvoorwaarden: kies voor meer salaris, extra vakantiedagen of een combinatie van beide. Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden: 31 vakantiedagen, jaarlijkse gratificatie (7%), winstuitkering, flexibele pensioenregeling en reiskosten- en thuiswerkvergoeding. Ruime ontwikkelmogelijkheden: we bieden volop opleidingen, cursussen en trainingen. Bij indiensttreding stel je samen met het afdelingshoofd een persoonlijk ontwikkelingsplan op dat regelmatig wordt besproken. Kortom: bij Iv werk je samen met 1400 specialisten aan de grootste uitdagingen van deze tijd én beleef je veel plezier. Dat noemen wij: engineering that excites.

title: (Graduation) Internship Naval Ship Survivability - Shock and Blast
description: We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family. About Us Hop aboard Damen Naval; the naval division of the family-owned Damen Shipyards Group, where 12,000 professionals work worldwide. Damen Naval delivers advanced naval vessels to clients all over the globe. By implementing the most innovative technological developments in practice, we continue to push the boundaries of the shipbuilding industry. You can be part of our team! Are you ready for duty? The role The ability of naval vessels to survive and remain operational after being attacked is of paramount importance to their operators and crew. For the military, a well-designed vessel should be able to withstand an attack, stay afloat and in control, as well as retain the ability to defend itself. For many years, ships were designed based on specific threats coming from missiles, mines, and torpedoes. Technological advancements in these fields causes threats to become more devastating, meaning the complexity to predict vulnerability aspects (e.g. shock, blast) during the design of naval vessels becomes more complex. Damen Naval is continuously improving its products and developing the next generation vulnerability technology is a key part of those developments. Research in this field is ongoing to make these developments happen and determine how next generation of naval vessels will be designed against vulnerability aspects. In addition, supporting research is needed to provide tools and methods to further optimize the design of these systems. Various Graduate Research Or Internship Projects Are Available Related To This Topic, All Projects Are Supported By Subject Matter Experts Within The Company.Some Possible Subjects Are Plasticity, limit analysis and structural design. Prediction of material failure model(s) for large steel thin-walled structures using FEA. Influence of strain rates on the material properties of several steel species. Dynamic buckling of thin-walled plated structures. Dynamic FEA analysis techniques, high versus low fidelity tools. Predicting the structural resistance during shock induced global whipping. Design of light weight structures and or foundations w.r.t. shock compliancy. Bolt strength analysis under shock loadings by FEA techniques. Study limit states of local and global ship structures under damage scenarios. A combination of different subjects is part of the possibilities. Damen Naval can provide readily available assignments, but it is also possible to propose your own specific topic of interest. Please indicate your preferences (or research topics of your own making) when sending us your application through our career website. Key Accountabilities As an intern or graduate student at Damen Naval you may encounter multiple aspects related to vulnerability. Depending on the assignment, you are expected to select or develop the analysis methods and engineering tools needed to achieve your research goals. You will be responsible from day one for the planning and execution of your research project. You are expected to deliver a detailed in-depth analysis of your research problem and meanwhile be able to communicate the results and conclusions to other departments. Skills & Experience The perfect candidate for an internship or graduation project related to Naval vessel Vulnerability has the following characteristics: Top class student Master student Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering, Aerospace engineering, or Naval Architecture. Other equivalent fields of study may also apply or can be considered depending on the topic chosen for the assignment. Passionate about ships and shipbuilding. Passionate about military ships and striving to enhance safety on board of Navy vessels. Independent, curious, analytical, and proactive. Familiar with structural analysis and ship structural design (e.g. Solid mechanics, Structural Dynamics and ship structural details). Basic experience with simulation tools (e.g. Ansys, Femap , LS-Dyna) or have a proven ability and specific motivation to become familiar with this subject in a very short time. Able to use programming tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB). Capable of identifying and communicating with multiple stakeholders. Taking responsibility for your own planning and project management. Good command of the Dutch and English language both written and verbal. What We Offer The project will preferably be carried out at the Damen Naval office location in Vlissingen. description: Description De L'entreprise OPTIMEX, PME française basée près de Lyon, conçoit et fabrique des pompes à rotor noyé destinées aux environnements industriels les plus exigeants : nucléaire, chimie, pétrochimie, pétrole et gaz. Il participera à l’ensemble du cycle de développement, de l’étude amont aux essais et à la validation des performances . Il interviendra sur des applications industrielles exigeantes, notamment dans les secteurs du nucléaire, de l’énergie et de l’industrie de procédé . Connaissances en hydraulique, thermique, vibrations, mécanique des structures. Compétences en analyse et exploitation de données d'essais. Connaissance des normes industrielles applicables aux équipements électriques et aux environnements exigeants. Anglais technique professionnel requis. Compétences Et Savoir-être (soft Skill) Forte curiosité tecnhique et goût pour l'innovation. Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse. Rigueur méthodologique et sens du détail. Une expérience en conception, modélisation ou validation de machines tournantes constitue un atout majeur. Une expérience dans des secteurs à fortes exigences techniques (nucléaire, aéronautique, défense, énergie, oil & gas, ferroviaire) sera particulièrement appréciée. title: Postdoktor inom metallhydrider och neutronbaserade tekniker för vätelagring
description: Institutionen för kemi – Ångström bedriver forskning och utbildning inom kemiämnet. Institutionen har 270 anställda och omsätter 290 miljoner kronor. Vid institutionens sex program bedrivs mycket framgångsrik forskning av hög internationell klass. Vi har ett stort antal externt finansierade forskningsprojekt, ofta med internationellt samarbete och vi ser en fortsatt god tillväxt inom vårt ämnesområde. Institutionen har utbildningsuppdrag inom ingenjörs- och civilingenjörsprogram samt masterprogram. Mer information finns på vår hemsida. (https://kemi.uu.se/angstrom) Forskningsprojektet fokuserar på utveckling av metallhydrider som material för vätgaslagring. Projektet kommer att ingå i ett samarbetsprojekt med målet att utveckla instrumentering för in situ-neutrondiffraktion och neutronavbildning under absorption och desorption av vätgas vid European Spallation Source (ESS). Projektet kommer att omfatta syntes och strukturell karakterisering av metallhydrider, främst med hjälp av diffraktionsmetoder och undersökning av deras vätelagringsegenskaper. Materialen kommer att undersökas med ett nytt avancerat instrument som utvecklats som en del av projektet, vilket erbjuder unika möjligheter för in situ-studier av vätelagringsmaterial. Arbetsuppgifter De huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifterna för en postdoktor är att bedriva forskning. De kan också inkludera undervisning, upp till 20 % av arbetstiden. Projektet kommer att genomföras under handledning av Dr Rebecca Clulow inom programmet för oorganisk kemi vid institutionen för kemi – Ångström Forskningen kommer att involvera syntes, strukturell karakterisering och egenskapsmätningar av metallhydrider. Syntesarbetet kommer bland annat att innefatta metoder vid höga temperaturer. För strukturell karakterisering kommer diffraktionsmetoder såsom röntgendiffraktion, neutrondiffraktion och in situ-mätningar att användas. Projektet kommer även att kräva en rad andra metoder för strukturell karakterisering samt experiment för vätgasabsorption. Arbetsuppgifterna innefattar även: Forskning inom ämnesområdet Undervisning på avancerad nivå och forskarnivå Ansökan om stråltider och relevanta finansieringsmöjligheter Handledning av examensarbetare och gäststudenter Administration kopplat till uppgifterna ovan. Kvalifikationer Doktorsexamen i kemi/materialkemi eller ett relaterat ämne. Examen ska vara uppfyllt senast vid tidpunkten då anställningsbeslutet fattas. Främst bör den komma ifråga som har avlagt examen för högst tre år sedan. Vid beräkning av ramtiden om tre år är utgångspunkten sista ansökningsdag. Om det finns särskilda skäl kan sådan examen ha avlagts tidigare. Med särskilda skäl avses ledighet på grund av sjukdom, föräldraledighet, förtroendeuppdrag inom fackliga organisationer, etc. Kompetens inom materialkemi, syntes och diffraktionsbaserade tekniker är ett krav för tjänsten, och den sökande bör tydligt beskriva relevant erfarenhet i sin ansökan Den sökande bör ha tidigare kunskaper om struktur–egenskapsrelationer samt generell erfarenhet av materialkarakterisering, exempelvis termisk analys och elektronmikroskopi. Sökanden bör vara flytande i engelska och ha utmärkta skriftliga och muntliga kommunikationsfärdigheter. Ansökningarna kommer att bedömas enligt följande kriterier: uppfyllande av behörighetskrav, tidigare erfarenhet inom närliggande områden och personlig lämplighet. Större vikt läggs vid kvaliteten på det enskilda vetenskapliga arbetet, snarare än vid kvantiteten av publikationer. Hänsyn kommer också att tas till god samarbetsförmåga, driv och självständighet. Hur den sökandes erfarenhet/kompetens bedöms komplettera och stärka pågående forskning inom institutionen kommer också att beaktas. Ansökan ska innehålla ett personligt brev, CV, kopior av examensbevis, och publikationer. Önskvärt/meriterande i övrigt Utöver ovanstående meriter kommer projektet att omfatta avancerad strukturell karakterisering och mätning av materialegenskaper. Kunskap om och/eller erfarenhet av neutrondiffraktion, neutronavbildning och hydrering/vätgasinförsel kommer att vara till nytta för projektet. Tidigare erfarenhet av metallvätesystem är också en stark fördel. Villkor Anställningen är en tidsbegränsad anställning på 2 år enligt centralt kollektivavtal. Anställningens omfattning: 100 %. Tillträde 2027-02-01 eller så snart som möjligt därefter. Placeringsort: Uppsala. Upplysningar om anställningen lämnas av: Rebecca Clulow rebecca.clulow@kemi.uu.se Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 18 November 2026, UFV-PA 2026/3142. Uppsala universitet är ett brett forskningsuniversitet med stark internationell ställning. Det yttersta målet är att bedriva utbildning och forskning av högsta kvalitet och relevans för att göra skillnad i samhället. Vår viktigaste tillgång är alla 7 500 anställda och 53 000 studenter som med nyfikenhet och engagemang gör Uppsala universitet till en av landets mest spännande arbetsplatser. Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att jobba inom Uppsala universitet https://uu.se/om-uu/jobba-hos-oss/ Anställningen kan komma att säkerhetsprövas. Vid säkerhetsprövning är en förutsättning för anställning att sökande blir godkänd. Vi undanber oss erbjudanden om rekryterings- och annonseringshjälp. Ansökan tas emot i Uppsala universitets rekryteringssystem. Fackliga företrädare: Saco-S - saco-s@uu.se, Seko - seko@uadm.uu.se, ST (OFR/S) - ofr@uu.se

title: PhD position on Physics-Guided Digital Twin Development for Composition-Process-Structure-Property Modeling of Magnesium Alloys
description: Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon The Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon conducts cutting-edge international research for a changing world: Around 1,000 employees contribute to the tackling of climate change, the sustainable use of the world's coastal systems and the resource-compatible enhancement of the quality of life. From fundamental research to practical applications, the interdisciplinary research spectrum covers a unique range. Institute of Material and Process Design The Institute of Material and Process Design is dedicated to the sustainable and ecological development of innovative materials and manufacturing processes, especially for the transportation sector and medical technology. To this end, materials are tailored and manufacturing processes are designed to conserve resources – from the modeling of material behavior to the development of the material to the finished component. PhD position on Physics-Guided Digital Twin Development for Composition-Process-Structure-Property Modeling of Magnesium Alloys Reference code: 1057 - 2026/WD 1 Commencement date: as soon as possible Work location: Geesthacht Application deadline: November 12th, 2026 The Institute of Material and Process Design at the Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon is offering a 4-year PhD position in the field of computational materials engineering, machine learning, and digital twins for advanced lightweight materials. The focus of the PhD project will be the development of a physics-guided digital twin framework for magnesium alloys by integrating experimental characterization, crystal plasticity, phase-field modeling, precipitation modeling, and machine learning approaches to establish quantitative composition-process-structure-property relationships. Building upon recently developed machine-learning approaches for structure-property prediction in extruded magnesium alloys, the project aims to advance toward a next-generation Integrated Computational Materials Engineering (ICME) framework capable of predicting microstructure evolution and resulting mechanical properties across previously unseen processing conditions and material states. The candidate will work closely with interdisciplinary teams combining expertise in magnesium alloy development, thermomechanical processing, crystal plasticity, phase-field modeling, machine learning, and advanced experimental characterization. The objective of the project is to bridge the gap between purely data-driven materials modeling and mechanistic microstructure simulations by combining crystal plasticity, dynamic recrystallization, precipitation kinetics, and machine learning into a unified digital-twin framework. The resulting methodologies shall enable accelerated alloy and process design by leveraging experimentally validated physics-guided surrogate models with improved extrapolation capabilities beyond the limits of conventional machine-learning approaches. This work directly contributes to the digital transformation of materials development and manufacturing technologies for future lightweight engineering applications. title: Mechanical Simulation Engineer / FEA Engineer – Défense & Systèmes Autonomes
description: L’ENTREPRISE Notre client est une entreprise française de la Défense spécialisée dans le développement de systèmes aériens autonomes de nouvelle génération. La société conçoit des intercepteurs guidés par l’intelligence artificielle pour contrer les drones et les missiles de croisière, ainsi que les plateformes logicielles permettant de piloter ces systèmes. Ses technologies sont destinées à des acteurs institutionnels et militaires internationaux et sont régulièrement mises à l’épreuve lors de démonstrations et d’essais opérationnels en Europe, au Moyen-Orient et en Asie. L'entreprise connaît une croissance rapide et elle entre dans une nouvelle phase de développement axée sur l’industrialisation de ses produits, l’expansion internationale et le renforcement de ses équipes d’ingénierie. LE POSTE En tant qu’Ingénieur Simulation Thermomécanique, vous interviendrez sur la modélisation numérique, le dimensionnement et la validation de systèmes mécaniques complexes destinés aux applications de défense. Votre rôle consistera à réaliser des simulations avancées, à analyser le comportement des structures soumises à des sollicitations extrêmes et à contribuer à l’amélioration des produits, en lien étroit avec les équipes de conception, de systèmes et d’essais. Vos principales responsabilités : Simulation numérique et calcul de structures Réaliser des simulations thermomécaniques : analyses statiques et dynamiques, vibrations, chocs et fatigue. Modéliser des phénomènes transitoires rapides et des sollicitations mécaniques complexes. Définir les hypothèses de calcul, les modèles numériques, les conditions aux limites et les critères d’acceptation. Exploiter les résultats des simulations pour évaluer le comportement et la résistance des structures. Analyse et amélioration des produits Interpréter les résultats numériques et formuler des recommandations techniques pour améliorer la conception. Identifier les zones critiques et contribuer à l’optimisation des architectures mécaniques. Étudier, selon les besoins, des phénomènes complexes tels que les interactions fluide-structure, les effets de pression et la fragmentation. Participer au développement et à l’amélioration des méthodes et outils de simulation. Corrélation essais et validation Corréler les résultats des simulations avec les données expérimentales. Contribuer à la préparation et à la planification des campagnes d’essais. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de tests et de validation pour confronter les modèles numériques aux résultats physiques. Rédiger les notes de calcul, rapports de simulation et documents techniques associés. Garantir la traçabilité, la fiabilité et la qualité des modèles et des résultats. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement technique exigeant, avec une forte proximité entre la simulation numérique, la conception mécanique et les essais physiques. VOTRE PROFIL Formation d’ingénieur ou Bac+5 en mécanique, calcul de structures, simulation numérique ou domaine équivalent. Solides connaissances en mécanique des structures et en dynamique. Maîtrise des méthodes de calcul par éléments finis. Expérience en simulation explicite et dans l’étude de phénomènes transitoires rapides. Maîtrise d’un ou plusieurs outils de simulation tels que LS-DYNA, Abaqus, ANSYS ou équivalent. Capacité à analyser des résultats complexes et à les traduire en recommandations techniques concrètes. Expérience de la corrélation entre simulations numériques et essais mécaniques. Une connaissance des phénomènes pyrotechniques et/ou balistiques constitue un atout important. Rigueur dans la documentation, la traçabilité des calculs, la sécurité et la conformité réglementaire. Au-delà des compétences techniques, nous recherchons un ingénieur pragmatique et autonome, à l’aise avec les activités expérimentales, capable de piloter ses travaux de simulation et de collaborer efficacement avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires. SALAIRE ET INFORMATIONS PRATIQUES Rémunération : 75K€ à 85K€ Environnement : Défense, systèmes autonomes et technologies de pointe. Entreprise en forte croissance, soutenue par des investisseurs. Poste au sein d’une équipe d’ingénierie en phase de structuration et d’industrialisation. POURQUOI POSTULER ? Participer au développement de systèmes de défense de nouvelle génération. Travailler sur des problématiques complexes de mécanique, de dynamique et de simulation numérique. Évoluer dans un environnement où les calculs sont directement confrontés aux essais physiques. Avoir un impact concret sur la conception, la fiabilité et les performances des produits. Rejoindre une entreprise technologique en forte croissance, avec des ambitions internationales. title: Ingeniero/a de Cálculo Estructural Dinámico

Buscamos un perfil con experiencia en simulación estructural avanzada, dinámica no lineal y solucionadores explícitos , capaz de abordar fenómenos de choque, impacto, grandes deformaciones y cargas extremas. Experiencia: Al menos 2 años de experiencia en análisis dinámico no lineal y simulación estructural avanzada . Conocimientos técnicos: Experiencia con ANSYS Mechanical, Autodyn y/o LS-DYNA . Dominio de solucionadores explícitos . Experiencia en análisis de choque, impacto, altas aceleraciones y grandes deformaciones . Modelado avanzado de materiales no lineales . Configuración de contactos no lineales y problemas con mallas altamente deformadas. Funciones a desempeñar: Realizar simulaciones de cálculo estructural dinámico y no lineal . Vous êtes autonome, appréciez le travail en équipe et savez gérer des interfaces multiples. Une expérience dans le secteur nucléaire est un plus, mais n’est pas obligatoire . Tercih Sebebi Olacak Yetkinlikler İş makinesi kovası, ataşman veya treyler tasarımında doğrudan proje deneyimi, Kaynaklı çelik konstrüksiyonlarda dayanım ve yorulma analizi tecrübesi, ANSYS, SolidWorks Simulation veya benzeri analiz yazılımlarını kullanabilme, Yeni ürün geliştirme, prototipleme ve seri üretime geçiş projelerinde görev almış olma, Tasarım iyileştirme, maliyet optimizasyonu ve üretilebilirlik çalışmalarında deneyim.
