title: Feasibility-Die Process Engineer – Gölcük
description: About The Job We believe that our employees are the foundation of our success and the source of our strength. Our vision is to become Turkey's most valuable and preferred industrial company that champions equality in the workplace. Join us in shaping the future of the automotive industry at Ford Otosan! What awaits you in this role? • The aim of the Feasibility & Die Process Engineer is to take actions towards Ford Otosan's purpose of becoming Turkey's most valuable and most preferred brand and manage the body quality processes that will ensure that customers who prefer Otosan products are also satisfied with the quality of the product. What are we looking for in this position? (Responsibilities) In the new vehicle projects of Ford Otosan, Ford Europe and Ford America; This role will be responsible from: • Supporting new vehicle programs according to Global Product Development System(GPDS) Timing. • Checking Part Design according to Process Driven Product Design (PDPD) give quick feedback to Product Design Team at the beginning of feasibility phase. • Providing Stamping Feasibility feedback and proposing applicable solutions to Design Studio and Product Development Teams by using CATIA & AUTOFORM Software for Ford Otosan, Ford of Europe and Ford North America new vehicle projects. • Reviewing the lesson learns from previous projects and creating solutions for best-in-class quality parts. • Participating vehicle design meeting and be a part of problem resolutions. • Taking an active role in determining the stamping die investments by defining Creating process concept, deciding process parameters for each part which is appropriate to Main and Alternative Press Lines according to Global Press Book. • Generating cost saving and quality improvement actions at mass productions. • Preparation/outsourcing of 3D data which are required for die design and manufacturing. • Investigating new technologies to improve stamping operations and die manufacturing • Providing subject matter expertise and supporting tooling supplier. Technical & Behavioural Skills and Competencies • Graduate from Mechanical Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, Metallurgical and Materials Engineer • Preferably, at least 3 years sectoral experience in stamping engineering and/or manufacturing of sheet metal dies. • Preferably, at least 2 years of experience in sheet metal forming simulations with Autoform software • Working knowledge Catia v5 (Preferably Generative Shape Design) • Competent in MS Office • Being eligible to travel abroad Role Location • Golcuk, Kocaeli When You Start Your Career In "Ford Otosan"; • We have hybrid working model and you can enjoy being part of an agile team. • You'll become a member of Koç Pension Foundation • You and your loved ones will enjoy the benefits of KoçAilem • You'll choose the side benefits with Flextra The only criterion evaluated in the recruitment and employment is suitability for the job; equal opportunity is provided without any discrimination. What About Us? Ford Otosan, being one of the top three exporting companies in Turkey since 2004, has achieved 13 consecutive years of automotive industry championship and is Turkiye goods product export champion for 9 years in a row. Ford Otosan operates in 4 main centers with its Gölcük and Yeniköy Plants in Kocaeli, Eskişehir Plant in Eskişehir, Sancaktepe R&D Center and Spare Parts Warehouse in İstanbul and Craiova Plant in Romania employs more than 20,000 people. Kocaeli and Eskişehir Plants are listed among Ford's 'Best Vehicle Production Centers' and Eskişehir is the only factory in Turkiye that can produce vehicles, engines, and powertrains in the same center. Ford Otosan, standing out with its sensitivity regarding social responsibilities, also carries out several social responsibility projects in many fields including education, healthcare, culture, arts, and sports on “Future. Now” vision. Ford Otosan, also carrying out awareness studies on gender equality since 2013 with the understanding of "Equality at Work", became the only automotive and the first and only industrial company from Turkiye to be included in the Bloomberg Gender-Equality Index in 2021. The building blocks of our new corporate culture, which we call “Dynamic Balance”, our values are mutual trust and respect, value each other and affection, openness to change and innovation, open and transparent communication. A common culture brings us to a common sense and purpose, helps us to work in a positive atmosphere of trust, ties us closer and helps us to reach a stronger future all together.

title: Makine Mühendisi
description: Yapı Kredi olarak 1944’ten beri ilklerin, yeniliklerin ve kültür sanatın bankasıyız. Finans sektörünün tartışmasız lideri olma vizyonuyla yolumuzda ilerliyor, her adımımızda paydaşlarımıza ve ülkemize değer katıyoruz. Bugünü olduğu kadar geleceği de önemsiyor, sürdürülebilirliği iş kültürümüzün merkezine yerleştiriyoruz. Sen de bugüne ve geleceğe değer katan, yenilikçi fikirlerin peşinden giden, gücünü birbirinden alan bir ekibin parçası olmak istersen hemen aramıza katıl. Saha İnşaat ve Emlak Yönetimine bağlı ekibimizde görev alacak Makine Mühendisi arıyoruz. Mekanik Mühendisi sorumlulukları neler? Şubelerin mekanik projelerinin çizimi, kontrolü ve onaylanması, Şube inşaatlarında şantiye ziyaretlerinin yapılması, ihtiyaç halinde özel çözüm ve detay üretilmesi, Şube konsepti doğrultusunda standartların korunması, Sorumluluğunda bulunan bölgelerde yer teknik incelemesi yapmak ve kira sözleşmeleri için teknik şartname oluşturmak, Tamamlanan şube inşaatının geçici kabul, kesin kabul ve hak edişinin kontrolünün yapılması, Maliyet analiz kontrollerinin yapılması, Şartname hazırlanması ve satın alma süreçlerinin takibi, Müteahhit firmalar ve proje tedarikçilerinin yönetilmesi, Sorumluluğundaki tüm hizmet noktalarından gelen talep/tadilat/arızaları değerlendirmek, sorunun çözümüne kadar olan süreci yönetmek, Sorumluluğunda bulunan Şube ve ATM’lerin tamir, bakım ve tadilatları sonrasında mekanik işlerin sözleşmelere uygun olarak hak ediş ve fatura kontrollerini yapmak, Sorumluluğunda bulunan mekanik ekipmanların periyodik bakım ve envanter süreçlerinin yönetilmesi, Tüm hizmet noktalarındaki doğalgaz, su ile ilgili abonelik süreçlerinin yönetilmesi, Bütçe oluşturulması ve takibinin yapılması, Bu rol için aradığımız nitelikler neler? Üniversitelerin 4 yıllık eğitim veren Makine Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, Şantiye ve proje yönetimi konularında en az 3 yıl deneyimli, Kurumsal iş süreçlerine ve ilgili disiplinlerin koordinasyonuna açık, MS Office ve Autocad programlarına hakim, Yangın yönetmeliği, doğalgaz şartnameleri, ısı kaybı, ısı kazancı, havalandırma basınç kaybı, sıhhi tesisat gibi genel mekanik hesaplamalar konularında bilgi sahibi, Bakım ve onarım konularında tecrübeli, hak ediş kontrolü yapabilen, Asansör bakımı ve yapımı konusunda tecrübeli, Yapı Kredili olmak sana neler katacak? 📖 Yapı Kredi Akademi ile sınırsız gelişim, 🏆Fark yaratan başarıların ödüllendireceği takdir ve ödüllendirme uygulamaları, 🔄Yapı Kredi ve Koç Grubu içinde kariyer, gelişim ve rotasyon fırsatları, ⚕️Özel sağlık ve hayat sigortası, 🍝TokenFlex dijital yemek kartı, ✨Sosyal destek ödemeleri, 🐾Yapı Kredi Gönüllüleri ile dâhil olabileceğin sosyal sorumluluk projeleri, 🏀16 farklı spor dalında faaliyet gösteren Yapı Kredi Spor Kulübü, 🎭 BizClub ile birçok kültür-sanat etkinliğine indirimli bilet alma fırsatı, 🎁Özel günler için hediye kitleri, 🎂Doğum günü izni, 🐏 Koç Ailem, Koç Akademi, Koç Healthcare eşliğinde Koçlu olmanın ayrıcalıklı dünyası, …ve çok daha fazlası! Eğer sen de bu dünyanın bir parçası olmak istiyorsan, hemen başvurunu yap ve Yapı Kredili olma yolunda ilk adımını at! Geleceğe yön vermek #YapımızdaVar . * Yapı Kredi’de işe alım sürecimiz tüm pozisyonlar için İK görüşmesi, yönetici görüşmeleri ve yetkinlik değerlendirme envanterleri içerir. Bütün aşamaları başarıyla tamamlaman durumunda teklif aşamasına geçilir. “6698 sayılı Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu kapsamında kişisel verilerinizin işlenmesinden doğan haklarınıza ve bu konudaki detaylı bilgiyehttps://kariyerim.yapikredi.com.tr/Account/StaticKvkk adresinde yer alan aydınlatma metnimizden ulaşabilirsiniz.”

title: Mekanik Tasarım Mühendisi – Yanma Odası, Artyakıcı ve Egzoz Müdürlüğü
description: TEI olarak 1985’ten günümüze; havacılık motorları alanında sektöre sunduğumuz yüksek kaliteli ürün, hizmetler ile uluslararası arenada dünya çapında bir üretici ve küresel bir tasarım merkezi konumundayız. Bu güçlü konumumuzdan hareketle kendimizi Gücün Kaynağı olarak tanımlıyoruz. Küresel havacılığa sunduğumuz katkılar ve Türkiye’nin havacılık serüvenine kazandırdığımız ilkler ile başarı hikâyeleri yazmaya devam ediyor; parça ve modül üretimi, motor montaj, test ve bakım, onarım, revizyon, motor tasarımı ve ürün geliştirme alanlarında mükemmeli hedefliyoruz. Türk Havacılık Uzay Sanayii, GE Aerospace, Türk Silahlı Kuvvetleri Güçlendirme Vakfı ve Türk Hava Kurumu ortaklığında kurulan şirketimiz, millî projelerle gurur veren başarılarda yerini alma ve geleceğin havacılık hikâyelerine imza atma fırsatı sunuyor. Bu yolculukta başarımızı teknoloji ile beraber değerlerimizden de alıyoruz: adaletle güven inşa ediyor, birlikte mükemmelliği hedefliyor, kapsayıcı bir ortam kuruyor, yenilikçi bakış açısıyla büyüyor ve sorumluluk bilinciyle hareket ediyoruz. Gökyüzündeki her iki uçaktan birinde TEI parçaları var! Sen de geniş öğrenme imkanlarıyla sınırsız gelişimi planlıyor; yenilikçi ve öncü projelerle başarılı bir kariyer hedefliyorsan aramızdaki yerini hemen al! #GücünOdağındaSenVarsın TEI'de Seni Neler Bekliyor? Kariyer Yolculuğu: İnsan ve gelişim odaklı uygulamalarla zenginleştirilen kariyer modelleri, TEI Akademi: Teknik ve davranışsal yetkinliklerinin sürekli desteklendiği kariyer yolculuğu, Sosyal Kulüpler: Binicilik, sualtı, denizcilik ve yelken, yoga, voleybol, basketbol gibi kulüplerle kültürel çeşitliliğin desteklendiği bir çalışma ortamı, Yaz & Kış Turnuvaları, Esenlik Faaliyetleri: Diyetisyen, Psikolog, Fit Bülten, Seminer uygulamaları, Çalışma Modeli: Esnek çalışma modelleri ile iş-yaşam dengesini destekleyen uygulamalar, Çalışma Ortamı: Kampüs içerisinde kahve alanları, yürüyüş yolu, market ve oto yıkama, Yan Haklar: Toplam deneyim süresine bağlı yıllık izin uygulaması, TEIFLEX ile özgürce kullanılan esnek yan hak uygulaması, TEI Kurumsal Avantaj Programı ile birçok mekânda indirimli alışveriş yapma ve yemek yeme fırsatı, Ödüllendirme: Ekip arkadaşlarının veya üst yönetimin takdiri ile yürütülen birçok kategoriyi kapsayan ödül sistemi. Senden Neler Bekliyoruz? Üniversitelerin Makina, Mekatronik, Uçak, Havacılık ve Uzay Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezunsan, Mukavemet ve malzeme mekaniği teorisine hakimsen, ihtiyaç halinde el hesapları ile kullanabiliyorsan, CAD yazılımlarında ileri düzey 2D/3D modelleme deneyimine sahipsen, Geometrik ölçülendirme ve toleranslandırma (GD&T) konularında bilgiliysen, Yapay zeka araçlarını etkili kullanabiliyorsan, Modül bileşenleri ara yüzlerini oluşturup takibini yapabiliyorsan, Aynı anda birden fazla işi yapabilme yeteneğine sahipsen, Görev aldığı projelerde teknik çıktıları prosedür ve politikalara uygun bir şekilde raporlayabiliyorsan, Yurt içi ve yurt dışı seyahat engeli bulunmuyorsa, MS Office programlarını iyi derecede kullanabiliyorsan, İyi derecede yazılı ve sözlü İngilizce biliyorsan, Takım çalışmasını ve iş birliğini ön planda tutuyorsan, Güçlü iletişim becerileri ile paydaş yönetimini etkin şekilde gerçekleştirebiliyorsan, Hedef ve sonuç odaklı çalışma disiplinine sahipsen, Sürekli öğrenmeyi ve gelişimi destekleyen bakış açısını benimsiyorsan, Değişen koşullara hızlı adapte olabiliyorsan ve yüksek duygusal dayanıklılığa sahipsen, Veriye dayalı, analitik ve objektif karar alma yetkinliğine sahipsen, Eskişehir’de ikamet ediyorsan/edebileceksen. Tercihen: Havacılık sektöründe ve/veya gaz türbinli motor tasarımı konusunda deneyimliysen, Siemens NX ve Teamcenter yazılımlarında deneyimliysen, ANSYS ya da benzeri sonlu elemanlar analiz yazılımlarında deneyimliysen, Uçuşa elverişlilik, sertifikasyon (CS-E Part 21, SHT-21) hakkında tecrübe ve bilgiye sahipsen, İmalat yöntemleri konusunda bilgiye sahipsen. Gücünü Senden Alan Bir Yolculuk Başlıyor: Yanma odası, artyakıcı ve egzoz sistemlerinin parça ve modül seviyesinde tasarım sorumlusu olarak görev alınması, Teknik gereksinimlere (montaj, dayanım, ömür, imal edilebilirlik, güvenilirlik, titreşim, malzeme vb.) uygun tasarım yapılması, Tasarım faaliyetlerini gerçekleştirmek için araştırmalar ve hesaplar/analizler yapılması (NX, ANSYS), Diğer disiplinlerle (motor sistem, aerodinamik, termal sistem, yapısal mühendislik, test, malzeme, imalat vb.) etkin bir şekilde çalışmak ve parça sahibi olarak gerekli koordinasyonun sağlanması, Diğer tasarım disiplinlerinin raporlarını değerlendirerek, gereksinimleri karşılayan en uygun tasarımın oluşturulması, Tasarımın sertifikasyon gerekliliklerini yerine getirmesi için faaliyetlerde bulunulması, İmalat sırasında ya da çalışan parçalarda ortaya çıkabilecek uygunsuzlukları değerlendirilmesi, Modül ve parça seviyesi rig test planlarının hazırlanması ve yürütülmesinde rol alınması, İç ve dış müşteriler ile etkin iletişim kurmak ve teknik sunumlar yapılması, Mekanik tasarım metodolojileri geliştirmek ve yapılan çalışmaları prosedürlere uygun şekilde raporlanması, Eğitim dokümanları hazırlamak ve eğitim verilmesi, Atanan kişilere yönderlik yapılması, İş sağlığı ve güvenliği, çevre ve kalite kurallarına uyulması. İşe Alım Sürecimiz Aşağıdaki linke tıklayarak işe alım sürecimizin detayları hakkında bilgi alabilirsin. https://kariyer.tei.com.tr/tr/gokyuzundeki-firsatlar Aşağıdaki linke tıklayarak işe alım süreçlerimizde işlenen kişisel veri faaliyetlerine ilişkin detaylar hakkında aydınlatma metnine erişerek bilgi alabilirsin. https://www.tei.com.tr/kisisel-verilerin-korunmasi İlham verici çalışma ortamımızda, gökyüzünde kalıcı bir iz bırakmaya var mısın?

title: Makine Mühendisi
description: 1995 yılında ÖZAK Global Holding'in öncü yaklaşımı ve kalite anlayışını inşaat sektörüne taşımak amacıyla kurulan İnt-Er Yapı, üstlendiği işler, projelendirmeden anahtar teslimine kadar, inşaat sektörünün tüm aşamalarını kapsıyor. title: Maintenance Engineer
description: About CATL CATL is a global leader in zero-carbon new energy technology, committed to providing first-class solutions and services for global new energy applications, building a zero-carbon energy ecosystem with a comprehensive incremental strategy, promoting energy transition and sustainable development. Join CATL Turkiye Be part of a global leader in new energy technology and contribute to building a safer, greener, and more sustainable future. We are looking for an experienced Maintenance Engineer to join our team and be based at our Bursa facility in Turkiye. This position serves as the primary responsible person for BIW welding equipment maintenance and reliability at the Turkey factory. The role combines hands-on technical leadership with full responsibility for maintenance team management, shift planning, training, safety, spare parts, budgeting, supplier management, system establishment, and localization. The position is responsible for ensuring the reliability of welding robots, spot-welding systems, automated production lines, safety systems, and special equipment, while establishing a maintenance system compliant with Turkish OHS (İSG) regulations and EU CE machinery safety standards. Job Responsibilities Technical Leadership: Take full responsibility for technical decision-making and troubleshooting during major equipment failures in the BIW welding workshop, including welding robots, resistance welding controllers, PLCs, and pneumatic/hydraulic systems. Lead RCA and 8D processes to eliminate recurring failures and minimize downtime. Maintenance & Reliability: Establish and manage the complete PM/TPM maintenance system, inspection standards, maintenance strategies, and annual/quarterly/monthly maintenance plans. Monitor MTBF, MTTR, OEE, and equipment failure rates to continuously improve equipment reliability. Equipment Improvement & Production Quality: Lead equipment modifications, performance upgrades, program optimization, cycle-time improvements, and error-proofing projects. Resolve equipment-related welding quality, dimensional accuracy, and production stability issues to support stable mass production. Safety, CE & Special Equipment Compliance: Take primary responsibility for BIW equipment safety and ensure compliance with Turkish OHS (İSG) regulations, CE Machinery Directive, and functional safety standards. Manage safety-related equipment and inspections, including pressure vessels, safety valves, pressure gauges, safety light curtains, STO safety circuits, laser protection, and high-voltage electrical inspections, ensuring readiness for EU/Turkish official inspections and audits. Technical Documentation & Standardization: Establish and maintain equipment SOPs, maintenance manuals, electrical drawings, program versions, failure case libraries, and other technical documentation. Standardize maintenance practices and knowledge across Chinese, foreign, and local teams. Team & Shift Management: Take full responsibility for BIW maintenance team management, including manpower planning, shift scheduling, shift planning, and night-shift coordination and management. Training & Localization: Develop skill matrices, annual training plans, mentoring programs, and skill assessments. Lead technology transfer and capability development to build an independent and qualified Turkish maintenance team. Maintenance Safety Management: Take primary responsibility for maintenance safety, including LOTO energy isolation, high-risk work approvals, safety inspections, violation follow-up, accident investigation, and corrective actions, with the objective of maintaining zero maintenance-related safety incidents. Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with company standards. WHAT DO WE OFFER? Hybrid working opportunity, One day off on your birthday, Comprehensive Private Health Insurance, Professional and personal training & development opportunities, Exclusive discounts and campaigns for employees. In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. title: Senior Fullstack Engineer, DP Practice Adoption team (100% Remote within Türkiye)
description: Welcome to the good side of tech 👋 You might have heard about us, but with a different name: DoktorTakvimi. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human? Docplanner at scale We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago. At Docplanner we are a diverse group of over 300 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement. We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor speak for themselves. In case you’d like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here’s a video of us. And why should you join us? Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs. We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote friendly. Job Description Team vision and mission Doctoralia Practice is Docplanner's practice management system for individual doctors: agenda, EHR, prescriptions, invoicing and Noa, our AI clinical assistant, in one product. The Practice Adoption team makes Practice win in each market by adapting it to local regulation and local doctor needs, on top of a shared global platform. In Türkiye, that means one clear mission: get Doctoralia Practice and our telehealth product certified by the Ministry of Health, so DoktorTakvimi doctors can keep working with us on a fully compliant, legal foundation. About the role We are looking for two Senior Fullstack Engineers based in Türkiye to build the features the Ministry of Health requires for USBS certification. You will own work end to end, from the doctor-facing interface to the integrations with national health systems, and you will be our technical reference for Turkish health regulation inside a global product team. We want engineers who are product-minded, comfortable across the stack, and excited to turn regulatory requirements into a product doctors actually enjoy using. Key responsibilities Build the features required for USBS certification end to end, frontend and backend. Turn regulatory requirements into product decisions: question scope, propose the simplest compliant solution, and validate it with doctors and the local team. Integrate Doctoralia Practice with Turkish national health systems (e-Nabız, ÇKYS, T.C. Kimlik No. validation, SBYS). Design secure, auditable systems: authentication, access control, audit logging, encryption and data residency. Act as the team's reference on Turkish health regulation, working closely with our local regulatory and compliance team. Prepare and support the Ministry audit together with the local team. Collaborate with product, design and engineers across Spain and LATAM; ship small, measure impact, iterate. Track adoption and impact of what you ship, not just certification status. Contribute to code reviews, automated testing, monitoring and documentation. What we're looking for Must have 5+ years building production web applications as a fullstack engineer. Product mindset: you've owned features from problem to outcome, talked to users, and pushed back on scope when a simpler solution was enough. Strong backend fundamentals: API design, relational databases, integrations with third-party and government systems. Solid frontend experience with a modern framework. Experience with security-sensitive systems: authentication, 2FA, access control, audit logs, encryption. Experience with cloud environments (AWS preferred), CI/CD and containers. Daily use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code or similar) and ownership of every line they ship. Professional English (B2+) and native Turkish. Strong plus Experience with Turkish Ministry of Health compliance frameworks, specifically USBS (Uzaktan Sağlık Bilgi Sistemi) and MBYS / HBYS certification processes. Integrations with e-Nabız, ÇKYS or other Ministry systems. Health-tech, EHR or telehealth background (WebRTC, video and messaging). Knowledge of KVKK (Turkish personal data protection law). Why our team You Will Join a Product Team That Builds What Doctors Use Every Day To Run Their Practice, And Your Work Decides Whether Docplanner Can Keep Serving Doctors In Türkiye. We Work As Product Engineers Product-minded: you understand the why, challenge over-engineering and track impact after shipping. AI-first: AI tools are the default; you own delivery end to end. Small, fast releases: ship to validate, then iterate. Radical ownership: a feature without monitoring is not done. You will have a strong local network (regulatory, compliance and country leadership in Türkiye) and a global engineering team behind you. description: Insense is a platform that helps brands work with creators. You'll work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering throughout the product lifecycle, from reviewing requirements and identifying risks to validating releases and investigating production issues. This is a manual QA role for someone who enjoys understanding how products work, thinking beyond predefined test cases, and helping the team identify quality risks early. 📍You must be within CET ±2 hours ⏰This is a full time role with a flexible schedule, you must be available every working day between 9 am and 12 pm EST. Who are we looking for? Required: 3+ years of experience as a Manual QA Engineer testing web applications. Strong understanding of software testing principles and test design. Hands-on experience with exploratory, functional, regression, and API testing. Able to review requirements, identify risks, and raise questions before development starts. Experience investigating issues using logs, monitoring, or analytics tools (Sentry, Rollbar, Amplitude, or similar). Validate key user flows and important edge cases. Identify issues before they reach production. Communicate quality risks clearly. Early Quality Involvement: get involved early to prevent issues before development starts. Review requirements and acceptance criteria. Identify gaps, edge cases, and potential risks. Work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to clarify expected behavior. Risk-Based Testing: focus your effort where it matters most. Prioritize testing based on product risk. Combine structured and exploratory testing. Ensure important regression scenarios are covered. Keep documentation simple and useful. Collaboration & Investigation: partner with the team to investigate issues and improve product quality. Write clear and actionable bug reports. Investigate issues using logs, APIs, and monitoring tools. Share timely feedback throughout development. Help improve future testing based on production learnings. AI-Assisted Testing: use AI to work smarter, not replace critical thinking. Use AI to support test design, investigations, and documentation. Review and validate AI-generated output. Spend more time on exploratory testing, risk analysis, and collaboration. Continuously improve your workflow with new tools. title: Quality Control Engineer
company: XERA MEDICAL SYSTEMS AND TECHNOLOGY LTD.
description: XERA Medical Systems and Technology Precision at the final gate — every system we ship carries our name. Quality Control Engineer Job Posting About the Role XERA Medical Systems and Technology designs and manufactures X-ray systems, supplying equipment that enables accurate diagnosis in medical settings around the world. Final Inspection is the last checkpoint before a system reaches our customers. It is where the quality of every unit is confirmed, and where an engineer grows into one of the people who understands our products most deeply. As Quality Control Engineer, you will own the final inspection process: defining what is tested and why, making the final release decision, and guiding the Quality Control Technicians who carry out the day-to-day inspections. Position Overview Position: Quality Control Engineer Employment Type: Full-time Work Arrangement: On-site Experience: 2-4 years Education: Bachelor's degree (4-year, Lisans) in Electrical-Electronics Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline Function: Quality Assurance / Manufacturing Industry: Medical Device Manufacturing Location: XERA Medical Systems and Technology (Türkiye) Key Skills: Electronic Engineering, ISO 13485, Quality Inspection, Final Inspection, Measurement Instruments, X-ray, Electronic Circuits, Radiation Safety, QMS, Test Method Design, CAPA What You'll Do - Own the final inspection of completed X-ray systems and make the final pass/fail determination before shipment. - Apply a thorough understanding of the product's electrical, mechanical, and radiological characteristics to identify and propose the most relevant test items, prioritizing higher-risk areas. - Develop sampling inspection strategies aligned with Acceptable Quality Level (AQL) standards, and write and continuously improve inspection specifications and procedures in line with ISO 13485 requirements. - Review and approve inspection records and the Device History Record (DHR) to ensure full product traceability. - When nonconformities occur, go beyond re-inspection to lead root cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and feed findings back into production and design. - Manage the calibration programme for precision measuring instruments (multimeters, oscilloscopes, radiation dosimeters, etc.) and evaluate measurement uncertainty to preserve inspection reliability. - Train, guide, and review the work of Quality Control Technicians. What You'll Bring - A bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline (Electrical-Electronics, Biomedical, Mechatronics, or equivalent) and 2-4 years of relevant experience, with the ability to read circuit diagrams and technical specifications independently. - The ability to explain not just whether a unit passes or fails, but why a given test is necessary in the first place. - A working understanding of precision measurement equipment and measurement uncertainty. - A data-driven quality mindset, comfortable analyzing nonconformity trends and identifying patterns. - Strong communication skills to raise inspection findings constructively with Production and R&D. - A proactive approach to the role and a genuine interest in continuously learning relevant standards and technologies. - Strong interpersonal skills and a solid understanding of organizational culture. - Turkish language proficiency, sufficient for daily work communication. - English proficiency, sufficient to understand technical documents and international standards (e.g., ISO 13485, IEC 60601 series). Preferred Qualifications - Experience in radiation-related work. - Experience in medical device quality management (ISO 13485) or inspection/testing roles. - Certification or training in radiation safety management, such as a radiation protection training certificate. - ISO 13485 internal auditor training, or experience with statistical quality tools (SPC, sampling plans). Growth Path Quality Control Engineer → Senior Quality Control Engineer → Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer. Hiring Process Application Review → Working-level Interview → Executive Interview (if applicable) → Offer Discussion → Final Offer

title: KALİTE MÜDÜRÜ
description: Firmamızda görevlendirilmek üzere; GÖREV VE SORUMLULUKLAR Şirketin kalite politikası, hedefleri ve stratejileri doğrultusunda kalite yönetim sisteminin oluşturulması, uygulanması, sürdürülmesi ve sürekli iyileştirilmesine liderlik etmek. AS9100 ve ISO 9001 başta olmak üzere, faaliyet kapsamına ve müşteri gerekliliklerine uygulanabilir kalite standartları ile sözleşmesel kalite şartlarının karşılanmasını sağlamak. Kalite yönetim sisteminin etkinliğini izlemek; prosedür, talimat, proses ve kalite dokümantasyonunun güncelliğini ve uygulanabilirliğini güvence altına almak. İç tetkik, dış denetim, müşteri denetimi ve belgelendirme denetimlerini planlamak, koordine etmek ve sonuçlarını yönetmek. Denetim bulguları, uygunsuzluklar ve müşteri geri bildirimleri doğrultusunda düzeltici faaliyetleri yürütmek; kök neden analizlerini ve faaliyet sonuçlarını takip etmek. Tasarım, mühendislik, üretim, tedarik, montaj, test ve entegrasyon süreçlerinde kalite güvence faaliyetlerinin etkin şekilde yürütülmesini sağlamak. Giriş kalite kontrol, proses kalite kontrol, son kontrol, ölçüm ve test süreçlerini yönetmek; ürünlerin teknik resimlere, şartnamelere ve kabul kriterlerine uygunluğunu güvence altına almak. Tedarikçi kalite yönetimi, tedarikçi değerlendirme, performans izleme, uygunsuzluk yönetimi ve tedarikçi denetimlerini koordine etmek. Kaynaklı imalat, talaşlı imalat, boya ve yüzey işlemleri, montaj ve sistem entegrasyonu süreçlerine yönelik kalite gerekliliklerini takip etmek. Kalite performans göstergelerini belirlemek, izlemek ve raporlamak; hata oranları, uygunsuzluklar, müşteri şikâyetleri ve yeniden işleme maliyetleri üzerinden iyileştirme faaliyetleri yürütmek. Süreç ve ürün risklerini değerlendirmek; risk temelli düşünme yaklaşımının ilgili süreçlerde uygulanmasını sağlamak. Müşteri kalite gerekliliklerini, teknik şartnameleri ve proje kalite planlarını değerlendirmek; proje ekipleriyle koordineli çalışmak. Kalite ekibini yönetmek, çalışanların yetkinliklerini geliştirmek ve kalite bilincinin şirket genelinde yaygınlaştırılmasına liderlik etmek. Üst yönetime kalite performansı, denetim sonuçları, temel riskler ve iyileştirme ihtiyaçları hakkında düzenli raporlama yapmak. ARANAN NİTELİKLER Kalite yönetimi alanında en az 10 yıl mesleki deneyim. Üniversitelerin tercihen Makine, Endüstri, Metalurji ve Malzeme, Elektrik-Elektronik veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun. AS9100 kalite yönetim sistemi konusunda ileri düzeyde bilgi ve uygulama deneyimi. ISO 9001 kalite yönetim sistemi gerekliliklerine hâkim. Kalite yönetim sisteminin uygulanması, denetlenmesi, sürdürülmesi ve geliştirilmesi süreçlerinde aktif sorumluluk almış. İç tetkik, dış denetim, müşteri denetimi ve belgelendirme süreçlerini yönetme deneyimine sahip. Uygunsuzluk yönetimi, kök neden analizi, düzeltici faaliyetler ve sürekli iyileştirme yöntemlerinde yetkin. Üretim prosesleri, teknik resimler, ölçüm ve muayene yöntemleri ile ürün doğrulama süreçleri hakkında bilgi sahibi. Tedarikçi kalite yönetimi ve müşteri kalite süreçlerinde deneyimli. Ekip yönetimi, problem çözme, planlama, organizasyon ve karar alma becerileri gelişmiş. Analitik düşünme, iletişim ve raporlama yetkinliklerine sahip; MS Office uygulamalarını etkin kullanabilen. Tercihen iyi seviyede İngilizce bilen. TERCİH SEBEBİ OLACAK YETKİNLİKLER AS9100 kapsamında kalite yönetim sisteminin kurulması, geliştirilmesi veya belgelendirme süreçlerinde liderlik deneyimi. Savunma ve havacılık sanayii projelerinde, müşteri denetimlerinde ve ürün kabul süreçlerinde deneyim. AQAP 2110 ve/veya AQAP 2310 gibi ilgili kalite güvence standartları hakkında uygulama bilgisi. Kaynaklı imalat, talaşlı imalat, hassas ölçüm ve sistem entegrasyonu süreçlerinde kalite güvencesi deneyimi. Kalite yönetimi alanında baş denetçilik veya iç tetkikçilik eğitimi ve belgesi. Süreç performans yönetimi, risk analizi ve yalın üretim uygulamalarında deneyim Çalışma arkadaşları aramaktayız.

title: Head of Production
description: HEAD OF PRODUCTION Product Development, R&D & Prototyping Company : SLR – Smart Living Residences Location : İstanbul, Kadıkoy/Maslak Workplace Type : On-site Employment Type : Full-time Seniority Level : Director / Head of Department About SLR SLR (Smart Living Residences) is a next-generation residential living brand that combines innovative architecture, robotics, smart home technologies, and hospitality-inspired services to redefine modern living. We are building more than residences. We are developing an integrated living experience where design, technology, functionality, and comfort work seamlessly together. The Role We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Head of Production to lead the development and delivery of our physical products, prototypes, and residential experiences. This role requires someone who can connect architecture, interior design, mechatronics, engineering, technology, and manufacturing — transforming ambitious concepts into fully developed, functional products and spaces. You will take ownership of multidisciplinary teams, external manufacturers, suppliers, budgets, production schedules, quality standards, and final delivery. Key Responsibilities • Lead end-to-end product development, prototyping, manufacturing, installation, and delivery. • Coordinate architects, interior designers, mechanical and mechatronics engineers, software developers, and technology partners. • Manage production schedules, budgets, suppliers, workshops, and external contractors. • Translate creative concepts and technical designs into manufacturable solutions. • Oversee the development of transformable furniture, robotic mechanisms, and integrated smart living systems. • Establish clear deliverables, quality-control processes, and technical approval procedures. • Identify production risks early and develop practical solutions. • Coordinate prototype testing, technical safety verification, installation, and commissioning. • Build scalable production workflows for future SLR developments. • Report directly to the founder with clear progress updates, proposed solutions, and key decisions. Qualifications • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Industrial Design, or a related field. • 8+ years of experience in product development, technical production, manufacturing, prototyping, or multidisciplinary project delivery. • Proven experience leading complex projects involving multiple technical disciplines. • Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, technical documentation, materials, suppliers, and quality control. • Experience managing external production partners and international manufacturers. • Excellent planning, budgeting, problem-solving, and leadership skills. • Ability to make independent decisions, take ownership, and deliver under tight deadlines. • Professional proficiency in English. • Willingness to travel internationally when required. Highly Preferred Experience in one or more of the following areas: • Robotics and mechatronic systems • Transformable or modular furniture • Smart home technologies and automation • Innovative residential interiors • Hardware product development • International sourcing and manufacturing, particularly in China • Prototype-to-production processes What We're Looking For We are not looking for a traditional construction project manager or an advertising production executive. We are looking for a builder, problem-solver, and multidisciplinary leader who understands both design ambition and engineering reality. Someone who can take ownership, lead people, make decisions, solve complex challenges, and deliver exceptional results without constant supervision. Why Join SLR? This is an opportunity to join an ambitious new venture at its foundation and play a key role in developing a new generation of residential living products and experiences. You will work across architecture, engineering, robotics, and emerging technologies, helping build not only our first project but also the production systems that will support SLR's future growth. How to Apply Please apply through LinkedIn with your CV and a brief description of at least two complex projects you have personally managed from concept through production and delivery. We are particularly interested in understanding your responsibilities, the challenges you solved, and the final results you delivered. SLR – Smart Living Residences More Life. More Living.

title: Junior Mechanical Engineer Machinebouw - Werktuigbouwkunde
description: Over de vacature Combineer techniek en klantcontact als Junior Mechanical Engineer / Project Engineer Machinebouw. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen van kolommen, drukvaten en warmtewisselaars, waarbij je direct schakelt met grote klanten uit de olie- en gasindustrie en (petro)chemie. Je ontvangt technische datalists van opdrachtgevers als Shell, Exxon of BP en vertaalt deze naar een berekening en een eerste 2D-schets in AutoCAD. Daarna werk je het ontwerp uit in 3D CAD (SolidWorks/AutoCAD), stel je stuklijsten op en lever je een compleet documentatiepakket aan. Na goedkeuring door de klant draag je het pakket over aan de werkplaats voor productie. Je bent dus betrokken bij het volledige traject: van klantvraag en ontwerp tot realisatie en overdracht. Naast technische diepgang biedt deze rol afwisseling door klantcontact en projectmatige verantwoordelijkheden. Je borgt kwaliteit, maakbaarheid en klanttevredenheid van concept tot werktekening. Deze producent van procesapparatuur is gespecialiseerd in de engineering en fabricage van drukvaten en warmtewisselaars voor de olie- en gasindustrie en (petro)chemische sector. Drukvaten worden ontworpen en geproduceerd volgens de strengste internationale normen. De organisatie beschikt over een eigen ingenieursafdeling voor mechanisch ontwerp en thermische berekeningen (HTRI). Voor 2D/3D-ontwerp worden AutoCAD (LT) en SolidWorks ingezet, inclusief het opstellen van stuklijsten en productietekeningen. Je werkt direct samen met productie voor een efficiënte overdracht van ontwerp naar maakproces en borgt normen als ASME. Wat ga je doen? Ontwerpen van kolommen, drukvaten en warmtewisselaars op basis van technische datalists van grote klanten (o.a. Shell, Exxon, BP); Uitvoeren van berekeningen en opzetten van eerste 2D-schetsen in AutoCAD; Uitwerken en detailleren van ontwerpen in 3D CAD (SolidWorks of AutoCAD); Opstellen van stuklijsten en samenstellen van een compleet documentatiepakket; Afstemmen met de klant over specificaties en goedkeuringen; Overdragen van het goedgekeurde pakket aan de werkplaats voor productie; Verzorgen van technische documentatie; Optioneel: uitvoeren van constructieberekeningen volgens ASME, EN13445 en RToD. Wat neem je mee? MBO of HBO diploma richting Werktuigbouwkunde of gelijkwaardig óf aantoonbare ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol; Ervaring als tekenaar/constructeur of engineer, bij voorkeur met drukvaten en/of warmtewisselaars; Kennis van of ervaring met het ontwerpen in de machinebouw is een pré; Ervaring met SolidWorks of AutoCAD is een pré; Goede beheersing van het Nederlands in woord en geschrift; Redelijke tot goede beheersing van het Engels. Wat bieden we jou? Salaris op basis van opleiding en ervaring; Vakantiegeld (8,33%) en vakantiedagen (minimaal 25 p/j); Netto onkostenvergoeding van €500 op jaarbasis; Pensioenregeling en optie tot deelname collectieve zorgverzekering; Gratis opleidingen en trainingen op onze eigen Academy; Indien gewenst begeleiding door een specialist binnen jouw vakgebied; Mogelijkheid om één dag thuis te werken; Passende begeleiding op basis van ervaring. Vragen over deze vacature? Heb je (technische) vragen over deze rol of wil je vrijblijvend sparren over de inhoud en de match met jouw expertise? Neem contact op met Nadine van Schie via +31686816336 of nadine.van.schie@dosign.com.

title: Mechanical Engineer (Hydraulics)
description: Mechanical Engineer (Hydraulics) Werk jij graag aan de nieuwste generatie voertuigen en weet jij alles van hydraulische systemen? Als Mechanical Engineer (Hydraulics) krijg je de kans om een sleutelrol te spelen in de ontwikkeling van innovatieve automotive oplossingen bij een toonaangevende fabrikant. Wat ga je doen? Operating in the Rotterdam area, the company delivers high-quality engineering solutions to clients worldwide, with a strong emphasis on quality, safety, and technical excellence. You will work closely with project managers, production teams, suppliers, and other engineering disciplines to ensure projects are delivered in accordance with technical specifications, applicable standards, and client requirements. Perform mechanical calculations in accordance with applicable codes and standards, including ASME, EN, and PED. Prepare, review, and maintain technical documentation, datasheets, engineering specifications, and drawings. Please note that this is a fully office-based position in the Rotterdam area. Applicants must be comfortable commuting to the office every working day. Candidates requiring remote or hybrid working arrangements will not be considered.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Ben jij een gedreven en enthousiaste Mechanical Engineer met een passie voor techniek en innovatie? Beschik jij over een analytisch denkvermogen en krijg je energie van het bedenken van slimme oplossingen? Dan wij zijn op zoek naar jou! Als Mechanical Engineer bij Randstad Professional krijg je de mogelijkheid om voor verschillende bedrijven in Noord-Nederland op project basis te werken. Dit kunnen grote bedrijven zijn, maar ook de MKB bedrijven. Je wordt onderdeel van een team van professionals en experts en je werkt mee aan verschillende uitdagende projecten binnen Engineering. Je krijgt de kans om jouw kennis en creativiteit in te zetten voor ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en verbeteren van producten en systemen. Je deelt de opgedane kennis van je opdracht met collega professionals en daarnaast bouw je aan een sterk relatienetwerk waarmee je bijdraagt aan de collectieve kennis van ons. Wat kun je van Randstad Professional verwachten? Met jouw afgeronde HBO/WO Werktuigbouwkunde of Mechatronica opleiding heb jij mooie theoretische ervaring opgedaan. Via Randstad Professional krijg je de kans om deze ervaring om te zetten naar de praktijk. Wij geven jou zowel persoonlijke- als technische begeleiding om het maximale uit je opleiding te halen. Wij bieden uitdagende opdrachten in een omgeving die passen bij jouw ontwikkeling en ambitite. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om je verder te specialiseren. Denk hierbij aan R&D, Test Engineering, Production & Manufacturing, Maintenance, Quality en nog veel meer. Solliciteer nu en ontvang binnen 15 minuten een WhatsApp-berichtje met een paar korte vragen, zodat we je snel kunnen helpen. Heb je geen WhatsApp? Dan nemen we contact met je op via telefoon of e-mail! Functie-eisen Wie zoeken wij? Als Mechanical Engineer komen jouw technische kennis, analytisch vermogen en persoonlijke vaardigheden goed van pas. Voor de rest vragen wij: Een afgeronde HBO of WO opleiding in de richting van Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica, Elektrotechniek of Biomedical Engineering; Relevante ervaring in een technische omgeving vanuit een stage of werkervaring (denk hierbij aan 3D tekenen in CAD systemen zoals Siemens NX, Creo, Solidworks, Inventor, etc); Vloeiend in de Nederlandse taal. Arbeidsvoorwaarden Randstad Professional gelooft in jouw toekomst. Er dat betekent ook dat wij in jou investeren. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: SENIOR MECHANICAL PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER Join our product development team Mechanical Product Development • Robust Design • Plastics • From Design To Production-ready Product Location: Allerød, north of Copenhagen • Function: R&D / Product Development Do you enjoy the engineering disciplines that turn a good mechanical design into a robust product design that works reliably in the real world ? Qufora is a growing, design-focused medical device company. We develop intuitive products that help people with chronic bowel disorders live a more fulfilled life. We have a relatively small and flat organisation, which means short distances from idea to decision and from decision to action. You will be close to the products, the technical decisions and the people who make them—with the opportunity to influence both the engineering solutions and how we work. The engineering role This is a role for someone who enjoys the fundamentals of good mechanical engineering and knows how to combine them into robust design solutions. Understanding variation and sensitivity to design products that perform consistently despite real-world variation in components, materials, processes and use. Interface & mechanical design – create well-defined interfaces and mechanically sound solutions without unnecessary constraints or complexity. Tolerances & GPS/GD&T – translate functional needs into meaningful dimensions and tolerances, using tolerance stack-ups and statistical tolerancing where relevant. Mechanics & structural integrity – apply solid mechanics, engineering calculations and FEA where appropriate to understand loads, deformation, strength, fatigue and failure modes. Materials & plastics – select materials based on function, environment, manufacturing process and long-term product performance. DFM/DFA & injection moulding – develop designs that can be manufactured and assembled consistently and at the required quality, working closely with toolmakers, suppliers and Operations. Variation & statistical analysis – use data and statistical methods to understand variation, identify critical parameters and build robustness into the design. You will not be placed in a narrow technical box. Depending on the challenge, you may move from CAD and tolerance analysis to material selection, supplier discussions, FEA, design reviews, verification results or solving a difficult mechanical problem in an existing product. What you will do You will take senior technical ownership of mechanical development activities, particularly in the later stages of product development. You will: Develop and mature mechanical solutions from established concepts through detailed design, verification, design transfer and launch. Create high-quality 3D designs and clear, production-ready 2D drawings. Drive difficult mechanical issues to root cause and closure. Work hands-on with plastics, injection-moulded components, interfaces, tolerances, materials and robust design. Work closely with Operations, external manufacturers, suppliers and toolmakers to turn designs into stable, manufacturable products. Lead and coordinate mechanical engineering activities when several people or disciplines need to contribute. Help strengthen our mechanical engineering methods, standards and ways of working. What we are looking for You have a BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Product Development or a similar discipline and at least 8 years of experience in mechanical product development . Ideally, you bring several of the following: Strong mechanical design fundamentals and engineering judgement. Experience with plastic product design and injection moulding. Advanced 3D CAD and 2D drawing skills, preferably SolidWorks. Strong knowledge of ISO GPS/GD&T, tolerance analysis and robust design. Experience with DFM/DFA, materials, mechanics and preferably FEA. Experience taking products from detailed development through verification and into production. The ability to structure complex technical work and drive issues to completion. Experience from medical devices or another regulated industry is an advantage, but first and foremost, we are looking for a strong mechanical product developer . Why Qufora? At Qufora, you will work broadly across mechanical engineering disciplines and follow products through the development process rather than being limited to one narrow area. You will be close to the products, colleagues and decisions, with the opportunity to influence both engineering solutions and how we work. And because we develop medical devices, your engineering decisions ultimately matter to people who rely on our products every day. Application Please apply through LinkedIn. Applications will be reviewed, and interviews held on an ongoing basis.

title: Drivetrain Engineer – Wind Power
description: Drivetrain Engineer – Wind Power On behalf of Goldwind Denmark, Nordic Talent Collab is looking for a Drivetrain Engineer to contribute to the development of wind turbine drivetrain systems. You will join an international engineering environment where colleagues in Denmark and China work together to develop mechanical concepts, evaluate design solutions and support their implementation. This opportunity suits you if you enjoy combining component design with an understanding of the complete drivetrain. In a growing company with ambitious technology goals, you can influence new concepts and help turn them into practical solutions while broadening your expertise. The role You will develop and evaluate drivetrain concepts, balancing reliability, weight, cost and serviceability. Working with engineering specialists and suppliers, you will translate system requirements and turbine loads into mechanical solutions. Your responsibilities include: Developing concepts for main shafts, bearing arrangements, housings, supporting structures and interfaces with gearboxes and generators. Developing mechanical designs supported by calculations, CAD models and technical specifications. Assessing load paths, stiffness, alignment, tolerances and component interactions alongside FEA specialists. Comparing solutions to improve performance, manufacturability, assembly and maintenance. Supporting colleagues in China during detailed design and participating in design reviews. Assessing suppliers’ component capabilities, resolving technical questions and supporting design verification and testing. Documenting recommendations, assumptions and design risks. Your profile You take a systematic, practical approach to engineering, develop concepts independently and challenge assumptions constructively. You involve specialists when needed, take responsibility for your work and communicate your findings clearly. We expect you to have: A degree in mechanical engineering or a related discipline. At least five years of relevant experience in mechanical design and development. Practical knowledge of one or more drivetrain components, such as shafts, bearings, housings, couplings or gearbox support arrangements. A solid grounding in strength, fatigue, stiffness, materials and tolerances. Experience with 3D CAD, engineering drawings and mechanical calculations, together with the ability to interpret simulation results and use them to guide design decisions. Good written and spoken English and the ability to communicate effectively across teams and cultures. Experience with wind turbine drivetrains or comparable large rotating machinery is preferred. Experience with rolling or plain bearings, large cast or forged components, drivetrain dynamics, prototype testing or wind turbine certification is an advantage. We also welcome specialists who want to broaden their understanding of the complete drivetrain. What can you look forward to? You will have the opportunity to influence drivetrain concepts and help develop them into practical engineering solutions. Your work will span concept development, component design, design reviews and validation, allowing you to see how technical decisions translate into working designs. Through close collaboration with an international engineering team and specialist suppliers, you will exchange knowledge, explore different approaches and develop both your specialist expertise and your understanding of the complete drivetrain. About Goldwind Goldwind Energy ApS (also called Goldwind Denmark) is a R&D focused subsidiary of GOLDWIND SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD. (Goldwind), a world leading wind turbine technology and energy solutions provider headquartered in Beijing, China. Through the implementation and investment in industry-leading turbine technology, water treatment solutions and other green energy technological ventures, Goldwind has been hailed as one of China’s most innovative companies. Interested? Nordic Talent Collab is managing the recruitment for Goldwind Denmark. Please submit your CV and a short application as soon as possible. Interviews are held on an ongoing basis. If you have any questions about the role, please contact: Kristian Kantsø Nordic Talent Collab T: +45 2834 1509 M: kristian@nordictalentcollab.dk

Traditional CBM still relies heavily on information coming from manual inspections, analysis, and planning. While generic digital tools exist, they often fail to deliver efficiency gains for complex and specialized assets like navigation locks. Navigation locks are made up of many structural and mechanical components, each with unique degradation mechanisms. These can be detected and structural condition indicators drawn when changes in certain parameters are detected/triggered. Understanding these “triggers” is essential for building a digital CBM ecosystem that truly works. By identifying and clustering triggers, and deploying sensors optimally, we can create a Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) system that offers reliable, real-time insights into the condition of a lock complex. Challenge The aim of this project is to design a framework for the SHM system of the Hengelo Lock Complex . You will investigate how the condition of the lock is currently assessed and identify triggers that allow for automated, continuous SHM with minimal human interventions. Your research will cover: Analysis of structural and mechanical behaviour of lock components. Review of relevant national, regional, and organizational regulations and guidelines. Evaluation of current practices and feasible structural health monitoring technologies. Cost–benefit assessment of sensor deployment and measurement interpretation strategies. This is a multifaceted project at the intersection of structural and mechanical engineering, asset management, and Civionics – sensor-based SHM of civil infrastructure. Context and Supervision The project is sponsored and hosted by Rijkswaterstaat , the executive agency of the Dutch Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management. Rijkswaterstaat designs, constructs, manages, and maintains key infrastructure in the Netherlands. You will be supervised by: Dr. Farid Vahdatikhaki (University of Twente) Dr. Roland Kromanis (University of Twente) Mr. Sukon Wu (Rijkswaterstaat) You will work closely with Rijkswaterstaat to deliver a tailor-made design artifact with real-world impact. The project is based in Enschede/Hengelo . On successfully completing the program, you will receive a certified and recognised degree. You will be entitled to use the academic title of Engineering Doctorate (EngD). You will be registered as a Technological Designer in the Dutch register kept by the Royal Institution of Engineers in the Netherlands (KIVI). Your profile We invite you to apply when fulfilling the following conditions. You are: One of the best M.Sc. graduates with a background in structural and mechanical engineering, structural health monitoring, monitoring systems, and asset management. You have the ambition and talent to accelerate in finding solutions / crafting designs for complex technological issues with a multidisciplinary character. Your professional English proficiency is high. A working command of Dutch is highly preferred. You like to spend time in a professional organisation like Rijkswaterstaat, and the academic environment of the University of Twente You work systematically and like designing innovative solutions. You can work independently. You have strong communication and social skills. You can collaborate in teams and take initiative to develop solutions. You must be willing to move to (the vicinity of) Enschede. Presence at the UT and Rijkswaterstaat branch in Hengelo is expected on a daily basis. Our offer Two-year fulltime EngD position, where scientific and research domains are combined optimally with education and practical implementation of innovative design. Full status as an employee at the UT, including pension and health care benefits Tailor-made educational/development program of at least 6 months (30 EC), including visits to conferences. A salary of €3.173,- gross per month. An annual holiday allowance of 8% of the gross annual salary, and an annual year-end bonus of 8.3%. Minimum of 29 holidays per year in case of fulltime employment. A work environment on a green and lively campus with sports and leisure facilities. Mentorship that supports your professional and personal growth. Information and application Please send your application using the instructions below before November 15th . Your submission is considered eligible if it includes (only and no less than) the following documents: Recent CV (including relevant academic, and (if any) professional experience) Motivation letter (max 1 page) specifically explaining your interest and relevant background knowledge for the project. Overview of M.Sc. degree: including thesis project title, thesis abstract, and grade list Please contact the selection committee for more information about the project or your eligibility. You can reach them via email on f.vahdatikhaki@utwente.nl (Farid Vahdati) and r.kromanis@utwente.nl (Roland Kromanis). About The Organisation At the Faculty of Engineering Technology (ET), we work on engineering for impact: developing smart, sustainable, human-centred and technological solutions for societal challenges. We connect fundamental education, research and practice across five core domains: Asset & Maintenance engineering, Intelligent Manufacturing Systems, Personalised Health Technology, Resilience Engineering, and Sustainable Production, Energy and Resources. We work on education and research in mechanical engineering, civil engineering and industrial design engineering. Together, we learn by making, creating, and innovating, addressing challenges in a solution-oriented way. Quality, connection and inclusivity are the foundation of our culture. In our open community, students, researchers and staff collaborate with industrial and societal partners. This enables us to develop insights, applications and solutions that add value to society.

We want talented, passionate and engaged people to join Aerogen and build your career with us. title: Ingénieur mécanique H/F
description: À propos de Vulcain Engineering Group Vulcain Engineering Group est un groupe d’ingénierie et de conseil en forte croissance, présent en France et à l’international. Nous créons, concevons, construisons et exploitons des solutions qui améliorent les infrastructures essentielles et soutiennent le progrès durable. Nos équipes accompagnent des acteurs clés de l’énergie, de la santé, des transports, de l’industrie et des infrastructures. Notre mission : apporter « The Energy to Transform » à des projets utiles et responsables. Concrètement, nous aidons à décarboner, optimiser la consommation d’eau et réduire l’empreinte environnementale des procédés industriels. Nous investissons aussi dans la transformation numérique pour renforcer l’innovation et la performance de nos clients. Chez Vulcain, l’entraide et la bienveillance structurent nos équipes au quotidien, en agence comme sur le terrain. Nous offrons des parcours personnalisés (mobilité, formation, e-learning via Mylee ) pour développer les talents. Engagés pour la diversité, le handicap et l’égalité professionnelle, nous construisons un collectif inclusif et ouvert. Ensemble, faisons de l’ingénierie une force pour un futur durable et responsable. Nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Mécanique pour rejoindre nos équipes dans l’Ouest de la France. Que vous soyez jeune diplômé(e) souhaitant démarrer votre carrière, ou ingénieur(e) expérimenté(e) à la recherche d’un nouveau challenge technique, nous avons plusieurs opportunités adaptées à votre profil et à vos ambitions. Vos missions Réaliser des études mécaniques (dimensionnements, analyses fonctionnelles, calculs de contraintes et de résistance des matériaux). Concevoir des équipements ou systèmes mécaniques en 3D selon les contraintes techniques, normatives et environnementales. Élaborer la documentation technique : plans, nomenclatures, fiches techniques et dossiers de conception. Collaborer avec les équipes projet, les services procédés, structures et installation générale pour assurer la cohérence technique des livrables. Participer au suivi de la fabrication, aux contrôles qualité et aux essais en usine ou sur site. Proposer des améliorations sur les méthodes de conception, les choix de matériaux et les performances mécaniques. Assurer la conformité HSE et contribuer aux démarches d’amélioration continue. Autres… Profil recherché Formation : Diplôme d’ingénieur ou équivalent (Bac +5) en mécanique, conception de produits industriels ou génie mécanique. Expérience : Première expérience réussie (stage, alternance ou emploi) ou profil confirmé en conception ou ingénierie mécanique. Compétences techniques : conception 3D/2D, dimensionnement mécanique, connaissance des matériaux et des procédés de fabrication, maîtrise d’un ou plusieurs logiciels tels que SolidWorks, CATIA, CREO, NX, AutoCAD ou Inventor. Qualités : rigueur, capacité d'adaptation, autonomie, esprit d’équipe et curiosité technique. Langues : anglais intermédiaire ou plus apprécié. Pourquoi rejoindre Vulcain ? Évoluer sur des projets à fort impact dans des secteurs innovants (énergie, industrie, transport, environnement). Développer votre carrière technique grâce à un accompagnement de proximité, des formations ciblées et des opportunités de mobilité en France comme à l’international. Intégrer une culture d’équipe solidaire et bienveillante, où entraide et performance s’allient au quotidien. title: Mechanical Engineer, Lund
description: Job Title Mechanical Engineer, Lund Job Description Mechanical Engineer with passion for product development! At Axis, our passion is to create a smarter and safer world! We have delivered several groundbreaking products and look forward to paving the way for many more. Come join our team and help us in finding smart solutions for fantastic products! We are now seeking a mechanical engineer to join our mechanics team within System Products at Axis HQ in Lund. System Products is responsible for developing a wide and exciting product portfolio, which includes body-worn cameras, video recorders, microphone products, video decoders, sirens, and other system accessories. Your future team We who work in your future team are passionate engineers who love technology and tough technical challenges. We highly value creativity, collaboration, and openness. You will be overwhelmed by your colleagues' helpfulness and their willingness to help you develop. We are multiple functions working together to develop, improve, and deliver world-class products! What You’ll Do Here As a Mechanical Engineer As a mechanical engineer on System products, you will work on product development in areas such as body-worn cameras, recorders, microphone products, and other system devices. Much of your daily work is in projects where the project team consists of different functions and competencies. The length of a project typically ranges from 6 months to 2 years. In the project, you work closely with electronics, firmware, and many other internal functions such as quality, testing, production, and purchasing. In the projects, you drive the mechanical development together with a few colleagues from concept study to mass production. These tasks include designing the product, creating prototypes, communicating with suppliers, verifying the product, and preparing the product for mass production. To optimize the production of the design, you also have close contact with our suppliers around the world. The portfolio includes both large and small projects, and several of the product types we develop are new to us, so unknown challenges and opportunities for variation are promised. In your work, you will also meet and work together with product managers, project leaders, line managers, and engineers from other departments and competencies. Who are you? We are looking for a team-oriented colleague with a positive mindset. You love challenges and working together with others. You are passionate about product development from the first idea to holding the product in your hand. You like to challenge old truths and develop new innovative products. You are considerate and value good communication. Finally, and most importantly, you love being part of a creative and happy team that delivers outstanding products! In our department, we work with both mechanical designs, electromechanics, and several different types of manufacturing methods. We would like you to have experience or a strong interest in some of these areas (new graduates are welcome to apply): Knowledge of at least one 3D CAD system, preferably Creo. Prototype creation Mechanical engineering background Windchill/Creo knowledge Injection molding/diecast/sheet metal Design for production Product development in telecommunications (4G, 5G), Wi-Fi, or GPS Fluent in Swedish and English, both spoken and written. What can Axis offer you? A fantastic team with colleagues who want to succeed together with you. We learn and develop through our work with product development, and we are not afraid to try new things. Internal courses and external education are part of your work life here. From your first day, you will have a mentor colleague who helps you and teaches you how we work at Axis. Axis also has an excellent introduction program for new employees. We strive to give each individual great personal responsibility and opportunity to grow both as a person and professionally. You become part of a well-functioning team with engaged people who like going to work in the morning. We want you to thrive with us. Therefore, we offer fantastic benefits such as flexible working hours, morning coffee every day, Friday coffee, company bonus, health insurance, paid vacation, generous parental leave, generous sick/accident insurance, and your very own Axis bike - just to mention a few. What Axis Has To Offer We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you’ll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance — developing solutions used worldwide. As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You’ll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance — and even your own Axis bicycle. To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore: Life at Axis blog Engineering at Axis blog Innovation at Axis Ready to act? If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Engineering Manager Maiko Karlsson at phone number 046-272 1800. We review applications continuously, so don't wait to send in your application! Type of Employment Permanent Employment Posting End Date 2026-11-03 Certain roles at Axis require background checks, which means applicable verifications will be done in these recruitments. Notice will be provided before we take any action. About Axis Communications We enable a smarter and safer world by creating innovative solutions for improving security and business performance. As a network technology company and industry leader, we offer solutions in video surveillance, access control, intercom, and audio systems, enhanced by intelligent analytics applications. With around 6,000 committed employees in over 50 count

title: Ingénieur Calcul Mécanique

title: Ingénieur simulation/Ingénieure simulation
description: Dans le cadre du développement de ses activités dans le secteur de la défense et des véhicules industriels , agap2 renforce ses équipes et recherche un Ingénieur Pilote Calcul Éléments Finis pour intervenir sur des projets de conception, de dimensionnement et de validation de structures mécaniques complexes. Vous serez responsable de la réalisation et du pilotage des études de simulation numérique par éléments finis (FEM/FEA) , afin de garantir la résistance, la fiabilité et les performances des composants et systèmes mécaniques. Vous interviendrez en collaboration avec les équipes de conception et d'ingénierie pour optimiser les architectures et valider les choix techniques. Mobilité : Ouest parisie Démarrage : ASAP Contrat : CDI Expérience : 5 ans minimum Vos principales responsabilités : Réaliser les simulations numériques par méthode des éléments finis (FEM/FEA) sur des composants et structures mécaniques. Définir les méthodologies de calcul adaptées aux sollicitations et aux exigences techniques des projets. Construire et préparer les modèles numériques nécessaires aux simulations. Réaliser le maillage des structures et définir les conditions aux limites ainsi que les différents cas de chargement. Effectuer les calculs statiques linéaires et non linéaires . Réaliser les analyses de fatigue et de tolérance aux dommages . Effectuer les analyses modales, vibratoires et dynamiques . Réaliser les analyses de réponse en fréquence et de réponse aléatoire . Utiliser la suite Altair HyperWorks , notamment les solveurs OptiStruct et Radioss . Réaliser le post-traitement des résultats de simulation et analyser les comportements mécaniques des structures. Vérifier la conformité des résultats avec les exigences du cahier des charges et les référentiels métier. Identifier les zones critiques et proposer des solutions d'optimisation mécanique . Apporter un support technique aux équipes Bureau d'Études, Conception Mécanique et Ingénierie . Challenger les choix de conception et proposer des modifications permettant d'améliorer la résistance, la masse et les performances des structures. Rédiger les notes de calcul, rapports d'analyses et dossiers de justification technique . Assurer le pilotage et le suivi des demandes de calcul sur les différents projets. Coordonner les études réalisées en interne et en sous-traitance. Piloter les prestataires de calcul et garantir le respect des exigences techniques, qualité et délais. Vérifier la bonne application des référentiels métier dans les études sous-traitées. Participer à la planification des activités et au suivi des jalons projet. Assurer le reporting technique et le suivi de l'avancement des études. Participer aux revues de conception et de validation technique . Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des méthodologies et outils de calcul . Participer à la justification des architectures et à la validation des différents niveaux de maturité des produits. Travailler en coordination avec les équipes Conception, Essais, Industrialisation et Gestion de Projet . Profil recherché : Diplôme Bac+5 en génie mécanique, calcul de structures, simulation numérique ou école d'ingénieur généraliste à dominante mécanique. Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en calcul mécanique et simulation numérique par éléments finis. Maîtrise obligatoire de la suite Altair HyperWorks , notamment OptiStruct et Radioss . Solides connaissances en résistance des matériaux (RDM) et comportement des structures mécaniques. Bonne maîtrise des calculs statiques linéaires et non linéaires . Expérience en analyses vibratoires, dynamiques, modales et de fatigue . Connaissances en tolérance aux dommages et essais mécaniques . Maîtrise des différentes étapes d'une étude FEM : modélisation, maillage, conditions aux limites, calcul et post-traitement . Bonne compréhension des problématiques de conception mécanique et dimensionnement de structures . Capacité à rédiger des notes de calcul et dossiers de justification technique . Expérience dans le pilotage d'études de calcul et la coordination de sous-traitants . Une expérience dans les secteurs automobile, véhicules industriels, systèmes mobiles ou défense constitue un véritable atout. Capacité à travailler en mode multi-projets . Autonomie, rigueur, réactivité et esprit de synthèse. Excellentes capacités de communication et qualités rédactionnelles. Esprit d'équipe, proactivité et capacité à proposer des solutions techniques adaptées. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Intervenir sur des projets de conception et de validation de structures mécaniques complexes . Participer au développement de véhicules et systèmes industriels à forte technicité. Occuper une fonction transverse entre calcul, conception mécanique, essais et ingénierie . Développer votre expertise en simulation numérique et pilotage d'études par éléments finis . Évoluer vers des fonctions de Référent Calcul, Expert Simulation ou Lead Stress Engineer . Comment postuler ? Envoyez votre CV actualisé ainsi que votre disponibilité Nous nous engageons à étudier toutes les candidatures sans discrimination, dans une logique d'égalité des chances. Si vous avez besoin d'adaptations spécifiques liées à votre situation, nous restons à l'écoute.
