title: Process Engineer
description: Life tastes better with ice cream With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry. We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference. What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work. We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done. We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better. The Role The Process Engineer role is critical to the development of our factories to World Class, which means zero defects, zero waste and zero losses. He/She will apply extensively the full range of Focussed Improvement methods and tools to counter losses identified in the areas of Safety, Quality, Business priority and Cost Deployment, Autonomous maintenance, Customer Service and Agility. The Business priority and Cost Deployment pillar will be populated with data built up through application of the Managing Manufacturing Performance Code, which is key to ensuring focus on the main losses. Working directly with the line crews on a daily basis the Process Engineer also acts as the technical trainer for line teams and provides coaching in phenomena identification, root cause analysis and the establishment of counter-measures. The Process Engineer is responsible for the validation of all process improvements and the establishment of revised basic conditions on the line. FI pillar and process engineers will collaborate with Customer Service and Agility team regarding to OR (Foundation Tier) and site DBNR improvement(Advanced Tier). Process engineers can suggest an automation solution to attack certain losses or participate in a factory automation projects if he/she has relevant expertise What you'll be responsible for Eliminate Waste and Loss according to the UMS prioritization process using BPCD, FI, AM, PM, Q, PD pillar tools and methodologies; Create Technical Standards to ensure process stability on the line; Run to Standard (R2S) implementation: (Data collection and analysis, Prioritization of losses, Problem solving, SMED, AM activities definition and machine settings (Centerlines or Process parameters definition); Train line crews on technical standards and restoration of basic conditions (Stability sustainability); Identify and extend good practice to other lines; Provide inputs of EEM pillar – MP data; Factory OR and DBNR improvement; NVAA reduction; Application and accuracy of MMP Code data. We're looking for someone who Process Engineers are required in our sites to support Manufacturing teams by focusing on technical elimination of losses and waste on the production line including, but not limited to Minor stoppage reduction Change over time reduction Elimination of RPM waste Support of digital related projects Confidential Other NVAA reduction activities Process engineers are involved in continuous improvements from the engineer viewpoint, responsible to solve chronical problems, reduce NVAA, develop standards, and drive productivity while granting quality and safety. Process engineers also lead/co-ordinate the deployment of digital activities in the factories. The focus will be on enabling our manufacturing sites to deploy appropriate, standardized technologies and ensure consistency in deployment and associated benefit delivery Key Skills and Competencies Business acumen and financial tools, understanding of the Master plan, factory priorities and how manufacturing performance of the site correlates with its finance KPIs and BGs targets achievement; Manufacturing & Packaging technology. Rely on basic but consistent understanding of the manufacturing technologies of the Category to drive relevant process Improvement; Engineering. title: Hava Savunma Sistemleri Proje Mühendisi
description: ASELSAN Savunma Sistem Teknolojileri (SST) Sektör Başkanlığı bünyesinde Gölbaşı yerleşkesindeki faaliyetlerimizde bize güç katacak üniversitelerin Elektrik-Elektronik, Makina, Bilgisayar ve Endüstri Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun Hava Savunma Sistemleri Proje Mühendisi çalışma arkadaşları arıyoruz. BU POZİSYONDA EN ÖNEM VERDİĞİMİZ YETKİNLİKLER VE DENEYİMLER Proje yönetimi, planlama, mali yönetim, gereksinim ve risk yönetimi, sözleşme yönetimi süreçlerinde bilgi sahibi, Tercihen proje yönetim araçları konusunda bilgi ve uygulama tecrübesine sahip, Benzer sektörde ve pozisyonda tercihen 2-7 yıl tecrübeli, Saha testlerine katılmak konusunda istekli ve herhangi bir açıdan engeli olmayan. SENDEN NELER BEKLİYORUZ? SST Sektör Başkanlığı tarafından yürütülen Taktik Hava Savunma Füze Sistemleri projelerinde, Proje takviminin, proje bütçesinin ve hedeflenen özelliklerin kontrolünün sağlanması, Projenin taahhüt edildiği şekilde tamamlanmasının sağlanması, İç ve dış paydaşlarla koordinasyon ve iletişim yönetimi, Bütçe, takvim ve iş gücü planlamasının yapılması, Planların etkin bir şekilde izlenmesi ve raporlanması, Proje takvimlerinin oluşturulması, güncellenmesi, ilerlemelerin raporlanması, Risk yönetim faaliyetlerinin etkin ve standart bir şekilde yürütülmesi, izlenmesi ve raporlanması, Saha testlerinin koordinasyonu ve yönetimi Sorumlu olduğu faaliyetleri ile ilgili gerekli tüm dokümantasyon ve raporların hazırlanıp idame edilmesi, Mali yönetim faaliyetlerinin etkin ve standart bir şekilde yürütülmesi, izlenmesi ve raporlanması, Alt yükleniciler ile yürütülen faaliyetlerin yönetilmesi (işin tanımlanması, takibi ve sonuçlandırılması). *İşe alım kriterlerimizi ASELSAN internet sayfamızda Kariyer Sekmesinde bulunan İşe Alım Sürecimiz alanından inceleyerek iş başvuru formumuzu doldur. Aselsan ailesinin bir parçası olarak yerli ve milli projelerdeki başarımızda senin de imzan olsun. Biz Kimiz? title: Yapısal Tasarım Mühendisi
description: YAPISAL ÇELİK MÜHENDİSİ OSEMA Makina Sanayi A.Ş. | Ankara / Temelli İş Tanımı Ankara Temelli’de bulunan fabrikamızda ağır çelik konstrüksiyon, yapısal çelik ve özel kaynaklı imalat alanlarında faaliyet gösteren OSEMA Makina Sanayi A.Ş. bünyesinde görevlendirilmek üzere, yapısal çelik projelerinin tasarım, statik analiz ve imalat detaylandırma süreçlerini uçtan uca yürütebilecek Yapısal Çelik Mühendisi arıyoruz. Aradığımız adayın, projeleri yalnızca hesap ve modelleme aşamasında bırakmayıp, imalata doğrudan aktarılabilecek eksiksiz ve uygulanabilir teknik resimlere dönüştürebilmesi beklenmektedir. Görev ve Sorumluluklar Yapısal çelik konstrüksiyon projelerinin tasarımını, boyutlandırmasını ve statik analizlerini gerçekleştirmek. Çelik yapıların güvenliğini, dayanımını, rijitliğini ve ekonomik malzeme kullanımını gözeterek optimum tasarım çözümleri geliştirmek. Kolon, kiriş, makas, çapraz, birleşim, taban plakası, ankraj ve benzeri yapısal elemanların tasarım ve detaylandırmasını yapmak. Projelerin 3D modellerini oluşturmak ve model üzerinden imalata yönelik tüm teknik çizimleri hazırlamak. İmalat resimlerini eksiksiz şekilde oluşturmak; parça ve montaj resimleri, ölçülendirme, malzeme kaliteleri, plaka ve profil bilgileri, delik yerleşimleri, kaynak detayları ve bağlantı bilgilerini belirtmek. Kesim listeleri, malzeme listeleri (BOM), parça listeleri ve gerekli imalat metrajlarını hazırlamak. Statik proje ile imalat resimleri arasındaki uyumu sağlamak; tasarım, imalat ve montaj süreçlerinde oluşabilecek teknik sorunları önceden tespit etmek. Malzeme sarfiyatını, üretim kolaylığını ve montaj verimliliğini dikkate alarak imalat maliyetlerini optimize etmek. İmalat ve montaj ekipleriyle koordineli çalışmak, teknik revizyonları yönetmek ve üretim sürecine teknik destek vermek. Gerektiğinde müşteri, proje ekibi ve ilgili disiplinlerle teknik koordinasyonu yürütmek. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin İnşaat Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun olmak. Yapısal çelik tasarımı, statik hesap ve çelik konstrüksiyon detaylandırma alanlarında deneyim sahibi olmak. Çelik yapıların tasarımından imalat resimlerinin hazırlanmasına kadar tüm sürece hâkim olmak. Çelik birleşim detayları, bulonlu ve kaynaklı bağlantılar, plaka ve profil detayları konusunda teknik bilgi sahibi olmak. İmalat resimlerini ölçü, malzeme, bağlantı ve montaj detayları açısından eksiksiz hazırlayabilmek. Tekla Structures, Advance Steel, SolidWorks veya benzeri 3D çelik modelleme ve detaylandırma yazılımlarından en az birine ileri düzeyde hâkim olmak. SAP2000, STAAD.Pro, Robot Structural Analysis veya benzeri statik analiz programlarından en az birini etkin kullanabilmek. AutoCAD ve teknik resim standartlarına hâkim olmak. Çelik yapı tasarım standartları ve ilgili yönetmelikler konusunda bilgi sahibi olmak. İmalat süreçlerini anlayabilmek ve tasarım kararlarını üretilebilirlik açısından değerlendirebilmek. Teknik dokümantasyon, proje takibi ve revizyon yönetimi konusunda titiz çalışmak. Analitik düşünme, problem çözme ve iş takibi becerilerine sahip olmak. Tercih Sebepleri Ağır çelik konstrüksiyon ve endüstriyel çelik yapı projelerinde deneyimli olmak. Fabrika binaları, çelik makas sistemleri, platformlar ve özel çelik konstrüksiyon projelerinde çalışmış olmak. Statik hesap raporlarını ve imalat çizimlerini bağımsız olarak hazırlayıp sonuçlandırabilmek. Malzeme optimizasyonu, kesim planlaması ve imalat maliyetlerinin düşürülmesi konularında tecrübeli olmak. İmalat ve montaj sahası deneyimine sahip olmak. Çalışma Yeri OSEMA Makina Sanayi A.Ş. – Ankara / Temelli Başvuru Yapısal çelik projelerini tasarımdan imalata kadar yönetebilen, teknik yeterliliği ve çözüm odaklı yaklaşımıyla üretim süreçlerimize katkı sağlayacak adayların başvurularını bekliyoruz.

title: Termal Sistem Tasarım Mühendisi
description: TEI olarak 1985’ten günümüze; havacılık motorları alanında sektöre sunduğumuz yüksek kaliteli ürün, hizmetler ile uluslararası arenada dünya çapında bir üretici ve küresel bir tasarım merkezi konumundayız. Bu güçlü konumumuzdan hareketle kendimizi Gücün Kaynağı olarak tanımlıyoruz. Küresel havacılığa sunduğumuz katkılar ve Türkiye’nin havacılık serüvenine kazandırdığımız ilkler ile başarı hikâyeleri yazmaya devam ediyor; parça ve modül üretimi, motor montaj, test ve bakım, onarım, revizyon, motor tasarımı ve ürün geliştirme alanlarında mükemmeli hedefliyoruz. Türk Havacılık Uzay Sanayii, GE Aerospace, Türk Silahlı Kuvvetleri Güçlendirme Vakfı ve Türk Hava Kurumu ortaklığında kurulan şirketimiz, millî projelerle gurur veren başarılarda yerini alma ve geleceğin havacılık hikâyelerine imza atma fırsatı sunuyor. Bu yolculukta başarımızı teknoloji ile beraber değerlerimizden de alıyoruz: adaletle güven inşa ediyor, birlikte mükemmelliği hedefliyor, kapsayıcı bir ortam kuruyor, yenilikçi bakış açısıyla büyüyor ve sorumluluk bilinciyle hareket ediyoruz. Gökyüzündeki her iki uçaktan birinde TEI parçaları var! Sen de geniş öğrenme imkanlarıyla sınırsız gelişimi planlıyor; yenilikçi ve öncü projelerle başarılı bir kariyer hedefliyorsan aramızdaki yerini hemen al! #GücünOdağındaSenVarsın TEI'de Seni Neler Bekliyor? Kariyer Yolculuğu: İnsan ve gelişim odaklı uygulamalarla zenginleştirilen kariyer modelleri, TEI Akademi: Teknik ve davranışsal yetkinliklerinin sürekli desteklendiği kariyer yolculuğu, Sosyal Kulüpler: Binicilik, sualtı, denizcilik ve yelken, yoga, voleybol, basketbol gibi kulüplerle kültürel çeşitliliğin desteklendiği bir çalışma ortamı, Yaz & Kış Turnuvaları, Esenlik Faaliyetleri: Diyetisyen, Psikolog, Fit Bülten, Seminer uygulamaları, Çalışma Modeli : Esnek çalışma modelleri ile iş-yaşam dengesini destekleyen uygulamalar, Çalışma Ortamı: Kampüs içerisinde kahve alanları, yürüyüş yolu, market ve oto yıkama, Yan Haklar : Toplam deneyim süresine bağlı yıllık izin uygulaması, eş ve çocuklarınızı da dahil edebileceğiniz özel sağlık sigortası uygulaması, TEIFLEX ile özgürce kullanılan esnek yan hak uygulaması, TEI Kurumsal Avantaj Programı ile birçok mekânda indirimli alışveriş yapma ve yemek yeme fırsatı, Ödüllendirme: Ekip arkadaşlarının veya üst yönetimin takdiri ile yürütülen birçok kategoriyi kapsayan ödül sistemi. Senden Neler Bekliyoruz? Üniversitelerin Makina, Uçak, Uzay ve Havacılık Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezunsan, Isı transferi teorik ve pratik bilgi birikimin varsa, Gaz dinamiği teorik ve pratik bilgi birikimin varsa, Sıkıştırılabilir/sıkıştırılamaz akışlar hakkında teorik ve pratik bilgi birikimin varsa, Motor tasarımında yağlama sistemi, ısı transferi, motor ikincil hava sistemi hesaplamalarında görev almak istiyorsan, Sonlu eleman metodolojisine (ANSYS Thermal) ilgin varsa, 1 boyutlu akış çözücülerine (Flow Simulator) ilgin varsa, Tercihen gaz türbinli motorların konsept, ön ve detay termal sistem tasarımlarında görev aldıysan, Tercihen akışkanlar dinamiği & HAD hakkında teorik ve pratik bilgi birikimin varsa, Tercihen termal sistemler ile ilgili yüksek lisans ve/veya doktora yaptıysan, Tercihen herhangi bir programlama dilini (C#, C++, Fortran) kullanabilen, MS Office programlarını iyi derecede kullanabiliyorsan, İyi derecede yazılı ve sözlü İngilizce biliyorsan, Takım çalışmasını ve iş birliğini ön planda tutuyorsan, Güçlü iletişim becerileri ile paydaş yönetimini etkin şekilde gerçekleştirebiliyorsan, Hedef ve sonuç odaklı çalışma disiplinine sahipsen, Sürekli öğrenmeyi ve gelişimi destekleyen bakış açısını benimsiyorsan, Değişen koşullara hızlı adapte olabiliyorsan ve yüksek duygusal dayanıklılığa sahipsen, Veriye dayalı, analitik ve objektif karar alma yetkinliğine sahipsen, Eskişehir’de ikamet ediyorsan/edebileceksen. Gücünü Senden Alan Bir Yolculuk Başlıyor: Gaz Türbinli motor komponentlerinin konsept, ön ve detay tasarımlarının termal, ikincil hava sistemi ve yağlama tasarımlarının gerçekleştirilmesi, Tasarımın gerektirdiği termal, ikincil hava sistemi ve yağlama isterlerinin anlaşılması, değerlendirilmesi ve sağlanması, Termal, ikincil hava sistemi ve yağlama tasarım ve analiz metodolojilerinin geliştirilmesi faaliyetlerinde görev alınması, yön verilmesi, Motor bütünü ve komponent test sonuçlarının, termal, ikincil hava sistemi ve yağlama tasarımlarının ve araçlarının doğrulanması amacıyla kullanılması, Teknik verilerin iç ve dış müşterilere hazırlanması, sunulması, Liderlik ve müdürlük içerisindeki çalışanlarla uyum içerisinde çalışılması, Diğer mühendislik disiplin çalışanlarıyla uyum içerisinde çalışılması, İşe Alım Sürecimiz Aşağıdaki linke tıklayarak işe alım sürecimizin detayları hakkında bilgi alabilirsin. https://kariyer.tei.com.tr/tr/gokyuzundeki-firsatlar Aşağıdaki linke tıklayarak işe alım süreçlerimizde işlenen kişisel veri faaliyetlerine ilişkin detaylar hakkında aydınlatma metnine erişerek bilgi alabilirsin. https://www.tei.com.tr/kisisel-verilerin-korunmasi İlham verici çalışma ortamımızda, gökyüzünde kalıcı bir iz bırakmaya var mısın?

title: Sistem Tasarım Mühendisi
description: PAVO GROUP, teknolojik gelişmeleri sürekli takip eden, bu gelişmeleri ürün ve hizmetlerine yansıtarak öncü olmaya çalışan, kendisine ve çevresine değer katan, ekibiyle birlikte temel değerleri koruyan, tercih edilen işletme olma hedefiyle ilerlemektedir. Etik kurallarından, iş ahlakından ve dürüstlüğünden taviz vermeden pazarda ortak olmayı hedefleyen Pavo Group; Aviyonik Sistemler, Veri Merkezi & Altyapı Çözümleri, Katma Değerli Endüstriyel Yapılar ve Bilgi Teknolojileri, Yapay Zeka, Siber Güvenlik, Ethernet Çözümleri, savunma ve sivil sektörde sistem entegratörü olarak yerli ve yabancı stratejik ortaklarına sistem çözümleri sunmaktadır. ANDASİS, olarak haberleşme alanında Otomotiv, Endüstri ve Telekomünikasyon sektörlerine gömülü elektronik sistem çözümleri sunmaktayız. Ağ Altyapı cihazları sektöründe küresel devlerle rekabet edebilen cihazları tasarlayıp üreterek, ülke olarak %100 dışa bağımlı olduğumuz bu alanda dışa bağımlılığa son veriyoruz; yerli cihazlarımız sayesinde haberleşme güvenliğini garanti altına alıyoruz. Yüksek nitelikli mühendislik ekibimizle tasarım ve üretim faaliyetlerimize devam ediyor, küresel rekabette ülkemizi temsil etmeyi vizyonumuzun merkezine yerleştiriyoruz. GENEL NİTELİKLER IP tabanlı ağ mimarileri, Katman 2/Katman 3 ağ protokolleri,anahtarlama ve yönlendirme uygulamaları, vb teknolojiler hakkında bilgi ve deneyim sahibi olmak. 2G, 3G, 4G ve 5G mobil haberleşme teknolojileri ile bu teknolojilere ait Radyo Erişim Ağı (RAN), Çekirdek Şebeke (Core Network) ve Transport/Backhaul mimarileri konusunda bilgi ve deneyim sahibi olmak. Spektrum analizörü, osiloskop, ağ trafik üreteci/analizörü ve benzeri laboratuvar test ekipmanlarını kullanabilmek. Sistem entegrasyonu ve doğrulama çalışmalarına yönelik test mimarilerini, test topolojilerini ve test senaryolarını oluşturabilmek ve dokümante edebilmek. Protokol analizi, ağ performans ölçümü, hata ayıklama ve test sonuçlarının değerlendirilmesinde kullanılan yöntem ve araçlar hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak. Teknik doküman hazırlama, gereksinim analizi ve sistem mühendisliği süreçleri konusunda bilgi sahibi olmak. Güçlü yazılı ve sözlü iletişim becerilerine sahip olmak. Analitik düşünebilmek, detaylara önem vermek ve sistematik problem çözme yaklaşımına sahip olmak. Diğer gruplarla ve ekip üyeleriyle uyumlu ve entegre çalışabilme GÖREV VE SORUMLULUKLAR IP tabanlı ağ teknolojileri ile 2G, 3G, 4G ve 5G mobil haberleşme sistemlerindeki güncel gelişmeleri takip etmek ve ilgili teknolojilerin sistem tasarımlarında uygulanmasına katkı sağlamak. Sistemlerin etkinliğini, performansını ve sürdürülebilirliğini artırmaya yönelik süreç geliştirme ve iyileştirme çalışmaları yürütmek. Yeni müşteri taleplerinin teknik olarak değerlendirilmesine, çözüm mimarisinin oluşturulmasına ve teklif çalışmalarına sistem tasarımı açısından destek vermek. Sistem gereksinimlerine uygun haberleşme protokollerini, ağ topolojilerini ve sistem mimarilerini analiz etmek, seçmek ve tanımlamak. description: Uçuş Kontrol Mühendisi DASAL Havacılık Teknolojileri olarak; tek ve çok rotorlu insansız hava araçları ile kamikaze sistemlerden orta–ağır sınıf kargo ve görev platformlarına kadar geniş bir ürün ailesi geliştiriyoruz. magnetometre, LiDAR, radar ve kamera gibi sensörlerden gelen verilerin füzyonu için Kalman tabanlı (KF, EKF, UKF vb.) kestirim algoritmalarının geliştirilmesi • Sensör gürültü modellerinin title: Kontrol Sistemleri Mühendisi
description: TEI olarak 1985’ten günümüze; havacılık motorları alanında sektöre sunduğumuz yüksek kaliteli ürün, hizmetler ile uluslararası arenada dünya çapında bir üretici ve küresel bir tasarım merkezi konumundayız. Bu güçlü konumumuzdan hareketle kendimizi Gücün Kaynağı olarak tanımlıyoruz. Küresel havacılığa sunduğumuz katkılar ve Türkiye’nin havacılık serüvenine kazandırdığımız ilkler ile başarı hikâyeleri yazmaya devam ediyor; parça ve modül üretimi, motor montaj, test ve bakım, onarım, revizyon, motor tasarımı ve ürün geliştirme alanlarında mükemmeli hedefliyoruz. Türk Havacılık Uzay Sanayii, GE Aerospace, Türk Silahlı Kuvvetleri Güçlendirme Vakfı ve Türk Hava Kurumu ortaklığında kurulan şirketimiz, millî projelerle gurur veren başarılarda yerini alma ve geleceğin havacılık hikâyelerine imza atma fırsatı sunuyor. Bu yolculukta başarımızı teknoloji ile beraber değerlerimizden de alıyoruz: adaletle güven inşa ediyor, birlikte mükemmelliği hedefliyor, kapsayıcı bir ortam kuruyor, yenilikçi bakış açısıyla büyüyor ve sorumluluk bilinciyle hareket ediyoruz. Gökyüzündeki her iki uçaktan birinde TEI parçaları var! Sen de geniş öğrenme imkanlarıyla sınırsız gelişimi planlıyor; yenilikçi ve öncü projelerle başarılı bir kariyer hedefliyorsan aramızdaki yerini hemen al! #GücünOdağındaSenVarsın TEI'de Seni Neler Bekliyor? title: Special Processes Quality Engineer
description: Mubea is a global leader in lightweight engineering solutions, with more than 100 years of history and over 70 manufacturing locations worldwide. Beyond its strong automotive heritage, Mubea has also established itself as a trusted partner in the aerospace industry through Mubea Aviation, delivering advanced components and assemblies for leading aircraft programs. Mubea Türkiye operates manufacturing and engineering facilities in Manisa, Ergene, and Çerkezköy, serving the automotive, aviation, and home appliance industries. The Ergene plant plays a key role in Mubea’s aviation operations, supporting the development and serial production of advanced aerospace components and assemblies in close collaboration with international customers. We are looking for an experienced, analytical, and detail-oriented Special Processes Quality Engineer to join our team in Ergene and ensure the compliance, qualification, and continuous improvement of special manufacturing processes in accordance with applicable aerospace standards, customer-specific requirements, and internal quality procedures. About the Role As a Special Processes Quality Engineer , you will ensure the quality, compliance, and qualification of special processes in line with aerospace standards and customer requirements. You will oversee process controls, audits, and corrective actions while driving process stability and continuous improvement in collaboration with cross-functional teams. What You'll Do: Implement, maintain, and improve quality controls for heat treatment, chemical surface treatment, anodizing, painting, assembly, and NDT operations, Review customer specifications, material standards, and aerospace requirements, translating them into process controls, inspection plans, and work instructions, Ensure heat treatment compliance with AMS2750, including SAT, TUS, instrumentation calibration, and monitoring of critical process and quenching parameters, Monitor chemical treatment and painting processes, including bath analyses, concentration, contamination, processing times, and environmental conditions, Analyse process control and laboratory results, identify trends, and initiate actions to prevent deviations and maintain process stability, Lead process qualification, requalification, and validation activities, coordinating laboratory testing, technical documentation, and customer approvals, Manage PTP Scheme, IRP, and customer-specific special process approvals, ensuring documentation remains current and compliant, Lead Nadcap audit preparation, gap analyses, internal audits, and corrective action follow-up to maintain audit readiness, Investigate nonconformities using root cause analysis tools such as 8D, 5 Why, and fishbone analysis; coordinate containment and corrective actions, verifying effectiveness before process restart, Maintain special process instructions, control plans, quality records, and traceability, ensuring effective document control and compliance, Assess the impact of changes to equipment, chemicals, process parameters, and documentation on process qualification and customer approvals, Verify equipment calibration and personnel qualification records in coordination with relevant technical teams, Analyse quality and production data through ERP systems and report process performance, compliance risks, and action status to management, Collaborate with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, and external laboratories to improve process capability and drive continuous improvement. What We're Looking For: Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline, At least 5 years of relevant experience in special processes, preferably within the aerospace manufacturing industry, Practical experience in chemical surface treatment, anodizing, painting, and/or heat treatment of aluminium alloys, Working knowledge and practical application of AS9100, ISO 9001, Nadcap requirements, and AMS2750, Experience in process qualification, requalification, validation, and customer approval activities. Knowledge of chemical bath control, analytical testing, surface preparation, and coating or paint performance testing, Knowledge of SAT, TUS, thermocouples, instrumentation calibration, and temperature monitoring systems, Ability to interpret engineering drawings, material specifications, process standards, and customer-specific requirements, Experience in internal audits, customer audits, and corrective action management; direct involvement in Nadcap audits is a strong advantage, Practical knowledge of quality tools and methodologies, including PFMEA, control plans, SPC, MSA, and 8D, Experience with ERP systems, technical reporting, and quality data analysis, Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with a high level of attention to detail, Ability to take ownership, manage competing priorities, and coordinate activities across multiple functions, Good command of written and spoken English, including technical correspondence and discussions with customers and auditors. Preferred Qualifications Experience with aerospace OEM process specifications and qualification requirements, Familiarity with laboratory quality practices and ISO/IEC 17025 requirements, Knowledge of assembly and NDT quality assurance requirements, Experience in equipment commissioning, process changes, and continuous improvement projects. Why Mubea? Be part of a global, family-owned engineering company with a people-focused culture, operating across both the automotive and aviation industries, A collaborative, international team culture, Continuous learning and development opportunities, Opportunities for professional growth in a scaling organization.

title: New Graduates (GDP)
description: New Graduates (GDP) About the Graduate Development Programme (GDP) The Graduate Development Programme (GDP) is an 18-month structured development initiative designed to equip new graduates with core Toyota standards through comprehensive training modules and hands-on, job-embedded practices. Our objective is to empower high-potential talent efficiently and effectively, developing the future leaders and key professionals of Toyota. Throughout the programme, your individual growth will be supported through personalized development plans and direct mentorship from experienced professionals. Applications with a cover letter will be processed with priority.

title: Manual QA Engineer
description: About Progress Partners Progress Partners is a fast-growing technology company building and scaling next-generation SaaS and mobile platforms. We blend creativity with data-driven execution to ship high-impact products, including AI-powered tools, productivity platforms, and workflow software, used by millions of people in more than 160 countries. Our global team of experts in software development, product design, growth, and analytics collaborates across time zones to deliver category-defining innovations. We work end-to-end across the product lifecycle: design, build, launch, and scale. If you’re passionate about building transformative products, Progress Partners is a place to make a lasting impact. About The Role Hi, I'm Bohdan, Head of Customer Support at Progress Partners, and I'm hiring a Manual QA Engineer to join my team. Our support operation runs on connected tools (Zendesk, Twilio, Outlook, Gmail, in-house admin panels and our product APIs), all tied together by flows, triggers and automations. Until now we've borrowed QA help from other teams, but as support grows we need someone who owns this full-time. You'll make sure every email turns into the right ticket, every call routes correctly and every automation does what it promises, so our customers get reliable support and my team can trust the systems they use every day. What You’ll Do Own the quality of our support flows, funnels and automations end to end, catching issues before they reach customers or agents. Reproduce real customer scenarios across Zendesk, Outlook, Gmail and our in-house admin panels, confirming that emails arrive, tickets are created and triggers fire as expected. Validate phone number routing and call flows in Twilio, so every customer reaches the right person the first time. Test API integrations across Zendesk, Twilio and our product as one connected system, not as isolated features, so data moves reliably between them. Turn findings into fixes by writing clear, reproducible bug reports and working with the people who build and maintain our tools. What We’re Looking For 3+ years of experience in manual QA or software testing. Hands-on experience with Zendesk, or a comparable support CRM such as Freshdesk, Intercom or Salesforce Service Cloud, including its triggers, automations and workflows. Proven experience testing API integrations that span multiple services, not only single product features. A methodical, detail-oriented approach to designing test scenarios and documenting results. Strong written and verbal communication in English and the ability to work autonomously in a remote, async environment. Comfort with ownership, transparency, and a results-driven mindset. Nice to Have Experience with Twilio or other telephony and call-routing platforms. Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman, and comfort reading API docs, JSON payloads and logs. A background working in or closely alongside a customer support team. How We Work We’re fully remote and distributed across time zones. We default to async, communicate in writing, and trust people to deliver outcomes, not log hours. Decisions are transparent, ownership is clear, and your work is visible from day one. Interview Process We've designed our interview process to be transparent, respectful of your time, and a genuine two-way conversation, we want to get to know you, and we want you to get to know us. You'll always know what stage you're at, what to expect next, and roughly how long things will take. Initial screen with our Talent Acquisition Team - 30 min Technical interview with our Hiring Manager - 60 min Final interview with Head of Customer Support - 45 min What we offer We believe great work starts with taking care of our people and we want everyone on our team to have the support and resources they need to thrive, both professionally and personally. Here's what you can expect when you join our team: Remote-first: Live and work wherever you're happiest and most productive. No relocation, ever. Flexible hours: we measure outcomes, not time spent at a desk. Unlimited PTO: take the time you need to rest, recharge, and do your best work. Learning & development budget: courses, books, conferences, certifications, whatever helps you grow. Home office & wellness allowance: a dedicated budget to set up your workspace and support your health. A small, senior, collaborative team where your work is visible and your decisions matter. The chance to build products used by millions of people across 160+ countries. Equal Opportunity Progress Partners is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re serious about building a diverse, inclusive team. We welcome applications from people of all genders, gender identities and expressions, sexual orientations, ages, ethnicities, nationalities, religions, disabilities, neurotypes, family situations, socioeconomic backgrounds, and life experiences. We hire on skills, experience, potential, and values fit, never on protected characteristics. If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, just let us know.

title: Data QA Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data QA Engineer based in Turkey. As a Data QA Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of data delivered to customers. You will work with web data extraction projects and AI-assisted solutions, translating customer requirements into clear, measurable quality standards. Rather than treating quality assurance as a final checkpoint, you will help identify potential issues early and prevent defects before they reach production. Combining exploratory testing, data analysis, and automation, you will investigate anomalies and provide actionable insights to developers and project teams. You will use Python, SQL, and modern testing tools to assess data quality and communicate results through meaningful reports, metrics, and visualizations. Working closely with project managers, developers, and clients, you will have the autonomy to improve testing processes and strengthen quality practices. This is an opportunity to join a globally distributed, multicultural team that values ownership, continuous improvement, and flexible ways of working. Accountabilities Translate customer data extraction and web scraping requirements into clear, testable criteria and comprehensive QA strategies, taking ownership of quality assurance from the beginning of new projects. Perform exploratory, manual, and visual testing, complemented by automated testing where it provides measurable value. Execute test cycles on extracted datasets to validate compliance with customer specifications and identify inconsistencies, inaccuracies, missing information, and other defects. Document defects clearly and thoroughly, providing reproducible steps and supporting evidence so developers can investigate and resolve issues efficiently. Apply descriptive statistics, data summaries, and visualizations to assess completeness, accuracy, consistency, and data drift. Prepare quality reports and scoring metrics that communicate results honestly to internal teams and, where appropriate, customers. Clearly identify the scope of testing, any untested areas, and the associated risks to support informed project decisions. Collaborate with project managers and customers to clarify ambiguous requirements and ensure that expectations are measurable and testable before QA begins. Contribute to the development and improvement of test automation frameworks, with an emphasis on coverage, reliability, and performance. Identify, propose, and implement improvements to QA processes and tooling, including browser extensions, spreadsheet add-ons, and user-interface-based testing tools. Work independently while maintaining close collaboration with QA leadership, developers, and project managers to uphold quality standards throughout delivery. Requirements At least 5 years of experience as a QA Engineer or in a comparable role involving software testing, data testing, or data quality assurance. Proficiency in Python for data analysis and validation, preferably using Pandas and Jupyter notebooks. Basic to intermediate SQL skills, including the ability to query and validate data in at least one relational database environment. Strong understanding of web technologies and protocols, including HTML, XPath, JSON, HTTP, and CSS. Experience testing HTTP/REST APIs and validating their responses against expected requirements. Solid knowledge of test case design, test data management, and practical approaches to exploratory and automated testing. Understanding of data quality principles, particularly completeness, accuracy, consistency, and data drift. Experience working in an Agile environment, such as Scrum or Kanban, and collaborating effectively with developers. Familiarity with AI and large language model (LLM) tools to improve test case generation and accelerate data validation workflows. A proactive, detail-oriented mindset with strong ownership of project quality and the confidence to uphold standards under delivery pressure. Ability to learn new technologies quickly, understand complex project requirements, and adapt testing strategies to different domains. Strong written and spoken English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings clearly and precisely. Nice To Have Practical knowledge of Scrapy or other Python-based web scraping frameworks. Experience working with test automation frameworks. An interest in data science concepts and their application to data analysis and validation. Enthusiasm for exploring AI and LLM-powered approaches to improve data quality assurance. Benefits 35 days of paid holidays, supporting substantial time away from work. Flexible, location-independent working, with the freedom to work from where you are most productive. Global, multicultural team: Join a self-motivated, progressive, and internationally distributed team. Modern technology: Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies and tools. Autonomy and ownership: Contribute ideas, take responsibility for improvements, and help shape QA processes and tooling. Collaborative environment: Work closely with technical and project teams to solve meaningful data quality challenges. Today Otokoç Otomotiv, is Turkey's largest automotive retailing, car rental and car sharing company offering services through the brands Otokoç, Avis, Avis Filo, Maestro Filo Yönetimi, Budget, Otokoç Sigorta, Otokoç 2. El, otokocihale.com and Otokoç Parça brands. Otokoç offers a full range of automotive solutions under one roof — including new vehicle sales, servicing, spare parts, wholesale parts distribution, insurance and financing services, accessories, used car sales, and vehicle protection systems — all provided under the Ford, Ford Trucks, Volvo, Fiat, Alfa Romeo, Jeep, and Maserati brands. In car rental, Otokoç offers short-term rentals through the Avis and Budget brands; operational leasing, also known as fleet leasing, through Avis Filo; and fleet management services through the Maestro Filo Yönetimi brand. Continuing the activities at nearly 400 points in 9 countries, including Turkey, Greece, Azerbaijan, Hungary, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Ukraine, Northern Cyprus, and Northern Iraq, with the vision of “Being a global and leading reference point developing innovative mobility solutions." As an organization that embraces agile working principles and places a strong emphasis on equal opportunity and inclusiveness throughout the candidate and employee experience, we define development, innovation, collaboration, sincerity, and transparency as core values of our corporate culture. If you are looking to be part of such a working environment, we invite you to review the job posting below and submit your application. title: Mechanical Engineer
description: For our Advanced Packaging team, we are looking for a Mechanical Engineer. In this role, you will work on something that does not yet exist: a completely new platform within our latest generation of Advanced Packaging machines. This is no development on an existing machine, but true pioneering. You will work within a growing team where you can truly make impact. You will have the freedom to introduce and develop your own ideas, with ample opportunity for feedback and refinement from our team. Together we form the driving force behind machines that are deployed worldwide in high-tech industries. Key Responsibilities: Design and develop mechanical concepts, modules, and components for high-precision systems, from initial concept through detailed design and release. All design work is done in NX and managed in Teamcenter. Translate functional and system requirements into robust mechanical designs, ensuring performance, manufacturability, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. Perform tolerance analyses and detailed dimensioning, taking into account precision, thermal behaviour, and assembly constraints. Conduct mechanical analyses and simulations (e.g. FEM, stiffness, deformation, eigenfrequencies, thermal effects) to validate design performance. Collaborate closely with system engineers, mechatronics engineers, suppliers, and international teams (including Singapore and Hong Kong) to ensure alignment with system-level performance. Contribute to the definition and realization of mechanical subsystem concepts, including prototype design and implementation. Support integration and testing of prototypes and modules, perform root cause analysis, and implement design improvements. Participate in design reviews and technical discussions, ensuring compliance with performance, quality, safety, and cleanroom (e.g. ISO 3) requirements. Work with suppliers and manufacturing teams to ensure design for manufacturability and assembly (DfM/DfA) and support industrialization. Maintain structured technical documentation (drawings, specifications, change management) and contribute to continuous improvement and innovation, including support in patentable concepts where relevant. THIS IS YOU Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Design; a PhD or PDEng in Mechanics is a plus. 5+ years of industry experience in high-tech machine development, ideally in the semiconductor industry. Proven expertise in developing and realizing mechanical concepts, ideally in the semiconductor industry. A multidisciplinary thinker with an open-minded approach, strong in communication and collaboration across various technical domains. A proactive mindset in overcoming challenges on conflicting demands of machine accuracy and machine throughput. Fluent in English; speaking Dutch is a plus. WE OFFER A full-time position (32 - 40 hours per week) at an international high-tech company, where innovation and manufacturing solutions are key. A competitive salary, depending on your knowledge and experience. Excellent employee benefits including a premium pension scheme, travel allowance, and more. Opportunities for personal and professional growth through training and development programs. A dynamic, collaborative work environment with friendly colleagues and exciting, multidisciplinary projects. 25 vacation days and 3 additional days off. We provide all the necessary hardware and software, including a laptop and phone, to ensure you have everything you need to succeed. We like to think that we are fun to work with. Besides working together, we enjoy different activities with our team on a regular basis. Enabling the Digital World At ASMPT, we are committed to making the world a better, safer, and more sustainable place through innovation in the high-tech industry. Our mission is enabling the digital world: empowering our customers to shape tomorrow’s technology with advanced, integrated hardware and software solutions.

title: Control Engineer
description: A Snapshot of Your Day You will most likely start in a wind turbine development project that is still in its early stages. Using our MATLAB controller tuning tools and BHawC (our in-house aeroelastic wind turbine simulation code), you will investigate controller solutions to optimize the balance between turbine loads, turbine behaviour, and power production. Working closely with experienced colleagues, you will review simulation results, apply engineering judgement to identify the next steps, and coordinate with teams across Turbine Loads, Software, Certification, Testing, and component design. As you gain experience and the project progresses, you will also work with prototype data and support turbine validation activities at our test site in Østerild. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on wind turbine controller development, tuning and validation. It is not a project management or software development position, although you will collaborate closely with both disciplines. How You’ll Make An Impact Tune the wind turbine controllers using aeroelastic simulations and engineering analysis. Analyze simulation and test results to understand turbine loads, performance and behaviour. Support the development of new controller functionalities, from early simulation studies through prototype validation. Identify opportunities to improve engineering tools, reports, methods, and processes, and take an active role in implementing improvements. Collaborate with Turbine Loads, Certification, Testing, Software, and component design teams, while ensuring technical findings and progress are effectively communicated. What You Bring A degree in Control Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or another relevant engineering discipline. Relevant engineering experience from industry, research, or technically complex projects, combined with the ability to critically evaluate results, challenge assumptions, and raise concerns when something does not add up. Strong MATLAB skills and experience with, or interest in, Python for engineering tools and data analysis. Experience with wind turbines, aeroelastic simulations, control engineering, or prototype measurements is an advantage. We do not expect candidates to bring experience in all of these areas. A collaborative and responsible way of working, with the ability to communicate progress, seek alignment, and take ownership of the overall engineering challenge, not just your assigned tasks. Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken. About The Team Optimization & Validation is part of the Turbine Control Department within R&D. Our team consists of six full-time employees and two student assistants based in a new office in Ballerup, Denmark. We are proud to be an international team with colleagues from four continents: North America, Europe, Africa, and Asia. Our working language is English. The team plays a key role in offshore wind turbine development projects. During the early stages of a project, we scope and tune the controller using BHawC simulations, support certification activities, coordinate controller changes with the Software Department, and discuss simulation results with Turbine Loads and component design teams. As projects move towards prototype testing, we perform extensive validation activities, ensuring turbine and controller performance matches simulation predictions. Much of this work is based on data collected from our prototype offshore turbines installed in Østerild. We encourage open technical discussions and value diverse engineering perspectives. Constructive disagreement is welcomed when it helps identify a problem or reach a better technical decision. Who is Siemens Gamesa? Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by multiple nationalities. We celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits Opportunities to work with a global team Medical benefits Paid holidays and parental leave Employer-funded pension Subsidised lunch and more

title: Rotating Machine Lead Engineer
description: What we do at Blykalla Blykalla is a Swedish deep-tech company at the forefront of the nuclear industry, pioneering the development of small modular reactors that provide clean, safe, and reliable energy. Thanks to lead-cooling, we achieve high safety in a very compact format, allowing for a simple and cost-effective design that can be mass-produced. Our unique reactor design will provide safe and green baseload energy that perfectly complements solar and wind powe r. What you’ll get to do As a Rotating Machine Lead Engineer, you will own the rotating equipment portfolio of the SEALER plant — from the Primary Coolant Pumps (PCPs) submerged in molten lead above 400 °C, where conventional bearing and sealing solutions don't apply, to the secondary-side feedwater and condensate pumps and the full set of auxiliary and safety-related pumps the plant requires. It is a technically demanding portfolio that spans genuinely novel engineering on the primary side and rigorous nuclear-grade discipline throughout: Define functional and design requirements for the full rotating equipment portfolio — PCPs in molten lead, secondary-side feedwater and condensate pumps, and all auxiliary, safety-related, and service pumps. Develop design basis documentation and lead trade-off studies on pump configuration, drive arrangement, sealing strategy, and bearing technology. Set priorities across the portfolio — distinguishing where Blykalla-specific engineering is warranted from where standard industrial solutions suffice. Act as Blykalla's technical counterpart to pump suppliers and engineering partners, challenging design choices and steering solutions to fit plant requirements across hydraulics, sealing, materials, and maintainability. Define the scope of hydraulic, rotordynamic, and structural analyses; brief specialists; and critically review their outputs. Use hand calculations to sanity-check results. Own supplier work packages: evaluate proposals, lead design reviews, and keep pump development aligned with plant requirements and schedule. Support test rig development when needed to advance tailor-made pumping solutions. Collaborate across internal teams and with academic and industrial partners. Who’ll you’ll get to work with The Rotating Machine Lead Engineer sits in the Fluid Systems Engineering Team within Blykalla, and reports to the Manager of Fluids Engineering. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and Blykalla . Who you are You will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personnel chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help for you to succeed in this role, these are: More than 5 years of professional experience as a rotating equipment engineer. Degree in mechanical, energy, nuclear, or a closely related discipline. A meaningful portion of your experience at a pump manufacturer or rotating equipment OEM, ideally in a role combining hydraulic and mechanical design with workshop and field interface, or equivalent experience as a discipline lead on the operator or EPC side. Strong working knowledge of centrifugal and/or axial pump design, including rotordynamics, bearing selection, mechanical seals or seal-less concepts, and applicable design codes and standards such as API 610, API 682, ASME III, PED, or RCC-M. Hydraulic and mechanical fundamentals sufficient to steer and critically review calculations performed by specialists, including the ability to perform hand calculations on head, NPSH, power, and basic rotordynamics to sanity-check results. Comfort writing clear technical specifications, reviewing supplier deliverables critically, and managing a multi-vendor technical dialogue from concept through qualification. Familiarity with CAD tools and engineering software. Fluent in English, spoken and written. Fluency in Swedish is a plus. Meritorious skills: Hands-on experience with heavy liquid metal pumps (lead, lead-bismuth, sodium). Experience with reactor coolant pumps in light-water reactors. Experience with high-pressure feedwater or boiler feed pumps in conventional or nuclear steam plants. Familiarity with magnetic drives, canned-motor pumps, or other seal-less concepts. Experience with rotordynamic, CFD, or FEA analyses; the priority is the ability to define, commission, and review such analyses rather than execute them. Prior experience coordinating multidisciplinary design work or managing supplier technical interfaces. If you are not sure that you are 100% qualified but are up to the challenge, we encourage you to apply. Location This position is for our office in Stockholm. So, what do you think? Take the chance to be at the forefront of revolutionizing nuclear power. Join our team as Rotating Machine Lead Engineer and help shape the energy landscape of tomorrow. Apply today with your resume and a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and achievements. We are proud to foster an inclusive workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product. This is something we value deeply and we encourage everyone to be a part of changing the way the world thinks about power supply! We do not accept applications via email. We are not open to external help from recruitment agencies.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: In 25 jaar is TOBROCO-GIANT uitgegroeid tot een wereldwijde speler op de markt van wiel- en knikladers, aanbouwdelen en compactiemachines. Vanuit onze moderne productielocaties ontwikkelen, produceren en leveren wij machines aan klanten over de hele wereld. De komende jaren zetten we deze groei met zekerheid door. Om onze verdere groei te ondersteunen zijn wij op zoek naar een Mechanical Engineer die ons R&D-team komt versterken. Binnen deze afdeling werk je samen met circa 40 collega’s aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe generaties machines en het continu verbeteren en optimaliseren van bestaande ontwerpen. Je hebt nu een aantal jaren mooie vlieguren gemaakt in Mechanical Engineering. Je kent de kneepjes van het construeren en weet goed wat maakbaar en produceerbaar ontwerpen van je vraagt. Toch wil je een volgende stap maken: werken aan hoogwaardige machines, in een groter team waarin verschillende specialismen samenkomen en je elkaar inhoudelijk verder uitdaagt. Niet alleen tekeningen en modellen maken, maar ook het verder opbouwen en structureren van deze ontwerpen in CAD en PLM, zodat deze goed onderhoudbaar zijn. Ook wil je wat meer verantwoordelijkheid kunnen en mogen nemen om een machine goed te ontwerpen en het product tot een succes te maken. Daarnaast spreekt de samenwerking met disciplines zoals System Engineering, Test Engineering en Werkvoorbereiding je aan. Zo ontwikkel je jezelf niet alleen verder op technisch vlak, maar ook in projectmatig werken en het samenwerken binnen multidisciplinaire teams. Kortom: meer impact maken, inhoudelijk uitgedaagd worden en in een team op persoonlijk vlak groeien! Klinkt dit als een uitdaging die je wilt aangaan? In concrete termen betekent dit: Als Mechanical Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen en uitwerken van mechanische constructies voor bestaande en nieuw te ontwikkelen machines. Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met collega’s van verschillende disciplines en stakeholders in het projectteam. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Ontwerpen en uitwerken van mechanische constructies en hoofdcomponenten van machines; Uitwerken van conceptstudies naar concrete 3D ontwerpen in CAD (Creo); Opstellen van 2D constructietekeningen met passingen, toleranties, lasspecificaties en afwerking; Integreren van systeemcomponenten zoals hydrauliek en kabelrouting binnen constructies; Rekening houden met maakbaarheid, modulariteit, kosten en onderhoudsvriendelijkheid; Voorbereiden en begeleiden van prototypebouw en testopstellingen; Analyseren van testresultaten en verwerken van verbeteringen in ontwerpen; Documenteren, valideren en vrijgeven van ontwerpen richting de Lead Engineer en de organisatie; Meedenken over optimalisaties van bestaande machines en werkprocessen. Dit ben jij: Je beschikt over een afgeronde MBO- of HBO-opleiding richting Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of Automotive; Ervaring met CAD-software en PLM systemen (bij voorkeur Creo en Windchill); Ervaring met het maken van constructietekeningen, stuklijsten en revisiebeheer; Kennis van sterkteberekeningen en FEM-modellering is een pré ; Je hebt affiniteit met machinebouw, voertuigen of agritechniek; Je beschikt over een analytisch en innovatief denkvermogen; Pragmatisch, resultaatgericht en nauwkeurig; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels, zowel in woord als geschrift. Wat hebben wij te bieden: 40 dagen betaald verlof: 27 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen; Een goed salaris, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring (Cao Metalektro van toepassing); Een dienstverband van 12 maanden met uitzicht op een vaste aanstelling; Een uitdagende functie van 40 uur per week in een professioneel team; Ruimte voor nieuwe initiatieven en ideeën, alleen dan komen we samen vooruit!; Telefoon & laptop; 8% vakantiegeld; Pensioenregeling, geen zorgen voor later; Reiskostenvergoeding: we vergoeden de reiskosten die je maakt voor woon-werkverkeer vanaf de eerste kilometer. Of je nu met de auto of de fiets komt, je krijgt € 0,23 per kilometer; Fietsplan, zodat jij een nieuwe fiets met belastingvoordeel kan kopen; Doorgroeimogelijkheden op basis van jouw probleemoplossend vermogen en toegevoegde waarde; Trainings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden. We bieden diverse trainingen aan om jezelf te ontwikkelen in jouw vakgebied; Goede bereikbaarheid: het treinstation ligt op 100 meter afstand!; En niet te vergeten hele gezellige personeelsuitjes, teamuitjes, borrels, BBQ’s en traktaties!

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: Als senior mechanical engineer bij high tech systems werk je aan technisch complexe projecten die bijdragen aan een betere wereld. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerptraject van eerste idee tot werkend prototype. Heb je passie voor het vak, heb je affiniteit met ontwikkeling van innovatieve technische oplossingen en neem je makkelijk het eigenaarschap om zaken met anderen in beweging te brengen, dan maken we graag kennis met jou. Over Demcon Onze bedrijven onderscheiden zich elk op eigen terrein met unieke expertises en skills. Daarmee helpen ze opdrachtgevers om beter te presteren en meer te bereiken. Vanuit een passie voor technologie kunnen onze bedrijven krachten bundelen. Door kennis te delen en samen te werken maken we meer maatschappelijke impact. Demcon management & support is een ontwikkelaar en producent van technologie en innovatieve producten die bijdragen aan oplossingen voor technische en maatschappelijke problemen. Wat ga je doen? Als senior mechanical engineer bij high tech systems werk je in het domein van de precisie engineering, vaak gerelateerd aan Semicon, maar ook aan projecten gericht op duurzaamheid. Als senior mechanical engineer maak je deel uit van een multidisciplinair team. In je rol neem je de verantwoordelijkheid voor een module of subsysteem of voor aspecten gerelateerd aan de mechanische architectuur. Op basis van functionele decomposities kom je tot concepten die binnen de doelstellingen van het project passen. Deze doelstellingen weet je ook over te brengen naar verschillende stakeholders binnen en buiten het project. Tijdens de ontwikkeling onderbouw je het concept. Je maakt daarvoor berekeningen, simulaties en definieert proefopstellingen om vroegtijdig de werking veilig te stellen. Je werkt vanuit een visie op wat er moet gebeuren. Gedreven door vakmanschap leid je het keuzeproces naar resultaat toe. Je neemt je team daarin mee door ze technisch uit te dagen met aandacht voor hun professionele ontwikkeling. De samenwerking met overige disciplines is een wezenlijk onderdeel om tot de beste oplossingen te komen, daarvoor kijk je makkelijk over je eigen discipline-grens heen. Parallel daaraan neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor de documentatie en de kwaliteit daarvan en bereid je je voor op de realisatie en verificatie waarin de samenwerking met toeleveranciers, inkoop en proto wezenlijk onderdeel is van je werk. Kortom binnen de dynamiek van een project speel je de rol van de spin in het web en tegelijk maak je deel uit van een team: iedereen brengt zijn specifieke kwaliteiten mee en door rekening te houden met elkaar weten we voor de klant het verschil te maken. Wat breng je mee? Afgeronde master in mechanical Engineering of vergelijkbaar; Ervaring binnen 1 of meerdere van de volgende domeinen precisie engineering, machine bouw of Industriële automatisering; 7 jaar relevante werkervaring. Wat bieden we jou? Bij Demcon werk je aan technologie die ertoe doet. title: Junior Engineer Werktuigbouwkunde
description: Over de vacature Ontwerp en optimaliseer als Junior Engineer Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties duurzame klimaatsystemen voor utiliteit of industrie. Je vertaalt klantwensen naar concrete HVAC- en klimaattechnische oplossingen, maakt installatieberekeningen en borgt kwaliteit in elke projectfase. Daarbij werk je met AutoCAD en Revit voor het uitwerken van werktuigbouwkundige ontwerpen. Je werkt aan energiezuinige werktuigbouwkundige installaties, van ontwerp tot oplevering, en hebt direct invloed op comfort, betrouwbaarheid en verbruik in complexe omgevingen. Zo bouw je aan je kennis van werktuigbouwkunde, klimaattechniek, installatietechniek en HVAC engineering in een professionele projectomgeving. Je komt te werken bij een groot Nederlands familiebedrijf in de installatietechniek, actief in utiliteitsbouw, industrie en zorg. Ruim 1.300 technische professionals ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden hier complexe werktuigbouwkundige installaties met een sterke focus op duurzaamheid en innovatie. Het bedrijf realiseert complete werktuigbouwkundige installaties, waaronder HVAC-, verwarmings-, koel- en ventilatiesystemen, en werkt daarbij veelal in multidisciplinaire projectteams. Voor het ontwerp en de uitwerking wordt veelvuldig gebruikgemaakt van AutoCAD en Revit. Medewerkers krijgen de ruimte om zich technisch te verdiepen via opleidingen en certificeringen en mee te denken over energiezuinige en toekomstbestendige oplossingen voor klanten door het hele land. Wat ga je doen? description: Senior Mechanical Engineer (m/f/d) Your mission Conceptual work in collaboration with systems, electrical, mechanical engineers. Establish mechanical engineering design standards, documented workflows and guidelines and best practices. Work with manufacturers and suppliers to support fabrication and component selection. title: Ingeniero/a calculista estructural
description: ¿Nos ayudas a resolver los mayores desafíos de ingeniería? En Quest Global desarrollamos soluciones de ingeniería y tecnología en todo el ciclo de vida del producto que permiten a nuestros clientes resolver los grandes retos a los que se enfrentan en los sectores aeroespacial y de defensa, automoción, energía, alta tecnología, ferrocarril y semiconductores. Somos más de 23.000 personas en 20 países, apasionadas de la innovación y comprometidas a hacer del mundo un lugar mejor, superando los límites cada día para hacer posible lo que, a priori, parecía imposible. Te incorporarás al equipo de cálculo estructural de uno de nuestros principales clientes del sector eólico. ¿QUÉ HARÁS EN TU DÍA A DÍA? Te encargarás de hacer cálculos estructurales y análisis mediante elementos finitos (FEA), principalmente con ANSYS. Evaluarás tensiones, deformaciones, cargas, y comportamiento estructural de los componentes a través de cálculos de fatiga, cálculos estáticos y dinámicos. Evaluarás estructuralmente estructuras secundarias de acero de aerogeneradores ya instalados, identificando posibles riesgos durante su ciclo de vida. Analizarás e interpretarás los resultados obtenidos de las simulaciones. Elaborarás conclusiones y recomendaciones a partir de los resultados de los cálculos. Trabajarás con documentación técnica y requisitos de certificación del sector eólico. Colaborarás con otros equipos de ingeniería para resolver problemas estructurales y proponer soluciones. Trabajarás con normativas internacionales, como la DNV - GL y normativas VDI para cálculo de uniones atornilladas. ¿QUÉ BUSCAMOS? Grado universitario relacionado con ingeniería mecánica o similar. Dominio de herramientas de análisis de elementos finitos (ANSYS). Familiaridad con las normas y requisitos de certificación del sector (p. ej., IEC, GL). Experiencia en la evaluación y el análisis de resultados de análisis de elementos finitos y datos de simulación. Se valorará positivamente experiencia y conocimientos en el sector y en los componentes internos de las torres de aerogeneradores. Nivel fluido de inglés. ¿QUÉ TE OFRECEMOS? Quest Global es un lugar donde valoramos la curiosidad, la autenticidad y el talento de cada persona. title: Ingénieur en Calcul Mécanique - Nucléaire F/H
description: À propos de nous SERES Technologies est un spécialiste de l’ingénierie et du conseil, filiale du Groupe Gorgé, industriel familial présente dans les hautes technologies et dont les métiers s’organisent autour de trois pôles d’activités : les Systèmes Intelligents de Sûreté (Exail Group), la Protection des Installations à Risques (Vigians et Baumert) et l’Impression 3D (Prodways Group). En tant qu'acteur majeur de la transition énergétique, SERES est expert dans la maîtrise des risques et la conception de systèmes complexes . L’entreprise met son savoir-faire au service des secteurs exigeants tels que la défense, les énergies (nucléaire, hydrogène, pétrochimie), la mobilité (naval, automobile, aéronautique, ferroviaire) et le médical. Seres Technologies s'engage pleinement en matière de responsabilités sociales des entreprises (RSE). En adhérant au Global Compact et en obtenant la médaille d'argent d'ECOVADIS, nous démontrons notre engagement envers le développement durable. La société s’engage d’ailleurs à réduire son empreinte carbone d’ici 2025. #Véhicule autonome #Electrolyseur Hydrogène #Small&modular reactor #Systèmes de défense #calogena #EPR #RSE Mission Dans le cadre de projets stratégiques en nucléaire de défense , nous recrutons un Ingénieur Calcul basé à Aix-en-Provence. Vous interviendrez sur des études à forts enjeux, au cœur de la sûreté et de la performance des installations critiques. Modélisation numérique des structures Créer des modèles éléments finis (cuves, tuyauteries, composants) avec ANSYS pour représenter le comportement réel. Analyses mécaniques et thermiques Réaliser des calculs de contraintes, déformations, fatigue, tenue au séisme et effets thermiques couplés. Justification réglementaire Vérifier la conformité aux codes nucléaires (RCC-M, Eurocodes…) et produire les dossiers de justification pour les autorités de sûreté. Études de sûreté et criticité des défauts Évaluer l’impact de fissures, défauts ou vieillissement des matériaux sur la tenue des équipements. Optimisation et dimensionnement Proposer des améliorations de conception pour garantir performance, sécurité et durée de vie. Rédaction et communication technique Rédiger des notes de calcul, rapports et échanger avec les équipes projet (ingénierie, sûreté, chantier). Dans le cadre des exigences de sécurité liées à ce poste et aux conditions d’accès aux informations et environnements concernés, la nationalité française est requise. Cette condition est liée aux contraintes réglementaires et d’habilitation applicables à la mission. Profil Vous êtes rigoureux, curieux, engagé. Vous aimez comprendre, analyser, résoudre. Türk Havacılık Uzay Sanayii, GE Aerospace, Türk Silahlı Kuvvetleri Güçlendirme Vakfı ve Türk Hava Kurumu ortaklığında kurulan şirketimiz, millî projelerle gurur veren başarılarda yerini alma ve geleceğin havacılık hikâyelerine imza atma fırsatı sunuyor. Bu yolculukta başarımızı teknoloji ile beraber değerlerimizden de alıyoruz: adaletle güven inşa ediyor, birlikte mükemmelliği hedefliyor, kapsayıcı bir ortam kuruyor, yenilikçi bakış açısıyla büyüyor ve sorumluluk bilinciyle hareket ediyoruz. Back to Core, yurt dışında edindiğin bilgi ve deneyimi Türkiye’ye taşıyarak havacılık motorları alanında değer üretmek isteyen mühendisler için tasarlandı. Back to Core ile TEI’de tam zamanlı kariyerine başlarken, global bakış açını mühendisliğin kalbine taşıyacak ve yüksek katma değerli teknolojilerin geliştirilmesine doğrudan katkı sağlayacaksın. Gökyüzündeki her iki uçaktan birinde TEI parçaları var! Sen de geniş öğrenme imkanlarıyla sınırsız gelişimi planlıyor; yenilikçi ve öncü projelerle başarılı bir kariyer hedefliyorsan aramızdaki yerini hemen al! #BackToCore #GücünOdağındaSenVarsın TEI'de Seni Neler Bekliyor? Kariyer Yolculuğu: İnsan ve gelişim odaklı uygulamalarla zenginleştirilen kariyer modelleri, TEI Akademi: Teknik ve davranışsal yetkinliklerinin sürekli desteklendiği kariyer yolculuğu, Sosyal Kulüpler: Binicilik, sualtı, denizcilik ve yelken, yoga, voleybol, basketbol gibi kulüplerle kültürel çeşitliliğin desteklendiği bir çalışma ortamı, Yaz & Kış Turnuvaları, Esenlik Faaliyetleri: Diyetisyen, Psikolog, Fit Bülten, Seminer uygulamaları, Çalışma Modeli: Esnek çalışma modelleri ile iş-yaşam dengesini destekleyen uygulamalar, Çalışma Ortamı: Kampüs içerisinde kahve alanları, yürüyüş yolu, market ve oto yıkama, Yan Haklar: Toplam deneyim süresine bağlı yıllık izin uygulaması, TEIFLEX ile özgürce kullanılan esnek yan hak uygulaması, TEI Kurumsal Avantaj Programı ile birçok mekânda indirimli alışveriş yapma ve yemek yeme fırsatı, Ödüllendirme: Ekip arkadaşlarının veya üst yönetimin takdiri ile yürütülen birçok kategoriyi kapsayan ödül sistemi. Senden Neler Bekliyoruz? Üniversitelerin Mühendislik Fakülteleri (Makine, Uçak, Endüstri, Elektrik-Elektronik, Mekatronik, Metalurji ve Malzeme, Bilgisayar, Havacılık ve Uzay Mühendisliği vb.), İktisadi ve İdari Bilimler Fakülteleri (İşletme, İktisat, Uluslararası İlişkiler vb.) veya Fen Fakültelerinin (Matematik, İstatistik vb.) ilgili bölümlerinden lisans veya üstü eğitim derecesine sahipsen, MS Office programlarını iyi derecede kullanabiliyorsan, İyi derecede yazılı ve sözlü İngilizce biliyorsan, Takım çalışmasını ve iş birliğini ön planda tutuyorsan, Güçlü iletişim becerileri ile paydaş yönetimini etkin şekilde gerçekleştirebiliyorsan, Hedef ve sonuç odaklı çalışma disiplinine sahipsen, Sürekli öğrenmeyi ve gelişimi destekleyen bakış açısını benimsiyorsan, Değişen koşullara hızlı adapte olabiliyorsan ve yüksek duygusal dayanıklılığa sahipsen, Veriye dayalı, analitik ve objektif karar alma yetkinliğine sahipsen, TEI’nin gücüne güç katacak başvurunu bekliyoruz! Başvuru Şartları Nelerdir? Türkiye Cumhuriyeti vatandaşı/çifte vatandaş veya Mavi Kart sahibi olmak, Yurt dışında ikamet ediyor olmak. title: Mechanical Projects Executive
description: WHO WE ARE At Doğuş Hospitality & Retail Group, we create experiences that make everyday life more inspiring. Through our diverse portfolio of brands in food & beverage, tourism, retail, entertainment, and event management , we bring people together and turn moments into memories. Combining hospitality expertise with entertainment capabilities, the Group continues to strengthen its sector leadership while prioritizing sustainability, environmental responsibility, and long-term social impact. Today, it operates in 27 countries, 62 cities, and 339 locations , serving guests in Türkiye and internationally. We, the members of the Doğuş Hospitality & Retail team… We know that tomorrow we will be much further ahead than today because we are open to improvement, inspiration, opportunities, collaboration and fun! Are you ready to be a part of the boundless world of Doğuş Hospitality and Retail and to take a bold step in your career and join our growing organization? WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR? Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering from an accredited university. Preferably experienced in luxury hotels, restaurants, high-end retail stores, and premium commercial developments. Minimum 8 years of experience in mechanical engineering project and construction management, preferably including at least 5 years in similar projects. Strong technical knowledge of HVAC, heating, cooling, ventilation, plumbing, fire protection, smoke control, and Building Management Systems (BMS). Extensive knowledge of commercial kitchen ventilation, exhaust systems, fresh air supply, air conditioning, and mechanical infrastructure solutions, particularly for hotel and restaurant projects. Proven ability to coordinate mechanical engineering activities with architectural, interior design, electrical, and other engineering disciplines. Experience in mechanical quantity take-offs, cost estimation, technical specifications, budgeting, cost analysis, and tender processes. Strong capabilities in managing project schedules, budgets, quality standards, and on-site construction activities simultaneously. Proficiency in AutoCAD and MS Office; knowledge of Revit, BIM, and MS Project is an advantage. Familiarity with relevant national and international engineering standards, fire safety regulations, and occupational health and safety requirements. Excellent written and spoken English , with the ability to communicate effectively with international designers, engineering consultants, and hospitality operators. Ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-project environment and willingness to travel domestically and internationally. then this opportunity is OPEN to you. WHAT WE EXPECT FROM THIS POSITION... Manage and coordinate mechanical engineering disciplines throughout the concept, schematic design, design development, and detailed design phases of hotel, restaurant, and retail projects. Review mechanical engineering designs to ensure alignment with architectural and interior design concepts. Coordinate with international design firms, engineering consultants, and hospitality operators. Evaluate contractor proposals from both technical and commercial perspectives. Lead Value Engineering initiatives by identifying alternative materials, equipment, and mechanical system solutions. Monitor mechanical works to ensure compliance with approved project budgets. Coordinate on-site mechanical works with architectural, interior design, electrical, and other engineering disciplines. Identify technical challenges and develop practical, efficient, and timely solutions. Manage testing, adjusting, balancing, and commissioning (TAB & Commissioning) activities for all mechanical systems. Ensure the completion and submission of as-built drawings, operation and Coordinate the successful and timely handover of completed mechanical systems to hotel, restaurant, and retail operations teams. Knowledge of fire protection,NFPA,energy efficiency, and sustainable mechanical engineering systems. WHAT WE OFFER? Be part of a strong, agile, and diverse team that creates meaningful experiences across multiple industries — and grows together by learning from each other. Explore career opportunities across different brands and sectors within our Group. Enjoy exclusive ‘’BİZ Employee Discount’’ and ‘’Family & Friends Days.’’ Access our BİZ Flexible Experience Package, offering unique and memorable experiences across our brands. Celebrate life’s special moments with our new birth and marriage gifts Benefit from our well-being–focused employee support line and private health insurance. Flexible working model that supports work–life balance Flexible transportation support to make everyday life easier
category_reasons: 8+ yıl - kıdemli / uzun deneyim isteyen pozisyon

title: Ürün Geliştirme ve Mekanik Tasarım Yöneticisi
description: Danışmanlığını yapmakta olduğumuz Kocaeli bölgesinde bulunan üretim firmamızda görevlendirilmek üzere Ürün Geliştirme ve Mekanik Tasarım Yöneticisi aramaktayız. title: Mekanik Bakım Uzman /Uzman Yardımcısı
description: Türkiye’nin cesur ve yenilikçi şirketlerinden biri olan Şölen, ülkemize yaptığı güçlü yatırımlar ve sağladığı istihdamla içinde bulunduğu topluma katma değer yaratma amacıyla faaliyetlerini sürdürmektedir.35 yılı aşkın tecrübesiyle atıştırmalık, çocuk ürünleri, hediyelik ve ikramlık kategorilerde zengin bir ürün portföyünü; gıda güvenliği, hijyen ve kaliteyi odağına alan Şölen, yüksek teknolojiyle donatılmış, Endüstri 4.0 standartlarına uygun Gaziantep ve İstanbul’daki iki üretim tesisiyle faaliyet göstermektedir.Yıllık 330.000 ton üretim kapasitesine ve 3.000’i aşkın çalışana sahiptir. Yenilikçi vizyonu ve kaliteli ürünleri sayesinde; Biscolata, Ozmo, Milango, Boombastic, Luppo, Nutymax, Papita, Chocodans ve Greta gibi dünya çapında tanınan ödüllü markalarıyla dikkat çekmektedir. 200’ün üzerinde ürün çeşidini, Amerika’dan Belçika’ya, Japonya’dan Maldivler’e kadar 120’den fazla ülkeye ihraç etmektedir. Walmart, Walgreens, Dollar General, Aldi, Lidl, Dollar Tree ve Dollarama gibi küresel perakende zincirleriyle iş birliği yapmaktadır. Globalleşme stratejisi doğrultusunda Dubai, Cezayir, Azerbaycan, Amerika, Suudi Arabistan, Almanya ve İngiltere'de bölge ofislerine; Levant Bölgesi, Kanada, Çin ve Latin Amerika'da ise bölge müdürlüklerine sahiptir. Gaziantep Fabrikamızda Mekanik Bakım Müdürlüğümüze bağlı ekibimizde görev alacak Mekanik Bakım Uzman / Uzman Yardımcısı arıyoruz! Bu Rol İçin Aradığımız Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezunsan, Endüstriyel işletmelerde Bakım Mühendisi olarak en az 2 yıl tecrübeliysen, İyi derecede İngilizce biliyorsan, MS Office, Autocad, Solidworks ve SAP uygulamalarına hakimsen, Takım çalışmasına yatkınsan, Proaktifsen ve enerjin yüksekse, Analitik düşünebiliyorsan, Sonuç odaklıysan bu ilan tam sana göre. Görev ve Sorumluluklar İşletmeye alınacak her türlü makine ve teknik donanımı teknik açıdan incelemeni, Yapılan planlı bakım çalışmalarını takip etmeni, Yapılan arızi ve koruyucu bakımları takip etmeni, İşletme içerisindeki makinelerin verimliliğini maksimum düzeye çıkarmanı, Fabrika makine ve ekipmanlarında iyileştirme ve kronik arızaların kök neden analizlerini yapıp kalıcı çözümler bulup uygulanmasını sağlamanı, İhtiyaç duyulan yedek parçaları takip etmeni ve asgari seviyede hazır bulundurmanı, Taşeron ve teknisyen çalışmalarının koordinasyon ve kontrolünü yapmanı bekliyoruz. Şölen’de Seni Neler Bekliyor? 📚 Şölen Akademi ile sınırsız eğitim ve gelişim fırsatı 🏥 Özel Sağlık Sigortası, Hayat ve Ferdi Kaza Sigortası 🏆 Çalışan ödüllendirme ve takdir uygulamaları 💳 Hediye alışveriş çekleri 🍫 Yılda 4 kez ürün dağıtımı 🎂 “İyi ki doğdun!“ izni ❤️ Heltia – Çalışan Destek Programı 👩 Şölen annelerine özel kreş desteği 💪 MultiSport – Spor ve İyi Yaşam Uygulaması Değerlerimiz Başarmaya Tutkuluyuz - Gözle görülür, fark edilir, istisnai başarılar elde etmek için kendimizi işimize adarız. İşimize beynimiz ve kalbimizle bağlanır, yolculuğun keyfini çıkartır ve sonuca odaklanırız. Yarattığımız başarılı sonuçların gururunu tüm paydaşlarımızla birlikte yaşarız. Fark Yaratırız - Ölçülü riskleri cesaretle alır, hata yapmaktan çekinmeyiz. Yaptığımız her işte fark yaratır; topluma, tüketicilerimize, iş ortaklarımıza ve çalışanlarımıza değer katarız. Üstün kaliteli ürünlerimizi dünyaya sunar, tüketicilerimizi ödüllendiririz. Değerlerimize Bağlıyız - Birbirimize, iş ortaklarımıza ve tüketicilerimize karşı açık, içten, dürüst ve adil davranırız. Geçmişten gelen değerlerimize saygı gösteririz. Değer zincirimizdeki her bir bireyin itibarını en önde tutar, kararlarımızı, onlara karşı taşıdığımız sorumluluk bilinciyle alırız. Şölen’de işe alım süreçlerimizi adil ve kapsayıcı şekilde yürütüyoruz. Dil, din, etnik köken, ırk, yaş ya da cinsiyet fark etmeksizin hiçbir önyargı veya ayrımcılığa izin vermiyoruz. Tüm değerlendirmelerimizi iş tanımına uygunluk, objektif ve ölçülebilir kriterler ile yetkinlik odaklı mülakatlar üzerinden gerçekleştiriyoruz. “Kişisel Verilerinizin İşlenmesine ilişkin bilgiye https://www.solen.com.tr/gizlilik linkinde yer alan Aydınlatma Metnimizden ulaşabilirsiniz”
