title: Mekanik Tasarım (CAD) Stajyeri
description: Saha Robotik Hakkında Saha Robotik olarak, otonom sistemler ve robotik teknolojiler geliştiriyoruz. Yeni robotlarımızın mekanik tasarım süreçlerinde ekibimize katılacak; tasarlamayı seven, meraklı ve öğrenmeye açık bir stajyer arıyoruz. Robotlarımızın şasi ve mekanik parçalarını tasarlarken bizimle birlikte çalışacak, fikirlerini paylaşacak ve tasarımlarının gerçek bir robota dönüşmesini deneyimleyecek bir takım arkadaşıyla tanışmak istiyoruz. Birlikte Neler Yapacağız? •⁠ ⁠Yeni robotlarımızın şasi ve mekanik parçalarının tasarımına birlikte katkı sağlayacağız, •⁠ ⁠SolidWorks veya Autodesk Fusion üzerinden parça ve montaj modelleri üzerinde çalışacağız, •⁠ ⁠Motor, tekerlek ve diğer bileşenlerin robot üzerindeki yerleşimini değerlendireceğiz, •⁠ ⁠Prototip üretim, montaj ve test süreçlerine katılarak tasarımlarımızı geliştireceğiz, •⁠ ⁠Tasarım yaparken üretim ve montaj kolaylığını nasıl gözetebileceğimizi uygulamalı olarak ele alacağız. Nasıl Bir Takım Arkadaşı Arıyoruz? •⁠ ⁠Üniversitelerin Mekatronik, Makine veya Endüstriyel Tasarım bölümlerinde okuyan, tercihen 3. veya 4. sınıf öğrencisi, •⁠ ⁠SolidWorks veya Autodesk Fusion kullanarak temel seviyede modelleme yapabilen ve CAD becerilerini geliştirmek isteyen, •⁠ ⁠Robotlara, mekanik tasarıma ve hareketli sistemlere ilgi duyan, •⁠ ⁠Soru sormaktan, fikir paylaşmaktan ve yeni şeyler denemekten çekinmeyen, •⁠ ⁠Ekip içinde çalışmayı seven, geri bildirimlere açık ve birlikte öğrenmeye istekli, •⁠ ⁠Tercihen Gebze, Kocaeli’deki ofisimize gelebilecek. Daha önce bir okul projesinde, öğrenci takımında veya kendi projenizde tasarım yapmış olmanız bizi mutlu eder. Özellikle mobil robotlar ya da motorlu mekanizmalar üzerine çalışmalarınız varsa duymak isteriz. Bizim için en önemlisi öğrenme isteğiniz, merakınız ve tasarıma duyduğunuz ilgi. Başvuru Özgeçmişinizle birlikte kendinizden ve bu alanda neler öğrenmek istediğinizden kısaca bahsedebilirsiniz. Varsa yaptığınız bir CAD modelini veya katkı sağladığınız bir projeyi de paylaşabilirsiniz.

title: Endüstri Mühendisliği Stajyeri
description: İstanbul Beylikdüzü Kavaklı bölgesinde, yüksek teknoloji sektörlerine yönelik hassas talaşlı imalat alanında faaliyet gösteren fabrikamızda, Yalın Dönüşüm çalışmalarımıza destek olacak Endüstri Mühendisliği Stajyeri (Uzun Dönem) arıyoruz. Süreç Analizi: CNC işleme, CMM ölçüm ve bekleme sürelerini sahada kronometre ve iş etüdü çalışmalarıyla verileştirmek. Pilot Proje Desteği: Yalın pilot alanımızda 5S, SMED, Poka yoke vb. iyileştirme uygulamalarını yürütmek. Raporlama: Elde edilen verileri analiz ederek haftalık Yalın toplantılarında sunum yapmak. Aranan Özellikler: Üniversitelerin Endüstri Mühendisliği bölümünde 3. veya 4. sınıf öğrencisiysen, Yalın Üretim, VSM, SMED ve İstatistiksel Süreç Kontrolü konularına meraklı ve teorik olarak hakimsen, Haftada en az 3 gün devam sağlayabiliyorsan, MS Excel ve VSM çizim araçlarını etkin kullanabiliyorsan, Analitik düşünme gücüne güveniyor ve üretim sahasında olmayı seviyorsan... Sana Ne Sunuyoruz? Bir fabrikanın Yalın Dönüşüm Projesi’nde doğrudan sorumluluk. CMM ve CNC talaşlı imalat kalite süreçlerinde önemli bir saha tecrübesi. Yüksek teknoloji sektörlerine yönelik parçaların üretim ve ölçme süreçlerinde deneyim. Proje bitiminde yönetime sunulacak referans niteliğinde bir VSM projesi.

Sistemlerin test ve devreye alma süreçlerini planlamak, yürütmek, Test sonuçlarını analiz ederek iyileştirme önerileri sunmak, Sahada karşılaşılan teknik problemlere hızlı ve kalıcı çözümler üretmek, Test süreçlerinin her aşamasında risk analizlerinin yapılması ve güvenlik önlemlerinin alınması, Proje takvimine uygun şekilde görevleri zamanında sonuçlandırmak. title: CNC 3 ve 5 Eksen İşleme Merkezi Operatörü
description: CNC 3 VE 5 EKSEN İŞLEME MERKEZİ OPERATÖRÜ Havacılık, savunma ve ileri teknoloji makine imalatı sektörlerinde faaliyet gösteren, yüksek hassasiyetli tezgah parkına sahip üretim tesisimizde görevlendirilmek üzere "CNC 3 ve 5 Eksen İşleme Merkezi Operatörü" aramaktayız. Genel Nitelikler Eğitim: Meslek Liseleri veya Meslek Yüksekokullarının Makine, CNC, İmalat Teknolojileri, Kalıpçılık veya Mekatronik bölümlerinden mezun. Deneyim: CNC 3 Eksen ve tercihen 5 Eksen (Simültane veya Pozisyonlamalı) freze tezgâhlarında en az 2-3 yıl aktif tecrübeye sahip. Kontrol Ünitesi: Heidenhain, Fanuc, Siemens veya Mazak kontrol ünitelerinden en az birinde yetkin ve tezgah başında program takibi yapabilen. Ayar ve Sıfırlama: Parça bağlama (fikstür/mengeneli montaj), 3D prob/orijin sıfırlama, takım sıfırlama ve boy/çap ölçümü konularında tecrübeli. Teknik Resim ve GD&T: Karmaşık 3D montaj ve parça resimlerini okuyabilen, geometrik toleranslandırma (GD&T) işaretlerine hakim. Ölçüm Becerisi: Mikrometre, kumpas, komparatör, mihenk gibi hassas ölçüm aletlerini yetkin şekilde kullanabilen (CMM raporlarını yorumlayabilen). CAM/Program Bilgisi: Tercihen CAM programlama mantığını anlayan, G/M kodlarına hakim ve zorunlu hallerde tezgah başında satır müdahalesi yapabilen. Çalışma Düzeni: Vardiyalı çalışma sistemine ve esnek çalışma saatlerine uyum sağlayabilecek. İş Tanımı Tezgah Hazırlığı (Setup): CAM birimi tarafından hazırlanan programları 3 ve 5 eksenli CNC tezgahlara yüklemek, sıfırlamaları yapmak, iş emrine uygun takım kurulumlarını ve tutucu montajlarını gerçekleştirmek. İlk Parça ve İşleme: İşleme sürecinde ilk parça onayını (trial cut) almak, simülasyon ve eksen hareketlerini gözlemleyerek çarpma/çakışma risklerini önlemek. Tolerans ve Kalite Takibi: İşlenen parçaların kritik ölçü toleranslarını tezgah üzerinde veya ölçüm alanında kontrol etmek, gerektiğinde eksen offsetlerini güncellemek. Takım Yönetimi: Kesici uç ve freze takımlarının aşınma durumlarını takip etmek, takım ömrü yönetimini yapmak ve kırılan/aşınan takımları yenisiyle değiştirmek. Proses Takibi: 5 eksen işleme sırasında parça ve iş mili oryantasyonlarını, soğutma sıvısı/hava akışını sürekli kontrol altında tutmak. Bakım ve Temizlik: Tezgâhın günlük koruyucu bakımlarını (yağ seviyesi, talaş konveyörü temizliği vb.) yapmak ve 5S çalışma alanı düzenine uymak.

title: Enstrümantasyon Uygulama Teknisyeni

(TEITECH) olarak havacılık motorları ve güç sistemleri alanında özgün teknolojiler geliştirirken; ileri mühendislik, malzeme teknolojileri ve araştırma ve geliştirme yetkinliklerimizi ortak bir hedef doğrultusunda ileri taşıyoruz. title: Teknik Ressam
description: İLAN TEKNİK RESSAM Şirket Hakkında ; İzmir Bergama’da bulunan fabrikamızda, uluslararası standartlara uygun Basınçlı Depolama Tankı İmalatı gerçekleştirmekteyiz. title: Staff Application Security Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Application Security Engineer based in Turkey. Help establish and scale a dedicated application security function within a high-growth technology environment where protecting customers against fraud and abuse is a core priority. As a senior individual contributor, you will combine deep security expertise with hands-on software engineering to identify vulnerabilities, strengthen development workflows, and build practical security tooling. You will design secure software development practices, lead threat modeling and security reviews, and drive vulnerability remediation across complex APIs, SDKs, and cloud-based systems. Working closely with engineering teams and security leadership, you will integrate AI-powered tools into security testing and remediation while maintaining rigorous quality standards. This role offers substantial technical autonomy, opportunities to influence engineering practices across the organization, and the chance to solve challenging security problems at scale. You will help make security an integral part of product development rather than a separate compliance requirement. Accountabilities As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you will serve as the technical foundation of the application security function, translating security strategy into effective engineering practices, tools, and measurable improvements. Your responsibilities will include: Design and implement a secure software development lifecycle (SDLC), incorporating security requirements, design-time threat modeling, secure code reviews, and pre-release testing into existing engineering workflows. Own and improve application security tooling, including static and dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), dependency scanning, secrets detection, and container and infrastructure-as-code scanning. Integrate security tools into CI/CD pipelines, reduce false positives, establish clear vulnerability ownership and remediation service-level agreements (SLAs), and ensure findings lead to meaningful action. Develop an AI-first security engineering approach using AI-assisted vulnerability triage, automated remediation, security review agents, and AI-augmented testing, with evidence-based controls governing what these tools can flag, block, or fix. Build reusable security patterns, hardened libraries, and secure defaults for authentication, authorization, input validation, secrets management, and cryptographic operations. Contribute directly to production codebases by implementing security fixes, developing security libraries, and building automation and CI integrations. Lead threat modeling and architecture security reviews for new products, features, and significant technical changes across APIs, web and mobile SDKs, dashboards, and data pipelines. Manage vulnerability identification, risk assessment, prioritization, and remediation for findings from security scanners, penetration tests, bug bounty reports, and customer disclosures. Conduct hands-on security testing, including manual code review and exploitation testing for authentication and authorization weaknesses, API vulnerabilities, injection attacks, server-side request forgery (SSRF), business-logic flaws, and abuse scenarios. Pay particular attention to adversarial threats involving fraud detection and bot mitigation, identifying weaknesses that could allow attackers to bypass or undermine platform protections. Collaborate with penetration testing and compliance specialists to scope assessments, validate fixes, retest findings, and translate technical discoveries into actionable engineering work. Lead technical investigations of application-layer security incidents, coordinating containment, root-cause analysis, remediation, and collaboration with cloud infrastructure teams when necessary. Define application security logging and alerting requirements and partner with engineering and cloud platform teams to implement effective detection capabilities. Support engineering teams through security consultations, office hours, secure coding guidance, and a Security Champions program that expands security expertise across the organization. Develop practical secure coding training based on real application code, vulnerabilities, and lessons learned from security incidents. Mentor engineers through code reviews and architecture feedback, helping improve security awareness and engineering quality without relying solely on mandates. Partner with application security leadership to shape technical priorities, communicate findings and risk assessments, and execute initiatives that advance the broader security roadmap. Provide technical evidence for security controls, contribute to vendor security assessments, and support enterprise customer due diligence, security questionnaires, architecture discussions, and penetration testing summaries. Requirements The ideal candidate is an accomplished security engineer who combines strong software development skills with extensive practical application security experience. You should be comfortable independently driving complex initiatives, working directly within engineering repositories, and influencing technical decisions across teams. Required qualifications include: At least 8 years of experience in software engineering and/or security engineering, including 5 or more years focused on application security. Experience building or improving application security programs within a product engineering organization, with a strong emphasis on hands-on implementation rather than consulting or auditing alone. Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to write production-quality code in TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Python, or a comparable language. Familiarity with modern web applications, APIs, software architectures, source code repositorie

description: Over de vacature Ontwerp en beoordeel als Starter / Junior Mechanical Engineer Industrie / junior mechanical engineer procesinstallaties voor (petro)chemie, food en farma in West-Brabant. Je vertaalt P&ID’s naar proces- en drukapparatuur, maakt 2D/3D-ontwerpen en specificaties voor rotating en static equipment. Je werkt aan optimalisaties, revamps en greenfield projecten binnen de procesindustrie, van kleine verbeteringen tot complete nieuwbouwplannen, onder begeleiding van een ervaren mentor die jou technisch en projectmatig begeleidt. Je komt te werken bij een multidisciplinair ingenieurs- en EPCM-bureau met een sterke focus op de (petro)chemische procesindustrie. Vanuit de vestiging in de regio West-Brabant begeleiden zij projecten voor productiebedrijven in Noord-Brabant, Zeeland en Zuid-Holland. Het bureau is actief in alle engineeringfases: van conceptual en FEED tot basic- en detailengineering, plus constructiemanagement. Alle relevante disciplines zijn in huis: Process Engineering, E&I, Piping, Bouw/Civiel, HVAC en Construction Management, waardoor je dagelijks samenwerkt in multidisciplinaire projectteams aan duurzaamheidsvraagstukken, plant optimalisaties, maintenance-, revamp-, turn around- en nieuwbouwprojecten. Wat ga je doen? Interpreteren van processchema’s (zoals P&ID’s) en vertalen naar benodigde process equipment; Opstellen van datasheets voor rotating equipment en static equipment; Maken van 2D ontwerpen van machines, procesinstallaties en onderdelen; Maken van 3D ontwerpen van machines, procesinstallaties en onderdelen; Analyseren van ontwerpen op fouten en toetsen aan veiligheidsnormen en -protocollen; Schrijven van specificaties voor rotating equipment en static equipment; Uitvoeren van werkzaamheden volgens normen en voorschriften voor drukapparatuur. Wat neem je mee? Je beschikt over een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde of gelijkwaardig; Je bent een starter met bijbehorend diploma of hebt al enige ervaring in de industrie (junior); Je hebt aantoonbare interesse of basiskennis van de procesindustrie; Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal uitstekend en de Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk; Je bent communicatief vaardig en werkt graag in teamverband; Je herkent jezelf in de eigenschappen enthousiast, daadkrachtig en leergierig. Wat bieden we jou? Wij hanteren Gelijkwaardig Belonen. Dit betekent dat jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden als Dosign-professional volledig gelijkwaardig zijn aan die van een collega die rechtstreeks bij onze opdrachtgever in dienst is. title: Konstruktör VVS inom Skydd & säkerhet till Stockholm
description: Säkerhet och motståndskraft är i dag några av de viktigaste kriterierna när vi planerar framtidens samhällen. Swecos konsultverksamhet inom Fysiskt skydd & säkerhet jobbar för att skydda viktiga funktioner i samhället och vår expertis efterfrågas i allt större omfattning. Vi fortsätter satsa och kompletterar därför vår grupp inom Fysiskt skydd & säkerhet i Stockholm med en VVS-projektör som vill jobba i spännande uppdrag. Vill du vara med? Varför jobba hos oss? När världen ställer om till ett uthålligt och motståndskraftigt samhälle har behovet av trygga och anpassade byggnader som står emot inre och yttre hot aldrig varit större. Sweco är helhetsleverantör av tjänster inom skydd och säkerhet och våra konsulter inom fysiskt och fortifikatoriskt skydd jobbar med att förebygga och förhindra hot mot samhällsviktiga funktioner. Genom förstudier, utredningar, projektering, projekteringsledning och uppföljning i byggskede erbjuder vi tjänster som bidrar till att våra kunder redan från planeringsstadiet får resilienta och säkerhetsskyddade byggnader. Våra grupper inom Fysiskt skydd & säkerhet består av medarbetare med kompetenser inom flera teknikområden; arkitektur, byggkonstruktion, VVS, fastighetsautomation, el/tele/säkerhet och kraftförsörjning. På Sweco får du jobba med kompetenta kollegor som brinner för att skapa smarta och hållbara lösningar för våra kunder. Hos oss jobbar engagerade och nyfikna personer som tar stort ansvar för sina uppdrag. VVS-systemen i byggnader blir alltmer komplexa och den tekniska kompetensen är viktigare än någonsin, därför arbetar vi på Sweco med de senaste tekniska konsultverktygen för att kunna optimera för våra kunder. Din framtida roll Rollen som Konstruktör inom VVS innebär att du projekterar tekniska systemlösningar och detaljkonstruktioner av VVS-system i byggnader. Du kommer att arbeta med alla installationssystem inom VVS och involveras i uppdragen från tidigt skede till projektering, ritningar, leverans och uppföljning. Några av de verktyg vi har till vår hjälp är AutoCAD/MagiCAD och Revit. Att arbeta hos Sweco innebär att arbeta med många olika typer av projekt, både i storlek och i karaktär. Vi strävar alltid efter att uppnå bästa resultat i våra uppdrag, vilket kräver starka team och stor entusiasm, tekniskt kunnande och samarbete. Då många av våra uppdrag är säkerhetsklassade utförs merparten av vårt arbete i säkerhetsskyddade miljöer. Detta innebär att du behöver vara på plats på kontoret eller hos kund största delen av din arbetstid. Den vi söker – är det du? title: Beräkningsingenjör LS-DYNA
description: Företagsbeskrivning AFRY är ett ledande europeiskt företag med global räckvidd inom teknik, design och rådgivning. Vi accelererar omställningen mot ett hållbart samhälle. Vi är 18 000 hängivna experter inom infrastruktur, industri, energi och digitalisering, som skapar hållbara lösningar för kommande generationer. Ett omväxlande jobb där vi ofta jobbar inom områden som är ”heta” just nu. Våra kunder finns både lokalt och internationellt och vi arbetar inom flera branscher där automotive är störst men där försvar och övrig industri ökar. Uppdragen kan komma att variera i både storlek och innehåll samt utföras antingen in-house i våra egna lokaler eller ute på plats hos våra kunder. Urval sker kontinuerligt så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag! Skicka med CV samt personligt brev. Kvalifikationer Vi söker nu dig med en gedigen utbildning inom hållfasthet och strukturmekanik. Vi tror att du har en civilingenjörsexamen från Maskin, Teknisk Fysik eller Samhällsbyggnad och har jobbat något eller några år med LS-DYNA eller motsvarande programvara. Du skall ha goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och i skrift. Som person är du noggrann, ambitiös och vetgirig. Du har ett sinne för detaljer och har en förmåga att förklara komplexa tekniska termer för personer i din omgivning. Du gillar att träffa människor och har förmåga att anpassa dig i nya miljöer. Du är självständig, handlingskraftig, van att ta egna initiativ och är bra på att kommunicera och dokumentera. Ytterligare information Vi söker dig som vill vara en del av AFRYs framgångssaga. På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. Vi söker konstant kvalificerade kandidater som vill ansluta sig till våra inkluderande team runt om i världen. Bli en del av oss och påskynda den gröna omställningen

title: Mechanical Integration Leader
description: Are you interested in joining EDAG? EDAG, one of the leading global engineering experts with heritage from the automotive industry, serves its customers with complete development responsibility, ranging from concept work to even building prototypes. Whether it is software development, development of future mobility solutions, sustainability, design engineering, quality assurance, manufacturing engineering or various other engineering requests, EDAG has successfully helped its clients take the next technology leap, for more than 56 years. We at EDAG simply claim to be our customer’s global mobility and industry engineering experts! EDAG Engineering Scandinavia AB is the Scandinavian subsidiary of the EDAG Group. With an origin from Gothenburg, we have naturally become an important partner to the western region of Sweden. More and more customers are discovering our ability to deliver local engineering capabilities within a wide range of areas – not seldom in combination with other global EDAG sites, colleagues and competences to accommodate larger projects and undertakings. We are looking for Mechanical Integration ! About the Role We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Integration Leader to drive vehicle-level integration activities and ensure seamless interaction between systems, components, and engineering disciplines throughout the product development process. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying and resolving interface challenges, coordinating technical stakeholders, and securing robust engineering solutions that balance performance, quality, cost, manufacturability, and regulatory requirements. You will act as a key technical focal point, ensuring alignment across vehicle programs and supporting the successful delivery of engineering milestones. This position requires a strong systems-thinking mindset, combining a broad vehicle perspective with the ability to dive into technical details when needed. Key Responsibilities Lead mechanical integration and packaging activities across multiple vehicle systems and functional areas. Investigate interface and packaging challenges and develop feasible technical concepts and integration solutions. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration between engineering teams, attributes, suppliers, design, manufacturing, purchasing, and program management. Organise and lead technical workshops, integration reviews, and decision-making forums to drive alignment and issue resolution. Manage system and component interfaces, ensuring technical compatibility and programme maturity. Provide technical guidance and recommendations to support engineering decisions, risk mitigation, and problem-solving activities. Balance vehicle requirements related to performance, cost, weight, quality, sustainability, manufacturability, and compliance. Drive closure of integration issues and secure resolution before key project gateways and release milestones. Monitor project maturity, CAD releases, engineering deliverables, and integration readiness throughout development phases. Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and recovery plans to management and key stakeholders. Support the development and maintenance of vehicle mechanical architecture and integration strategies. Required Qualifications Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Product Development, or a related technical field. Extensive experience within automotive product development and vehicle integration. Strong knowledge of mechanical packaging, system integration, and interface management. Hands-on experience with CATIA and Teamcenter . Previous experience from Volvo Cars product development environment . Solid understanding of vehicle development processes, engineering gateways, release management, and maturity planning. Proven ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and drive technical alignment in complex organisations. Strong communication and workshop facilitation skills. Ability to combine strategic thinking with detailed technical analysis. Personal Attributes Solution-oriented with a proactive mindset. Strong leadership and influence skills without formal authority. Excellent relationship-building and stakeholder-management capabilities. Comfortable working in cross-functional and international environments. Able to maintain a "helicopter view" while managing detailed technical challenges when required. Structured, analytical, and driven to achieve results. Why Join EDAG? Work on cutting-edge automotive software and technologies. Collaborate with leading automotive companies and industry experts. Influence technical strategy and operational excellence. Be part of a collaborative and innovative engineering culture. Opportunity to lead high-impact teams delivering quality automotive solutions.

description: Mechanical Design Engineer | Dundee (Onsite) | £38-45K + paid overtime Most mechanical engineers spend their careers on one slice of a product. This role gives you the whole thing: mechanisms you help design, prototype, test and release into high-volume manufacture. You’ll join an established engineering team in Dundee designing high-speed electromechanical devices, built to run reliably across very different climates and environments worldwide. It’s precision mechanism work, and you’ll see your designs in production. What you’ll be doing Supporting new and existing products from a mechanical design perspective Evaluating technologies and backing your recommendations with analysis Designing mechanisms and working with tooling suppliers and part manufacturers Delivering cost-effective designs to spec and engineering standards Running design reviews, stress and tolerance analysis, testing and root-cause problem solving Managing supplier engagement and engineering change Working closely with electronics and software engineers Releasing design changes with full supporting documentation What you’ll bring A degree in Mechanical Engineering and around 2+ years’ relevant experience Solid CAD skills in Creo/ProE or SolidWorks, plus drawing, dimensioning and tolerancing Stress and tolerance analysis; FEA or simulation experience is a plus Design for manufacture across plastic moulding, sheet metal and tooling An understanding of mechanical drive systems and rapid prototyping Bonus points for mechanism design or assemblies with PCBs and harnesses Happy to travel internationally now and then for customer support and analysis This is a fully onsite role, and for good reason: you’ll be hands-on with the hardware every day, building, testing and troubleshooting the mechanisms you design rather than working from a screen alone. title: Senior Valve Design Engineer
description: VALVE DESIGN ENGINEER | WEST YORKSHIRE I’m currently working on an opportunity with a specialist engineering and manufacturing business experiencing a significant period of growth. They are looking for an experienced Valve Design Engineer to join their technical engineering function and play a key role in the development of specialist, highly engineered valve solutions . The Opportunity: This is an opportunity to move beyond standard product design and work on large, technically complex and custom-designed equipment . You’ll be involved in the design concept and development of new valve ranges, as well as the continued development of existing products. The role offers genuine exposure across the full engineering lifecycle, from initial concept and calculations through to manufacture and testing. Your responsibilities will include: • Designing innovative and bespoke valve solutions • Developing new product ranges • 3D CAD design • FEA & CFD • Structural calculations and design reports • Material selection • Valve and actuator sizing • Design for manufacture • Supporting manufacturing and testing • Producing technical documentation and risk assessments • Working closely with engineering and manufacturing teams You’ll also have the opportunity to work on challenging customer requirements , developing solutions where standard catalogue products simply aren't enough. Career Progression: The business is investing heavily in its engineering capability, making this an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to build a long-term career rather than simply move into another design position . As your experience develops, you'll have the opportunity to take greater ownership of complex projects, become a key technical resource within the business and contribute to the development of future products and engineering processes. There is also scope to mentor and support junior engineers , helping to shape the wider design capability of the team. What we're looking for: We're interested in speaking with experienced Design Engineers with a strong background in valves or closely related engineered products such as pumps. Ideally, you'll have: • Strong knowledge of valve design and functionality • Experience with operating mechanisms • Excellent CAD capability, ideally SolidWorks / AutoCAD • FEA & CFD experience • Experience with structural calculations • Material selection and valve/actuator sizing experience • Understanding of PED and relevant ASME, BS, ISO or API standards • An understanding of manufacturing processes • A logical and analytical approach to engineering challenges • A genuine interest in innovative product development Why consider it?: If you're currently designing relatively standard products and want to move into something more technically challenging, more bespoke and with greater ownership , this could be an interesting next step. You'll be working on large, specialist and custom-engineered products , gaining exposure to complex engineering challenges while being given the opportunity to develop your technical career alongside the growth of the business. title: Lead Civil and Structural Engineer
description: Bedrijfsomschrijving AFRY is een Europese marktleider op het gebied van engineering, ontwerp en adviesdiensten en versnelt de transitie naar een duurzame toekomst. Met meer dan 18.000 experts in meer dan 40 landen leveren we innovatieve, multidisciplinaire oplossingen op het gebied van infrastructuur, energie, industrie en digitalisering. De Industry Division is een van de belangrijkste pijlers van AFRY en ondersteunt klanten in sectoren zoals pulp & papier, chemie, bioraffinage, mijnbouw en metalen, voedingsmiddelen en dranken, biowetenschappen, enz. Terwijl we onze aanwezigheid in Nederland blijven uitbreiden, kijken we ernaar uit om ons nieuwe kantoor in Rotterdam te laten groeien en ambitieus talent te verwelkomen dat bijdraagt aan een duurzamere industrie. Kernverantwoordelijkheden Vertegenwoordigen en leiden van de discipline civiele techniek binnen AFRY Nederland. Fungeren als eerste aanspreekpunt voor alle civieltechnische en bouwkundige onderwerpen/projecten (intern en extern). Verantwoordelijk voor civiele techniek en het bouwkundig en ontwerp in: De procesindustrie. Betonconstructies, staalconstructies, funderingen, gebouwen, pijpenrekken en machinesteunen. Uitvoering van alle engineeringfasen: Ontwerpbasis. Haalbaarheidsstudies. Concept, Basic- en Detailengineering. Bouwtoezicht. Oplevering en overdracht van de bouwplaats. Kostenraming, input voor planning, risicobeoordeling en bijdrage aan projectcontroley. Zorgen voor engineeringresultaten, tijdige levering en technische conformiteit. Opstellen en coördineren van documentatie die nodig is voor bouwaanvragen en goedkeuringsprocedures. Toezicht houden op civiele activiteiten in EPCM-projecten, inclusief het aansturen van onderaannemers: Onderzoeks- en onderhandelingsfasen. Opstellen van functionele bestekken en onderzoeksdocumenten voor aanbestedingen. Toezicht houden op de prestaties, veiligheid, tijdschema's en naleving van de kosten door aannemers. Ondersteuning ter plaatse bieden, waaronder inspecties, toezicht en acceptatieprocessen. Deelname aan zakenreizen en opdrachten ter plaatse, wordt gezien als een waardevolle kans en niet als een last. Bekijk de gerenommeerde projecten waar onze Industry Divisions binnen AFRY bij betrokken is: https://afry.com/en/offerings/process-industries. Functie-eisen Wat u meebrengt Vereist Bachelor- of masterdiploma civiele techniek. Vloeiend Nederlands (gesproken en geschreven) en een uitstekende beheersing van de Engelse taal zijn essentiële vereisten. Meerdere jaren kennis en praktische ervaring in planning, ontwerpcoördinatie en projectmanagement van civiele en staalprojecten in de chemische, raffinaderij- en/of energiecentralebouw in alle engineeringfasen. Kennis van moderne engineeringtools en -programma's. Kennis van relevante Europese/Nederlandse civiele en constructiestaalnormen en -standaarden. Ervaring op bouwlocaties. ________________________________________ Je sterke punten Vermogen om mensen te leiden. Vaardigheden om een netwerk van onderaannemers te beheren. In staat om zelfstandig te werken en multidisciplinaire teams aan te sturen. Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en vaardigheden op het gebied van stakeholdermanagement. title: Senior Structural Engineer
description: About the Role The Structural Integrity Engineer (SIE) is a senior technical specialist who analyses, develops, and validates the mechanical integrity of complex structural systems across light‑weight and heavy‑weight platforms. The role encompasses metallic, non‑metallic, and composite materials, covering design, production, testing, and maintenance phases. Core responsibilities include damage‑tolerance, durability, and structural modelling across dynamics, loads, stability, stress fatigue and thermal analyses. The duty cycle uses a broad array of engineering tools, notably MSC Nastran, MSC Marc, Siemens Simcenter, Beta CAE, ANSA, and PTC Creo. The Structural Integrity Engineer will be a Subject Matter Expert in structural analysis and integrity decision‑making, operating within the Structural Integrity Group, a sub‑function of the Engineering Department. A key requirement of this role is the ability to obtain and maintain a high‑level security clearance. If you do not currently hold the required clearance, we can support you through the application process. DV Clearance will eventually be required for the role - applicants should either already hold a DV or being prepared to go through an application immediately. This position will require an on-site presence in Ampthill, Bedfordshire. Core responsibilities will include: Developing and validating high‑fidelity finite‑element models for metallic, composite and hybrid structures. Executing static, dynamic, vibrational, thermal and fluid‑structure interaction analyses. Performing damage‑tolerance and fatigue assessments. Authoring concise strength‑summary reports and risk assessments that satisfy MoD and customer standards. Translating analysis outcomes into manufacturing instructions and inspection plans. Leading knowledge‑transfer workshops and maintaining model libraries. Championing process improvement through new software, material databases and automation scripts. Representing the Company at design reviews, client briefings and external audits. Required skills, qualifications and experience Proven experience of industrial structural‑analysis experience on metallic and composite parts. BEng (Hons) in Mechanical/Aerospace or equivalent. Proficient in MSC Nastran and pre‑processors such as Patran, Apex, Simcenter, or ANSA. Experienced in static, dynamic, linear and non‑linear analyses. Skilled in hand‑based stress calculations and fatigue life prediction. Extensive experience modelling aluminium, titanium, steel and high‑strength alloys for both light‑ and heavy‑weight systems. Basic knowledge of composite lay‑up, ply‑by‑ply modelling and defect effects. Capable of drafting clear, concise strength‑summary reports and risk assessments. Comfortable working collaboratively with design, manufacturing, testing and quality teams. Skilled in scripting (Python, batch) and use of high‑performance computing to streamline analyses. Candidates must be able to undergo the process to achieve a Secret Clearance and be willing to go through the process to achieve a Developed Vetting Clearance. What we offer you At Lockheed Martin our employees come first and therefore your physical, mental and financial wellbeing matters to us. On top of working in a highly supportive, friendly, respectful environment you can expect so much more. We are an employer in support of and offering Flexible working with the option to also work a 4 day week depending on business requirements, where you have the option of Fridays off. Business Environment Lockheed Martin (UK) Ampthill is a rapidly changing, dynamic part of the Lockheed Martin Corporation with both domestic and international customers. It consists of three business areas focusing on Vehicles, Special Projects and Mission Support, which provide a variety of products and services to the MoD and other customers including the Scout and support to the Land Environment Air Picture Provision capability. We are looking for talented individuals to join the company, in return, we can offer an exciting and challenging career path. Please note that Lockheed Martin Ampthill work an 8 day fortnight with the site closed every Friday. We recognize the importance of leveraging the unique talents and experiences of all our employees to drive innovation, deliver superior solutions, and maximize value for our customers. Furthermore, Lockheed Martin is dedicated to ensuring our recruitment process is inclusive for all individuals. We are prepared to accommodate reasonable adjustments for applicants as needed. title: Graduate Computational Scientist
description: Job Description About us Fusion, the process that powers the sun and stars, is one of the most promising options for generating the cleaner, carbon-free energy that our world badly needs. UKAEA leads the way in realizing fusion energy, partnering with industry and research organisations to achieve ground-breaking advancements. Our goal is to bring fusion electricity to the grid by developing the power stations of tomorrow and the skilled workforce to deliver them. What you'll join Your degree got you this far. Where could fusion energy take you? If you're looking for your first graduate role and want a career that's meaningful, challenging, and packed with opportunities to grow, UKAEA's Graduate Development Programme could be the perfect next step. Working alongside world-leading experts, you'll help advance ground breaking fusion technology while building the technical, professional, and leadership skills needed for a successful career. This is your chance to be part of an industry that's helping create a sustainable future for generations to come. The Computing division at UKAEA runs a comprehensive computing programme exploring the use of new technologies to allow faster and more detailed studies of the physics and engineering problems associated with creating sustained and controlled fusion reactions. You will join the Materials Simulation group, which develops predictions based on physical-mathematical models informed by cutting-edge supercomputing simulations for what happens to structural reactor materials when subjected to the extreme conditions inside a fusion reactor. See here for an example. What you'll do As part of an established, supportive team of computational scientists and engineers, you will learn to: apply advanced computational methods to study materials evolving under fusion-relevant conditions, contribute to the creation of new modelling approaches, and evaluate new computational tools. Contribute to the development of physical-mathematical multiscale models (using methods ranging from atomistic simulations, to finite-element modelling, to data-driven approaches) of how irradiation by high-energy neutrons, generating defects on the nanoscale, leads to changes in materials properties on the reactor component scale. Deliver project work and build technical expertise, managing assigned tasks, communicating progress effectively, and engaging with technical and scientific communities to share knowledge and support innovation. Take an active role in the UKAEA Graduate Scheme, participating in training and development activities, collaborating across different teams through placements and projects, supporting outreach and early careers initiatives, and acting as a positive ambassador for UKAEA’s inclusive and collaborative culture. How you'll develop On the graduate scheme here at the UK Atomic Energy Authority, you will have 20% of your time focused on professional and personal development. This will include a series of core development activities to fast track your business acumen, along with skills for technical, project management and people leadership. The remaining 80% of time is role-based, working within a team growing your technical knowledge within your chosen discipline. Working with your line manager, you will get the opportunity to experience different roles and responsibilities within projects to broaden your understanding and help decide your future career route. What you'll need Degree educated in physics, engineering, materials science, computing, mathematics, or related discipline, from 2025 to 2027 Aptitude for mathematics and a keen interest in theoretical physical modelling. An interest in scientific computing, with a willingness to learn or develop programming skills (such as Python) Curious and highly motivated, with a dedication to learning and taking on new challenges Able to collaborate effectively and communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences Well organised and adaptable with the ability to plan and prioritise workload If you are excited by this role and bring a demonstrated aptitude for mathematics, we encourage you to apply, as we value perspectives from a diverse range of academic backgrounds. Benefits We have a generous range of benefits (see the full list here) and highlights include: £35,227 base salary. Final salary defined benefit scheme with an equivalent of 21.5% employer pension contribution. 25 days annual leave, plus 3 days Christmas closure and 2.5 privilege days, in addition to UK bank holidays. Flexible working options plus family-friendly leave provisions. Take part in our Skern Lodge residential to develop new skills and build your network. Our commitment to ED&I UKAEA’s mission is clean energy for all, and we welcome talented people from all backgrounds to help us achieve this goal. We are committed to equality, diversity, and inclusion and strive to ensure fair representation across our workforce. We particularly encourage applications from groups currently underrepresented in STEM, including women and individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, while ensuring all appointments are made on merit. UK Atomic Energy Authority is committed to being accessible. Please email earlycareerstalent@ukaea.uk if you have any questions or require any help or adjustments . AI may be used for preparation purposes only. All responses submitted during interviews and assessments must be your own work. To maintain a fair recruitment process, candidates are limited to two applications across our Early Careers programmes. If you apply for multiple roles, we may contact you to discuss which opportunities best match your skills and interests. Applications are due to close at 23:59 on 21st October 2026. As we're expecting strong interest, we encourage you to apply early, as the vacancy may close sooner if we receive a high volume of applications. More information can be found here.

title: CPU Post Silicon Power and Performance Engineer, Senior/Staff - Cork, Ireland
description: Company QT Technologies Ireland Limited Job Area Engineering Group, Engineering Group > ASICS Engineering General Summary As a CPU Post-Silicon Power and Performance Engineer, you will work on the characterization, analysis, debugging, and optimization of next-generation CPU technologies within complex SoC platforms. You will develop validation methodologies, design experiments, analyze silicon behavior, and provide actionable feedback to architecture, design, and product teams. Working across hardware and software domains, you will leverage laboratory instrumentation, automation, and data analysis techniques to ensure that silicon meets performance, power, and product objectives. Roles And Responsibilities Define and execute end-to-end power, performance, and characterization plans for CPU and SoC subsystems. Develop measurement methodologies and experiments to evaluate silicon behavior across a wide range of workloads and operating conditions. Debug performance, marginality, and power miscorrelations with pre-silicon projections in post-silicon. Analyze interactions between CPU microarchitecture, memory hierarchy, interconnects, firmware, operating systems, and platform components. Process, sanitize, analyze, and interpret large datasets to derive meaningful engineering insights and recommendations. Collaborate closely with architecture, design, verification, firmware, and software teams to improve current and future products. Drive continuous improvements in validation methodologies, tooling, and technical capabilities. What Are We Looking For? Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline. 5+ years of experience in post-silicon validation, CPU characterization, power/performance analysis, or related fields. Good understanding of modern CPU microarchitectures, including out-of-order execution, speculation, memory hierarchies, caching, and system-level performance behavior. Knowledge of ARM architectures and ecosystem technologies is a strong plus. Solid understanding of semiconductor fundamentals, including transistor operation, FinFET technologies, leakage mechanisms, dynamic power, voltage-frequency relationships, and process variation. Strong programming and scripting skills (Python, C/C++, or similar) with experience developing automation, instrumentation, and data analysis solutions. Hands-on experience with laboratory equipment, including oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, DAQs, logic analyzers, and automated measurement systems. Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess data quality, identify anomalies, validate results, and perform root-cause analysis. Experience collecting, processing, and interpreting large volumes of silicon, telemetry, or measurement data. Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills. Self-motivated and capable of independently driving technical investigations from experiment design through final recommendation. Where you will be working Cork has a proud reputation as Ireland's second largest economic engine and is now one of the Top 20 location choices in Europe with 39,000 people being employed by over 170 overseas companies. There's a growing diversity in the region with people from many nationalities relocating to Cork, relishing the opportunity to work and live in a location that offers an excellent quality of life. A gateway to Europe, Cork airport provides access to almost 50 international destinations including transatlantic air routes. Equal Opportunities We are an Equal Opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any protected classification. title: R&D Engineer
description: Job Description Ready to make a visible impact? Are you an experienced engineer who wants more than simply executing predefined assignments? In this role, you will have the autonomy to shape technical solutions, lead R&D projects from concept to implementation and directly influence the future of our products. As R&D Engineer, you are a hands-on, mechanically-minded engineer who takes ownership of our R&D lab and the physical equipment that our projects and our sales team depend on, from demo suitcases and pilot test setups used in front of customers, to the air-sampling equipment that determines how reliable our GC-MS measurements are. You keep the lab organised, maintained and continuously improved, including its inventory and logistics. Alongside this, you combine mechanical design and fabrication with a working knowledge of electrical and instrumentation systems to develop, build and validate practical solutions in the laboratory. Your work will contribute to higher product quality, improved functionality, greater energy efficiency and reduced odor and environmental impact. You will take ownership of multiple R&D projects, coordinating their technical and operational progress from start to finish. As a key technical contact for customers, you will translate real world challenges into innovative, reliable and manufacturable solutions. You will also work closely with Operations and Service to ensure that developments perform successfully beyond the laboratory. This is an opportunity for an experienced engineer who enjoys both strategic thinking and practical problem-solving. You will join a small, multidisciplinary and international team where decisions are made quickly, expertise is valued and individual contributions are highly visible. You will have the freedom to challenge existing approaches, explore new technologies and test your own ideas. Job Requirements To be successful in this role, you have: You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field. You have at least five years of relevant experience, for example as an R&D Engineer, laboratory technician, manufacturing automation engineer or workstation designer. You have strong, hands-on mechanical skills, fabrication, prototyping and mechanical design, and a working knowledge of electrical and instrumentation systems (wiring, sensors, basic troubleshooting) to support this work. You are comfortable reading and working around PLC-based control systems (e.g. reading register/IO documentation, basic configuration) you are not expected to program PLCs from scratch. You have experience with SolidWorks and AutoCAD. You have a good command of written and spoken English. You have strong interpersonal and communication skills. You work independently, proactively, accurately and in an organised manner. You will be the only engineer in the team day to day, so self-sufficiency and clear documentation of your own work are essential. You are a self-starter who takes ownership of tasks and projects. You hold a valid driving license. You are willing to travel up to 10% of the year, mainly within the Netherlands and Belgium and occasionally farther abroad. International travel will be discussed in advance. Job Responsibilities You coordinate R&D projects and ensure they progress from initial concept through experimentation and implementation. You are also an important point of contact for our customers. Your responsibilities include: Owning the R&D lab: keeping it organised and well maintained, managing inventory and logistics, and continuously improving the space and how it runs. Maintaining and improving the demo suitcases and pilot test equipment used by the sales team and in customer-facing trials, with an eye for making them more robust and easier to use reliably in the field. Maintaining and redesigning the air-sampling equipment (bags, lines, fittings) used ahead of GC-MS analysis, so that samples can be taken more consistently and measurement results can be trusted. Planning, preparing and conducting laboratory experiments. Managing R&D projects from start to finish. Improving manufacturing processes and product quality and functionality. Developing mechanical and electrical improvements. Designing and automating manufacturing processes and workstations. Monitoring project progress and setting priorities. Translating customer requirements into practical technical solutions. Working closely with the Operations and Service teams. Contributing to the development of increasingly energy efficient products. You start the day with the team to review current tasks and projects. During the day, you divide your time between laboratory experiments, lab and equipment upkeep, engineering activities and coordinating project progress. You start the day with the team to review current tasks and projects. During the day, you divide your time between laboratory experiments, engineering activities and coordinating project progress. Job Benefits What do we offer? The opportunity to improve products and manufacturing processes with a positive environmental impact. A varied role combining engineering, experimentation and project management. Continuous learning and professional development. The opportunity to work with the latest technologies. A position within a small, multidisciplinary and international team. The chance to grow alongside our products and contribute to increasingly energy efficient solutions. A role in which your expertise directly supports product development and the expansion of our growing market. Joining us would mean to be part of an organization that is a world leader in its niche market. We are innovative and solution-oriented for the customer. We operate internationally, serving both large and small clients. We control nearly the entire process in-house, and you would play an important role in that. Improvement and environmental awareness are important within our organization.

title: Battery Design Release Engineer - AUTOMOTIVE

Lavoriamo con attori chiave nei settori: Aeronautico &Spaziale, della Difesa & Navale, della Sicurezza, Automobilistico, Ferroviario, dell’Energia, del Life Sciences, Finanziario, del Retail e dei Servizi. Con un fatturato di oltre 4.069 miliardi di euro, abbiamo attualmente più di 57.400 collaboratori in tutto il mondo. In Italia siamo presenti in 13 città lungo tutto il territorio nazionale: Torino, Milano, Gallarate, Brescia, Genova, La Spezia, Modena, Maranello, Bologna, Firenze, Roma, Napoli e Bari. Di cosa ti occuperai: Supportare lo sviluppo e la gestione del Battery Pack lungo l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, dalla definizione dei requisiti fino al rilascio finale. Collaborare con team multidisciplinari coinvolti nello sviluppo di sistemi elettrici ed elettronici, integrazione veicolo, validazione, testing, qualità e produzione. Definire, raccogliere e monitorare requisiti tecnici, funzionali e prestazionali relativi ai sistemi batteria. Partecipare alle attività di integrazione del Battery Pack all'interno del veicolo, assicurandone compatibilità meccanica, elettrica e termica. Supportare l'analisi dei risultati di test e validazione, contribuendo alla risoluzione delle problematiche tecniche emerse durante le fasi di sviluppo. Interagire con fornitori e stakeholder internazionali per il coordinamento delle attività progettuali. Gestire modifiche tecniche, documentazione di progetto e processi di rilascio dei componenti. Monitorare avanzamento attività, milestone progettuali e rispetto di tempi, costi e qualità. Contribuire allo sviluppo di soluzioni innovative nell'ambito dell'elettrificazione e dei sistemi batterie per veicoli di nuova generazione. Requisiti: Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria Meccanica, Automotive, Meccatronica, Elettrica o affini . Esperienza da neolaureato fino a circa 2 anni in contesti automotive, preferibilmente in ambito Battery Pack, sistemi HV, testing, validazione, calibrazione o sviluppo prodotto . Valutiamo sia candidati con tesi, tirocinio o stage sul mondo batterie , sia profili con esperienza iniziale come DRE, Component Owner, Test Engineer o Calibration Engineer . Conoscenza dei principi di funzionamento dei sistemi batteria, architetture HV e processi di sviluppo automotive. Familiarità con attività di testing, analisi dati, validazione o integrazione di componenti/sistemi. Buona capacità di interfacciarsi con stakeholder interni, fornitori e team internazionali. Ottime capacità di problem solving, organizzazione e gestione delle priorità. La retribuzione annua lorda per questo ruolo è compresa tra 31.000 EUR e 35.000 EUR. La posizione è inquadrata nell’ambito del CCNL del Commercio e Terziario applicato da ALTEN. Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. In presenza di profili con caratteristiche eccezionali rispetto al range indicato, una revisione potrà essere valutata previa approvazione interna. Il ruolo include l’applicazione dei principi di sicurezza delle informazioni e il rispetto delle policy aziendali. Prevede la gestione sicura di credenziali e strumenti, il riconoscimento di minacce come il phishing e la segnalazione di eventuali incidenti. È prevista formazione per supportare queste attività. Perché scegliere ALTEN? Technological challenges Crediamo che la tecnologia abbia un grande potenziale per migliorare il nostro futuro, per questo ricerchiamo talenti che siano motivati a costruire oggi il mondo di domani. Con il nostro portfolio clienti e i diversi progetti di R&D attivi, in ALTEN avrai modo di lavorare su progetti all'avanguardia. La nostra Technical Direction ti accompagnerà e indirizzerà durante il tuo percorso. Avrai la possibilità di metterti alla prova in contesti progettuali diversi e di confrontarti con esperti del settore per ampliare sempre più le tue conoscenze. Potrai unire le tue passioni e metterti in gioco professionalmente. Accetti la sfida? Inspiring Togetherness Ci impegniamo a favorire un ambiente di lavoro sereno e collaborativo organizzando attività di team building, iniziative di aggregazione, eventi sportivi, per conoscerci meglio e condividere momenti insieme. Il successo di un gruppo si fonda sulla cooperazione e condivisione reciproca del sapere e degli interessi. Fulfilling Opportunities In ALTEN troverai corsi formativi all’avanguardia per accrescere le tue competenze sia tecnologiche, sia linguistiche! Tramite ALTEN Academy potrai ottenere certificazioni con alcuni dei più importanti schemi internazionali comeIREB®, ISTQB® e altri. Attraverso Aula Streaming, invece, avrai accesso a corsi di formazione più trasversali relativi a soft skills e potrai scegliere tra 12 corsi di lingua straniera. Sustainable commitment Crediamo che la tecnologia sia a supporto dello sviluppo sociale e della tutela ambientale. Oltre a collaborare a progetti che mirano alla sostenibilità, ci impegniamo a sostenere le cause che più abbiamo a cuore, avendo collaborato e collaborando, tra gli altri, con AISM, AIRC, LILT, Save the Children, Treedom, This Unique. Valorizziamo l'unicità e ci impegniamo a garantire che tutte le nostre persone abbiano pari opportunità all'interno della nostra azienda, fornendo loro gli strumenti per esprimere al massimo il proprio potenziale. Il nostro approccio alla diversità e all'inclusione si fonda sui principi di etica e integrità e rappresenta il fattore determinante per lo sviluppo di orizzonti di crescita personale e aziendale più

title: Mechanical Engineer – Vacuum Pumps
description: Job Description We are seeking a motivated Mechanical or Aerospace Engineer to join our Vacuum Technologies R&D team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the design, development, verification, and validation of dry scroll vacuum pumps and rotary vane vacuum pumps, supporting new product development as well as sustaining engineering activities. The role will focus on the design and development of vacuum pump components and assemblies, with particular emphasis on structural and rotodynamic analysis, leveraging simulation tools and experimental methods to ensure product performance, reliability, and durability. The engineer will work closely with multidisciplinary teams including design engineering, manufacturing, testing, and product management throughout the product development lifecycle. Key responsibilities include: Design and develop mechanical components and assemblies for scroll and rotary vane vacuum pumps. Perform structural analyses using Finite Element Analysis (FEA) tools to evaluate strength, stiffness, fatigue life, and reliability of components and systems. Conduct rotodynamic analyses to assess vibration behavior, critical speeds, dynamic stability, and overall system performance, with a strong focus on reducing noise and vibration levels. Plan, execute, and analyze experimental validation activities to correlate simulation results with physical testing. Support noise and vibration investigations through data acquisition and analysis. Develop test plans, analyze results, and generate technical reports and recommendations. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve technical issues and drive product improvements. Contribute to continuous improvement of analytical methodologies, simulation processes, and testing capabilities. Support root cause investigations and corrective actions related to field and manufacturing issues. Qualifications Master's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline. Typically 4+ years of relevant experience in mechanical product development, analysis, or validation engineering. Experience in mechanical design and development of rotating machinery or electromechanical systems. Strong knowledge of structural analysis and Finite Element Analysis (FEA). Proficiency with CAD software and structural simulation tools; experience with ANSYS is strongly preferred. Knowledge of rotordynamics, vibration analysis, and dynamic behavior of rotating systems. Experience with experimental testing and validation, including noise and vibration data acquisition and analysis. Familiarity with test instrumentation, sensors, and data acquisition systems. Ability to interpret test data and correlate experimental results with simulation models. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and international engineering environment. Nice to have: Experience with vacuum technology, scroll pumps, rotary vane pumps, compressors, or similar rotating equipment. Pay range: 34.112,00 - 53.300,00 per annum The position is classified at Levels B1 or B2 under the CCNL Industria metalmeccanica e della installazione di impianti – Cod. C011, which defines minimum salary levels, pay progression, and working conditions Additional Details This job has a full time weekly schedule. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: https://careers.agilent.com/locations Agilent Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other protected categories under all applicable laws. title: Mechanical Engineer - MedTech Start up
description: Founding Mechanical Engineer — Medical Device Start Up Paris, France | Full-time | On-site We are a venture-backed medtech company developing a minimally invasavice, at-home blood-monitoring platform. The role We are looking for a hands-on mechanical engineer to take ownership of a core part of our product: the blood-collection device and its disposable components. You will work directly on the architecture, design, prototyping, and testing of a complex medical device, taking ideas from early concepts through to robust, manufacturable solutions. title: Beräkningsingenjör inom Durability/NVH
description: Företagsbeskrivning AFRY är ett ledande europeiskt företag med global räckvidd inom teknik, design och rådgivning. Vi accelererar omställningen mot ett hållbart samhälle. Vi är 18 000 hängivna experter inom infrastruktur, industri, energi och digitalisering, som skapar hållbara lösningar för kommande generationer. Jobbeskrivning Söker du nya utmaningar och tycker det är kul att utveckla produkter och hitta nya lösningar? Har du dessutom erfarenhet inom hållfasthet/durability och/eller NVH så är det här jobbet för dig. Vi har mycket att göra och söker nu en eller flera beräkningsingenjörer till vårt kontor i Göteborg! Som konsult hos oss får du en unik möjlighet att bidra med din kompetens i olika projekt inom ett flertal spännande branscher. Vi hjälper bland annat våra kunder med att ta fram nya produkter, optimera deras processer eller produkter och mycket, mycket mer. Ett omväxlande jobb där vi ofta jobbar inom områden som är ”heta” just nu. Våra kunder finns både lokalt och internationellt och vi arbetar inom flera branscher där automotive är störst men där försvar och övrig industri ökar. Uppdragen kan komma att variera i både storlek och innehåll samt utföras antingen in-house i våra egna lokaler eller ute på plats hos våra kunder. Urval sker kontinuerligt så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag! Skicka med CV samt personligt brev. Kvalifikationer Vi söker nu dig med en gedigen utbildning inom hållfasthet och strukturmekanik. Vi tror att du har en civilingenjörsexamen från Maskin, Teknisk Fysik eller Samhällsbyggnad och har jobbat något eller några år med hållfasthet/durability och/eller NVH. Förmodligen har nu använt mjukvaror som ANSA samt Abaqus, Nastran eller Ansys. Du skall ha goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och i skrift. Som person är du noggrann, ambitiös och vetgirig. Du har ett sinne för detaljer och har en förmåga att förklara komplexa tekniska termer för personer i din omgivning. Du gillar att träffa människor och har förmåga att anpassa dig i nya miljöer. Du är självständig, handlingskraftig, van att ta egna initiativ och är bra på att kommunicera och dokumentera. Ytterligare information Vi söker dig som vill vara en del av AFRYs framgångssaga. Brinner du för teknisk utveckling? Gillar du att samarbeta för att hitta den bästa lösningen? Då kan vi erbjuda dig karriärmöjligheter på en modern arbetsplats med utmanande arbetsuppgifter och spännande projekt världen över. AFRY är rankat som en av Sveriges mest populära arbetsgivare bland ingenjörer. Hos oss är du med och utvecklar innovativa och hållbara lösningar inom infrastruktur, energi och industri. Just nu söker vi marknadens vassaste kompetens som tillsammans med oss vill skapa framtidens samhälle. Vi hoppas också att du kommer lära dig lika mycket av oss som vi kommer göra av dig. På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. Vi söker konstant kvalificerade kandidater som vill ansluta sig till våra inkluderande team runt om i världen. Bli en del av oss och påskynda den gröna omställningen

title: Mekanik Teknik Ressam
description: Biz Kimiz? 1993 yılında kurulan Rönesans Holding, bugün Türkiye, Avrupa, Orta Asya ve Afrika’yı kapsayan geniş bir coğrafyada; inşaat, gayrimenkul, enerji, endüstri ve sağlık alanlarında ana müteahhit ve yatırımcı olarak faaliyet göstermektedir. 40.000’i aşkın çalışanı ve 60’tan fazla milletten oluşan güçlü ve çok kültürlü ekibiyle Rönesans, dünyanın en büyük müteahhitlik şirketleri arasında yer almakta; sürdürülebilir bir gelecek inşa etme vizyonuyla yenilikçi ve küresel ölçekteki mühendislik projelerini hayata geçirmeye devam etmektedir. Bu Rolde Seni Neler Bekliyor? Konsept tasarım aşamasından shop drawing ve asbuilt süreci sonuna kadar mekanik tesisat sistemlerinin Revit ortamında modellenmesi ve projelendirilmesi, Havalandırma, ısıtma, soğutma, sıhhi tesisat ve yangın tesisatı sistemlerine ilişkin uygulama projelerinin hazırlanması, Projelerin ilgili standartlar, işveren şartnameleri ve saha uygulama gerekliliklerine uygun olarak geliştirilmesi, Disiplinler arası koordinasyon süreçlerine destek verilmesi ve çakışma analizlerinin gerçekleştirilmesi, Genel proje koordinasyonunu etkileyebilecek teknik konuların ilgili ekiplerle paylaşılması ve gerekli çözüm önerilerinin sunulması, Şantiye ekipleri ile koordineli çalışarak uygulama süreçlerine teknik destek verilmesi. Adaylardan Beklentilerimiz Şirketimizin Ankara’da yapımını üstlendiği Veri Merkezi Projesi’nde değerlendirilmek üzere ; Meslek Yüksekokullarının Makine ile ilgili bölümlerinden mezun, Alanında en az 7 yıl deneyimli, Üç boyutlu modelleme ve Yapı Bilgi Modellemesi (BIM) süreçlerine hakim, İleri seviyede Revit, AutoCAD kullanabilen, Mekanik tesisat uygulama projeleri ve shop drawing hazırlama süreçlerinde deneyimli, Teknik çizim standartlarına, ölçülendirme ve proje dokümantasyon süreçlerine hakim, Tercihen büyük ölçekli altyapı ve üstyapı projelerinde (hastane, havaalanı, endüstriyel tesis, AVM vb.) görev almış, Navisworks Clash Detection süreçlerinde deneyimli, Ekip çalışmasına yatkın, çözüm odaklı ve analitik düşünme becerisine sahip, Ankara’da ikamet eden veya edebilecek, “Mekanik Teknik Ressam” aramaktayız. Biz Neler Sunuyoruz? Performans ve başarıyı destekleyen prim uygulamaları Kapsamlı yan haklar ve çalışan destek uygulamaları Özel Sağlık Sigortası kapsamında çalışanlarımızı destekleyen sağlık uygulamaları Mesleki ve kişisel gelişimini destekleyen eğitim ve gelişim programları Çeşitlilik ve Eşitlik Beyanımız Rönesans Holding, şirketlere stratejilerini ve operasyonlarını evrensel insan hakları, çalışma, çevre ve yolsuzlukla mücadele ilkelerine uygun hale getirmeye ve toplumsal hedefleri ilerletecek önlemler almaya çağıran BM Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi'nin imzacıları arasında yer almaktadır ve Birleşmiş Milletler Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi çerçevesinde evrensel kabul görmüş beyanlara dayalı ilkeleri benimser. Rönesans Holding, ana ilkeleri olan dürüstlük, rekabetçilik ve yenilikçilikten ödün vermeden şeffaf ve etik değerleri gözeterek insan kaynakları uygulamalarında eşitliği sağlamayı amaçlayan bir işverendir. Tüm başvurular cinsiyet, dil, din, ırk ve etnik kökene bakmaksızın fırsat eşitliğine göre değerlendirilir ve ayırımcılık yapılmaz.

title: Kıdemli Kontrol Sistemleri Mühendisi
description: Pozisyon: Kıdemli Kontrol Sistemi Mühendisi (Senior Control Systems Engineer) Lokasyon: İstanbul / Pendik (Blitz Ofis) Çalışma Modeli: Tam Zamanlı (Yerinde) İş Hakkında Blitz bünyesinde geliştirdiğimiz yüksek hassasiyetli Gimbal ISR (İstihbarat, Gözetleme, Keşif) sistemleri için kontrol mimarisine, dinamik modellemesine ve stabilizasyon algoritmalarına yön verecek "Kıdemli Kontrol Sistemi Mühendisi" arıyoruz. Sorumluluklarınız Kontrol Mimarisi Tasarımı: Gimbal stabilizasyonu, Görüş Hattı (LOS) kontrolü, hassas hareket kontrolü ve hedef takibi için ileri seviye lineer ve lineer olmayan kontrol algoritmalarını tasarlamak, mimarisini kurgulamak ve uygulamak. Sistem Modelleme & Simülasyon: Karmaşık elektromekanik sistemlerin, motor-yük dinamiklerinin ve sürtünme/bozucu etki modellerinin Simülasyon ortamında yüksek sadakatli (high-fidelity) matematiksel modellerini oluşturmak; donanım döngüde (HIL) benzetim altyapılarını kurgulamak. Gelişmiş Algoritma ve Sensör Füzyonu: Yüksek frekanslı IMU, optik/manyetik enkoder ve yardımcı sensör verilerini işlemek; Extended/Unscented Kalman Filtreleri (EKF/UKF) ve tamamlayıcı filtreler ile hassas sistem durumu (durum/yönelim) tahmini sağlamak. Bozucu Etki Giderimi & Motor Kontrolü: Platform titreşimleri, rüzgar yükleri ve mekanik esneklikleri bastırmak için Bozucu Etki Giderici (ADRC, DOB) kontrol yapılarını geliştirmek; BLDC motorlar için Alan Yönelimli Kontrol (FOC) stratejilerini optimize etmek. Saha ve Laboratuvar Doğrulaması: Frekans cevabı analizleri (Bode, FFT), sinyal işleme, bant genişliği testleri ve uçuş/saha testleri ile kontrol döngülerini (PID, durum uzayı vb.) ayarlamak, sistem davranışını doğrulamak. Disiplinlerarası Liderlik: Mekanik, gömülü yazılım ve donanım ekipleriyle koordineli çalışarak kontrol gereksinimlerini belirlemek; genç mühendislere teknik liderlik ve mentorluk sağlamak. Gereksinimler Eğitim: Kontrol ve Otomasyon, Elektrik-Elektronik, Mekatronik, Havacılık/Uzay Mühendisliği veya ilgili alanlarda Lisans; tercihen Yüksek Lisans / Doktora derecesi. Deneyim: Gerçek zamanlı kontrol sistemlerinin tasarımı, modellenmesi ve canlı platformlar üzerinde uygulanmasında 5+ yıl (Gimbal, İHA/SİHA, Savunma Sanayii, Optronik veya Robotik projelerinde) aktif tecrübe. Robot Kinematiği ve Dinamik: Çok eksenli sistemlerin kinematiği (ileri/ters kinematik, Euler açıları, Kuaterniyonlar, koordinat dönüşümleri) ve rijit/esnek cisim dinamiğinde derin uzmanlık. İleri Kontrol Teorisi: Klasik (PID, Bode/Nyquist, Kök Eğrisi) ve Modern Kontrol Teorisi (Durum Uzayı, Gözlemciler/Luenberger, LQR/LQG), Lineer Olmayan Kontrol ve Bozucu Etki Giderici (ADRC, Disturbance Observer) algoritmalarında güçlü teorik ve uygulamalı birikim. Yazılım & Simülasyon Yetkinliği: Çeşitli simülasyon modellerinden C/C++ kod üretimi tecrübesi. Sensör Füzyonu & Sinyal İşleme: IMU, jiroskop, ivmeölçer, enkoder ve tork/akım sensörlerinin gürültü karakterizasyonu, kalibrasyonu ve Kalman filtreleme yöntemleriyle entegrasyonu konusunda doğrudan deneyim. Saha ve Test Tecrübesi: Kontrol döngülerinin laboratuvar ortamında (shake table, rate table vb.) ve sahada tespiti, bant genişliği tuning süreçleri ve test veri analizi tecrübesi. Sizi Öne Çıkaracak Ek Nitelikler FOC & Motor Sürüş: BLDC/PMSM motorlar için Alan Yönelimli Kontrol (FOC), akım/hız döngüsü tasarımı ve uzay vektör PWM (SVPWM) konularında doğrudan geliştirme deneyimi. Gömülü Kontrol Uygulaması: C/C++ ile RTOS veya bare-metal platformlarda (STM32, TI C2000 vb.) gerçek zamanlı kontrol algoritmalarını koşturmuş olmak. Gömülü Arayüzler: CANBUS, SPI, I2C, UART gibi veri haberleşme protokollerine ve gömülü sistem sınırlamalarına (ör. sabit nokta aritmetiği, gecikme yönetimi) aşinalık. Süreç Bilgisi: Git ile versiyon kontrolü, model tabanlı tasarım (MBD) süreçleri ve dokümantasyon disiplini. Askerlik Durumu: Erkek adaylar için askerlik hizmetini tamamlamış veya en az 2 yıl tecilli olmak.

title: Junior Product Specialist - Aquapark
description: About Voodoo Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games. Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher. title: Procurement Engineer
description: About the Position Blitz Technology is looking for a Procurement Engineer to join our team and contribute to the production and development processes of our Gimbal ISR Systems and Video Processing Modules. The position is based at our office in the Pendik/Kurtköy area of Istanbul. We are looking for a candidate who can effectively manage technical procurement processes, work closely with engineering and production teams, and develop reliable domestic and international supplier networks. Key Responsibilities Manage domestic and international procurement processes for electronic components, mechanical parts, electromechanical components, optical components, and other technical materials. Identify suitable products and suppliers based on BOMs, technical documentation, drawings, datasheets, and engineering requirements. Evaluate supplier quotations in terms of technical compliance, cost, lead time, availability, and commercial conditions. Communicate with domestic and international suppliers and manage the full procurement cycle, including RFQs, quotations, purchase orders, order confirmations, and delivery follow-up. Support commercial negotiations regarding pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and other purchasing conditions. Research alternative components, products, and suppliers, particularly for critical, obsolete, or long-lead-time components, in close coordination with the relevant engineering teams. Manage and track procurement activities through the ERP system, ensuring accurate and up-to-date procurement records and documentation. Collaborate closely with Production, Planning, R&D, and Engineering teams to support inventory management, continuity of supply, and production requirements. Monitor supplier performance in terms of quality, cost, delivery performance, and responsiveness. Identify, evaluate, and develop new domestic and international suppliers to strengthen and diversify the company's supply chain. General Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Preferably at least 3 years of experience in technical purchasing, procurement, supply chain, or a related field. Knowledge of electronic components, mechanical parts, and basic electronics manufacturing processes. Ability to read and interpret BOMs, datasheets, technical drawings, specifications, and other technical documentation. Experience with ERP systems, preferably Odoo, and proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Advanced proficiency in English, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate effectively with international suppliers. Strong research, analytical, organizational, follow-up, and problem-solving skills. Strong communication and negotiation skills and the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience in electronics, electromechanical manufacturing, defense, aerospace, or other high-technology industries. Procurement experience involving one or more of the following: Electronic components Mechanical parts PCB / PCBA Cameras and imaging sensors Optical components Electromechanical components Familiarity with global electronic component manufacturers, authorized distributors, and international sourcing channels. Experience in alternative component sourcing and cross-reference analysis. Familiarity with EOL (End-of-Life), obsolescence management, and product lifecycle management for electronic components. Basic knowledge of international procurement, logistics, shipping, import procedures, and customs processes. What We Are Looking For We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented engineer who is comfortable working in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment and can combine technical understanding with strong procurement and supplier management skills. The ideal candidate will be able to understand engineering requirements, communicate effectively with suppliers, evaluate technical and commercial alternatives, and contribute to building a reliable, flexible, and sustainable supply chain for Blitz Technology.
