title: Senior Protective Design Engineer (Structural / Blast Engineering)
description: Joining Arup Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. The Opportunity Our risk, security and resilience practice has helped organisations to understand their exposure to threats and make better risk-informed decisions since it was formed in the mid-1990s. Our team of experts are trusted advisors to private and public-sector clients, providing strategic risk management, technical risk assessment, operational planning, security engineering and counter-terrorism design measures that suit their business needs. Our team apply their knowledge, critical thinking and experience to help our clients to understand and anticipate what could go wrong, and we help with finding better solutions to ensure that risks are effectively managed and controlled. Our team has consistently delivered high-quality advisory and engineering services to clients across a range of markets and industries, including Rail, Energy, Data Centres, Highways, Healthcare, Property and Scientific research facilities. You will join Arup as a Consultant working in our protective design engineering team with a focus on sustainable development across a range of market and industries. The types of projects you will be involved range from advisory to engineering solution based blast engineering and hostile vehicle mitigation across a range of project lifecycle stages (such as research & development, feasibility to concept and detailed design). At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective- in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning - to Arup, to your career, to our members, and to the clients and communities we serve. In this role you will: Utilise your knowledge of mainstream structural engineering design practice and develop your understanding of how to model such structures against transient dynamic loading Provide technical input across a broad range of projects across the resilience, security and risk practice Support the preparation of threat and vulnerability risk assessments for malicious threats (including terrorism, crime and civil disruption) Develop coherent, risk-based security strategies and integrate protective design and/or blast engineering measures from concept through detailed design to construction Carry out blast modelling using engineering software including computational fluid dynamic modelling and finite element methods Undertake the structural blast engineering design of a wide range of structures in common and novel engineering materials Undertake the façade blast engineering design of a wide range of glazed and non-glazed façade systems Undertake the design of Hostile Vehicle Mitigation measures Is this role right for you? We are seeking talented structural engineers who have a broad knowledge of structural engineering design and an interest in specialising in resilient structural design, to join our team but possibly to be deployed to projects being led from other centres and to further the development of our blast engineering services globally. Arup has one of the most significant protective design teams globally, with teams in London, Manchester, New York, San Francisco, Melbourne and Singapore working together as one global team. Unlike traditional codified design, blast engineering requires a very different approach to the design but requires a designer’s empathy with regard to aesthetic, form and function of any proposed facility. As such, this is a great opportunity for an existing practitioner to build their professional and tactical position in the industry, or for a talented structural engineer to provide strategic input and undertake first-principles design as traditional forms of mainstream structural engineering design are increasingly being automated and undertaken by code-compliant software. The successful candidate will be able to confidently and articulately communicate concepts of threat, risk and risk mitigation, supported by our threat specialists, will be able to develop and present conceptual ideas, understand the planning, design and construction process in the development of design solutions in a multi-disciplinary design environment and will be able to manage the detailed analysis, design and specification of structures and façade subject to blast loads. title: R&D Engineer – Inkjet Technology
description: About This Vacancy Are you fascinated by the science behind advanced technology? Do you enjoy combining experimentation, data analysis, and physical modelling to solve complex engineering challenges? If so, this could be the perfect opportunity for you. We are looking for a Print Process Developer to join an innovative R&D team developing the next generation of industrial inkjet printing technology. In this role, you will explore the physics behind the printing process and develop solutions that directly contribute to future products and applications. From ink behavior and droplet formation to media interaction and drying processes, you will investigate the fundamental mechanisms that determine print quality and system performance. This is a highly multidisciplinary role where scientific insight is translated into technology that works in real-world printing systems. As a Print Process Developer, you will work on complex technical challenges at the intersection of physics, chemistry, and engineering. Your Responsibilities Will Include Investigating printing phenomena through experiments, measurements, data analysis, and physical modelling. Developing and optimizing print processes involving inks, printheads, media, drying, fixation, and image processing. Translating print-quality challenges and application requirements into physical questions and technical solutions. Designing and executing experiments using laboratory setups and industrial printing systems. Building, validating, and refining physical models to explain and predict process behavior. Analyzing complex datasets and using insights to improve print performance. Collaborating with specialists from multiple disciplines to understand process interactions and trade-offs. Converting scientific knowledge into robust, scalable solutions for future products and applications. You will be part of a multidisciplinary R&D organization where innovation is driven by collaboration. Working alongside physicists, chemists, engineers, software developers, and technology specialists, you will tackle challenges ranging from: Fluid dynamics Droplet generation and jetting behavior Ink-media interactions Drying and fixation processes Print quality optimization Process modelling and validation The unique aspect of this role is that you will not only develop theories and models but also test them directly on experimental setups and real industrial printing systems. What We Expect From You We are looking for a curious and analytical professional who enjoys understanding how complex systems work and translating scientific knowledge into practical solutions. Qualifications BSc, MSc or PhD in Physics, Applied Physics or Chemistry with a strong interest in material science Strong understanding of physical principles and engineering fundamentals. Hands-on experience or affinity with experimental research and measurement techniques. Ability to describe physical behavior through calculations, models, and data analysis. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. A structured approach to investigating and testing hypotheses. Interest in bridging the gap between scientific research and product development. Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams. Fluent in spoken and written English. What You Can Expect From Us The opportunity to work on cutting-edge inkjet technology within a highly innovative R&D environment. Challenging technical projects that combine physics, experimentation, modelling, and engineering. Collaboration with experienced specialists across multiple disciplines. A culture that encourages curiosity, innovation, and continuous learning. The chance to see your ideas evolve from scientific concepts into technologies used in real-world products. Excellent opportunities for personal and professional development.

title: Ingénieur R&D mécanique H/F
description: Coris Innovation est une entreprise spécialisée dans les métiers de l'ingénierie système et des processus industriels. Fondée en 2015, notre société a été imaginée selon un principe clairement défini : Inscrire le consulting dans une relation durable et de proximité en assurant la satisfaction de nos partenaires, de nos consultants et de notre structure. Cette conception du conseil en ingénierie est aujourd'hui partagée par une centaine de collaborateurs répartis au sein de 5 agences entre la Suisse et la France (Annecy, Bourges, Grenoble et Lyon) qui accompagnent au quotidien nos clients industriels dans leurs défis d'innovation, de Recherche & Développement et de production. Vous souhaitez prendre part à l'aventure et rejoindre une structure en pleine croissance et qui se donne les moyens de respecter ses engagements auprès de ses collaborateurs et de ses clients ? C'est par ici ! Coris Innovation s'engage en faveur de l'égalité professionnelle, de la diversité et de l'inclusion. Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes à tous les talents et nous veillons à garantir un processus de recrutement fondé uniquement sur les compétences, l'expérience et le potentiel. POSTE / MISSIONS Au sein d'un environnement industriel à forte dominante mécanique, vous intervenez sur des projets de recherche et développement, de conception et d'évolution de produits techniques. Vous contribuez à la définition de solutions innovantes, au dimensionnement mécanique et à la validation expérimentale des équipements développés, notamment dans un environnement intégrant des pompes turbomoléculaires. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes projet, la R&D, les équipes technologiques et le pôle électronique afin de garantir la performance, la fiabilité et la conformité des solutions. Coris Innovation recherche son/sa nouveau/elle Ingénieur développement mécanique – R&D et caractérisation expérimentale, pour contribuer au développement de solutions techniques, à la définition des moyens d'essais et à la validation des performances des produits, tout en intégrant les enjeux de performance énergétique et les exigences industrielles. Missions Principales Développer des solutions techniques en s'appuyant sur des concepts éprouvés et en proposant de nouvelles approches adaptées aux besoins des projets, en concertation avec les équipes pluridisciplinaires. Participer aux groupes de travail multiservices afin d'identifier les besoins techniques, d'optimiser les moyens de réalisation et de fabrication et de favoriser la cohérence des choix de conception. Réaliser le dimensionnement mécanique des ensembles et sous-ensembles, en tenant compte des contraintes fonctionnelles, des performances attendues et des exigences du produit. Définir et dimensionner les moyens de caractérisation expérimentale, notamment les bancs d'essais, les équipements associés et les protocoles de mesure nécessaires à la validation des produits. Contribuer à la définition des méthodes de test et réaliser les essais en laboratoire, analyser les résultats obtenus et participer à la validation des performances techniques. Assurer le suivi des démarches de certification réalisées par des organismes tiers, selon les besoins du projet, et prendre en charge un lot technique en qualité de Work Package Leader lorsque nécessaire. Intégrer les enjeux de performance énergétique dans les solutions développées et contribuer à l'amélioration des performances globales des produits. PROFIL RECHERCHÉ De formation ingénieur en mécanique, génie mécanique ou domaine équivalent, vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en environnement industriel, idéalement dans un contexte de recherche et développement ou de développement de produits à forte dominante mécanique. Vous avez acquis une expérience significative dans la recherche de solutions techniques, la conception et le dimensionnement d'ensembles mécaniques, ainsi que dans la validation expérimentale de produits ou d'équipements. Vous maîtrisez les principes de dimensionnement mécanique, la définition de moyens d'essais et l'élaboration de protocoles de caractérisation. Vous êtes en mesure de préparer et de réaliser des essais en laboratoire, d'exploiter les résultats et de contribuer à la validation des solutions techniques. La connaissance des pompes turbomoléculaires, des procédés de certification et du pilotage d'un lot technique en tant que Work Package Leader constitue un atout. Les logiciels de CAO, de calcul mécanique et les outils métiers utilisés dans l'environnement du poste seront à préciser selon les besoins du projet. Vous faites preuve de rigueur technique, d'autonomie, d'un bon esprit d'analyse et d'une réelle capacité à proposer des solutions adaptées aux contraintes industrielles. Votre aisance dans le travail en équipe vous permet de collaborer efficacement avec des interlocuteurs issus de différents domaines techniques. Le niveau d'anglais requis et les modalités de présence sur site seront précisés en fonction des exigences du projet.

title: R&D Mechanical Engineer
description: Movu Robotics Innovation, ambitious growth, technology, state-of-the-art robots – that’s Movu Robotics in a nutshell. Due to the in-house design and manufacturing process of our systems, an exciting, hands-on work environment with plenty of challenges and advancement opportunities is guaranteed. Will you help shape the future of intralogistics? Job Description The R&D Mechanical engineer is responsible for the research and development of mechanical components and system modules. This includes conceptualization, design, engineering and testing of new prototype components and full systems. Tasks & Responsibilities You review the current automated warehouse solutions based on performance, downtime, technical specifications, … You discuss with colleagues (R&D, Service, Testing, …) about improvement points of the Movu Robotics products. You take the lead on R&D activities concerning mechanical components and the full mechanical product. You develop a PoC and plan a timeline in accordance with Movu’s Product Development Process. You perform mechanical design of system modules (NX). You are responsible for component selection and calculation. You interface with controls specialists to design a complete, mechatronic, solution. You make full production files (BOM’s, drawings, datasheets). You manage design states and revisions in the PLM package. You discuss test specifications and set-up with the Test & Validation team. You review prototype testing reports and adapt the PoC accordingly. You work together with the production engineer concerning assembly training for the blue collars. Qualifications You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechatronics or a related field. You have at least 5 years of engineering experience, preferably in the material handling, manufacturing, automation, machine or aerospace industries. Your expertise is mainly mechanical, but you have a keen interest in the full product picture, including controls, electronics and software. You have knowledge and experience in CAD. You have experience with NX. You are an autonomous team player. English is a must (C1 or higher). Knowledge of Dutch is highly recommended. Additional Information What do we offer? A place in an enthusiastic, young organisation with the necessary ambitions The necessary freedom and opportunity to take initiative. An intensive training by experienced people. An attractive salary in an international environment with many benefits: Company car with fuel card/charging pass Group & health insurance Meal vouchers (8€) Net allowances CAO90 Bonus Laptop iPhone + subscription 20 days of vacation plus 12 extra days for working a full year on 40h-workweek instead of 38h (32 leave days in total) Unsolicited representations by third parties (recruitment agencies, headhunters, ...) of CVs via mail and/or telephone for our vacancies are considered as direct applications where no compensation is provided to the third party. Candidates remain registered in the system for 12 months and cannot be proposed again during this period.

Braun Melsungen AG - and Christoph Miethke - founder and CEO of Christoph Miethke GmbH & Co. KG in Potsdam. Opportunity to gain additional qualifications and advance your career through job related training events.

title: Senior Thermomechanical Analysis Engineer – Extreme Environments (all genders)
description: Your Mission: As Senior Thermomechanical Analysis Engineer (all genders) you will join VÆRIDION’s Technology division within the Mechanical Design & Integration team and lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical finite element analysis (FEA) of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will own the computational modelling of battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and their internal hardware, predicting how every component behaves under nominal and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions applied to the pack and PDU as airborne equipment (temperature and altitude, temperature variation, humidity, operational shocks and crash safety, and vibration), flight loads, and durability over service life. Your analysis will provide engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is structurally robust, thermally safe, and certifiable. Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will collaborate with Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, Test, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, Thermal Systems, Aircraft Structures, Certification, Safety, and Quality teams to define analysis methods, apply the material property allowable required for your analyses, and substantiate the qualification of the propulsion battery pack and PDU. You will be the structural and thermomechanical analysis authority for the propulsion battery system, responsible for checking and releasing design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION’s mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation. Your Day-to-Day: Lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical FEA of propulsion battery packs, PDUs, and their internal components, predicting how they behave under nominal operation and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions, and flight and inertial loads. Perform room-temperature and elevated-temperature analysis of composites (including sandwich structures), metals, adhesives, and mechanical fasteners, capturing temperature-dependent material behaviour. Build and correlate nonlinear models covering material, geometric, and contact nonlinearity – including cohesive-zone and VCCT delamination, composite progressive failure and damage propagation, metal plasticity and rate-dependent behaviour, crushable foam plasticity and densification, large-deformation and post-buckling response, and frictional contact with bolt pretension, including bearing behaviour at fastener holes (bearing yield, hole elongation, and bearing–bypass interaction). Model the hyper-elastic and viscoelastic behaviour of potting compounds, gap fillers, foams, gaskets, seals, and thermal interface materials to predict contact pressure and interface integrity across the life of the pack. Perform durability and life analysis across the differing service lives of components within the system, covering vibration-induced high-cycle fatigue (DO-160 random and sine sweep), low-cycle fatigue from ground–air–ground and charge/discharge thermal cycling, and fatigue of bonded joints, fasteners, busbars, and interconnects. Assess creep and stress relaxation of seals, adhesives, polymers, potting compounds, and thermal interface materials at elevated temperature, including loss of contact pressure across a pack replacement interval. Analyse thermal runaway response as a coupled thermomechanical event – pressure loads, direct impingement flow, ejecta, and heat transfer to surrounding structure and systems – working closely with the Thermal Systems team on thermal runaway CFD modelling and the resulting heat transfer boundary conditions, in support of containment and continued safe flight and landing. Apply static, fatigue, and creep material property allowable (room and elevated temperature) in the substantiation of the propulsion battery pack and PDU, working to established methodologies such as CMH-17 for composites and MMPDS for metallics, and specify the allowable, material data, and test conditions required from the Materials & Processes and Test teams. Automate and script analysis workflows – model generation, parametric studies, load case sweeps, and post-processing – using Python for Abaqus scripting, and develop closed-form and lower-order analysis methods in Python or MATLAB to size hardware quickly and to verify finite element results. Interface closely with the Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, and Airborne Electronics teams to translate analysis results into design improvements and robust, certifiable hardware. Check and release design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements, providing the stress sign-off for propulsion battery pack and PDU hardware releases. Define modelling standards, assumptions, load cases, and acceptance criteria, and maintain configuration-controlled analysis models and inputs. Support test planning and post-test correlation of FEA models against coupon, component, and full-scale test data. Author and release certification documentation, including analysis reports and means-of-compliance evidence for structural, environmental, and thermal runaway requirements. Your Profile: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural/Computational Mechanics, or a related field; a PhD in a relevant area is beneficial. 5+ years of experience in structural/stress and thermomechanical FEA, preferably in aerospace, automotive, battery systems, or other high-performance engineering environments. Experience taking analytical responsibility for hardware, including checking the work of others and providing stress sign-off or equivalent release approval within a configuration-controlled environment, is desirable. title: Kalite ve Boyutsal Ölçüm Mühendisi
description: Çalışma Yeri: Manisa Savunma sanayiinde faaliyet gösteren, sektörünün öncülerinden biri olan müşterimiz için, yüksek hassasiyet gerektiren mekanik parça ve montajların teknik resimlere, geometrik toleranslandırma standartlarına ve kalite gerekliliklerine uygunluğunu değerlendirecek; GD&T konusunda iyi düzey bilgiye ve CMM (Coordinate Measuring Machine) ölçüm tezgâhı kullanım deneyimine sahip Kalite ve Boyutsal Ölçüm Mühendisi arıyoruz. Görev ve Sorumluluklar Mekanik parça ve montajların teknik resimlere, geometrik toleranslandırma gerekliliklerine ve ilgili kalite standartlarına uygunluğunu değerlendirmek. GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) kapsamında geometrik toleransları, datum referans sistemlerini, tolerans bölgelerini ve ölçüm stratejilerini ileri düzeyde yorumlamak. CMM ölçüm tezgâhlarını kullanarak hassas boyutsal ölçümler gerçekleştirmek ve ölçüm programlarını hazırlamak, düzenlemek ve optimize etmek. CMM ölçüm yazılımları üzerinden ölçüm planları oluşturmak, ölçüm sonuçlarını analiz etmek ve raporlamak. Konum, profil, düzlemsellik, paralellik, diklik, eşmerkezlilik/koaksiyellik ve diğer geometrik tolerans gerekliliklerinin uygun yöntemlerle doğrulanmasını sağlamak. Ölçüm sonuçlarını teknik resimler ve tolerans kriterleriyle karşılaştırarak uygunluk değerlendirmesi yapmak. Üretim ve kalite kontrol süreçlerinde tespit edilen ölçüsel uygunsuzlukları analiz etmek; kök neden analizi ve düzeltici/önleyici faaliyet çalışmalarına katkı sağlamak. İlk ürün doğrulama (FAI), boyutsal kontrol, proses doğrulama ve ürün kabul faaliyetlerini yürütmek veya desteklemek. Ölçüm raporları, kontrol planları, teknik değerlendirmeler ve kalite kayıtlarını hazırlamak. Ölçüm belirsizliği, tekrarlanabilirlik, izlenebilirlik ve ölçüm ekipmanlarının kalibrasyonu konularında gerekli kontrolleri sağlamak. Tasarım, üretim, kalite güvence ve tedarikçi kalite ekipleriyle koordineli çalışmak. Savunma sanayii projelerine ait teknik dokümantasyon, kalite gereklilikleri ve konfigürasyon yönetimi süreçlerine uygun hareket etmek. Aranan Nitelikler Makine Mühendisliği, Mekatronik Mühendisliği, İmalat Mühendisliği veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun olmak. Tercihen Savunma, havacılık veya otomotiv sektörlerinde Kalite mühendisliği, metroloji, boyutsal ölçüm veya hassas imalat alanlarında en az 7 yıl mesleki deneyime sahip olmak. GD&T konusunda iyi düzeyde bilgi ve uygulama tecrübesine sahip olmak. Teknik resim okuma, geometrik toleranslandırma ve datum referans sistemlerini yorumlama konusunda yetkin olmak. CMM ölçüm tezgâhlarını bağımsız kullanabilmek ve tercihen ölçüm programlama deneyimine sahip olmak. CMM ölçüm yazılımlarından en az birinde uygulamalı deneyim sahibi olmak; örneğin PC-DMIS, CALYPSO, MCOSMOS veya benzeri yazılımlar. Hassas mekanik parçaların ve karmaşık geometrilere sahip komponentlerin boyutsal kontrolünü gerçekleştirebilmek. Ölçüm sonuçlarını teknik açıdan değerlendirebilmek, uygunsuzlukları analiz edebilmek ve teknik rapor hazırlayabilmek. Tercihen ASME Y14.5 ve/veya ISO GPS geometrik toleranslandırma standartları konusunda uygulamalı bilgi sahibi olmak. Tercihen AS9100 kalite yönetim sistemi ve ISO 9001 gerekliliklerine aşina olmak. Problem çözme, analitik düşünme ve kök neden analizi konularında yetkin olmak. Teknik dokümantasyon ve kalite kayıtlarının hazırlanması konusunda titiz ve sistematik çalışmak. title: Fabrication Design & Estimating Specialist
description: About Us: US Bullnosing Inc. is a custom porcelain paver, tile and stone fabricator based in Oakland Park, Florida, serving residential and commercial projects across South Florida and beyond. Our work includes bullnose edge finishing, mitered and waterfall edges, pool coping, step wraps and anti-slip stair treads, drain and skimmer cutouts, cut-to-size and rectification, waterjet cutting, and custom mosaics and medallions. Position Overview: This is a remote position supporting our Oakland Park fabrication facility. Working from customer drawings, site measurements and photos, the Specialist designs and details the shop drawings, mosaics, waterjet cut files and assembly tray layouts our production team cuts from, and prepares accurate, timely estimates and quotes. Key Responsibilities Design & Drafting Create and revise 2D/3D AutoCAD drawings for coping, step wraps, stair treads, mitered/waterfall edges and cutouts. Convert plans, field measurements, digital templating files (DXF) and sketches into dimensioned shop drawings. Lay out coping for radius and freeform pools: segment curves, set joint spacing and miter angles, number each piece. Model mitered and waterfall assemblies in 3D to verify fit, angles and visible faces before fabrication. Prepare clear approval drawings for customers and track revisions through final sign-off. Share the design workload with our in-house designer to keep drawing turnaround short. Mosaic & Medallion Design Develop custom mosaics, medallions, borders and logos from customer concepts, photos and artwork. Convert images and artwork into clean, correctly scaled vector geometry ready for waterjet cutting. Produce color/material maps and mockups so customers can see and approve the design before cutting. Break designs into numbered pieces with grout-joint allowances and create assembly tray layouts for the shop. Estimating & Quoting Review drawings, job requests and customer specifications and prepare accurate quotes for custom fabrication work. Perform takeoffs of linear and square footage, piece counts, cutouts and edge details, plus machine time and labor. Price from the company’s master price list and customer classification; flag non-standard work for review. Work with operations and sales to finalize scope and pricing, and keep a log of quotes, revisions and approvals. Cut Files & Production Support Prepare production-ready waterjet cut files with clean geometry, efficient nesting and toolpaths/G-code as needed. Design for manufacturability: allow for kerf, minimum piece size and inside radii so parts cut cleanly. Label every file clearly (job, material, thickness, edge detail, quantity) so the shop can cut without follow-up. Confirm files with the Plant Manager and operators before cutting, and revise them the same day when issues arise. Maintain an organized digital library of standard profiles, patterns, parts and project templates. Qualifications Required Qualifications: 2+ years in fabrication design, waterjet/CNC programming or estimating, preferably in porcelain or stone. Strong proficiency in AutoCAD (2D required; 3D a plus) and comfort exchanging DXF/DWG files. Understanding of how porcelain, ceramic and stone behave when cut, including kerf, inside radii and thickness. Ability to read architectural and pool plans and prepare takeoffs and quotes from drawings or digital files. Able to work independently and meet deadlines remotely, with clear communication and strong attention to detail. Work samples or a portfolio of shop drawings, mosaic or medallion designs, or cut files. Ability to work Eastern Time (ET) business hours, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM ET. Fluent in English. Degree in Engineering or a related field. Preferred Experience: Experience designing pool coping, step work, mosaics or medallions, with a good eye for pattern and color. Vector design software (Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW or similar) for converting artwork into cut-ready files. Familiarity with waterjet nesting/CAM software (e.g., FlowPath, IGEMS or equivalent). Experience with QuickBooks or a similar quoting, work order or project tracking system. Spanish language proficiency. What We Offer At US Bullnosing, we offer: Dollar-based competitive salary and performance-based growth A supportive, team-oriented work culture focused on excellence and efficiency Remote working opportunity Equal Opportunity Provider US Bullnosing is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We welcome all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status, and celebrate the unique contributions of every individual on our team.

title: Entegrasyon Teknisyeni
description: Entegrasyon Teknisyeni Havacılık alanında faaliyet gösteren firmamızın yürütmekte olduğu projelerde görev alacak Entegrasyon Teknisyeni arıyoruz. Bu pozisyonda; İHA platformlarımızın mekanik, elektrik/elektronik ve aviyonik sistemlerinin entegrasyon, montaj, test ve doğrulama süreçlerinde görev alarak, sistemlerin teknik dokümanlar ve kalite standartları doğrultusunda eksiksiz şekilde platform üzerine entegrasyonuna katkı sağlayacaksınız. Rol DetaylarıİHA platformlarının mekanik, elektrik/elektronik ve aviyonik sistemlerinin entegrasyon ve montaj faaliyetlerini gerçekleştirmek. Motor, servo, aktüatör, sensör, anten, uçuş kontrol sistemi ve diğer alt sistemlerin platform üzerindeki montaj ve entegrasyon süreçlerinde görev almak. Kablo demetleri, konnektörler ve elektronik birimlerin platform üzerindeki bağlantı ve entegrasyonlarını gerçekleştirmek. Teknik resim, montaj dokümanı, bağlantı şeması ve iş talimatlarına uygun şekilde çalışmak. Entegrasyon sonrasında alt sistem ve platform seviyesinde fonksiyonel kontrolleri ve testleri gerçekleştirmek. Multimetre ve benzeri ölçüm/test ekipmanlarını kullanarak elektriksel kontroller gerçekleştirmek. Entegrasyon ve test süreçlerinde tespit edilen mekanik veya elektriksel uygunsuzlukların belirlenmesi ve giderilmesine yönelik çalışmalara destek olmak. Gerektiğinde sökme-takma, yeniden işleme (rework), bakım ve düzeltici faaliyetleri gerçekleştirmek. Entegrasyon ve test süreçlerine ait iş emirleri, kontrol formları ve teknik kayıtları eksiksiz şekilde oluşturmak ve takip etmek. Üretim, kablaj, mekanik tasarım, kalite ve saha operasyon ekipleriyle koordineli çalışmak. Havacılık ve savunma sanayii kalite standartları ile iş sağlığı ve güvenliği kurallarına uygun şekilde çalışmak. Entegrasyon süreçlerinin iyileştirilmesi, hata oranlarının azaltılması ve üretim kalitesinin artırılmasına yönelik çalışmalara katkıda bulunmak. Gerektiğinde yurt içi ve yurt dışı saha faaliyetlerinde sistem kurulumu, bakım-onarım, arıza giderme ve teknik destek çalışmalarına katılmak. Aranan Nitelikler Meslek Liseleri, Meslek Yüksekokulları veya ilgili teknik eğitim programlarının Uçak Teknolojisi, Elektrik, Elektronik, Elektrik-Elektronik, Mekatronik, Makine, Otomotiv veya benzeri bölümlerinden mezun. Mekanik ve/veya elektrik-elektronik montaj ve entegrasyon süreçlerinde deneyimli veya bu alanda çalışmaya istekli. Tercihen havacılık ve savunma sanayiinde İHA, hava aracı, aviyonik sistem veya benzeri platformların üretim ve entegrasyon süreçlerinde görev almış. Mekanik montaj, elektronik sistem entegrasyonu ve kablolama süreçleri hakkında temel bilgi sahibi. Teknik resim, elektrik bağlantı şeması ve teknik dokümanları okuyabilen, anlayabilen ve uygulayabilen. El aletleri, tork anahtarı ve temel montaj ekipmanlarını etkin şekilde kullanabilen. Tercihen multimetre ve benzeri elektriksel ölçüm/test cihazlarını kullanabilen. Temel arıza tespiti ve problem çözme becerisine sahip. Montaj ve entegrasyon işlemlerinde dikkatli, ölçülü ve sistematik çalışabilen. İş emirleri, kontrol formları ve teknik kayıtların tutulması konusunda dikkatli ve sorumluluk sahibi. El becerisi yüksek, detaylara önem veren ve iş disiplinine sahip. İş sağlığı ve güvenliği kurallarına uygun çalışmaya özen gösteren. Öğrenmeye açık, sorumluluk sahibi ve süreç takip yeteneği güçlü. Disiplinler arası ve takım çalışmasına yatkın. Yurt içi ve yurt dışı saha görevlerine engeli bulunmayan. Erkek adaylar için tercihen askerlik görevini tamamlamış.

title: Senior Mechanical Plant Design Engineer
description: The opportunity As a Senior Mechanical Plant Design Engineer within Plant mechanical, you will work in a collaborative engineering environment where problem‑solving, learning, and sound technical judgement are key. Within Plant Engineering , this role covers several disciplines, including electrical, mechanical, civil, and structural engineering, with a primary focus on mechanical design. Knowledge of other engineering areas is an advantage. The position offers the opportunity to contribute to HVDC station design through engineering design, planning, risk assessments, resource coordination, and technical project execution. You will be supported by a strong multidisciplinary team and encouraged to take responsibility while continuously developing your technical and professional skills. “In this position, you’ll work with complex and interesting challenges, collaborate closely across disciplines, and contribute to solutions that make a real impact. You are never alone — teamwork and knowledge sharing are fundamental to how we succeed.” — Lars‑Ove Mellberg, Mechanical Plant Design Manager This role is based in Ludvika or Västerås, Sweden. How You’ll Make An Impact Lead mechanical plant design activities for complex HVDC projects, ensuring high-quality multidisciplinary engineering coordination. Develop robust and cost-effective technical solutions in line with customer requirements, contracts, budgets, and schedules. Drive engineering deliverables within your area of expertise and provide technical support during testing, installation, and commissioning. Ensure compliance with safety standards, quality requirements, and risk mitigation practices throughout the project lifecycle. Prepare work plans, cost estimates, and engineering schedules, and support scope and budget reviews. Collaborate closely with project teams, tender teams, customers, contractors, authorities, and supply chain partners. Independently manage technical activities, solve complex engineering challenges, and support project execution with limited supervision. Mentor and review the work of junior engineers while contributing to technical development and best practices within the team. Your background We know that no candidate meets every requirement. If you are motivated by this role and meet many of the criteria below, we strongly encourage you to apply. Ideally, You Bring Experience in mechanical plant design, including preparation of documents and design concepts aligned with customer needs, relevant standards, and internal guidelines. Knowledge of electrical power transformation systems is beneficial but not mandatory. Experience or interest in 3D modeling of equipment layouts and close collaboration with internal teams and external partners. Experience and/or knowledge in BIM coordination between external and internal partners. Familiarity with cost estimates like bill of quantities and engineering hours. Experience with CAD tools such as Siemens NX, Revit, and PLM systems like Teamcenter is beneficial, and we support further learning and development where needed. Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken, and a willingness to collaborate across cultures and disciplines. More About Us We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. title: Mechanical Design Engineer (Rotating Electric Machines)
description: Please read the 'how to apply' instruction below before applying. About Cooled Motors Cooled Motors is developing next-generation electric drive systems for high-performance automotive and aerospace applications. We are building advanced propulsion technologies that combine innovations in electric-machine, power electronics, control systems and thermal management to deliver compact, efficient and scalable electric drives for the future of mobility. Our work sits at the intersection of electric vehicles, aerospace propulsion, advanced manufacturing and clean technology. We are tackling some of the most important challenges in electrification: improving performance, reducing system cost, increasing power density and enabling more sustainable supply chains. The role We are looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to support the development of our electric motor drive technologies. The role will focus on mechanical design, CAD modelling, engineering drawings, supplier communication, and supporting the development of prototype and production-intent components. You will work closely with the technical team to turn concepts into manufacturable designs, prepare clear engineering documentation, and support supplier engagement for prototype and manufacturing activities. Key responsibilities You will: · Develop mechanical designs for electric motor components, assemblies, and test hardware. · Create detailed 3D CAD models and complex mechanical assemblies. · Produce engineering drawings in accordance with BS 8888 and good drawing practice. · Apply GD&T principles to define tolerances, fits, interfaces, and critical features. · Support design for manufacture, assembly, and inspection. · Communicate with suppliers to request quotes, review manufacturability, clarify drawings, and support component delivery. · Review supplier feedback and update designs or drawings where required. · Support prototype build, testing, and design iteration. · Work with the engineering team to solve mechanical, thermal, structural, and packaging challenges. · Maintain design documentation, BOMs, and revision-controlled engineering files. Essential requirements You should have: · A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related discipline. · Relevant mechanical design industrial experience. · Strong experience creating engineering drawings to BS 8888. · Good understanding of GD&T, tolerancing, fits, and manufacturing constraints. · Experience with complex CAD design and mechanical assemblies. · Experience using SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or similar CAD software. · Ability to communicate clearly with suppliers and manufacturing partners. · Good understanding of mechanical materials, manufacturing processes, and design for manufacture. · Strong attention to detail and ability to produce accurate engineering documentation. Desirable Experience · Experience in the automotive, aerospace, electric motor, powertrain, or advanced manufacturing sectors. · Structural FEA experience, preferably using ANSYS, Altair, or similar tools. · Thermal CFD experience, preferably using ANSYS, Altair, or similar tools. · Experience with rotating machinery, electric motors, cooling systems, or high-performance mechanical assemblies. · Experience supporting prototype builds, testing, and design validation. · Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related subject. · Experience working in a startup, R&D, or fast-paced engineering environment. What we are looking for The ideal candidate is a practical mechanical engineer who can take a design from concept through to detailed CAD, drawings, supplier discussions, and prototype manufacture. You should be comfortable working with complex designs, solving engineering problems, and producing clear documentation that suppliers can manufacture from. It is preferred to have good electric motor experience, you should be interested in advanced engineering, future mobility, and high-performance mechanical systems. Why join Cooled Motors? Opportunity to work on next-generation electric drive technology. Hands-on role with real influence over product design and development. Exposure to automotive, aerospace, and advanced propulsion applications. A fast-moving engineering environment with significant responsibility from day one. The opportunity to work directly with founders and senior technical leadership. Location Cooled motors has multiple small offices and access to co-working spaces in the following locations Sheffield, Coventry, Oxford and London. We operate a hybrid working model and site work when essential. How to Apply Please use the following link to apply: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/e/yThFsRXaSe DO NOT APPLY THROUGH LINKEDIN If you apply through LinkedIn you will be rejected automatically.

title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer

description: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer – Aerospace & Defence- Bristol- £50,000-£70,000 Design the Systems That Make the Mission Possible Are you a Senior Mechanical Engineer looking for more ownership, more variety and the opportunity to work on technology that actually gets into the air? Join an innovative aerospace and defence engineering team developing tactical uncrewed aircraft, avionics and mission systems. You’ll own mechanical design for critical avionics and payload installations, taking hardware from early concept through qualification and into production. The programmes move quickly. Designs can go from CAD to flying hardware in months, giving you rapid feedback and the opportunity to see the direct impact of your engineering decisions. A Role Beyond Traditional Mechanical Design This is a broad engineering role where mechanical, thermal and electrical considerations come together. You’ll be responsible for: Designing avionics and payload installations, airframe components and mechanisms in SolidWorks. Owning models, drawings and design packs through the product lifecycle. Designing thermal management solutions for high-power electronics, including heatsinks, ducting, fans and interface materials. Designing installations with harness routing, connector access, grounding and serviceability in mind. Developing sealing and environmental protection for maritime and extreme climate operations. Supporting qualification testing across vibration, shock, temperature, altitude, humidity and salt exposure. Managing mechanical interfaces with electrical, systems and aerodynamics teams. Working with suppliers and manufacturing on machining, additive manufacturing and composites. Supporting design reviews and producing analysis and test documentation. Providing guidance and technical support to engineers earlier in their careers. What You’ll Bring Degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering. Around 4–8 years' mechanical design experience, ideally within aerospace, defence or another demanding engineering environment. Experience taking hardware through environmental qualification and testing. Experience with low-to-medium volume manufacturing, including machining, additive manufacturing and/or composites. Ability to use structural or thermal FEA/CFD for initial analysis. Strong SolidWorks and engineering drawing experience; GD&T knowledge is beneficial. An interest in working across mechanical, thermal and electrical interfaces rather than being limited to a single discipline. A practical approach to engineering, with the ability to hand-calculate and sanity-check designs before turning to simulation. The confidence to make decisions and deliver under changing priorities and tight timescales. Why This Role? This is an opportunity to work on innovative technology at the pace of a growing aerospace and defence programme. You’ll get: Genuine design ownership from concept through to flight and production. The chance to work on tactical uncrewed aircraft and advanced mission systems. Exposure to challenging problems in thermal management, environmental protection, vibration and integration. A broad engineering remit rather than a narrowly defined mechanical role. The opportunity to see your designs built, tested and flown within months. Collaboration with engineering teams across the UK and Portugal. Opportunities to develop your technical expertise and support the development of other engineers. Competitive salary + discretionary annual bonus. Pension contribution of up to 10%. 25 days holiday + Bank Holidays. Private Medical Insurance and wellbeing support. Flexible hybrid working from Bristol. Opportunities for national and international travel. For further information and to apply please contact Victoria at Copello on 07341347640 and email Victoria@copello.co.uk

Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and external stakeholders to resolve technical challenges, support production activities, and ensure successful project delivery. title: Structural Engineer - Pipeline
description: The Pipeline Engineering Department is part of the Allseas organisation and prepares and provides support for the offshore pipelay campaigns. The work extends from the proposal phase to offshore execution and pre-commissioning of pipelines. Within the Pipeline Engineering department there are multiple disciplines and each discipline contribute with the brightest minds to meet the project goals working as one team. The Pipeline Structural unit is part of the Pipeline Engineering department and is responsible for designing the structures needed in a pipelay project. The team's expertise lies in two primary categories of structures: permanent structures (such as PLET, ILS, and manifolds) that are integral to the pipeline, and installation aids (including heads and rollerguides) required for the pipeline's installation. Your role Structural engineers design and analyse structures for functional loads specifically in offshore environments. You assess the integrity of structures and ensure it meets safety, performance and regulatory standards. As Structural Engineer You Are Responsible For Analyse and prepare project specifications for construction of subsea pipeline projects structural components, review fabrication drawing, liaise with and supervise fabrication subcontractors and equipment suppliers; Develop equipment for subsea field development projects or installation vessels; Prepare designs, design calculations (and reports) for all structural design work within scope, budget and schedule; Identify the risks and consequences of the vessel or equipment related to the strength/stability/safety/class approval etc.; Perform analytical calculations and structural simulation using FEM analysis; Prepare plans and procedures for the installation and inspection of equipment and discuss these procedures with the project team and the offshore personnel responsible for the execution; Liaise with project teams, subcontractors, crew, clients and certification authorities’; Opportunity to stay on board our vessels as a Field Engineer and provide installation support. What we expect from you BSc or MSc degree in Mechanical, Aerospace (preferably) or Civil Engineering; 1 to 5 years of relevant experience; Strong analytical skills and technical insight; Good command of the English language, both written and spoken; Willingness to work offshore occasionally, depending on the nature of your project; Fresh graduates are welcome to apply to this vacancy . What we Offer Working at Allseas allows you the chance to work in a dynamic, fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, with creative thinking, collaboration and down-to-earth culture at its core. You can expect Competitive industry benchmarked salary and excellent pension; Performance based salary raises and bonuses; 30 holidays days per year, flexible working hours; Extensive training and development programme, study budgets and coaching; A company-sponsored fitness scheme; Internal clubs, committees, parties and (sportive) events. Please note that an assessment and/or pre-employment screening may be part of the recruitment process, depending on the role.

title: Senior CAE Engineer
description: Lead Rotor System CAE Engineer Location: Frome, Somerset Salary: £55,000 - £65,000 depending on experience Working pattern: 9-day fortnight, averaging 37.5 hours per week About the Opportunity Certo is looking for an experienced Lead Rotor System CAE Engineer to take technical ownership of the mechanical performance and development of a key rotor head assembly within its rotor system design team. This is a hands-on engineering R&D role combining advanced structural Computer-Aided Engineering (CAE), mechanical design, aerodynamic analysis, physical testing and technical leadership. Working within a small, established design office, you will play a key role in developing next-generation rotor systems , taking complex mechanical assemblies from concept through detailed design, simulation, physical validation and certification support. You will lead engineering analysis and validation activities, establish and improve CAE methods, mentor other engineers and work closely with manufacturing teams, suppliers and test engineers to deliver safe, reliable and high-performance aerospace systems. Key Responsibilities Take full technical ownership of the rotor head system, leading its development from initial concept through detailed design, analysis, testing and certification support. Develop and manage the Design Verification Plan (DVP), covering simulation, test mules, test rigs, prototypes and production release. Apply first-principles calculations and mathematical modelling to determine initial loads, degrees of freedom, system layouts and component sizing. Develop aircraft and system load cases, requirements and acceptance criteria, ensuring requirements flow down to individual components. Apply a V-model systems development approach, connecting project definition and engineering development with physical validation. Perform detailed structural analysis of complex mechanical systems using industry-standard aerospace FEA solvers. Carry out linear and nonlinear stress analysis, aeroelastic loading, structural dynamics, frequency response analysis, fatigue and life calculations. Support multidisciplinary CAE activities, including multibody dynamics, aerodynamic loading (CFD), optimisation and advanced analysis methods. Develop internal CAE processes, modelling guidelines, solver templates, material models and technical documentation standards. Identify opportunities to improve engineering tools, analytical methods and design processes. Plan and support physical development testing, including defining test requirements, designing bespoke test rigs and fixtures, and selecting instrumentation. Correlate simulation predictions with physical test results, investigate discrepancies and conduct root cause analysis. Provide technical leadership to a small team of engineers, offering direction, mentoring and support for professional development. Lead formal design reviews and technical risk assessments throughout the product development lifecycle. Manage multiple engineering activities against demanding programme schedules. Collaborate with manufacturing teams, suppliers and external partners to ensure designs are practical, producible and robust. Required Skills and Experience Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. Significant experience in aerospace, rotorcraft or complex mechanical systems design. Proven experience in the analysis and development of rotor head control assemblies. Extensive experience in advanced structural CAE techniques using aerospace-accredited FEA solvers, including coupled mechanical and aerodynamic behaviour. Strong analytical skills, with extensive experience in detailed engineering calculations and first-principles problem-solving. The Ideal Candidate We are looking for an engineer who combines rigorous analytical thinking with practical engineering judgement. You should be comfortable taking ownership of complex technical challenges, questioning conventional approaches and developing innovative solutions. You will also be a collaborative technical leader who enjoys mentoring others, improving engineering capability and delivering high-quality results across multiple programmes. Benefits 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays. Private healthcare. Holiday purchase/buyback scheme. Essential Requirements British citizenship or a valid British passport. Ability to work on-site in Frome, Somerset. A valid UK driving licence. Willingness to travel occasionally within the UK and internationally. Why Join Certo? This is an opportunity to take technical ownership of a critical aerospace assembly and influence the development of next-generation rotor systems. You will have the opportunity to combine advanced simulation, hands-on engineering validation and technical leadership within a collaborative design environment, helping shape the methods, designs and engineering capabilities behind future aircraft programmes. If you have the structural CAE expertise, rotor system knowledge and technical leadership experience to take ownership of complex aerospace engineering challenges, we would welcome your application.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Modern working environment. title: Ingénieur(e) Produit et Process
description: Une journée type En tant qu’Ingénieur produit et process, vous jouerez un rôle clé au cœur de l’innovation de nos produits et de l’amélioration continue de nos process de fabrication, dans la réalisation du cœur de métier de LANDAUER : la fabrication et la lecture de nos 1,5 millions de dosimètres annuels au sein de notre laboratoire accrédité de dosimétrie passive. Sur son site de Vélizy, pôle d’excellence de la dosimétrie passive au sein de LANDAUER, leader mondial de la dosimétrie passive, vous aurez en charge les projets d’amélioration, de conception, et de lancement en production de nouveaux produits, localement ou bien à une échelle plus globale. Nos dosimètres, assemblage de diverses pièces en plastique encapsulant nos détecteurs, sont assemblés de manière automatisée ou semi-automatisée sur des machines spéciales intégrant diverses technologies : soudure ultrason, découpe et marquage LASER, vision, robotique, etc. Vous aurez à développer de nouveaux produits, de nouvelles matières, de nouveaux procédés de fabrication, afin de répondre aux exigences du marché, guidé par la Direction Marketing, et épaulé par les docteurs en physique de la Direction Scientifique. De culture scientifique, vous trouvez un réel intérêt dans la physique et la métrologie. Vous aimez dialoguer aussi bien avec des chercheurs qu'avec des experts terrain ; qu'il s'agisse de nos physiciens en interne ou des spécialistes de nos fournisseurs (fabricants de machines spéciales, plasturgistes, usineurs, tôliers…) pour identifier ensemble la solution la plus pertinente à un problème donné. Chez LANDAUER, les défis ne manquent pas : comprendre l'interaction entre photons et matière, élaborer la formulation d'un matériau plastique, optimiser son spectre d'absorption pour trouver le juste équilibre entre performances métrologiques et ergonomie du produit. Ce sont précisément ces problèmes à la croisée de la physique des rayonnements, de la physique des matériaux, et de l'ingénierie qui vous stimulent et vous donnent envie de vous dépasser. Vous êtes également à l'aise avec la donnée sous toutes ses formes : LANDAUER génère un volume important de données de fabrication et de mesure, et vous saurez les localiser (bases de données relationnelles), les extraire (SQL), les structurer (Excel) et les analyser (statistiques, modélisation de flux, SPC…) pour en tirer des enseignements concrets et améliorer en continu nos produits et services. Responsabilités Ce Poste Comporte Deux Composantes Qui Permettront De Laisser S’exprimer Votre Créativité Et Votre Rigueur D’ingénieur Produits : création ou amélioration. Vous aurez en charge la conception de la solution, en intégrant sa fabricabilité, et de la méthode de production. Vous interviendrez sur toutes les phases : dessin, prototypage, définition et réalisation des essais, qualification de fournisseur, formations internes, etc. Le développement de produits à une échelle internationale se fera avec le Directeur de l’Ingénierie. Mise en place des procédés de fabrication : cette partie regroupe process (techniques de fabrication, d’assemblage, de traitement ou lecture des dosimètres, lancement en production de nouveaux produits) et méthode (organisation de l’atelier pour une meilleur gestion des flux, 5S, instruction de fabrication, en collaboration avec le Responsable de Production). Vous aurez la charge de plusieurs chantiers d’amélioration, et mènerez avec le Directeur de l’Ingénierie les chantiers d’ampleur : remplacement ou rétrofit lourd de machine spéciale. Vous serez l’interface technique avec l’intégrateur sélectionné. Vous assurerez le suivi de tous ces projets et le maintien dans les objectifs de coût, qualité et délai. Sans être un expert de tous les domaines afférents à nos produits et procédés (plasturgie, robotique, automatisme, etc.), vous saurez développer votre expertise de nos produits et leur mise en œuvre. Votre équipe Vous intégrerez la Direction des Opérations et reporterez au Directeur de l'Ingénierie, au sein d'une équipe soudée : un ingénieur généraliste, deux ingénieurs maintenance et un technicien de maintenance. Ensemble, vous évoluerez sur notre site de Vélizy, où 63 collaborateurs aux profils variés (opérateurs, techniciens, ingénieurs, docteurs en physique) partagent une culture commune : collaboration, dynamisme et exigence au service de clients des secteurs médical et nucléaire. Expérience requise Ingénieur généraliste ou issu d'une spécialité technique, vous avez su construire au fil de vos expériences une vraie polyvalence. title: Senior innovation engineer - Metallurgist H/F/X 1
description: Senior Innovation Engineer – Metallurgist Constellium is a world leader in the development and manufacture of high value-added aluminum products and solutions for a wide range of markets and applications, focusing in particular on aerospace, automotive and packaging. Constellium currently has approximately 12,000 employees worldwide. We are committed to minimizing the environmental impact of our operations and improving the environmental footprint of aluminum throughout the value chain. In our company, safety is essential, it is one of our core values. Our Research and Technology Center, C-TEC Constellium Technology Center, employs about 250 people. Our research is mainly in the field of casting, aluminum transformation and surface treatment. By joining our company, you will discover a multicultural company which is committed to diversity and the well-being of its employees. In this context, we are looking for a Senior Innovation Engineer able to identify, develop and validate innovative metallurgical solutions in an industrially relevant environment (up to TRL 5). Their priority targets will be developing breakthrough aluminium products and/or increasing substantially the recycling content of Constellium’s products. To this end, the jobholder will be expected to contribute to the ideation, project definition, and proof of concept stages of our R&T projects. The position will involve working in a multi-disciplinary and multi-cultural Research & Technology project team. It will also involve direct connection with Constellium’s Business Units. Your main responsibilities: Your mission will include the following aspects: Technical: Contribute to the identification of opportunities for new projects, in particular through discussions with a broad range of materials specialists inside and outside Constellium, participation in conferences or trade fairs, ideation sessions, patent searches. Transition these opportunities into viable projects by clarifying technical objectives, contributing to the preliminary business case, and developing targeted action plans. Drive these projects through the proof of concept stage. Share the knowledge thus developed through clear and high-quality reporting. Support patent filing when possible and relevant. EHS and security Contribute to C-TEC’s zero accident policy by leading by example and taking all the appropriate actions to ensure work is performed in total safety (full compliance to all EHS rules, LSTs, incident / near miss reporting etc…); Contribute to Constellium’s environmental objectives, in particular via the reduction in GHG emission through increasing the recycled content of our products. Your Profile: For this position a Masters-level degree and/or a PhD in Materials Science with a focus on metals-related technologies is necessary, Practical and theoretical knowledge of metal processing technologies, preferably developed on aluminium-based alloys. Knowledge of recycling technologies and/or recyclability of materials. Strong digital skills (data analytics, R or Python programming etc.) and knowledge of environmental assessment methodologies and regulations would be a plus. You will have at least 5 years’ post-education experience developing metal processing technologies. You have demonstrated your ability to work in a multicultural environment, for example through a period of training or professional experience acquired outside your native country. You have the ability to explain complex concepts in simple terms. You are open-minded and innovative and you have demonstrated interest in working across the traditional boundaries of scientific or technical disciplines. You are result and speed oriented. You demonstrated in previous experience your determination and perseverance to drive novel products/ processes. You are capable of working in a team, have a can-do attitude and demonstrate excellent communications skills. Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory. Fluency in French (written and spoken) is desirable. Fluency in German language would be a plus. Specificities: By its very nature, early-stage breakthrough R&D requires the ability to assess multiple solutions rapidly in order to select the most promising. It will also generally involve wider opportunities and more varied challenges but lower success rates than more incremental projects. Occasional national and international travel expected.

title: Wissenschaftliche Mitarbeit (Promotionsstelle) "Wandlungsfähige Produktionssysteme für die automatisierte Fertigung von CFK-Luftfahrtstrukturen"
description: Die Leibniz Universität Hannover bietet exzellente Arbeitsbedingungen in einem lebendigen wissenschaftlichen Umfeld, eingebettet in die hervorragenden Lebensbedingungen einer modernen Großstadt im Grünen. Mit rund 90 wissenschaftlichen Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern gehört das Institut für Fertigungstechnik und Werkzeugmaschinen (IFW) weltweit zu den führenden universitären Forschungseinrichtungen in der Produktionstechnik. Forschung auf höchstem internationalen Niveau, ein attraktives nationales und internationales Netzwerk zur Förderung deiner Karriere, Gründungsunterstützung, Arbeit im Team und in einer offenen sowie interdisziplinären Atmosphäre erwarten dich! Projekte aus den Querschnittsthemen Digitalisierung, künstliche Intelligenz, Nachhaltigkeit und Energieeffizienz sowie Möglichkeiten zum Ausbauen von Führungserfahrung, Übernahme von Projektverantwortung und Aufgaben in der Lehre bieten ein spannendes Aufgabengebiet auf dem Weg zur Promotion. Einer der weltweit modernsten Maschinenparks, eine umfangreich ausgestattete Analytik und exzellente weitere Infrastruktur steht dir für deine Aufgaben zur Verfügung! In der Forschungsabteilung „Faserverbundtechnologien“ sind in unserer Stader Außenstelle am CFK Nord ab sofort zwei Stellen zu besetzen: Wissenschaftliche Mitarbeit (Promotionsstelle) zum Thema "Wandlungsfähige Produktionssysteme für die automatisierte Fertigung von CFK-Luftfahrtstrukturen“ (EntgGr. 13 TV-L, 100 %) Die Stellen sind zunächst auf drei Jahre befristet. Eine Verlängerung bis zur Promotion ist vorgesehen. Im Luftfahrtforschungsprojekt „SCyZero“ entwickeln wir innovative Technologien für die automatisierte und ressourceneffiziente Fertigung zukünftiger CFK-Luftfahrtstrukturen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen ein wandlungsfähiges Automated-Fiber-Placement-System (AFP) für die wirtschaftliche Verarbeitung von TowPregs sowie intelligente Methoden zur KI-basierten Prozessüberwachung und Qualitätssicherung. Die entwickelten Technologien werden an realen Luftfahrtstrukturen erprobt und leisten einen Beitrag zur wirtschaftlichen Kleinserienfertigung zukünftiger elektrischer Leichtbauflugzeuge. Im Rahmen des Projekts besetzen wir zwei Promotionsstellen mit unterschiedlichen fachlichen Schwerpunkten. Je nach fachlichem Interesse und Qualifikation liegt der Schwerpunkt deiner Arbeit in einem der folgenden Bereiche: Schwerpunkt 1: Intelligente und wandlungsfähige Produktionssysteme Du entwickelst neue Ansätze für flexible und rekonfigurierbare AFP-Produktionssysteme. Dabei verbindest du die Entwicklung modularer Legetechnologien mit Robotik, dezentraler Steuerung und digitalen Simulationsmethoden. Ein besonderer Fokus liegt auf intelligenten Methoden, mit denen Produktionssysteme abhängig von Bauteilgeometrie und Fertigungsaufgabe automatisiert konfiguriert und an neue Anforderungen angepasst werden können. Schwerpunkt 2: KI-basierte Prozessüberwachung und digitale Qualitätssicherung Du entwickelst intelligente Methoden, mit denen die Qualität bei der automatisierten Fertigung von CFK-Strukturen bereits während des Prozesses erfasst und bewertet werden kann. Hierfür kombinierst du visuelle und IR-basierte Sensorik mit Methoden des Machine Learning zur automatisierten Erkennung und Klassifikation von Fertigungsfehlern. Ergänzend erforschst du Ansätze aus Augmented Reality und Motion Tracking, um erkannte Fehler direkt am Bauteil zu lokalisieren, zu visualisieren und eine effiziente Fehlerkorrektur zu ermöglichen. Deine Stelle im Überblick · Eigenverantwortliche Bearbeitung des Forschungsprojekts · Bearbeitung von Entwicklungsprojekten mit renommierten Industrie- und Forschungspartnern · Erarbeiten neuer Forschungsideen und Veröffentlichung von Forschungsergebnissen · Betreuung von Studierenden · Möglichkeit zur Übernahme von Aufgaben in der Lehre · Möglichkeit zum Erarbeiten einer Dissertation Wen suchen wir? Voraussetzung für die Einstellung ist ein abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium in einem technisch oder naturwissenschaftlich ausgerichteten Studiengang (Uni/TH/FH). Darüber hinaus erwarten wir folgende Qualifikationen: · Teamfähigkeit und Selbständigkeit werden vorausgesetzt · überdurchschnittliche Studienleistungen · sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich Weiterhin sind erwünscht: · Kenntnisse in der Programmierung (Python, Matlab) · Kenntnisse im Bereich Leichtbauproduktion und Automatisierung (Schwerpunkt 1) · Kenntnisse in Messtechnik und Messdatenanalyse, u. a. KI-gestützte Methoden (Schwerpunkt 2) · Erfahrungen in der Programmierung und Anwendung von Industrierobotern (bspw. Kuka) sind von Vorteil · Erfahrungen im Bereich Faserverbundwerkstoffe/CFK sind von Vorteil Die Leibniz Universität Hannover setzt sich für Chancengleichheit und Diversität ein. Ziel ist es, das Potenzial aller zu nutzen und Chancen zu eröffnen. Wir begrüßen daher Bewerbungen von allen Interessierten unabhängig von deren Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter, sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Wir streben eine gleichmäßige Verteilung der Beschäftigten und einen Abbau der Unterrepräsentanz im Sinne des Niedersächsischen Gleichberechtigungsgesetz (NGG) an. Daher freuen wir uns, wenn sich auch Frauen auf die o. g. Stelle bewerben. Menschen mit einer Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Qualifikation bevorzugt. Was bieten wir? · Möglichkeiten des mobilen Arbeitens inkl. Dienstnotebook · Einen modernen Arbeitsplatz und digitale Arbeitsstrukturen · Unterstützende Strukturen zum Verfassen der Dissertation · Kooperative Zusammenarbeit im Team und eine konstruktive Feedback-Kultur · Ein umfangreiches Weiterbildungsangebot der Leibniz Universität Hannover · Die Möglichkeit zur Teilnahme an nationalen und internationalen Konferenzen · Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement und vielfältiges Hochschulsportprogramm · Eine Jahressonderzahlung und zusätzliche Altersvorsorge (bei Vorliegen der Voraussetzungen) ·

title: Mechanical Integration and Test Engineer
description: About HyLight Power lines, gas pipelines and railways are still inspected the way they were 50 years ago: by helicopter. Expensive, noisy, and up to a tonne of CO₂ per flight hour. We built the alternative. The HyLighter is a 12-metre autonomous airship running on hydrogen. It flies for up to 10 hours, almost silently, and spots a 1 mm defect from 25 metres up. It’s not a prototype. HyLighters already fly missions for France’s largest energy and rail operators and have flown over the Palace of Versailles. Backed by Y Combinator, we just raised €13M to go from 4 airships to 15. Working at HyLight We design, build and fly every HyLighter ourselves, under one roof on a former airbase. Which means: You own it all the way. At a big company, you’d own a small piece of one subsystem. Here, you design it, test it, stand on the airfield when it flies, and see the client act on the data it brings back. Weeks, not years. Ideas go from whiteboard to flight test in weeks. Responsibility from day one. Job Summary: As a Mechanical Integration and Test Engineer , you will be the technical owner of the drone’s mechanical lifecycle. You will bridge the gap between "engineering perfection" and operational reality, ensuring our drones are robust, easy to assemble, and available for mission-critical inspections. The Mission: In collaboration with the Mech Team, your responsibilities will focus on Reliability, Industrialization, and Continuous Improvement: Creative Design: Lead the conceptual design of new mechanical subsystems and airframe evolutions. You will transform innovative ideas/prototypes into functional products through rapid iteration (CAD, 3D printing, machining), balancing sleek aesthetics, design for manufacturing with high-performance engineering. Reliability & Lifecycle Management: Establish fatigue models and design accelerated life tests (HALT/HASS) to predict component "End of Life" and maximize fleet availability. You will robustify the drone design to ensure reliable operation in challenging conditions. Root Cause Excellence: Implement a systematic Root Cause Analysis process for every field failure, ensuring rapid design updates and maintaining a strong feedback loop between engineering and operations. Profile Sought: Background: Mechanical Engineering degree or equivalent practical experience. 3+ years experience in designing resistant outdoor/rugged mechanical systems (material fatigue, vibration). Experience in test planning (DoE), designing test equipment (fixtures, set-ups), actual testing, analyzing results, and writing reports as well as new test specifications. Versatility: You accept dual roles, comfortable alternating between deep design work (New Versions) and operational urgency (Production Support). Mindset: You possess a "Shop Floor" mindset, you enjoy spending time in workshops and do not consider work finished until the physical product is validated, not just the CAD file sent. Technical Skills: Core Mechanics: solid CAD & DFM expertise (Design for Assembly, reduced part count), Material Mechanics (S-N curves/Wöhler, UV aging, creep, stress cycles). Reliability Data: Comfortable with statistical methods for reliability and data-driven approaches (Python). Manufacturing: Comfortable with processes such as 3D printing, welding, machining, or sheet metal work. Analysis Methods: Mastery of problem-solving methods like 5 Whys, Ishikawa to trace field failures to root causes. Soft Skills: Highly organized and detail-oriented in documentation and execution Entrepreneurship: Willingness to find shortcuts and ways to do things efficiently. You enjoy getting your hands dirty and respect the insights of the technical team. Willingness to be present on-site and support operational teams during test and flight activities Curious, analytical, eager to learn, and proactive in problem-solving Good communication skills and collaborative mindset Languages: French AND English: Fluent (Required) What We Offer: 100% reimbursement of public transport pass (Navigo) or €800/year for sustainable commuting Bike provided for commuting Free lunch Bi-annual offsite trips with the whole team Excellent work environment: international team , team events, beautiful offices on a former airbase Why You Should Join: Founder Mentality: We value extreme ownership and want people who think like founders—fast decision makers, natural problem solvers, and executers. Ground Floor Opportunity: You’ll be helping to shape and grow a revolutionary company with the resources to back it. Impact & Speed: Work in a fast-paced environment where your contributions will have immediate, tangible effects on the company’s success.

A good command of English is important, as you will work in an international environment. Fluency in Italian, both written and spoken, is required. We also expect people to take ownership of their assignments, communicate risks early and follow commitments through to completion.
