title: Mechanisms Engineer - Solar Arrays
description: About the role In space, there are no second chances. As Mechanisms Engineer – Solar Arrays (f/m/d) , you will be responsible for the deployment systems at the heart of dcubed's solar arrays. You will design, prototype, test, and qualify the hardware that allows spacecraft to generate power once they reach orbit. We are looking for an engineer with a builder's mindset: someone who can move seamlessly from CAD models and FEM analyses to the workshop and test lab, turning ambitious ideas into reliable flight hardware. If you are motivated by ownership, speed, and the challenge of making space mechanisms work where repair is impossible, you'll fit right in. Responsibilities Mechanism Design & Development: Design, analyze, and develop space-qualified deployment mechanisms and motion systems for Solar Array products, from concept through flight hardware delivery. Technical Expertise: Provide expert guidance on mechanism design, materials selection, lubrication, coatings, thermal effects, motorization margins, tolerancing, and reliability for space applications. Manufacturing & Prototyping: Apply Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles, generate production-ready technical drawings, and support rapid prototyping and manufacturing activities using additive manufacturing and conventional machining techniques. System Integration: Ensure seamless integration of mechanisms with structural, electrical, and deployment subsystems while balancing performance, manufacturability, cost, and schedule requirements. Testing & Qualification: Define, support, and execute development, qualification, and acceptance test campaigns, including deployment, vibration, thermal vacuum, shock, and lifetime testing. Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement: Investigate anomalies, perform root-cause analysis, and implement design improvements to enhance mechanism performance, reliability, and manufacturability. Documentation: Maintain engineering documentation including CAD models, technical drawings, specifications, analyses, test procedures, and qualification reports. Candidate requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline. 5+ years of experience in mechanism design, aerospace engineering, precision mechanical systems, or related fields. Strong knowledge of space mechanisms, including bearings, gears, springs, hinges, release systems, lubrication, coatings, wear mechanisms, thermal effects, and motorization sizing and margins. Expert-level CAD proficiency (SolidWorks preferred) and familiarity with FEM tools (ANSYS preferred). Strong understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, GD&T, tolerancing, and technical drawing generation. Experience applying Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles. Hands-on experience with prototyping and fabrication methods including 3D printing, milling, turning, laser cutting, CNC machining, and hardware assembly. Familiarity with space qualification methods and standards, including vibration, shock, thermal vacuum, deployment, and lifetime testing. Knowledge of ECSS, NASA, or equivalent aerospace standards is highly desirable. Fluent English skills. Eligibility to work in Germany. What we offer We want you to feel welcome and have the best possible tools for your work here at Dcubed. Therefore, we have selected a set of benefits to support your work days and everyday life, today and longer term. Commute: Deutschlandticket Wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass, recovery toolkit ETF-based pension program offering 30-50% company contribution Modern work equipment, based on your role and needs: laptop, phone, headphones, electric desk, wide screens, state-of-the-art workshop equipment Office environment: kitchen and break areas; lunch offering, beverages & snacks at the office; small exercise area, Space Bar Work-life balance & activities: hybrid work arrangements (location and working hours), company events and trips, launch parties Professional development: 70-20-10 thinking, training budget, training library, regular performance reviews Company swag: hoodie, t-shirt, stickers, water bottle, notebook etc. This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. and/or Germany export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant's capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. and/or Germany export controls. We specialize in bio‑based materials science and the surface chemistry of lignocellulosic materials, with emphasis on fundamental insights and interaction forces. Gestión de Documentación Técnica: Generar y mantener la documentación técnica relacionada con los análisis estructurales, informes y certificaciones necesarias. Control de Calidad: Asegurar que las estructuras cumplan con los estándares de calidad establecidos y que los procesos de fabricación estén alineados con los requisitos estructurales. Gestión de Proyectos: Participar en la planificación y coordinación de proyectos relacionados con el diseño y análisis estructural de los trackers fotovoltaicos. title: Production Engineer
description: Life tastes better with ice cream With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry. We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference. What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work. We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done. We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better. The role TMICC is the place where you can bring your purpose to life with the work that you do – creating a better business and a better world. If you are willing to manage production processes effectively and contribute to the achievement of business objectives. This role is just for you. What You'll Be Responsible For Overall Purpose: To effectively manage production processes and contribute to the achievement of business objectives. Duties And Responsibilities Occupational Health and Safety and Quality: Ensure compliance with occupational health and safety and Quality standards. Manage employees' access to and implementation of safe working conditions. Management Of Production Processes Monitor production processes and propose improvement suggestions to increase efficiency. Oversee processes to ensure compliance with quality standards and manage quality controls. Personnel Management Organize, direct, and motivate the production team. Evaluate staff performance and identify development opportunities. Maintenance Of Machinery And Equipment Plan and coordinate regular maintenance of production equipment. Provide quick intervention and solutions in case of breakdowns. Cost Control Conduct cost analyses to increase efficiency in production processes and propose cost-saving measures. Ensure compliance with budget targets. Communication And Collaboration Facilitate effective communication between the production department and other departments. Regularly report and share information with upper management. Performance Analysis Analyze the performance of production processes and identify improvement opportunities. Evaluate department achievements based on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). We're Looking For Someone Who Fluent in English Good communication skills. Ability of analytical thinking. Engineering with a strong understanding of manufacturing processes, safety, productivity and quality assurance. Ability of handling several projects simultaneously and meeting tight deadlines. Working effectively with different departments. Proficiency in MS Office applications Problem solving skills. Living (or willing to live) in Konya. Skills Manufacturing Vision and Plan Manufacturing Technology Manufacturing Performance Negotiation Project Management Stakeholder Management What You'll Get Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes Market-competitive pay and performance related rewards Flexible ways of working Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work Time off to rest and recharge Ongoing learning and development opportunities Why join us? This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could! You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward. Roles with real accountability and visible impact Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done Continuous learning and development as the business grows Reward linked to performance and contribution. Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business. Ready to build the future of Ice Cream? If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps. If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know. Additional Information The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Endüstriyel Soğutma Satış Mühendisi
description: Good climate starts with people™ Biz kimiz? Daikin Industries, 1924 yılında Osaka, Japonya'da kuruldu. Küresel grup, dünya çapında 104.000'in üzerinde kişiyi istihdam etmektedir. Isı pompası ve klima sistemlerinin yanı sıra hava filtrasyonu konusunda da pazar lideridir. Dünyada ısıtma, havalandırma, klima ve soğutma ekipmanlarının yanı sıra kendi soğutucularını şirket içinde geliştiren ve üreten tek üreticidir. Daikin Türkiye Türkiye'de 1978'den beri distribütörler aracılığıyla faaliyet gösteren Daikin, Temmuz 2011'de Airfel'i satın alarak Türk iklimlendirme sektöründe iddialı bir yatırımcı oldu. Daikin Türkiye bugün Airfel ve Daikin markalarıyla ısıtma, soğutma ve havalandırma alanında Türkiye'de en geniş ürün yelpazesine sahip şirkettir. Merkez ofisimiz İstanbul'da bulunmaktadır. Kombi kazanları, klima üniteleri, fancoil, VRV ve son teknolojiye sahip klima santralleri gibi farklı ihtiyaçlara uygun ürünler üretmektedir. İstanbul Maltepe'de bulunan Genel Müdürlük ofisimizde, Endüstriyel Sistemler Satış Departmanında " Satış Mühendisi " pozisyonunda görevlendirilecek ekip arkadaşımızı arıyoruz 📢 Nasıl bir ekip arkadaşı? Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, Endüstriyel Soğutma sektöründe en az 3 yıl deneyimli, Tercihen CO2/NH3 ve Elektronik kontrol bilgisine sahip, Proje yönetim süreçlerine hakim, İyi seviyede İngilizce bilgisine sahip, Aktif araç kullanabilen ve seyahat engeli bulunmayan. Yeni ekip arkadaşımızdan neler bekliyoruz? Soğuk zincirin tüm halkalarındaki (Süpermarket Firmaları, Soğuk Oda Yatırımcıları, Ho-Re-Ca, Gıda Üreticileri, Soğuk Zincir Lojistik firmaları) müşterilere; endüstriyel soğutma ürün portföyümüzdeki Daikin, AHT, Zanotti, Tewis, Hubbard ürünlerin tanıtım ve satışını gerçekleştirmek. Müşterilere uygun ürünleri belirleyip, gerektiğinde proje desteği vermek. Teklif süreçlerini yönetmek, bütçe süreçlerinde yer almak. Bayi, müşteri ve tedarikçi ziyaretlerini gerçekleştirmek. **İşbu işe alım ilanımız ile ilgili kişisel verilerinizin korunmasına yönelik olarak şirketimize ait politikamız, aydınlatma metinlerimiz ve başvuru formumuza https://www.daikin.com.tr/daikin-kisisel-verilerin-korunmasi adresi üzerinden ulaşabilir veya tüm merak ettiğiniz sorularınız için bizimle https://www.daikin.com.tr/daikin-kisisel-verilerin-korunmasi adresindeki iletişim formumuz aracılığıyla iletişime geçebilirsiniz. title: Online Service Engineer/Technician (Çevrimiçi Servis Mühendisi/Teknisyeni)
description: Company Description Bodor Laser is a professional manufacturer and exporter dedicated to the design, R&D, and production of fiber laser machines that are widely used for cutting different metal materials. All of our products comply with international quality standards (CE, SGS, ISO9001, etc.) and are greatly appreciated by customers around the world. With 20 service languages, a knowledgeable sales and after-sales team, 24/7 service, worldwide market network covering more than 150 countries, we reach out to customers all over the world and look forward to all potential partnerships. Keeping in mind its responsibilities for the well-being of its staff and society, Bodor is determined to gain world recognition with intelligently Made-in-China and change human life with laser technology. In addition, The company has maintained a high growth rate since its establishment in 2008. Now Bodor has a 51000 m2 production base, 10000+ delivery capability, and 2000+ global employees. Bodor's global Network covers 180 countries with 10 global branches and 4 technical centers. Ultra-high power capability World premier of 25000w, 30000w, 40000w and world unique 22000w laser cutting machine. Sales record (Until Sept, 2021) Choice of 700 companies worldwide on 10kW+ laser cutting machines, in 37 different countries and regions. No. 1 World No. 1 in 10kW+ laser cutting machine sales volume. R&D Capability Strong R&D team led by the drafter of international Standards for CNC laser cutting machines Over 200 R&D Technicians, the R&D level is in line with international standards 10 subdivision platforms, including plate cutting, pipe cutting, application engineering, etc. 2 Core R&D Centers in China and 4 overseas Technology Centers More than 200 patent certificates, 5 international awards, 22 industry awards with 200+ R&D Teams, 200+ Patents, and 10 R&D Platforms. Job Description This position for supporting customers with BODOR. Responsible for offering technical advice to the customers and after-sales service in the field. Responsibilities Serve as the primary remote technical point of contact for customers, providing online support for laser machines through phone, email, chat, and remote diagnostic tools, with on-site visits when required. Assist customers and field personnel in troubleshooting mechanical, electrical, and software-related issues of laser machines, and take appropriate corrective actions to ensure timely resolution. Monitor, track, and manage incoming technical service requests, ensuring proper documentation, prioritization, and follow-up of all cases. Manage and coordinate service schedules within the assigned territory to ensure optimal machine performance and customer utilization. Perform remote diagnosis and guide customers or field teams through mechanical repairs, determining when special tools, parts, or escalation to on-site intervention is required. Interpret layout drawings, electrical schematics, and mechanical blueprints to support installation, troubleshooting, and maintenance activities. Maintain and update spare parts lists, ensuring availability by coordinating with customers, internal teams, vendors, and manufacturers. Identify and report machine safety issues and ensure compliance with operational safety standards. Provide technical training to customers remotely or on-site to improve machine operation and reduce downtime. Prepare and submit detailed service reports, failure analysis reports, and expense reports in a timely manner. Perform failure mode analysis and provide recommendations for machine upgrades, performance improvements, and preventive maintenance. Support final integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting of complex automation systems when required. Support logistics and technical coordination for equipment movement, including loading/unloading supervision when needed on-site. Perform regular travel within assigned territories when remote resolution is insufficient. Approximately 25% travel may be required depending on customer needs. Other duties as assigned. Qualifications Associate degree in mechatronic, automation engineering, mechanical/electrical engineering or equivalent with 2 years’ experience on automated CNC machines. Recent experience of installing, repairing and diagnosing problems of automated CNC machines. Able to read and interpret electrical and mechanical drawings and test equipment. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Demonstrated technical writing skills Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and remote communications. Proficient at working independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. Self-driven and responsible. Ability to work under pressure. Ability to travel as required (local and domestic). Valid Driver’s License. Strong leadership skills. Highly organized. Meticulous attention to details. English or Chinese + Turkish languages can be used as working languages. Local residence permit or working authorization in the local country are required. Additional Information Applicants from neighboring cities can also be considered.

title: Kıdemli İş Geliştirme Mühendisi ( Yenilenebilir Enerji)
description: Biz Kimiz? Enerjisa ile Geleceğin Yolunda! Enerjisa olarak, daha iyi bir gelecek için enerji dönüşümüne öncülük etmek ve yön vermek için çalışıyoruz. Türkiye'nin çevik ve yenilikçi enerji şirketi olarak, yarının ihtiyaç duyduğu altyapı ve hizmetleri kurarak sürdürülebilir enerji dönüşümünü hızlandırmaya kararlıyız. Temel değerlerimiz olan samimiyet, tutku, cesaret, sürekli gelişim ve kapsayıcılıktan güç alıyoruz. Çeşitliliğin gücüne ve ekibimize kattığı güce inanıyoruz. Enerjisa'da her adayın adil ve önyargısız bir şekilde değerlendirilmesini sağlıyoruz. Tüm süreçlerimizde fırsat eşitliğine dayalı bir yaklaşım benimsiyor, çeşitlilik ve kapsayıcılığı odağımıza koyuyoruz. Çalışanlarımıza, müşterilerimize ve diğer paydaşlarımıza dil, din, milliyet, ırk, etnik köken, yaş, cinsiyet, cinsel yönelim, medeni durum, sağlık, engellilik durumu, siyasi görüş, sendika üyeliği veya benzeri nedenlere dayanarak ayrımcılık yapılmasına müsaade etmiyoruz. Sen de enerjimize ortak olmaya ne dersin? Neler Yapıyoruz? Enerjisa Enerji olarak ‘Herkes için daha iyi bir gelecek’ vizyonu ve sürdürülebilirlik odağıyla Türkiye’nin enerji dönüşümüne öncülük ediyor, ana iş kollarımız olan elektrik dağıtım, perakende satış ve müşteri çözümleri ile E-mobilite alanlarında Türkiye’nin dörtte birine kesintisiz hizmet sunuyoruz. Sektörün en büyük oyuncusu olarak 14 ilde 10.7 milyon müşteriye ulaşarak 22 milyonu aşkın kullanıcıya elektrik dağıtım hizmeti sağlıyoruz. Aynı zamanda İşimin Enerjisi markasıyla müşterilerimize yenilenebilir enerji, verimlilik ve yeşil enerji çözümleri sunarken; %100 Enerjisa iştiraki olan elektrikli şarj operatörü şirketi Eşarj ile Türkiye’nin ilk ve en hızlı şarj istasyonu ağını işletiyoruz. İnsan, teknoloji ve müşteri odaklı yaklaşımımız doğrultusunda verimlilik ve teknoloji odaklı iş modellerimizle insan hayatına dokunan sürdürülebilir çözümler üretiyoruz. Faaliyetlerimizi sürdürürken bir yandan da toplumsal sorumluluklar da üstleniyor, daha iyi bir gelecek hayali ile sosyal etkisi yüksek projeleri hayata geçiriyoruz. title: Sales Engineer
description: UNTHA Türkiye | Industrial Shredding Technology Location: Istanbul (Asian Side) – Ataşehir Employment Type: Full-Time Position Level: Specialist – Technical Sales UNTHA Türkiye is looking for an experienced and technically skilled Sales Engineer to join our growing organization within an international group specializing in industrial shredding technology. We are seeking a motivated professional with technical sales experience who can independently manage customer relationships, develop new business opportunities, and coordinate sales projects in close cooperation with our Austrian headquarters. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Manage technical sales activities for UNTHA industrial shredding machines in the Turkish market. Develop existing customer relationships, acquire new customers, and identify new business opportunities. Analyze customer requirements and recommend suitable machinery and technical application solutions. Conduct customer visits, technical presentations, and project discussions throughout Türkiye. Prepare and follow up on technical and commercial quotations and conduct sales negotiations. Manage sales projects from initial customer contact through to order placement, coordinating with relevant internal teams. Work closely with the Demo Technician and technical teams to organize machine demonstrations and material testing. Coordinate with the Austrian headquarters, sales, and technical departments to develop suitable customer solutions. Monitor market developments, competitor activities, and potential business opportunities. Maintain accurate customer records, quotations, and sales opportunities in the CRM system and prepare regular sales reports. Represent UNTHA Türkiye at industry exhibitions, trade fairs, and customer events. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS University degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Preferably 2–3 years of experience in industrial machinery, plant engineering, or technical equipment sales. Knowledge of technical B2B sales, customer relationship management, and quotation preparation. Ability to understand technical drawings, machinery specifications, and customer application requirements. Strong communication, negotiation, and customer relationship management skills. Analytical mindset, results-oriented approach, and ability to work independently. Good command of English (mandatory) for direct communication with the Austrian headquarters. German language skills are an advantage. Willingness and ability to travel throughout Türkiye. Valid Category B driving licence and confidence in driving. Proficiency in MS Office and preferably experience with CRM systems. Structured, disciplined, responsible, and team-oriented working style. Preferred Experience: Recycling, waste management, industrial shredding machinery, machinery and plant engineering, or capital equipment sales. WHAT WE OFFER A long-term technical sales career with an international machinery manufacturer. The opportunity to work with high-quality and innovative industrial shredding technologies. Comprehensive training and development in products, applications, and sales techniques. Direct cooperation with the Austrian headquarters and international technical teams. Opportunities to work independently, take responsibility, and develop professionally. Long-term career growth and advancement opportunities. Modern working equipment, including a laptop and mobile phone. Flexible working arrangements and home office options. Supplementary private health insurance. A growing organization in Türkiye backed by strong international support. JOIN UNTHA TÜRKİYE! If you are passionate about technology, enjoy building customer relationships, and want to contribute to UNTHA's growth in the Turkish market, we look forward to receiving your application.

title: Maintenance Engineer
description: What You’ll Do The Maintenance Engineer will be responsible for all aspects of the Eaton Ankara sites' (Temelli and Sincan) maintenance and facilities activities. This includes daily general maintenance along with various project work. The position will be responsible for maintenance employees concerning job performance, attendance, discipline, and administrative actions while continuously improving safety, quality, delivery, and productivity. The individual will serve as a critical member of the Manufactoring team. The individual reports directly to the Maintenance leader Making what matters work at Eaton takes the passion of every employee around the world. We create an environment where creativity, invention, and discovery become reality, every day. It’s where bold, bright professionals like you can reach your full potential—and where you can help us reach ours. Lead maintenance and facilities activities for the Ankara Sincan sites, including daily operations and improvement projects. Ensure compliance with EHS policies, Life Saving Rules, LOTO, machine guarding and arc-flash requirements, supporting a Zero Incident Safety Culture. Direct, train and develop maintenance personnel; plan work, review performance, strengthen engagement and coordinate required resources. Develop, implement and audit preventive, productive and predictive maintenance programs, including IR, ultrasound, vibration and lubrication analysis. Improve equipment reliability and availability through PDCA, structured troubleshooting and close coordination with production planning and supervisors. Lead continuous improvement activities that enhance safety, quality, productivity, equipment performance and operational efficiency. Manage maintenance spending, contractor selection, service procurement and resource allocation in line with budget and cost-control targets. Develop spare-parts and asset lifecycle strategies covering stocking, repair, capital equipment, obsolete assets, records and disposals. Support OPEX and capital planning, manage energy tracking and cost-reduction systems, and coordinate stakeholders and contractors to complete commitments. Qualifications Bachelor’s or master degree from Mechanical Engineer, Electrical Engineer, Mechatronics Minimum 3 years of solid manufacturing background including maintenance background. Skills Experience in metal fabrication. SAP business system experience. Experience implementing and sustaining a TPM program. Relevant computer skills (Microsoft Office suite, compliance software). Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams. Ability to negotiate with all levels of management, both internally and externally. Excellent verbal, written, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate positive and constructive feedback to employees or co-workers. Ability to direct the training, motivation, and development of personnel. Experienced with working in a PM System. Fundamental understanding of Asset Reliability Principles. Ability to reach consensus to best support the employee, the business, and the customer. Strong understanding of budget control. Great problem-solving skills All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws. Proje verilerini analiz ederek yönetime karar alma süreçlerini destekleyecek aksiyon odaklı rapor ve öneriler sunulması. Müşteri taleplerinin üretim kapasitesi, kaynak planı ve mevcut proje yükü dikkate alınarak değerlendirilmesi; Master Plan'ın oluşturulması, güncelliğinin sağlanması ve etkin şekilde yönetilmesi. Proje performans göstergelerinin (KPI) takip edilmesi, sapmaların analiz edilmesi ve sürekli iyileştirme çalışmalarına katkı sağlanması. Neden sen? Küresel bir ilaç şirketi olma vizyonuyla çalışmalarını sürdüren Sanovel, ürünlerini 5 kıtada 50’den fazla ülkeye ulaştırmakta, geniş ihracat ağıyla uluslararası pazarlardaki gücünü her geçen gün artırmaktadır. Birçok tedavi alanında pazara ilk eşdeğer ürün sunan şirket olan Sanovel, geleceğe yönelik yatırımları, yenilikçi yaklaşımı, kalite ve insan odağıyla 40 yılı aşkın süredir toplum sağlığı için değer yaratmaktadır. Stratejik öncelikleri doğrultusunda çalışmalarını büyüme, globalleşme ve sürdürülebilirlik odağında sürdüren Sanovel, 2035 vizyonu kapsamında etki alanını iki katına çıkararak endüstrisine ve toplum sağlığına sunduğu katkıyı daha da artırmayı hedeflemektedir. Silivri Üretim Tesisi & Ar-Ge Merkezi’nde Silivri Üretim Tesisi & Ar-Ge Merkezi’nde Üretim Müdürlüğü bünyesinde “ Sefalosporin İmalat Uzmanı'' arıyoruz. Temel Sorumluluklar Üretim alanındaki tüm bölümlerde yer alan, üretilen ürünlerin üretim proseslerinin GMP kuralları gözetilerek yüksek kalite ve verimde gerçekleşmesi için gerekli personel, ekipman ve malzeme organizasyonunu yapmak, Sorumlu olduğu ekibin iş planlarını yapmak, başlangıç ve sürekli eğitimlerini sağlamak, Üretim Planı kapsamında maksimum verimde üretim planı hedeflerini gerçekleştirmek, Sorumluluğu altında olan üretim proseslerinin ürün bazında, üretim verimlilik, ekipman kapasite analizlerini yapmak, raporlamak. Beklenen Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Fizik, Biyoloji, İşletme Mühendisliği, Kimya Mühendisliği ya da Kimya bölümlerinden mezun olan, Tercihen ilaç sektöründe üretim proseslerinde (tablet baskı, granülasyon ve karışım vb) az 2 yıl deneyimi bulunan, Gelişim çevikliği yüksek, sonuç odaklı, değişime açık olan, Yeni ve farklı olan her şeye merak duyan, İş birliği yaklaşımıyla ilişki ve görev sorumluluklarını yöneten, Kişisel ve kariyer gelişiminin gerekliliklerini bilerek sürekli gelişme odağında olan, Orta derecede İngilizce bilen, Vardiyalı düzende çalışabilecek olan, Erkek adaylar için askerlik hizmetini tamamlamış ya da yakın zamanda askerlik görevini tamamlayabilen, Silivri, Çorlu, Çerkezköy, Büyükçekmece, Beylikdüzü, Avcılar’da ikamet eden ya da edebilecek olan. Biz, her birimizi eşsiz ve değerli kılan asıl şeyin; bakış açılarımız, hayatlarımız, özgeçmişlerimiz ve farklılıklarımız olduğuna inanırız. title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: På Capgemini Engineering, världsledande inom ingenjörstjänster, samlar vi ett globalt team av ingenjörer, forskare och arkitekter för att hjälpa världens mest innovativa företag att nå sin fulla potential. Från självkörande bilar till livräddande robotar, våra experter inom digital och mjukvaruteknik tänker utanför boxen när de levererar unika R&D- och engineering-tjänster inom alla branscher. Bli en del av oss för en karriär full av möjligheter. Där du kan göra skillnad och där ingen dag är den andra lik. Din roll Vi söker nu en mekanikingenjör eller mekanikkonstruktör till vårt Capgemini Engineering kontor i Malmö. I denna roll kommer du att arbeta med utveckling av avancerade produkter och tekniska system inom försvarsindustrin. Du blir en del av ett engagerat projektteam där du bidrar genom utvecklingskedjan, från koncept och detaljkonstruktion till verifiering, dokumentation och produktionsstöd. I den här rollen kommer du att ha en nyckeroll i: Mekanisk konstruktion och produktutveckling av komponenter, delsystem och kompletta installationer Framtagning av 3D-modeller, tillverkningsritningar och teknisk dokumentation Hantering av konstruktionsändringar, konfigurationsstyrning och kravuppfyllnad Produktionsstöd samt förbättrings- och vidareutvecklingsarbete Deltagande i designgranskningar och tekniska utredningar. Din profil Högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom maskinteknik, produktutveckling eller motsvarande. Minst 3 års erfarenhet av mekanikkonstruktion och produktutveckling samt flytande svenska och engelska. God vana av CAD-verktyg såsom Creo Parametric, Autodesk Inventor eller motsvarande. Erfarenhet av ritningsframtagning och teknisk dokumentation samt god förståelse för toleranser, material och tillverkningsmetoder. Erfarenhet av produktionsstöd, tekniska förbättringsarbeten och/eller försvarsindustrin. Erfarenhet av komplexa tekniska system, stora sammanställningar, konstruktion i aluminium/stål samt PDM/PLM-system som Autodesk Vault och IFS är meriterande. Note: Denna tjänst kräver svenskt medborgarskap samt är säkerhetsklassad, vilket innebär att säkerhetsprövning kommer ske enligt svensk lagstiftning. Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas Innovativ miljö: Hos oss får du chansen att jobba med den senaste tekniken och vara en del av ett dynamiskt team som älskar att skapa värde genom innovation. Karriärutveckling: Vi bryr oss om din framtid och erbjuder utvecklingsprogram och certifieringar i de senaste teknologierna, så att du kan växa och bli den bästa versionen av dig själv. Flexibelt arbete: Vi förstår att livet är mer än bara jobb. Därför erbjuder vi möjligheter till distansarbete och flexibla arbetstider för att du ska må bra och trivas. Teamkänsla: Vi är som en stor familj med en härlig teamkänsla. Genom att leva efter våra värdeord som mod, passion, laganda och entreprenörskap - skapar vi en arbetsmiljö där alla kan trivas. Ansökan Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov. Capgemini är en global partner för affärs- och verksamhetstransformation i en tid präglad av AI. Vi hjälper företag och organisationer att skapa en intelligent och hållbar framtid genom att kombinera AI, teknik och mänsklig expertis. Tillsammans hjälper vi verksamheter att utveckla sina arbetssätt, stärka innovationsförmågan och skapa tillväxt. Genom helhetslösningar som omfattar strategi, teknik, engineering och intelligent operations kombinerar vi djup branschkunskap med marknadsledande expertis inom AI, moln och data. Det gör det möjligt för våra kunder att omsätta ambitioner till mätbara affärsresultat i stor skala. Med stöd av ett starkt partnernätverk och nära 60 års erfarenhet är Capgemini en ansvarstagande global organisation präglad av mångfald, med över 410 000 medarbetare i fler än 50 länder. Koncernens omsättning uppgick till 22,5 miljarder euro under 2025. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

title: Mekanikkonstruktör – Produktutveckling
description: Därför är detta jobb för dig Du är en erfaren mekanikkonstruktör som trivs med att lösa komplexa tekniska utmaningar och vill vara med och utveckla framtidens produkter och tekniska lösningar. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med avancerad produktutveckling inom bland annat fordons-, försvars- och tillverkningsindustrin. Våra projekt varierar i både omfattning och teknisk inriktning, vilket ger dig möjlighet att använda din specialistkompetens, bredda din erfarenhet och utvecklas inom nya teknikområden. Vi värdesätter din förmåga att omsätta tekniska krav till funktionella och hållbara lösningar. Oavsett om din bakgrund finns inom mekaniska system, komponentutveckling eller olika typer av konstruktion är det din samlade kompetens och erfarenhet som är mest intressant för oss. Du kommer att tillhöra vårt affärsområde Hardware & Design, där vi kombinerar bred ingenjörskompetens med djup specialistkunskap. Här får du möjlighet att utvecklas tillsammans med erfarna kollegor och bidra till tekniskt avancerade utvecklingsprojekt i nära samarbete med våra kunder. Arbetsuppgifter Som mekanikkonstruktör hos oss är du delaktig i utvecklingen av tekniskt avancerade produkter och mekaniska lösningar, från tidiga koncept till färdig produkt. Du arbetar tillsammans med andra ingenjörer och tekniska specialister, där du bidrar med din konstruktionskompetens, kreativitet och förmåga att lösa tekniska utmaningar. Dina Arbetsuppgifter Kan Exempelvis Innefatta Konceptutveckling, konstruktion och vidareutveckling av mekaniska system och komponenter. 3D-modellering, detaljkonstruktion och framtagning av tekniska ritningar och konstruktionsunderlag. Konstruktion och utveckling med hänsyn till funktion, materialval, hållfasthet och tillverkningsbarhet. Teknisk problemlösning, konstruktionsgranskning och förbättring av befintliga produkter. Samarbete med andra teknikdiscipliner, produktion, leverantörer och kunder genom produktutvecklingsprocessen. Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som har ett genuint teknikintresse och flerårig erfarenhet av mekanikkonstruktion och produktutveckling. Du trivs med tekniska utmaningar, tar ansvar för ditt arbete och uppskattar att samarbeta med andra för att hitta de bästa lösningarna. Vi är framför allt intresserade av din samlade kompetens och vilka erfarenheter du kan bidra med. Du Behöver Inte Ha Erfarenhet Inom Samtliga Områden – Vi Värdesätter Olika Specialistkompetenser Och Perspektiv Inom Produktutveckling. Utöver Dina Personliga Egenskaper Behöver Du Ha Följande Ingenjörsexamen inom maskinkonstruktion eller produktutveckling Flerårig erfarenhet av mekanikkonstruktion och produktutveckling, gärna inom fordons-, försvars- eller tillverkningsindustrin God erfarenhet av 3D-CAD, exempelvis Creo, CATIA, SolidWorks eller motsvarande. God förståelse för konstruktionsprinciper, materialegenskaper och tillverkningsmetoder. Erfarenhet av att ta fram tekniska konstruktionsunderlag och arbeta utifrån tekniska krav God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift Meriterande Vi ser gärna att du har fördjupad erfarenhet inom något område av mekanikkonstruktion och produktutveckling, exempelvis: Konstruktion i olika material, såsom plast, plåt, metall eller komposit Utveckling av avancerade mekaniska system och komponenter Tillverkningsmetoder och produktionsanpassad konstruktion Hållfasthetsberäkningar, simulering eller FEM Toleranssättning, konstruktionsgranskning eller arbete i PDM/PLM-system En spännande resa med Knightec Group Knightec Group är idag en av Norra Europas ledande strategiska partners inom produkt- och digital tjänsteutveckling – hur häftigt är inte det? Genom att förena ingenjörskompetens, digital expertis och affärsförståelse hjälper vi våra kunder att omvandla ny teknik till verkliga lösningar som skapar värde. Vi arbetar i skärningspunkten mellan affärsstrategi och teknikutveckling och stöttar våra kunder genom hela resan – från de första idéerna till utveckling, implementering och vidare utveckling. På Knightec Group samlas människor med olika perspektiv, erfarenheter och specialistområden. Tillsammans skapar vi innovation som gör verklig skillnad – för företag, människor och samhället i stort. För våra medarbetare innebär det stora möjligheter att vara med och forma framtidens lösningar genom meningsfulla projekt i teknikens absoluta framkant. Här får du inte bara utvecklas och växa i din roll – du blir också en del av ett team där nyfikenhet, samarbete och modet att utmana driver oss framåt. Låter det som platsen för dig? Häng med på vår fortsatta resa! Praktisk information Detta är en tillsvidareanställning med en provanställning på sex månader, placerad på vårt kontor i Göteborg. Resor i tjänsten kan förekomma till våra kunder. Startdatum är så snart som möjligt eller enligt överenskommelse. Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, men senast 2025-11-15. Om du har några frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Maha Sifariny, Talent Acquisition Specialist. Observera att vi, på grund av GDPR, endast tar emot ansökningar via vår karriärsida. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Mekanikkonstruktör – nyfiken på nästa steg i karriären?
description: Är du en erfaren mekanikkonstruktör som trivs med tekniska utmaningar och produktutveckling? Då vill vi gärna komma i kontakt med dig! På Sigma Industry Innovation arbetar vi tillsammans med flera av regionens ledande industriföretag inom bland annat fordonsindustrin, energi, försvar och tillverkande industri. Vi söker löpande efter duktiga mekanikkonstruktörer som vill fortsätta utvecklas, arbeta med spännande teknik och vara med och skapa framtidens produkter. Det här är en generell intresseannons och inte kopplad till en specifik ledig tjänst. Vi vill gärna lära känna dig inför både nuvarande och framtida möjligheter hos oss. Vad kan du arbeta med hos oss? Som mekanikkonstruktör hos oss kan du få möjlighet att arbeta med varierande tekniska utmaningar, från tidig konceptutveckling till färdig produkt och produktion. Beroende på din bakgrund och dina intressen kan det exempelvis handla om: Mekanisk konstruktion och produktutveckling 3D-modellering och framtagning av tillverkningsunderlag Konstruktion av komponenter, mekaniska system och kompletta produkter Teknisk problemlösning och förbättring av befintliga konstruktioner Samarbete med produktion, inköp, kvalitet och andra teknikdiscipliner Vi arbetar med flera olika kunder och branscher, vilket ger möjlighet att hitta uppdrag som passar både din erfarenhet och dina ambitioner. Vem söker vi? Vi söker dig som har en teknisk utbildning inom exempelvis maskinteknik, produktutveckling eller motsvarande erfarenhet. Vi ser gärna att du har: Erfarenhet av mekanisk konstruktion eller produktutveckling, där du har hunnit bygga upp en god teknisk förståelse och självständighet i ditt arbete. Goda kunskaper inom något etablerat CAD-system, exempelvis Catia, Creo, SolidWorks eller Siemens NX. Erfarenhet av konstruktion för tillverkning och förståelse för material och produktionsmetoder. God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska. Du bor i Eskilstuna med omnejd, då vi värdesätter lokal närvaro och ett nära samarbete med både kunder och kollegor. Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och tycker om att samarbeta med andra. Du tar ansvar för ditt arbete och trivs med att utvecklas genom nya tekniska utmaningar. Varför Sigma Industry Innovation? Hos oss får du möjlighet att utvecklas i en miljö där teknik, människor och långsiktiga relationer står i centrum. Vi vill att du ska trivas, känna dig delaktig och ha möjlighet att påverka din egen utveckling. Tillsammans försöker vi hitta uppdrag där både din kompetens och dina personliga ambitioner kommer till sin rätt. Som konsult hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta nära några av regionens mest intressanta industriföretag, samtidigt som du har en trygg anställning och kollegor att utvecklas tillsammans med. Nyfiken? Vi tar gärna ett samtal! Du behöver inte vara aktivt arbetssökande för att höra av dig. Kanske trivs du bra där du är idag, men är nyfiken på vilka möjligheter som finns framöver? Då vill vi gärna prata med dig. Skicka in ditt CV eller dela din LinkedIn-profil, så tar vi kontakt för ett första förutsättningslöst samtal. Detta är en generell intresseannons. Vi rekryterar löpande utifrån våra kunders behov och ser fram emot att lära känna dig inför framtida möjligheter. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer

You will be involved throughout the entire development process, from concept generation and requirement setting to testing, validation, analysis, and documentation. Key Responsibilities: Develop and contribute to exhaust aftertreatment solutions, focusing on muffler design, verification, and system performance. Participate in the full development lifecycle, from concept generation and requirement setting to testing, validation, analysis, and documentation. Collaborate with component owners, engine test engineers, simulation engineers, project managers, and suppliers. Contribute to the design and development of components operating in demanding thermal and vibration environments. Use technical expertise to solve engineering challenges and support the development of robust and sustainable solutions. Build strong working relationships across different teams, technologies, and organizations. Share knowledge, collaborate with colleagues, and contribute to continuous learning and improvement. Maintain a broader systems perspective while developing expertise within your core technical area. Requirements: Experience in Exhaust Aftertreatment Systems (EATS) muffler development or UDS development. Strong technical knowledge within your area of expertise, combined with a willingness to learn and broaden your competence. Experience with CAD tools is beneficial. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and external suppliers. Strong communication and networking skills, with a willingness to share knowledge and learn from others. Curious, adaptable, and collaborative mindset, with an interest in solving complex engineering challenges. Ability to combine technical expertise with a broader systems perspective and contribute to continuous development. What We Offer: A dynamic and innovative workplace driving advancements in cutting-edge robotic technologies The opportunity to collaborate with talented cross-functional teams on meaningful and impactful projects Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package A supportive culture that fosters continuous learning, growth, and professional development Flexible hybrid working model for an optimal work-life balance 25 days of annual leave to recharge and relax An annual wellness allowance of 3,500 SEK to support your health and wellbeing

title: Senior Space Vehicle Mechanical and Structural Dynamics Engineer
description: At Axient Systems, we are shaping the future of sovereign space capability. Based in Delft, at the heart of the Dutch aerospace ecosystem, we develop advanced satellite systems that support critical commercial and government missions. Our solutions enable secure communications, defence, security, and resilient infrastructure where performance and reliability are essential. As a growing and ambitious organisation, we offer professionals the opportunity to contribute directly to innovative space projects that make a real impact on society, security, and technological progress. We are looking for a mechanical engineer who owns the dynamic behaviour of a space vehicle: the stiffness, the disturbances, and the stability that a high-performance imaging mission depends on. The project You will own the structural dynamics and micro-vibration side of a high-performance optical satellite, through design, analysis, qualification and test correlation. What you will own The structural dynamic behaviour of the vehicle: modal analysis, coupled-loads with the launch provider, and the stiffness the payload needs. The micro-vibration and jitter budget: sources, transfer paths and effects, against the line-of-sight stability requirement set by image quality. The structural input to the STOP chain (structural-thermal-optical performance), which is run by our optomechanical engineer: the models and the deformation behaviour behind it. The analysis models behind all of this: build them, run them per design cycle, and correlate them against test. Test predictions and the mechanical qualification approach, with our AI&T and qualification engineers. The mechanical case at the design reviews, including the margins and what they rest on. You lead this discipline rather than execute a fixed scope: the depth of each topic follows the design as it matures. You have the following demonstrable competencies You think in load paths, modes and transfer functions, and you know when a hand calculation beats a model. You are precise about margins and about the assumptions they hide. You can work with a launch provider, a structure supplier and a payload supplier at the same time and keep one consistent picture. You keep your models under configuration control and can explain what changed between two design cycles. You communicate results to non-specialists without losing the caveats. Essential qualifications Eligible for a Dutch VGB-B clearance. Engineering degree in mechanical or aerospace engineering. 5+ years in structural analysis of space or comparable high-reliability systems, with demonstrable ownership of a model and its results. Finite element analysis craftsmanship (Nastran, Abaqus, Ansys or comparable), including modal and coupled-loads analysis. Fluent English. Comfortable in a multidisciplinary, transatlantic team. Desirable qualifications Micro-vibration and jitter analysis on a pointing-critical mission. STOP analysis experience. Experience with launch vehicle coupled-loads cycles. Test correlation of structural models. Fracture control and ECSS structural standards. Fluent Dutch. What we offer A discipline lead role on a vehicle where the mechanical behaviour decides whether the mission performs. Competitive, market-aligned salary and benefits, real ownership of your discipline, and room to grow as the organisation scales. On-site work in Delft, limited hybrid working possible. Particularities This role requires Dutch security screening. You will need a VOG (Certificate of Conduct) to start, which is quick to obtain and lets you begin work on the project immediately. You might also need a VGB-B clearance. This takes longer, and we support you through it. It is required for some aspects of the role, so you must be eligible for it and willing to undergo the screening, but you do not need to have it in hand to join us. Interested? Apply via the vacancy on LinkedIn or the registration form on our website. In your application, include a short description of one structural or micro-vibration analysis you owned: the model, the margin, and what the test told you afterwards. title: Senior Optomechanical Engineer | STOP Analyst
description: At Axient Systems, we are shaping the future of sovereign space capability. Based in Delft, at the heart of the Dutch aerospace ecosystem, we develop advanced satellite systems that support critical commercial and government missions. Our solutions enable secure communications, defence, security, and resilient infrastructure where performance and reliability are essential. As a growing and ambitious organisation, we offer professionals the opportunity to contribute directly to innovative space projects that make a real impact on society, security, and technological progress. We are looking for an optomechanical engineer who owns what heat and structure do to optical performance: the coupled structural-thermal-optical chain of a high-performance imaging satellite. The project You will own the STOP chain of an optical satellite: how thermal loads in orbit deform the structure and the optical bench, and what that does to focus, alignment and line-of-sight. From concept through detailed design, qualification testing and correlation What you will own The system-level optical performance analysis. The STOP analysis chain end to end: thermal fields into structural deformation into optical performance, per orbit position and season, and its maintenance through every design cycle. The alignment budget of the vehicle: optical bench, payload, star trackers and their stability over temperature and over time. Dimensional stability: material choice on CTE, creep and moisture release, mounting and isostatic concepts, together with our materials and processes engineer. The optomechanical interface with our payload supplier: mounting, alignment, what we guarantee to them and what they guarantee to us. The optomechanical side of qualification: alignment measurements before and after vibration and thermal vacuum testing, and the correlation of your models against them. The stability case at the design reviews: the numbers, the assumptions, and the margin that is left. You own the coupled chain. Our imaging performance systems engineer sets the requirement and judges the result, our thermal engineer supplies the thermal fields, and our structural dynamics engineer covers the dynamic disturbances. You have the following demonstrable competencies You think across three disciplines at once and are not thrown by a thermal model, a finite element model and an optical prescription in the same afternoon. You know why a mount is isostatic and what happens when it is not. You are precise about micrometres and about the assumptions that produce them. You keep your models under configuration control and can explain what changed between two design cycles. You work naturally with an external optics supplier: challenging, accepting, and knowing where their responsibility ends. Essential qualifications Eligible for a Dutch VGB-B clearance. Engineering degree in mechanical engineering, applied physics, precision engineering or comparable. 5+ years in optomechanical design or analysis of precision optical systems, with demonstrable ownership of an alignment or stability budget. Thermo-elastic analysis craftsmanship: finite element work coupled to thermal results, and the translation into optical performance. Experience with STOP analysis chains and the tools that support them (for example Nastran or Ansys coupled to Zemax or Code V, or comparable). Fluent English. Comfortable in a multidisciplinary, transatlantic team. Desirable qualifications Space sector experience, including thermal vacuum testing and space materials. Space systems understanding. Earth observation or astronomical instruments. Semiconductor, metrology or other high-precision industry backgrounds are equally welcome. Kinematic mount design and bonded optical assemblies. Fluent Dutch. What we offer Ownership of the physics that decides whether a satellite still focuses after eight years in orbit. Competitive, market-aligned salary and benefits, real ownership of your discipline, and room to grow as the organisation scales. On-site work in Delft, limited hybrid working possible. Particularities This role requires Dutch security screening. You will need a VOG (Certificate of Conduct) to start, which is quick to obtain and lets you begin work on the project immediately. You might also need a VGB-B clearance. This takes longer, and we support you through it. It is required for some aspects of the role, so you must be eligible for it and willing to undergo the screening, but you do not need to have it in hand to join us. Interested? Apply via the vacancy on LinkedIn or the registration form on our website. In your application, include a short description of one alignment or stability problem you owned: the mechanism behind it, what you predicted, and what the measurement showed. Applications without this description will not be reviewed.

Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets. We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together. Role description: Our paid Intern & Placement programme is designed to give you a hands-on insight into the work we do as a company and help to develop skills and knowledge within your chosen field. Supported by signposted training, the programme is based on Arcadis’ core values, giving you both technical training and support to help you develop both personally and professionally whilst with us. You will be exposed to real projects and clients and given a range of experiences to immerse yourself into over the course of your 10–12-week internship or 12-month placement. Role accountabilities: Assist with drawings, models, calculations, and technical reports. Support data collection, document preparation, and project administration. Participate in project meetings and coordination activities. Learn company standards, engineering processes, and digital delivery tools. Support site visits and surveys where appropriate. Accepted Degrees: Civil or Structural Engineering Qualifications & Experience: You will be working towards a degree in a relevant subject You will demonstrate typical Arcadian skills including Resilience, Creativity, Analytical Thinking and being a Team Player You will have excellent communication skills and the ability to use your technical knowledge to influence and consult stakeholders. Willing to travel and stay away from home when required (where possible we embrace virtual working) Why Arcadis? We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together. You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you. Together, we can create a lasting legacy. Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy. Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We believe that by working together diverse people with different experiences develop the most innovative ideas. Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the heart of how we improve quality of life and we work closely with our people across six ED&I Workstreams: Age, Disability, Faith, Gender, LGBT+ and Race. A diverse and skilled workforce is essential to our success. #EarlyCareersUK&I #UndergraduateUK&I #EarlyCareersIreland

title: Wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) an der Fakultät für Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik im Bereich Werkstoffe für die Additive Fertigung
description: Wissenschaftliche Mitarbeiterin bzw. Wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) an der Fakultät für Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik im Bereich Werkstoffe für die Additive Fertigung (Entgelt bis in die Entgeltgruppe 13 TVöD) Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt wird die Stelle zunächst befristet auf zwei Jahre in Voll- oder Teilzeit gesucht. Eine Weiterbeschäftigung bei der Bewilligung eines weiteren Projekts zur Finanzierung ist vorgesehen. Es handelt sich um eine Qualifikationsstelle, in deren Rahmen die Aufnahme einer Promotion möglich und ausdrücklich erwünscht ist. Die Professur Werkstoffe für Additive Verfahren beschäftigt sich mit der Erforschung und Entwicklung neuartiger Werkstoffe und Prozessstrategien für die Additive Fertigung. Unsere Forschung umfasst unter anderem metallische Multimaterial- und Multilaser-Verfahren, innovative Laserprozessstrategien, Prozess-Mikrostruktur-Beziehungen sowie die Charakterisierung additiv gefertigter Werkstoffe und Strukturen. Im Rahmen des Forschungsprojekts SPECTRE werden innovative Werkstoff-, Fertigungs- und Strukturkonzepte für thermisch funktionale Komponenten entwickelt. Der Schwerpunkt der ausgeschriebenen Stelle liegt auf der metallischen additiven Fertigung mittels Laser Powder Bed Fusion (PBF-LB/M). Untersucht werden innovative Prozessstrategien wie Laser Beam Shaping sowie die additive Fertigung von Multimaterial-Komponenten. Ziel ist die Entwicklung und wissenschaftliche Untersuchung neuer Prozess- und Materialkonzepte sowie deren Überführung in funktionale Bauteile. Die Arbeiten sind in ein interdisziplinäres Verbundprojekt mit Industriepartnern eingebettet. Aufgaben Koordination und Durchführung eines drittmittelfinanzierten Forschungsprojektes Entwicklung und experimentelle Untersuchung innovativer PBF-LB/M-Prozessstrategien Entwicklung und additive Fertigung von Multimaterial-Komponenten und funktionalen Strukturen Zusammenarbeit mit den Industriepartnern innerhalb des Forschungsprojekts SPECTRE Mitwirkung in der Lehre (Übungen, Praktika, Betreuung von studentischen Arbeiten) Vorstellung Ihrer Ergebnisse in Fachpublikationen sowie auf nationalen und internationalen Konferenzen Profil Überdurchschnittlich abgeschlossene wissenschaftliche Hochschulbildung (Master / Diplom) in der Materialwissenschaft, Werkstofftechnik, Lasertechnik, Maschinenbau oder verwandten Fächern Was erwarten wir: Interesse an Additiver Fertigung, Lasermaterialbearbeitung und metallischen Werkstoffen Idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit PBF-LB/M, Lasertechnik und/oder Werkstoffcharakterisierung Interesse an experimenteller wissenschaftlicher Arbeit Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise Teamfähigkeit und Interesse am wissenschaftlichen Austausch Sie verfügen über Gleichstellungs- und Diversitätskompetenz Eintreten für die freiheitliche demokratische Grundordnung im Sinne des Grundgesetzes Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie vertiefte Deutschkenntnisse stark erwünscht Wir bieten Aktive Förderung Ihrer wissenschaftlichen Entwicklung und Ihrer Promotion Forschungsumfeld an der Schnittstelle von Additiver Fertigung, Werkstoffwissenschaft und Lasermaterialbearbeitung Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Industriepartnern und anwendungsnahe Forschung innerhalb eines Verbundprojekts Angenehmes Arbeitsumfeld in einem kleinen, engagierten Team mit flachen Hierarchien, eingebettet in einen aktiven Forschungsschwerpunkt im Bereich der additiven Fertigung an der Universität Eine Campusuniversität mit sehr guter Infrastruktur, betriebseigener Kinderkrippe und Kindergarten (Elterninitiative), einer Familienservicestelle mit Beratung und Hilfestellung für Universitätsangehörige zur besseren Vereinbarkeit von Familie, Pflege und Berufstätigkeit Die Eingruppierung (bis) in die Entgeltgruppe 13 TVöD erfolgt im Hinblick auf die tatsächlich nicht nur vorübergehend auszuübenden Tätigkeiten und die Erfüllung der persönlichen bzw. tariflichen Anforderungen Homeoffice ist nach Absprache mit der Projektleitung möglich Sie arbeiten bei einem anerkannten und familienfreundlichen Arbeitgeber in sicheren wirtschaftlichen Verhältnissen, der eine ausgeglichene Work-Life-Balance durch flexible Arbeitszeiten und Teilzeitmodelle fördert Sie profitieren im Rahmen der Weiterentwicklung von vielseitigen Karriereperspektiven sowie einem umfangreichen Fort- und Ausbildungsangebot Sie haben die Möglichkeit, in einem festgelegten Rahmen an Sport- und Gesundheitsprogrammen während der Arbeitszeit teilzunehmen Sie können am Corporate-Benefits-Programm mit Vergünstigungen und Rabatten auf Markenartikel, Dienstleistungen und viele lokale Angebote teilnehmen Bemerkungen: Die Beschäftigung kann auf Wunsch auch in Teilzeit erfolgen. Die Bundeswehr fördert die berufliche Gleichstellung von Frauen und Männern und begrüßt deshalb besonders Bewerbungen von Frauen. Nach Maßgabe des Sozialgesetzbuchs IX und des Behindertengleichstellungsgesetzes begrüßen wir ausdrücklich Bewerbungen von schwerbehinderten Menschen; hinsichtlich der Erfüllung der Ausschreibungsvoraussetzungen erfolgt eine individuelle Betrachtung. Die Bundeswehr unterstützt die Ziele des Nationalen Integrationsplans und begrüßt Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Migrationshintergrund. title: Stage 2027 - Ingénieur(e) Montée en TRL d'Échangeurs Thermiques en Fabrication Additive (All Gender)
description: Job Description Et si votre aventure professionnelle commençait avec Airbus Protect ! Vous recherchez un stage de fin d’année ou intégré dans une année de césure vous permettant de valider votre diplôme ? Nous vous proposons de travailler auprès d’experts en analyse et maîtrise des risques dans les métiers de la cybersecurity, de la safety et de la sustainability. Une offre de stage intitulée « Stage 2027 - Ingénieur(e) Montée en TRL d'Échangeurs Thermiques en Fabrication Additive (All Gender) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’ Airbus Protect sur son site de Vitrolles . Vous rejoindrez le département Sustainability en charge des Matériaux & Procédés . Votre stage consistera à accompagner la montée en maturité technologique (passage vers les niveaux TRL 5 et TRL 6) d'échangeurs de température innovants fabriqués en impression 3D métallique (ALM). Face aux enjeux de gestion thermique critique et de réduction drastique de poids sur les aéronefs, la fabrication additive aluminium permet d'atteindre des densités énergétiques très élevées grâce à des géométries complexes impossibles à réaliser en usinage classique. Idéalement, ce stage d’une durée de 1 an commencera de préférence en Janvier 2027 (la période est communiquée à titre indicatif, et pourra être revue). Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. Tâches Et Responsabilités Votre tuteur/tutrice vous aidera à identifier vos objectifs professionnels et vous accompagnera dans le développement de vos compétences. Vos Principales Activités Seront Les Suivantes Participer à la maturation du procédé d'impression en alliage d'aluminium afin de garantir la répétabilité géométrique des micro-canaux et des parois minces. Analyser et suivre les tests de performances fluides et thermiques sur des boucles dynamiques représentatives (bancs de type Iron Bird). Contribuer à la validation structurelle et vibratoire de l'équipement en intégrant les contraintes des interfaces mécaniques réelles. Mettre à jour les analyses de sécurité (FMECA) de l'équipement pour prendre en compte les spécificités de l'aluminium, comme la résistance à la corrosion et la fatigue thermique. Accompagner la préparation des campagnes d'essais de fatigue en laboratoire, la validation du Business Case et l'analyse des risques opérationnels de maintenance (ORL). Ce stage vous permettra notamment de développer les compétences suivantes : Expertise technique en fabrication additive (ALM) appliquée aux systèmes de gestion thermique dans l'aéronautique. Maîtrise des processus de maturation technologique (TRL) et industrielle (MRL) sur des matériaux innovants. Connaissance approfondie des méthodes de qualification environnementale, d'essais en vol et des analyses de sécurité fonctionnelle (FMECA). Cette offre vous intéresse ? Êtes-vous notre candidat·e ? Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau Bac +5 (ou équivalent) dans le domaine de la Thermique, de la Mécanique des Fluides, des Matériaux ou une discipline apparentée ? Durant vos études et expériences précédentes, vous avez développé les compétences suivantes : Des connaissances solides en transferts de chaleur, thermodynamique et résistance des matériaux. Un fort intérêt pour la fabrication additive métallique et le comportement des alliages d'aluminium. Des notions en ingénierie d'essais (vibratoires, hydrauliques) et en simulation numérique (CFD). Une rigueur analytique pour la gestion des risques, l'analyse de défaillances (FMECA) et la certification aéronautique. Compétences Linguistiques Attendues Anglais : Intermédiaire/Courant Français : Courant. Prochaines Étapes De Notre Processus De Sélection Votre candidature sera analysée par un manager et un recruitment business partner dans les prochains jours. Si votre profil correspond aux pré requis, vous serez invité·e à réaliser un entretien technique et un entretien RH. Rejoignez-nous ! #BUSustainabilityAP / #BUSafetyAP / #BUCyberAP / #SupportFonctionAP #JobAPFR #Internship This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. Company Airbus Protect Contract Type Internship Experience Level Student Job Family Support to Management By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus. Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief. Airbus is, and always has been, committed to equal opportunities for all. As such, we will never ask for any type of monetary exchange in the frame of a recruitment process. Any impersonation of Airbus to do so should be reported to emsom@airbus.com. At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

title: Advanced Operations Engineering Graduate Program - September 2027
description: I am delighted to share that we are now accepting applications for our Stryker Advanced Operations (AO) Global Engineering Development Programme (AOGEDP) – to begin in September 2027. If you are an upcoming or recent graduate in a Level 8 or above Engineering, Software or Digital discipline-based Degree, then this is the opportunity for you! Advanced Operations (AO) is Stryker’s function that specialises in new product introductions across all of our divisions. The “AO Global Engineering Development Programme” is a 20-month structured programme that provides participants the opportunity to be part of a global team, with exposure to cutting edge technology varying from traditional manufacturing processes to additive manufacturing and Robotics, as well as interactions with market leading Product Development, Quality Assurance and Operations teams from across the 9 Stryker divisions. The programme focuses on developing the skillsets, mindset and toolkit of each participant to enable them for success within Advanced Operations to support our wider business to be successful. During each rotational assignment participants will be responsible for: Participating in various project teams. Work with a highly creative design team to invent and develop innovative new product concepts. Investigation, design, development and implementation of new manufacturing processes and technology. Handover of new processes from development to production. Implement quality systems and work closely with Design, Quality and Manufacturing Engineering. Provide process validation support both internally and with vendors. Develop and qualify new test equipment and methods. Research, specify and qualify new test or prototyping equipment. Participate in various trainings to develop your skillset, mindset and toolkit. What Are We Looking For? Dedicated achievers: People who thrive in a fast-paced environment and are determined & driven to ensure commitments are met, projects are delivered and meet our extremely high quality and regulatory standards. Curious learners: People who seek out cutting-edge research and information to expand and enhance their ability to be creative which supports the development of new ideas from concept into reality. Collaborative Partners: People who build and leverage cross-functional relationships to bring together ideas, information, use cases, and industry analyses to develop best practices. What You Need? Candidates must have already attained or be on course to attain a 2.1 result in a Level 8 or above Mechanical/ Manufacturing/ Biomedical/ Electrical/ Electronic/ Software/ Digital / BIS/ Project Management Discipline-Based Degree. Candidates must have/will have attained the above between June 2025 and Sept 2027. Self-starter with demonstrated efficient work methods, analytical & problem-solving skills, and ability to handle multiple tasks at once. The individual should enjoy working in a fast paced, dynamic and results orientated team environment. Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively work cross-functionally and with global teams. Basic knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials, product, and process design. Recruitment Process: Our recruitment process has a number of stages to give you the opportunity to learn about us as well as helping us learn about you: Initial Phone Interview Gallup Interview Technical Assessment & Final Interviews Benefits of Working in Stryker: Secure a place on our Graduate Programme and you’ll enjoy a remuneration package that is unsurpassed, including: Permanent Contract. Annual Target Bonus. Share Option Scheme. Pension Scheme. Health Care. Excellent opportunity for Progression and Development. Hybrid Working. Flexible Working Hours – 2.00 pm Finish on a Friday. Employee Assistance Programme Employee Resource Groups, and Sports and Social Groups Training and support with a dedicated mentor from day one. International Travel Opportunities. Stryker Stryker is one of the world’s leading medical technology companies and is dedicated to helping healthcare professionals perform their jobs more efficiently while enhancing patient care. Stryker is committed to delivering exceptional results to patients so they can continue to live healthy, active lifestyles. A wide and diverse range of Stryker products are manufactured in Ireland including hip and knee system implants, bone cement, surgical blades and micro-rotary burs which are used for cutting, drilling, burring, and shaping bone and soft tissue during orthopaedic, spine, ear, nose and throat plastic surgery. Our neurovascular Ireland product pipeline represents a broad offering of detachable coils for the treatment of haemorrhagic stroke (the rupture of a blood vessel in the brain) and ischemic stroke (a blockage in a blood vessel in the brain). Stryker offers results-driven people a place where they can make a difference. It is our privilege to create medical technology that exceeds our customers’ expectations and improves peoples’ lives around the world. We give employees the opportunity to develop their career based on each individual’s strengths, performance and potential, including the possibility to move geographically, functionally, laterally, and vertically. Stryker is a career destination for engaged passionate and talented people who seek innovation, growth, and opportunity. #IJ Ireland: €44,000 EUR Annual At Stryker, we believe transparency helps candidates make confident decisions about their next career step. Compensation is an important part of that process and we want to be clear about how pay is determined. The compensation information posted for this role may be presented as a salary range or a fixed amount depending on the role. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for incentive compensation (such as bonus and/or commissions where applicable), along with Stryker’s comprehensive benefits package. title: Projektingenieur Entwicklung (m/w/x) – Teilprojektleitung Prototypen und Prüftechnik
description: Die Alveon MedTech GmbH ist ein innovatives Medizintechnik-Startup mit Sitz in Ostfildern bei Stuttgart. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung medizinischer Inhalationssysteme. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2020 haben wir erfolgreich eine patentgeschützte Basistechnologie entwickelt. Aktuell arbeiten wir – im Rahmen einer strategischen Partnerschaft mit einem der größten deutschen Unternehmen im Medizinalcannabis-Markt – an der Entwicklung und Zulassung des ersten dosierfähigen Cannabis-Inhalators für den europäischen Markt. Jetzt steht die entscheidende Phase an: Prototypen, Versuche, Verifikation und Zulassung. Dafür erweitern wir unsere Prüfkapazitäten in Ostfildern und bei externen Partnern und suchen jemanden, der diesen Bereich verantwortet. Als Projektingenieur Entwicklung und Prüftechnik übernimmst du abgegrenzte Entwicklungsbereiche mit voller Ergebnisverantwortung — von der Konzeption über Versuch und Prototyp bis zum belastbaren Nachweis. Du bekommst Ziele, keine Arbeitsanweisungen. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CTO und Projektleiter zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass zum jeweiligen Meilenstein die richtigen Prototypen bereitstehen — und koordinierst dafür Kolleginnen, Kollegen und externe Partner. Aufgaben Eigenverantwortliche Arbeitspakete: Konzeption und Umsetzung abgegrenzter Entwicklungsthemen Festlegung von Vorgehen, Umfang und Abbruchkriterien Abstimmung mit QM/Regulatory und externen Partnern Terminverantwortung für die Bereitstellung von Versuchsaufbauten, Prototypen und Mustern Schwerpunkt: Versuch, Prüfaufbau und Labor Aufbau, Inbetriebnahme und Weiterentwicklung von Prüfvorrichtungen, Messplätzen und Versuchsständen Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung von Entwicklungs- und Verifikationsversuchen, unter anderem zu Verdampfungsleistung, Dosiergenauigkeit, Temperaturverhalten, Dichtheit und Lebensdauer Aufbau und Betreuung der Messtechnik inklusive Kalibrierung und Prüfmittelverwaltung Vorbereitung, Begleitung und Auswertung von Prüfkampagnen bei externen Laboren und Hochschulen Erstellung von Versuchsplänen, Versuchsprotokollen, Prüf- und Entwicklungsberichten Ergänzend: Konstruktion und Prototyping Konstruktion von Vorrichtungen, Adaptern und Bauteilen im CAD Prototyping mittels 3D-Druck sowie Aufbau, Kennzeichnung und Rückverfolgbarkeit von Mustern Technische Bewertung von Bauteilen und Werkstoffen aus Keramik, Spritzguss und Silikon Zuarbeit zur technischen Dokumentation gemäß MDR und ISO 13485 Qualifikation Damit du in dieser Position erfolgreich bist, solltest du Folgendes mitbringen: Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (z. B. Maschinenbau, Medizintechnik, Verfahrenstechnik, Physik) oder Technikerabschluss mit einschlägiger Erfahrung Mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im technischen Entwicklungsumfeld, davon mehrere Jahre in eigenverantwortlicher Rolle Die Fähigkeit, pragmatisch zu entscheiden, wie weit eine Lösung gehen muss — und das zu begründen Sicheres, repräsentatives Auftreten gegenüber Lieferanten, Prüflaboren und Hochschulen Sicherer Umgang mit Messtechnik sowie mit der Auswertung und Darstellung von Versuchsdaten Sorgfältige, nachvollziehbare Dokumentation deiner Arbeit Hohe Eigenmotivation, Selbststrukturierung und Verantwortungsbewusstsein Schnelle Auffassungsgabe, analytisches Denken und die Bereitschaft, dich tief in technische und regulatorische Themen einzuarbeiten Bereitschaft zur Arbeit vor Ort in Ostfildern sowie zu gelegentlichen Einsätzen bei Partnern und Prüflaboren Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität: du baust auf, misst und packst selbst an Praktische Erfahrung im CAD, etwa mit SolidWorks, Creo oder Fusion 360 Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch sicher in Wort und Schrift Besonders von Vorteil sind: Erfahrung in der Entwicklung medizinischer Geräte unter EU-MDR Kenntnisse der Qualitätsnormen ISO 9001 und ISO 13485 Erfahrung mit Aerosolen, Inhalation, Thermodynamik oder Strömungstechnik Kenntnisse in statistischer Versuchsplanung und Auswertung, etwa Python,
