title: Progettista Meccanico Junior
description: Azienda: Fluid-o-Tech Group Progettiamo e produciamo pompe volumetriche e componenti per il controllo dei fluidi, con meccanica di alta precisione. Siamo un gruppo multinazionale a conduzione familiare: strutture snelle e decisioni rapide rendono visibile l'impatto di ogni progetto. Il ruolo Progetterai pompe volumetriche per il settore automotive all'interno del team Automotive. Seguirai componenti meccanici ad alta precisione dalla modellazione CAD fino ai test di laboratorio e alla prototipazione. Cosa farai Modellerai in CAD 3D componenti e assiemi di pompe volumetriche destinate ad applicazioni automotive. Redigerai disegni tecnici complessi, con quote e tolleranze stringenti, per lavorazioni meccaniche di alta precisione. Collaborerai con l'attrezzeria interna alla realizzazione dei prototipi, adattando il progetto ai vincoli di lavorazione. Seguirai in laboratorio i test sulle pompe e integrerai nel progetto le evidenze emerse. Gestirai disegni e revisioni nel PLM Windchill, interfacciandoti con la qualità e con i Project Engineer del team. Contesto tecnico Sistema: pompe volumetriche per il controllo dei fluidi in applicazioni automotive. Strumenti principali: CAD 3D parametrico e PLM Windchill, con formazione in azienda. Ambiente operativo: ufficio tecnico in open space, con laboratorio test, attrezzeria e produzione nello stesso sito. Team: 4 persone (engineering manager, due Project Engineer e Design Engineer), all'interno di un team più ampio di progettazione meccanica di 13 persone. Vincoli distintivi: meccanica di alta precisione, tolleranze stringenti e procedure richieste dalle certificazioni di settore. Chi cerchiamo Requisiti essenziali Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica, Aerospaziale, oppure Biomedica con percorso o esami di ambito meccanico. Utilizzo di un software CAD 3D parametrico per la modellazione di componenti meccanici, anche in ambito universitario o di tesi. Capacità di leggere e interpretare disegni tecnici meccanici con quote, tolleranze e indicazioni geometriche. Interesse a consolidare il proprio percorso nella progettazione meccanica, con autonomia nel reperire informazioni e coinvolgere colleghi di altre funzioni per risolvere problemi tecnici. Conoscenza professionale dell'italiano, lingua di lavoro quotidiana, e dell'inglese, usato nelle riunioni con la sede cinese, fornitori e clienti. Requisiti preferenziali Esperienza, anche di tesi o stage, nella progettazione di componenti meccanici di piccole dimensioni e alta precisione. Utilizzo di un sistema PLM per la gestione di disegni e revisioni. Cosa offriamo Sede: Milano, a 10–15 minuti a piedi dalla metro M1 Bisceglie. Modalità di lavoro: ibrido, 4 giorni in sede + 1 da remoto (di norma dal termine del periodo di prova), con orario flessibile: entrata tra le 8 e le 9, uscita tra le 17 e le 18. Trasferte: assenti o occasionali. Pacchetto retributivo: RAL 33 – 35k€ (CCNL Metalmeccanico, apprendistato per chi ha conseguito la laurea di recente) + premio di risultato aziendale indicativamente convertibile in welfare + buoni pasto 9€/giorno + assistenza sanitaria integrativa Metasalute. Crescita: percorso di consolidamento nel ruolo di Design Engineer, con accesso diretto a laboratorio test e produzione.

title: CDI – Ingénieure/Ingénieur Conception Développement
description: Plongez au cœur de l'innovation spatiale et contribuez à la conception de structures révolutionnaires en matériaux composites ! Rejoignez notre équipe dynamique en tant qu' Ingénieure/Ingénieur Conception Développement et participez à la conception et à la qualification des structures de moteurs à propergol solide pour les lanceurs militaires et civils. 🌍 Votre environnement de travail Au sein du département Propulsive Systems Engineering , le service Tanks & Inert Motor Case Engineering est responsable de la conception, du développement et de la qualification des structures en matériaux composites pour les moteurs à propergol solide et les réservoirs de gaz sous haute pression. Vous intégrerez une équipe pluridisciplinaire travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les laboratoires matériaux, les secteurs d'analyse mécanique et thermique, ainsi que les secteurs méthodes industrielles et essais. Votre rôle sera central dans les projets, en assurant la conception et la justification des structures, ainsi que la qualification des nouveaux matériaux. Ce poste vous offrira l'opportunité de participer à des projets innovants et de contribuer à l'avancement des technologies spatiales. 📈 Ce que ce poste peut vous apporter Expérience concrète : Participation à la fabrication et aux essais de démonstrateurs technologiques. Innovation : Contribution aux prochains développements de moteurs à propergol solide pour les lanceurs militaires. Expertise : Implication dans la justification et la qualification de structures primaires de lanceurs. 🔍 Vos missions Conception et justification : Justification de la structure du moteur vis-à-vis des cas de charges dimensionnants. Justification de la protection thermique interne pour respecter les températures maximales de fonctionnement. Préparation des bilans de performance (masse, centrage, inerties et volume interne) pour les différentes phases de vie. Préparation de la documentation de justification : plan de justification, dossier des cas de charge dimensionnants, dossier de justification de la définition. Qualification des matériaux : Suivi et exploitation des caractérisations mécaniques. Définition des plans d'essais, suivi et exploitation des essais sur structures. Préparation de la documentation de synthèse des travaux de qualification matériaux. Support à la production série : Traitement d'obsolescences de matériaux constitutifs de la structure du moteur. Rédaction des dossiers d'exigences matériaux. Contribution à l'identification des nouveaux matériaux candidats en lien avec le laboratoire matériaux et procédés. Préparation du dossier de justification du nouveau matériau. 🎯 Profil recherché Formation : Bac+5 Ingénieur(e) mécanique. Expérience : Minimum 6 mois dans le domaine de la conception ou des analyses mécaniques. Compétences techniques : Maîtrise technique des règles de conception et de dimensionnement des structures en matériaux composites. title: Project Engineer
description: Wil jij onze projecten van A tot Z in goede banen leiden, in nauwe samenwerking met een ervaren productieteam? Combineer je technisch inzicht met een sterk analytisch vermogen voor calculaties? Dan ben jij de Project Engineer die wij zoeken! De functie Binnen de afdeling werkvoorbereiding/engineering begeleid je projecten van A tot Z. Dit omvat het volledig traject vanaf de calculaties tot tekeningen van de klant omzetten, van werkvoorbereiding tot en met het opvolgen van het productieproces. Je houdt alle gegevens met betrekking tot jouw projecten bij in ons ERP-pakket en bewaakt de goede voortgang van deze projecten in productie. Jouw analytisch inzicht om de kosten te bepalen zorgt ervoor dat je steeds op zoek gaat naar de beste oplossing voor de klant en ons bedrijf. Je houdt hier o.a. rekening met het gebruiken van juiste materialen en machines. Je bent het technisch aanspreekpunt voor verschillende partijen, zowel intern als extern. Hierbij communiceer je vlot met klanten om zo hun behoeftes te kennen. Verantwoordelijkheid opnemen vind je vanzelfsprekend en je tracht steeds op zoek te gaan naar de beste resultaten in samenwerking met andere afdelingen (verkoop, productie, kwaliteit, magazijn). Ben je graag met verbeteringen bezig? Ook in jouw functie ga je bestaande processen optimaliseren, waarbij je op zoek gaat naar hoe we nóg beter, sneller, kwalitatiever kunnen werken. Denk hierbij aan het uitdenken en het faciliteren van automatisaties met robot of cobots Door je proactieve ingesteldheid en je probleemoplossend vermogen voorkom je problemen en bied je steeds maximale oplossingen voor onze klant. Je hands on ingesteldheid zien we graag terug door je regelmatige aanwezigheid in de productie waar je stukken voor onze klanten opvolgt, controleert, en waar nodig bijstuurt. Jouw kracht Je bent in het bezit van een technische Bachelor (Elektromechanica, Mechanica, Ontwerp en productietechnieken) of gelijkwaardig door ervaring. Ervaring is mooi meegenomen, schoolverlaters komen ook in aanmerking. Heb je relevante kennis van metaalbewerking (plaatbewerking, lassen...) dan is dit een pluspunt. Je hebt ervaring met tekenprogramma Solid Works of andere programma’s, of je wil het graag leren. Je hebt een basiskennis MS Office. Je spreekt en schrijft perfect Nederlands en beheerst goed de Engelse taal (kennis Frans en Duits is een plus). De kracht van VDL We voorzien een competitief loon in verhouding met jouw ervaring en competenties Mooie werkuren van 8:00 tot 16:30 Extra verlofdagen! Bij ons krijg je 9,5 ADV-dagen op jaarbasis Maaltijdcheques Een werkgever die oog heeft voor jouw talenten en competenties, dit binnen een informele en no-nonsense bedrijfscultuur Klaar om jezelf uit te dagen? Is je interesse gewekt en voldoe je aan het profiel? Dan ontvangen we graag je cv en motivatie voor deze vacature! Wil jij bijdragen aan diverse projecten voor uiteenlopende klanten in de metaalbewerking? Bij VDL Belgium produceren we met ongeveer 55 collega's onderdelen voor verschillende industrieën. Wij zijn gespecialiseerd in buisbewerkingen zoals CNC-zagen, CNC-buigen, laser- en robotlassen. Onze producten, zoals handgrepen, uitlaten en koelwaterleidingen, worden gebruikt door gerenommeerde fabrikanten van onder andere bussen, trucks, tractoren en grondbewerkingsmachines. Wij bieden Fijne werksfeer Open en informele werksfeer Afwisseling en uitdaging Jij bent Betrokken Een aanpakker Een teamspeler Waarom VDL? Internationaal familiebedrijf Jouw inbreng telt Ontwikkeling én productie

Krakowska 110/114, 02-256 Warszawa. Administrator wyznaczył inspektora ochrony danych, z którym można skontaktować się pod adresem: iod@ilot.lukasiewicz.gov.pl Dane są przetwarzane w celu przeprowadzenia procesu rekrutacji oraz przyszłych procesów rekrutacyjnych (wyłącznie w przypadku wyrażenia na to zgody). Podstawę prawną przetwarzania Pani/Pana danych osobowych stanowi art. 6 ust. 1 lit. a), b) i c) rozporządzenia Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (Dz. Urz. UE L 119 z 4.5.2016 r., s. 1) w zw. z art. 221 1, 2, 4 i 5 - 221b ustawy z dnia 26 czerwca 1974 r. Kodeks pracy (Dz. U. z 2023 r., poz. 1465 z późn. zm.). Dane osobowe mogą być udostępniane podmiotom upoważnionym do ich otrzymania na podstawie przepisów prawa oraz podmiotom współpracującym z administratorem w procesach rekrutacyjnych (wyłącznie w przypadku wyrażenia na to zgody). Dane osobowe będą udostępniane w Biuletynie Informacji Publicznej na zasadach i w zakresie określonym w art. 52 ustawy z dnia 21 lutego 2019 r. o Sieci Badawczej Łukasiewicz (Dz. U. z 2020 r., poz. 2098 z późn. zm.). Dane osobowe będą przechowywane przez okres trwania procesu rekrutacji, a po jego zakończeniu na potrzeby przyszłych procesów rekrutacyjnych (wyłącznie w przypadku wyrażenia na to zgody). Przysługuje Pani/Panu prawo do żądania od administratora dostępu do swoich danych osobowych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia lub ograniczenia przetwarzania oraz prawo do przenoszenia danych, a także wniesienia skargi do organu nadzorczego. Zgoda na przetwarzanie danych osobowych może być cofnięta w dowolnym momencie, bez wpływu na zgodność z prawem przetwarzania, którego dokonano na podstawie zgody przed jej cofnięciem. Podanie danych osobowych jest dobrowolne, niepodanie danych skutkuje brakiem możliwości wzięcia udziału w procesie rekrutacji oraz w przyszłych procesach rekrutacyjnych. Administrator na podstawie przetwarzanych danych osobowych nie dokonuje profilowania ani zautomatyzowanego podejmowania decyzji. Wysyłając niniejszy formularz wyraża Pani/Pan zgodę na udział w procesie rekrutacji.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: At Voltrac, we are on a mission to strengthen Europe’s food security and defence with an autonomous electric tractor to free farmers from drudgery and keep soldiers out of harm’s way. The 3.5 tonnes platform is currently being tested at vineyards, olive orchards and citrus groves across Spain - check out our website to see it in action. We are about to scale manufacturing to 100 units yearly, and are looking to match the sales accordingly. As part of this scaling efforts, we are looking to strengthen our engineering team. You'll work closely with the founders and contribute to every stage of product development: from understanding end-user needs through to prototyping, manufacturing, and scaling for market adoption. Within 12 months, the aim is to evolve from first customer delivery to regular production. If you're driven by curiosity, thrive in tackling hard engineering problems, and are motivated by building real-world impact with a team of sharp, mission-driven peers – this role could be a great fit. Who we are Voltrac was founded by Francisco Infante Aguirre and Thomas Hubregtsen in 2024. Francisco used to build hydrogen-powered supersonic planes at Destinus and heavy-lifting eVTOLs at Volocopter, but comes from a family that builds and sells tractor implements in over 25 countries. Thomas used to accelerate Machine Learning using GPUs, TPUs, and Quantum Computers at Google X, IBM and BMW, as well as started San Francisco-based Extropic introducing Thermodynamic computers, but also had his first job at a farm. Together, they set their sights on shaking up the market, competing directly with incumbents and startups alike. In their journey, they are supported by investors such as Extantia, Foodlabs, Antler, Push, and Prototype, who together committed a total of 9M in funding. With this, they were able to open up shop in a 1200 m² facility in Valencia, with 300 m² of natural‑light office and a 900 m² workshop. Valencia is consistently voted as one of Europe’s top places to live based on its low cost of living, excellent climate, and vibrant historic centre. The team is young, comes from different backgrounds, and loves to have team bbqs, but share one aim: shape Europe’s agriculture and defence with machines that do real work. Tasks You'll take ownership of projects from concept to production – including hands-on prototyping, detailed design, component selection and rigorous testing. The role spans a broad range of responsibilities and requires close collaboration with teams across R&D, manufacturing, and QA. More specifically, you will: Use CAD, FEA, and engineering calculations to develop robust mechanical designs Perform analysis and testing to validate and optimise system performance Interface with suppliers and manage procurement for prototyping and production Work in close collaboration with electronics, mechatronics, and software teams to bring prototypes to life Lead field testing and iteration of functional prototypes Optimise tools, processes, and designs for production Requirements Degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering (or equivalent practical experience) Demonstrated experience in hardware development, with a track record of taking designs from idea to reality Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a hands-on, pragmatic mindset Clear communicator with collaborative instincts, especially in multidisciplinary environments Experience working with welded parts, mechanical components, system architecture or fabrication will be appreciated Benefits We offer a very competitive base salary, equity participation plan, aid in relocation,, and sales bonuses. Most importantly, we want to offer perks that are important to you. We'd love to hear what you value!

description: Last date to apply: 04 November 2026 Help shape robust, high-performing products through advanced structural analysis. As a Structural Analysis Engineer in our Advanced CAE team, you will turn simulations into clear engineering decisions—from early concepts to product verification. The team is an experienced specialist team within R&D in Huskvarna and work closely with design engineers, test engineers, project teams, and other experts across Husqvarna Group. The role gives you broad exposure to the product-development process and the opportunity to influence both product design and the way we use simulation. Role Description In this role you will plan, perform, and evaluate structural analyses throughout the product-development process. Your work will support concept selection, design improvements, verification, and root-cause investigations. The analyses may include linear and nonlinear structural behavior, durability, dynamics, and impact, depending on product and project needs. As a Structural Analysis Engineer, you will take technical ownership of your analyses: defining the question, selecting an appropriate method, assessing model quality and assumptions, interpreting results, and communicating conclusions and recommendations. Collaboration with physical testing and design functions to build confidence in the results is another part of this role, as is contributing to improved methods, automation, guidelines, and good CAE practices across the organisation. Your profile We are looking for someone who combines sound engineering judgement with curiosity and a practical approach to problem-solving. You are comfortable working independently, while actively seeking input and sharing knowledge with others. The ability to explain complex analysis results in a way that helps colleagues and project teams making well-founded decisions is also an important trait. You structure your work, take responsibility for quality and delivery, and can balance several assignments in a project-driven environment. Just as importantly, you are motivated by learning—deepening your expertise, exploring new methods, and contributing to the development of the team. What You Bring A Master’s degree, or equivalent competence, in mechanical engineering, engineering physics, or a related field with a focus on structural mechanics Relevant professional experience in structural analysis or CAE, including finite element analysis The ability to define analysis tasks, assess assumptions and model quality, interpret results, and provide actionable engineering recommendations The ability to communicate technical content clearly in reports, presentations, and engineering discussions Very good spoken and written English Swedish-language skills, or a willingness to develop them It is an advantage if you also have experience in one or more of the following areas: Pre- and post-processing in ANSA and META Solvers or multibody tools such as LS-DYNA, Nastran, or Adams Nonlinear analysis, dynamics, impact, fatigue, or correlation between simulation and physical testing Python scripting, workflow automation, and AI-assisted software development Exploring or implementing AI and agent-based solutions for simulation workflows, engineering decision support, knowledge reuse, or quality assurance Working in a Linux environment Location Huskvarna. This role requires you to work on site at our Huskvarna office at least four days per week. We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This approach helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive. Your application Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. For more questions regarding the position please contact: Hiring Manager: Per Carlén, per.carlen@husqvarnagroup.com. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com. Processing of personal data When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice. Winning Through Culture We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters. Our culture is built on three core themes: Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities. Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on. Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference. Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future! Learn more about our culture here .

Our products power Formula 1 cars, launch rockets into space, accompany satellites in orbit, and win the 24 Hours of Le Mans. What drives us? The next tenth of a second, the next orbit. If you’re ready to push boundaries, join our team. YOUR TASKS You will analyse complex composite structures and pressure vessels for demanding space applications. Using state of the art simulation methods and in depth knowledge of material behaviour, you will assess the structural integrity and safety of our components, from numerical analysis to validation against experimental data. physics or a related technical field Minimum of 5 years of hands on experience in structural analysis, preferably within the aerospace industry In depth knowledge of composite materials, particularly their behaviour and failure mechanisms under load Strong proficiency in finite element analysis, ideally using Abaqus, Nastran, Ansys and/or HyperMesh Knowledge of nonlinear material behaviour of metals under static and cyclic loading Solid foundation in fracture mechanics, including related modelling approaches and failure analysis Experience in planning and overseeing test campaigns for material characterisation, model calibration and validation Programming skills, preferably in Python, for automating data evaluation and analysis workflows Structured, analytical and independent working style, combined with a strong commitment to quality Strong understanding of engineering principles and processes Experience working with pressure vessels, launch vehicles, or spacecraft structures is a plus Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in cross functional teams Excellent written and spoken English WE OFFER A versatile role in a successfully growing Company mobile phone, company bicycle, climate ticket, corporate benefits, ... title: Ingénieur Calcul Sénior
description: À propos de TMC TMC est une société internationale de conseil en hautes technologies présente dans 16 pays et comptant 3000 collaborateurs. Nous apportons une expertise technique à nos clients pour les accompagner dans la réalisation de leurs projets et de leurs défis depuis plus de 20 ans. Nous travaillons dans des domaines passionnants tels que l'aéronautique, l'automobile, le ferroviaire, l'énergie, la finance et la santé. Chez TMC, nous croyons que ce sont les personnes qui sont les moteurs de l'innovation. C'est pourquoi nous offrons les meilleures conditions possibles pour le développement de chacun de nos collaborateurs. Vous trouverez chez TMC un environnement de travail stimulant dans lequel vous prendrez en main votre propre carrière. Ce que nous vous proposons : - Un modèle basé sur la transparence : chacun connaît les bénéfices générés par son projet. - Un "profit sharing" : une participation individuelle mensuelle aux bénéfices. - Un budget formation de 2 000 € par an: formation technique et coaching personnalisé. - Une organisation en équipes métier : des référents pour stimuler l'échange, le partage de compétences et renforcer la cohésion. - Un CDI : vous bénéficierez d'un emploi stable tout en ayant la possibilité d'explorer différents projets et/ou secteurs d'activités. - Un LAB' ENTREPRENEURIAL : en parallèle de votre projet client, vous aurez l'opportunité de donner vie ou de prendre part à une innovation grâce à notre incubateur de start-up. Description du poste Réaliser les activités de vérification structurale et de modélisation éléments finis (MEF) sur les structures primaires et secondaires. Garantir la conformité, robustesse et maturité des solutions techniques dans un contexte de développement, modifications série ou réparation. 1. Modélisation Éléments Finis Développer et mettre à jour des modèles MEF 2D/3D sous Patran/Nastran , HyperMesh, ou outils Airbus. Réaliser l’idéalisations de structures composites et métalliques (coques, poutres, assemblages). Assurer la qualité du maillage (CQ), la représentativité physique et la cohérence des hypothèses. 2. Vérifications de résistance Effectuer des calculs statiques, instabilités, fatigue et tolérance aux dommages (DT/F&DT). Vérifier la conformité des conceptions aux critères Airbus et certificatifs. Utiliser les méthodes Airbus (ISAMI, ISAMI Neo, outils internes). 3. Analyse & justification Rédiger des notes de calcul , dossiers de justification et rapports de certification. Participer aux revues techniques : PDR, CDR, FAT, MRB. Proposer des optimisations de conception en lien avec les équipes Design, Manufacturing et Airworthiness. 4. Support technique Soutenir les équipes design dans les choix mécaniques et dimensionnements. Répondre aux queries production et participer à la résolution de non-conformités (NC). Contribuer aux analyses d’impact liées aux modifications du produit. Compétences requises Calcul & MEF Maîtrise des logiciels : Patran/Nastran , HyperMesh, Abaqus (un plus). Bonne connaissance des matériaux composites et métalliques . Analyse statique, modale, flambement. Fatigue & tolérance aux dommages (F&DT). Connaissance des règles Airbus (ISAMI/ISAMI Neo fortement apprécié).

title: Makine Mühendisi
description: İhtiyacımız olan kişinin Solidworks bilgisi üst seviyede olmalı , çünkü biz tasarımlarımızı solidworksde yapıyoruz. Hatta simulation bilgisi varsa +1 Fark ettiysen makine imalatı yapıyoruz. dur bi saniye öyle düşündüğün gibi basit değil! haliyle solidworks de tasarlanan ürünün imalatı da bizim fabrikamızda kendi ekibimizce yapılıyor. Bu nedenle sheet metal tecrüben olması gerekli ! Lazer kesim için kesim dosyası verilmesi, Abkant büküm için büküm dosyasının verilmesi, CNC Dik işlem için işlenecek parça dosyasının verilmesi (Cam hariç) Double Column işlem için tarama dosyası verilmesi, Torna için teknik resim verilmesi, Kaynak için kaynak dosyası verilmesi gerekli. Bunları yaparken bir de ihtiyaç olan malzeme listesini çıkarıp satınalmaya vermelisin ki ustalar boş durmasın :) Çok şey istiyoruz değil mi? Daha bitmedi :) Solidworksde yeni tasarımı yapabilecek tecrüben var mı? Olmalı çünkü yeni makineleri de sen çizeceksin. Zor değil keyifli, biz yapıyoruz ama sen yapabilecek misin ? iyice düşün, tekrar düşün solidworkse hakim değilsen olmaz! müracaat etme ilanımıza. ne bizi ne kendini yor lütfen! ama benim işim bu, yapabilirim diyorsan. Ara bizi.
category_reasons: Örtüşen: SolidWorks, Teknik resim, Talaşlı imalat / CNC, Sac metal

title: Mekanik Tasarım Mühendisi veya Makine Konstrüktör Ressam
description: Mekanik Tasarım Mühendisi veya Makine Konstrüktör Ressam AR-GE bölümümüzde, makine tasarım projelerinde görev alacak kıdemli çalışma arkadaşı arıyoruz. Görev ve sorumluluklar Yeni tasarlanacak makine ve mekanik sistemlerin 3D modellerini oluşturmak, parça listelerini ve teknik resimlerini hazırlamak. Mevcut makine tasarımlarını performans, maliyet, üretilebilirlik, bakım kolaylığı ve standartlaşma açısından geliştirmek. Prototip çalışmalarına destek vermek; üretim ekipleriyle koordineli çalışarak teknik sorunlara çözüm geliştirmek. Yapay zekâ modellerini tasarım alternatifleri geliştirme, teknik araştırma, problem çözme ve dokümantasyon süreçlerinde kullanmak; çıktıları mühendislik bilgisi ve teknik kaynaklarla doğrulamak. Yeni malzeme, üretim yöntemi ve dijital araçları takip ederek tasarım ve otomasyon çalışmalarına katkı sağlamak. Mekanik tasarım, konstrüksiyon ve imalat resimlerinin hazırlanmasında deneyimli. SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor veya benzeri bir 3D mekanik tasarım programını etkin kullanabilen. Araştırmacı, çözüm odaklı, detaylara önem veren; sistemli çalışma, dokümantasyon ve ekip iletişimi becerileri güçlü. Tercih sebebi AR-GE, yeni ekipman tasarımı ve prototip oluşturma deneyimi. Yapay zekâ destekli tasarım uygulamalarında deneyim.

tercihen Navisworks / BIM modelleri üzerinden saha koordinasyonu yapabilen, Teknik dokümanları takip edebilecek seviyede İngilizce bilgisine sahip, Yoğun saha çalışma temposuna uyum sağlayabilecek, çözüm odaklı ve sorumluluk sahibi, Planlama, organizasyon, iletişim ve koordinasyon becerileri güçlü, Ekip çalışmasına yatkın ve alt yüklenici ekiplerini etkin şekilde koordine edebilecek, Şantiye çalışma düzenine ve gerektiğinde esnek çalışma saatlerine uyum sağlayabilecek. Adaylardan Beklentilerimiz Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun olmak. Güçlü iletişim, koordinasyon ve organizasyon becerilerine sahip olmak. İleri seviyede İngilizce bilgisine sahip olmak. AutoCAD,REVIT,NAVISWOORKS ve MS Office programlarını etkin kullanabilmek. title: Senior Production Engineer (Hygiene Category)
description: Founded in 1987, Hayat operates in the fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) sector, serving millions of consumers globally with 16 powerful brands. Hayat’s portfolio includes Molfix and Bebem Natural in baby care; Molped in feminine care; Joly , Evony , and Goodcare in personal healthcare; Bingo , Gleen , Test , and Has in home care; Papia , Familia , Teno , and Focus in tissue paper; and Sholk in pet care. As the 4th largest branded diaper manufacturer in the world and the leading tissue producer in the Middle East, Eastern Europe, and Africa, Hayat employs over 10.000 people across its operations. Hayat operates 21 production facilities in 8 countries , including Turkey, Egypt, Iran, Algeria, Russia, Nigeria, Pakistan, and Vietnam, and manages sales and distribution companies in Morocco, Bulgaria, Kenya, Thailand, and Malaysia. With its global operations structured under three main regions Eurasia & Americas, Middle East & Africa, and Asia Pacific Hayat reaches over 100 countries across 5 continents, bringing its brands into millions of homes worldwide. We are currently seeking a talented “Senior Production Engineer” to join our dynamic “Hygiene Prdouction” team. Based in “ Kocaeli ”, this role will contribute to transformative projects under the Consumer Group. If you want to be part of a diverse and vibrant community where your ideas can shape the future of the FMCG industry and your contributions can create a lasting global impact, then Hayat is waiting for you! Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineer, Min. 4 years of experience in production, Experience in Baby Diaper production processes is preferred, Preferably having knowledge about lean manufacturing such as Kaizen, 5S, TPM and problem solving methods, Effectively using MS Office programs, knowledge of SAP is preferred, Fluency in English both written and spoken, Analytical, result oriented, team player and good communication skills, Living in or willing to relocate to Kocaeli, No restriction to travel, No military obligation for male candidates. Job Descriptions Organizing the necessary human resources and facility preparations to execute manufacturing programs, Ensuring high quality, capacity and safe production, Minimizing the production costs and losses, Ensuring occupational health and safety via actions and regulations, Carrying out production according to the defined standards of process and taking actions to improve the process, Following technical deficits related to his/her responsibilities and ensuring their solutions. description: Job Description Summary Rôles d'amélioration des processus et de la qualité Responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution des opérations du département ou axé sur l'exécution d'activités professionnelles au sein d'une discipline technique. Ce poste est autorisé à modifier les procédures et les pratiques en relation avec les tâches dans la mesure où les résultats finaux répondent aux normes d'acceptabilité (qualité, volume, respect des délais, etc.). Développe des compétences pour amener les membres de l'équipe à un consensus autour de sujets relevant du domaine. Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction). Caractéristiques souhaitées Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. Kapsamındaki tüm imalatlardan sorumlu olarak, imalatlar sırasında oluşabilecek risk ve sorunları öngörmek suretiyle bir üst makama raporlanması, Proje kapsamında sorumluluğu dâhilindeki tüm mekanik işlerin takibinin yapılması, Malzemenin ve uygulamaların saha kontrol ve koordinasyonunun sağlanması, İlgili iş programına uygun şekilde gerekli kalite ve iş güvenliği kapsamları dâhilinde yönetilmesi, Yapılan imalatların onaylanması ve uygunsuz imalatların raporlanması, Yapılan işlerin, kalite standartları ve yönetmeliklere uygunluğu konusunda verilen takiplerin gerçekleştirilmesi, Malzemenin saha kontrol ve koordinasyonunun sağlanması, Taşeron ve/veya ekip yönetiminin yapılması, Alt Yüklenici hakedişlerinin, tamamlanmış olan imalatlar doğrultusunda metraj kontrolünü yapılması ve raporlanması, Metrajların hazırlanması, test ve devreye alma süreçlerinin aktif olarak yürütülmesi. Adaylardan Beklentilerimiz Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği bölümünden mezun, Büyük ölçekli üst yapı projelerinde en az 8 yıl tecrübesi bulunan, Taşeron ve ekip yönetimi noktasından tecrübe sahibi, MS Office ve Autocad uygulamalarına hâkim, Yoğun ve esnek çalışma saatlerine uyum sağlayabilecek, Ekip çalışmasına yatkın, Biz Neler Sunuyoruz? Performans ve başarıyı destekleyen prim uygulamaları Kapsamlı yan haklar ve çalışan destek uygulamaları Özel Sağlık Sigortası kapsamında çalışanlarımızı destekleyen sağlık uygulamaları Mesleki ve kişisel gelişimini destekleyen eğitim ve gelişim programları Çeşitlilik ve Eşitlik Beyanımız Rönesans Holding, şirketlere stratejilerini ve operasyonlarını evrensel insan hakları, çalışma, çevre ve yolsuzlukla mücadele ilkelerine uygun hale getirmeye ve toplumsal hedefleri ilerletecek önlemler almaya çağıran BM Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi'nin imzacıları arasında yer almaktadır ve Birleşmiş Milletler Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi çerçevesinde evrensel kabul görmüş beyanlara dayalı ilkeleri benimser. Rönesans Holding, ana ilkeleri olan dürüstlük, rekabetçilik ve yenilikçilikten ödün vermeden şeffaf ve etik değerleri gözeterek insan kaynakları uygulamalarında eşitliği sağlamayı amaçlayan bir işverendir. Tüm başvurular cinsiyet, dil, din, ırk ve etnik kökene bakmaksızın fırsat eşitliğine göre değerlendirilir ve ayırımcılık yapılmaz.

title: Quality Control Engineer
description: Who we are? Wilo is proud to be one of the leading companies in the pump industry and a premium supplier for building technology, water management and the industrial sector. By developing excellent products and solutions, we not only move water, but also the future for people all over the world. Major movements like globalization, digitalization and energy shortages shape some of our largest future challenges. Challenges that we are happy to accept and dive into. We understand the trends that influence our company and our business and act accordingly. By developing products and solutions we move not only water, but we also move the future for people all over the world. As a pioneer in the pump industry, we focus as much on our employees as on our high-quality pumps. Those of you who want to be part of the Wilo will experience a constant flow of personal and organizational development as well as sufficient space for the implementation of own ideas. At Wilo you will move the future, for yourself and for others. We are looking for a Quality Control Engineer to join our organization in Turkey. Job Requirements Bachelor's degree in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering or Mechanical Engineering. Good command of English. Ability to read technical drawings and use measuring equipment. Capable of implementing incoming, in-process, and final quality control processes. Proficient in MS Office applications and SAP (specifically the QM module). Knowledgeable about pump performance test processes. Fluent in root cause analysis methodologies such as FMEA (DFMEA/PFMEA), 8D, 5 Whys, and Ishikawa. Experienced in ISO 9001 and TSE standards along with Quality Management Systems (QMS). Strong communication and interpersonal skills, a team player, with advanced analytical thinking and problem-solving competencies, open to learning and self-development. Knowledgeable about ISO 1101, ISO 17025, and sampling standards. Job Responsibilities Product Quality Control & SAP QM Management Planning and operationally executing incoming, production, and final quality control processes according to the ISO 1101, ISO 17025, and sampling standards. Creating and updating quality plans, inspection characteristics, and control parameters in the SAP QM module. Determining and developing critical quality parameters based on material structure and type. Implementing, standardizing, and improving process (daily routine checklist) and final quality control for semi-finished and finished products across all production lines. Defining control checklists for each product. Non-Conformance & Process Management Creating complaint reports (NCR) via SAP QM in case of supplier-induced non-conformances, managing supplier follow-ups, and corrective actions. Analyzing customer complaints, performing root cause analyses, offering solution proposals, and finalizing the process. Taking an active role in process improvement projects. Quality KPI & PPM Tracking Entering production line defects into the system to generate and report PPM (Parts Per Million) values. Tracking supplier quality, customer return rates, and scrap/rework data, and keeping quality dashboards updated. Test Processes (Test Bench) Carrying out all testing processes from start to finish in accordance with the EN ISO 9906 Standard and without errors. Taking action to solve any issues that happen during testing; developing preventive measures for recurring errors, Performing performance tests in accordance with the established calendar and plan. Tracking the calibration of test benches, determining needs, and ensuring the detection of defective parts. Analyzing flow rate, pressure, power consumption, efficiency, vibration, and temperature data belonging to pumps and systems, and evaluating their conformity with technical criteria and customer requirements. Integrated Management Systems (IMS) Contributing to the development of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and ISO 50001 management systems. Providing active support in internal audits, external audits (CE, TSE, UL-FM, EAC, etc.), and customer audit processes.

title: Senior Railway System Engineer
description: RINA is currently recruiting for a Senior Railway System Engineer to join its office in Istanbul within the Project Engineering Division. Mission The Senior Railway System Engineer leads the technical execution of complex and high-value railway projects, ensuring that all technical aspects are effectively integrated and aligned with project requirements. The role provides strategic technical guidance across multidisciplinary teams, with responsibility for technical quality, compliance, system integration, and delivery. The successful candidate will join the Railway System Engineering discipline and will be accountable for successful project delivery, while mentoring junior engineers and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives. Key Accountabilities System Technical Management & Integration Lead system-level activities in compliance with EN 50126-1/-2, EN 50129, CSM-RA, and applicable National Rules. Define and maintain the System Definition, including requirements, configuration, interfaces, V&V strategies, and O&M aspects. Coordinate system activities supporting authorization for placing the system into service. Ensure coherence and effective integration of all relevant subsystems. Coordinate interfaces between subsystems, the System Integrator, and external stakeholders. Testing & Commissioning Manage testing and commissioning activities. Coordinate and oversee FAI and FAT activities for subsystems. Coordinate on-site system validation activities, including SIAT and SAT. Plan, coordinate, and execute on-site system integration tests, including SIT and SPT. Proposal & Technical Feasibility Lead technical feasibility assessments for complex proposals, identifying key requirements, risks, and technical challenges. Coordinate multidisciplinary technical contributions to develop competitive solutions. Define the technical resources, expertise, and timelines required for project delivery and estimation. Technical Delivery Oversee technical delivery, ensuring quality, compliance, and achievement of project milestones. Lead the resolution of complex technical issues and provide effective engineering solutions. Monitor technical progress and adjust technical plans as required. Technical Team Leadership Provide technical guidance and support to engineering teams. Coordinate technical activities and foster effective collaboration across engineers, technical teams, and subcontractors. Work closely with the Discipline Manager on resource allocation and technical priorities. Quality Control Ensure that project deliverables meet required technical and quality standards. Identify and address technical deviations and quality issues, implementing corrective actions in collaboration with relevant teams. Education Master’s Degree in Engineering (Systems, Electrical, Mechanical, Transport, or equivalent). Qualifications 10+ years of professional experience in railway systems engineering, covering multiple lifecycle phases, from concept and design through integration, commissioning, and operation. Advanced expertise in at least one of the following domains, with a solid understanding of the others: Rolling Stock Systems: traction, braking, TCMS, onboard ETCS/CBTC Signaling & Train Control: ERTMS/ETCS, CBTC, PTC, interlocking Power Supply & Electrification: 25kV AC, 3kV DC, 750V DC Infrastructure & Track Systems: conventional, metro, light rail, high-speed rail Strong knowledge of Systems Engineering and Integration methodologies, including the V-Model, requirements management, and interface control. In-depth knowledge of CENELEC standards (EN 50126, EN 50128, EN 50129) and related railway safety processes. Experience with relevant engineering, RAMS, and simulation tools, such as DOORS, Enterprise Architect, FMECA, FTA, ReliaSoft, MATLAB, Simulink, and CATIA. Fluent in English and Turkish. Excellent communication, facilitation, and leadership skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams. Proven experience in leading multidisciplinary teams and managing client relationships. Competencies DOMAIN & BUSINESS ACUMEN - Applying a scientific approach and critical thinking in operations and solution development within area of expertise. INTERPERSONAL INFLUENCE - Skills and strategies we use to interact effectively with others. WORKPLACE DYNAMICS - Resourcefulness in shaping progress and working efficiently. FORESIGHT & INSIGHT - Context awareness adopting a systemic perspective and informed decision making. PERSONAL EMPOWERMENT - Ownership for life, work and results, striving to grow professionally and personally. RINA is a multinational company providing a wide range of services in the energy, marine, certification, infrastructure & mobility, industry, research & development sectors. Our business model covers the full process of project development, from concept to completion. At RINA, we endeavor to create a work environment where every single person is valued and encouraged to develop new ideas. We provide equal employment opportunities and are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected and safe from discrimination or harassment of any kind. We are also compliant to the Italian Law n. 68/99.

title: Sales Engineer
description: About Motul Motul is a French company with a long-standing expertise in the development, production and distribution of high-quality lubricants and fluids. Founded in 1853, Motul operates in more than 160 countries and serves a wide range of markets, including powersports, automotive, heavy-duty and industrial applications. Known for its technical expertise and innovation, Motul has developed strong relationships with leading manufacturers, motorsport teams and major championships around the world. At Motul, people are at the heart of our business. We aim to create an environment where employees can develop their skills, take responsibility and contribute to the success of the company. About MotulTech MotulTech is the industrial division of Motul Group, specializing in lubricants and technical solutions for metalworking and machinery maintenance. Our product range includes metalworking fluids for cutting, grinding, forming, casting and extrusion, as well as quenchants, cleaners, rust preventatives, lubricating oils and greases. Our teams work closely with customers on their production sites to improve processes, solve technical challenges and deliver solutions that contribute to performance, efficiency and sustainability. The Position Motul Türkiye is looking for a Sales Engineer to join the MotulTech team. This role is responsible for developing the MotulTech business in Türkiye by combining technical knowledge with a strong sales and customer focus. You will work closely with industrial customers, distributors and internal teams to understand customer requirements, identify business opportunities and provide the right technical solutions. We are looking for an individual with an engineering background and a strong interest in sales and business development . A degree from an engineering faculty is required, preferably in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Metallurgical and Materials Engineering or a related field. The position is based in Istanbul and/or Kocaeli and involves regular travel to customer sites across Türkiye. Key Responsibilities Develop new business by identifying potential customers and creating new sales opportunities. Manage the sales process from the first customer contact through to quotation, negotiation and closing. Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, distributors and business partners. Visit customer sites regularly to understand their production processes, technical requirements and business needs. Maintain technical follow ups, analysis and measuring the lubricants for regular schedule and/or for troubleshooting. Provide technical advice on industrial lubricants and metalworking applications. With enhanced communication on the technical side, you will obtain letters of approvals & recommendations Follow up on product trials, technical tests and customer applications, including the analysis and reporting of results. Support customers with troubleshooting and application-related issues. Work closely with customers to identify opportunities for process improvement and cost optimization. Prepare and deliver technical presentations, customer trainings and product demonstrations. Participate in customer meetings, trade fairs, seminars and other industry events. Work with the sales and technical teams to resolve customer complaints and provide appropriate solutions. Prepare technical sales materials and application recommendations together with the Product Management and Technical teams. Follow market developments and competitor activities and share relevant information with the wider team. Contribute to achieving sales, customer development and business growth targets. What We Are Looking For Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical, Industrial, Chemical, Metallurgical and Materials Engineering or a related field. Strong technical understanding and an interest in industrial processes and manufacturing. Previous experience in technical sales, B2B sales, business development, application engineering or a similar customer-facing role is an advantage. Experience in industrial manufacturing, metalworking, machinery, automotive, chemicals, lubricants or a related industry is a plus. Strong interest in sales and the ability to identify and develop new business opportunities. Good communication and negotiation skills, with the confidence to communicate with customers at different levels. Ability to understand technical problems and explain solutions in a clear and practical way. Customer-oriented, proactive and results-driven approach. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively. Willingness to travel extensively within Türkiye. Valid driving licence. Good command of English, both written and spoken. Good working knowledge of MS Office applications. Based in Istanbul and/or Kocaeli. What You Can Expect This is a field-based role with a high level of customer interaction and responsibility. You will have the opportunity to develop your career across both technical and commercial areas , work with a wide range of industrial customers and gain in-depth knowledge of MotulTech products and applications. If you are an engineer with a strong interest in sales, enjoy working with customers and are looking for a role where you can combine technical knowledge with commercial responsibility, we would be happy to hear from you. If you are interested in joining Motul and believe your profile matches the position, please apply through our career page and indicate your possible starting date. We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Technical Support Engineer - German Speaker
description: Join Eaton, a global leader where equality and inclusivity are at the heart of our mission. Here, everyone is valued and belongs. Be part of a team that delivers cutting-edge, energy-efficient solutions, making a tangible impact on the world. We empower our customers to manage electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical energy more effectively, safely, and sustainably. At Eaton, we’re dedicated to enhancing quality of life and protecting the environment with our innovative energy management technologies and services. Our EMEA Business Service teams empower seamless operations and drive exceptional results across our electrical, industrial, and corporate teams. What You’ll Do The primary role of the Technical Support Engineer is to deliver exceptional technical support and troubleshooting assistance to end-users, customers, and internal partners. Acting as a key point of contact across multiple channels—including telephone, email, and web tickets—this position focuses on EATON's electrical product portfolio, specifically tailored devices within the Electrical division. In this capacity, you will engage with a diverse range of stakeholders, including end customers, wholesalers, distributors, panel builders, designers, logistics teams, quality departments, product management, R&D, manufacturing, and sales or service representatives. Your responsibilities will encompass a variety of pre-sales and post-sales functions, ensuring seamless communication and support. You will provide vital assistance to sales functions across the EMEA region, and partially in APAC and the Americas, addressing technical inquiries, product-specific questions, warranty issues, documentation requests, repair and calibration needs, and troubleshooting challenges. Additionally, you will guide customers in product selection and application assistance through phone and email interactions. As the first point of escalation for non-standard inquiries and advanced troubleshooting related to hardware and software, your expertise will be invaluable. Key Responsibilities Serve as an engineering resource to resolve customer challenges related to single-phase UPS products (both hardware and software) through various communication channels, including phone, email, and web chat. Manage and follow up on hardware and software escalations involving Level 2, Level 3, and Quality teams. Foster customer loyalty by delivering high-quality service and enhancing value through a performance-driven culture. Actively contribute to the organization and daily execution of technical support tasks, leveraging resources such as people, processes, and technology. Maintain up-to-date process documentation to ensure clarity and efficiency. Participate in knowledge-sharing sessions and continuous improvement initiatives, both within the team and across the organization, to implement best practices at BSC Budapest. Collaborate with team members to enhance customer satisfaction, minimize customer effort, and achieve improvements in cycle time and cost through effective problem-solving. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree (BS/BA) in Industrial Engineering (Electrical/Electronic/Mechanical/Energetic) from an accredited institution (MSc/Electrical is an advantage). Skills Understanding of Electrical products and basic applications Basic Network Knowledge Analytical mindset, communication skills, problem-solving Excellent German and English language knowledge What We Can Offer To You Competitive compensation and benefits package Flexible working solutions Excellent working environment – safety and ethics are important for us Culture & Values – we are more than the products we invent and produce – the way we do business is just as important. At Eaton, our values and culture define who we are – both individually and as an organization – and direct our activities every day Learning & Development - we invest in our employees for the long term – not just with salary and benefits, but with ongoing learning and development opportunities, made available through Eaton University We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

title: Information Technology and Administrative Intern - Turkish Speaking - Office Based - Full Time
description: Job Description Background Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are core principles at UNDP: we value diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate, we foster inclusion as a way of ensuring all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, and we ensure equity and fairness in all our actions. Taking a ‘leave no one behind’ approach to our diversity efforts means increasing representation of underserved populations. People who identify as belonging to marginalized or excluded populations are strongly encouraged to apply. Learn more about working at UNDP including our values and inspiring stories. UNDP does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of harassment, including sexual harassment, and discrimination. All selected candidates will, therefore, undergo rigorous reference and background checks. Corporate Background As the lead United Nations agency on international development, UNDP works in 170 countries and territories to eradicate poverty and reduce inequality. We help countries develop policies, leadership skills, partnerships and institutional capabilities to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals. As outlined in the UNDP Strategic Plan 2026-2029, UNDP’s work is guided by four strategic objectives that together define our contribution to human development: expanding prosperity for all, strengthening effective governance, safeguarding a healthy planet and building crisis resilience. These objectives are enabled by three accelerators that drive transformative impact across our portfolio: digital and AI innovation, gender equality and sustainable finance. Through this integrated approach, UNDP supports countries to deliver tangible improvements in people’s lives and to advance sustainable development at scale. UNDP, through its Sustainable Finance Hub (SFH) ( https://sdgfinance.undp.org/) , supports partners in promoting financing for the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). As an accelerator of the UNDP Strategic Plan, sustainable finance strengthens countries’ ability to mobilize, align and deploy finance at scale for national priorities. UNDP supports international and country level policy reform as a catalyst for system-wide change, stronger policy environments, better-functioning markets and more coherent financing strategies for sustainable development. SFH work is delivered through three interconnected portfolios: 1) Public Finance for the SDGs; 2) Private Finance for the SDGs; and 3) Global & Country Financing Policy Frameworks. Internship Office Background The Istanbul International Center for Private Sector in Development (ICPSD) is one of UNDP’s six Global Policy Centers. ICPSD supports governments, the private sector, and foundations to become transformative partners in sustainable development through applied research, policy advisory, advocacy, and the facilitation of public–private dialogue and partnerships. The Centre leads UNDP’s global work on private sector and foundation engagement and provides technical support to UNDP Country Offices across all regions. ICPSD’s work is structured around four interlinked thematic pillars: AI, digital transformation and skills development SDG finance and private sector development Islamic SDG finance and Crisis and resilience. Through these pillars, ICPSD generates evidence, convenes partners, and supports innovative solutions that mobilize private capital, expertise, and innovation in support of the Sustainable Development Goals. ICPSD offers internship opportunities for outstanding graduate-level students. The Programme operates under the rules and regulations of the UNDP Internship Policy. ICPSD is seeking a dedicated and proactive Information Technology and Administrative Intern to join its team in Istanbul, Türkiye. This internship offers a unique opportunity to support the Centre’s information technology infrastructure and administrative operations, contributing to the effective management of digital tools, internal systems, and knowledge management platforms that support ICPSD’s work across its four thematic pillars. The intern will provide ICT support, assist in the administration of internal digital platforms, and contribute to knowledge management activities, including supporting website updates and social media channels to showcase ICPSD’s global partnerships, knowledge products, and country-level engagement. The successful candidate will gain hands-on experience in information technology support, digital platform administration, and knowledge management within an international development organization. The internship provides practical exposure to UNDP’s standards and workflows, while offering the opportunity to work closely with a multicultural team and contribute meaningfully to UNDP’s mission of sustainable development. Duties And Responsibilities Under the overall guidance of Programme Analyst on Knowledge Management and Partnerships and the direct supervision of Administrative Associate, the Information Technology and Administrative Intern will support ICPSD’s management activities. Support the development of basic PowerApps or digital forms to automate routine office tasks and improve data collection efficiency. Assist with routine technical tasks, such as backup procedures and inventory updates. Assist in ensuring compliance with corporate information management standards across all digital platforms used by the team. description: Vacancy: Mechanical Engineer Design R&D who is ‘equipped for impact’ Do you want to be part of a globally operating team of innovators? Do you also think bigger than big? And, do you have what it takes to make an impact? Then we might be looking for you. Find out more about our vacancy for a Mechanical Engineer Design. About Our Organisation We are Huisman. We develop step changing technical solutions and translate these into the design and construction of the largest onshore and offshore installations. For decades, we have been working all over the world for offshore wind, geothermal energy, oil & gas, leisure, civil and port logistics industries. With our passionate workforce and worldwide production, service & sales facilities we are equipped for impact in these times of energy transition. ““Engineering excellence starts with collaboration, that’s how we innovate and deliver on safety, quality and performance.”” Mike van Wingerden About The Position Of Mechanical Engineer Design R&D As a Mechanical Design Engineer at Huisman, you have the opportunity to create creative, innovative designs for mechanical components, steel structures, and complex installations. You play a crucial role in delivering turn-key projects that are fully designed and built in-house. You are the one who creates the design. You independently develop complete mechanical designs. You translate functional requirements into practical, efficient, and intelligent solutions. You follow your design from concept through to production, a unique opportunity! We offer an international, innovative working environment where quality, creativity, and entrepreneurship are central. You will have ample opportunities to grow within the organisation or to further specialise in your field. What do we expect of you? You contribute to project innovations and the further development of our engineering capabilities. You design the mechanical components that form the heart of our systems. Your Responsibilities: Independently developing and elaborating basic and detailed designs of steel structures, mechanical components, and mechanisms. Performing structural calculations and basic FEM analyses to support your designs. Taking into account manufacturability, cost, material selection, production processes, and assembly. Creating, checking, and revising drawings for both design and production purposes. Ensuring your design integrates seamlessly within the overall environment and system design. Developing alternative design solutions in case of production or assembly issues. Coordinating with procurement, suppliers, and other disciplines regarding component and interface specifications. Contributing ideas for the optimisation of existing designs and supporting innovation efforts. Delivering your design to the structural engineer, who further optimises it in consultation and collaboration with you. In short: you create designs that others can build upon. Wondering if you are 'equipped for impact'? You Are: Creative, innovative, and proactive. Strong in communication. A team player who also performs well independently. Solution-oriented, flexible, and detail-oriented. Able to switch quickly in a dynamic project environment. You Have: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering. Dutch and English both written and spoken on a professional level 2–5 years of experience as a Mechanical Engineer within the offshore or maritime sector, or in the heavy steel industry. A passion for complex mechanical systems and design. The ability to prioritise in a technically challenging environment. Experience with AutoCAD and Inventor is an advantage. Some Practical Things We Need You To Have: An EU passport/valid work permit for The Netherlands; A good command of the Dutch and English language verbally and in writing. title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Ontwerp techniek die het verschil maakt Mechanical Engineer Fulltime 38 uur | Oldenzaal Salaris € 3.056,58 – 4.278,69 per maand o.b.v. fulltime (Definitieve inschaling afhankelijk van ervaring) Bij Ropeblock ontwikkelen we hijs- en hefoplossingen die dagelijks tonnen staal verplaatsen in havens, scheepswerven, offshore-installaties en zware industrie. Producten die veilig moeten zijn. Betrouwbaar moeten zijn. En gewoon moeten werken. Daar hebben we sterke engineers voor nodig. Wat ga je doen? Als Mechanical Engineer vertaal je technische uitdagingen naar slimme en maakbare oplossingen. Je ontwerpt, berekent en verbetert producten die wereldwijd worden ingezet onder zware omstandigheden. Je werkt met SolidWorks, voert berekeningen uit, denkt mee over standaardisatie en productverbeteringen en hebt direct invloed op wat uiteindelijk in onze fabriek wordt gebouwd. Geen eindeloze vergaderingen, maar techniek die snel tastbaar wordt. Wat breng je mee? HBO of WO Werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar. Interesse in mechanica, constructies en productontwikkeling. Ervaring met 3D CAD (bij voorkeur SolidWorks) en ERP. Een gestructureerde manier van werken. Eigenaarschap, nieuwsgierigheid en de drive om dingen beter te maken. Wat krijg je van ons? Technische uitdagingen die ertoe doen. Ruimte om initiatief te nemen en verantwoordelijkheid te pakken. Een team van engineers dat houdt van inhoud en vakmanschap. Producten die je daadwerkelijk terugziet bij klanten over de hele wereld. Een nuchtere organisatie waar beslissingen snel worden genomen en goede ideeën worden gewaardeerd. Opleidingen, trainingen en doorgroeimogelijkheden. Flexibele werktijden en mogelijkheden tot hybride werken. Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de cao Metalektro. Waarom Ropeblock? Omdat je hier niet aan een klein onderdeel werkt. Je werkt aan complete technische oplossingen. Je ziet jouw ontwerp van eerste schets tot eindproduct. Je werkt samen met productie, kwaliteit en productmanagement. En je draagt bij aan producten die dagelijks worden gebruikt in de zwaarste toepassingen ter wereld. Enthousiast? Wil jij technische uitdagingen vertalen naar slimme, maakbare ontwerpen en direct invloed hebben op de producten die we bouwen? Stuur dan je CV én motivatie naar vacature@ropeblock.com t.a.v. Jeanette Scholten, HR Officer . Wil je eerst wat meer weten over de functie? Neem gerust contact op met Willem Alink, Manager Engineering & Development, via 088 - 53 23 200 . Ropeblock – Technisch Sterk achter Groots Werk Acquisitie naar aanleiding van onze vacatures is niet gewenst.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. About The Team The Voyager team in Anduril Industries is an engineering and design division with a vast experience in developing innovative computing and communications solutions for the network edge. title: Medarbejder til additiv fremstilling (3D-print) ved Efterretningsregimentet, Varde
description: Har du interesse for og praktisk erfaring med additiv fremstilling (3D-print) og vil du arbejde med hele processen fra idé til det færdige produkt? Så har vi stillingen til dig. Om os Du bliver en del af Intelligence Fusion Centre (IFC), som er en del af 2. Military Intelligence-bataljon ved Efterretningsregimentet. Vi er en organisation bestående af både militære og civile medarbejdere. IFC er et videns- og analysecenter, som udover at varetage den efterretningsmæssige understøttelse af Hærkommandoen, dagligt bearbejder informationer fra forskellige klassificerede og ikke-klassificerede netværk og udarbejder efterretningsprodukter (INTSUM, SUPINTREP, briefinger, temabaserede notater m.m.) til støtte for Hærens uddannelse, styrkeudvikling og omstrukturering samt potentielt kommende missioner og beredskabsenheder på det taktiske niveau. Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads præget af stor faglig stolthed, analytisk kapacitet, gode interne relationer kollegerne imellem, tid til grundighed, vekslende opgaver og plads til udvikling og uddannelse af den enkelte medarbejder. Om stillingen Stillingen omfatter hele processen inden for additiv fremstilling fra idé til det færdige produkt i tæt samarbejde med brugerne og vores samarbejdspartnere. Opgaverne Er Primært Udvikling og printning af 3D-modeller. Kalibrering, fejlfinding og vedligeholdelse af teknisk udstyr. Opbygning af netværk til både interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere. Videndeling samt bidrage til sidemandsoplæring inden for additiv fremstilling. Stillingen er nyoprettet og der er derfor mulighed for at bidrage til udvikling af både stillingen og opgaverne. Om dig Din uddannelsesbaggrund er ikke afgørende. Det vigtigste er, at du har en solid erfaring med additiv fremstilling. Du er teknisk nysgerrig og innovativ både i forhold til opgaveløsning, udvikling, materialer og metoder. Du arbejder selvstændigt, engageret og går positivt til opgaverne. Du prioriterer koordination og kommunikation med de forskellige faggrupper i forhold til både drifts- og udviklingsdelen. Du værdsætter og bidrager aktivt til et godt arbejdsmiljø med plads til smil og kollegialt fællesskab. Ansættelsesvilkår Ansættelsen sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) og Organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK) i staten. Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning. Arbejdsstedet er i Varde. Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet. Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer. Kontakt og ansøgning Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte major Karsten Falck på EFR-2B-100A@mil.dk . Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Sofie Gadegaard på telefon 3266 5585. Ansøgningsfristen er den 30. oktober 2026 og samtaler forventes afholdt i forlængelse heraf. Stillingen er til besættelse 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale. Du søger stillingen via linket, og vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og kopi af uddannelsesbevis. Vær opmærksom på, at bilag skal tilføjes i PDF-format. I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen. Om Efterretningsregimentet Efterretningsregimentet opstiller, uddanner og udsender enheder og enkeltpersoner, som indsamler informationer om modstanderen på kamppladsen. Efterretningsregimentets specialister bearbejder de indsamlede informationer, så Hærens chefer får det bedst mulige grundlag til at træffe beslutninger om militære operationer. Efterretningsregimentet har ansvaret for Hærens udvikling af det efterretningsmæssige område samt uddannelsen af efterretningsspecialister til hele Hæren, ligesom regimentet forestår Survival, Evasion, Resistance and Escape (SERE) i forsvaret. Endvidere uddanner Efterretningsregimentet værnepligtige med henblik på at friske de eksisterende enheder. Efterretningsregimentet består af to bataljoner, en tjenestegrensafdeling samt en regimentsstab. EFR har et tæt samarbejde med Varde og Esbjerg Kommune vedrørende bl.a. tilflytterservice. Med udgangspunkt i dit/jeres behov og ønsker, tilpasser vi støtten i forhold til partnerjob, skole og bolig m.v. Samarbejde med Varde og Esbjerg Kommuner Varde Kommune har en række tilbud til tilflyttere, herunder bistand til bolig og job. Der er mulighed for sparring på jobsøgning og formidling af CV til en række virksomheder. I Varde Kommune har partneren mulighed for at komme til samtale ved udvalgte private og offentlige virksomheder, når der er et match på kvalifikationer. Tilflyttere med ansættelse samt pendlere har derudover fortrinsret til en række lejeboliger i Varde kommune. Esbjerg Kommune har et program for medflyttende partnere med bl.a. sparring på jobsøgning og formidling af CV til en lang række virksomheder. Ligeledes formidles kontakt til private udlejere af lejeboliger. Tilflyttere med ansættelse kan skrive sig op på venteliste hos boligforeningerne i Esbjerg Kommune og rykke frem i køen til lejligheder. Læs mere om, hvad tilflytterservice kan gøre for dig/jer på www.esbjerg.dk/ny-i-esbjerg og www.livetmodvest.dk . Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte bosætningskonsulenterne i Varde Kommune Nadia Steinicke på 3034 4625 og Jens N. Pedersen på 2465 7189 eller på mail bolo@varde.dk . title: Master Thesis: Concept Development for Extended Steering and Tilt Range in Sterndrive Systems
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. Background Sterndrive systems provide propulsion and steering through an drive mounted at the stern of a boat. The steering and tilt ranges of the outdrive are mechanically limited to protect components such as the steering linkage, driveshaft joints, gears, transom assembly, and trim cylinders from interference, excessive loads, or loss of function. These limits can constrain maneuverability and access in shallow-water or other operating conditions. Thesis work objective This thesis aims to develop and assess concepts that enable larger steering and tilt angles while maintaining safe and reliable operation. The wanted outcome is a set of feasible design concepts, together with an assessment of their benefits, technical risks, and further development needs using criteria including achievable angular range, structural strength, durability, manufacturability, serviceability, and impact on steering and propulsion performance. Qualifications And Personal Profile Mechanical design and CAD: model assemblies, check clearances, and develop alternative concepts. Kinematics and mechanisms: understand how the drive moves through steering and tilt ranges, including joint and linkage constraints. Engineering mechanics: assess loads, stresses, and potential failure points in components and connections. Structured concept development: generate, compare, and justify concepts against requirements such as performance, durability, manufacturability, and serviceability. Useful Additional Experience Finite-element analysis or other simulation tools. Hydraulics and steering systems. Marine propulsion, transom assemblies, or corrosion and marine environments. Ready for the next move? Contact: Henrik Eldh, Director Driveline, henrik.eldh@volvo.com Last application date: October 31 We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Who We Are And What We Believe In We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities. Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group . Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. Volvo Penta , a world-leading supplier of engines and complete drive systems for marine and industrial applications, you will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who works with passion, trust each other and embraces change to stay ahead. We make our customers win.

title: Mechatronics Engineer (Entry-level)
description: Cota Robotics puts robots to work in retail stores. We're a small team based at Sankt Eriksgatan in Stockholm, where half the office is our own dark store. About The Role You’ll work hands-on with the robot and make it survive real stores. Why join Build on real robots operating in real stores Work across disciplines rather than in a narrow silo Learn quickly from field deployments and hardware feedback Help shape the next version of the system
