title: Hydraulikingenjör | Olsbergs Hydraulics | Eksjö
description: Vill du vara med och utveckla nästa generations elektrohydrauliska styrsystem i ett världsledande teknikföretag? Lockas du av att arbeta nära avancerad produktutveckling och tekniska lösningar med höga krav på precision och kvalitet? Nu söker vi en erfaren Hydraulikingenjör som vill spela en nyckelroll i Olsbergs Hydraulics fortsatta utvecklingsresa. Om rollen Som Hydraulikingenjör hos Olsbergs Hydraulics blir du en viktig del av företagets R&D-verksamhet i Eksjö. Rollen är bred och kombinerar praktiskt tekniskt arbete med utveckling, testning, felsökning och framtida produktutveckling. Inledningsvis kommer du att bidra i flera pågående utvecklings- och investeringsprojekt kopplade till produktionsutrustning och testmiljöer. På sikt kommer rollen i allt större utsträckning fokusera på utveckling av företagets befintliga och framtida hydrauliska produkter och system. Du arbetar nära kollegor inom utveckling, produktion och kvalitet samtidigt som du har kontaktytor inom Hiabs internationella organisation. Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att omfatta Utveckla och implementera hydraulsystem för både ny och befintlig produktionsutrustning. Genomföra tester och kontroller av vår egen produktionsutrustning. Framtagning av teknisk dokumentation, hydraulikscheman och ritningsunderlag Säkerställa att företaget uppfyller interna kvalitetskrav och säkerhetsstandarder Delta i och driva tekniska utvecklingsprojekt Bidra till framtida produktutveckling inom hydraulik och elektrohydrauliska styrsystem Om dig Vi söker dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av hydraulik och som trivs i en miljö där teknik, kvalitet och problemlösning står i centrum. Du har en god förståelse för hydrauliska komponenter och system och känner dig bekväm med att arbeta både teoretiskt och praktiskt nära produkten. Vi ser gärna att du uppskattar att själv vara ute i verksamheten, testa lösningar, göra justeringar och verifiera resultat. Som person är du analytisk, lösningsorienterad och strukturerad. Du trivs med att arbeta självständigt men har samtidigt god samarbetsförmåga och uppskattar att dela med dig av din kompetens. Krav för tjänsten Flerårig erfarenhet av arbete med hydraulik Erfarenhet av utveckling, felsökning eller verifiering av hydrauliska system God förståelse för tekniska ritningar och hydraulikscheman Tala och skriva obehindrat på svenska och engelska Meriterande Eftergymnasial teknisk utbildning inom exempelvis maskinteknik eller hydraulik Erfarenhet av CAD Vad kan Olsbergs Hydraulics erbjuda dig? Vi erbjuder en varierande och utmanande roll där du får möjlighet att utvecklas inom Olsbergs, som är en del av HIAB. Som medarbetare i ett världsledande företag får du tillgång till ett omfattande nätverk och möjlighet att arbeta med spännande utvecklingsprojekt. Samtidigt värdesätter vi den personliga utvecklingen och det nära samarbetet som kännetecknar vår lokala verksamhet. Samarbete, engagemang, kvalitet och struktur är ledord som genomsyrar vårt arbete. Vi arbetar kontinuerligt för att skapa en trivsam och inkluderande arbetsmiljö där du får möjlighet att växa i din roll och vidareutveckla både din kompetens och ditt ansvar. Olsbergs Hydraulics är idag inne i en expansiv fas med flera strategiska utvecklingsprojekt och internationella satsningar. För rätt person finns därför goda möjligheter att vara med och påverka både produkter, teknik och verksamhetens framtida riktning. Låter detta intressant? I denna rekrytering samarbetar Olsbergs Hydraulics med Jefferson Wells. Vid frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Eva Ekdahl på eva.ekdahl@jeffersonwells.se.Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Vi rekommenderar därför att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! Om Olsbergs Hydraulics Olsbergs Hydraulics, som är en del av Hiab, är världsledande inom utveckling och tillverkning av elektrohydrauliska styrsystem för lastbilskranar, skogskranar och mobila maskinapplikationer. Företagets radiostyrda system används av tiotusentals kranförare världen över och är känt för sin höga precision, prestanda och innovationsförmåga. All utveckling och tillverkning sker i egna svenska anläggningar, vilket säkerställer hög kvalitet genom hela produktionskedjan.

title: FGSE Spaceport Engineer
description: Description Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular. With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, space consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, flight test services, satellite propulsion systems, and much more. SSC also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future. Are you fueled by a passion for people and the ambition to create an awesome workplace? Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help Earth benefit from space? If you answer yes to these questions, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact as Fluidic Ground Support Equipment (FGSE) Spaceport Engineer in our team. We are looking for a dedicated person who shares our core values of Customer passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage. Requirements As a FGSE Spaceport Engineer, you play an important role in enabling safe, reliable, and efficient rocket launch operations. You are responsible for the design, development, implementation, and lifecycle ownership of ground systems supporting vehicle fluid and propulsion systems. The role combines hands-on engineering, system ownership, and close collaboration with operations, suppliers, and customers throughout testing and launch campaigns. In This Role, You Will Collaborate with coworkers and customers to analyze the requirements of ground- and vehicle systems, testing procedures, safety standards, and operational needs. Oversee assembly and integration of systems and components for cryogenic fluids and gases. Coordinate with suppliers, technicians, and other stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate implementation. Have the ownership of systems and subsystems critical to the execution of rocket launch campaigns, resolving issues encountered during the life of the systems. Lead the Concept of Operations definition with the rest of the operational team. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to provide technical support and guidance related to system usage. Both internally and directly with the end-user/customer on site. Continuous improvement of system designs, processes, and workflows to enhance efficiency, reliability, and safety. Incorporate feedback from users and stakeholders to drive iterative improvements. Be an active console operator during tests and launch campaign chronologies in the Launch Control Center Responsibilities To thrive in this role, you have a drive to provide excellence in technical solutions as well as a drive to learn new things. You like technical challenges, collaboration, and teamwork in an international environment. You have some years of experience working with fluid and Cryogenic systems, preferably both hardware and software. You can describe your designs and ideas to customers and colleagues with the ability to communicate complex technical solutions in an easy and understandable way. As required in the Space business, you can write technical documentation and follow formal processes. As well as being a hands-on engineer with a taste for practical work on-site. Benefits WE OFFER YOU A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry. An excellent opportunity for personal and career development. An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world. Additional Benefits In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar. Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year. Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees. Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program. Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams. Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance. LOCATION This is a full-time, permanent position based at our spaceport at Esrange outside of Kiruna. FURTHER INFORMATION For questions regarding employment terms or union-related matters, you are welcome to contact our union representatives: Sveriges Ingenjörer: SverigesIngenjorer-AF@sscspace.com Unionen: unionen@sscspace.com NEXT STEP If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process. You can submit your application up until 2026-11-01, which is the latest possible date for consideration. Please note, however, that the position may be filled before this date, and the advertisement may therefore close earlier. This allows us to manage the process efficiently and give each application the attention it deserves. When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process. description: Vill du arbeta med avancerad försvarsteknik och bidra till att utveckla några av världens främsta system för spårning och identifiering av mål? Hos oss på PU UTAAS & Trackfire blir du en viktig del i utvecklingen av högteknologiska produkter som används på både marina plattformar och landbaserade fordon. Du följer projekten genom hela livscykeln – från kravanalys och design till integration, verifiering och leverans. Rollen innebär många kontaktytor, både internt och externt, vilket gör arbetet både varierande och utvecklande. Trackfire är ett stabiliserat, fjärrmanövrerat vapen- och sensorsystem som kan användas på fordon, fartyg och fasta installationer, och ger hög prestanda oavsett miljö. Läs mer här. Tjänsten är placerad i Järfälla och resor kan förekomma. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter: Hantera och bryta ner tekniska krav till hanterbara nivåer Utforma produkt- och systemarkitektur inklusive gränssnitt Stödja konstruktörer och utvecklare i systemstrukturering Följa systemet genom design, integration och verifiering Delta i offertarbete vid behov Din profil Vi söker dig som är civil- eller högskoleingenjör och har flera års erfarenhet av produktutveckling. Du är strukturerad, analytisk och trivs med att tänka både strategiskt och kommersiellt. Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift, är ett krav. Vi ser gärna att du har god samarbetsförmåga, lätt att bygga nätverk och uppskattar att arbeta i team. Meriterande med erfarenhet inom: Kravhantering och systemarkitektur Sensorer (laser, IR, elektrooptik) Optik, ballistik, styr- och reglersystem Embedded-programvara, elektronik- och mekanikkonstruktion Verktyg som DOORS och Enterprise Architect Vi värdesätter också personliga egenskaper som positiv energi, förmågan att engagera och entusiasmera samt en god kommunikationsförmåga som får teamet att sträva mot gemensamma mål. Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. Allt från att utveckla kod och bygga imponerande försvars- och säkerhetslösningar till att ta en kaffe med en kollega. Varje bidrag räknas. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: The Team Cundall's Building Services Engineering team exists to make buildings dramatically more energy-efficient, sustainable and cost-effective to operate. We're proud of our track record of designing innovative, low-carbon mechanical and electrical solutions that minimise the use of natural resources across some of the UK's most significant and complex projects. You'll join a world-class team that takes skills development seriously - offering mentorship, collaborative working, and clear pathways to Chartership and career progression. Specialists in mechanical, electrical, public health and specialist services work side-by-side, meaning you'll always have expert colleagues to learn from and collaborate with. Based in the heart of Edinburgh, our large, vibrant office is easy to reach by public transport and surrounded by great amenities. More than that, it's a place people genuinely love to work - thanks to a strong team ethos, a collaborative work culture, and a social environment that brings people together. The office itself is a statement of our values: designed to be completely free of fossil fuels, following zero-carbon and circular economy principles. This commitment earned us the British Council for Offices Scotland's prestigious Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) Award in 2026 - recognition we're extremely proud of. The Role If you want your engineering to genuinely matter - shaping buildings that use less energy, generate less carbon, and improve lives for decades - this is the opportunity you've been waiting for. Cundall's Edinburgh team is at the forefront of low-energy design in the UK and internationally, and we're looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to help lead the charge. You'll be trusted with real engineering responsibility from day one: leading mechanical design on diverse, high-profile projects from inception through to handover, and playing a central role in a collaborative, multi-disciplinary team that is serious about sustainability. You will gain exposure to a diverse range of sectors, including Education, Healthcare, Government, Rail, Workplace, Residential, Critical Systems, and Defence, providing the opportunity to contribute to a variety of impactful projects and develop broad industry experience. Whether you're a confident senior practitioner ready to take the next step, or a rising engineer who has demonstrated they're capable of more - we want to hear from you. You will take ownership of the full mechanical design lifecycle - from early-stage concept through detailed design, specification and site handover - across a rich variety of building types and client profiles. Lead the design of mechanical building services: heating, ventilation, cooling, water services, drainage and automated controls Drive projects from inception to handover, making confident, well-reasoned engineering decisions independently Produce high-quality drawings, specifications and equipment schedules using industry-standard tools (AutoCAD, Revit) Carry out engineering calculations and analyses using recognised design principles and software Coordinate building services designs with structural, architectural and other engineering disciplines within the wider design team Represent Cundall professionally in client meetings, design team workshops and contractor discussions Monitor installation quality on site, manage snagging, and lead handover procedures Prepare clear, client-focused technical reports and support Principals and Associates with production information Critically evaluate and champion engineering solutions that align with decarbonisation and passive design principles The Skills We're looking for engineers who combine technical rigour with genuine curiosity. You'll be comfortable working autonomously on smaller commissions and as a collaborative team member on large, complex projects. At least 4 years' experience in a professional building services design consultancy A degree (or equivalent) in Mechanical, Building Services or Architectural Engineering A thorough understanding of RIBA Design stages and the level of information required at each gateway Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit and the Microsoft Office suite A genuine passion for low-energy architecture, passive design strategies, and decarbonisation Membership of a relevant professional engineering institute (preferred) — or active progress toward it An interest in digital engineering and AI-assisted tools that improve project efficiency and accuracy Job Description Your career at Cundall We know that to be the best at what we do we need a diverse workforce underpinned by an inclusive culture. Creating environments where everyone can find joy doing their best work is also great for everyone. That’s why we positively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and encourage, support, and celebrate the diverse voices of our people.

title: Open vacature – Constructeur/ Modelleur Industrie & Gebouwen (Structural Engineering)
description: Heb jij een passie voor constructief ontwerp, modelleren en techniek? Bij Haskoning zijn we altijd benieuwd naar bevlogen constructeurs en modelleurs die willen bijdragen aan duurzame, innovatieve projecten in de industrie en gebouwde omgeving. We hebben niet altijd direct vacatures openstaan, maar we willen graag mensen de kans geven om te solliciteren, die ons team kunnen versterken zodra de gelegenheid zich voordoet. Deze open vacature is bedoeld voor professionals van alle senioriteitsniveaus – van starter tot ervaren specialist – om de kans te krijgen te solliciteren, voor onze locaties in Amsterdam, Delft, Eindhoven & Nijmegen. Wat je bij ons kunt doen als Constructeur/ Modelleur Industrie & Gebouwen Als constructeur of modelleur werk je samen met collega’s aan het ontwerpen, berekenen en modelleren van constructies voor industriële en gebouwde projecten in Nederland en daarbuiten. Je draagt bij aan de kwaliteit, veiligheid en duurzaamheid van onze ontwerpen en krijgt de ruimte om te groeien in de richting die bij jou past. Je houdt je onder meer bezig met Het berekenen, ontwerpen en modelleren van staal-, beton- en houtconstructies; Het opzetten en beheren van 3D-modellen in multidisciplinaire BIM-omgevingen; Het samenwerken met architecten, installatietechnici en andere disciplines; Het bijdragen aan digitalisering, parametrisch ontwerpen en automatisering; Het verbeteren van processen en kennisdeling binnen het team. Waar je komt te werken Bij Haskoning kom je te werken bij een onafhankelijk adviesbureau dat ingenieurs-, ontwerp- en adviesdiensten combineert met software en technologie. Onze missie, “Enhancing Society Together" drijft ons om een positieve impact op de wereld te creëren. Wij bieden uitdagend werk in diverse internationale projecten, waarbij we gebruik maken van onze 140+ jaar aan expertise. Met meer dan 6.800 medewerkers in meer dan 25 landen zetten we samen uitdagingen om in kansen om zo een positieve impact op de samenleving te maken. We werken samen met toonaangevende klanten in markten zoals infrastructuur, klimaatbestendigheid, hernieuwbare energie, decarbonisatie van de industrie en duurzame mobiliteit. Wat je meebrengt Je bent nieuwsgierig, zorgvuldig en hebt oog voor detail. Je werkt graag samen, denkt in oplossingen en krijgt energie van technische uitdagingen. Daarnaast beschik je over Een opleiding in Bouwkunde of Civiele Techniek, als basis voor constructief inzicht en ontwerpkennis; Ervaring of ambitie in constructief ontwerpen, modelleren of berekenen; Affiniteit met digitale tools zoals Revit, Tekla of rekensoftware, om efficiënt en nauwkeurig te werken; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden, nodig voor samenwerking in multidisciplinaire teams; Een leergierige houding, zodat je blijft groeien binnen een innovatieve werkomgeving. Wat je van ons kan verwachten Bij Haskoning geloven we dat het welzijn van onze medewerkers cruciaal is voor ons gezamenlijke succes. Daarom bieden we een uitgebreid pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden die zijn ontworpen om jouw professionele en persoonlijke groei te ondersteunen. Wat wij bieden Een goede basis: Een goed primair salaris (€ 3.091 - € 6.679) dat jaarlijks groeit. Aantrekkelijk secundaire voorwaarden: Goede pensioenopbouw met een werkgeversbijdrage van 18,3%, 2,15% persoonlijk budget en jaarlijkse winstdeling. Daarnaast kun je aandelen kopen van onze organisatie en zo meedelen in ons gezamenlijke succes; Werk-privébalans: 28 vakantiedagen (op basis van fulltime) met de mogelijkheid om 16,5 dag per jaar bij te kopen en drie feestdagen in te ruilen voor een dag die voor jou belangrijk is. We werken hybride met flexibele werktijden, een thuiswerkvergoeding en een volledige ingerichte thuiswerkplek; Ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden: Diverse opleidings- en ontwikkelingsprogramma’s zoals leer- en ontwikkelpaden afgestemd op jouw expertise, learning weeks en verschillende kennisgroepen; Bereikbaarheid en reiskostenvergoeding: Een goed bereikbare werkplek op één van onze kantoren, reiskostenvergoeding en NS-Business Card. Kom je lopend of met de fiets naar kantoor? Dan ontvang je een hogere reiskostenvergoeding – zo stimuleren we duurzaam reizen; Informele en inclusieve cultuur: een informele en open cultuur waar iedereen zich welkom voelt met vrijblijvende sociale en sportieve activiteiten en diverse netwerken zoals Pride, Young Haskoning. Meer over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden vind je hier. Wil jij onze nieuwe collega worden en zie jij geen concrete vacature die bij jouw situatie past? Dan zien we je open sollicitatie graag tegemoet! Klik op de sollicitatieknop en upload je cv en motivatiebrief. Na ontvangst van je sollicitatie nemen we zo snel mogelijk contact met je op. Na je sollicitatie gaan we kijken of we mogelijkheden hebben voor jouw profiel. Heb je vragen over de functie of het proces? Je kunt altijd contact opnemen met Pieter van Rhee, Recruiter Multinationals & Mission Critical Facilities, via pieter.van.rhee@haskoning.com, of Devika Jagmohan, Recruiter BuildingsNL, via devika.jagmohan@haskoning.com. Wij zetten we ons in voor een diverse en inclusieve werkplek waar iedereen zich gewaardeerd, gerespecteerd en empowered voelt. Ongeacht je ervaring, afkomst, leeftijd, gender, of andere persoonlijke kenmerken—bij ons ben je welkom. Lees meer over onze ED&I-initiatieven op onze webpagina . Vanwege de privacywetgeving verzoeken we je om je sollicitatie via de sollicitatieknop in te dienen en niet via e-mail. Acquisitie voor deze vacature door bureaus wordt niet op prijs gesteld en aangeboden kandidaten worden niet in overweging genomen.

title: Associate / Principal Structural Engineer

This role is designed for an experienced professional who enjoys solving complex problems and delivering high-quality structural design within a highly regulated environment. WORKING ENVIRONMENT This role offers flexible and hybrid working arrangements, combining office collaboration with remote working depending on project requirements. You will work within multidisciplinary engineering teams based in Cumbria, with occasional travel to client sites where required. Due to the nature of the projects involved, the role requires the ability to obtain and maintain UK security clearance, and a full UK driving licence may be required for certain site visits. ROLE SCOPE AND PURPOSE This role focuses on delivering technically robust structural engineering solutions within the nuclear sector. Working as part of multidisciplinary teams, you will provide specialist design, analysis and assurance across projects from early concept through to detailed design and implementation. You will act as a technical authority within project teams, ensuring designs meet nuclear, industry and statutory standards while supporting safe and compliant project delivery. The position is centred on hands-on engineering expertise, allowing you to concentrate on complex technical work, independent verification activities and maintaining the highest standards of quality and regulatory compliance. Your expertise will play a critical role in enabling safe and reliable nuclear infrastructure. By delivering technically sound design and analysis, contributing to safety case development and supporting robust engineering decision-making, you will help ensure projects meet the demanding expectations of the nuclear industry. Your input will support multidisciplinary collaboration, strengthen technical assurance processes and contribute to the successful delivery of projects that operate within strict regulatory frameworks. You will act as a subject-matter specialist within project teams, maintain knowledge of evolving nuclear standards and regulatory guidance and promote engineering excellence and continuous improvement in technical practices. Work closely with engineers, project managers and clients to resolve complex technical challenges and support informed engineering decisions across projects QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS You will hold a degree in Civil, Structural or a related engineering discipline and be a Chartered Engineer with a recognised professional institution. title: Truck Customization - Design Engineer
description: Transport vormt de kern van onze moderne samenleving. Stel je voor dat je jouw expertise kan toepassen om duurzame transport- en infrastructureoplossingen voor de toekomst vorm te geven. Wil je een verschil maken op wereldwijde schaal en hierbij gebruik maken van de nieuwste technologieën en deel uitmaken van een sterk team? Dan zijn wij wellicht de perfecte match! Introductie De Volvo vrachtwagenfabriek in Gent is de grootste vrachtwagenfabriek binnen de Volvo Group. Elke dag werken bijna 3.000 collega’s samen om vrachtwagens van topkwaliteit te bouwen. Innovatie en continue verbetering zitten ingebakken in ons dagelijkse werk, en we geloven sterk in Lean Manufacturing, waarbij kwaliteit, veiligheid en milieuzorg onze hoogste prioriteit hebben. Onze locatie in Gent bestaat tegenwoordig uit veel verschillende afdelingen, maar één ding hebben we allemaal gemeen: we zijn gepassioneerd over het bouwen van vrachtwagens. Ontmoet jouw team Je komt terecht in een team van engineers die samen werken om trucks aan te passen aan de noden van de klant. We ondersteunen elkaar om de klant een kwalitatieve en technisch haalbare oplossing te bieden. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat de truck voldoet aan de specificaties van de klant. Jouw ideale job Je helpt standaard voertuigen aan te passen aan de specifieke vraag van de klant. Je werkt technische niet-standaard concepten uit zodat deze hier in onze fabriek geassembleerd kunnen worden en documenteert deze. Je ontwerpt technische oplossingen en geeft advies aan andere afdelingen. Je neemt zelfstandig beslissingen en draagt eindverantwoordelijkheid over jouw concepten. Jouw profiel Je hebt een technische bachelor- of masteropleiding, of gelijkwaardige ervaring. Kennis van vrachtwagens is een groot pluspunt. Ervaring is niet noodzakelijk, interesse in automotive wel. Je werkt graag in teamverband. Je bent organisatorisch en administratief onderlegd. Je werkt zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en gestructureerd. Je hebt een goede kennis van MS Office en kan technische tekeningen interpreteren. Je beheerst Nederlands en Engels zeer goed; andere talen zijn een plus. Wat wij bieden Een functie in een hecht team binnen een internationale omgeving. De kans om je kennis en expertise in te zetten en verder uit te bouwen. Veel aandacht voor groei en ontwikkeling. Een aantrekkelijk salarispakket. Doorgroeimogelijkheden. Flexibele uren en een goede work-life balance. Over Volvo Group We bouwen mee aan de toekomst van efficiënt, veilig en duurzaam transport. Je werkt samen met sterke en creatieve collega’s aan oplossingen voor de volgende generatie. Teamwork, inclusiviteit en empowerment staan centraal in onze cultuur. Binnen Trucks Technology & Industrial Division werk je in decentrale teams die dicht bij de klant staan. Samen creëren we innovatieve en duurzame oplossingen met echte impact. We hechten belang aan jouw privacy en daarom accepteren wij geen sollicitaties via mail. Wie we zijn en waar we in geloven We zijn toegewijd aan het vormgeven van de toekomstige landschap van efficiënte, veilige en duurzame transportoplossingen. Het vervullen van onze missie creëert ontelbare carrièremogelijkheden voor talenten binnen de toonaangevende merken en entiteiten van de groep. Solliciteren op deze functie biedt je de kans om je bij de Volvo Group aan te sluiten. Elke dag werk je samen met enkele van de scherpste en meest creatieve geesten in ons vakgebied om onze samenleving in een betere staat achter te laten voor de volgende generatie. We zijn gepassioneerd over wat we doen en gedijen op teamwork. We zijn bijna 100.000 mensen die wereldwijd verenigd zijn door een cultuur van zorg, inclusiviteit en empowerment. De divisie Trucks Technology & Industrial neemt teamspelers aan die klaar zijn om echte impact te maken voor onze klanten. Onze gedecentraliseerde teams werken dicht bij onze klanten, met snelheid en autonomie, om te bouwen wat zij echt nodig hebben.Sluit je bij ons aan om samen te werken aan innovatieve, duurzame technologieën die opnieuw definiëren hoe wij waarde ontwerpen, bouwen en leveren. Breng je nieuwsgierigheid, je expertise en je samenwerkingskracht mee en samen zullen we gedurfde ideeën omzetten in tastbare oplossingen voor onze klanten en bijdragen aan een duurzamere toekomst.

title: Principal Engineer, MEMS Development
description: About SiTime SiTime is the Precision Timing company. Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT. Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com . Job Summary Join the team that is revolutionizing the timing industry with the best Microelectromechanical Systems (MEMS) timing products in the world. As a Principal MEMS Development Engineer, you will use your technical and creative problem-solving skills to push forward MEMS technology and engineer resonators for SiTime’s next-generation timing products. It is not necessary to meet all job requirements to be a qualified candidate for the position. Responsibilities Lead definition and execution of challenging technical projects. Advise management of challenges, impact, recommendations. Develop new or improved resonators, MEMS technologies and/or products. Design MEMS devices and characterize their electrical, mechanical, and thermal performance on wafer level and/or device level. Work with process team to drive continuous improvement in MEMS yields. Extend and enhance automated infrastructure for MEMS design, measurements, and data analysis. Design and analyze experiments to understand device physics, materials, and fabrication. Interface with local and overseas vendors. Work in cross-functional teams, including circuits, systems, and packaging. Working/supporting other projects as needed. Qualifications & Requirements Ph.D. in ME, EE, Physics, or equivalent At least 3 years of industry experience. Skilled scientist with ability to design, conduct, and analyze experiments. Excellent problem identification and problem-solving abilities. Excellent knowledge of mechanics, electrodynamics, thermodynamics. Knowledge in fundamentals of MEMS devices physics and fabrication. Experience with finite element simulation tools (COMSOL, ANSYS) and data processing tools (Matlab, Python). Excellent interpersonal, organizational, written and verbal communication skills. Passion for delivering exceptional results. Desired Characteristics & Attributes 3 -10 years of industry experience. Intermediate to advanced knowledge of programing languages, circuits, metrology equipment and methods. Experience with Statistical analysis and tools such as R or JMP. Experience in RF device characterization and RF prober systems Knowledge in MEMS microfabrication. С ompensation range: At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of innovation goals – reflecting our commitment to recognizing meaningful impact. We also offer equity grants, providing a meaningful opportunity to share in the company’s future growth and success. SiTime is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We treat each person fairly and we do not tolerate discrimination or harassment against anyone on the basis of any protected characteristics, including race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy, political affiliation, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, or marital status or other characteristics protected by law. title: Device Test Technician
description: Department: Device Development Location: invoX Belgium N.V. Description In this role, you will play a key part in the design, development, build, and validation of in-house test setups and fixtures, enabling robust testing of inhalation devices and sub-components. You will work closely with the device engineering team while also being able to independently execute tests, analyse results, and iterate designs in a fast-paced R&D environment. Additionally, you will maintain laboratory equipment and ensure all safety guidelines are followed. Your role will also involve preparing shipments of samples to external parties and collaborating closely with the office manager. Use 3D CAD tools to design test parts, prototypes, and mechanical component Build and iterate prototypes using rapid prototyping equipment, including FDM & resin 3D printers, CNC milling equipment. Execute mechanical and functional tests on devices and sub-assemblies and perform hands-on testing yourself. Prepare test protocols, configure test setups, and ensure accurate and traceable data collection. Analyse test results, document findings, and provide feedback for design improvement. Develop and improve test methods and procedures to increase reliability and repeatability. Maintain laboratory equipment, tools, and prototyping machines, ensuring safe and efficient operation. Collaborate closely with device engineers and cross-functional teams in an international environment. Ensure that all safety guidelines are followed and maintain a clean and orderly environment. Prepare shipments of samples to external parties as required, in close collaboration with the office manager. Essential Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Graduated in a (elektro-)mechanical engineering discipline or experience in a physical test lab environment Strong hands-on technical profile with experience in development of mechanical or electromechanical test set designing and assembling prototypes, and executing laboratory or engineering tests. Ability to work autonomously with a practical, problem-solving, and can-do mindset. Good understanding of the English language, both written and spoken. Strong planning, organization, and documentation skills. Team player who enjoys working in a hands-on innovation environment. Desirable Experience with medical devices. Knowledge of laboratory safety guidelines. Familiarity with maintaining laboratory equipment and ordering supplies. Why work at invoX? We get things done, we keep things simple and we are driven by the science. We are ambitious so we work hard to create an environment where we can take smart risks. We want to be innovative so encourage debate and collaboration to challenge the usual way of doing things. We love our celebrations and socialising, which make invoX a fun and diverse place to work. And most of all, everyone has the opportunity to make a difference.

title: Dolum ve Paketleme Ekipmanları Mühendisi
description: Sütaşkımız Sizinle Birlikte Büyüyor Sütün iyiliği ve bereketini yayma misyonu ile çalışan ve her biri işinin uzmanı 5.000 çalışma arkadaşımızın yanı sıra satış dağıtım grubundaki iş ortaklarımız ile birlikte 7.500 kişilik büyük bir aileyiz. Her geçen gün büyüyen Sütaş Ailesi’ne, yaratıcı, yenilikçi, heyecanı yüksek, uluslararası platformlarda çalışabilecek, takım çalışmasını seven çalışma arkadaşları katmak istiyoruz. Misyonumuzu benimseyen, vizyonumuzu paylaşan, değerlerimizi kendi değerleri ile örtüştüren, “Çiftlikten Sofralara” entegre iş modelimiz doğrultusunda gıda mühendisliği, makine mühendisliği, endüstri mühendisliği, veterinerlik, elektrik elektronik mühendisliği, işletme, iktisat, bilgisayar mühendisliği, yazılım mühendisliği gibi pek çok farklı bölümden mezun geleceğin Sütaş'lıları ile tanışma heyecanı içindeyiz. Siz de bu aileye katılarak Sütaş'lı olmaya ne dersiniz? Sütaş A.Ş. Bingöl Fabrikasında görevlendirilmek üzere "Dolum ve Paketleme Ekipmanları Mühendisi" pozisyonunda aramıza katılmanız için başvurunuzu bekliyoruz. Nasıl Bir Takım Arkadaşı Arıyoruz ? Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği ya da Mekatronik Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, Alanında 1-2 yıl deneyim sahibi, İleri seviyede İngilizce bilgisi olan, MS Office Programlarına ve Autocad uygulamasına hakim, Ekip çalışmasına yatkın, analitik becerileri güçlü, sonuç odaklı, Bingöl'de ikamet eden/edebilecek olan. Takım Arkadaşımızdan Ne Bekliyoruz? Dolum ve paketleme makinelerinin, planlı bakımlarının gerçekleştirilmesi, yedek parça çalışmalarının yapılması ve bu makinelerde iyileştirme projelerinin gerçekleştirilmesi, Saha içerisindeki tüm arıza bakımlarından sorumlu olunması, Yeni alınan makinelerin SAP 'ye kayıtlarının yapılması ve periyodik bakımların sisteme tanıtılması, Yeni Kurulan dolum ve paketleme makinelerinin devreye alma çalışmalarının yapılması, envanter listelerinin çıkartılması ve bakım talimatlarının hazırlanması safhasında ilgili bölümle koordineli bir şekilde çalışmaların yürütülmesi, Makine verimliliklerini günlük olarak takip etmesi, analizlerini yapması ve makinelerin hedeflenen verimlilikte çalışması için gerekli aksiyonların alınması, Makine verimliliklerini arttıracak projelerin geliştirilmesi. Sütaş ‘ta sizin için neler var ? Çalışma arkadaşlarımızın potansiyellerini en üst seviyede gerçekleştirebilmeleri için kişisel gelişimlerini, bilgi, beceri ve yetkinliklerini destekler, fikir ve önerilerine değer verir, kazanımlarını, kariyer beklentilerini, iş sonuçlarını ve organizasyonun ihtiyaçlarını değerlendirerek onlara kariyer yolculuklarının ilerleyen yıllarında da farklı lokasyon ve iş kolları arasında geçiş imkanı sunarız. "6698 sayılı Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu kapsamında, kişisel verilerinizin işlenmesinden doğan haklarınıza ve bu konudaki detaylı bilgiye Sütaş KVKK Aday Aydınlatma Metni | Sütaş adresinde yer alan aydınlatma metnimizden ulaşabilirsiniz ."

title: Technical Engineer, Surgical Robot (Medbot)(Based in Turkey)
description: Role Overview The Technical Engineer, MedBot is responsible for providing technical support, installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and field service support for MicroPort MedBot surgical robotic systems across Turkey and surrounding markets as required. The role will work closely with commercial, clinical, training, and customer service teams to ensure optimal system performance and a high level of customer satisfaction. This position requires strong technical aptitude, a customer-focused mindset, and the flexibility to travel extensively within the region and internationally when required. Job Responsibilities System Installation & Commissioning Perform installation, setup, testing, and commissioning of MedBot robotic systems at customer sites. Conduct system verification and ensure all technical requirements are met prior to handover. Provide technical support during product launches and new customer implementations. Technical Service & Maintenance Perform preventive and corrective maintenance activities on robotic systems and associated equipment. Diagnose and troubleshoot hardware, software, and system-related issues. Ensure timely resolution of technical issues to minimize system downtime. Maintain service records and technical documentation in accordance with company procedures. Clinical & Customer Support Provide on-site technical support during clinical procedures when required. Support surgeons, hospital staff, and users with technical product operation. Respond promptly to customer inquiries and technical service requests. Build strong relationships with hospitals, distributors, and key stakeholders. Training & Product Support Support customer training activities related to system operation and maintenance. Assist in technical demonstrations, workshops, and clinical education programs. Work closely with Training and Clinical teams to ensure successful customer adoption. Quality & Compliance Ensure all service activities are conducted in compliance with company policies, quality standards, and regulatory requirements. Support complaint investigations and technical assessments as required. Escalate product quality and technical issues through appropriate channels. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Clinical Affairs, Training, and Regulatory teams to support business objectives. Provide field feedback to R&D and Product Management teams to drive continuous product improvement. Support distributors and service partners on technical matters. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Medical Technology, or related discipline. Minimum 3–5 years of experience in technical service, field service engineering, clinical support, or medical device support. Experience supporting capital medical equipment is required. Experience with surgical robotics, or advanced medical technologies is highly preferred. Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills covering both hardware and software systems. Experience working in hospital and operating room environments is advantageous. Strong customer service and communication skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. Language Fluent English (written and spoken). Turkish language proficiency required. Travel Willingness to travel extensively within Turkey and internationally as business needs require.

title: Control and Systems Engineer – Wind Power Plants
description: About us At MOGAN, a subsidiary of GÜRİŞ Group Companies, we are dedicated to leading the way in renewable energy solutions. Our mission is to create sustainable energy systems that not only meet today’s needs but also safeguard our planet for future generations. Your Growth Starts Here As one of the largest and oldest conglomerates of Türkiye, you will take part in advance and innovative projects. From the moment you join GÜRİŞ, we will support your personal and professional development so that you grow with the company. title: R&D and Innovation Manager
description: Farplas is one of the leading automotive suppliers globally, providing parts, equipment, and services used in vehicle production to many top automotive manufacturers, including Toyota, Renault, Hyundai, Ford, Tofaş-Fiat, and Togg, with a diverse product range. Utilizing advanced technology and high-quality production processes, Farplas delivers innovative and customized solutions for its customers. With state-of-the-art production facilities and automation systems, Farplas prioritizes quality and efficiency, aiming to strengthen its competitive edge through sustainability and an environmentally friendly approach. As a trusted solution partner, Farplas is committed to excellence across all its operations. Would you want to make a difference on this journey, where we embrace the values of persistence, passion, people, purpose, progress and the planet? What Does the R&D and Innovation Manager at Farplas? Contribute to the development of the innovation and industrial technology roadmap in line with the company’s strategic objectives and manage the projects under their responsibility. Monitor developments in automotive, mobility, and advanced manufacturing technologies to identify new technology and application opportunities that will strengthen the company’s manufacturing capabilities. Work closely with shop-floor, engineering, and operations teams to translate on-site needs, technical challenges, and improvement opportunities into innovation projects. Research and evaluate emerging technologies, smart automation solutions, digital manufacturing systems, and AI-enabled applications that can be implemented in manufacturing processes. Collaborate with relevant functions to conduct feasibility studies, prototype development, and pilot implementation activities to assess the applicability of new technologies. Evaluate the technical and economic benefits of innovation projects, supporting the transfer and scaling of successful pilot applications across relevant operations and engineering teams. Strengthen collaboration in technology development and innovation among R&D, Product and Process Development, Manufacturing, Quality, Maintenance, Information Technology, and Operational Excellence teams. Contribute to the development of an innovation culture across the company by supporting the evaluation and development of innovative ideas originating from the shop floor and translating them into viable projects. Support the adoption of new technologies by developing partnerships with universities, research centers, technology startups, technology suppliers, and industry organizations. Identify opportunities for nationally and internationally funded projects in new manufacturing technologies and industrial innovation, working in coordination with relevant R&D and corporate functions. Manage the prioritization of innovation projects, budget and resource planning, implementation timelines, and performance indicators. Measure and report innovation outcomes to management in terms of technological advancements, manufacturing efficiency, quality, sustainability, and economic contribution. Define team objectives, support the development of technical competencies, and foster a working environment that promotes cross-functional collaboration. What Are the Requirements for a R&D and Innovation Manager at Farplas? A degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Electrical and Electronics, Industrial, Materials Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. At least 10 years of experience, preferably in the automotive industry or advanced manufacturing technologies. Strong experience in at least one of the following areas: manufacturing technologies, industrial innovation, technology development, or advanced manufacturing systems. Hands-on experience working closely with shop-floor teams and translating technical needs into innovative technology projects. Experience in evaluating emerging technologies, conducting feasibility studies, implementing pilot applications, and deploying technologies at an industrial scale. Knowledge of smart manufacturing, Industry 4.0, automation, digitalization, and industrial applications of artificial intelligence. Experience in cross-functional project management, technology partnerships, and stakeholder management. Strong strategic and analytical thinking skills, with the ability to identify technology opportunities and translate innovative ideas into viable projects. Experience in project prioritization, budget management, resource planning, and investment feasibility assessment. Leadership capabilities in team management, employee development, and fostering a culture of collaboration. Advanced proficiency in English and the ability to communicate effectively in an international business environment. Strong communication, problem-solving, planning, and results-oriented working skills. What Does the Recruitment Process Look Like? Submit Your Application Competency-Based Interview Assessment Tools Reference Check Final Steps & Offer You can explore all job and internship opportunities at Farplas via LinkedIn and Kariyer.net. If you share our passion and values, we look forward to meeting you,

title: Kalite Güvence Uzmanı
description: İş tanımı: Dünyayı hareket ettiren herkes için geliştirerek üretiyoruz! Mercedes-Benz Türk olarak İstanbul ve Aksaray'da bulunan fabrikalarımızda mobilitenin geleceğini şekillendirmek için Kamyon & Otobüs geliştiriyor ve üretiyoruz. Daimler Truck AG'nin üretim ve Ar-Ge ağının önemli bir parçasıyız. Yaptığımız her şey, daha temiz, daha güvenli ve verimli bir geleceğe katkıda bulunuyor. İşe başlarken önce dinliyoruz, farklılıklarımızdan ilham alıyoruz ve birlikte çözüm üretiyoruz. Uzun vadeli bakış açısıyla liderlik ediyor ve birlikte ilerleyerek fark yaratıyoruz. Dünyayı hareket ettirmek için ekibimizin bir parçası olmaya hazır mısın? Bu rolde neden önemlisin? Üretimde hata riskini azaltır , Güvenliği standart değil refleks haline getirir, Kaliteyi kağıt üzerinde değil, sahada yaşatır . Yani yaptığın iş sadece bugünü değil, markanın gelecekteki güvenini de şekillendirir. Pozisyondan neler bekleyebilirsin: Üretim süreçlerinde ortaya çıkan müşteri ve iç kalite şikayetlerini analiz edecek, kök nedenleri belirleyerek kalıcı çözümler geliştireceksin. Yapıştırma, izolasyon ve boya proseslerine yönelik laboratuvar testlerini gerçekleştirerek kalite standartlarının sürdürülebilirliğine katkı sağlayacaksın. Yapıştırma proseslerine ilişkin yıllık denetimlerin (audit) planlama ve yürütme süreçlerinde aktif rol alacaksın. Sorumlu olduğun proseslere ait çalışma talimatlarını hazırlayacak, güncelliklerini takip edecek ve gerekli revizyonları yöneteceksin. Yapıştırma, izolasyon ve boya proseslerine ilişkin araç deneme çalışmalarının koordinasyonunu sağlayacaksın. Üretim sırasında tespit edilen hata bildirimlerinin açılması, takibi ve aksiyonların koordinasyonundan sorumlu olacaksın. Farklı disiplinlerden ekiplerle iş birliği yaparak kalite iyileştirme projelerine katkı sunacaksın. Bu rol için doğru eşleşme olabilirsin: Zorunlu nitelikler Kimya, Boya Teknolojisi veya ilgili alanlarda ön lisans mezunu olmak SAP ve MS Office uygulamalarını etkin kullanabilmek Dinamik bir üretim ortamında sonuç odaklı çalışabilmek Analiz etme ve problem çözme becerilerine sahip olmak Takım çalışmasına yatkın olmak ve farklı fonksiyonlarla etkin iş birliği kurabilmek Planlama, organizasyon ve zaman yönetimi konularında güçlü olmak Artı nitelikler (tercih sebebi) ISO 9001 Kalite Yönetim Sistemi konusunda bilgi veya deneyim sahibi olmak Kalite güvence, proses kalite veya laboratuvar süreçlerinde deneyim sahibi olmak Yapıştırma, izolasyon veya boya prosesleri konusunda bilgi sahibi olmak Denetim (audit), kök neden analizi ve iyileştirme çalışmalarında görev almış olmak Disiplinler arası proje ekiplerinde aktif rol alma deneyimine sahip olmak Neden bize katılmalısın? • Dünyayı ileri taşı: Türkiye’de üretilen her 10 kamyondan 7’si ve her 10 otobüsten 4’ü imzamızı taşıyor. • Mobilitenin geleceğini şekillendir: Yıldızdan aldığımız ilhamla, çığır açan elektrikli araç projeleriyle inovasyona yön veriyoruz. Bugünkü fikirlerin, yarının dünyasının nasıl hareket edeceğini değiştirebilir. • Global etki, yerel kökler: 40’tan fazla lokasyonda 100.000 çalışma arkadaşımızla gerçek anlamda çok uluslu bir kültürü temsil ediyor; Daimler Truck içinde bilgi birikimimizi ve etkimizi dünyaya taşıyoruz. • Amaca bağlı sürdürülebilirlik: Bizim için sürdürülebilirlik bir trend değil, Birleşmiş Milletler Sürdürülebilir Kalkınma Amaçları ile tam uyumlu bir sorumluluk. • Sınır tanımayan gelişim: Fonksiyonlar arası, lokasyonlar arası ve uluslararası rotasyon fırsatlarıyla kariyerinin önünde sınır yok. • Öğren & geliş: Her adımda gelişimini destekleyen sürekli öğrenme, mentorluk ve gelişim programlarından yararlan. • İşin ötesinde iyi yaşam: 20+ aktif hobi ve spor kulübü ile milli takımlara sponsorluklarımız sayesinde, hayatı sahada ve saha dışında birlikte kutluyoruz. Bize katılmak için: Başvuru: Kendini tanıt ve bu rol için neden güçlü bir aday olduğunu paylaş! Değerlendirme: Bu pozisyon için hazırladığımız test ve araçlarla yetkinliklerini göster. Unutma! Her pozisyon farklıdır ve farklı beceriler gerektirir. Mülakat: Tanışalım! Birbirimizi daha yakından tanıyalım. Teklif: Tüm adımlar tamamlandığında teklifimizi ileteceğiz. Karar zamanı! Mercedes-Benz Türk’te çeşitliliği destekliyor, hakkaniyetli ve kapsayıcı bir şirket kültürünü savunuyoruz. Çalışma arkadaşlarımızın bireysel yetkinliklerine değer veriyoruz; çünkü en iyi takım performansını ve dolayısıyla şirketimizin başarısını bununla sağlıyoruz. Ekiplerimizdeki çeşitliliği destekleyecek farklı yaş, kültür, din, cinsiyet, cinsel kimlik, cinsel yönelim, medeni durum, ebeveynlik durumu ve engellilik durumlarına sahip tüm başvuruları memnuniyetle kabul ediyor ve değerlendiriyoruz. Bu nedenle; tüm kriterleri karşılamasanız dahi başvurunuzu bekliyoruz - benzersiz yetkinlikleriniz ve hikayeniz tam da aradığımız özellikler olabilir.

title: Satış Mühendisi
description: Norm Holding Hakkında Yarım asrı aşan köklü geçmişimizden aldığımız güçle, 3.800 çalışma arkadaşımız, 25 şirketimiz, 24 üretim tesisimiz ve 4 Ar-Ge ve Tasarım Merkezimiz ile büyümeye devam ediyoruz. Türkiye, ABD ve Fas'taki üretim, satış ve lojistik merkezlerimizin yanı sıra Almanya, Birleşik Krallık, Fransa, Polonya, Romanya ve Çin'deki satış ve lojistik merkezlerimiz aracılığıyla ürünlerimizi 50’nin üzerinde ülkeye ulaştırıyoruz. Bağlantı elemanları, ticaret, sıcak dövme, kimya, kalıp ve talaşlı imalat, sac şekillendirme, eklemeli imalat, teknoloji, makine ve otomasyon ile tarım ve gıda olmak üzere 10 farklı sektörde faaliyet gösteriyoruz. Çalışma kültürümüzün temelinde sürekli öğrenme ve gelişim, iş birliği ve sorumluluk alma anlayışı yer alıyor. Çalışma arkadaşlarımıza farklı deneyimler kazanabilecekleri, yetkinliklerini geliştirebilecekleri ve uluslararası ölçekte projelerde görev alabilecekleri bir çalışma ortamı sunuyoruz. Bu anlayışla, Norm Holding bünyesinde faaliyet gösteren Norm Fasteners Bursa şirketimizde görevlendirilmek üzere, ekibimize katılacak “Satış Mühendisi” arıyoruz. Nasıl Bir Ekip Arkadaşı Arıyoruz? Üniversitelerin Mühendislik Fakülteleri'nin Endüstri Mühendisliği, Makine Mühendisliği, İşletme Mühendisliği vb. bölümlerinden mezun, Satış alanında en az 3 yıl deneyime sahip, Tercihen bağlantı elemanları satışı konusunda tecrübeli, Güçlü iletişim becerilerine sahip ve ekip çalışmasına yatkın, Problem çözme ve analitik düşünme yetkinliklerine sahip, MS Office ve SAP programlarına hakim, Aktif olarak araç kullanabilen ve seyahat engeli olmayan, İyi derecede İngilizce bilen. Bu Pozisyonda Sizi Neler Bekliyor? Müşteriden gelen teklif doğrultusunda stok kontrolünün yapılması, Eksik kalemlerin satın almadan gelen fiyatlar ile fiyatlandırmasının yapılması, Siparişin ödeme şekli, talep edilen teslimat şekli ve adresi gibi tüm detayların takibinin ve kontrolünün sağlanması, Haftalık olarak finansın istediği ödeme raporlarının hazırlanıp teslim edilmesi, Müşteri sorunlarını çözmek ve müşteri memnuniyetini artırmak için ziyaretlerde bulunulması, Müşteri memnuniyet anketlerinin ulaşmasının sağlanması ve hesaplanmasındaki altyapı çalışmalarının oluşturulması, Her hafta düzenli olarak vadesi gelen tahsilatların yapılmasından sorumlu olunması. Norm'da Sizi Neler Bekliyor? Sürekli öğrenmeyi ve gelişimi destekleyen kurum kültürü Kariyer gelişimini destekleyen eğitim ve gelişim programları Yenilikçi ve dinamik çalışma ortamı Çalışan deneyimini destekleyen kapsamlı yan haklar Farklı uzmanlık alanlarıyla birlikte çalışma ve şirket içi kariyer fırsatları Çalışanların sosyal, kültürel, sportif ve gönüllülük alanlarında yer alabilecekleri çeşitli proje ve faaliyetler Seçme ve Yerleştirme Sürecimiz Ön görüşme Teknik ve yetkinlik bazlı mülakat süreçleri Yabancı dil değerlendirmesi Envanter ve değerlendirme uygulamaları Referans ve belge kontrolleri Yüz yüze görüşme Sağlık kontrolü Teklif süreci Eşitlik ve Kapsayıcılık Farklı bakış açılarının, deneyimlerin ve yetkinliklerin daha güçlü ekipler oluşturduğuna inanıyoruz. Tüm başvuruları yaş, cinsiyet, engellilik durumu, etnik köken, inanç, medeni durum veya diğer bireysel farklılıklar gözetmeksizin eşit ve adil şekilde değerlendiriyoruz. title: Mechanisch Engineer Machinebouw
description: Wil jij slimme machines ontwerpen die logistieke processen sneller en efficiënter maken? Als Mechanisch Engineer Machinebouw werk je aan technische systemen voor internationale projecten. Je combineert 3D CAD, machinebouw en R&D en ziet jouw ontwerpen uiteindelijk echt tot leven komen. Wat ga je doen? Als Mechanisch Engineer Machinebouw ontwerp je voor onze opdrachtgever mechanische systemen voor geautomatiseerde logistieke oplossingen. Je vertaalt technische eisen naar slimme en betrouwbare ontwerpen en werkt deze uit in 3D CAD met Autodesk Inventor. Daarbij maak je onder andere layouts, technische tekeningen en de benodigde documentatie. Je houdt rekening met de Machinerichtlijn, CE-richtlijnen, veiligheid en andere relevante normen. Tijdens projecten stem je de technische uitvoering af met disciplines zoals electrical engineering en IT. Naast klantprojecten werk je aan Research & Development en de ontwikkeling van modulaire bouwstenen voor nieuwe machines en systemen. Je gebruikt principes uit Configure To Order (CTO) en Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) om oplossingen verder te standaardiseren en verbeteren. Ook beantwoord je technische vragen vanuit montage en customer service en kun je betrokken zijn bij de bouw en het testen van prototypes. Af en toe ondersteun je een installatie op locatie, waardoor je jouw ontwerp ook in de praktijk ziet functioneren. Zo combineer je mechanical engineering, productontwikkeling en machinebouw in één brede technische functie. Jouw werkzaamheden Ontwerpen en uitwerken van mechanische systemen en machineonderdelen in Autodesk Inventor; Opstellen van layouts, technische tekeningen, handleidingen en andere technische documentatie; Ontwikkelen en verbeteren van modulaire bouwstenen binnen Research & Development; Toepassen van de Machinerichtlijn, CE-richtlijnen en relevante veiligheidsnormen; Afstemmen van technische oplossingen met electrical engineering, IT en andere betrokken disciplines; Ondersteunen van monteurs en customer service bij technische vraagstukken; Meewerken aan de bouw, het testen en optimaliseren van prototypes; Ondersteunen bij de installatie en technische uitvoering van systemen op locatie. Wat heb jij in huis? Hbo-werk- en -denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting werktuigbouwkunde, mechanical engineering of vergelijkbaar; Ervaring met mechanical engineering en machinebouw; Ervaring met 3D CAD, bij voorkeur Autodesk Inventor; Kennis van de Machinerichtlijn, CE-richtlijnen, technische normen en risico-inventarisaties; Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal; Een proactieve instelling en het vermogen om conceptueel en technisch mee te denken. Wat bieden we jou Een salaris van €3.600 - €4.800 p.m. 40 vakantiedagen per jaar; Uitgebreide groene pensioenregeling; Volg kosteloos sessies via het welzijnsplatform empowr; Opleidingsbudget van €2.000; Een persoonlijke Career Coach; Gratis deelname aan bijvoorbeeld de Marathon van Eindhoven of de Strong Viking Run; Werken bij het groenste detacheringsbureau van Nederland; Mogelijkheid tot overname door opdrachtgever. De organisatie & Duurzaamheid Je werkt voor een innovatieve machinebouwer en integrator die slimme systemen ontwikkelt voor interne logistiek. De oplossingen worden ingezet bij internationale bedrijven in onder andere e-commerce, retail en post- en pakketverwerking. Je komt terecht in een informele organisatie met korte lijnen, veel ruimte voor technische ideeën en aandacht voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Werken bij Evoke Je gaat via Evoke aan de slag in deze functie. Na een tijdje kun je in dienst bij onze partner, als je wil. Of je begint aan een nieuw uitdagend project via ons netwerk. Wij doen er alles aan om onze mensen op dé werkplek te krijgen. Jouw persoonlijke Career Coach is specialist binnen de sector en samen brengen jullie jouw wensen in kaart. Door écht te luisteren, maken zij steeds de juiste connectie voor jou. Ondertussen bieden wij je alle voordelen als jouw werkgever en Carrière Coach. Zoals een goed salaris, jaarlijks studiebudget en groen pensioen. Samen zetten we zo altijd de beste stappen voorwaarts in jouw loopbaan. Want: Evoke Centers You.

title: Design Engineer
description: 🚀 Challenge the Impossible About Beyond Gravity Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1800 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and manufacture products for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. In 2024, the company generated a revenue of around CHF 359 million. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com Our Crew The engineering team in Linköping consists of around 90 people, including engineering managers, design, analysis, systems, and verification engineers. We work in an international environment, closely collaborating with our customers as well as with other Beyond Gravity sites across Europe and the USA. This Design Team is responsible for executing mechanical design activities for space structures, mechanisms, and components. Our work includes CAD modeling, the creation of detailed drawings, and the development of design documentation. We support change management processes and actively participate in design reviews, working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure design feasibility, manufacturability, and full compliance with technical requirements. Your Mission Independently design parts and assemblies, considering requirements, tolerances, manufacturability, cost, mass, and integration. Develop complex CAD models and perform design tasks within the assigned domain. Lead change management, ensure traceability, and coordinate part lifecycle activities with PLM/ERP. Prepare design justifications and support validation activities, including requirement traceability and design reviews. Participate in NRBs, propose technical solutions, support corrective actions, and perform basic root cause analysis with guidance. Support FAI activities and operator training when required; provide on-site production support to prevent non-conformances. Prepare project-specific technical documentation and contribute to internal and customer deliverables. Maintain traceability between engineering inputs, outputs, and requirements; clearly communicate project status in meetings. Gather and interpret basic data; contribute ideas during brainstorming and innovation sessions. Support bidding and proposal activities; provide inputs to ECPs (Engineering Change Proposal) and CCNs (Contract Change Notice). Coach interns, students, and junior engineers. Maintain strong knowledge of the product portfolio and regularly interact with flight and test hardware. Your Story Must have: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Aerospace, Mechanical or other engineering, or equivalent experience. 3+ years of mechanical design experience in aerospace or equivalent industry. Proficiency in 3D CAD modelling and 2D drawings (preferably CATIA V5). Ability to work independently on moderately complex design tasks. Understanding of mechanical design principles, tolerancing standards and configuration control. Knowledge of manufacturing processes and their constraints. Nice to have: Experience in the space industry, with structures, mechanisms or components. Experience with composite and metallic structures or electrical designs. Familiarity with Teamcenter or similar PLM systems. Why Beyond Gravity? Work in a growing high-tech company with career opportunities both locally and internationally Be part of a dedicated team with the ambition to redefine space! In Linköping, we have experienced and skilled staff and a diverse management team Wellness allowance via the benefits portal Epassi. We offer a hybrid workplace with flexibility and independence, as well as brand-new facilities — including our own gym 🌌Are you ready for lift-off? Our core values - Passionate, Together, and Curious - transform challenges into opportunities. Embark on a journey to transcend the ordinary with us. We‘re actively reviewing candidates and will promptly select the ideal fit for our team. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact: Catarina Rio | catarina.afonsorio@beyondgravity.com Beyond Gravity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected categories. Applications by e-mail cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruitment agencies for this position.

title: Design Engineer - Mechanical (PUI)
description: About The Role Our Design Engineers own their work from the first sketch to the finished part on the car. The Power Unit Integration group sits at the heart of the car, making sure the power unit and its supporting systems are packaged, mounted, cooled and connected to perform at their best within the chassis. As a Design Engineer in the team, you'll take complete integration projects from conceptual through to detail design, then see them through R&D, dyno and production build and test programmes . You'll be designing components and structures such as PU mounting, cooling and exhaust systems, fuel system and energy store installation hardware , where every gram, every millimetre of packaging space and every pound counts. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with our power unit supplier and with teams across the business including aerodynamics, vehicle science, transmissions, chassis structure and the stress office. And when issues arise on the dyno or at track, you'll be the one who gets to the root of the problem and puts the fix in place quickly. It's a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving complex packaging and interface challenges and wants to see their work make a real difference on track . Your Responsibilities Support the delivery of complete power unit integration projects from concept through to detail design, defining and supporting R&D, dyno and production build and test programmes Produce conceptual and detailed designs for PU installation components and structures, including mounting, cooling, exhaust, fuel and energy store systems Carry out supporting calculations for structural, thermal and functional analysis Contribute to the mechanical, thermal and system interfaces between the power unit and the chassis Build strong working relationships with our power unit supplier and external component suppliers Take ownership of faults, carrying out thorough analysis and implementing timely rectification Keep communication clear, concise and consistent across all teams Work flexibly as part of the wider Powertrain design team, adapting to the demands of the racing calendar About You You'll be degree qualified in Mechanical, Automotive, Aerospace, Marine or a related engineering discipline, with strong CAD skills. Experience with Siemens NX is preferred, but if you're coming from another CAD system, we'll provide training! You'll bring: Design experience in powertrain, engine installation or a closely related area, ideally within motorsport, automotive or aerospace A good understanding of cooling, fluid and thermal systems, and how they interact with vehicle packaging Familiarity with the software systems used in vehicle design A thorough understanding of engineering designs and drawings of components and assemblies, in line with defined standards and procedures Strong organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise and deliver to agreed deadlines Just as important is how you work. Integration is all about interfaces, so you'll be comfortable balancing competing requirements from different teams and finding the best overall solution for the car . You're self-motivated and innovative, happy working under pressure with minimal supervision, and you lead by example. You're an open-minded, constructive team player who can engage and support those around you to build a high-performance culture. You're approachable, show balanced judgement and a high level of personal integrity, and you're able to collaborate with people at every level of the organisation. Company Description For almost 50 years, Williams has been at the forefront of one of the fastest sports on the planet, being one of the top three most successful teams in history competing in the FIA Formula 1 World Championship. With an almost unrivalled heritage of engineering and racing F1 cars and unforgettable eras that demonstrate it is a force to be reckoned with, the British squad boasts 16 F1 World Championship titles to its name. Since its foundation in 1977 by the eminent, late Sir Frank Williams and engineering pioneer Sir Patrick Head, the team has won nine Constructors’ Championships, in association with Cosworth, Honda and Renault. Its roll call of drivers is legendary, with its seven Drivers’ Championship trophies being lifted by true icons of the sport: Alan Jones, Keke Rosberg, Nelson Piquet, Nigel Mansell, Alain Prost, Damon Hill and Jacques Villeneuve. The team has made history before and is out to make it again with a long-term mission to evolve and return to the front of the grid. Qualifications Additional Information Atlassian Williams F1 Team is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We are happy to discuss reasonable job adjustments.

title: Bovenleiding Engineer

Uitvoeren van sterkte berekeningen Het bijdragen aan onze digitale ambitie en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe ontwerptechnologieën. Het integraal afstemmen van ontwerpen met verschillende disciplines. Aansturing van onze GEC-collega’s in India. Kwaliteitsborging. Jouw team: Je wordt onderdeel van de business unit Civil& Rail in Amersfoort. Hier werken we dagelijks aan complexe ontwerpen en het beter maken van de spoorinfra. We zoeken een gedreven professional die ons team kan versterken en samen met ons de toekomst van spoorontwerp vormgeeft. De adviesgroep waarin je werkt, biedt strategische en technische oplossingen om de infrastructuur efficiënter en duurzamer te maken. Met jouw innovatieve ideeën draag je bij aan de verbetering van onze processen en projecten. Kwalificaties & Ervaring: Je hebt meerdere jaren aantoonbare ervaring met complexe ontwerp- en engineeringprojecten. Als bovenleiding ontwerper weet je structuur aan te brengen in ingewikkelde vraagstukken en vertaalt je technische uitdagingen naar heldere, toepasbare oplossingen. Je werkt oplossingsgericht en brengt regelmatig vernieuwende ideeën in om zowel technische als organisatorische knelpunten te overwinnen. Je bent een echte teamspeler die gemakkelijk afstemt met collega’s en andere disciplines (binnen Nederland maar ook daarbuiten) en daarbij altijd het klantbelang vooropstelt. Met sterke communicatieve vaardigheden draag je jouw expertise overtuigend over aan interne en externe stakeholders. Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een soortgelijke functie. Ervaring met bovenleidingontwerp en opstellen van sterkte berekeningen. title: PhD Position Probing Hydrogen-Defect Interaction in Circular Steels via Atomistic Simulation
description: Join TU Delft and help design hydrogen-resistant steels for a sustainable energy future. As a PhD researcher, you will unravel the atomic-scale mechanisms of hydrogen embrittlement in compositionally complex recycled steels, using density functional theory and machine-learned interatomic potentials, in close collaboration with leading academic partners and Tata Steel. Job Description At TU Delft, you will contribute to a transformative research initiative focused on enabling the transition to a hydrogen-based energy system. This position is within the project "Circularity as Opportunity: Engineering Hydrogen-Resistant Circular Steels (CIRHY)" which is a 6-year research and innovation project developing next-generation circular steels that can safely operate in hydrogen environments. By combining advanced experiments with multiscale modelling, CIRHY enables reliable, sustainable steels for future infrastructure and industry. The project was granted by the Dutch national funding agency NWO in 2025. Understanding hydrogen-material interactions at the atomic scale remains one of the most complex and urgent challenges in the transition to a hydrogen-based energy system. Since the first discovery of the phenomenon in 1875, several hypotheses have been proposed about the mechanistic origin of hydrogen embrittlement (HE). Atomistic modelling can play a crucial role in verifying, characterizing and quantifying the HE mechanisms, since hydrogen is challenging to detect experimentally. Machine learning potentials can overcome typical bottlenecks of empirical potentials for simulating dislocations, cracks and hydrogen diffusion near precipitates embedded in ferritic iron. While considerable progress has been made in simulating hydrogen behaviour in the presence of defects (e.g., grain boundaries) in iron, the effects of hydrogen in compositionally complex recycled steels remain poorly understood. Within this position, you will investigate the atomistic mechanisms underlying hydrogen embrittlement (HE) in circular steels, with a particular focus on the role of tramp elements at experimentally informed microstructural features. You will combine first-principles modelling and machine-learning approaches to develop predictive simulations of hydrogen behaviour in compositionally complex Fe alloys. Working closely with Tata Steel and an interdisciplinary academic team, your research will contribute to the development of more hydrogen-embrittlement-resistant circular steels. Your Responsibilities In this role, you will develop fundamental insights into the atomistic mechanisms governing hydrogen embrittlement in compositionally complex circular steels. As a PhD researcher, you will: Perform Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations to model hydrogen-tramp element co-segregation at grain boundaries and phase boundaries Perform DFT to obtain atomistic insights into how tramp elements interact with dislocations and how hydrogen modifies these interactions Develop a DFT-accurate machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP) for a multi-component Fe alloy system, enabling predictive molecular dynamics (MD) simulations capable of probing hydrogen diffusion and trapping at interfaces in the presence of tramp elements with near-DFT accuracy Collaborate closely with a broad team of researchers from the department MSE of TU Delft, University of Groningen, Eindhoven University of Technology, University of Twente, KU Leuven, and MPI for Sustainable Materials, as well as with the project's industrial partner, Tata Steel. Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations and the dissemination of research findings within the M2i framework Your work environment You will be part of Team Dey within the Computational Materials Science section at TU Delft. This team focuses on atomistic simulations to investigate materials for sustainable energy, with proven expertise in hydrogen embrittlement, hydrogen storage and the behaviour of carbon-based materials such as graphene. Your project on the atomistic mechanisms of hydrogen embrittlement in circular steels aligns perfectly with the team's broader interest in metal–impurity interactions, interfacial phenomena and its commitment to computation-guided design for a sustainable future. You will collaborate closely with researchers from a broad consortium, including academic partners from the University of Groningen, Eindhoven University of Technology, University of Twente, KU Leuven and the MPI for Sustainable Materials, as well as the industrial partner Tata Steel. The project is embedded within the M2i framework. The Computational Materials Science section offers a collaborative and intellectually stimulating environment, where researchers work across disciplines and scales, with ample opportunities for scientific development and impact. Job Requirements We are looking for a self-motivated researcher to help develop atomistic insights and simulation tools for enabling hydrogen-resistant circular steels. You are independent but also a good team player and are willing to cooperate closely with other researchers and our industry partners. Furthermore, you meet the following requirements: You hold a Master’s degree in Materials Science and Engineering, Physics, Chemistry or a closely related discipline. You have a strong background and prior experience in atomistic and molecular simulation techniques, specifically density functional theory (DFT) and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. You are keen to learn new techniques for the development of machine learning interatomic potentials for MD simulations. You have a strong academic track record, as evident from your Master's thesis and relevant coursework. You have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
