title: Ingénieur Conception Mécanique — Réducteurs Robotiques (H/F)
description: Nous recherchons pour l'un de nos clients évoluant dans le domaine de l'industrie automobile Un Ingénieur Conception Mécanique — Réducteurs Robotiques (H/F) Votre Mission Intégré(e) aux équipes de R&D, vous pilotez le développement mécanique des réducteurs de précision dédiés aux nouvelles générations d'articulations robotiques. Vos responsabilités clés Stratégie & Architecture : mener les analyses Make or Buy et comparer les technologies de réduction (cycloïdale, épicycloïdale, Strain Wave/Harmonic Drive, planétaire de précision) afin de sélectionner l'architecture idéale pour répondre aux exigences de chaque articulation. Conception & Optimisation : assurer la conception complète de la macro-géométrie des engrenages (module, angle de pression, nombre de dents, diamètres primitifs, coefficients de déport, entraxe) et optimiser la micro-géométrie (bombé de profil, corrections de flanc) afin de minimiser le jeu, le NVH et l'erreur de transmission (PPTE), tout en maximisant la durée de vie. Intégration CAO : concevoir les assemblages 3D paramétriques et réaliser les plans de fabrication (carters, arbres, roulements) sous CATIA V5. Industrialisation : s’assurer de la faisabilité des pièces, définir les gammes de fabrication (power skiving, rectification, électroérosion…), et les exigences en matière de traitements thermiques. Établir les standards de contrôle sur machine à mesurer tridimensionnelle. Prototypage & Essais : élaborer les protocoles d'essais permettant de valider par mesures les jeux, le rendement, la rigidité torsionnelle, la durabilité. Et analyser les modes de défaillance observés pour améliorer les modèles. Formation : diplôme d'Ingénieur en Génie Mécanique ou équivalent. Expertise technique : maîtrise de la conception et du dimensionnement d'engrenages de précision, des Réducteurs cycloïdaux & épicycloïdaux. Savoir apporter des corrections personnalisées des flancs d’engrenages à partir de matrices de déformation des arbres et des carters. Maîtrise des analyses de chaînes de cotes 1D/3D pour des assemblages de haute précision. Maîtrise des normes : connaissance approfondie des normes internationales de dimensionnement des engrenages (ISO 6336, DIN 3960/3962, AGMA 2001). Outils : maîtrise de CATIA V5 et des logiciels d'analyse/optimisation de géométrie d'engrenages (KISSsoft/KISSsys ou MASTA, ou Ansys Motion). Savoir-faire procédés : solides connaissances en usinage de précision, traitements thermiques et méthodes de contrôle dimensionnel (MMT). SEGULA Technologies is a global engineering group, boosting the competitiveness of all major industrial sectors: automotive, aerospace, energy, rail, naval, life sciences, and telecoms. With a presence in more than 30 countries and 140 locations worldwide, the Group prioritizes close relationships with its clients, driven by the expertise of its 15,000 employees. As a leading engineering player putting innovation at the heart of its strategy, SEGULA Technologies manages large-scale projects, ranging from initial studies to industrialization and production. SEGULA TECHNOLOGIES is dedicated to gender balance and diversity, recognizing and recruiting talent of all backgrounds.

title: R&D Mechanical Engineer Senior
description: Join Hitachi Energy and help shape the next generation of On-Load Tap Changers (OLTCs), motor drives, and transformer accessories through innovative mechanical design. As a Senior R&D Mechanical Engineer , you will lead the development of high-performance electromechanical products, transforming requirements into reliable, manufacturable, and cost-effective solutions. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will drive product innovation, continuous improvement, and technical excellence throughout the product development lifecycle. You will play a key role in advancing technologies, solving complex engineering challenges, and ensuring the highest standards of quality and reliability. This is an exciting opportunity to make a lasting impact on critical power infrastructure while contributing to a more sustainable energy future. How You’ll Make An Impact Act as the lead mechanical design engineer for new product development, product upgrades, and technology development projects related to On-Load Tap Changers (OLTCs), motor drives, and transformer accessories. Develop innovative design concepts that meet customer, functional, reliability, manufacturability, cost, and serviceability requirements. Drive continuous improvement initiatives for existing products focusing on reliability, performance, manufacturability, quality, cost, and sustainability. Lead mechanical design reviews and provide technical recommendations throughout the development lifecycle. Support laboratory testing, prototype evaluations, product validation, and qualification activities. Define test objectives, test setups, acceptance criteria, and verification plans. Participate in root cause analyses of field failures, production issues, and customer complaints, identifying corrective and preventive actions. Participate in FMEA, risk assessments, and technical reviews for new products and product modifications. Collaborate closely with materials, electrical, manufacturing, quality, service, and supply chain teams. Develop and maintain design guidelines, best practices, lessons learned, and engineering standards. Your background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Significant experience in mechanical design and product development within industrial equipment, power systems, electromechanical products, or related industries. Knowledge of design for manufacturability (DFM), design for assembly (DFA), reliability engineering, and cost optimization principles. Proficiency in 3D CAD modeling, engineering drawings, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T), and product data management systems. Experience developing engineering documentation, specifications, test plans, design standards, and technical reports. Understanding of material selection, mechanical calculations, tolerance analysis, fatigue, wear, and failure mechanisms. Experience supporting prototype development, laboratory testing, product validation, qualification activities, and design verification processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience with root cause analysis and corrective action implementation. Working knowledge of risk assessment methodologies, including FMEA and product design reviews. Good written and spoken English. What We Offer 13th salary; Monthly food vouchers; Supplementary health insurance; Additional bonuses. More About Us Join Hitachi Energy and work in a team that is dedicated to creating a future where innovative digital technologies allow greater access to cleaner energy! title: Beräkningsingenjör inom kompositteknik
description: Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens hållbara kompositprodukter? Trivs du i samlingspunkten mellan simulering, materialmekanik och praktisk provning? Nu söker RISE en beräkningsingenjör som vill stärka vår verksamhet inom kompositteknik i Mölndal. Hos oss får du arbeta med avancerade beräkningar och produktutveckling i nära samarbete med kunder, forskare och kollegor – från material- och processförståelse till verifiering och färdig produkt. Om oss Enhet Kompositteknik är en del av divisionen Material och industri på RISE. Vi är ett team med kompetens inom bland annat kompositmaterial, produktutveckling, materialmekanik, mekanisk provning, tillverkningsteknik, digitalisering och återvinning. Vi arbetar med kunder och samarbetspartners både i Sverige och internationellt. Våra projekt omfattar hela värdekedjan för hållbara kompositprodukter – från material- och processutveckling till konstruktion, simulering, provning, verifiering och återvinning. Vi ser en ökad efterfrågan på vår kompetens, bland annat inom elektrifiering och hållbara kompositlösningar, och vill därför förstärka teamet med en beräkningsingenjör. Om rollen Som beräkningsingenjör blir du en viktig del av våra forsknings- och utvecklingsprojekt. Du arbetar tillsammans med kollegor, kunder och projektpartners från industri, akademi och andra institut. Rollen är bred och kombinerar numerisk simulering med praktisk förståelse för material, tillverkning och provning. Du får möjlighet att arbeta med varierande frågeställningar och branscher, både nationellt och internationellt. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter: konstruktion, analys och dimensionering av kompositstrukturer med FEM och analytiska modeller simulering av material-, produkt- och tillverkningsprocesser utveckling och validering av beräkningsmodeller mot experimentella resultat medverkan i och koppling till mekanisk provning av material och strukturer optimering av produktdesign och tillverkningsprocesser med hjälp av numeriska metoder teknisk dialog med kunder, samarbetspartners och projektteam rapportering och presentation av tekniska resultat i projektmöten och rapporter ansvar för delprojekt samt medverkan i utvecklingen av nya projekt och kunduppdrag. Vem är du? Du har en relevant högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom exempelvis maskinteknik, teknisk fysik, materialteknik, samhällsbyggnad eller ett närliggande område. Du har ett stort intresse för beräkning, hållfasthet och materialmekanik och vill använda din kompetens för att utveckla hållbara produkter och processer. Du har erfarenhet av FEM-beräkningar och är van att arbeta i någon eller några relevanta FE-mjukvaror, exempelvis LS-DYNA, ANSYS, Abaqus, HyperMesh eller motsvarande. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av simulering kopplad till materialutveckling, produktutveckling eller tillverkningsprocesser. Erfarenhet av kompositmaterial och praktisk mekanisk provning är meriterande, eftersom rollen innebär att omsätta testresultat till utveckling och validering av beräkningsmodeller. Som person är du analytisk, noggrann och nyfiken. Du har förmåga att sätta dig in i komplexa tekniska frågeställningar och kan förklara resultat på ett tydligt sätt för både tekniska och icke-tekniska målgrupper. Du arbetar självständigt och tar initiativ, samtidigt som du uppskattar att arbeta nära andra i projektteam. Eftersom vi verkar i en internationell miljö behöver du kunna kommunicera väl på både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift. Krav Masterexamen inom maskinteknik, teknisk fysik, materialteknik, samhällsbyggnad eller annat relevant område erfarenhet av FEM-beräkningar och relevant FE-mjukvara, exempelvis LS-DYNA, ANSYS, Abaqus, HyperMesh eller motsvarande god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift. Meriterande erfarenhet av kompositmaterial och dimensionering av kompositstrukturer erfarenhet av simulering inom materialutveckling, produktutveckling eller processutveckling erfarenhet av explicit dynamik, krock, skadetålighet eller icke-linjära analyser erfarenhet av modellvalidering genom mekanisk provning erfarenhet av praktisk mekanisk provning erfarenhet av projektledning, kundnära arbete eller forsknings- och utvecklingsprojekt forskarutbildning inom kompositteknik, materialteknik, beräkningsmekanik eller närliggande område Välkommen med din ansökan! Vill du veta mer om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta: David Mattsson, Enhetschef: 010 – 228 49 43. Sista ansökningsdag är den 25:e oktober 2026. Urval och intervjuer kommer att ske löpande under ansökningstiden. Vi använder inte personligt brev i våra rekryteringar. title: Senior Staff Mechanical Engineer
description: At Carbon, our mission goes beyond 3D printing. We are enabling creators everywhere to make what the world needs, right now. Our company is built on the idea that diverse fields of study must come together to solve intractable problems. We have grand ambitions to create technology that will influence industry around the world. You will be joining a diverse team with a vibrant culture, where team success is as important as celebrating individual contributions. Help us change the world and we will help you change yours. As a Senior Staff Mechanical Engineer, you will be a primary architect of Carbon’s hardware future. You won't just design parts; you will define the technical roadmap and foundational architectures for our next generation of additive manufacturing solutions. As a senior leader within a high-velocity hardware team, you will navigate extreme ambiguity to deliver elegant, high-reliability systems. You are expected to be a technical cornerstone, elevating the engineering bar across the organization and mentoring the next generation of staff-level talent Note: This role is remote; working from a home office in North Carolina. You will… Drive Hardware Architecture: Own the high-level mechanical architecture for new 3D printing platforms, ensuring modularity, serviceability, and industry-leading precision. Lead Cross-Functional Technical Delivery: Act as the technical bridge between Systems, Electrical, Software, and Materials Science to de-risk 0-to-1 products. Establish Engineering Standards: Define company-wide frameworks for validation, reliability testing, and DFM to ensure hardware excellence at global scale. Influence the Roadmap: Partner with Leadership and Product Management to translate product needs into a multi-year technical execution strategy. Navigate Technical Debt: Proactively identify and resolve architectural gaps in our technology to improve long-term product performance. Act as a Technical Gatekeeper: Serve as an influencer and decision maker in critical Design Reviews and Root Cause Analysis for high-stakes hardware events or failures. You have… Industry Tenure and Experience: 12+ years of experience in mechanical or mechatronics product development, with a proven track record of shipping complex systems from "blank sheet" to mass production. Proven ability to scale: A history of successfully mentoring and leveling up Senior and Staff-level engineers across a hardware organization. Systems-level Expertise: Expert-level intuition in thermodynamics, structural dynamics, and precision motion control within high-tolerance environments. Manufacturing Insight: Extensive experience managing Tier 1 JDM/CM partners and directing global pilot and production builds. Executive and Cross-Functional Communication: The ability to distill complex technical trade-offs into clear, data-driven recommendations for leadership. Foundational Rigor: Expert-level application of GD&T (ASME Y14.5), DFMEA, and Statistical Process Control (SPC) to high-volume hardware Mentorship: An attitude of mentorship towards junior engineers across the organization. Expertise in performing engineering analysis of major systems that can include: detailed tolerance, safety, thermal, stress, fatigue, lifetime, manufacturability, failure modes, and cost. Experience in material selection in sheet metal, metal, plastic, and elastomers. Bonus Experience… Interdisciplinary Engineering: Proficiency in software or firmware development for developing custom tools or automated test hardware. Domain Expertise: Direct experience in optics, fluidics, or UV-curable resin systems. Innovation Record: A portfolio of patents or proprietary innovations in the fields of robotics, automation, or additive manufacturing. You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Carbon, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills. At Carbon, we look at the person holistically and carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining salary. The compensation bracket based on a North Carolina location for this position is $167,600 - $251,400 (per year). In order to maintain equitable internal pay practices, we aim to hire new employees near the midpoint of $209,500 taking into account your experience, work location, certifications, and the unique skills you bring to the role. Carbon also offers to our eligible employees a comprehensive total rewards package that includes equity, benefits, and time off programs. For details on our total rewards package, visit https://www.carbon3d.com/about/life-at-carbon . #LI-Remote #LI-MRWC By clicking the “APPLY NOW” button and submitting your job application, you agree you have reviewed the complete Privacy Notice for Employees, Independent Contractors and Job Applicants , which explains the categories of personal information we collect about you, the purposes for which the categories of personal information shall be used and your rights with respect to our use of such personal Information.

description: At Fresenius Medical Care, we are the global leader in kidney care, committed to improving the lives of patients with chronic kidney disease. Our mission is to deliver high-quality, innovative products, services, and care across the entire healthcare journey. Guided by our vision—“Creating a future worth living. For patients. Worldwide. Every day.”—we work with purpose and compassion, supported by a global team of over 125,000 employees. Within our Care Enablement segment, we develop and provide life-sustaining medical products, digital health solutions, and therapies that empower clinical teams and improve patient outcomes. Our FME Reignite strategy drives transformation through innovation, efficiency, and sustainable growth. Our values guide how we work: We Care for our patients, each other, and our communities We Connect across teams and borders to deliver excellence together We Commit to doing things the right way— growing with purpose and leading kidney care with integrity and innovation At our Antalya plant in Turkey, we focus on the production of high-quality components used in dialysis therapy, including bloodlines, tubing systems, and accessories. Bu pozisyonda görev alacak ekip üyesi; biyofarmasötik üretim operasyonlarının GMP gerekliliklerine, onaylı prosedürlere ve üretim talimatlarına uygun şekilde yürütülmesine katkı sağlaması beklenmektedir. USP pozisyonu için başvuracak adaylar için hücre kültürü, seed train, biyoreaktör operasyonları, hücre büyümesi ve üretim proseslerinin takibinde görev almak. DSP pozisyonu için başvuracak adaylar için filtrasyon, kromatografi, ultrafiltrasyon/diafiltrasyon ve ilgili saflaştırma operasyonlarını yürütmek. Üretim ekipmanlarının kullanımı, operasyon öncesi hazırlıkları ve operasyon sonrası işlemlerini ilgili prosedürlere uygun şekilde gerçekleştirmek. Üretim parametrelerini ve proses performansını takip etmek; proses verilerini, ekipman kullanım kayıtlarını ve ilgili dokümantasyonu zamanında ve doğru şekilde tamamlamak. Proses transferi, ölçek büyütme, mühendislik serileri ve proses validasyonu çalışmalarına destek vermek. Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Biyomühendislik, Biyoteknoloji, Kimya Mühendisliği, Biyoloji, Kimya veya ilgili bölümlerinden mezun olmak. Biyofarmasötik veya biyoteknolojik üretim süreçlerinde, temiz alanlarda en az 1 yıl deneyim sahibi olmak. Üst akım (USP) ve/veya alt akım (DSP) proseslerinden en az birinde uygulamalı deneyime sahip olmak. GMP gereklilikleri ve biyofarmasötik üretim dokümantasyonu hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak. Prosedürlere uygun çalışma, kayıt tutma ve veri bütünlüğü konularında özenli olmak. Analitik düşünme, problem çözme ve teknik konuları değerlendirme becerisine sahip olmak. Takım çalışmasına yatkın, iletişim becerileri güçlü, sorumluluk sahibi ve öğrenmeye açık olmak. Tercih Sebebi Olabilecek Nitelikler CHO hücre kültürü ve memeli hücreleriyle biyoreaktör operasyonlarında deneyim. Tek kullanımlık (single-use) biyoreaktör sistemleri ve hücre kültürü ekipmanları hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak. Protein saflaştırma, kromatografi sistemleri ve TFF operasyonlarında deneyim. Proses transferi, ölçek büyütme, ticari üretim veya proses validasyonu çalışmalarında görev almış olmak. Elektronik üretim sistemleri ve GMP kayıt sistemleri hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak. title: QA Engineer (Payment Gateway)
description: QA Engineer (Payment Gateway) Employment Type: Full-time, Remote Experience: 3–5 years Industry: Fintech / Payment Systems About the Role We are looking for a QA Automation Test Engineer to join RDC Partner. In this role, you will work with the engineering team of our US-based business partner in the fintech industry. Our business partner develops solutions covering card payment processing, virtual POS, physical POS terminals, and payment infrastructure for merchants. In this role, you will be responsible for end-to-end testing of the payment gateway and will play an active role in API testing, test automation, payment transaction flows, and certification processes. You will work remotely with teams based in the US and Türkiye, contributing to the reliability, security, and performance of the product. What we are looking for 3–5 years in QA / test engineering, with at least 2 years testing payment gateways, acquiring platforms, POS software or terminal integrations. Direct experience with certification work — you have executed a certification script and worked findings through to closure. Experience with BKM, bank VPOS integrations, scheme certification or terminal certification in the Turkish market is directly relevant, and our partner will provide training on US payment processor specifics. Solid understanding of card transaction lifecycles, authorization and settlement, response codes, and ISO 8583-style host messaging. Hands-on API testing (Postman, REST Assured, pytest + requests or similar) and the ability to read and interpret JSON payloads and host logs. Working knowledge of a scripting language, Python preferred, for automation and test data generation. Comfortable with SQL for verifying transaction and settlement data. Familiarity with PCI DSS requirements as they apply to testing: test card data handling, logging restrictions, and environment segregation. Meticulous documentation habits — certification evidence and traceability are part of the job. Strong written and spoken English. You will be in live calls with our US team and, at times, with our processors. Proven ability to work independently in a remote team with asynchronous communication. Availability for at least four hours of overlap with US Eastern Time business hours, and flexibility for scheduled certification sessions with US processors. In practice this means working into the early evening Türkiye time. Nice to have Prior work at an ISO, payment facilitator, gateway provider, processor, bank acquiring team or terminal manufacturer. Experience with Datacap, NMI, FreedomPay or similar gateway and semi-integrated solutions. Familiarity with tokenization and vault services, 3-D Secure, Level 2/3 data, and dual pricing or surcharge rules. Knowledge of TLS, certificate handling and network-level debugging (Wireshark, mitmproxy). Performance testing tools (k6, JMeter, Locust). Experience with EMVCo L3 test tools or processor-provided certification portals. Prior experience working remotely for a US or European company.

title: Senior Product Development Engineer
description: Senior Development Engineer, VELUX Products & Innovation – Maintenance Free Window Modules – LKR Innovation House - Østbirk Join a team of passionate engineers and technical specialists with end-to-end responsibility for critical window modules. If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges, driving product development, and creating value across the entire product lifecycle, you could be our next Senior Development Engineer. Meet your future team You will become part of the Maintenance Free Window Modules team based in Østbirk. The team has end-to-end responsibility for VELUX sash and frame mo-dules made from polyurethane and other polymers, as well as our Insulating Glass Unit (IGU) modules. Working across the full product lifecycle, the team supports everything from concept creation and new product introduction to continuous optimization of cost, performance, sustainability, and quality. We collaborate closely with Product Management, Production, and other development teams to ensure our products continue to create value for customers and the business. As our new Senior Development Engineer, you will act as the Module Owner of the IGU module area, driving development activities, shaping future module roadmaps, and ensuring strong cross-functional alignment across the organization. What We Offer This is an opportunity to take on a highly influential technical role with significant impact across products, processes, and stakeholders. You will work with experienced colleagues in an international environment where innovation, knowledge sharing, and collaboration are valued and encouraged. More specifically your tasks will be to: Hold technical ownership and end-to-end responsibility for Insulating Glass Unit (IGU) modules. Drive module development activities across new product launches, performance improvements, cost optimization, upgrades, sustainability initiatives, and quality enhancements. Conduct module health assessments to evaluate performance, value creation, business relevance, and future opportunities. Identify, qualify, and drive opportunities that create value across the product lifecycle and value chain. Lead design, concept development, and resolution of complex technical challenges. Define and secure technical requirements, module performance, and robust engineering solutions. Build strong relationships with stakeholders and ensure alignment across Product Management, Production, Supply Chain, and Product Development. Support management decision-making through technical expertise and insights. Act as a knowledge leader by developing technical capabilities, facilitating learning activities, and promoting effective knowledge sharing throughout the organization. What You Will Bring You enjoy navigating complex technical environments and are motivated by combining deep technical expertise with cross-functional collaboration. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are able to balance technical excellence with business value. Moreover, we expect that you: Hold a Master’s degree in Engineering or another relevant technical discipline. Have experience working with product development or complex technical products. Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured approach to technical challenges. Have experience with CAD tools, preferably CREO and Windchill. Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing. Demonstrate the ability to engage and align stakeholders across functions and disciplines. Take a proactive approach and can independently drive activities from concept to implementation. Have experience or knowledge into systems engineering, which is considered an advantage but not a requirement. Have experience or knowledge within insulating glass, glazing solutions, or related technologies, which is considered an advantage but not a requirement. Ready to apply? Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process. We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match. All inquiries will be treated confidentially. About VELUX In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air. The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world. Equal Opportunity Employer At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

title: Mechanical Project Engineer - Offshore Wind Service
description: Do you have a passion for renewable energy and an eye for technical details? Are you excited about supporting projects from start to finish? If so, we want to hear from you! Your position As our new Mechanical Project Engineer in the Renewable division, you will be a valuable member of the Global Modification team, whose mission is to execute modification projects on offshore wind farms. You will design, communicate and implement operational plans for engineering activities and contribute technical input to larger projects. Working closely with the project manager, cross-functional engineering teams and the offshore execution team, you will participate throughout the project lifecycle—from initial client inquiries and planning to design, construction, installation and commissioning. Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg or at our office in Hamburg. The position is full-time, and up to 30 travel days per year should be expected. “You will be part of a team of energetic and competent colleagues that prioritizes teamwork and a "winning as a team" mentality. Our team values a flexible work atmosphere with an emphasis on balancing work and personal life, as well as opportunities for professional growth. In this role, you will have great opportunities to bring your own ideas to the table and play a key role in shaping our projects and services.” – Kristoffer Frederiksen, Senior Manager, Global Modifications. Your Tasks & Responsibilities As a Project Engineer, you will be responsible for developing technical solutions and engineering documentation for modification projects, working closely with the project manager and other cross-functional teams in the BoP Service organisation. You will plan and coordinate engineering activities, monitor progress and performance, and take action to resolve technical issues to secure the required quality and project timelines. You will also be a key contributor to resolving warranty claims on OSS projects delivered by Semco Maritime. For offshore execution projects and site operations, you may perform site or offshore surveys as preparation and provide back-office engineering support during construction, installation and commissioning. Therefore, you can expect an interesting and steep learning curve, and we will provide the training needed to help you succeed in your new role. Your Tasks Will Include But Are Not Limited To Develop technical projects and solutions and provide engineering input to larger projects Prepare, communicate and maintain operational plans for engineering activities and deliverables Prepare and manage job packages for onshore and offshore installation Perform or coordinate engineering activities across relevant disciplines and stakeholders Monitor engineering progress and performance, and resolve issues to secure quality and project timelines Participate in all project phases from tender and design through production, construction, installation and commissioning Perform or support site and offshore surveys required for project preparation Provide back-office engineering support during offshore execution, construction, installation and commissioning Participate in technical communication with clients to explain, clarify and align technical solutions relevant to project success Your Profile & Qualifications As a person, you enjoy having a lot of responsibility and you thrive in an environment where you have daily communication with many stakeholders. You are driven by completing tasks to the best of your ability and remain in control even in fast-paced situations. In the team we value a positive mindset both to the benefit of our clients delivering first class services and also to secure a strong working environment among all our colleagues. You prioritize safety above all and never compromise when it comes to the safety of any people participating in our projects. To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have: An educational background as a Marine Engineer, Service Engineer, Technical Manager Offshore or Mechanical Engineer Previous experience and broad knowledge and understanding of Mechanical equipment and systems related to offshore substations and offshore turbines at a generalist level Fluency in English, written and verbal Ability to communicate in German is an advantage, but not a requirement We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible. If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Kristoffer Frederiksen, Senior Manager, Global Modifications. Welcome to Semco Maritime At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward. Care to join the movement? Change. With us.

title: Mekanikkonstruktör till Köping
description: Är du mekanikkonstruktör och vill vara med och utveckla specialmaskiner och automationslösningar för Sveriges mest teknikintensiva industrier? På Sejfo får du arbeta nära både kund och projektteam i uppdrag där teknik, innovation och problemlösning står i centrum. Vi söker nu både juniora och seniora mekanikkonstruktörer som vill vara med och skapa framtidens industriella lösningar. Du blir en viktig del av våra projektteam och får möjlighet att påverka tekniska lösningar som används i verklig produktion hos ledande industriföretag. Beroende på erfarenhet kommer du att arbeta med allt från detaljkonstruktion och ritningsframtagning till tekniskt ansvar för större maskinprojekt. Hos oss gäller frihet under ansvar , korta beslutsvägar och stort utrymme att utvecklas tillsammans med erfarna kollegor. Du erbjuds Spännande projekt inom maskinbyggnad och industriell automation. Möjlighet att arbeta med hela kedjan från konstruktion till färdig installation. Stor teknisk bredd och varierande uppdrag. Kompetenta kollegor och en prestigelös företagskultur. Goda utvecklings- och karriärmöjligheter. En arbetsplats där teknikintresse, engagemang och samarbete värderas högt. Arbetsuppgifter Konstruktion och utveckling av maskiner, fixturer och automationsutrustning. Framtagning av 3D-modeller, ritningar och teknisk dokumentation. Utveckling av mekaniska lösningar utifrån kravspecifikation och kundbehov. Val av komponenter, material och tillverkningsmetoder. Samarbete med el-, automations- och mjukvaruingenjörer. Delta i tekniska genomgångar med kunder, leverantörer och projektteam. Medverka vid montage, FAT, installation och idrifttagning när projektet kräver det. Vi söker dig som Har erfarenhet av mekanisk konstruktion inom maskinbyggnad, automation eller industriprojekt. Har förståelse för hur konstruktioner fungerar i verklig drift och tillverkning. Har intresse för eller erfarenhet av att bygga, montera, testa och verifiera mekaniska lösningar i praktiken Är utbildad högskoleingenjör, civilingenjör eller har motsvarande erfarenhet. Har mycket goda kunskaper i SolidWorks. Är van att arbeta med 3D-modellering, tillverkningsritningar och teknisk dokumentation. Behärskar svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Har B-körkort. För juniora kandidater Vi välkomnar även dig som är nyutexaminerad eller har några års erfarenhet. Det viktigaste är att du har ett starkt teknikintresse, goda kunskaper i SolidWorks och en vilja att utvecklas tillsammans med oss. För seniora kandidater Vi Ser Gärna Att Du Har Erfarenhet Av Konstruktion av maskiner och automationsutrustning. Projektarbete och kunddialog. Maskinsäkerhet och tillämpliga direktiv och standarder. Materialval och tillverkningsteknik. Tekniskt ansvar eller ledande roller i utvecklingsprojekt. Meriterande Erfarenhet av maskinbyggnad och specialmaskiner. Erfarenhet av industriell automation. Erfarenhet av prototypframtagning, montage och praktisk verifiering av konstruktioner. Erfarenhet av 3D print Kunskap inom pneumatik eller drivsystem. Erfarenhet av samverkan mellan mekanik, el och automation. Erfarenhet från life science, tillverkande industri eller processindustri. Som person Är du nyfiken och lösningsorienterad. Du gillar att kombinera konstruktion med praktiska prototyp tester. Tar du ansvar för dina uppgifter och driver arbetet framåt. Trivs du med att samarbeta och dela kunskap. Har du ett praktiskt teknikintresse och gillar att se dina konstruktioner bli verklighet. title: Mekanikkonstruktörer till Sigma Industry South, Nordvästra regionen
description: Jobbeskrivning Nu söker Sigma Industry South i Helsingborg/Halmstad erfarna mekanikkonstruktörer till spännande uppdrag inom tunga fordon och tung industri. Vi vänder oss till dig som har minst tre års erfarenhet av mekanisk konstruktion och som trivs med att arbeta nära produktutveckling, kundanpassningar och framtagning av tillverkningsunderlag. Du har god kunskap inom ritningslära och är van att ta fram kompletta konstruktions- och produktionsunderlag. Vidare har du erfarenhet av CAD-verktyg såsom Creo, Inventor, SolidWorks eller motsvarande. Det är meriterande om du har arbetat med konstruktion av chassi & drivlina, fordonskomponenter, plåt- och stålkonstruktioner eller svetsade sammanställningar. Vi ser även positivt på erfarenhet av beredning, tillverkningsanpassning och arbete med relevanta standarder inom verkstads- och fordonsindustrin. Har du tidigare arbetat i PDM-system som Windchill, Vault, Teamcenter eller liknande är det ett extra plus. Uppdragen kan varierar i omfattning och komplexitet men som ger dig möjlighet att bidra med din kompetens i både nyutvecklings- och förbättringsprojekt. Uppdragen är främst lokaliserade till Helsingborg, Landskrona, Halmstad och Markaryd där din tillgänglighet till dessa orter är en viktig faktor i matchningen. Vi söker dig som är tekniskt driven, kvalitetsmedveten och lösningsorienterad. Du trivs i en konsultroll där du får möjlighet att arbeta i varierande miljöer, bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer och utvecklas tillsammans med några av regionens mest intressanta industriföretag. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande i dialog med kund, vilket innebär att rekryteringsprocessen kan variera i tempo och i vissa fall gå både snabbt och mer utdraget. Grundläggande kvalifikationer Vi söker dig med minst 3 års erfarenhet av konstruktion samt en civil- eller högskoleingenjörsexamen inom maskinteknik. Du skall tala och skriva obehindrat på svenska och engelska. Vissa tjänster kan medföra en bakgrunds kontroll där ser vi till denna tjänst att du har svenskt medborgarskap. Meriterande färdigheter, egenskaper och erfarenheter Vi på Sigma ser stort värde i att du som person besitter goda sociala kompetenser och är öppen för de olika förutsättningar och utmaningar som uppdrag av olika karaktärer kan medföra. Vi erbjuder Hos oss står alltid konsulten i centrum, vår affär är uppbyggd kring vår förmåga att anställa och utveckla de bästa förmågorna inom våra områden. Som privatägt bolag tittar vi inte på börskursen eller förbereder inför nästa kvartalsrapport, vi fokuserar istället på stabil och långsiktig utveckling. Utöver detta erbjuder vi: Distanskostnadsersättning vid arbete utanför kontoret Förmånsprogram via vår partner Benify Flexibla arbetstider Betald övertid enligt kollektivavtal Friskvårdsbidrag Bonus vid tips om rekrytering eller uppdrag Kollektivavtal via TechSverige För att våra konsulter ska trivas så bra som möjligt och känna sig som en del av Sigma, även när man är placerad i kundens organisation, anordnar vi: Återkommande avdelningsmöten och aktiviteter Kompetensutveckling på konferenser och bolagsträffar Tillställningar och fester vid olika tillfällen under året Som konsult hos oss får du arbeta tillsammans med de främsta utvecklingsintensiva företagen inom svensk industri. Uppdragen anpassas alltid i möjligaste mån, för att nivån ska bli så utvecklande och stimulerande som möjligt. Omkring dig kommer du ha många duktiga kollegor och ett aktivt erfarenhetsutbyte. Vår företagskultur präglas av entreprenörskap och korta beslutsvägar. Gemenskap, engagemang och glädje är viktiga element som vi anser skapar trivsel. Sigma Industry South AB är ett dynamiskt teknikkonsultföretag inom produkt- och produktionsutveckling som utmanar de etablerade standarderna. Kombinationen av lång branscherfarenhet, stort engagemang, interna och externa uppdrag samt ett tätt samarbete mellan Sigmas olika verksamheter i regionen skapar ett unikt branschöverskridande växthus för ingenjörer. Med mångfald, delaktighet och entreprenörskap stärker och utvecklar vi vår verksamhet och våra medarbetare. title: Mechanical Engineer

title: Production-focused Mechanical Engineer
description: About Swiftstrike Swiftstrike is a Swedish defence-technology company. We build hardware and the AI software that runs it, from edge to command. Our products are developed with experienced operators and refined through real-world field testing, and everything we build is designed to be cost-effective at scale and priced for fielding in numbers. The role Our hardware works in the field. Now it needs to be built in numbers. As our production-focused Mechanical Engineer, you will take our products from working prototypes to series production, owning design for manufacture, ruggedisation, production logistics, and close cooperation with suppliers and contract manufacturers through the ramp to mass production. Your job is to make sure the system that worked in the last field trial can be built at scale, at cost, without losing what made it work. This is a hands-on role in a small team. You will spend time in CAD, at the workbench, at suppliers, and occasionally in the field. What you'll do Own the mechanical design of enclosures, mounts, and mechanisms for systems deployed in harsh field environments. Drive design for manufacture and assembly (DFM/DFA) across our product line, from small-batch builds to series production. Ruggedise hardware for real conditions: ingress protection, vibration, shock, and thermal management for edge compute in sealed enclosures. Select components and materials with an existing-parts-first mindset, balancing cost, lead time, and field performance. Build and qualify suppliers and contract manufacturers, and work with them day to day through the production ramp: drawings, tolerances, bills of materials (BOMs), acceptance criteria, and the problem-solving in between. Own production logistics for series manufacture: lead times, second sources, inventory, and component availability. Prototype hands-on (3D printing, machining, assembly) and iterate fast on field feedback. Support field trials and feed what breaks back into the design. What we're looking for A degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent practical experience. 3+ years of product development experience where your designs went into production. You have lived through a manufacturing ramp. Strong CAD skills (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or similar) and disciplined drawing and tolerance practice. Hands-on DFM/DFA experience with sheet metal, CNC machining, and injection moulding. Experience designing for environmental requirements: IP ratings, vibration, thermal. A pragmatic, cost-aware approach. You would rather adapt an existing part than design a custom one. Professional fluency in English. Hands-on manufacturing experience (e.g. as a CNC machinist) – a strong advantage. Nice to have Experience from defence, aerospace, automotive, or another regulated, reliability-driven industry. A background from the armed forces or from defence procurement. Ruggedised electronics enclosures and thermal design for high-power compute at the edge. Experience standing up or scaling production with contract manufacturers in Europe. Swedish language skills. What we offer The systems you build protect people on the modern battlefield. You set the mechanical engineering standard in a small, senior team. Short loops from design to field: what you release is used, and the findings come back to you. A workshop-equipped office in Gothenburg and the tools you need to build. Competitive compensation, including equity options, so you share in what we build. Given the nature of our work, employment may be subject to a security review and to citizenship or residency requirements applicable to Swedish defence industry. We will discuss this openly during the process.

title: Satellite Mechanical Design Engineer

We are currently building satellites that can operate at an altitude of just 200 km - one-third that of conventional satellites. Role Overview Responsible for the mechanical design of satellite structures, mechanisms, and related hardware from concept through qualification and on-orbit operation. Working within a small, multidisciplinary team, you will translate requirements into manufacturable designs and validate them through prototyping and environmental testing. Key Responsibilities Design and develop mechanical systems and components for satellites, including primary structure, thermal-control hardware, secondary structures, and mechanisms. Generate 3D CAD models, fully dimensioned drawings, and interface control documents using GD&T, managing assembly configuration and PLM data. Take hardware from conceptual design through qualification to on-orbit operations, leading design reviews, and planning verification tests. Optimise designs for manufacturability, cost, mass, and reliability, working directly with manufacturers and suppliers. Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials, structural mechanics, FEA ,and thermal management. Demonstrated ability to design, build, and test hardware, including troubleshooting and iteration. Why NewOrbit Space? Pioneering Space Technology – You'll contribute to launching groundbreaking technology into space. Your work on our revolutionary ion propulsion system and ULEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and disrupt traditional LEO operations. Unmatched Ownership and Impact – You'll experience a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry. You will participate in the full lifecycle of satellite technology. Equity and Competitive Salary – You'll receive not just a competitive salary but also company ownership stakes. Comprehensive Benefits Package – Including private health insurance with dental and optical coverage, annual healthcare check-ups etc. Hybrid Work - A hybrid setup with one dedicated remote day per week. Visa Sponsorship & Relocation Support - We provide a relocation package and sponsor your visa if you’re joining us from abroad.

We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future. Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities. The Opportunity Our projects range in scale from the inception of major infrastructure down to small alterations. Some are pure art; others exist only to be functional. They are all rooted in our core desire to shape a better world and to do work that is interesting and rewarding. One of our teams is helping finish Gaudi's astonishing church of La Sagrada Familia in Barcelona, another is fixing significant problems that threaten a hospital. One team is reimagining the use of an existing commercial building; another is designing the stations for a new railway line. Each of our UK offices is connected to the global Arup, linking up with teams designing projects across the world. At the same time, they are rooted in the community and the work of the local industry. They provide a work community that is inclusive, and supportive of you as a person, but technically challenging and rigorous. They will care about your learning and progress and will help you to grow as an engineer and a team member. They will help and mentor you towards professional qualification, to develop your skills and build your career. The first step is learning the craft of being a structural Engineer. Shadowing an experienced Engineer within the team. Helping in the early stages of a project that could include designing buildings that are beautiful & effective from a low carbon point of view. The role includes: Analysis: Carrying out structural calculations, modelling, engineering, computer, and hand analysis. Design: Finding structural engineering solutions. Choosing structures and details that are economical and practical, that minimise embodied carbon and achieve the project sustainable development goals. Building computer & structural engineering models to monitor the way the building behaves structurally. Communication: Through drawings, sketches, digital modelling, calculation documents, building information modelling, meetings, explanations, presentations, discussions, persuasions, emails, written reports, chats and electronic messages. Working with teams: Cooperating, helping others, taking instructions, giving instructions, solving problems together, thinking beyond the conventional, helping to find new and effective ways to succeed. Treating others with respect, kindness and empathy. Learning: The practice of structural engineering, codes of practice, software, materials and construction techniques as well as all the other disciplines and people that are needed to design and deliver a project successfully. Planning your work: Agreeing deadlines and working together effectively with the rest of the team. Taking responsibility: for the quality and timely delivery of your work, for your own learning and professional development, and for your impact on other people. Finding new ways: of working. Finding solutions that are better, faster and cheaper. Learning international best practice in structural engineering design and delivery. Inventing and developing new ideas and new ways of working. Applying scripting and automation and developing bespoke software and spreadsheets. Investing time in people: developing relationships with your project team and your peers and everyone in the office. Contributing to the life of the team. Building an effective network outside and inside Arup. Is this role right for you? For this opportunity, we are seeking the following qualifications, skills and attributes: Degree in Civil, Structural, General or Architectural Engineering, or Engineering Science, at 2.1 or above Studying, or have studied, an ICE or IStructE accredited course A passion for structural engineering To Be Considered For a Graduate Opportunity, Your Application Must Include a Copy Of Your Academic Transcript And Meet The Following Criteria Full working rights in the country of application No more than 12 months of full-time experience in a comparable role Recently graduated, or on track to graduate, from your most recent degree, related to your role of choice, before employment starts. Alongside your degree, we look for the following core attributes; Changemakers: A passion for sustainable development and creating a better world is key. Innovative minds: We’re looking for critical thinkers who embrace new ideas and challenge the status quo. Growth seekers: You have a growth mindset, always eager to learn and explore new ways of working. Adaptable adventurers: You’re ready to take on any challenge that comes your way. You should be able to start this opportunity on 1 September 2027 . Advert Closing Date: 16 October 2026 Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. Early application is recommended. Eligibility Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Therefore, you must ensure that you are eligible to work permanently in the UK without our sponsorship. What we offer you At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together. Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

title: Junior Mechanical Design Engineer I Advanced 3D Tool Design I Geothermal Sector
description: Company Description: At Hephae Energy Technology, we are redefining how the world taps into deep geothermal energy. We design and develop robotics that operate under extreme temperatures and harsh subsurface conditions to unlock a baseload source of clean, renewable power. Join the movement as we enable next-generation geothermal for everyone, everywhere. Position Summary: To help us build the next generation of geothermal drilling technology, we’re looking for a Junior Mechanical Design Engineer who thrives on complex 3D assemblies, precision engineering, and real-world hardware development. If you enjoy transforming challenging engineering concepts into robust mechanical designs, then this is your moment. As a Junior Mechanical Design Engineer, you will support the design and development of advanced geothermal drilling tools and mechanical systems. Working closely with experienced engineers and the R&D team, you will help transform innovative concepts into robust, manufacturable mechanical designs, while progressively taking ownership of components and subsystems. You will be involved throughout the product development process, from initial concepts and 3D modelling to detailed drawings, prototyping, assembly, and testing. Your work will contribute directly to developing tools designed to operate kilometres underground in some of the harshest environments on earth. Roles & Responsibilities: · Create and develop 3D models, components, and assemblies for advanced geothermal drilling tools · Support the design of mechanical components and subsystems for high temperature, high pressure, shock, and vibration environments · Generate technical drawings and manufacturing documentation, including dimensions, tolerances, materials, and assembly requirements · Support the development and maintenance of CAD structures, configurations, and design revisions · Contribute to managing engineering data within PDM/PLM systems · Work with senior engineers to evaluate design concepts, interfaces, tolerances, and manufacturability · Support prototyping, assembly, testing, and troubleshooting of new tool concepts Candidate Requirements: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field 0–2 years of professional experience in mechanical design, product development, engineering, or a related field Good understanding of mechanical engineering fundamentals, including materials, manufacturing processes, mechanics, and mechanical assemblies Intermediate proficiency with 3D CAD software such as SolidWorks, Onshape, Siemens NX (Unigraphics), or similar Ability or willingness to develop skills in creating detailed manufacturing drawings, tolerances, and GD&T Interest in product development, prototyping, and hands-on engineering Strong English communication skills (C1 level as defined by CEFR) Location: Bilbao, Basque Country, Spain Fast-paced environment, international ambition, real impact Continuous technical training and self-development opportunities International working experience with travelling opportunities Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package

title: Ingénieur Calculs Mécaniques H/F
description: Au sein d'Ametra Group, Ametra Simulation est un Bureau d’études en calcul mécanique et structure (effectif : 25 personnes). Nos activités de dimensionnement se font par logiciel éléments finis et par calcul analytique. Notre activité est principalement mécanique (95 %), mais nous traitons également des études thermiques et CFD à l’occasion. Par ailleurs, nous cherchons également à solidifier nos connaissances en Génie Civil pour mieux accompagner nos clients sur des problématiques interaction acier / béton (ancrages). Notre bureau d'études calcul bénéficie d'une réputation exemplaire dans le domaine du nucléaire et de la défense. Les grands groupes du secteur (EDF, Framatome, Orano, CEA, MBDA, Thales, Naval group..) se tournent vers nous pour les projets à haute valeur ajoutée. Nos interactions et collaborations avec de plusieurs services de chacun de ces grands acteurs nous donnent une connaissance à 360° du monde calcul et garantit à nos collaborateurs une grande diversité de sujets traités et des opportunités de montée en compétences. Notre recrutement est rigoureux et sélectif. Il se fait sur la base d'un examen d’aptitude permettant de valider le niveau de connaissances et la capacité d’apprentissage du candidat. Son taux de réussite est d'environ 10%, c'est une bonne occasion pour venir se challenger ! Les ingénieurs réussissant ce test intègrent donc non seulement, un bureau d’étude, mais aussi une équipe solidaire. Votre challenge : Au sein de l’entité AMETRA Simulation et sous la responsabilité de la Responsable du Bureau d'études, vous serez partie intégrante d'une équipe d'études pluridisciplinaire en charge de la réalisation de calculs mécaniques (conception, pré-dimensionnement, dimensionnement, validation). Vous réalisez les analyses correspondantes aux cahiers des charges : • Modélisation par éléments finis (filaire, surfacique et volumique) • Analyse des comportements (statique, dynamique, vibratoire) • Vérification et justification de tenue d’assemblage (visserie, soudure) Vous serez amenés à traiter des affaires dans les domaines suivants : • Engins, cuves sous pression et tuyauterie • Levage et manutention • Défense et transports Vous avez en charge la rédaction des rapports d’études. Vous assurez un reporting régulier auprès du Responsable Technique. Vous aurez à moyen terme la charge de faire l’analyse critique des besoins clients ainsi qu'interpréter les résultats. A long terme une perspective d’évolution tournée vers la gestion de projet est possible. Vos atouts : Profils Jeunes Diplômés(es), Ingénieurs de 2 à 4 ans d'expérience ou Experts(es), vous rejoindrez notre bureau d'études en interne avec : Une bonne culture mécanique et un sens physique prononcé, Une bonne connaissance du fonctionnement des logiciels éléments finis (la formation à ces logiciels est à notre charge), De bonnes bases en RDM et en MMC, Des connaissances en traitement du signal et en programmation (Python, C++) sont un plus. Conformément à notre politique d'inclusion et de diversité, nos postes sont ouverts à tous.

Technologické centrum ABB v Brně je globálním vývojovým centrem zaměřeným na výzkum a vývoj rozváděčů vysokého napětí, servisních řešení, konfigurátorů a přístrojových transformátorů. Schopnost převzít odpovědnost, samostatně řešit problémy a dotahovat úkoly do konce. Technické a analytické myšlení, kreativitu a chuť přicházet s novými nápady. Schopnost spolupracovat v týmu a efektivně komunikovat napříč organizací. Zájem dále se rozvíjet v oblasti energetiky a moderních technologií. Co Vám nabízíme V ABB nebudete jen součástí projektu. Budete součástí týmu, který vytváří technologie využívané zákazníky po celém světě. Nabízíme Vám Práci na špičkových technologiích pro energetiku budoucnosti. title: Mechanical Engineer (Always Open)
description: Chipiron is building a radically new generation of MRI systems. We are taking one of the most complex medical technologies in existence and trying to make it radically simpler, cheaper and more accessible. We have no shortage of hard problems to solve. What we're looking for is exceptional people capable of solving them. We don't believe great talent should have to wait for an open position. If you're among the best at what you do, have a bias for action, and want to build technology that has never existed before, we'd like to meet you. Who we're looking for Your background matters much less than your trajectory. You probably recognize yourself in several of these: You are exceptionally good at what you do, and you can show it You reason from first principles, not from what already exists You take ownership beyond your formal responsibilities You hate letting problems sit unresolved You make decisions with incomplete information You communicate directly, including when you think we're wrong Key Responsibilities Design the mechanical foundations of next-generation MRI. Develop innovative mechanical components and assemblies that meet demanding requirements for precision, reliability, safety, and usability. Own mechanical development from concept to reality. Take designs from early concepts and CAD models through simulation, prototyping, testing, and manufacturing. Solve challenging engineering problems. Use structural analysis, finite element simulations, and hands-on experimentation to optimize mechanical performance, deformation, and reliability. Build for the real world. title: CFD Engineer – Thermal & Internal Fluid Dynamics (PhD)
description: Outrigo is an industrial deep-tech company building Morph, an intelligence-driven platform that unifies computational design, simulation, metal additive manufacturing and automated assembly into a single traceable workflow. We develop high-performance hardware for the space, aerospace, defence and mobility sectors, pushing the boundaries of what can be designed and manufactured. We are seeking a highly qualified CFD Engineer, holding a PhD, with deep expertise in thermal-fluid dynamics and internal flows to lead the thermal and fluid simulation capability within Morph. The successful candidate will develop and validate high-fidelity models for internally cooled, additively manufactured components, such as regeneratively cooled rocket engine chambers, compact heat exchangers, cold plates and conformal cooling channels, and will help turn that expertise into automated, AI-assisted simulation workflows that drive design decisions. All must be eligible to work in Spain. Responsibilities / What You Will Do Lead CFD and conjugate heat transfer (CHT) analysis of internal flows in complex geometries, including cooling channels, manifolds, injectors, heat exchangers and lattice/TPMS structures. Develop, verify and validate high-fidelity models for turbulent heat transfer, pressure drop and flow distribution, including compressible, reacting or supercritical/real-gas flows where required. Build robust, scripted simulation workflows (geometry preparation, meshing, solver setup, convergence monitoring and post-processing) within Morph’s OpenFOAM-based CFD pipeline, enabling design-space exploration with minimal manual intervention. Work with the computational design and AI teams to couple CFD with automated geometry generation, surrogate and reduced-order models, and thermal-fluid design optimisation (including adjoint and topology optimisation). Capture the effects of laser powder bed fusion (surface roughness, minimum feature size, channel distortion) in thermal-fluid models and correlate them with test data from printed parts. Collaborate with structural engineers on coupled thermo-mechanical analysis of thermally loaded components. Define and support experimental validation campaigns (pressure drop, flow rate, temperature and heat flux measurements) and correlate simulation results with physical test data. Establish simulation best practices, verification and validation standards, and mentor engineers in thermal-fluid analysis. Prepare comprehensive technical reports and presentations for customers and stakeholders, and contribute to R&D grant proposals, publications and intellectual property. Adhere to Health and Safety legislation and uphold Outrigo’s workplace standards to create a safe and productive work environment. Experience / Who You Are PhD in Mechanical, Aerospace, Chemical Engineering or a closely related field, with doctoral research in CFD, heat transfer or thermo-fluid dynamics (essential). At least 3 years of industrial or post-doctoral experience CFD to thermal and internal flow problems. Expert knowledge of fluid mechanics, heat transfer and turbulence modelling (RANS, e.g. k-ω SST, and LES), near-wall treatment and conjugate heat transfer. Advanced proficiency in OpenFOAM, including customisation of solvers and boundary conditions, and experience with at least one commercial code such as ANSYS Fluent/CFX, Simcenter STAR-CCM+, or similar. Strong meshing skills for complex internal geometries (snappyHexMesh, Gmsh, Fluent Meshing, or similar), with rigorous mesh independence and V&V practice. Proficiency in Python for automation, data analysis and workflow orchestration; experience with Linux and HPC environments. Proven track record of correlating simulation with experimental data. Desirable experience with regeneratively cooled rocket engines, gas turbine cooling, battery thermal management or compact heat exchangers. Desirable experience with additively manufactured flow components and the effect of surface roughness on heat transfer and pressure drop. Desirable experience with multiphase, reacting or supercritical/real-gas flows. Desirable experience with adjoint or topology optimisation, reduced-order modelling, or machine learning surrogate models for CFD. Desirable experience in programming languages such as C/C++, and a record of peer-reviewed publications. Fluent English. Strong analytical and problem solving skills. Excellent team-worker, who is agile, proactive, and has a "startup" attitude. Track record demonstrating creativity and ingenuity. What We Offer Competitive salary commensurate with your skills, experience, and contribution to the field of thermal-fluid simulation. The opportunity to shape the thermal-fluid simulation capability of an AI-driven engineering platform from an early stage. In-house metal additive manufacturing (LPBF), so you can design, print and test your own concepts. Involvement in high-impact programmes across the space, aerospace, defence and mobility sectors. Professional development and growth opportunities, including support for conferences and publications. Potential for international travel. Access to a range of benefits that support your well-being, including private medical insurance.

title: Doctoral researcher in computational weld mechanics
description: Do you want to build a research career in computational weld mechanics? Join LUT University as a doctoral researcher and become part of an international research team developing advanced simulation methods for welded high-strength steel structures. What Your Work Will Be Like Your work will focus on the analysis of local heat-affected zone (HAZ) behaviour in welded high-strength steels through computational weld mechanics (CWM) and phase-transformation modelling. The research combines thermo-metallurgical and phase-transformation modelling, simulation of microstructural evolution in weld heat-affected zones, and modelling of local mechanical properties such as hardness, strength and strain-hardening behaviour. In addition, the work includes experimental characterisation of welded joints using microstructural, thermal and mechanical measurements and the validation of predictive models for performance-driven design of welded structures. You will contribute to the development of next-generation simulation methods capable of accurately predicting local property variations in welded high-strength fossil-free steel structures. You will be part of the Welding Technology Unit and the Steel Structures Unit at the LUT School of Energy Systems. Approximately 25 researchers are involved in these units, which collaborate closely with national and international partner universities, such as University of Oulu (Finland), KTH Royal Institute of Technology (Sweden) and Chemnitz University of Technology (Germany). What We Expect From You You have a master's degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in a relevant field such as mechanical engineering, materials engineering, welding engineering, computational mechanics, or another relevant discipline, and the ability and motivation to complete the doctoral studies within their normative duration (i.e. four years). A solid background in numerical modelling, materials science, solid mechanics, finite element methods, programming, and/or welding technology is considered beneficial. Success in this position requires the ability to work independently, communicate findings clearly, and collaborate effectively within our international research community. Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, is required for performing the duties of this role. We expect a willingness to travel, as the position includes project-related travel within Finland, participation in international conferences, and opportunities for research mobility with partner universities in Europe. The selected candidate must submit an application for the right to complete doctoral studies with all required appendices to the LUT Doctoral School within the first two months of the employment relationship. What We Offer At LUT, you will have the opportunity to develop your scientific expertise and research skills. Our experienced supervisors will guide you, and you will benefit from professional development opportunities. The position is based at the Lappeenranta campus, and you are expected to be regularly present on site. The employment relationship will start with a one-year term (including a six-month trial period) and may be extended for up to three additional years, depending on the progress of your studies and research. The work starts in December 2026. The start date is negotiable. Working hours are flexible, supporting work-life balance, with a total of 1,612 annual working hours in accordance with the collective agreement for Finnish universities. The salary is determined according to the Finnish university salary system (requirement level 2). The starting salary is approximately EUR 3,100 per month, depending on experience and qualifications. Interested? Please submit your application by 15 October 2026 at 23:59 (UTC+2h). Fill out the online application form and attach the following documents in English and in PDF format: A cover letter describing your motivation and suitability specifically for this position, based on your expertise acquired during studies and potential prior work experience A curriculum vitae (CV) following the guidelines of the Finnish Advisory Board on Research Integrity Scanned copies of your original bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and transcripts of records; if the original documents are not in English or Finnish, each document must be accompanied by an official certified translation into English (or Finnish). If you wish to submit multiple files, please combine them into a single PDF before uploading. We will review applications on a rolling basis. Please ensure that your application includes all required documents and is submitted through the recruitment system. For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Tuomas Skriko (tuomas.skriko@lut.fi, +358 50 470 6518) or Assistant Professor Antti Ahola (antti.ahola@lut.fi, +358 50 475 2825), preferably by email. title: Erfarna beräkningsingenjörer till Advanced Platforms
description: Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll. Din roll På Advanced Platforms söker vi drivna beräkningsingenjörer inom hållfasthet som vill vara med och forma skrovet till framtidens stridsflygplan. Vi är i en intensiv teknikutvecklande fas och du ska vara redo att utmana arbetssätt och metoder tillsammans med oss för att ta fram nya tekniska lösningar och bygga flygande demonstratorer. På området utvecklar vi framtidens autonoma flygkoncept med överljudskapacitet. Arbetet består av specifika teknikstudier, mark-demonstratorer och flygande demonstratorer. Vårt mål är att vara en snabbfotad organisation som utför teknologiutveckling genom att producera hårdvara i snabba loopar för ett snabbt lärande. Som beräkningsingenjör inom hållfasthet är du delaktig i att forma designen av våra flygande demonstratorer, med fokus på hållfasthet. Arbetsuppgifterna kommer bestå av att genom analytiska metoder samt ingenjörsmässiga bedömningar säkerställa hållfastheten i nya produkter samt driva förbättringsarbeten av våra arbetssätt och metoder. Beroende på din förmåga och intresse kan rollen fördjupas inom tekniska och/eller ledarskap. I rollen kommer du att ansvara för: Säkerställa/bidra till sund hållfast design från blankt papper till färdig produkt. Driva utredningar av konstruktioner i utmanande applikationer. Säkerställa korrekt beräkningsunderlag. Driva kontinuerlig förbättring av arbetssätt. Samverka med andra discipliner i frågor om hållfasthet. Din profil Vi söker efter dig som är erfaren beräkningsingenjör inom hållfasthet, som vill vara en del av vår organisation där vi vågar prova nytt, vågar utmana men också vågar att misslyckas. Du ska vara redo att anamma lärdomarna och fortsätta framåt. Du ska vara en lagbyggare, nyfiken och ha en vilja att lära. För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har God förmåga att fungera i tvärfunktionella team/organisationer. Högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom Maskinteknik, Teknisk fysik eller liknande utbildning. God förståelse för grundläggande hållfasthet samt erfarenhet av arbete med FEM-verktyg. Erfarenhet av Hypermesh, Abaqus, Nastran, Matlab och grundläggande kunskap av CAD-verktyg är meriterande men inte ett krav. Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och viktigast för oss är din ambition och ditt intresse för hållfasthet och ingenjörskonsten i stort. Utifrån din bakgrund, kompetens och ambition, samt våra behov, kommer vi hitta en utvecklande väg i vår verksamhet för just dig. Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap. Vad du blir en del av Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas. Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här
