title: Ingénieur Calculs (Stress) Abaqus H/F
description: Groupe international d’ingénierie et d’expertise en technologies, Fortil repose sur un modèle indépendant et rassemble plus de 2 500 collaborateurs. Avec 30 agences réparties dans 14 pays, Fortil cultive la liberté d’entreprendre et la libération des potentiels. Description De Poste Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités industrielles, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Calculs spécialisé(e) en analyse mécanique et simulation numérique sous Abaqus pour intervenir sur des projets de dimensionnement et de validation de structures et d’équipements mécaniques. Intégré(e) à une équipe projet, vous contribuez à la justification du comportement mécanique des produits en tenant compte des exigences fonctionnelles, des conditions de fonctionnement, des normes applicables et des contraintes industrielles. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de conception, matériaux, essais, méthodes, industrialisation et production. À ce titre, vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes : Analyser les besoins de calcul et définir les méthodologies adaptées aux problématiques de dimensionnement ; Construire et exploiter des modèles éléments finis sous Abaqus ; Réaliser des calculs linéaires et non linéaires en statique, en dynamique et en fatigue selon les exigences projet ; Étudier le comportement des structures et des composants soumis à des chargements mécaniques, thermiques ou vibratoires ; Définir les hypothèses de calcul, les conditions aux limites, les chargements et les critères de dimensionnement ; Analyser les résultats de simulation, identifier les marges de sécurité et proposer des optimisations de conception ; Contribuer au dimensionnement et à la justification de pièces, d’assemblages et de structures mécaniques ; Réaliser les corrélations entre les résultats de calcul et les essais lorsque cela est nécessaire ; Rédiger les notes de calcul, rapports de justification et documents techniques associés ; Participer aux revues de conception et présenter les résultats auprès des équipes projet et des clients ; Vérifier la conformité des analyses avec les spécifications, normes et procédures applicables ; Contribuer à la résolution des problèmes techniques rencontrés lors des phases de développement, d’industrialisation ou de production. VOTRE PROFIL Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une formation Bac +5 en mécanique, génie mécanique, calcul de structures, matériaux ou domaine connexe. Vous justifiez idéalement d’une première expérience en calcul mécanique et simulation numérique, acquise au sein d’un bureau d’études ou dans un environnement industriel, idéalement dans les secteurs aéronautique , spatial, automobile ou défense. Vous maîtrisez ou avez des connaissances en : Calcul par éléments finis et analyse mécanique des structures ; Utilisation du logiciel Abaqus, notamment Abaqus/CAE et Abaqus/Standard ou Explicit ; Calculs linéaires et non linéaires, statiques, dynamiques et thermomécaniques ; Modélisation des matériaux, lois de comportement et critères de rupture ; Définition des chargements, conditions aux limites et hypothèses de calcul ; Analyse et interprétation des résultats de simulation ; Mécanique des milieux continus, résistance des matériaux et dimensionnement mécanique ; Rédaction de notes de calcul et de rapports de justification technique ; La programmation Python ou l’automatisation des post-traitements constituera un atout supplémentaire. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur, votre esprit d’analyse et votre capacité à prendre du recul sur les résultats obtenus. Votre curiosité technique et votre sens du travail en équipe vous permettent de collaborer efficacement avec des interlocuteurs issus de différentes spécialités. La maîtrise de l’anglais professionnel, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, est appréciée selon les projets. Les raisons de nous rejoindre Chez Fortil, nous mettons en place des leviers concrets pour accompagner votre évolution et garantir un environnement de travail stimulant : L’accompagnement sur la montée en compétences Un écosystème pour sortir de votre zone de confort La possibilité de devenir associé(e) L’engagement dans des projets associatifs Une politique dédiée à la parentalité Fortil s’engage en faveur de l’égalité des chances. Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap, sans distinction de genre, d’origine ou d’orientation sexuelle.

title: CAE Engineer
description: Description Overview - Senior CAE Application Engineer Rafinex is looking for an experienced senior CAE Application Engineer to support a variety of design projects across prototypes, pre-series and production vehicles/components in the defence and security industries (e.g. space, unmanned systems, aerospace applications). The role is primarily focused on CAE/FEA for structural mechanics and advanced topology optimization; covering a full workflow from problem definition through result evaluation. Integration and collaboration with further colleagues and tools on multi-physics codes and analysis is required. The algorithms and software to be used range from Rafinex internal proven tools through to cutting-edge developmental and research codes that may need verification and validation support. A sound foundational understanding of the underlying FEA theory and numerical implementation aspects is required. This role is physically based in Luxembourg, offering a flexible remote environment. The role is full time and should be long-term to accompany the projects from design phase to manufacturing, trial and testing deployments. Experience in working on sensitive and/or classified materials is an advantage, though not a strict requirement. Starting as soon as possible. Roles & Responsibilities Use Rafinex’ simulation software for i) FEA for structural mechanics applications, ii) Stochastic topology optimization studies and iii), Algorithm performance profiling and computational scalability Identify structural load scenarios, and compare load cases at assembly and component level. Combine simulation results and produce engineering reports capable of providing relevant technical insights and recommendations to design and simulation engineers. Create and interpret free body diagrams to define load paths and support accurate simulation setup, with appropriate approaches for connecting different components of large assemblies. Creating and modifying solid and surface CAD models; preparing models for analysis; resurfacing results from topology optimization. Pre-processing operations including geometry preparation / defeaturing / meshing and automation. Post-processing operations using Rafinex tools or open-source software (Paraview); scripting and automation. Contribute to product roadmap, identifying future capability requirements / comparison with competitors. Assist in validation and verification of analysis and optimization methods. Collaborate and integrate structural FEA results and methodologies with other multi-physics tools and software from partners and research centers. Take global project ownership from administrative conception to final delivery and post-delivery reporting, including delegation and directing sub-teams / suppliers. Candidates with a strong background in a distinct subset of the above Responsibilities will be considered for a standalone Role. About You - Requirements 10-15+ years experience in industry applied FEA design and analysis. Degree in Mechanical/Aerospace engineering or equivalent. Proficiency in finite element analysis tools and methods for structural analysis (static and modal). Solid understanding of mechanics of materials, load paths, and failure modes. Demonstrated experience with structural optimization techniques. Expertise in defining load cases, constraints, and boundary conditions for complex systems. Experience modeling assemblies and connections, including contact interactions. Ability to clearly communicate complex technical results. Fluent in written and spoken English. Further European languages are advantageous. Procedural experience / mindset to work in sensitive and classified environments. Ability to effectively manage concurrent deadlines, integrate with other functional teams, ensuring project management ownership and on-time deliverable The right to work in Luxembourg; Rafinex will not assist with any relocation or visa applications. Benefits Generous remuneration package. 25 days vacation per year. Flexible working hours. Dedicated Equipment budget. Financial support for professional development. Apply Rafinex is committed to fostering an innovative and inclusive environment. To apply please send your CV to careers@rafinex.com There is no closing date for applications but interviews will be held on a rolling basis and closed as soon as the position is filled. No recruiters & No AI Agents of any sort.

title: Additive Manufacturing Project Engineer
description: Additive Manufacturing Project Engineer An additive manufacturing system only creates value when it produces the right part, reliably, in the customer's hands. At Voksel 3D, this role makes sure that happens. As a Additive Manufacturing Project Engineer, you will be the technical link between what our customers in defense, aerospace, industrial manufacturing and medical need to produce and what our systems can deliver. If you want hands-on work across a wide range of AM technologies, with real impact on Türkiye's advanced manufacturing landscape, this role is for you. About us: Voksel 3D supplies advanced additive manufacturing systems across Türkiye: metal and polymer powder bed fusion systems, ultra-polymer FDM systems, 3D sand printers and ceramic printers. We support our customers from technology selection through installation, process qualification and series production. What You'll Do Part assessment: Evaluate candidate parts for additive manufacturing, including technology and material selection, manufacturability, design optimization and the business case behind each part Design & build preparation: Apply DfAM to redesign existing parts and optimize new ones; prepare build files that deliver high-quality parts with minimum build time and maximum consistency Process & materials: Analyze print parameters and post-processing routes (including heat treatment) by evaluating mechanical properties, dimensional accuracy and surface finish; document parameters, build reports and work instructions Benchmarks & demos: Manage benchmark and sample parts needs that show customers what our technologies can do for their applications Customer & sales support: Take part in technical meetings with customers, provide input for proposals and feasibility studies, and prepare technical reports and presentations Ownership: Manage several projects in parallel, adapt to shifting priorities, close loops and hold yourself to a high standard of quality Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Aerospace or Materials Engineering 2–3 years of hands-on experience in additive manufacturing (metal and/or polymer) Hands-on experience operating metal or polymer AM systems, preferably powder bed fusion Working knowledge of DfAM: you know how to make a part printable and worth printing Proficiency in 3D CAD (SolidWorks preferred; Siemens NX or CATIA also welcome) Experience with build preparation software (e.g., Materialise Magics or similar) Ability to read and interpret technical drawings Understanding of metal and polymer material behavior, heat treatment and post-processing Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, comfortable with ambiguity Good written and spoken English For male candidates, military service completed or exempted Preferred Qualifications Experience in defense, aerospace or medical manufacturing environments Experience with high-performance polymer FDM, sand or ceramic AM processes Experience with inspection methods (CMM, 3D scanning, CT) Experience with simulation or topology optimization tools Experience training or supporting customers on manufacturing equipment Why This Role Additive manufacturing is growing fast in Türkiye, especially in defense, aerospace and medical. As part of a small team, you will work hands-on with a broad range of technologies that most engineers only see one of. You'll build experience quickly, take on real responsibility early, and help shape how our customers adopt AM in production. Work Environment Based on-site at our Esenyurt, Istanbul office Limited domestic and international travel might be required

title: Design Engineer
description: Mubea Türkiye Engineering Office is part of the global Mubea Group, an automotive supplier with roughly 17,000 employees and over 50 locations worldwide. Within aerospace, Mubea Aviation operates with approximately 2,350 employees, ranking among the world's top 100 aerospace suppliers. Located in Istanbul Teknopark , our Türkiye office is dedicated to the design of aircraft components, supporting Mubea’ s global role in the aerospace industry. This office represents a strategic expansion of our engineering capabilities and our commitment to innovation, knowledge transfer, and collaboration. We are currently seeking a Design Engineer to join our growing team. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to advanced aerospace projects, collaborate with international colleagues, and play a key part in shaping the future of engineering excellence at Mubea. Key Responsibilities Develop and modify metal and composite aircraft parts and assemblies. Design tooling and jigs for aircraft components (including lamination tools, milling jigs, and other manufacturing tooling). Perform tolerance analyses for parts, assemblies, and tooling. Create design data, including 3D models, 2D drawings, bills of materials, ply books, and engineering change documentation, in CAD and PDM systems according to customer requirements. Collaborate closely with international engineering teams, manufacturing teams, and suppliers to ensure manufacturable and cost-effective designs. Prepare engineering documentation and participate in design reviews, checks, and release activities. Core Competencies Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Aerospace Engineering. Experience in mechanical design, including parts, assemblies, tooling, molds, and fixtures. Good working knowledge of CATIA V5. Proficiency in Geometrical Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T). Good command of English, including technical terminology, with the ability to communicate effectively in technical meetings and written correspondence. A structured and proactive working style, with a strong sense of responsibility and the ability to work effectively in an international team. Willing and able to travel internationally. Preferred Qualifications Experience in composite tooling design and related manufacturing processes is a plus. Experience in aircraft fuselage design and related manufacturing technologies is a plus. A good understanding of general airworthiness regulations, including EASA Part 21J / Part 21G, is a plus. Experience with Airbus PLM systems, including Airbus VPM and PASS SSI, is a plus. Familiarity with hand lay-up and autoclave curing processes is a plus. What We Offer Regular technical meetings and direct collaboration with international engineering teams. An engineering culture based on quality, precision, and continuous improvement. Opportunities to contribute to aircraft component and tooling design projects within Mubea’s global aerospace network. Opportunities to develop technical skills through a variety of aerospace projects.

title: MOD&Engineering Technical Specialist
description: What We Expect Key Responsibilities Review and interpret site survey reports, measurements, photographs, and technical findings received from field teams. Assess the existing condition of elevator systems and identify appropriate modernization solutions in line with project requirements. Prepare and revise mechanical and/or electrical technical drawings for elevator modernization projects using AutoCAD. Develop layout drawings, component arrangements, shaft plans, and technical details required for modernization applications. Perform the necessary technical calculations and ensure that proposed solutions are technically feasible and compliant with applicable standards. Prepare project cost estimates, budgets, material requirements, and pricing studies based on site survey data and technical specifications. Determine the scope of modernization projects and prepare accurate technical documentation and bills of quantities. Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Procurement, Installation, and Field teams throughout the quotation and project preparation processes. Provide technical support during customer proposal and tender preparation stages. Ensure that designs and technical solutions comply with relevant elevator regulations, company procedures, and applicable safety standards. Follow developments in elevator technologies, modernization solutions, components, and industry standards. Who we are looking for Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering. Minimum 5 years of professional experience in elevator modernization, technical design, engineering, estimation, or a related field. Strong knowledge of elevator modernization processes, including the assessment and replacement or adaptation of mechanical, electrical, control, drive, door, car, shaft, and safety systems. Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD, with the ability to prepare and interpret detailed technical drawings. Solid knowledge of EN 81-20 and EN 81-50, as well as relevant elevator safety regulations and technical standards. Ability to interpret field survey data and convert site findings into technically feasible modernization solutions. Experience in cost estimation, budgeting, material take-offs, and project pricing. Good command of written and spoken English, with the ability to read and prepare technical documentation. Preferably holding a relevant SMM Certificate (Independent Engineering and Consultancy Certificate). Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, planning, and cross-functional communication skills. As a manufacturer of passenger and freight elevators, escalators, moving walkways, passenger transport bridges as well as stair lifts and platform lifts, you will find us, for example, at the One World Trade Center in New York, the Financial Center in Shanghai. You will also find us at the Television Tower in Berlin and at almost every airport. With more than 50,000 employees and customers in more than 100 countries, we are changing the daily lives of people all over the world. TKE - Move Beyond. title: Mechanical Maintenance Engineer

Coordinate, supervise, and provide guidance and training to maintenance personnel and external contractors to ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality maintenance execution. Manage spare parts inventory and ensure the effective utilization of the maintenance budget. Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, sufficient to effectively manage technical documentation, international communication, and occupational health and safety processes. Knowledge of lubrication systems, hydraulic and pneumatic systems, as well as alignment and balancing of rotating equipment. Experience with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS); knowledge of SAP PM Module is preferred. Strong problem-solving, project management, and leadership skills. Ability to adapt to a dynamic and fast-paced industrial working environment. At TITAN we provide equal opportunities for employment, prohibiting any kind of discrimination. All applicants will be acknowledged and treated in the strictest confidence.

title: Özgün Motorlar CNC Programlama İmalat Mühendisi
description: TEI olarak 1985’ten günümüze; havacılık motorları alanında sektöre sunduğumuz yüksek kaliteli ürün, hizmetler ile uluslararası arenada dünya çapında bir üretici ve küresel bir tasarım merkezi konumundayız. Bu güçlü konumumuzdan hareketle kendimizi Gücün Kaynağı olarak tanımlıyoruz. Küresel havacılığa sunduğumuz katkılar ve Türkiye’nin havacılık serüvenine kazandırdığımız ilkler ile başarı hikâyeleri yazmaya devam ediyor; parça ve modül üretimi, motor montaj, test ve bakım, onarım, revizyon, motor tasarımı ve ürün geliştirme alanlarında mükemmeli hedefliyoruz. Türk Havacılık Uzay Sanayii, GE Aerospace, Türk Silahlı Kuvvetleri Güçlendirme Vakfı ve Türk Hava Kurumu ortaklığında kurulan şirketimiz, millî projelerle gurur veren başarılarda yerini alma ve geleceğin havacılık hikâyelerine imza atma fırsatı sunuyor. Bu yolculukta başarımızı teknoloji ile beraber değerlerimizden de alıyoruz: adaletle güven inşa ediyor, birlikte mükemmelliği hedefliyor, kapsayıcı bir ortam kuruyor, yenilikçi bakış açısıyla büyüyor ve sorumluluk bilinciyle hareket ediyoruz. Gökyüzündeki her iki uçaktan birinde TEI parçaları var! Sen de geniş öğrenme imkanlarıyla sınırsız gelişimi planlıyor; yenilikçi ve öncü projelerle başarılı bir kariyer hedefliyorsan aramızdaki yerini hemen al! #GücünOdağındaSenVarsın TEI'de Seni Neler Bekliyor? title: EPT Component Specialist (Hybrid)
description: Job Description Join Amaris Consulting as an EPT Component Specialist in Bursa and take part in engineering projects for one of our clients in the automotive sector. You will contribute to component development activities within the EPT scope, with a strong focus on HVAC systems, design coordination, and project follow-up in an industrial environment. Key Responsibilities Lead component development activities within the EPT scope for automotive projects. Coordinate HVAC-related design activities in line with project requirements and technical standards. Review technical specifications, drawings, and design documentation for assigned components. Follow up project milestones, deliverables, and technical action plans with relevant stakeholders. Manage design changes and ensure proper documentation throughout the project lifecycle. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support component integration and validation activities. Monitor technical risks and propose corrective actions to secure project delivery. Ensure alignment with automotive quality, cost, and timing objectives. Requirements Experience in the automotive sector, ideally in component development, HVAC systems, or EPT-related projects. Experience with HVAC design, component development, and technical documentation. Experience with project management, milestone follow-up, and cross-functional coordination. Knowledge of automotive development processes, design change management, and validation activities. Proficiency with CAD tools and technical drawing review. Academic background in mechanical engineering, automotive engineering, or a related technical field. English fluent. Turkish fluent. Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail. Ability to coordinate technical topics with multiple stakeholders in a structured environment. Strong communication skills and a solution-oriented mindset. If you are ready to take the next step in your career and contribute to innovative automotive projects, we would be glad to receive your application. Amaris Consulting is committed to promoting diversity within its workforce and to creating an inclusive work environment. We review applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic. Special consideration will be given to candidates with disabilities. Who are we? Amaris Consulting, part of Mantu is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1,000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your steppingstone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges and achieve all your projects with success. At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like: Brief Call : Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you! Interviews (the average number of interviews is 3 - the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your line manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities! Case study : Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem-solving scenario, etc. As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company. That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience. We look forward to meeting you!

title: Maintenance Engineer
description: Job Description About the Position We have an excellent opportunity available for Maintenance Engineer to make a difference at Kraft Heinz Turkey. Maintenance Engineer role lies within the Maintenance team and is based in our Susurluk factory. You’ll be working in a high-performing team, alongside peers always trying to reach the next level. You’ll be reporting to the Maintenance & Utilities Manager. In brief, you will be responsible for To ensure that maintenance and repair operations are carried out, recorded, reported and coordinated with the production department (breakdown, predictive, preventive and planned maintenance) To carry out and implement maintenance activities according to the maintenance planning organization and annual maintenance revisions. To increase the quality of care, to carry out continuous training and development activities for the maintenance team in terms of productivity and occupational safety, Receiving the price offers of spare parts, services and services required for machinery and equipment, ensuring their organization and creating purchase requests, Receiving the offers of spare parts, services and services required for machinery and equipment, ensuring their organization and creating purchase request. What You Bring Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechatronics, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or related engineering disciplines 1+ year Maintenance experience Professional knowledge in all kinds of mechanical elements, connections, fittings, sealing parts, root cause analysis, 7D problem solving, TPM knowledge, Installing and Commissioning of new lines/machines, spare parts warehouse managing and supplying spare parts types of equipment, reducing annual maintenance budget within the root cause analysis, experience in auxiliary facilities such as steam boilers, air compressors etc. Microsoft Office, SAP, AutoCAD Knowledge of English What We Offer You An ambitious employer; we only want to the best for you; A fast career track like only few other companies can match; Always room for new ideas; if you have an excellent idea, please let us know and we can set it in action! About Us The Kraft Heinz Company is one of the largest food and beverage companies in the world, with eight $1 billion+ brands and global sales of approximately $25 billion. We’re a globally trusted producer of high-quality, great-tasting, and nutritious foods for over 150 years. Our brands are truly global, with products produced and marketed in over 40 countries. These beloved products include condiments and sauces, cheese and dairy, meals, meats, refreshment beverages, coffee, infant and nutrition products, and numerous other grocery products in a portfolio of more than 200 legacy and emerging brands. No matter the brand, we’re united under one vision To sustainably grow by delighting more consumers globally. Bringing this vision to life is our team of 39,000+ food lovers, creative thinkers, and high performers worldwide. Together, we help provide meals to those in need through our global partnership with Rise Against Hunger. We also stand committed to responsible, sustainable practices that extend to every facet of our business, our consumers, and our communities. Every day, we’re transforming the food industry with bold thinking and unprecedented results. If you share our passion – and are ready to create the future, build a legacy, and lead as a global citizen – there’s only one thing to do join our table and let’s make life delicious! Our Culture of Ownership, Meritocracy and Collaboration We're not afraid to think differently. Embrace new ideas. Dream big. We empower our people at every level – from entry-level intern to senior leader – to own their work. We share a responsibility to think like Owners – to be mindful of the collective and sustained success of Kraft Heinz – which we apply to every situation, every day. As part of Kraft Heinz, you're supported to grow and achieve. You’re expected to bring your authentic self to work every day, to lead with humility, and drive outstanding performance at every level – and you’ll be rewarded. You’re given opportunities to leave a mark and build a legacy. But you won’t do it alone. You’re supported by passionate teammates along the way, and our collective, collaborative spirit fuels our incredible progress. title: Field Services Engineer
description: ABOUT VOKSEL 3D VOKSEL 3D is a leading high-tech engineering and additive manufacturing related solutions provider. Specializing in industrial-grade SLS (Selective Laser Sintering), SLM (Selective Laser Melting), DED (Directed Energy Deposition), FDM (Fused Deposition Modeling), and SBJ (Sand Binder Jetting) technologies, we empower industries ranging from aerospace and defense to medical and automotive. At VOKSEL 3D, we don't just supply hardware and software; we act as a strategic partner in digital transformation. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in manufacturing by providing cutting-edge systems and unparalleled technical expertise. Join us to be part of a visionary team that is shaping the future of production today. International Technical Service Engineer Role Overview We are seeking a high-caliber International Technical Service Engineer based in Istanbul to join our global support network. You will be responsible for the end-to-end technical lifecycle of our advanced 3D printing systems (SLS, SLM, DED, FDM, SBJ). Your mission is to ensure operational excellence at customer sites through expert installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting, directly contributing to customer satisfaction and global sales growth. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Field Operations: Perform on-site system installations, re-locations, fault recoveries, and preventive maintenance for a diverse portfolio of additive manufacturing systems. Technical Support: Provide advanced remote and on-site troubleshooting to maximize system uptime and performance. Training: Conduct professional operational and technical maintenance training for customers and create supporting educational materials. Sales Integration: Support the pre-sales stages with technical demos and collaborate with the sales team for spare parts quoting and order tracking. Global Coordination: Maintain rigorous communication with headquarters, submitting detailed service reports and field feedback in a timely manner. Essential Education, Skills, and Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical-Electronics, Mechatronics, or Manufacturing Engineering. Experience: Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in technical field services (Experience in Additive Manufacturing is highly preferred). Technical Proficiency: Strong "hands-on" skills in troubleshooting and repairing complex electromechanical and optical systems. Languages: Excellent command of English is mandatory for international coordination. The Chinese Advantage: Basic knowledge of Chinese (Mandarin) is a significant asset, facilitating direct technical communication with suppliers. Software: Proficiency or familiarity with 3D modeling and slicing software. Travel: High flexibility for domestic and international travel; must work well under pressure with a keen eye for detail.

title: teknik Ressam / Konstrüktör
description: Ekibimize Yeni Bir Teknik Ressam / Konstrüktör Arıyoruz! Çizdiğin her parçanın atölyede kesildiğini, büküldüğünü, birleştirildiğini ve sonunda bir mağazada müşterisiyle buluştuğunu görmek ister misin? Brandis olarak premium teşhir üniteleri, perakende çözümleri, festival yapıları ve özel üretim projeler geliştiriyoruz. Tasarım ekibimizin hayal ettiğini üretimin anlayacağı dile çevirecek, çizimleriyle atölyemize yol gösterecek yeni bir takım arkadaşı arıyoruz. Neler yapacaksın? Teşhir ünitesi, stant ve özel projelerin SolidWorks'te 3D modellerini ve üretim çizimlerini hazırlamak Sac metal parçaların açınımlarını ve lazer kesim için DXF dosyalarını oluşturmak Ahşap, pleksi ve alüminyum parçaların kesim ve montaj detaylarını çizmek Montaj resimleri, patlatılmış görünümler ve parça listeleri (BOM) hazırlamak Atölye ve tedarikçilerle birlikte çalışarak çizimleri üretimde sınamak ve iyileştirmek Kimleri arıyoruz? ✔ Makine Resim ve Konstrüksiyon, Makine Mühendisliği, Mobilya ve Dekorasyon ya da benzer bölümlerden mezun olan, ✔ SolidWorks'e (Sheet Metal, Weldments, Assembly) gerçekten hâkim olan, ✔ Teknik resim standartlarını, ölçülendirmeyi ve toleransları bilen, ✔ Açınım, büküm payı ve üretilebilir tasarım mantığına hâkim olan, ✔ Metal, ahşap, pleksi ve plastik malzemelere yabancı olmayan, ✔ Atölyeye girmekten ve ustayla aynı dili konuşmaktan keyif alan, ✔ Detaycı ama pratik düşünebilen, ✔ Takım çalışmasına inanan, öğrenmeye açık. Bunlar varsa harika olur POP/POS, mağaza dekorasyonu veya shopfitting sektöründe 1-5 yıl deneyim AutoCAD bilgisi Demonte (flat-pack) tasarım ve sevkiyat odaklı düşünme LED ve kablo yolu detaylarını çizebilme MS Office bilgisi, tercihen İngilizce B sınıfı ehliyet Brandis'te seni neler bekliyor? Her gün farklı bir proje. Çizdiğin parçanın birkaç gün içinde atölyede hayat bulduğunu görmek. Tasarım, mühendislik ve üretimin aynı çatı altında olduğu bir ekip. Fikirlerinin dinlendiği, sorumluluk alabildiğin bir ortam. Sürekli öğrenme ve gelişim fırsatı. Küçük ama önemli bir not 🙂 Bizim için iyi bir çizim, atölyede soru işareti bırakmayan çizimdir. Ustanın tek bir telefon açmadan üretebileceği çizimler hazırlamak sana heyecan veriyorsa, tanışalım. 📍 Çalışma Yeri: İstanbul / Ataşehir / Ferhatpaşa CV'ni ve mümkünse hazırladığın birkaç üretim çizimi ya da SolidWorks çalışmasını bizimle paylaşmanı rica ediyoruz. Başvurunda, çizimini yaptığın ve üretildiğini gördüğün bir parçayı birkaç cümleyle anlatırsan çok seviniriz.

title: Design and Release Engineer
description: JOB DESCRIPTION Lead New Development and Ongoing Program Development (OPD), Quality, and Total Value Management (TVM) activities for Electrical Distribution Systems (EDS) and/or Switch & Display Systems. Be responsible for all subsystem-related activities, including: • Developing functional and engineering specifications • Conducting technical design reviews • Creating and executing Design Verification Plans (DVP) • Performing design efficiency and TVM analyses • Leading technical collaboration with suppliers and cross-functional teams • Ensuring deliverables are completed on time in accordance with the Global Product Development System (GPDS) Work closely with suppliers, manufacturing plants, core engineering teams, and global program teams. Manage and coordinate communication among internal and external stakeholders. Support sourcing activities, including Requests for Quotation (RFQ) management, maintain project plans, and contribute to vehicle, component, and system-level testing activities. Additionally, oversee program-specific Bill of Materials (BoM) management and coordinate FSU, production release, WERS, and other engineering release activities. Required Qualifications & Experience • B.Sc. degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Control Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Mechatronics Engineering • Experience in Electrical Distribution Systems (EDS) Routing Engineering and Complexity Management • Project management experience, preferably within the automotive industry • Knowledge and hands-on experience with engineering development tools and methodologies such as FMEA, DVP, 8D, FEDE, and similar processes • Understanding of modern materials, manufacturing processes, and product development methodologies • Interest and enthusiasm for the design and development of electrical components and systems • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment • Willingness to travel as required • Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal Role Location Sancaktepe / İstanbul When You Start Your Career In "Ford Otosan"; • We have hybrid working model and you can enjoy being part of an agile team. • You'll become a member of Koç Pension Foundation • You'll choose the side benefits with Flextra The only criterion evaluated in the recruitment and employment is suitability for the job; equal opportunity is provided without any discrimination. What About Us? Ford Otosan, being one of the top three exporting companies in Turkey since 2004, has achieved 13 consecutive years of automotive industry championship and is Turkiye goods product export champion for 9 years in a row. Ford Otosan operates in 4 main centers with its Gölcük and Yeniköy Plants in Kocaeli, Eskişehir Plant in Eskişehir, Sancaktepe R&D Center and Spare Parts Warehouse in İstanbul and Craiova Plant in Romania employs more than 20,000 people. Kocaeli and Eskişehir Plants are listed among Ford's 'Best Vehicle Production Centers' and Eskişehir is the only factory in Turkiye that can produce vehicles, engines, and powertrains in the same center. Ford Otosan, standing out with its sensitivity regarding social responsibilities, also carries out several social responsibility projects in many fields including education, healthcare, culture, arts, and sports on “Future. Now” vision. Ford Otosan, also carrying out awareness studies on gender equality since 2013 with the understanding of "Equality at Work", became the only automotive and the first and only industrial company from Turkiye to be included in the Bloomberg Gender-Equality Index in 2021. The building blocks of our new corporate culture, which we call “Dynamic Balance”, our values are mutual trust and respect, value each other and affection, openness to change and innovation, open and transparent communication. A common culture brings us to a common sense and purpose, helps us to work in a positive atmosphere of trust, ties us closer and helps us to reach a stronger future all together.

title: Maintenance Engineer - Bandırma
description: How about building your career at one of the world’s largest food companies? Come work at MBRF , a company present in the lives of thousands of families around the world. From the simplest moments to the most special ones, we nourish life through quality, innovation, and the people who make everything happen. Would you like to join Banvit MBRF and nourish life as part of a global food giant? Since 1968, Banvit MBRF has been one of Turkey's leading food manufacturers, known for its sustainability mindset and quality-oriented approach. We count on our 5,000 employees and stakeholders all around Turkey, especially in Bandırma, İzmir and Elazığ, where our production facilities are located. In 2017, Banvit has joined forces with BRF, one of the world's leading food manufacturers. Thanks to a legacy spanning 90 years, together we are more confident in our future than ever. Serving more than 125 countries, MBRF is a global company that operates 44 facilities and employs more than 100,000 people around the world. At Banvit MBRF, nourishing life is our commitment. We focus not only on production, but also on animal welfare, social development, and sustainable consumption within our communities. What will you be doing at Banvit MBRF? Develop and update maintenance plans, define technical standards, review maintenance frequencies, and implement maintenance routines Perform systematic analyses, including Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), for critical equipment; analyze Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) and Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF), and recommend reliability improvements Support spare parts management activities, including inventory optimization, stock control, and localization initiatives Establish and monitor maintenance targets and KPIs Monitor and control the maintenance budget Promote maintenance best practices and support the preparation and delivery of technical training programs Comply with health and safety policies and procedures, use appropriate safety equipment, and report hazards, incidents, and safety issues What kind of profile are we looking for? Bachelor's degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering or a related engineering discipline 2-3 years of experience in an industrial plant with preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance practices Good knowledge of PLC and HMI programming, including backup upload/download procedures (Mitsubishi and Siemens) Familiarity with the SAP PM module Knowledge of problem-solving methodologies and tools (e.g., PDCA, Cause-and-Effect Diagram) Advanced English proficiency Proficiency in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) Flexibility to work outside regular hours and on weekends when required Living in Bandırma or open to relocation What competencies are key to this role? Strong work ethic, proactive mindset and commitment to excellence High level of professional integrity Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills Ability to lead and develop teams and manage resources effectively Ability to interact effectively with all levels of the organization Ability to perform under pressure What can you expect from Banvit MBRF? Being part of a global, collaborative and dynamic working environment Strong corporate culture with commitments to customers, employees & environment we serve Vertical, horizontal, and cross-functional growth opportunities Apply now and be part of MBRF ! #BRFBanvit

For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Work from the Istanbul office while maintaining close collaboration with the Ankara office. We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. title: Senior Operations Research Engineer
description: Avenga is an international engineering firm helping businesses operate with AI at the core. With 6,000+ experts worldwide, we combine engineering expertise with AI-native thinking to turn ambitious ideas into real-world impact across industries, technologies, and markets. At the core of the role For our client, a global technology company focused on AI-driven industrial solutions, we are looking for a Senior Operations Research Engineer to join a team solving complex optimization problems at scale. In this role, you will design mathematical models and optimization algorithms that improve planning, scheduling, resource allocation, and operational efficiency. Working closely with software engineers, data scientists, and machine learning specialists, you will turn complex business challenges into scalable optimization solutions suitable for production environments. This position combines applied mathematics, optimization, simulation, and software engineering in a research-driven environment where ideas quickly become production systems. IMPORTANT NOTE : Working time required to have 1-2h overlap with US PST time zone Core skills you’ll bring MSc or PhD in Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or another STEM discipline. Strong knowledge of optimization techniques such as linear programming, mixed-integer programming, constraint programming, nonlinear optimization, or heuristic/metaheuristic algorithms. Experience translating business problems into mathematical optimization models. Strong Python programming skills. Experience with LLMs. Ability to combine optimization workflows with LLM automation. Experience building production-quality software rather than research prototypes only. Experience working with large datasets and developing efficient optimization workflows. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently in an R&D environment with evolving requirements. Good communication skills and fluent English. Nice-to-have Experience with machine learning or AI-assisted optimization. Experience with simulation, stochastic optimization, agent-based modeling, or Markov models. Knowledge of high-performance computing (HPC). Experience with cloud platforms and distributed computing. Experience with industrial optimization problems such as logistics, manufacturing, energy, robotics, or supply chain. The impact you'll create Design and implement mathematical optimization models for complex industrial problems. Develop algorithms for planning, scheduling, routing, allocation, and decision support. Collaborate with machine learning engineers to combine optimization techniques with AI solutions. Build scalable optimization pipelines using Python and modern software engineering practices. Validate optimization models through simulation and experimentation. Analyze algorithm performance and continuously improve solution quality and computational efficiency. Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business objectives and translate them into mathematical models. Document approaches, assumptions, and experimental results to support knowledge sharing and future development. What supports your journey Through our values, we strive to provide you with the tools, autonomy, trust, and assistance you need to excel. Enjoy benefits like private health insurance, well-being programs, flexible and hybrid work models, laptops and gear, training, language classes, social events, great offices, and more. People are at the core of Avenga. We provide equal opportunities regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, religion, or any other characteristic. We are committed to a respectful environment where everyone can be themselves, share their ideas, and feel that they belong.

title: Production Systems Expert

As a Manufacturing Systems Expert, you will play a key role in supporting reliable, compliant, and efficient manufacturing operations in a GxP-regulated environment. Working collaboratively with manufacturing, quality, engineering, automation, and IT teams, you will contribute to the management and continuous improvement of manufacturing systems that enable operational excellence and digital transformation. This role offers a unique opportunity to develop expertise across multiple production systems while helping shape the future of digital manufacturing and delivering sustainable value to the business. About The Role The Manufacturing Systems Expert is responsible for coordinating, maintaining, and continuously improving manufacturing systems that support production and packaging operations. The role acts as a bridge between business users, production teams, quality functions, IT, and external partners to ensure reliable and compliant system performance. The role is responsible for coordinating and continuously improving manufacturing systems in compliance with GMP requirements. Represent the assigned manufacturing area in MES and other Manufacturing Systems initiatives, ensuring that electronic batch records and related digital capabilities are implemented in line with business, operational, and compliance requirements. Collaborate with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to identify needs, define requirements, and deliver effective and value-added digital solutions. Design, create, maintain, and continuously improve MBRs in line with operational, quality, and compliance requirements. Major Accountabilities Coordinate end-to-end MES implementation activities for all products, including current and future MES releases, upgrades, and related digital initiatives. Identify improvement opportunities by analyzing system performance, operational needs, and industry best practices. Ensure inspection readiness by maintaining up-to-date manufacturing systems procedures, documentation, and compliance records, and by supporting internal and external audits/inspections. Act as a subject matter expert for assigned manufacturing systems, providing technical and functional guidance while promoting knowledge sharing and cross-training within the Manufacturing Systems team. Provide expertise for manufacturing and packaging processes during the design, testing, implementation, and continuous improvement of manufacturing system solutions and MBRs. Coordinate, maintain, and continuously improve manufacturing systems, including MES, SAP, MACO, Seidenader Track & Trace, AGE, Historian, and GISC, ensuring their reliable and compliant operation. Collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to identify current and future business needs, drive process simplification, system optimization, automation and digitalization opportunities, and contribute to new projects, enhancements, and digital initiatives. title: Product Application Engineer
description: Vil du være med til at bygge bro mellem produktudvikling, kundeløsninger og produktion – og samtidig bidrage til yderligere industrialisering af vores produkter? Bucher Municipal A/S er en del af schweiziske Bucher Industries, en international industrikoncern med omkring 14.000 medarbejdere. Hos Bucher Municipal udvikler og producerer vi slamsugere til professionelle kunder over hele verden. Vi er i gang med en vigtig udvikling, hvor vi har øget fokus på industrialisering, standardisering og høj dokumentationsgrad. Målet er robuste og veldokumenterede produkter, der kan produceres, konfigureres og serviceres effektivt. Din rolle Stillingen kombinerer elementer fra Application Engineering, System Modules Engineering og Production Engineering. Du kommer til at arbejde med både nye og eksisterende produkter og være med til at omsætte produkt- og kundebehov til tekniske løsninger, der er standardiserede, veldokumenterede og designet til at de er lette at servicere. Dine primære opgaver vil blandt andet være: Industrialisering og modning af nye og eksisterende produkter. Udvikling af standardiserede og modulære produktløsninger. Sikring og videreudvikling af teknisk dokumentation. Optimering med fokus på kvalitet, omkostninger, produktion og servicevenlighed. Teknisk support og problemløsning i tæt samarbejde med produktionen. Tværgående samarbejde med R&D, Product Management, Production, Quality, Service og Supply Chain. Vores nye kollega Vi forestiller os, at du har en teknisk uddannelse som eksempelvis maskiningeniør, produktionsteknolog, maskinmester eller tilsvarende. Du må gerne være nyuddannet eller have kort erfaring. Du har en god teknisk forståelse og trives med at arbejde i grænsefladen mellem konstruktion, produkt og produktion. Erfaring fra industriel produktion vil være en fordel, men ikke et krav. Vi lægger vægt på, at du arbejder struktureret og praktisk, har forståelse for produktmodning og industrialisering og ser værdien i standardisering og god teknisk dokumentation. Bliv en del af vores udvikling Hos os får du mulighed for at arbejde tæt på komplekse produkter og være med til at præge den måde, vi udvikler og industrialiserer dem på. Vi tilbyder en hverdag med stor teknisk berøringsflade, korte veje fra problem til løsning samt fleksibilitet og fokus på en god balance mellem arbejds- og privatliv. Interesseret? title: Senior Element Designer - LEGO® DESiGN
description: Job Description Ready to shape the future of LEGO® play through innovative products, functional solutions and outstanding design? In the LEGO® System, everything starts with a single element. For us, every piece is a unique product, worthy of the expertise required to bring a LEGO experience to life. We're looking to you to help us protect, enhance and imagine what the LEGO System is, both now and for the future. We are looking for a Senior Element Designer with strong 3D design capabilities and a passion for innovation. You combine excellent design fundamentals with a deep understanding of form, proportion, scale, detailing and functionality. You thrive on solving complex design challenges and turning ideas into compelling physical products that balance creativity, play value and manufacturability. As a senior member of the team, you will drive projects from concept to production, influence design direction and collaborate across disciplines to deliver world-class LEGO® elements and play experiences. No two projects are the same, and they all require different needs and expertise. Element Design is a key department in the development of new LEGO® elements, including both molded and textile solutions. We operate at the intersection of design for aesthetics, design for play and design for manufacturing, partnering closely with engineering and manufacturing teams to transform ideas into reality. Our designers create solutions that combine outstanding design quality with purposeful functionality. Whether developing a new mechanism, a novel building solution, an innovative material application or a breakthrough element concept, we strive to push the boundaries of creativity while maintaining the quality and values of the LEGO® brand. Every year, we create hundreds of new elements that shape play experiences across the LEGO® portfolio. Success is always a team sport, and our work relies on strong partnerships, curiosity and a shared passion for innovation. Do you have what it takes? Degree in Industrial Design, Product Design or equivalent design education, combined with a proven track record of product design experience and leading design processes Strong hardgoods design capabilities with an exceptional understanding of form, proportion, scale, detailing and product aesthetics Experience driving innovation and solving challenging design problems through creativity and systems thinking Strong 3D design capabilities using one or more of the following software packages NX, Rhino or similar software. Ability to translate 2D concepts and abstract opportunities into compelling and manufacturable 3D products Strong sketching, visualization and storytelling capabilities Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills and proven ability to collaborate across multiple functional areas Good understanding of manufacturing processes, including injection molding and other production methods Ability to navigate ambiguity and make sound design decisions in complex development environments Good analytic and systems-thinking skills Good at documenting progress and planning own time It is an advantage if you bring Experience designing consumer products, toys, functional products or mechanical systems Experience developing innovative mechanisms, product features or interactive experiences Experience working with both aesthetic and functional product requirements Experience with prototyping, testing and user-centered design approaches Understanding of textile product development and alternative manufacturing technologies Understanding of play from a child's perspective Willingness to invest in the lives and careers of interns and junior designers through mentorship Bring innovation to life As a Senior Element Designer, you will help define future building and play experiences through outstanding product design. You are equally passionate about aesthetics and functionality, and you enjoy exploring opportunities that challenge existing solutions and expand what is possible within the LEGO® System. You will find yourself in a creative and highly collaborative environment where ideas are encouraged, innovation is celebrated and your work will directly impact products enjoyed by children around the world. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: Why join us? We’re on a mission to empower people with disabilities to do what they once did or never thought possible. As the world-leader in assistive communication solutions, we empower our customers to express themselves, connect with the world, and live richer lives. At Tobii Dynavox, you can grow your career within a dynamic, global company that has a clear, impactful purpose - with the flexibility to also do what truly matters to you outside of work. What’s more, you’ll be part of a work culture where collaboration is the norm and individuality is welcomed. As a member of our team, you’ll have the power to innovate for good. You’ll see your ideas in use in new applications, work with the latest technology on leading platforms, and deliver meaningful solutions for our customers. The Senior Mechanical Engineer is responsible for system level designs and prototype fabrication of the hardware portion on our FDA Class II registered AAC devices. The senior mechanical engineer utilizes a 3D CAD platform (SolidWorks), which includes solid modeling and surface modeling, assembly modeling, and 2D drawing development to meet the program requirements and needs of our device users. The senior mechanical engineer will collaborate with other mechanical engineers, industrial designers, electrical engineers, product managers, project managers, QA/RA, sourcing and suppliers, as well as our manufacturing group in China to ensure program design activities, goals and targets are completed on-time, on budget, to ensure a successful product. A key emphasis is the ability to contribute to a fast-paced development team to bring engineering solutions from concept through production to give our customers a voice utilizing our AAC devices. Responsibilities and Accountabilities: Conceptual and detailed design of molded components (plastic and metal), sheet metal and machined components. Generate parts, assemblies, and drawings using SolidWorks. Develop innovative solutions that support the project requirements. Hands on prototyping and proof of concept. Work as part of a team of mechanical and manufacturing engineering staff to bring projects through prototyping and into production launch. Perform and present gated design reviews with both internal staff and external vendors at specific times in the design life cycle of an AAC device. - Participate in the ECO process and support change management. Develop BOMs and part numbers in our QMS system. Risk management Who we are looking for : Minimum Education And Experience Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering and 5-10+ years relevant work experience developing complex plastic/metal injection molded components that can be tooled and molded. Electronics hardware development experience preferred. Required Skills and Education: Experience with detail part/assembly/drawing development is required Experience with design for manufacturability and assembly is required Proficient utilizing SolidWorks Proficient in complex 3D solid and surface modeling All Microsoft Office software and Teams Great problem solving and communication skills Experience being part of a high-performance team in a fast-paced environment Ability to maintain a safe working environment Preferred Skills and Education: Background in FDA registered Class II medical devices An understanding of ISO 13485 standards and IEC60601 Experience with AAC devices Experience with CAD PDM data management and Arena or similar QMS system Plastic injection molding tool development Collaborating with a world-wide team (USA, China, Sweden) Apply today! description: Nu letar vi efter en CAD-konstruktör / Resident Engineer till ESSIQ Väst! ESSIQ är arbetsgivaren som anstränger sig lite extra för att du ska må bra. Vad är medarbetarfokus för dig? Du blir länken mellan leverantören och fordonstillverkaren och ansvarar för att konstruktionsunderlag, CAD-modeller och ändringar hanteras korrekt och i rätt tid. Du är bra på att föra samtal om dig, arbetsteamet och leveransen inför en eller flera åhörare. Du är lyhörd och hjälpsam – tar in kunskap från omvärld och kollegor, och delar gärna med dig av din egen. Du är generös med tips, hjälp och stöd. Lön och förmåner: Konkurrenskraftig fast eller rörlig lön. Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och generösa förmåner. Tjänstepension, omfattande försäkringar. Placering: ESSIQ Väst – på plats hos kund i Göteborg. OM ESSIQ ESSIQ är teknikkonsultföretaget där allt börjar med dig. Med fokus på individen, flexibla lösningar och en modern lönepolicy attraherar vi de skarpaste, mest professionella och engagerade personerna i branschen. Med denna vision grundades ESSIQ år 2005, sedan dess har vi utvecklats till ett framgångsrikt företag med kontor i Stockholm, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi består idag av över 250 medarbetare med olika bakgrund, personlighet och nationalitet, med en god fördelning av kvinnor och män. ESSIQ:s medarbetare arbetar med användarcentrerad tjänste- och produktutveckling inom följande tjänsteområden: UX & Service Design, Connected & Embedded Systems, IT & Cloud Services, Green Technology & Electromobility, Test & Quality Engineering, Agile Management, Mechanical Engineering samt Simulation & Visualization. Våra medarbetares intressen och ambitioner leder vägen – vårt mål är att göra den perfekta matchningen av individ och uppdrag. ESSIQ är ett familjärt och socialt företag med visionen att vara Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare för alla medarbetare, oavsett roll i organisationen. Vi lägger stor vikt vid gemenskap och har ett uppskattat utbud av professionella och sociala aktiviteter. Vår kommunikationsplattform genomsyras av öppenhet, och främjar nätverkande och kompetensutbyte såväl som fritidsaktiviteter och relationsbyggande. title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Company Description Cellular Origins Cell therapies have the potential to transform how devastating diseases such as cancer are treated. But for more patients to benefit, these therapies need to be manufactured reliably, efficiently and at a scale the industry has not been able to achieve before. At Cellular Origins, we’re changing that. Our Constellation platform brings robotics and automation into cell therapy manufacturing, helping developers scale their processes without having to redesign the biology or proven equipment behind them. As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer, you’ll help make that possible by turning complex mechanical challenges into precise, dependable designs that work not just once, but every time. Job Description This is an opportunity to take real ownership of some of the most mechanically demanding parts of our robotic manufacturing system. You’ll get the autonomy to design critical precision modules from concept through to manufacture, using your judgement and experience to move quickly towards solutions that are robust, repeatable and practical to build. You’ll join an interdisciplinary team spanning mechanical engineering, robotics, software, systems and biology. Your work will sit at the point where precision engineering meets a very human goal: making cell therapies accessible to far more patients. You’ll bring depth in precision design of complex electromechanical devices and use it to help us build a system that can perform reliably in demanding manufacturing environments. You’ll Get To Own the detailed mechanical design of critical modules within our robotic manufacturing platform. Turn early concepts and prototypes into stable, manufacturable designs that perform consistently. Build detailed tolerance analyses and use the right analytical techniques to understand and improve performance. Make thoughtful decisions around materials, manufacturing methods and component design. Work hands-on with prototypes and hardware, learning quickly from what you see and feeding that back into better designs. Collaborate closely with engineers from other disciplines to solve system-level challenges rather than isolated component problems. Use your experience to spot risks early and guide designs from “it works” to “it works all the time”. Help raise the standard of mechanical design across the team by sharing your judgement, methods and experience. Qualifications Requirements You’ll thrive here if precision design is something you genuinely enjoy. You notice the details that matter, but you also know when to stop analysing and build something. You’ll bring a strong engineering foundation alongside hands-on experience taking products through development and into manufacture. You’ll Also Bring A Mechanical Engineering degree, or a science-based degree with strong, relevant industrial experience. Hands-on experience designing precision devices across length scales from tens of microns to tens of millimetres. Proven experience developing complex electromechanical products and delivering them into manufacture. Proven experience working in cross-functional / cross-disciplinary teams. Experience leveraging analytical techniques to support design decisions with a particular focus on tolerance analyses, FEA and motor calculations. Strong 3D CAD capability, ideally using SolidWorks. Deep knowledge of material selection and manufacturing processes. Experience improving designs until they are consistently reliable, not simply functional. The ability to work collaboratively, challenge assumptions and make sound engineering decisions with incomplete information. Desired Experience Experience working in regulated industry with a particular emphasis on design for GMP. Experience creating appropriate documentation to support release of products for use in regulatory environments. Additional Information Cellular Origins is currently based on the TTP Campus, within purpose-built sustainable offices, labs and green surroundings, 10 miles south of Cambridge. Our working culture encourages entrepreneurship, shared ideas and collaboration, while providing you the freedom to do your best work. Our employee benefits include: Annual bonus 25 days holiday Employer pension contribution of 10% of salary Private medical insurance for employees and dependants Enhanced family friendly leave Life insurance worth 6x salary Electric car leasing scheme Cycle to work scheme Season ticket loan

title: Design & Analysis Engineer
description: We are looking for a Design & Analysis Engineer on behalf of and in support to our client for their location in Noordwijk, The Netherlands . Please note that this position is also offered at two other client locations, namely Galway (Ireland) and Rome (Italy). Further information can be provided during the interview process. For our in-house composites department, CompositesLab, we are looking for a bright and enthusiastic Design & Analysis Engineer with a passion for and deep understanding of composite structures & materials to join our growing team. CompositesLab is one of ATG’s internal engineering business units, with team members based in the Netherlands, Ireland and Italy. Our talented team is composed of highly motivated, multi-disciplinary engineers with a diverse international background. Since 2013, CompositesLab has been developing a game-changing composite CFRP lattice and grid-stiffened structure technology. This technology provides optimised structural solutions that are mass-efficient and cost-effective, allowing our customers to meet the stringent constraints of space applications. Initially developed internally at ATG and further supported through several large-scale ESA development programmes, the technology has now advanced to a level where real space applications are being realised. These applications include components for launchers (e.g. interstage and upper stage structures), satellite structures (e.g. central cylinders), and multi-payload adapters. Please note, the successful candidate will be employed by ATG Europe (or one of its subsidiaries). Furthermore, upon selection, they will be subject to a general security screening performed by an external provider (further information will be provided at interview stage). The successful candidate will be tasked with, but not limited to: Top level design and system engineering on composite technologies and products; CAD modelling and design; FE modelling, analysis, and optimisation; Setting up and improving design, analysis, and optimisation procedures; Developing testing processes for large spacecraft components; Reporting and documentation; CAD modelling and design; Supporting design for manufacturing activities; Supporting or partaking in manufacturing of components; Supporting or partaking in testing of components; Supporting the preparation of business proposals; Supporting the development of the supply chain including quality assurance activities; Organising, performing and supervising various research activities; Interfacing with customers as part of projects or business development. ATG is dedicated to diversity and inclusion and is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, handicap (categorie protette L.68/99 art.1), or any other reason protected by relevant state or municipal legislation, we are pleased to consider all eligible candidates for employment. Please ensure that your CV clearly explains how you meet the mandatory requirements. If it doesn’t align completely with the essential criteria, it could result in rejection. MSc degree in engineering (aerospace or mechanical); 5 years of relevant work experience; Ability to work autonomously across multiple disciplines; Affinity with fibre-reinforced composite materials and structures; Knowledge of design and optimisation methods, analytical and numerical, from conceptual design to detailed optimisation methods; Experience with FE model setup and analysis, preferably of composites; Experience with commercial FE tools (preferably FEMAP with NX/MSC Nastran); Experience with dynamic analysis including sine and random vibration; Experience with CAD software (preferably CATIA V5); Affinity and preferably experience with manufacturing methods for composites; Affinity and experience with manufacturing processes for metals is an advantage; Awareness of the advantages, disadvantages, and limitations of analysis and manufacturing methods; Basic programming skills (preferably in Python); Experience of working with ECSS standards and requirements is advantageous; Well organised and capable of organising an efficient workflow; Capable of working in an ambitious team with occasional peaks in workload; Open-minded attitude, with a capability to challenge industry standards; Personal initiative and thirst for improvement and developing new skills; Willing to travel for work; Fluency in English (additional languages are advantageous); At least a rudimentary sense of humour is appreciated. Please submit your application in English via the apply button below. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered. Due date: 2026-11-27

title: Structural Engineer – Offshore Wind & Cathodic Protection (NL-based)
description: For our office in Schiedam (The Netherlands), we are looking for a structural engineer who likes variety. You will be responsible for the structural integrity of our CP products and play a key engineering and project role in a new product line for offshore wind. This is not a role where you stay behind one screen. Next to calculations, you will coordinate projects, talk with suppliers and clients, and help wherever the team needs you. We are looking for a true multi-skilled professional who is eager to learn and embrace new opportunities. Your key responsibilities will be: Structural engineering • Perform strength calculations for ICCP anodes, mounting brackets, cable protection and other CP products • Carry out ULS and FLS (fatigue) assessments in line with offshore standards such as DNV and Eurocode • Assess vortex-induced vibration (ViV) risk for subsea and splash-zone components • Build and run FEM models, and check results with hand calculations • Write clear calculation reports and design notes for clients and certifying bodies • Review drawings and give design input to improve strength, weight and manufacturability New product line • Lead the structural design of a new offshore wind product, from concept to delivery • Translate client specifications and standards into design requirements • Support material selection, fabrication methods and testing • Write user manuals, assembly and installation instructions, and other product documentation Project management • Coordinate engineering deliverables, planning and document control for your projects • Be the technical contact for clients, suppliers, fabricators and third-party verifiers • Review technical parts of RFQs, tenders and contracts • Monitor progress, risks and changes, and report to management Broader team support • Help colleagues with technical questions across CP, anti-fouling and offshore projects • Contribute to product development, quotations and process improvement • Occasional travel to suppliers, yards or client offices Ideally, you identify yourself in the following profile: Must have • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil, Structural, Mechanical or Offshore Engineering • At least 3 years of experience in structural design for offshore, marine or heavy steel structures • Hands-on experience with ULS, FLS and ViV calculations • Proficient in FEM software (for example ANSYS, Abaqus, SACS, SCIA or Femap) and tools such as Mathcad or Python • Working knowledge of relevant standards (DNV, Eurocode, ISO) • Experience with, or a clear interest in, project coordination • Fluent in English; Dutch is a strong advantage Who you are • A hands-on all-rounder who is happy to switch between tasks • Curious, willing to learn and not afraid to take on something new • Independent, but a real team player in a small company • Practical and solution-oriented, with clear communication skills What we offer • A varied role with real responsibility from day one • The chance to shape a new product line in offshore wind • A small, informal team where your contribution is visible • Room to grow in engineering, project management or both • International projects and an energy-transition market • Competitive salary and benefits, based on experience About OES Group OES Group designs and supplies corrosion protection and asset integrity solutions for offshore wind and marine infrastructure. Our core is cathodic protection (CP), including impressed current (ICCP) systems and anti-fouling technology, delivered to projects across Europe, the Middle East and Asia. Our Dutch office in Schiedam is a small, close-knit team with a family atmosphere. We work hard, help each other out, and short lines mean your work has direct impact. How to apply Send your CV and a short motivation to hr-nl@oesgroupltd.com. Questions about the role? Please contact us via: hr-nl@oesgroupltd.com. Please note: We currently prefer a candidate who is immediately employable and not dependent on application for a work and/or residence permit, because we cannot facilitate this application immediately. Telephone acquisition is not appreciated.
